Deathtrap Mode

An ancient marvel built by master artisans, the Ephor's Palace stands solemnly as a silent witness to the shifts of Septimont through the ages. As the administrative center of Septimont, it upholds the city's order and cohesion. Here, Septimont's leaders convene daily with the Ephor to chart the course of the land's future.
Ephor's Palace
Leviathan's avatar rises with the boundless Dark Tide, seeking to "unify" the world in eternal darkness. Stand against the end, and fight for the faintest hope of dawn.
Weekly Challenge: Dark End
Amidst the bamboo grove verdant, a killing edge lies hidden.
As the Bamboo Leaf Falls

The Lament's lingering power gathers here, replaying the battles of the past.
Those unfulfilled dreams, unresolved obsessions… They are no myth.
Neon Tower: Observation Deck

Founded with the core mission to nurture "Synchronists" capable of Augmented Resonance with the Exostrider, Startorch Academy established Rabelle College. Its research is built upon three domains: Exostrider studies, Void Storms, and Reactor Drive energy, giving rise to the Departments of Exostrider Engineering, Voidmatters Science, and Light Energy Sciences. Within the latter, the Division of Ecology Conservation, closely tied to the work of the Exo Genesis Labs, is affectionately nicknamed the "Agronomy Wing."
Startorch Academy Departments

A live-fire facility for testing tactical weaponry and mechanized constructs, operated by the Division of Tactical Development under the Department of Exostrider Engineering. This site supports full-scale weapon validations and equipment trials, and its grounds are open to all Academy faculty and students.
Tactical Proving Grounds

Bathed in the constant radiance of the Reactor Drive, this plain teems with life. Flora, fauna, and Exoswarm creatures convert light and heat into diverse energy forms, channeling them through intricate ecological cycles. Every being contributes to this self-sustaining web of life.
Etching Plains

A vast valley stretching between the Starward Riseway and the Etching Plains. Its name, translated from Royan itself, refers to the jagged square cliffs and stone spires that jut from the valley like the serrated teeth of a giant, forever studded into a scar upon the earth.
Fangspire Chasm

An arched region that collapsed many years ago during a subterranean Void Storm eruption. As the land gave way, buried cable grids and mechanical spinal frameworks were laid bare like the sinew and bone of the earth itself.
Collapsed Arcbend Ravine

The Roya elders are organized into the Six—three pairs holding roles such as the Eye, the Binder, and the Shaper. Each pair is entrusted with a core function: observation, archival, and extrapolation. They dwell within the Solisylum, linking their consciousness to the Heliogyre to trace the Reactor Drive's trajectories and forecast Void Storms. To maximize efficiency, only one of the Six remains awake during each cycle to oversee daily affairs. At the close of each season, Shepherds from all settlements gather in Bjartr Woods to deliver their recorded data, which the Six then deliberate upon to chart the future.
The Heliodic Six

Officially Spacetrek Collective: Research Institute, it stands as part of the same borderless research initiative—the Spacetrek Collective—as Startorch Academy. Its mission is to extract and apply advanced technologies. Linked directly to the Starward Riseway, the Institute rests above the greatsword's tip like a guarding Stargram, watching over Lahai-Roi from above.
Research Institute

The sun of Lahai-Roi, the source of its life, the cornerstone of the Royas' sacred duty, and the heart of the Spacetrek Collective's Helios Project. But now, the Exostrider's heart is corrupted by the Threnodian's frequencies, teetering on the brink of collapse. Should it fall, an eternal night will engulf the world.
Exostrider's Reactor Drive

The Dreamer seals her heart and surrenders to a world of dreams beyond mortal sight. In this hidden realm built upon melancholy melodies, she walks a path of fragile hope and delusions without looking back. But the dreams she longs to realize have long been tangled up in shadow and deceit. Beneath the lofty facade of the Orchestrator, who seems to have everything, is but a wretched, pitiful soul, drowning in her own illusions.
In the end, will this dream of blooming and withering be a sweet reverie or a haunting nightmare?
Unfading Melody of Life

As the hunt begins, horns blare and fearless roars tear through the skies. Beneath the blazing sun, Gladiators gather, blades aflame with valor, swearing to protect Septimont. 
When the Dark Tide surges once more, the foretold hero shall rise to conquer the abyss and defy fate.
By Sun's Scourge, By Moon's Revelation
Everything you've done, the world will forever remember.
Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides

When the forsaken city crumbles, neon hues twist and devour the past. Between loops of ruin and rebirth, only the unfulfilled longings linger. In this stagnant season, the warm, simple bonds shall become blades to sever the chains.
Last night's stars still burn. The dawn of tomorrow will arrive.
To the City Set in Amber

Beneath the Startorch, we pledge to carry its flame forward, to stand beside kindred minds, and to push back the frontiers of knowledge. Let every quest for truth be a spark against the long night until it fades. Together, we build a dawn that is ours.
Startorch Academy Student Declaration:

The Priestesses have forgotten. Augusta has forgotten... Even though the world has forgotten, you remember Iuno. After all, you see her once again.
With her bracelet and the moonlight to guide you, you walk on. You don't know where the path leads, only that you must keep going, until the moonlight finally falls.
Where Moonlight Falls

Humble and unadorned, this place offers a transitory respite in the looping Lament.
Here, infinite loops pile atop each other, and people's cries become sustenance for the Lament. In the ruins of chaos, only the Tower shows its true face...

Inside Neon Tower, she fell into the cage of her own making.
Perhaps the girl never truly left her hometown, just as she never escaped her past…
Never in memory has Honami been this quiet…. Chisa, where are you?

The unfamiliar city teeters on the verge of collapse.
From the depths of your memory comes a faint, painful whisper... This is the Lament.

A ruined city, like amber trapped in the Sonoro. Once-bustling streets lie overgrown with wild grass, low roads swallowed by seawater. The Lament repeats endlessly, and time and space are fractured, but this view seems frozen, stopped in a silent eternity.

This soaring communication tower once embodied people's ambition to connect through radio waves. But eventually, it was here that the Lament began. Now, within its disordered heart, it recreates glimpses of familiar pasts, as if luring others to step deeper inside…
Neon Tower: Base

The past, the reality, the Lament... Such is the view from atop Neon Tower. See them. Face them. Confront them.
Step into tomorrow. Nothing can stand in your way.
Neon Tower: Observation Deck

When Voidmatter density reaches a critical threshold, the Shimmer descends from the skies and the earth quakes beneath it—the Void Storm follows, Lahai-Roi's most devastating catastrophe. All matter dissolves into nothingness, while infected Exoswarm mutate into massive Voidworms, casting devouring shadows across the land.
Void Storm

When a Resonator's mental strength and Forte are pushed beyond their limits for an extended period, it can lead to a rare state called "Overclocking." While this condition can be managed, there's no permanent cure. In extreme cases, the Tacet Mark can expand uncontrollably, devouring everything around it, with the Overclocked Resonators ultimately becoming a Tacet Discord of the Tacet Field.
Overclock I

Formed from Tacetite and hidden in the Stormy Sea, this archipelago is a sanctuary for the world's most talented individuals. With a mission to combat the destructive Lament, it has fostered extensive partnerships across Solaris-3. While its advanced technologies are shared with the outside world, their origins remain a mystery, even to its members.
The Black Shores

Modulation is the process of adjusting frequencies. In Solaris-3, frequencies serve as a crucial tool for uncovering the truth about reality. By altering these frequencies, one can delve into the very core of existence.
At the Black Shores, modulating Stellar Matrices is crucial for tracing and analyzing the Lament. Over the course of the Black Shores' history, only one individual has ever been honored with the title of "The Modulator."
Modulation

Memories converge into frequencies at the fingertip, where sound and form unite—the authority you were born with. Formless echoes coalesce through your power, as you continuously weave a deeper resonance with the world.
Reminiscence

The Sentinel of Rinascita, the one who guided the settlers to this promised land to escape from the Lament. In the faith of the Order of the Deep, They are often depicted as a being with the upper body of a horse and the lower body of a fish. Though Imperator rarely reveals Their presence to the world, They often deliver Oracles through the Laureate of Carnevale.
Imperator

A Waveworn Phenomenon native to Rinascita. It gathers in the sky above and eventually breaks, pouring down in torrents. Wherever the Dark Tide strikes, it spawns Tacet Discords, and the area around its point of origin becomes a new Tacet Field. According to the Order of the Deep, the two significant Dark Tides that occurred in history were stopped by Napoli the Second and the Blessed Maiden Fleurdelys respectively.
Dark Tide I

Thanks to the Genesis Nexus, Rinascita's Echoes can exist without Reserved Terminals. The people of Ragunna revere Common Echoes as divine gifts from Sentinel Imperator and treat them as friends and trusted allies. Managed by the Order of the Deep, Common Echoes are incorporated into every aspect of daily life, which is the very symbol that has earned Rinascita its name as the "Land of Echoes."
Common Echo

Rinascita's central Resonance Nexus, also known as the Genesis Nexus. According to legend, Imperator revealed the secrets of the Genesis Nexus to the Rinascitans, enabling them to construct other such towering monuments that stand as symbols of the Sentinel's power and sovereignty. Within the reach of the Genesis Nexus, Echoes can endure in physical form without relying on Terminals.
World of Sighs

With the Reactor Core restored and the New Solar Ceremony a success, the Academy's Executive Committee has announced that this year's showcase will be co-hosted with the Roya. Under the theme "New Solar Celebration," the event aims to deepen the bonds between both peoples.

New Moon's Blessing

New Moon, where light finds its fresh start.
One of Septimont's divinatory Lunar Phases. The New Moon heralds the dawn of the lunar cycle, with its surface veiled entirely in shadow.
The New Moon symbolizes rebirth and a new beginning:
After its long journey through the heavens, the moon circles back to its starting point, renewed and ready to begin anew.
The shadow drinks the moon. The world stirs anew.
The future remains unwritten, yet already, it stirs toward change.

Hard to observe? But it's just right to me.
Isn't everything born from emptiness, after all?
New Moon

Crescent Moon's Blessing

Crescent Moon, where light begins its spread.
One of Septimont's divinatory Lunar Phases. Following the New Moon, shadows start to retreat, and a sliver of light graces the sky.
The Crescent Moon symbolizes growth and hope:
The delicate arc of light grows fuller night by night in the eyes of those who gaze upward.
The crescent glows in silver. A song hums you forward.
The idealist's flame shall not grow dim tonight.

Night after night, it just wants to be more complete.
That's the happiest a moon ever gets, don't you think?
Crescent Moon

First Quarter's Blessing

First Quarter, where a bow of light is drawn against the veil.
One of Septimont's divinatory Lunar Phases. It is a half-lit moon, bright on the right, where light and shadow evenly divide the lunar surface.
The First Quarter symbolizes action and challenge:
After a long wait, the time to step toward the full light has finally come.
The darkness thins. The moonlight blooms.
This is the hour when light and shadow entwine, the hour of trial.

Walk the fine line where light meets shadow.
Past on one side, future on the other.
First Quarter
Reduces Flight STA cost for all Resonators in the team by 30% for 3h. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
Waxing Gibbous's Blessing

Waxing Gibbous, where ascent awaits.
One of Septimont's divinatory Lunar Phases. It is the time when the Full Moon is near, shadows are almost gone, and moonlight brightens the night.
The Waxing Gibbous symbolizes adjustment and preparation:
The restless edge of transformation calls for self-adjustment that leads to a breakthrough.
Waxing moon gilds the river. Waning night bathes in gold.
Even the stillness of waiting will one day become the past.

Will it rain tomorrow night? Will the moon shine brighter?
Something about the gibbous phase always stretches the night.
Waxing Gibbous

Full Moon's Blessing

Full Moon, where clarity rules.
One of Septimont's divinatory Lunar Phases. The moon reaches its brightest, wholly unshadowed and facing the world in full.
The Full Moon symbolizes wholeness and release:
The flawless silver mirror reflects the purest dreams held in every heart.
The night unveils in perfect glow. The moon ascends with flawless hope.
All the beauties and ideals, ripened at the right time, have already fused with life itself.

This is the Lunar Phase said to symbolize perfection and fullness.
They say that's when people remember their brightest moments.
Full Moon

Waning Gibbous's Blessing

Waning Gibbous, where brightness dims yet lingers.
One of Septimont's divinatory Lunar Phases. After the Full Moon, darkness returns, and the light begins its quiet retreat.
The Waning Gibbous symbolizes reflection and sharing:
All things wax and wane, so joy and sorrow are intertwined by nature's design.
Each gleaming pearl bears different marks. All waning moons share the same path.
The clamoring aftersound, too, will become a beacon towards tomorrow.
The more people cling to yesterday, the easier they forget that tomorrow's already on its way.
Waning Gibbous

Last Quarter's Blessing

Last Quarter, where darkness reclaims its share.
One of Septimont's divinatory Lunar Phases. It is a half-lit moon, bright on the left, where light and shadow evenly divide the lunar surface.
The Last Quarter symbolizes release and decision:
In the shifting tides, seasoned sailors know when to let go.
The half-moon comes as it must. The radiance hides as it should.
Those who reflect themselves in darkness will find their way to peace and clarity.

Bid the time. Stay hidden. Assess the situation.
Hah, definitely not my kind of moon.

Waning Crescent's Blessing

Waning Crescent, where only a glimmer remains.
One of Septimont's divinatory Lunar Phases. The final stage of the cycle, with only a faint shimmer clinging to the edge of shadow.
The Waning Crescent symbolizes rest and settlement:
Even the grandest journey calls for a pause to gather breath.
A final sliver remains. The world sleeps in fatigue.
Wisdom, gathered and stored, accumulates in silent hope.

Even a waning crescent can light up the sky.
Those saying the moon's almost gone... Did they even ask the moon?

Twin Moons, where two lives intertwine. 
A unique and unpredictable Lunar Phase in Septimont. Two crescent moons rise back to back in silent symmetry.
The Twin Moons symbolize trust and friendship:
With a steadfast ally by your side, even the longest night loses its terror.
Hope leans close. Faint light endures.
Even the faintest glows can endure an endless night by sticking together.

I've always been the one and only moon in this world.
No one else could make it this far anyway.

Rippled Moon, where changes return to one.
A unique and unpredictable Lunar Phase in Septimont. The Rippled Moon shimmers with layered, wave-like brilliance that flows across its surface.

In this world, only the whirl of ceaseless change endures forever.
Nothing goes without destiny. Everything moves as one.
The ever-shifting whirl is, in itself, an eternal instant.

Chasing some fixed eternity... What a foolish thing.
If fate won't hand it over, go fetch it yourself.

After the Great Agon, Cartethyia once again felt the lingering power of the Threnodian. You journey to the sea in search of answers, but are met with resistance from Fenrico, the Primus of the Order, who desires for you to sink forever in the deep. But Phrolova saves you from the raging waves.
The unknown ocean depths, enemies with unforeseen actions, and a gem coveted by many... everything swirls like a current, pulling you into its grasp. Where will this underwater adventure lead?
Chapter II Act VII
By Sun's Burning Hand

As the High Tide draws near, a lurking calamity stirs, with its gaze fixed upon the borders of Septimont. Ephor Augusta invites you to the Sanguis Plateaus for a fateful hunt, the one that may decide the realm's survival. To recover the lost relic of Sentinel Imperator and halt the Dark Tide before it devours Rinascita once more, you and the Gladiators of Septimont set out for the expedition...

But in the unforgiving wilds of the Sanguis Plateaus, the boundary between the hunter and hunted is perilously thin. Who truly holds the reins of fate? And who shall rise to wear the crown of glory? Only the victor has the right to answer.
Chapter II Act VIII
Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides

Following the defeat of the False Sovereign, Rinascita enjoys a brief period of tranquility. To open the Civilization Capsule left by Imperator, you and Abby prep for Ragunna to find Cartethyia, only to discover that the people of Ragunna are being plagued by nightmares. Meanwhile, inside the Inverted Tower, Avinoleum, the returning Discord Slayer fires her pistol at the once Blessed Maiden...
With Cartethyia's "death," the Fractsidus's "story" in Rinascita approaches its final chapter. Leviathan has been reborn from the Gem, and the prophesied Journeying Paradise makes its descent. Even though no Divinity remains on this land, familiar faces have begun to take action to prevent Rinascita's doom. Bearing everyone's will, you are determined to step into the Dark Tide...
Chapter II Act X & XI
Stagnant Dawn on Wastelands

With events in Rinascita finally over, you return once more to the Black Shores to find them investigating abnormal frequencies in nearby waters. During the investigation, you are pulled into the rift and soon awaken in a ruined, restless city. And as the situation grows dire, a mysterious black-haired girl appears before you… At this point, where time is frozen, sever the endless loop and embrace the dawn of the future.
Chapter II Act XII
What Burns Beneath Frostlands
The gateway to Lahai-Roi is now open! What burns beneath the frostlands is waiting for your return!

An area at the base of Capitoline Hill, near the Borderline Fort. Herds graze in peace throughout lush pastures, and scattered villages nestle among ancient ruins. Yet even in such tranquility, small arenas remain a vital part of life.
Capitoline Foothills

A vast plain framed by mountain ranges. Named for the giant boulder clusters left by ancient lava flows, it was here that Septimontian civilization first took root centuries ago. Now, only scattered old villages remain, where wayfaring outlanders often rest before crossing into the Septimont highlands.
Titanbone Expanse

A precipitous mountain range that marks the border of Septimont. The craggy peaks form a natural barrier between Septimont and the outside world. During the first outbreak of the Dark Tide, the Border Mountains bore the brunt, leaving them forever scarred by ashen traces and Tidal Blight calcification.
Border Mountains

The remains of a coast eroded by the Dark Tide. Temples and sacred statues once erected by Ragunnesi Acolytes now lie in ruin. Their silent halls, devoid of worshippers, are spread across the canyon floor, transformed into haunted dwellings of Tacet Discords.
Mournfell Canyon

A dragon of yore once perished in the Border Mountains, attracting numerous dissonant frequencies. Over the years, the area became plagued by Tacet Discords and ferocious creatures. Founding Septimontians saw it as a testing ground for warriors to prove their mettle, leaving behind countless tales of glory. This continued until the first Dark Tide swept through, laying waste to this sanctum of trials and burying its honor beneath Tidal Blight.
Ashen Dragon's Crypt

Officially known as "Remnant Cubes," these advanced artificial intelligences were created for the Second Coming of Solaris using Encore's abilities and Tethys's microprocessing support.
The Remnant Cubes differ from their originals in subtle to outright obvious ways. The cause of these variations remains unclear. Is it the user acting as the anchor point, Tethys's scanning and data support, or Encore's artistic leeway as the master artisan?
Remnant Cubes

Ciaccona's Sonoro Sphere, created through her perception of melodies and echoes.
Memories and stories carried by the melodies manifest here as still, frozen images.
But through Ciaccona's tuning, these stories and memories come together as notes on a music sheet.
As the notes play, the images begin to move and unfold.
Realm of Melodies
What will become of this twisted tale? What awaits at the end of this path, beyond the heroes' triumph...?
"The Finale"

In broad daylight, Daemons once devoured in a great fire whisper through the streets of Ragunna. They wield beloved poetry and music as weapons of their curse. A confrontation, wrapped in the language of art, begins to unfold on the stage of Rinascita.
Remnants of past sins resurge. From deep beneath the earth, they scheme and plot. When the flames that once ripped through the night return, a silent war will begin.
Fiery Arpeggio of Summer Reunion

The brighter the glory, the deeper the shadow. Amid the arena's deafening roar, tales of joy distort and drown in the icy embrace of the deep.
A champion's path is fraught with peril. When glory itself is burnt to ash by its own flames, none can say who will reach the end victorious.
Lightly We Toss the Crown

A masquerade that never ends, with music that never sleeps... During the Carnevale, people cast off the chains of society and reveal their truest selves. But now, the city is drowned in silence. Will your arrival lift the veil of quiet, and bring back the joy and song to the streets?

Chapter III Act III

After the New Solar Ceremony, your campus life kicks off. In class, you cross paths with a "ghost girl," Aemeath, a Synchronist presumed dead more than a decade ago. Why is she lingering at the Academy? What's her connection with you? To uncover the truth about her and the root cause of your fading frequency, you and Aemeath set out for the Roya Frostlands, where the Exostrider slumbers.
Gold Suspended in Shadows
Chapter III Act IV

As the New Solar Celebration kicks off, the air of Startorch Academy is filled with festivity. Yet beneath the surface, abnormal frequencies fester within the Academy's Dark Side, a subconscious dimension birthed from students' emotions. At President Lucilla's request, you take a dive into this psychic realm, where you encounter Sigrika—a spirited honor student hailed as a future successor to the Heliodic Six. As you venture forth, it soon becomes clear that the riddles and murmurs haunting the Dark Side harbor a far more sinister intent...
Starlights from Yesterdays
Chapter III Act V

With the Academy's Dark Side incident resolved, your pursuit of the Fractsidus brings you briefly face-to-face with an aloof white-haired miko who wields a blade. But before the Exostrider can awaken, the Threnodian in the underground Dimmr Plains begin flaring with alarming frequency, forcing the Spacetrek Collective to consider an emergency evacuation of Lahai-Roi. To keep the Exostrider plan alive, you move into action. And as the Void Storm spreads, Aemeath's ever-silent "shell" seems to be whispering to herself...
At Dream's Edge
Chapter III Side Story

A strange gate appears out of nowhere at Startorch Academy. Behind it, reality-invading frequencies leak through. To investigate the crisis, you step through the threshold and into the Somnoire, where you encounter Lucy and Rebecca as they battle a swarm of Nightmare Tacet Discords. But as you explore further, you uncover an unlikely truth…

Sol-III, the third planet from the sun. A world of chaos and change, where old conventions are discarded and disasters run rampant. Human civilization struggles to survive in this new era of destruction and rebirth, facing uncharted challenges with unwavering determination.

The Lament's power causes destructive waves across the land of Solaris. Manifestations like the "Tacet Fields," "Tacet Discord Outbreaks," and the enigmatic "Tacetite" are part of what is collectively known as the "Waveworn Phenomena."

The term "Lament" refers to the ongoing catastrophic events on Solaris-3. Since the onset of the first Lament, the cycle of destruction has persisted relentlessly. The tide of devastation remains ceaseless, with no signs of stopping.

The "Tacet Fields" are thought to be where all Tacet Discords originate. These locations feature a sky of inverted seas and a deep cross-shaped Tacet Mark on the ground. Reverberations fill the air, linking our world to an unknown space through a white Resonance Cord. These areas attract gatherings of Tacet Discords.

Individuals with the ability to resonate with certain objects and manipulate their frequencies are known as "Resonators." These individuals exhibit unique "Resonance Abilities," also known as their "Fortes," through the "Tacet Mark" on their bodies. According to experts, a Resonator's abilities are often influenced by their past experiences and subconscious mind.

Tacet Discords, created by the Waveworn Phenomena, are dangerous entities with ever-changing, amorphous forms. They possess "Tacet Cores" and feed on other frequencies to maintain stability and evolve. These creatures mimic their prey's abilities, shapes, and behaviors, influenced by the types of frequency they consume.

A type of special frequency that can be captured by the Terminal to reproduce Tacet Discords' abilities.
Tacet Discords may leave behind "Reverberations" when they are eliminated, which can then be transformed into "Echoes" through the Terminal's Data Bank, providing a useful advantage in battle.

Wherever there is civilization and history, there will be Sentinels. They serve as mankind's guardians and guides. Their immortal existence has helped humanity through countless troubles, sharing wisdom and prophecies. As we embark on a new journey after enduring the Lament, the Sentinels remain our record keeper and beacon in times of disaster.

Jinzhou, a fortified city on the frontier, stands guard against the looming Tacet Discord crisis. As one of Huanglong's six major regions, it bears the weight of this responsibility as the youngest provincial capital. The Midnight Rangers defend its northern border without hesitation.

Threnodians are formidable creatures born from the Laments, with the power to destroy human spirit and feed off of their collapsed will. If civilizations represent mankind's collective will, the Threnodians embody our fears and struggles. They manifest as destructive Tacet Discord disasters spreading across the planet.

The Waveworn Phenomena is believed to alter matter, information, and energy by converting them into vibrating "frequencies" referred to as "Reverberations." This process has been observed through experimental evidence in the academic community.

A form of pure energy with complete frequencies. The information it carries transcends time and space, enduring in a stable, unchanging state.
In their studies of Waveworn Phenomena, scientists discovered "Tacetite"—a substance that can permanently hold Remnant Energy. The Tacetite can be made into potent weapons for Resonators to combat Tacet Discords. Transdimensional spaces where Remnant Energy is abundant are known as the Sonoro Spheres.

End of Wandering

A nation of independent city-states scattered across a vast archipelago, with no central administrative center. Legends speak of Rinascita's founders, who fled their homeland and sailed to these islands to escape the Lament. 
The Rinascitan people, with their unique "Common Echoes," have integrated Echoes into every facet of their lives. This is how the nation came to be known as the "Land of Echoes."
Rinascita

Ragunna City, the administrative center of the Ragunna city-state in Rinascita, is a thriving port city by the sea, its districts linked by winding waterways. The Ragunnesi are devout followers of the Sentinel, who believe Common Echoes to be gifts from the Sentinel that carry Their divine will.
In addition to their faith, the people of Ragunna are also known for their love of the arts. Magnificent sculptures and paintings grace the city at every turn, and impromptu performances often bring the streets to life.
Ragunna City

The Order of the Deep worships Sentinel Imperator and holds de facto rule over Ragunna. According to city tradition, the Order's clergy serve as the Sentinel's earthly emissaries, guiding the people with Their divine word. Under the leadership of the current Primus, Fenrico, a series of laws were enacted to restrict certain themes in artistic expression. These laws have sparked divided opinion among the city's inhabitants.
Order of the Deep

At the farthest reaches of Whisperwind Haven lies an island where a labyrinth of woods and ruins surrounds a central lake. It is spoken of in knight's tales, said to be the destination of their quests. To this day, the restless spirits of those who sought it wander the ancient paths of the grove.
Silver Moon Grove

The sea of clouds lingering in this place is formed by concentrated Remnant Energy. Local legends of Ragunna speak of a serene, mirror-like area at the heart of Nimbus Sanctum, said to purify the darkest of thoughts and transform them into part of the clouds. At times, a haunting melody can be heard echoing from the depths of the sanctum.
Nimbus Sanctum

Built by the Montelli family, Averardo Vault stands like a heavily guarded fortress on the outskirts of the city. Within its walls lies the family's vast collection of treasures, including precious metals, artworks, and rare Echoes. The vault also provides public services such as secure storage for valuables, appraisals, and acquisition of rare collections.
Averardo Vault

This peninsula thick with oak trees was once where Rinascita's rulers gathered for secret councils. The Oracles carved into the stone and trees have withstood the passage of time, though their messages are now nearly impossible to distinguish.
Fagaceae Peninsula

The rugged mountains of Thessaleo Fells always seem shrouded in the darkness of night, their gloom as deep as the abyssal sea. Once the domain of the Fisalia family, the oldest lineage in Ragunna, this desolate place remains one few outsiders dare to tread.
Thessaleo Fells

The Fool's Troupe travels across all of Rinascita, but their base sits in a vast cavern on Penitent's End. Their creed is freedom, their treasure is laughter, and their gift to every city they visit is a new tale.
Penitent's End: Fool's Elysium

This forsaken island, shrouded in dense sea mist, is dominated by steep cliffs with giant ringed structures. Ships caught in the currents often end up stranded on the island's treacherous shores. For those lucky enough to survive the wreck, even greater horrors await...
Penitent's End

Averardo Bank utilizes an Echo train system to move clients' collections and staff to and from Averardo Vault.
Once the Echo trains reach the underground station of Averardo Vault, the collections within will undergo a second sorting process before being moved to specialized storage facilities.
Averardo Vault: Echo Station
A facility holding collections of works of art and rare Echoes from across the world, even including artifacts that have survived the Lament and Echoes from ancient times.
Averardo Vault: Echo Depository

Collections housed in this area are often referred to as "vessels of creativity and ingenuity."
For artists and inventors laboring under the patronage of a wealthy family, all their creations, tangible or intangible, are considered assets of the patrons.
The act of creation becomes a measure of worth, by which these creators' value is defined.
Averardo Vault: Artworks Depository
Located within the depths of Averardo Vault, off Echo train network, this tower is known to few. What dark secrets does the place hide?
Averardo Vault: Deeper Area

A group of islands northwest of Ragunna, rich in various marine resources. Falling out of the governance of the Order of the Deep, these islands have preserved the customs from Rinascita's Age of a Thousand Islands era, setting them apart from the rest of Ragunna in lifestyle. However, rumor has it a great mystery lies hidden within this secluded paradise...
Riccioli Islands
Once a theological seminary of Rinascita, it now rests in the boundless expanse of clouds. It once recorded Rinascita's glory and grandeur, along with countless unspeakable secrets.
Avinoleum
A seminary faintly visible through a thin veil of clouds. Suspended upside down in the sky, it stands solemn and silent, as though carrying the weight of the Blessed Maiden's life.
Avinoleum: Inverted Seminary

"The mortal world is a vast and mysterious ocean, wherein all souls are doomed to drown and sink to the depths. Those who refuse to be swallowed must learn to rise, climbing upward until their heads break the surface. Only then shall they glimpse the realm of the divine."
This proverb, written by the Order, is preserved within the tower.
Avinoleum: Tower of Salvation

Majestic and serene, ancient yet still sacred. This is the coronation platform prepared for the Blessed Maiden, though an aura of control lingers above. When the heavy weight of "divine right" falls upon one's head, it feels as if all choices have already been made.
Avinoleum: Path of Bestowal

Once the dwelling of dragons, this place witnessed those ancient, mighty beings soaring through the sky.
Now, wild vines and flowers steadily consume the garden's former glory while the buried history of dragons slumbers in cursed lairs.
Avinoleum: Zargon Garden

An ancient, mysterious castle perched on the edge of a cliff in the outskirts.
Surrounded by lush flora reminiscent of deep-sea creatures, its interior houses similarly strange and wondrous treasures. Enticing yet bizarre, it pulls the curious in like a whirlpool, drawing them to step inside.
Porto-Veno Castle
Simulation Training takes place in an artificial Sonoro Sphere dedicated to combat training. Clear the challenges within for various resources.
Simulation Training

Simulation Challenge

An artificial Sonoro Sphere-based combat simulation program in development in Huanglong. 
This facility is repurposed from an abandoned experiment site once owned by the Court of Savantae.
Tower of Adversity

An ember with smoldering flames. A domain of lingering memories.
If you step foot in this domain once more, you'll relive the memories of disasters and the "blade of destructions".
Statue of the Crownless: Heart

Those who are ignorant hinder progress, while the innocent suffer from the challenges imposed upon them. The embers of a fire, sparked by memories of a distant night and fueled by present circumstances, ignite the pain of Scar's past and the rebirth of new ideas, ultimately leading to the downfall of the old world order.
Sinful Declension
In the ruins, chaotic nightmares lurk in the shadows...
Somnoire
As you step into the train carriage, a journey through a tangled web of dreams unfolds before you.
Somnoire
In the lake, whispers of restless dreams drift gently to your ears...
Somnoire

The music persists, and the crimson curtains are set to rise once more.
Will you share another dance with her in this long, unfolding drama?
Weekly Challenge: Crimson Finale
It is said that the fates of the Fisalia heirs are bound to three towering spires, and this is one of them.
Twilight Rise
It is said that the fates of the Fisalia heirs are bound to three towering spires, and this is one of them.
Resounding Rise
A two-tiered holy edifice in Ragunna City, devoted to the worship of the Sentinel's statue. It also serves as the seat of the Order of the Deep.
Cathedral of Mercury
It is said that the fates of the Fisalia heirs are bound to three towering spires, and this is one of them.
Command Rise

The Sonoro Sphere of Phrolova.
Amid the wild revelry, she beckons you to join in the dance, offering a story in exchange and unveiling the truth behind the curtain.
Final Stage: Crimson Finale

The vault, controlled by the Montelli family, houses an exquisite collection of rare Echoes and artwork. Surrounded by natural barriers and perched atop a high vantage point, it offers a breathtaking view of Nimbus Sanctum.
Averardo Vault

A hall set for a banquet, grand enough to dazzle, yet secret enough to conceal.
At this very moment, a trade initiated by one Montelli is being undone by another.
"Perfect Trade"
Behind the mirror lies a realm where the illusions of the past intertwine with reality, yet the path ahead leads to an completely different destiny.
Realm of Ego: Mirrors in the Mirror
A prison built of power and fear is strong enough to chain the mind—but it cannot silence the song that rises from within people's hearts.
The Prisoned Song

The deepest point of the Averardo Vault. Lower ranking staff might not even be aware of its existence. Legend say an intruder would meet their end at the hands of the Echo guard, descending from a height to deliver their fate.
Averardo Vault: Vault Depths

A desolate field of ruins that sits near the Strand. As fog cloaks the sea, distant whispers emanate from within, enchanting the weary sailors. Little do they notice, they're lured into a howling vortex and a realm of death.
Whimpering Wastes

Time and space collapse into chaos here, and all things dissolve into nothingness. When the storm heralds a new world, the crown of thorns will finally settle upon her head.
Thereafter, Divinity descends.
Weekly Challenge: Broken Fortune

Ancient, enigmatic spirits slumber in the lake's depths. Their eyes once summoned stars, leaving trails of fleeting, radiant light across the night sky. As you glide across the lake, another vast world seems to stir in its reflection, just within reach.
Lake of Spirits

An annual festival in Egla Town to honor those who have passed.
When night falls, the townspeople don masks and dress as ghosts to attend the commemorative event. Legend has it that on the Night of Remembrance, vengeful spirits return to the mortal realm. Who's to say whether the person reveling beside you is human, or something else...
Night of Remembrance
Somnoire, the Illusive Realm
A mysterious gateway has appeared, leading to a realm known as Somnoire. Legend has it that it hosts the dreams of all beings in Solaris...

This flower is for you. I hope it makes you happy!
Hee-hee. Hi, there! I'm Encore from the Black Shores! Wanna go on an adventure with me and my Woolies?
Calcharo, leader of the Ghost Hounds Mercenary Group. I suppose you've heard about what we do. Don't worry, your safety as my client will be guaranteed until the job is done.
I am Jianxin, the successor of Fengyiquan. Thank you for your hospitality. Would you mind sparring with me?
You're probably more used to seeing me as that liondancer on the high poles, I guess? Let's hang out more! I want you to remember me as how I look, without the lion head!
Jiyan, of the Midnight Rangers. Protecting our lands and people is my solemn duty. Should you encounter any difficulties here, I will do my utmost to help.
Name's Yinlin. As for what I do... Shhh, we don't talk about that in public.
As the Sentinel said, we will meet here.
It is truly my fortune to find a worthy opponent like you in this vast world...
I'm Zhezhi… I do commissioned paintings. Um, what else...? Oh, I'm open for commissions! I offer fair prices, can adapt to any style you need, and do revisions too. And I never miss a deadline!

My name is Xiangli Yao, a researcher at the Huaxu Academy. Rover, your rare resonance frequencies raise an intriguing question: are you a unique beacon of insight in our quest for truth? Or do you already hold the ultimate truth in your hand?
"The Shorekeeper"... This name suits me well enough. It aligns with my purpose and drive: they only exist because of you.
Camellya, a Bloom Bearer of the Black Shores. Happy to see you again! My beloved... seed of fate.
Fate has led you to me, and considering the terms I'm offering… You wouldn't refuse me, would you?
All the world's a stage, and we are mere players.
I'm Phoebe, an acolyte of the Order. Praise the Sentinel. May They guide you to compassion and enlightenment.
Brant's the name, captain of the Fool's Troupe! A pleasure to meet you. Enough with introductions now—let's hand the stage over to everlasting joy and boundless liberty!

The current head of Fisalia, Cantarella, the Bane. Whether I am the Bane of the wicked or the pure is yours to decide. Shh, no need to answer. The moment you arrived, the ripples that surrounded you told me all I needed to know.

I am Ciaccona, a wandering bard from Rinascita. Should you harbor any unspoken thoughts or deep emotions, why not convey them into poetry? When you pour your heart into words and music, you speak directly to people's hearts.
Name's Zani, Averardo Vault employee. You're my client, huh? If so, I'm your sword and shield. Just say the word. If you leave me a good review when we're done, it'll be much appreciated.

Cartethyia, now a wandering knight. The Threnodian's malicious creation, the Order's unsuspecting Laureate, the defier lost in the tides of fate... These titles, once portrayed in poems and books, have long since slipped from my grasp. As for what lies ahead... let's explore it together, "Swordbearer."
Lupa, Gladiator of Septimont. Just ignore the attention, Warrior. This victory is ours to savor!

Do not fear the Fractsidus Overseer. Settle your mind. Quiet the clamor of thought. Only then can you stay and truly appreciate the perfect melody echoing through the Lycoris sea... and the true paradise that is soon to arrive.

I am Augusta, Ephor of Septimont. Etch this name into your memory—it belongs to the one who stands above, and whose mark will never fade. Whether we meet as foes or friends, my sword and I await the fierce fight between us.
Beyond myself. Beyond every written start and end of the story. Till we rewrite our fate.
Galbrena. The Fiend of Ever-burning Flame. The Discord Slayer. Call me what you want. Just point me to the monsters.
Qiuyuan, a blade drawn at your word. Wield me as you will.
Kuchiba Chisa. Tactical Development Program, Department of Engineering, Startorch Academy. Forte Specialization: structural dissection... Apologies, this might not be the time for formalities.
Outlaw Blue, Apollo Orange, Hazard Yellow, Acid Green... Wanna guess what color is my next pick?
I am Mornye, Research Institute engineer and professor at Startorch Academy. Please, let me know when my expertise can be of service.
Aemeath, Synchronist of the Exostrider from Rabelle College. That was me back when I was alive. Now? I'm a digital ghost!
Dr. Luuk Herssen, from the Resonator Nursing Unit. A rare exception that we meet outside my office. Oh, you can just call me Luuk.

Dance in the moonlight, sing to the blooms. It is a dance to commemorate your first meeting, the many journeys you'll share, and the companionship forged along the way.
"Now that spring returns, who will share it with me?
The peach blossom's beauty longs for eyes that see."

Silver hair, piercing red eyes, monochromatic garments... A ferocious mask conceals her face, while a gleaming blade rests in her hand. Her voice rings out in a powerful chant, driving away evil spirits and banishing malicious souls.
In the warm mist of the indoor hot spring, behind the fluttering chiffon veils, the laurel-crowned nymph casts her gentle gaze—a signal of invitation to a long-awaited, carefree holiday.
Soft satin smoothly flows down from her body. The droplets on her glisten like luxurious gems. As they dip into the water, ripples spread across the pool into you and the girl's heart.
An outfit soft to the touch, like feathers, but also highly durable. Feathers fill with wind, lifting the lark to the sky, and a song sounds as it flies.
A featherlight outfit favored by Jinzhou Speedster Chixia, perfect for her need to rush to the side of whoever calls out her name.
An outfit Verina wears when doing fieldwork. Every word from each unfurling bud, Verina engraves in her heart.
Rover's usual outfit. This is what he wore at the beginning of his journey and what he will be wearing for the rest of it.
A somber-colored lightweight outfit, worn by the City Hall guard Sanhua. She moves swiftly, a sharp blade in hand, ready to defend peace.
An outfit Taoqi wears at work, matching the Peachy Turtle in color. She always forgets to wear her uniform. Her everyday clothes have now become a uniform, in a manner of speaking.
Rover's usual outfit. This is what she wore at the beginning of her journey and what she will be wearing for the rest of it.
A well-fitted uniform that provides great freedom of movement, perfect for fieldwork. Truths are elusive, accessible only to the most indefatigable seekers.
A custom-made outfit gifted to Encore by her fellow Black Shores members. Cosmos and Cloudy, reporting for duty! One, two... three! Great, everyone is here. Let the treasure hunt begin!
Jade, clear and pure, assumes rosy hues after long exposure to crimson dye... at least that's what they say in the novels.
What's my trump card? It's... right here. Yes, the brain. It's all about how to squeeze every ounce of advantage from an information asymmetry.

A uniform bestowed by Jué when Jiyan was appointed general. Its design is based on the standard uniform of the Midnight Rangers. The turquoise coat billows when the wind rises, like a flag that rallies his fellow soldiers. Made of tough materials, it's resistant to wear and tear, much like the enduring mountains of Jinzhou.
An outfit worn by Huaxu Academy researchers. The fire inside the Red Dragon is burning as fierce as ever, but he has found his anchor, something he intends to devote his life to.

This custom Septimont Gladiator suit has evolved through many revisions to match Lupa's unique fighting style. It bears silent witness to her countless solitary days and nights, as well as the thunderous cheers that followed her every triumph.
Red is passionate and wild; white is serene and pure. Camellya dances at the junction of two opposing forces.

A Huanglong-style combat uniform custom-made for Calcharo, designed for ease of movement in the region. Lightweight yet durable, it is a no-frills outfit tailored to his needs, with an emphasis on concealment.
An outfit Yinlin commissioned her favorite qipao shop to make. Flamboyant, extravagant... Adjectives that aren't normally used on secret agents describe the real Yinlin behind her many masks.
A neat outfit Lingyang wears when performing liondances. It is adorned with a traditional pattern said to bring good luck, and the pattern is as vibrant as Lingyang's youthful energy.
A tailored suit over a form-fitting set of boxing attire, accentuating Yuanwu's long-limbed and powerful physique.
Rover's usual outfit. This is what she wore at the beginning of her journey and what she will be wearing for the rest of it.
Rover's usual outfit. This is what she wore at the beginning of her journey and what she will be wearing for the rest of it.
Rover's usual outfit. This is what he wore at the beginning of his journey and what he will be wearing for the rest of it.
A uniform Jianxin received from her sect. This outfit, whenever she wears it, always brings to mind the wise counsel of her master. Move like a shadow; stay as composed as a steady breath.

An outfit adorned with two diaphanous ribbons that seem to glow a faint blue, a perfect match for Jinhsi's complexion. The weight of the whole Jinzhou has been put on her shoulders, but she bears it with grace and dignity.
A simple, practical outfit, specifically designed for use on long-distance expeditions. A truth seeker is drawn to the truth, undeterred by any obstacle in their path.

Changli's usual outfit. It includes an Enflamement-infused gown, styled on Huanglong-style court attire. After many journeys and through terrain of all kinds, however, the texture of the gown no longer differs from that of ordinary fabric.
Of life's many highs and lows, I've known, yet joy stirs my soul when I behold grasses grow.
A picturesque outfit that puts one in mind of an exquisite painting. Landscapes abound, waiting to be recaptured on canvas.
Youhu's heart is as pure as a snowflake, filled with a great love for the stories behind antiques.

She manifested in human-like form in response to the one who awakened her, marking the beginning you bestowed upon her. It was the starting point of a new life. It was not the first time, nor would it be the last.
A lightweight yet sturdy outfit, worn by Lollo Logistics Navigator Lumi. It has survived many arduous deliveries.
A unique outfit Roccia wears when doing improv comedy. Made out of various scraps, this product of love is decorated with odds and ends that Roccia has accumulated.
A boldly designed one-piece dress. Red is Carlotta's color. She wears it even on secret missions, in the dead of night, when stealth is crucial. She is a nonconformist and trendsetter.
A costume the captain wears on his grand voyages. Its design inspires the garments of the Troupe of Fools. It captures the hues of sea and sky, bringing their grandeur back to Ragunna.

Phoebe's memories are always tinged with a shade of blue. The bird that soared from her childhood bedtime stories, the robes of the Acolytes who offered her sanctuary, and the gentle breeze that carried her out of her darkest dreams.
Rover's usual outfit. This is what he wore at the beginning of his journey and what he will be wearing for the rest of it.

The dress worn by Cantarella the Bane is awash in flowing, vibrant colors.
These iridescent hues change and refract, shifting with the light, like a deadly creature lurking deep in the ocean, beautiful, dangerous, and hypnotic.
An attire that is light but lacks no elegance. A gentle breeze passes by as Ciaccona plays her instrument, the rustling of the fabric of her clothes sometimes becomes the accompaniment.
A custom-made uniform, primarily of simple black and white color schemes. No matter how heavy the work load, one must maintain an impeccable appearance.

The dress Cartethyia wore during her coronation as the Blessed Maiden. These thorns accompanied her through storms of solitude, and they serve to engrave the responsibilities of "salvation" deep into her heart.

One of the near-orbit space stations humanity built before the Etheric Sea sealed off Solaris. Magnetic disturbances from the Lament sent it crashing down, but it remained largely whole. Its ruins once sheltered the Roya from the cold and served as an exploration outpost.
This sector houses SkyArk's most significant pre-Lament research achievement—a prototype Mass Relay Device powered by Etheric Sea Droplets.

Located within the research base zone, the Icebreak Port is the only regular access point into the Roya Frostlands. Upon arrival, personnel and supplies may be transferred via the Starward Riseway to the underground haven of Lahai-Roi, or routed deeper into the frostlands through the inter-outpost roads.

Once a forest-thick fjordland in the frigid zone, this region was home to the nomadic Roya. Then came Lahai-Roi's first recorded Lament that triggered a geomagnetic pole shift. The land was transformed into the new polar extremity of Solaris, buried beneath endless snow and ice. The violent shift also dragged near-orbit satellites and space stations from the sky. Their wreckage still litters the frostlands to this day.

Formally known as the Spacetrek Collective: Frostlands Polar Research Outpost, this facility is a joint project between the Spacetrek Collective and the Roya people. Built around the Exostrider's greatsword embedded in the ice, it serves as a vital logistics hub.
Here, researchers work to salvage pre-Lament data from fallen satellites and space stations, run non-invasive diagnostics on the Exostrider to monitor its restoration, and survey the ecosystem to revive the long-frozen flora and fauna of the ancient world.

During the second Lament recorded in Lahai-Roi, the Exostrider, a colossal mech from an unknown civilization, emerged through the Stridergate. It fought a fierce battle against the Threnodian to seal the catastrophe from the other side, a clash that shattered the very bedrock of the frostlands.
As the Roya faced annihilation, the Exostrider channeled its remaining power and drove the greatsword deep into the earth to brace the collapsing land. Its Reactor Drive transformed into a subterranean sun, casting warmth into the depths. Its scattered fragments reassembled into the Exoswarm that mimic the local lifeforms, guiding the Roya toward a new homeland. Since then, the Exostrider fell dormant upon the surface, awaiting the day of its awakening.

Named after Scott Rabelle, the founder of Resonance Curve Theory and inventor of the Rabelle's Curve, this college—also known as the Synchronist Department—identifies and trains Synchronists through uncompromisingly rigorous, data-driven methods. 
Access to Rabelle College requires special authorization and is ordinarily closed to students from other departments.

A collective Sonoro that manifested naturally in Lahai-Roi. The exact cause of its formation remains unconfirmed.
Influenced by the subconscious minds and residual frequencies of the Resonators at Startorch Academy, it gradually evolved into a mirrored projection of the Academy, becoming a unique phenomenon existing within its grounds.

Ambition, passion, anxiety, sorrow… the Academy's Dark Side absorbs them all without distinction, reflecting the students' rawest and most unguarded thoughts.
If left unchanneled, these accumulated negative emotions gather within the domain, eventually spilling into reality.

The Research Institute sealed the Dark Side within riddles, rendering it harmless and turning it into an annual game students eagerly await.
By solving these riddles, students confront their doubts directly, releasing and dispelling the negative energy accumulated in the Dark Side.

If the Dark Side is a vortex, then anxiety and sorrow form its very eye.
Interfered with by the Fractsidus, these negative emotions are now manifesting as aggressive Tacet Discords.

Every student who enters Startorch Academy does so with a sincere heart.
Such hearts are treasures that must never be allowed to be tainted.

The rabbit guides those who venture into the Academy's Dark Side, leading them to confront the fears and truths they usually avoid.
Even after Sigrika's incident, some students and professors continue to face their own dilemmas within the Dark Side.

Projector: Geospider S4

Geospiders S4 in Lahai-Roi gravitate towards places bathed in Lumiglow where they perform <color=Light>Lumiglow Revelation</color>. Once the revelation is complete, the Lumiglow fades, revealing the hidden objects inside.
Projector: Zip Zap

In Lahai-Roi, Zip Zaps can sense any nearby immobilized Spacetrek Explorer and release an <color=Thunder>Electric Shock</color> to restore the Explorer to normal operating status. Additionally, Zip Zaps can detect defective power lines in their immediate surroundings, and can release an <color=Thunder>Electric Shock</color> to re-energize the line.
Projector: Mining Reindeer

In Lahai-Roi, Mining Reindeer can sense nearby Soliskin sealed inside special Luxites. The reindeer can fire a sustained <color=Thunder>laser beam</color> to break the rock's outer shell, allowing you to free the trapped Soliskin.
Projector: Glommoth

In the frostlands, Glommoths can sense and shatter massive ice formations. Shattering the ice reveals paths and objects once sealed by the cold. Glommoths can also interact with Soliskin hiding within caves. Look for glimmering caves where the Soliskin hide, then use the Glommoth Projection to uncover the secrets they conceal.
Projector: Voidwing Moth

Around the Dimmr Plains, Voidwing Moth uses its wings to scatter the Soliskin Puffs unique to the Dimmr Plains, within which hidden treasures may be found. Additionally, in certain areas with residual Voidmatter contamination, Voidwing Moth's power may be utilized to disperse the residual Voidmatter that shrouds what's hidden within.

When the Known Thrums!

An unmistakably "unordinary" emergency request arrives! An unstable prototype patrol mech has vanished without a trace! Concerned for campus safety, Lynae asks you to help track it down. Once again, the merry duo of the Voidworm Knight sets out on a new adventure!
Head to the square with Lynae and speak with the student who lost the patrol mech.

It turns out that what's missing isn't just the unstable patrol mech, but also the student's cherished family photo. In a state of great distress, the young student is unable to offer any useful clues.
However, the mech's last known trail provides the first lead. Determined to uncover more, Lynae takes charge and decides on her next move...
Time to roll! Let's go check out this latest incident!
If You Catch Up to It...

A new lead emerges. To recover the missing patrol mech, Lynae invites you to investigate the lab together. One unusual trace after another points toward something far from ordinary. Is a real threat waiting ahead? Or just a false alarm?
Work with Lynae to uncover the truth.

Deep scratches on the wall. Flimsy debris. Weapon fragments that cannot be ignored… The prototype patrol mech proves far more dangerous than anticipated.
Seeing a reflection of her own past in the crisis, Lynae chooses to focus on locating the rogue mech and gives the student a chance to confront his own fears. All signs suggest the trail leads beyond the Celebration site.
Uh-oh… I've got a bad feeling about this. We need to hurry.
I'll Show You the Mech

Lynae finally pins down the mech's signal. It has already left the Academy. Why did the student install unauthorized modifications? Where is the patrol mech heading? And what truth awaits at the end of this pursuit?
Head to the Academy's main entrance and meet Lynae.

The truth behind the dangerous rogue mech finally surfaces. Its aggression was born of a desperate desire to protect. After losing his family, the student built the mech as a fragile yet desperate shield. But just as the dust begins to settle, the disabled mech suddenly jolts to life and bolts toward an unknown destination.
Turns out it's a move to save its creator from the contaminated Exoswarm. With the chaos behind you and everyone safe, you and Lynae return to the Academy, letting out a long-overdue sigh of relief.
A long-awaited full throttle! Feels like we’re getting close to the truth.
Where the Iridescent Rain Falls

The emergency has been resolved. After the Celebration, life at the Academy has settled back into its familiar rhythm. As your days find their balance between calm and chaos, Lynae's message pops up on your Terminal as usual. She wants to catch up and fill you in on what happened after the incident.
Meet Lynae by the fountain in the square.

The student received a just punishment for his actions, but also the support his talent deserved. Life at the Academy continues on, unchanged. For Lynae, however, the incident has sparked a question about her own path forward within. Enjoying the campus life here is no longer just a fragile dream. It's her everyday reality now. So what comes next?
Under the vast blue sky, she cracks open a soda and begins to share her new wishes with you...
Before we decide where to go next, why not stay with me until I finish this soda? It's on me.

Same hour, same place, and yet, the feelings are not the same. To Mornye's perplexity, the replicated environment failed to produce the same positive outcome as before.

Waffle Therapy

Luuk Herssen has put a new tweak on his recipe, and you're the first to get a taste. The infirmary is rarely this quiet. Usually, the endless stream of injured or sick students during the Celebration keeps the staff running off their feet.

Head to the infirmary and begin your investigation into this Case of the Missing Waffles.

The infirmary is a revolving door of people, and the clues are a tangled mess. But within the detective game Luuk Herssen has so meticulously crafted, you peel back the layers of the mystery and lock onto the prime suspect: the calico cat that frequents the infirmary.

A Fluffy Prescription

Luuk Herssen messages you that while he was relaxing at the celebration and scouting for potential adopters, the kitten got spooked and slipped out of its cage. 
A "criminal" like this cannot be allowed to roam free! For the safety of waffles everywhere, head to the teaching building, track down this fluffy fugitive, and bring it back to the infirmary.

After bringing the calico back to the infirmary, you and Luuk Herssen discuss the kitten's future. You suggest that he adopt the cat himself, an idea he readily accepts.

Well, seems like a day made for taking a friend's advice, don't you think?
The Heartbeat of Life

With the New Solar Celebration concluded, Luuk Herssen has stayed true to his word and taken a well-earned vacation. To mark the start of his break, he has prepared a fresh batch of waffles and invited you over.
How will the new waffles taste, and is the doctor getting along with his new feline roommate? Head to the Infirmary to catch up with Luuk Herssen.

Accustomed to the wild, the kitten struggled to adapt to life in a small room. It was born free-spirited. Yet even a soul like that needs a place to rest, and Luuk Herssen has become a quiet harbor where it can occasionally drop anchor. For him, this seems to be the most satisfying outcome.
Under the warm sunlight, you and Luuk Herssen finish your afternoon tea, marking the peaceful beginning of his holiday.
Life is short. We must cherish every encounter.

Where is she?
Like a solitary boat, moored between you and the vast sea of people.
Creases on Paper

Sigrika returns to her room. 
Her moments of vulnerability in the Academy's Dark Side replay on a loop in her mind. Her cheeks burn with embarrassment. Even hugging her favorite plushie can't stop the blushing.
(This is so humiliating... No, Sigrika! You have to apologize to Senior and the others who were worried about you.) 
With that thought, she opens your chat window on WavesLine.

Your meeting leaves Sigrika in high spirits. You accept her gift—an origami black cat she painstakingly made following a tutorial—and that brings her a great sense of relief.
(Great job, Sigrika! Now, keep that momentum going...)
She pats her cooling cheeks and runs toward the training grounds, leaving a trail of lighthearted notes in her wake.
Folding a black cat out of paper... So difficult...
Ground Engravings

Sigrika is practicing tirelessly at the training grounds, striving to sketch every rune with absolute precision. 
The weight of everyone's expectations propels her forward, but her nerves have stretched thin, tense as a bowstring pushed past its limit. Even so, she presses on, unaware that her stubborn determination is pushing her toward a suffocating mire...

After her training ends, Sigrika sends you an invitation. She has decided to take you to a place she's always kept to herself—her "secret base."
A seemingly ordinary rooftop is her sanctuary for wandering thoughts and her haven within the Academy. Now, she shares this sacred space with you, hoping you will share this moment with her.
Training is tough, but it's worth it! I'll keep doing my best!
Imprints of Wings

Sigrika leads you to a certain rooftop within the Academy. To any passerby, it looks completely ordinary. But only she knows just how many "spirits of freedom" love to pause and rest on this unassuming place. Every bird visiting the area carries its own character, but their size makes them easy to miss. Spotting them takes a sharp eye. She has one, undoubtedly. And so do you.

You and Sigrika spend the time photographing the birds together. It's something she loves to do, though she admits she usually misses the moment they face the camera. Fortunately, she has you this time. You capture several perfect shots and gift one to her.
Carrying Sigrika's quiet hopes for freedom, the birds lift into the horizon and disappear into the endless blue.
Senior, do you like birds?
Essence of Tranquility

Sigrika sits in silence on the rooftop. 
The wind, which once brought her endless inspiration, now only brushes past her, stealing her warmth. Her heart of gold has grown heavy, each beat a soft whimper.
Please, stop crying out, she prays, but it is to no avail. 
Just then, Sigrika hears the sound of your footsteps.

Catching a moment when you aren’t looking, Sigrika's eyes drift to the hem of your sleeve.
She has always told herself she can't run away—because of everyone's expectations, because of her own pride… Yet you never say those words. You simply tell her she's allowed to step back. To rest.
Slowly, the tension starts to ebb, and her heart stops its soft whimpering.
The wind quiets down, and a bird lands gently at your side.
Senior, can you stay with me a little longer?
The Happiness Spell

With the Dark Side crisis resolved, Sigrika is in higher spirits than ever before. After rushing to share her joy with you, she heads back to her sanctuary, her heart still racing with excitement. 
This place has witnessed her expectations, her fragility, and her confusion. Now, it finally holds her happiness. As she tells the birds and the horizon the story of your journey together, she makes a silent vow to cherish these memories forever.

Sigrika returns to her room.
Her brilliant adventure in the Academy's Dark Side replays on a loop in her mind. Her cheeks burn with heat. Even after running several laps around her room, she can't get the temperature to drop.
(I'm so, so happy. Sigrika, you did it!)
With that thought, she opens the photo of the two of you. Her heart of gold, light once more, continues to dance with joy.
I'll treasure our photo! I'll keep it right beside my other most precious ones.
"Festivals Don't Encore"

The New Solar Celebration belongs to the students, not the faculty keeping order, and certainly not the president overseeing it all. You've grown used to Lucilla's packed schedule. That one movie you watched together seemed to be the only leisure she could steal. But today, just outside the venue, you spot her looking remarkably relaxed...
"How's that for a teaser?"

As the Academy President, Lucilla is well aware of the sources of her students' stress, and this stroll is a moment of respite stolen from her own hectic schedule. After a brief chat, she returns to her duties, leaving only a promise to watch a movie together next time.
Will she truly be able to find the time to keep the promise?
"Treat it as a plot hook, one to be revealed when you meet again in the next 'scene.'"
"Take time out for those things that really make you happy, like watching a movie..."
"Department of Engineering Repair Scene"

On a day that started out like any other, you receive an unexpected message. The mere fact that the ever-busy Lucilla reached out at all is a rarity in itself. She brings two pieces of bad news: one concerns you, and the other... well, that concerns you, too.
"If a movie trailer were written this way, I'd accuse the PR department of being lazy. Then again, some of the best films start exactly the same way."

While helping Lucilla retrieve a repaired projector, you catch a glimpse of her life beyond the role of president—her side as a teacher. A top scholar of the Pioneer Association, a mentor to her students... Lucilla spins gracefully between her various roles, executing every footwork of the dance perfectly. 
"Alright, you, stop daydreaming. Let's move on to the next episode."
(A silent, elegant, and precise rhythm, as if it is dancing.)

"Awaiting my message? I'm afraid I really am swamped this time."

Concerto Energy of <color=Fire>Fusion</color> and <color=Thunder>Electro</color> Resonators is automatically restored.

Rapido Alloy:
Resonators' <color=highlight>Concert Energy</color> regeneration rate is increased. After Resonators cast Intro Skills, <color=highlight>Resonance Energy</color> will be fully restored and <color=highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color> will be increased by 225%.

Striking Alloy:
Resonators' <color=highlight>Concerto Energy</color> regeneration rate is increased. After Resonators cast <color=highlight>Intro Skills</color>, their <color=highlight>Crit. Rate</color> is increased by 100% and <color=highlight>Crit. DMG</color> is increased by 30%. The effect of Crit. DMG boost can stack up to 15 times.

Intimidating Alloy:
<color=highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color> is increased by 20% every time <color=highlight>Echo Skill</color> is cast. This effect can stack up to 15 times. The CD of <color=highlight>Echo Skills</color> cast within 8s after a <color=highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> is reduced by 100%.

Deafening Alloy:
<color=highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color> and <color=highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color> are increased by 20% when <color=highlight>Echo Skill</color> is cast. This effect stacks up to 15 times. <color=highlight>Echo Skill</color> CD is reduced by 50% after Resonators perform <color=highlight>Heavy Attacks</color>.

Furious Alloy:
Echo Skill CD is reduced by 50%. The <color=highlight>Crit. Rate</color> and <color=highlight>Crit. DMG</color> of <color=highlight>Resonance Skill</color>, <color=highlight>Basic Attack</color> and <color=highlight>Heavy Attack</color> are increased by 100% and 30% respectively after Resonators cast an <color=highlight>Echo Skill</color>. The effect of Crit. DMG boost can stack up to 15 times.

Ethereal Alloy:
Echo Skill CD is reduced by 50%. After Resonators release <color=highlight>Echo Skills</color>, a wind field will be generated to continuously pull in enemies. When the wind field disperses, <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> will be dealt 1 time.

Everlasting Alloy:
Casting <color=highlight>Intro Skills</color> reduces <color=highlight>Echo Skill</color> CD by 100% for 5s. <color=highlight>Defeating an enemy</color> increases Resonators' DMG by 10%, stacking up to 25 times.

Rupture Alloy:
Casting <color=highlight>Resonance Skill</color> reduces Resonance Liberation Cooldown and regenerates Resonance Energy.
Casting <color=highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> reduces all party members' Resonance Skill Cooldown, increases their Resonance Skill Crit. Rate for 3s, and boosts their Resonance Skill Crit. DMG. This effect can be stacked.

Empyrean Alloy:
While the active Resonator is <color=highlight>in mid-air</color>, increase their Crit. Rate and Crit. DMG each second. Whenever a Mid-air Attack hits the target, it triggers an additional attack that deals Resonance Liberation DMG.
The additional attack increases the Resonator's <color=highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>. This effect can be stacked.

Aftersound Alloy:
Increase inactive Resonators' DMG when <color=highlight>Coordinated Attack</color> hits the target. This effect can be stacked.
All party members gain extra Resonance Energy and Concerto Energy when <color=highlight>Coordinated Attack</color> hits the target.
Increase all party members' Crit. Rate and Crit. DMG for 8s when <color=highlight>Intro Skill</color> hits the target.

Fervor Alloy:
Reduce <color=highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> Cooldown.
Defeating an enemy regenerates extra Resonance Energy and Concerto Energy.
Defeating an enemy also increases the Crit. Rate and Crit. DMG of all party members' <color=highlight>Resonance Liberation</color>. This effect can be stacked.

Crescent Alloy:
Reduce <color=highlight>Echo Skill</color> Cooldown. At the beginning and end of an <color=highlight>Echo Skill</color>, cast a Crescent Slash beside the active Echo, dealing Echo Skill DMG to the enemy.
Defeating an enemy increases all party members' Attack DMG and Echo Skill DMG.

Stagnation Alloy:
Reduce <color=highlight>Echo Skill</color> Cooldown. <color=highlight>Echo Skill</color> inflicts a Stagnation effect on the enemy and marks it. Every marked enemy takes extra DMG.

Devouring Alloy:
Increase the Crit. Rate and Crit. DMG of Resonance Skill within a certain period after casting <color=highlight>Echo Skill</color>. This effect can be stacked.
Defeating an enemy with <color=highlight>Resonance Skill</color> reduces the Resonator's Echo Skill Cooldown and Resonance Skill Cooldown and regenerates a certain amount of Concerto Energy.

Unique Tacet Discord. A Gulpuff born from anomalous data, this creature possesses an enormous size and terrifying destructive power.

Its dual-wielded blades, replacing its arms, appear almost sentient, exploiting every weakness in an opponent's stance.

The specific frequency it mimicked to achieve such mastery in swordsmanship remains a mystery.

Unique cluster of Tacet Discords. A swarm of Cruisewings bunched together due to anomalous data, exhibiting a certain extent of teamwork.

This swarm possesses formidable combat abilities that should not be underestimated.

Unique group of Tacet Discords. Two Tambourinists fused together due to anomalous data, possessing frequencies of unimaginable intensity.

The sounds of their musical instruments are like the wails and resentments from the abyss—so haunting that merely hearing them might bring misfortune.

Tubpup

Among the prized treasures of the Montelli family is a morph painting depicting Hadrian, the legendary gladiator, with his blade drawn. In Ragunna, these paintings have the special power to pull anyone who touches them into the sphere within, allowing them to experience it as though it were real.
At the heart of Trattoria Margherita is an oven Echo known as Bakie, tirelessly fueling Ragunna with its roaring flames and delicious aromas.

To be a true performer, one must first learn how to listen. Give your records, sheet music, or any musical medium to the Aria Mummer. Don't be alarmed when it swallows and chews these items—it's simply its way of "listening" to the music.

Passersby are often drawn to the delicate hands reaching out from the Averardo Bank. These hands are perfectly adorned, always gesturing with elegance and grace...
Though their owner is just an Echo teller.

Once a lonely Echo drifting through the seas, Lario has spent years without a companion until it joined the Troupe of Fools. All people know about it is its genus—Pliosaurus Somnii. Though the troupe has sailed across many waters near Rinascita, they have yet to encounter another like it.

C-MOSS, the camera Echo owned by the Pioneer Association's Ragunna branch, acts with all the fine manners of an old gentleman. He captures moments in time with care, often sipping a cup of developer solution between shots.

Before they fall into slumber, the Farceur's Faces of the Masked Reverie fill Ragunna's days and nights with their playful banter. As the shop's iconic mascots, they've garnered their fair share of noise complaints.
An Echo boat that quietly glides through Ragunna's canals, offering a safe and silent voyage to all who hop on it, often known as the Water Bus.

Once, when the Dark Tide ravaged the city and Tacet Fields spread like a plague, Signor Octopus's duty was to sound the alarms. Those days are like a distant dream now, yet he still announces the hour with a gentle horn, guarding the city's peace with quiet dedication.
An Echo lantern that belongs to the Order of the Deep, serving as the Order's watchful eyes to monitor the people of Ragunna.
Originally transformed from discarded dolls, these plushie Echoes have evolved to feel delicate human emotions. For them, these emotions are delicious frequencies to be savored with relish.

Spotted throughout Ragunna's streets, the Tubpups are lively Echoes that serve as faithful companions. Whether they are playing with children, carrying art supplies, or working as handy baskets, they bring joy and energy wherever they go.

Mist rises over the sea, carrying echoes from all directions—songs, the creak of windmills, and the bustling noise of city streets. For sailors weary from the monotony of life at sea, these sounds become an irresistible siren call. Entranced, they steer their ships toward the heart of the mist, unaware they are sailing straight into the Tacet Discord's trap…
But as in every tale where despair festers, a glimmer of hope is bound to emerge. Even in these treacherous waters, someone will break the storm and waves and bring light to all.

[About]

After a decade of anticipation, the long-awaited Carnevale has reignited a fiery passion that refuses to fade.

The Water City has just unveiled a corner of its secrets. Now is the best time to set sail, ride the winds, and venture into the uncharted corners of this mysterious land.

With the world's curtain lifting, a new exploration calls—why wait? Dive into the adventure now!

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 22 and unlock Utility: Flight.

[Event Rules]

1. During the event, you can invite other players to join the Overdash Challenge in Co-op Mode. The first to finish is the winner.

2. Once the first player finishes, the challenge enters a 20-second final sprint phase. After the sprint phase ends, results will be finalized.

3. Combat is disabled during the challenge. Players must follow the markers to finish the challenge.

4. The final points consist of two parts: Course Completion Points and Ranking Points:

I. Course Completion Points are earned by reaching designated checkpoints along the track.

II. Ranking Points are earned based on the order in which players finish.
