A precise and powerful battle machine that has been refitted with special technology. It carries out its master's commands with absolute loyalty.

Any trace of its original form has faded, leaving only finely honed combat instincts within its frequencies. As an unyielding guardian, it adapts seamlessly to all types of combat. When needed, it activates a unique component to enhance mobility or unleashes all its energy in a devastating blast.

Once a remnant creature in Nimbus Sanctum, Lorelei gained intelligence through Sentinel Imperator's power, entrusted to purify corrupted frequencies drifting in the clouds.

Yet wicked desires have transformed her into the "Queen of the Night," seeking to cloak the Sanctum in endless darkness to clear all sins. With her final grasp on reason, Lorelei sealed herself within the atrium, where she sings a haunting lament, awaiting one who can awaken her from this dismal slumber.

A bird-of-prey-like animal that perches at the Whining Aix's Mire, with cries like a mournful song. 

Legend has it that this bird once had a partner and that their chorus was a beautiful sound. Their names were not passed down, but their hymns were recorded and preserved by human beings. 

Until one of them was deceased. The surviving one cried all day long, and the cries were so dismal it was called the Mourning Aix.

Jinhsi has earned widespread praise for her achievements as Magistrate. What kind of performance will she bring as a contender?
Jinhsi says every contender has their own strengths. A few races aren't enough to call it just yet!
Jinhsi shares her winning secret: "The key is to maintain your pace and breathing. Master the rhythm, and you'll master the race."
Jinhsi is grateful for the luck that got her to the finals. Now she's ready to team up with the other Resonators and bring it all home!
Congratulations to Jinhsi for taking first place! She says everyone's support gave her the strength to win.
In a pre-race interview, Changli admits she isn't particularly skilled at racing, but she's joining in for the experience.
Changli regrets seeing some strong competitors get knocked out and hopes for a rematch in the future!
Changli says she competes to make new friends, share ideas, and keep pushing herself to grow.
Changli is honored to compete with such great contenders and will give her all in the upcoming matches.
Congratulations to Changli for taking first place! She humbly credits her win to luck.
Shorekeeper says everyone adapts to the Cube form differently. It's not that she has better physical abilities than those eliminated. She's just better at being a Cube.
KU-Lolo mentions the last time Shorekeeper prepared this much was to welcome Rover to the Black Shores. Let's all look forward to her performance in the race!
Shorekeeper explains that since Cubes are mostly starch, too much sweat can make them break down. The trick to winning is keeping your body temperature and shape steady.
Based on race data, Shorekeeper suggests thrill seekers bet on the more explosive contenders, while those who play it safe might want to back endurance racers like herself.
Shorekeeper says she enjoys racing alongside others on an uncertain track more than knowing the outcome ahead of time.
Camellya declined our pre-race interview, stating that only winners have the right to speak.
Camellya states there are no secrets to victory. Strength is the only way.
Camellya says that the contenders are so boring that she's almost falling asleep!
Camellya declares that now that she's reached the final round, she will no longer hold back and will tear it up!
Congratulations to Camellya for taking first place! She says she had a blast and can't wait for the next race to begin!
As a contender known for using power-up items, what kind of surprises will Roccia bring to the race this time?
Roccia encourages the eliminated contenders not to feel down and to cheer on the ones still racing!
Roccia reveals that her secret to victory is keeping Pero's belly full.
Roccia says Pero is hungry! Spectators, feel free to toss anything you don't need her way!
Congratulations to Roccia for taking first place! We now have her partner, Pero, on camera: "Pero. Pero, Pero!"
Brant says that the finest sailors are just as comfortable on land as fish in water, and don't forget to keep supporting the Troupe of Fools, savvy?
Brant suggests adding a little extra prize money to make the competition more exciting.
Brant thanks the audience for their support and invites you all to stay tuned for more dazzling performances from the Troupe of Fools!
Brant promises to pull out all the stops in the final, so be ready for a show you won't forget!
Congratulations to Brant for taking first place! He hopes his performance left you grinning, and of course, keep supporting the Troupe of Fools!
We now bring you Phoebe's blessings: she hopes everyone enjoys the race and does their best!
Phoebe wishes the eliminated contenders all the best for their next chance to shine!
Phoebe shares her secret to victory: "T-T-There's really no secret!"
Phoebe was so shocked to make it to the final that she froze right in the middle of the interview. How adorable!
Congratulations to Phoebe for taking first place! She attributes her success to the blessing of the Sentinel.
Zani hopes there will be more paid competitions like this in the future.
Zani suggests adding a requalification round for eliminated contenders.
Zani states that she won't stop as long as paid competitions continue to exist.
Zani feels bittersweet about the competition ending: "Good times never last..."
Congratulations to Zani for taking first place! Unfortunately, she declined our interview to enjoy the last few moments of her vacation.
Cantarella wishes everyone a wonderful time and reminds them to stay safe during the race.
Cantarella offers an elixir that promises to bring championship-winning dreams to those eliminated… and it has virtually no side effects!
Cantarella shares a list of "nutritious" foods to boost race performance... but, uh, are these really what you'd call "nutritious"?
Cantarella warns that any contender who made it to the final should not be underestimated, so she plans to up the dosage accordingly… Wait, what dosage?!
Congratulations to Cantarella for taking first place! She says it was truly an enjoyable experience, and it was never about winning or losing.
Cartethyia says that she's fully prepared and promises to put on an exciting show for the audience with her fellow contenders!
Cartethyia says she's happy to have a friendly match with any eliminated contenders who didn't get to enjoy the race to the fullest!
After her victory in the last round, Cartethyia shares her secret: "Just run, run, and keep running. Don't let anyone pass you!"
Cartethyia declined our interview, saying she needs to fully focus on preparing for the final!
Congratulations to Cartethyia for taking first place! But it looks like she wasn't done running. Our camera crew couldn't keep up with her!
Carlotta wishes for a smooth commencement of the race, and the event organizers extend their gratitude for her generous sponsorship of the competition.

(Though some parts of the sword tomb have been weathered, the inscription remains clear.)
 
To the twelve valiant souls who laid down their lives to shield Septimont from disaster.
 
Were it not for your courage in the face of the Kerasaurs' threat, we would have perished beneath their claws.
 
Out of reverence for your will, we have shrouded your names and identities, erecting this sword tomb to ensure your sacrifice is never lost to the ages.
 
We shall forever remember you. And so, we who were saved by your valor make this vow:
 
Should the Kerasaur rise again to threaten Septimont, we, or our descendants, shall rise to meet it. We shall defend this land as you once did, carrying forth your spirit.
 
This oath shall endure, untarnished by time.
A Short Poem

Gryphon's Fortress, Gryphon's Fortress, I feel thee near,
In winds that stir the banners gold, their song I hear.
The shining banners lift and dance, and sing of battles won,
Across the ink-dark tides, through rivers red as blood, and me on the ground.
With them comes the golden triumph, and my mother's call,
With banners high, let winds arise, and bear me far from all.

Gryphon's Fortress, Gryphon's Fortress, I clasp thee tight,
From waters deep, from the lake asleep in the hush of night,
From the streams that flowed through my mother's braids
From the blood-stained water dripping from my brother's blade,
Those waters rise to meet me now, and they will stay, your steadfast aid.

Gryphon's Fortress, Gryphon's Fortress, I will shield thee well,
With lake and sea and blood of mine, a sacred, binding spell.
The dark tides shall never touch thy breast,
The dark tides shall never wash over my mother's hair,
The dark tides shall never bring thy end!
Gryphon's Fortress, O Gryphon's Fortress, in the unsetting sun you gleam,
Forever kissed by whispering breeze, like an eternal dream.

Annals of Past Primuses (Volume One, Excerpts)

The Founding Primus, Napoli the Second

Being the first leader chosen by the Sentinel to bear the Orchestrate carrying Their power, Napoli the Second was the commander who brought an end to the War of Faith, restoring both unified belief and territory to the people of Rinascita.
His ten-year reign brought legal reforms that standardized Rinascita's confused patchwork of laws. Furthermore, by the Sentinel's will, he also oversaw the propagation of the "Common Echoes," designed to shepherd the people back towards a life of normalcy. Under his watch, the Council of Ten was established to balance and legislate between the interests of nobility and common folk.
However, the exhaustive task of laying Rinascita's very foundations ultimately claimed this remarkable Primus. He did not live to see Rinascita grow to its full potential (a point of contention to this day).

The Gilded Primus, Clement

Clement, the sole Primus to hail from the Fisalia bloodline, led the formal codification of the Order's doctrines with the help of the Fisalias. Backed by his family's immense wealth, he elevated the Order's reach and influence to new heights. However, his mental stability deteriorated in later years, leading to erratic attempts to alter the fundamental doctrines—until his unexpected death.
Official historiography attributes his demise to undisclosed and secretive Fisalia rituals. Yet, whether his fractured mind was a consequence of these rituals or the influence of other dark forces remains a compelling subject of discussion.

The Technocrat Primus, Vester the First

A visionary who placed great faith in scientific progress, Primus Vester the First spearheaded the continuous development of Common Echo technology.
His most enduring achievement was the refinement of frequency editing, which lowered the time necessary to bridge the residual frequencies of Tacet Discords and solidified the Order's control over the long-range aggregation technology. For the first time, all Order-operated Common Echoes within Rinascita were able to maintain a state of perpetual frequency aggregation.
This achievement rendered the routine recall and destruction of Echoes obsolete, except in special circumstances. It was a major leap in overcoming the spatiotemporal constraints on Common Echoes and greatly enhanced their stability.

The Carnevale Primus, Pettini

A ruler of extraordinary openness and tolerance, Pettini ushered in an era of unprecedented prosperity. Society flourished, marked by remarkable advancements in technology and philosophy. Yet, as the constraints of tradition fell away, the people plunged into recklessness. With their faith eroded, they started to question the Divinity. What began as enlightenment devolved into dissension.
Thus, Pettini became the architect of ruinous revelry. Over time, the reformists rose in opposition and stripped him of the Primus Seat.
Shortly before his death, Pettini uttered these heretical words: "The Order of the Deep is already a swamp. The statutes, the deeds, the words—they are all twisted. We are beyond salvation... so why not just laugh?"

The Reformist Primus, Podolisk

Primus Podolisk personally executed his predecessor, whose reign had descended into grotesque decadence. Through this bold action, Podolisk averted the fragmentation of Rinascita and guided the people back to the path of unity. He restructured the Council of Ten into the Order Tribunal and tasked it with mediating civil disputes, prosecuting political crimes, and overseeing public affairs.
In his twilight years, Podolisk enacted sweeping theological reforms that would forever alter some of the Order's doctrine. Where previous teachings had maintained that Sentinel Imperator held a high position among many divine beings, Podolisk declared Imperator to be the one true Divinity. As a result, He issued a decree forbidding Acolytes from venerating any other deities.
The History of Rinascita (Excerpt 1)

The two great families diverged on the question of whether a formal faith should be established for the Sentinel.

The Fisalias argued that Rinascita must not retread the fate of the fallen archipelagos and could no longer endure fragmented governance. They advocated for a unifying faith to guide its people, with the Sentinel as the ideal deity. In their view, establishing this faith would also serve as Rinascita's expression of gratitude toward the Sentinel.

Contrasting sharply with this view, the Abrogati warriors held that the Sentinel was a rare and unrepeatable miracle that could not be summoned at will. To place one's hope in a Divinity whose presence is uncertain, they argued, was both foolish and cowardly. The Sentinel had already demonstrated immense benevolence by guiding the people of Rinascita to new lands. To continue praying for further intervention was inapropriate. Instead, they insisted that people must strive to become warriors worthy of standing alongside such a divine being, facing calamity not through supplication, but through strength.

The difference between the two forces steep in historical tensions eventually erupted into large-scale conflict. It was only when Tacet Discords attacked Rinascita that both sides realized their new land was far from a place where they could rest easy.

In the aftermath of the Tacet Discord Crisis and following lengthy negotiations, the Abrogati and their supporters moved westward into the wilds, where they founded Septimont. Meanwhile, the Fisalias led those who remained in establishing what would become Ragunna.
The History of Rinascita (Excerpt 2)

After the Fisalia family established the Sentinel faith and positioned themselves at the core of the religious structure, an increasing number of people in Ragunna began to dream of a fish imbued with divine presence. This phenomenon was especially common among the fishing communities who often went out to sea. When fishermen prayed to this fish in their dreams, their prayers were answered—sometimes with a more bountiful catch, other times by safely avoiding an approaching storm...

These accumulating small miracles over time gave rise to a new faith. While practitioners maintained their devotion to the Sentinel, they increasingly directed prayers to the dreamt fish, drawn by its tangible blessings.

Fearing crackdowns from the Fisalia family, followers of this new faith dared only to spread their belief within a limited circle among the lower classes. Yet as more discovered their shared worship of the same divine fish, a new clandestine group arose.
The History of Rinascita (Excerpt 3)

On the same fateful day, both leaders of the Order, Napoli the First and Napoli the Second, received divine revelations. After deliberation, they agreed that Napoli the Second would embark on a pilgrimage befitting the revelations, while Napoli the First would remain behind to lead the faithful.

In the third year of Napoli the Second's departure, Napoli the First suddenly fell ill and died, leaving the Order leaderless. When the Fisalia family caught wind, a war over authority to interpret the faith was inevitable.

Many believed this conflict would continue indefinitely, but a Dark Tide broke the stalemate. Inexorable in its advance, the Dark Tide indiscriminately overran the homes of all Rinascitans. The Tacet Discords, which surged from the Tides, were so relentless that both warring sides found themselves exhausted and forced into retreat. As each side prepared for a desperate final battle, Napoli the Second returned from his pilgrimage with a sacred lantern-shaped relic which a flood of Divine Envoys emerged, turning the tide of battle.

Following this event, Napoli the Second's prestige soared. Recognizing that their situation was untenable, the Fisalia family initiated peace talks with The Order. The precise details of the negotiation have been lost to time, as only a handful were present when Napoli the Second entered the gate of Fisalia castle, bearing a tightly bound sword.

Following these talks, Napoli the Second's coronation as Primus proceeded without opposition, and governance of Ragunna transitioned to The Order of the Deep.
An Acolyte's Diary from the Avenolium Theological Seminary

<s>Fenrico's devotion, wisdom, and determination are sufficient for him to become a second significant Priest in Avenolium.</s>

<s>Unfortunately, compared to the other one, he seems to lack spiritual insight and flexibility…</s>

Impossible, impossible! So long as I study hard and practice what we preach, I WILL stand before the Divinity someday.

Is it not right to take the sacred Codex in its most literal form and apply these truths to every aspect of society?

These teachings are the only authoritative truth. I must still be lacking the full comprehension. But once my understanding is clear enough to uphold these truths, They will surely understand. They will surely see me.

The Divinity is gone with the Blessed Maiden.
Rinascita must have its Divinity.
This... is my chance.
I will sit on that chair.
I will console the flocks.
I will deliver the Divinity's Oracle.
As it should have been my right.

The Carnevale must be canceled to safeguard the authority of our Order and to strengthen the foundation of our faith.

Only then will the Blessed Maiden be gone forever. Without her meddling, I shall lead Ragunna to a better future.

Merely delivering the Oracle is simply insufficient to earn people's trust. I must step back, foment a disaster, and perform an act of salvation.

When this year's liner is sunk by the behemoth monster of the sea, and the tide washes up horrific casualties, they will understand the punishment I speak of. Only then will I call upon divine power to halt the disaster. As the curtain falls on this spectacle, they will see the truth with their own eyes, and in that moment, all will trust me unreservedly. The masses will instead cheer as I cancel the Carnevale.

Spacetrek Collective Research Institute

The Spacetrek Collective Research Institute is a borderless research facility, where scientists from around the world study the Exostrider and the Stridergate. It also serves as the R&D center of the artificial sun, Helios. Standing at the highest point in Lahai-Roi, the Institute is built on an orbit track alongside the Starward Riseway, continuously monitoring the Exostrider's great sword. Over the years, countless researchers have devoted their lives and wisdom here, all in the hope that humanity's torch of exploration will forever burn bright.

Startorch Academy offers every student a private dorm room to relax and recharge. Every space in the building is thoughtfully designed to meet a variety of needs. But no matrix, no algorithm, no matter how complex, can model the human heart. Gotta ask yourself a simple question: Would you rather live in peace as a nobody, or go down for all times in a blaze of glory?
Greetings from the New World

Gonks who might mistake this place as an oasis, as some escape from their troubles, will learn the hard way. There's no such thing as a "fresh start." Toss aside your past life all you want, but old debts will always come due.
Little Clouds
Sit down, close your eyes, get your eddies at the ready, and witness your wildest fantasies turn to reality in an instant. How long will it last, you ask? Depends how many BDs you can pony up for.
Mean Streets

Between the restlessness of a neon-soaked city and the peace of a distant moon, what would you choose? A girl already accustomed to the grime of those streets looked up to moon one day and made her choice. She eventually reached her goal, but the price proved far more costly than she could've imagined.
Wastelands

Money and the luxuries it provides don't extend into this barren land of nightmares. But maybe life on the road isn't so bad. Riding a motorcycle, chromatic rock blasting at max volume – sounds preem, no doubt. Just don't let any ghouls hiding in roadside ditches leave you with a flat.
Jungle

Dismantled, reassembled, redundancies removed – only acid rain and the relics of industry remain. Above shimmers a digital paradise in a sea of stars. While, below, a hellscape of concrete and steel burns and scars.
Elementary

Filter out the noise, peel back the layers. Might be surprised to discover no one cares about the truth. Out there, the toxic fumes of desire rise like a haze from the streets. Either you choose to keep running, or sin and suffering will catch up to you.
Christmas Tree Attack

In this city, even the digital can dream. Data, whether stored on a server or in a meat brain, inevitably tries to carve a path for itself forward. How and why does this always happen? Does code have a soul?

Initiating frequency suppressor injection… triple unit. Ogo's frequency detected, causing effective interference with the Tacet Discord's frequency. Synchronization rate: 95.27%.

It all began three days ago. I was deep in the mountains hunting for a rare herb and lost track of time.

Revenge on the Sentinel? That's wild!

I turned and ran, and that monster kept howling behind me. Believe me, I've never heard anything so bone-chilling.

Here we are! Let's look for the perfect spot...
Oh, look at that ancient tree! Such a picturesque sight! Come, let's capture it!

See any good spots nearby?

Egg!

Corn?

He noticed a date on the calendar that he had never seen before. In shock, he grabbed a passerby and urgently asked, "Excuse me, can you tell me the current date and time?"
As he heard the answer, his legs went weak. Everything had changed—time had passed and his loved ones were gone. No one remembered him anymore.
So the woodcutter left Mt. Firmament, but how was he still alive and kicking? With a hundred year's worth of time inside him, shouldn't he...
Your story... It's a bit far-fetched, don't you think? I mean, if I wasn't from Hongzhen, I might have fallen for it.
...Well! That's the whole point. The truth is stranger than fiction, my friend. Every detail in that story is based on real events.
Let me share with you the other legend of Mt. Firmament, for deep within its sacred peaks lies a powerful secret... the "Secret of Immortality"!

We all know that Mt. Firmament is the abode of the Sentinel, gathering spiritual energies from both heaven and earth for countless eons. Over time, even the mountain itself has taken on the form of our majestic Sentinel!
Living in the mountains for long stretches of time, surrounded by fresh air and drinking from nature's own bounty, can add years to one's life span!
It all starts with that game of Weiqi, one that the woodcutter stumbled upon. Too bad those secrets have been long forgotten...
Gather around now, people. You're in for the story of a lifetime...
…Changli?
Shh...
...I'll see you there.
*yawn* What's with the ruckus... Huh, what’s that in your hands?
Changli gave it to me a moment ago.
Hmm... "Behold Hongzhen in its entirety, next to a ring and hanging eaves. When eternal snow thaw into flowing streams, let us reconvene."
Ooh... I see, I see...
Do you know what it means?
Ooh... So that's how it is...
I see I've got no clue at all!
So much for the anticipation!
Wow, I'm so shocked to hear that.
I get the very last part, at least! She’s asking you out! Well that's a fancy way to write stuff...
...The first part reads like it's about the meeting spot.
According to the description, it's somewhere in Hongzhen.
How did you manage to get all that hidden meaning?
I'm experienced. Dealt with Jinhsi's riddles already.
Thanks to my big brain.
But the buildings in Hongzhen all look pretty much the same. Which one exactly was she talking about?
We can ask around to find out. I’ve done this before.
Makes sense. Lead the way!
And now... this next sentence, "eternal snow thaw into streams"... What is that supposed to mean?
Maybe it has something to do with local folklore.
Rover, you're here.
I trust you’ll guide me well, Miss Wayfinder.
The notes only provided a vague idea of where the game record is. I've determined the most likely location on my last visit.
We’ll be heading there. See if we can find anything new.
You've been there before?
That’s surprisingly straightforward, especially coming from you.
But one can only do so much alone. This is why I need your help.
Lucky for you, I'm very good at finding things.
Gotta throw myself a challenge from time to time.
I'm not planning to go back on my own words.
How reliable.
Then let's get going.
Wasn't expecting you to arrive before me.
Well... As the Wayfinder, I do know a couple shortcuts.
Where are we going?
After dealing with those Artificers, I ruled out the other locations on my way to join you.
You seem curious about that ancient structure.
It looks familiar... Like the abandoned Court of Savantae facility I saw, but bigger in scale.
I heard it first appeared along with our Sentinel. Later, the Court of Savantae based their Chronosorters on its design.
We can see the whole of Hongzhen from here.
I never noticed how beautiful it looked during my previous visits.
It's the same place as always. I suppose it's my state of mind that has changed.
How did it change?
I don't know. Maybe it's because... Your presence makes me feel at ease.
Wait... I smell Tacet Discords in that cave!
No... There's more... Tacet Discords, humans, and...
Smells like a whole bunch of messed up frequencies... It's so... familiar...
(How could there be any Tacet Discords in Mt. Firmament?)
(Is Abby sleep talking again?)
C’mon, after all we've been through, you still don't trust my sniffer? Be grateful, I'm giving you a warning!
Rover? Did something happen?
Tacet Discords could be assaulting people over there.
It's in the same direction we’re going. Could it be...
Let's go take a look.
Signs of climbing... Someone may have been here before us.
A compass buried in the ground. It resembles those commonly used by the Pioneer Association.
Multiple footprints with varying levels of depth. They suggest a person was hastily running away from something.
Get away... from me! Ugh... I can't hold up much longer...
Help, help! Oh, thank goodness...
Please stand back. We'll take it from here.
I-I can fight! Let me help!
T-Thanks for your help...
Are you all right?
I... I'm okay. Wait, you... Are you THE Rover...?
How do you know me?
You're that hero who fought against the Threnodian, and you also resolved the time crisis here with Madam Magistrate. Everyone's been talking about you...
And Lady Changli... I-I never thought I'd have the chance to see you in person...
...Without your help, I would've been a goner for sure...
I can't die here. Not when I've got someone waiting for me...
I've finally, finally found it... After all this time... Ugh...
Take it easy. Everything's all right.
Relax. Your wounds look pretty bad.

While we've solved the crisis in Mt. Firmament for the time being... Public access to the mountain is still restricted. Before entering the mountain, any explorer must submit a request and can only do so while accompanied by the Midnight Rangers.
Sir, could you please share your reasons for traveling here alone?
I, I heard about Mt. Firmament's legend... So I came to find its secret...
I've only been in the mountain for half a day, everything was going smoothly before those monsters pounced on me on my way back... *cough*...
I must get back... Fuling... She's still waiting for me...
He doesn't look like he's only been here for half a day...
He seems a bit off.
It seems he is still hiding something from us.
He needs to go back to Hongzhen for proper medical attention... Time is against us.
We’ll need to escort him down the mountain.
Something feels strange about this place.
Agreed.
The appearance of Tacet Discords is indeed unusual… We can ask him later when he's recovered a bit more.
Indeed. Tacet Discords appearing in such numbers on Mt. Firmament, of all places… This is unusual, to say the least.
We can continue our conversation later, after getting him to safety.
On that note, we still don't know his identity... Judging from this uniform, he might be affiliated with the Pioneer Association.
The Association has a presence in Hongzhen right now.
He mentioned someone waiting for him.
Good point, Rover. Let's head back.
Some of those injuries are older than half a day...
Then perhaps that "someone" is in Hongzhen. Could be his friend or an acquaintance.
You take the adventurer in coma and return to Hongzhen with Changli
What can I help you with?
(Ask about the riddle in Changli’s note.)
"When snow thaw into streams"? Ah, you’re not from around here, I bet? When we say that in Hongzhen, we mean the <ano=Time Period>Shichen</ano> of Wei. Early afternoon, the warmest hours of a day.

Legend tells of a visitor who ventured here some centuries ago. Back then, local villagers were struggling with no firewood due to heavy snow. This visitor opened up a path with their Forte and diverted a hot spring to provide warmth and aid.

People say it was once a stunning sight, with mist and ice flowing westward down the streams, as if many celestial beings were returning to the sea. Now the sight has unfortunately disappeared, but the saying sticks. We use it to describe time in local speech.
I see.
Well, it's what Grandpa Zou tells everyone. I haven't seen it with my own eyes, but when it comes to stories like this one... They're usually made-up.
You don't believe in those stories?
Hmm... Not that I don't want to believe them, but... Oh, you were listening to one of his stories earlier too, right? What did you think?
It sounded interesting.
It was a bit too exaggerated.
I wasn't mentioned in the story, so a thumbs down.
Haha... Maybe Grandpa Zou can learn a thing or two from you in terms of humor.

Grandpa Zou's great-grandfather was a descendant of the first inhabitants of Hongzhen. He grew up hearing stories about Mt. Firmament. Recently he heard Madam Magistrate had resolved the crisis, so he decided to visit and learn more about his roots.

People in town are curious about the outside world and how they are perceived. Grandpa Zou is happy to answer their questions and has unknowingly become popular among them. Before he knew it, everyone was coming to talk to him...
And it turned into a storytelling session...
He must be a fan of that storyteller in Jinzhou.
It's funny to hear outsiders describe my hometown, Hongzhen, as mysterious. We're just a normal place with our own quirks...

Especially lately, with so many people from Jinzhou coming on some kind of expedition. They're obsessed with us, like we're some kind of ancient relics. Can you believe they actually asked if our Pavo Plums have magical powers?
Time truly is a formidable force...
Really? So you're into stories and anecdotes too?
Looks like we have that in common.
You're such a great storyteller, like everyone else I met here.
Oh please, I'm only repeating what I've heard from him. He's been on a roll with his stories lately. But let's not take them too seriously, they're just for entertainment.
Woah...! G-Greetings, Lady Changli!
H-How may I help you today, Lady Changli? Oh and, hello {PlayerName}! The person on your back... Is he okay?
We found him on Mt. Firmament. Do you know where his companions might be?
Isn't this Wuli? What happened to him?
He was attacked by Tacet Discords.
He's still unconscious...
He's one of the Pioneer Association's explorers, but we don't see him around Jinzhou too often.
I remember he went on sabbatical months ago, and he left with Fuling...
Fuling?
Yes, Fuling, his girlfriend. I think they're visiting Hongzhen together. They're staying at the inn over there.
Oh, Fuling asked us about his whereabouts not long ago. She seemed quite worried.
Speaking of... Is he really okay? Perhaps we should get him to a hospital first...
No, I'm not going... Fuling... She's waiting for me...
Don't worry. We'll help you find Fuling.
W-Wuli! I.. *cough*...
Breathe. Take it easy.
*cough*... Thank you. I'm okay now. Who are you? ... And Wuli, is he...
You must be Fuling?
Yes, I am... Can you please tell me what happened?
Fuling...!
Wuli... You're hurt?! I've been looking for you... You didn't pick up my calls...
Great news, Fuling! ...I found it! Finally!
I've found a way to slow down your illness. No more pain, my love... We can finally be together, forever!
You mean... that legend? It's real?
Fuling... Are you... Are you not happy?
No... I am... I'm so glad to hear it.
Haha... Yes...
...Wuli!
You carry an exhausted and unconscious Wuli to a doctor to treat his injuries.
Thank you, {PlayerName}, Lady Changli. You saved his life...
I'm glad he's okay.
May I please ask... what on earth happened? I've never seen Wuli like that...
Well...
... And then we found you.
So... He said he only spent half a day in the mountains?
Was that not the case?
No... I've been... I've been waiting for almost a week.

It's not unusual for Wuli to be out of touch for a few days when he goes on long trips. This time, however, seemed longer than usual. If it weren't for you two showing up, I would have asked the Midnight Rangers to help me search for him in the mountains.
What's his obsession with the mountains?
Wuli, he... He did it for me.
I used to work as a landscape painter. Wuli and I met through work, and we traveled to many places together.

A few months ago, I got really sick. It affected my ability to walk, which got worse over time. We couldn't go on our adventures like we used to. Wuli stopped taking on work and traveled all over the world to find a cure for me.
Despite his efforts, we couldn't find any cures... Until two weeks ago, when he brought me to Hongzhen. Said he had a surprise for me.
I thought it was just going to be a relaxing trip, but he disappeared for seven days. Now he's back, rambling about having found a way to stop my condition from progressing...
He was saying something about the "legend"...
Mt. Firmament's "Secret of Immortality", I presume?
Yes... Wuli told me that he's researched and found an untouched paradise on Mt. Firmament. A place where time stands still. He said if I lived there, my condition would never worsen...
...It cannot fully cure me, but at least we can spend eternity together.
At first, I thought it was just a myth... But then you brought up how he only spent half a day in the mountains...
He may have run into Temporal Disruptions.
Those were my thoughts as well, but Wuli seemed very certain.
Mt. Firmament used to have Temporal Disruptions caused by its tumultuous history. However, thanks to Magistrate Jinhsi and Rover, these disruptions have been dealt with. Or so we had hoped.
Looks like there might still be some of them.
So there are still unaddressed Temporal Disruptions in the mountains. And unfortunately, Wuli has stumbled upon one, mistaking it for the legendary cure he was searching for.
But little did he know, it would only put him in more danger.
I see...
...So that's why there were rumors of Rangers being here to take care of the leftover Tacet Discords, and block off access to the mountain...
Then... if this Temporal Disruption you speak of is truly so dangerous...
{PlayerName}, Lady Changli, please help us get rid of it. For the sake of everyone here.
But your friend...
He truly thinks it's the only way to save you. He's willing to take a slim chance, just for you.
*cough* I... I'm okay. I haven't talked this much in a long time.
I'll go get a doctor for you.
You need to rest.
...I'm just a little tired. I'll be fine after some rest.
Once Wuli wakes up, I'll explain everything to him.
If you have any other ideas, just tell him.
But if you keep it all to yourself... No one, even those closest to you, will know how you really feel.
...Yes. I understand.
{PlayerName}, things are taking a turn. We should probably tell Lady Xinyi first.
Freezing my own time... I don't think I should do that. It's not my best option. I appreciate your concerns, but I'll be fine.
Dreams always come to an end. Eventually we have to wake up, and keep moving forward.
Indeed. Let's go.
What brings you here at this time of the day?
There's been a bit of an incident.
You explain the events that have transpired.
I see. Strange appearances of Tacet Discords in the mountains, and undiscovered Temporal Disruptions...
There are several questionable details according to {PlayerName}'s description.
What do you make of Fuling's words from earlier, Rover?
About what happened to Wuli...

He claimed to have spent only half a day in the mountains, but it's been seven days since he returned to Hongzhen... That does sound like some kind of Temporal Disruption, one that wasn't strong enough to affect Hongzhen.
After Jinhsi's battle with the Sentinel, she ordered Midnight Rangers to patrol Hongzhen and inspect Mt. Firmament for any lingering Temporal Disruptions before reopening it to the public.
{PlayerName}, you've been exploring the mountains lately, so I'm sure you have a good grasp on Mt. Firmament. But if there are any hidden disruptions we missed...
It must've appeared after Wuli entered the mountains.
Someone had kept it hidden.
Precisely. Yet... Why did it reappear at this point?
Maybe it has something to do with Wuli.
Maybe it needed a specific trigger.
Fuling's "legend" differs from the situation at Mt. Firmament we're familiar with. In that tale, mortals were spared the cost of losing years from their lives.
He was utterly convinced of his discovery, and he somehow managed to run into Temporal Disruptions in half a day’s time. Also… when I questioned him, he evaded my inquiries.
Was he lying?
He was hiding something.
Lies that are most challenging to detect aren't usually outright falsehoods, rather they hide parts of the truth.
The explorer wanted to save his friend indeed, but he was also hiding something.
...I've become rather curious about the truth behind this "Temporal Disruption."
About Fuling's attitude towards all of this...
Did you notice something, {PlayerName}?
She accepted the reality a little too quickly.
Why did she want to get rid of the Temporal Disruption?
For someone with a terminal illness, they should hold onto any chance of survival—no matter how slim... Is that what you think?
Maybe she's come to terms with her destiny, or maybe... she never planned on continuing to live like that forever.
Changli...
...Well, please pardon my baseless speculations.
About the anomalies in that area...
I knew you'd notice too.
The frequency disturbance here is weak. It's similar to past Temporal Disruptions at Mt. Firmament, but not exactly the same.
Master Xuanmiao's records show that this is where the game record last appeared. This is also where we found that explorer.
... As Changli mentioned, this anomaly may indeed have something to do with that legendary game record.
The complete Temporal Program indicated in that game record...
Exactly... If this were to be the case, then we are not the only ones searching for its whereabouts.
The explorer did not tell us about his source of information.
But his knowledge of Mt. Firmament far exceeds that of a first-time visitor.
You mean...
Something bigger is behind all of this.
We need more information. Let's not act rashly.
Got it. The Midnight Rangers will block all entrances to the mountain for now. And Changli, you still have the power to send in garrison troops as needed.
We left Mt. Firmament in a hurry. I need to go back up the mountain and investigate further... I have some theories that could use confirmation.
We're still unsure about the exact location and range of the Temporal Disruption. Regardless, its reappearance is a pressing issue that needs our attention.
I'm coming with you.
It may get dangerous.
I haven't fulfilled my promise yet.
Then having another person onboard makes it less dangerous.
Well then... Thank you, {PlayerName}.
Thank you again for your help. You were supposed to be here for a relaxing time... but it seems another crisis has popped up.
Do take extra caution.
Now it has become quite clear what the two were thinking.
So this is what she had on her mind...
Did you know about it all along?
I had my speculation.

Fuling has come to terms with her impending death. She doesn't buy into the legends of "immortality." Instead, she simply wants to make the most of the time she has left and fulfill her and Wuli's dreams together.
If Wuli wants to reach that so-called "paradise," he'll be trapped inside forever. It also means he'll have to give up his entire future as an explorer.
That is not what she wants for him.
Her ultimate desire is for her lover to embrace her inevitable passing, and to realize the joint aspirations they hold in her place.
She hasn't given up, but rather clings to hope for their future, even if she won't be there to see it unfold.
Would you make the same choice... If it had happened to you?
Hmm...? Why the sudden question?
It seems you don't care that much about your own death.
You seem to understand Fuling deeply.
Is that how you see me? Hmm... Perhaps for some, death is just a destination. There are more significant things to focus on.
I'm just making an educated guess from what we've collected. And honestly, Fuling isn't exactly good at keeping things to herself.
Let's stay focused on the issue. While the diary is cryptic, it still exposes the true intentions of whoever misled Wuli.
It's no coincidence. All the clues point to a correlation between the Temporal Disruption and the legends of the Weiqi game. Or maybe... someone's trying to make us connect the dots.
Wuli's diary mentioned the Sentinel.
Yes. Information on the actual powers of Jué... This isn't the kind of information an ordinary explorer can obtain.
I guess our "old friends" have still not given up.
They went to great lengths just to lead us here. It would be rather rude of us to not respond in some way.
According to the information in my master's notes, and Wuli's map...
...The place we're looking for should be just ahead.
Since the Fractsidus already know so much about the Sentinel...
Traces of excavation on the ground... Looks like someone was trying to dig a hole with their bare hands. Could it be Wuli?
This is... a Weiqi board.
Could it have anything to do with the game record?
The abnormal time flow here is most likely caused by the Chronosorters. Perhaps there is a way to fix it.
Marvelous play, truly remarkable. Occupying both solid territory and influence. An extraordinary move.
Never have I imagined I'd experience such a great game of Weiqi on Mt. Firmament. You may look young, my friend, but there's so much more to you than meets the eye.
Please, no need to be so modest. I can tell the difference between our skill levels.
A mirage of the past...
...This is my master's voice. The voice of the other person seems deliberately erased.
Master Xuanmiao?
Who do you think the other person looks like?
That person looks familiar.
That person looks like... me?
Is this why you brought me here?
Changli seems to be in deep thought and does not answer.
What do you want? I've done nothing wrong!
(Ask about the riddle in Changli's note.)
Huh? Uh... You're just asking for directions...? Sorry, I'm not a local, can't help you there.
Wait, you... you were the one talking to Lady Changli earlier, weren't you?
The young man begins looking around warily, as if in fear of something terrible hidden in the shadows.
If I were you, I'd steer clear of her. She's a deceitful woman who enjoys toying with people's hearts. A cunning villain who will manipulate you without you even knowing it.
How so?
Haven't you heard? She left her government job to come here, to this small town. There's gotta be a reason behind it.
I heard she chose to quit her job, but I bet she messed up back in the capital and got demoted here as punishment.
...It's not nice to badmouth people like this.
Not everyone values power and fame.

Then I guess you've also been fooled by her looks. That woman will stop at nothing to get what she wants, while you remain oblivious to her true intentions. And by the time you catch on, you'll already be caught in her trap.
Wait a minute, has she actually achieved anything substantial during her time in Jinzhou? Or did Madam Magistrate just fall for her clever words and let her slack off?
You're underestimating Jinhsi.
What makes you so sure?
Hmph... I say you're underestimating Changli's trickery.
I... I have my reasons to believe so!
I heard she tricked that VIP guest of Jinzhou into going to Mt. Firmament. Just think about how dangerous that place was!

She must have been afraid of {Male=him;Female=her} getting too close to Madam Magistrate and ruining her plans... What a sinister woman! Fortunately, that guest was a skilled fighter, and {Male=he;Female=she} managed to escape unharmed.
I hope you don't mind my frankness. Just giving some advice, 'cause you look pretty innocent and gullible... Not from Jinzhou judging by your outfit, right?
I am that VIP guest.
People call me Rover.
Oh shoot, I completely forgot about something I need to do. Sorry, gotta run...
It has been decades since we last met, but you, my friend, still look the same.
Turns out I had already met you all those years ago, my life saver… and you're older than me. I should have been more respectful back then.
So you remember our promise. I am overjoyed...
A new city is about to be established. Having accomplished so much, why do you choose to retire now?
...I may have spoken out of turn. If you're not in a rush to depart Jinzhou, how about another round of Weiqi with me?
*cough*... Well played. Even after twenty years, I still have no chance of winning against you.
Haha... I barely noticed how so much time has passed.
Every move in Weiqi is fluid and unpredictable. Even if we start with the same opening, the outcome can never be predetermined... We see this in our game, and it's true for all the lives out there.
My clan are a group of hermits. We view the world as a game of strategy, manipulating the ebb and flow behind the scenes...
But you, my friend, chose to enter the game yourself. It's a dangerous path with no end in sight. I want to help, but my time is running out. I won't be there when you finally succeed...
Please don't feel sad for me. If I die, it would be an honor to rest at the Sentinel's feet.
When the time comes... the one who shall finish this game of Weiqi with you will not be me, but rather my apprentice.
Do my plans seem too risky to you?
No need for concern. With her intelligence and quick thinking, she'll surely be able to solve this puzzle.
The result of this game will decide the fate of Jinzhou, and even the entire world.
The road ahead is long and treacherous... Our final game, let's make it...
You've come this far and followed us here, yet you hesitate to reveal yourselves. Guess I'll have to take the lead and extend an invitation.
...Don't assume you'll always be in control, Changli.
Enough talk.
Our friendly chat is over. It's time to say goodbye.
Still not giving up yet, Changli?
We know more than just that unfinished game, we are well aware of the price you have paid... You're dangling at the end of your rope.
Your unwitting trail has led us straight to our target.
Oh? Is that so?
The Sonoro Sphere is open. Go!
Stop them!
Sorry, but you're not getting past me.
Jué's formidable time-bending abilities, at their peak... All trapped within this Sonoro Sphere, as I'm sure you are well aware.
It's only a legend.
Do you really want to chase after this legend when you don't even know if it's real?
So what? Wouldn't it be a sight to behold as this Sonoro Sphere consumes everything in its path, while the Temporal Disruptions bring death?
You're out of your mind...
Anyway... {PlayerName}, thank you for letting us into this Sonoro Sphere.
You are indeed very special, as the Excellency foretold.
Uhh... How did she disappear like that? Wait, are you that legendary Rover who saved Jinzhou?!
(Ask about the riddle in Changli's note.)
Well, you've come to the right person! I'm here to compile a new travel guide for Hongzhen!
"Next to a ring and hanging eaves"... Oh! I know where that is. You'll need to stand on the tallest building in Hongzhen to see what you're looking for.
It's on the northeast side of the town, can't miss it. You'll see it once you get there.
Say, that person earlier... that was Lady Changli, right?! I saw you talking to her!
Do you know her?
Of course! Everyone in Jinzhou knows about Lady Changli, even though she rarely appears in public.

As Master Xuanmiao's disciple, she excels in the arts of politics and diplomacy. Her travels have taken her across the four seas, and as Secretary-General, she has commanded respect from all who cross her path!
Really?
Yeah! And she came all the way to Jinzhou to help out Magistrate Jinhsi for the sake of peace in Huanglong. She's been working tirelessly behind the scenes since then, fully dedicated to her task...
How could anyone not revere such a selfless act?
*sigh* I could've sworn I just saw her. Where did she go? I wish I could take one more look...
Are you sure you're just here for the travel guide?
Ahaha...
The tallest building?
Ahem... what can I do for you?
Yes.
I can't help but feel envious. I wish I could speak to her like you did, but she refuses to do interviews with the Pioneer Association. Plus, I doubt we have anything in common to talk about anyway.
Hey. Why are the people here so divided about Changli?
She doesn't seem to have ill intents.
We'll have to figure it out ourselves.
Hmm... You humans make everything so complicated.
Well, at least now we know what she wanted to say.
"Let’s meet at the highest place in Hongzhen, in the early afternoon."
Now that’s much easier to understand. Why did she have to make it a whole riddle? *yawn*... I’m getting sleepy again.
Rover?
Nice to see you again. How are you liking Hongzhen so far?
It's nice. The place is bustling with life.
It's much more lively than before.

The crisis at Mt. Firmament has been resolved, and the waterway between Jinzhou and Hongzhen is open once again. As a result, there has been an increase in visitors from Jinzhou, making the town more lively than before.
With the chaos subsiding, our town and city are now reconnected, allowing residents to live and work in peace.
We owe you a debt of gratitude, Rover, for your efforts in clearing the remaining effects of Temporal Disruptions in Mt. Firmament over the past few days.
Just doing my part.
Couldn't have done it without everyone.
That job was a beast. You better have my money ready.
*chuckle* Of course.
We're all indebted to you, Hongzhen and its people alike. If there's anything you need, don't hesitate to ask.
I couldn't help but notice you've been asking around. Is there something you need assistance with?
(Xinyi and Changli have a mutual trust as acquaintances. It should be fine to ask Xinyi instead...)
Well...
You tell Xinyi about your encounter with Changli and what the passersby said about her.
Hmm... I see. That sounds like something Changli would do.
Even though we're not that close, I know a bit about her personality. She wouldn't just hand over something that symbolizes her identity to anyone, especially when...
Especially what?
I think it would be better for her to tell you personally.
The Magistrate's Counselor is shrouded in mystery, and her motives are often hard to decipher...
When she wants something done, it's never as straightforward as it seems, and few can grasp the true meaning behind her plans.
The rumors and controversies surrounding her never cease, but she seems unfazed.
However... I believe one has to get involved personally to truly understand Changli's intentions, regardless of public opinion.
My plans exactly.
I'm very curious about her plans.
About the riddle... it seems you have already figured it out by yourself.
But remember, it's not just about the answer, but also what she wants you to understand.
Indeed.
If there's anything else you need here in Hongzhen, please do not hesitate to let me know.
Thank you.
*chuckle* Then... If you'll excuse me.
It's so beautiful...
Wuli, this is the miracle we've been waiting to see! It's hope reborn after destruction...
Fuling...
