Compiling the codebase based on the current epoch of Solaris.

We're almost through!

Go. Explore.
There's much to this world than meets the eye.

You may depend on those around you, just as they depend on you.

If you let your mind wander for a second, you never know what might jump out at you.
So, are you here to help?
Of course, darling. We share the same goal, after all.
By the way, I found this nearby. Here, take it.
Let's finish up here quickly, and in return for my little gift... Promise me you'll save some time for me in the real world, okay?
Well, well, I didn't think we could have this kind of fun here.
Do whatever you want—let's make it more intense, more fiery, more electrifying than the real world…
I'll handle you later.
You're next once I've handled things here.
Are you going to keep me waiting again? Why can't we fight right now?
Because I have something urgent to take care of.
Fine… I'll behave. There's still plenty of time for us, hehe.
I can feel it... Those chaotic energies are gathering somewhere. Looks like there's a big surprise in store for you.
I'll be right back.
Hehe, take this little cutie with you and hurry back, my seed of fate.
{PlayerName}, I was musing about their relationship.
Do you mean the dynamics between the Ebony and Ivory Gatekeepers?
Yes, the Somnoire's guardians. Are they rivals or allies?
I think it's a bit of both.
Sometimes they work together, and other times they clash.
Hmm… They're like two sides of the same coin—interdependent yet counterbalancing. The Somnoire reflects that balance.
The recent disturbances were the result of a series of actions that tipped the scales, rather than the fault of one side going off track.
So, we need to restore the balance.
Are you suggesting I shouldn't favor the Ivory Gatekeeper?
Just my humble opinion. No need to dwell on it. Here, take this pouch. It may prove useful on your journey.
By the way, I'd love to hear about your adventures when you're back, if you have time.
{PlayerName}, good to see you again!
Lumi?
Why are you still here?
It's Lumi, the logistics team's good ol' captain.
Why can't I be here? Are you worried that I might be someone else?
There are still lots of messes to clean up, and besides, the dream's not over yet.
You remember what happened before, right?
Of course! We teamed up and took down that big cat, right?
Don't ya know dreams can pick up where they left off? Must be thanks to that Ivory Gatekeeper, huh?
Maybe so.
He helped a lot, didn't he?
Anyway, now that we're back, let's shake things up! No regrets when we wake up!
Oh, by the way, I ran into this quiet lady on my way here. She asked me to deliver this package to you.
A package?
Yep! Just sign here, and—another satisfied customer!
{PlayerName}... I-I think I just saw someone else's dream.
It was in a small, dim room. A child, with her parents watching so warmly, blew out the candles on a tiny cake... and smiled.
You seem a bit moved.
Yes... It was such a simple, ordinary moment, but it felt so full of happiness.
Maybe I had moments like that when I was little too.
But I can't remember anymore... I've gotten so used to being alone. And in my dreams, my parents always seem so... stern, so far away.
You've always been strong.
But you're not alone anymore.
N-no... I'm not strong... but if that's how you see me, I-I'll try to live up to your expectations.
Um... t-thank you... It makes me really happy to hear that, b-but... I don't know how to respond...
I've probably taken up too much of your time. Please, take this painting with you.
Even if it was just a dream, it holds a lot of my feelings... a-and I want to share them with you.
Ah, you're here. Speaking of which, I've stumbled upon quite a few... intriguing nightmares lately.
Seriously? Intriguing for nightmares?
Yes. I encountered different dreamers, but they all feared the same figure—though her appearance varied from one dream to the next.
Sometimes she appeared as a stern office worker, sometimes a lowlife street thug, and other times... a lone Exile wandering the wilds.
Ah, I see. That person... it was you, wasn't it?
Those were criminals' nightmares about you, right?
Well, I rarely reveal myself during a mission, but it's amusing when the "lucky few" get a glimpse.
If they're haunted by a little... trauma, it might make them hesitate the next time they think of causing trouble.
But you don't seem happy.
You've sacrificed a lot.
Hehe, trying to console me, are you, darling? Playing these sinister roles is simply part of the game. It's only natural that I appear in their nightmares.
But I see the real you—not the masks you wear.
I always see you as who you are.
You certainly know what to say, don't you?
Then come closer. I want to reward you with... a memory that tingles just right.
So, it really is you. I owe you my gratitude.
For...?
What happened?
I was trapped in yet another endless dream, fighting Tacet Discords alone. No matter how many I vanquished, they continued to rise.
The voices of the fallen cursed my every step, assailing my spirit. Yet, amidst the chaos, a radiant, golden light broke through the darkness.
It was fleeting, but soon after, you appeared.
But I didn't do anything.
You're the one who endured to the end.
Before, such dreams felt eternal, persisting until I awoke.
Yet, ever since we've crossed paths, I haven't been haunted by them again.
That dream will never become reality.
If you ever falter, I'll stand beside you and support you.
Thank you... If you're heading to somewhere perilous, take this lance.
May it grant you safe passage through every trial, and may it help you prevail the lasting night.
I didn't expect to cross paths with you here, {PlayerName}.
This place... it's quite amazing. As I walked through, I felt as if I was drifting between past memories and, at times, into the fantasies of others.
We're in the dreamscape.
I see. That would explain a lot.
Is something troubling you?
Dreams always stir mixed emotions in me. For a long time, I was plagued by nightmares.
Sleepless nights filled with images of my people displaced, shivering in the cold, and facing hunger. We were all so small before the might of the Lament.
Yet, those nightmares serve as a constant reminder of the complex challenges our people face, the burdens I bear as the Magistrate of Jinzhou.
It's okay to take a rest sometimes.
Let go of your responsibilities! You're in a dream!
But aren't you working just as hard to protect what you hold dear?
This ear of millet... it holds deep meaning for me, but now, I'd like you to have it. May everything go smoothly for you on your journey.
Ah... that is reminiscing
What happened?
I just had a dream from my past.
Simple dishes—plain noodles and soft steamed buns—but even in the dream, they appeared irresistible.
Really?
Steamed buns and noodles?
Surprised? In my childhood, I wandered the streets, often plagued by hunger. Each time I passed a restaurant or a food stall, my steps felt heavier.
Back then, all I longed for was a decent meal—so much so that it echoed even in my dreams.
That must have been tough for you.
It's behind me now. Look at me, healthy and well, am I not?
When peace is finally enjoyed across the land, no one will have to starve as I once did.
When we wake, let's go grab a meal together.
I'll treat you to a feast in reality.
Hehe, I won't say no to that. Then, it's a promise.
Here, take this journal. It contains some recommendations. I hope you find it useful.
Anything to share with me?
What happened?
Listen.
You faintly hear the sounds of waves crashing against the shore—they seem distant, yet stirring emotions within you.
Those sounds always take me back to the moments we shared—bathed in soft moonlight, with fine sand beneath us, and the rhythm of your breath and heartbeat filling the air.
You really cherish those memories, don't you?
...It reassured me that I have indeed kept our memories for you.
We'll create even more memories together.
Let's explore more of the world together.
Indeed, our connection will only grow stronger.
Let these bright stars guide you on your journey.
As expected, our paths shall always cross, even in dreams.
You come here too?
I'm surprised that you also dream.
Yes. Your arrival provided an opening for me to enter this realm.
Yes, and in the few dreams I have, your presence is always there.
You have probably noticed that this place looks similar to the Black Shores.
Will the Black Shores be affected in reality?
Not at this moment, but this dreamscape is on the brink of collapsing.
Dreams of the Black Shores are gathering, mingling with those from other realms.
I sense those wishes, memories, and obsessions are turning into something familiar yet dangerous.
What will happen then?
The existing data isn't enough to provide a clear answer...
In the worst case, this dreamscape could collapse under their impact.
But don't worry. I will use my power to stabilize this realm, and I will stay by your side until the end of your journey.
Alright, let's face this together.
Our goal is to resolve this crisis, right?
Yes. {PlayerName}, if you ever lose your way, call my name.
Remember, I am always here, right by your side.
So this is how it is... I see...
What did you find?
What is that?
The dreams of the Black Shores act like a gravitational center, pulling in other dreams to form entities of extreme density.
Those perished members of the Black Shores… Their thoughts linger and evolve within the dreams.
Their unshakable longings and aspirations lie deep within layers of volatile frequencies.
But why are they trying to destroy the Somnoire?
No, it's not destruction they want. They're trying to break free.
They are trying to escape from this space and return to the real world they once strove to save.
…A lost cause.
It's futile to try to bridge the gap between dreams and reality.
…But they dove headfirst into the Lament, fully knowing they were likely to fail. Maybe it was that same determination that drove them to take this path.
{PlayerName}, please release them.
I will.
This is the only thing we can do for them.
We are not here to prove that resistance is futile, but to mark that… we don't go down without a fight…
When those who follow see our gravestones, they will understand… humanity never surrenders…
We won't retreat… ██. This is our final task… Not everyone is lucky enough to bear this responsibility…
We're so close to getting the accurate modeling of ██… Just give me a bit more time, as long as it's before the Lament strikes…
Gravity... is the only pre-Lament law of physics that still holds true today…
{PlayerName}, you've helped them break free from their hopeless quest to return home.
So, that's it? It's over?
Those scattered dreams will still wander this realm, but they won't be burdened by those overwhelming desires anymore.
Do you regret putting an end to those longings and obsessions?
Their spirits still remain.
They will live on in our memories, won't they?
You are right. The time has come.
What time?
The Black Shores in a dream is not where I truly belong… I must go.
With the help of those two Gatekeepers, you will surely surely help to restore this place back to normal.
What's wrong?
It's just… who knows when we'll meet again in our dreams.
Let's meet one day when we wake up.
Yes, when we wake up... tomorrow.
You sorted out those dream masses. Well done.
Why are you here?
Where's the Ivory Gatekeeper?
He's trying to contain those scattered dream fragments.
But it's not an easy job to retrieve them all in such a vast realm as the Somnoire.
You're not to blame for that.
Don't worry, I'll come up with a plan...
Never stop exploring, Dreamwalker. Only in dreams will we find the answers we need.
Impressive work, Dreamwalker. That was quite a formidable foe, but it was still no match for you.
Looks like that's not all of it.
Yes, many more dream masses are lurking in the depths of the Somnoire...
They're getting stronger as we speak, targeting the Somnoire's weak points. It's almost as if they have a mind of their own.
What are they after?
Keep exploring, Dreamwalker. You will find the truth in a dream.
The frequencies I sensed earlier are still there. "They" are hiding in the depths of all of these dreams.
So, that's what a dream mass looks like?
What was that?
It's likely reflecting a form we're already familiar with, or maybe... it resembles a certain "something" inside the mass.
There are things I need to see for myself. This is the duty you have entrusted to me.
Take care.
See you around.
Rest assured, I will not put myself in danger again.
See you soon. You have my word.
Sigh, you must have noticed the Ebony Gatekeeper by now, right? I finally found him.
We were supposed to keep the balance in the Somnoire together… but now, things have spiraled out of control.
There are dream masses just up ahead.
Dreamwalker, please stay vigilant. I wish you the best of luck.
Don't you have anything to say?
These masses are devouring other dreams, threatening the stability of the entire Somnoire…
With what power I have left in me, I'm afraid I can no longer rein them in. I need your help.
You don't sound like you're asking for help.
I know I made a few missteps in trying to save more dreams. I don't expect you to forgive me.
But I am as devastated as anyone to see the Somnoire collapse. You have to believe me.
I'm… sincerely begging for your help.
Alright, but I'm not doing this for you.
Meow three times, and I'll think about it.
I understand. Thank you.
Ugh… Fine.
Meow! Meow! Meow!
Impressive work. These dream masses are disintegrating.
What happens now?
Well, they're breaking down into dream fragments now. In time, they might form something new. I'll track them down, but...
But what?
You really need to finish your sentences.
Our actions had unexpected repercussions. More dream masses are escaping the Somnoire. The boundary between reality and dreams is rapidly deteriorating.
I cannot predict what will happen next.
I've gotten used to surprises.
Don't worry. I can handle whatever comes.
That's reassuring. Please do keep exploring the Somnoire.
Abandoned buildings and platforms… I didn't see anything like this before.
Looks like things are shifting again inside the Somnoire…
An entity like this shouldn't exist in a dream… But now that I'm here, let me be of use to you.
Three days ago, the delivery van reached Waving Battlefield near Whining Aix's Mire!
Journeying from the New Federation to Jinzhou, it braved countless trials to arrive at its destination, but alas...
Enough. Explain it in five words.
Suspicious! Courier escaped! Package lost!
You're the one who's in charge of this.
Y-yes, but Boss...
Whatever you do, do it right and do it clean. That's the Cruising Drake's principle. Finish what you started.
Ah, Lollo Logistics! How despicable! Utterly insufferable!
I shall reclaim the package myself, that much is clear!

You unexpectedly overhear two Exiles discussing a lost package during transit, with one of them intent on confronting Lollo Logistics about it.
If I really have the chance to kill you...
Why are you so obsessed with it?

Well, because it's all about you.
Taking your life won't be easy, not with all the strong foes you've defeated.

Your potential, your desires, your ambitions... They're what truly excite me.

Perhaps one day I'll whisk you away to a hidden land, where you'll be mine, and mine alone.
You're back, {PlayerName}.
Sorry for the wait.
Did you regain all your power?
Yes, finally we're here.
I and all those you helped in the Somnoire are prepared for the final battle.
Once you're set, we'll be ready to face the one responsible for all this.
Let's repair the Somnoire and shut down his mischief for good!
All set... It's time to fight!
Here we come, Big Bad Demon!
I'll give this show a grand finale.
If I can help then, I'll... I'll do my best!

Now, give me your battle cry!
We promise, we deliver!
Not that one. It should be "Let's go save the world again!"
You have rescued all the Resonators trapped in their dreams, and the white cat has largely regained its clearance. You and your companions are now ready to challenge the Ebony Gatekeeper.
Mission complete. Well done.

Then you must be careful.
What will happen then?
Don't worry, I'll keep an eye on him.
Hmm... If things get serious, I can call on you again, can't I?
By the way, did you have something you wanted to ask?
Who created the Somnoire?
Why did I experience other people's dreams?
I have no questions.

Why not?
Because you, or maybe your past self, told me to keep it hush-hush.
If I were to tell you why, well... that's already saying too much!
What I can tell you is, you're the Dreamwalker, the only one who can come and go in Somnoire as you please.
You've got control over me, this gateway, and that sneaky black cat.
Basically, you're the only one who can see this gateway and all the anomalies it causes...
This is what happens when Somnoire expands into reality.
The black cat turned off Somnoire's filters, so it started copying every dream in Solaris.
To store all those dreams, he opened more gateways that started to leech into reality.
The dreams you just went through are from folks who got stuck in Somnoire by accident.
But since you control these gateways, you can help them escape.
When they wake up, all they'll have is a vague feeling of what happened.
Just like a real dream, mmm?
I can finally go back through the gateway I came from, and you... It's time for you to wake up, meow.

Will I see you again?
Can I pet you again?

I'll find you if I need help, Dreamwalker.
Seriously..?
Hmm... fine...
(You stroke the white cat.)
Meow... That's... purrfection.
Ahem! Enough! No more petting.
Alright then. See you next time, Dreamwalker!
If this is a dream, then what happened here isn't real...
Disappointed?
Maybe a bit, but you know what? My team always has my back, dream or not.
Even in a dream, the friendship felt so real.
You're right.
I'm your friend too.
Thank you, {PlayerName}.
Oh yeah, I've already met you in real life!
It was your support that kept me going.
So come find me in reality! I'll be waitin' for you!
Oh. Thought you'd already left.
What makes you think so?

Outside, more dirt's getting swept under the rug.
I'm ready to get back. But there is still one thing that's nagging at me...
You. When I screwed up, you... had my back.

It was plenty real.
Heh, is that right? Prove it to me in the real world, then.

Hooray!
A perfect ending.
In this story, the ten warriors defeated the Black Cat Demon!

Not true! Cosmos, Cloudy, and the white cat were also part of our team...
I didn't think of them.
Of course they count! We are all brave warriors!
And the Grape Kingdom is where the next adventure begins...
Make sure to tell me this story when you wake up.
No problem!
Maybe the white cat can be the bad guy next time...
Thanks for your help, {PlayerName}...
I couldn't have finished that draft without you.
You made your own decision.
You finished that same painting in reality.
I still find myself swayed by my doubts.
Painting, for me, isn't just in the finished piece. It's the only place I can let my emotions out.
When I worked on that Xiehua Village piece, I felt like I was capturing the very essence of life around me.
Thanks to you, I felt bold enough to capture those fleeting moments.
I really need to be truer to myself...
Hey, could you visit me when you wake up? I want to show you my painting.
Sure. I promise.
Okay...
I'll be waiting for you.
Mmm, what do you think a dream is?
It's a reflection of the past.
It's a glimpse into the future.
It's an alternate reality.
I realized this was a dream through careful observation. It's often that same keen observation that reveals the deepest truths.
Have you ever considered how someone with lost memories might confuse a dream with reality?
Perhaps paying closer attention to your surroundings could bring you closer to understanding the true nature of "reality."
What are you hinting at? Solaris is a figment of my imagination?
It's just a theory. I could be mistaken...
But when I found myself in Hongzhen in my dream, my mind was a blank slate.
I knew where I was, but I had no idea why and for what purpose.
I suspect you experienced something similar upon awakening in the Gorges of Spirits.
Yes...
Yes... I would advise you to pay close attention to the subtleties around you.
If you've learned something from this dream, then it wasn't for nothing.
Are you going to leave me? Again?
Time to wake up.
But I'm actually quite content here.
This is our arena! Look at all this, so much room for the chase...
It's just a dream.
Then why not stay a bit longer?
It's not all that different from reality, if you really think about it.
There's still a lot to do in reality.
A gateway will restore of all this back to reality.
Well, what a shame.
But waking up isn't so terrible. After all, you never fail to keep things interesting in reality.
Hmm? What's that over there next to the train?
"Delivered by Fulei"... This is the lost package. How did I not notice it before...
I should give it to Lumi.
You pick up the abandoned package.
It's already been three days and my package is still—
I'm terribly sorry, but could you please...
Lumi, over here!
Lumi, I found the package.
Oh, oh my!
This is your package, sir!
Huh? Let me check... Wait! Look at this, it's damaged!
Don't expect me to accept a damaged package! This is unacceptable!
This is our fault... Please accept my sincere apologies. We will compensate you for your loss.
I don't want your compensation! I want my package! In one piece!
Do you have any idea how important this—
Ah, the Rover {Male=himself;Female=herself}.
B-boss? Why are you here in person? I'm just...
Silence.

Did you retrieve this package yourself from the Waving Battlefield?
Yes. Do I know you?
...I don't think we've met before.
I'm Tianhu, leader of the Cruising Drake.
The package is secure, and we won't give you any more hassle. In fact, I wouldn't mind getting to know you better.
Not in that way, of course. I heard you took down that beast at Norfall Barrens. The wilds have been quieter since then, which means more opportunities for folks like us.
We're in need of skilled individuals like yourself more than ever. You'd fit right in.
Think about joining us one day. The Cruising Drake always welcomes the best of the best.
Hey, wait up, Boss! Why do you always have to walk off like that after talking...
Shut it! It's about showing our style and drawing in new blood. Pipe down...

A giant black cat.

I had a DREAM!

Was it a bad dream?

We promise, we deliver! We promise, we deliver!

We promise, we deliver! We promise, we deliver!

You engage in conversation with the Lollo member, named Lumi, who reveals that strange events have been occurring in the Whining Aix's Mire, where her team member lost the package. She asks for your help in recovering it, and to investigate the anomalies, you agree to assist her.

I don't know how, but I felt like you were guiding me.
Talking with her made me see how important it is to support each other.

I wouldn't have realized this without your help. Thank you so much, {PlayerName}.
Thanks a lot...
You can talk!
Only a bit...
Somnoire breaks into world. My authority... lost.
Many places... gateway open. Enter and fight!
I see now. I can help.

A sharp mind. You are smart.

No energy left. Can't talk. Stop disaster. I trust you...

(Stroke the white cat)
