(Lumi hasn't had any dreams since visiting Whining Aix's Mire.)
(And the Illusia I just saw of her... This abnormal Somnoire seems to be trapping parts of people's consciousness in their dreams.)
(If this has been going on for a while, Lumi might not be the only one trapped here.)
(She dreams about her team, but what about the others? I need to find more clues.)
I've already explained what happened, just give me the package.
If you can't, I'll... I'll file a complaint with your manager!
Don't worry, Lollo Logistics always takes care of its customers. We'll definitely get back to you within three business days.
Three days!? What if it's broken or lost? Don't you know how serious—
Oh, if it's broken or lost, you can get a full refund. Plus, the shipping insurance you have covers it. So really, there's nothing to worry about!
...If you say so. Come to think of it, Lollo Logistics has never missed a delivery... In that case, I'll come back later.
The Exile stresses the package's importance, and after a member of Lollo Logistics assures them it will be retrieved, he leaves in reluctance.
Upon arriving at Lollo Logistics, you notice the Exile departing after receiving the promise that his package will be retrieved.
The Somnoire gateway must be just ahead...
But why is it closed?
Meow—
Feels like I'm floating... Is the cat helping me?
This should be the last one.
Unusual? Huh? What are you talking about?
Oh, I know... Someone's deliberately spreading rumors!
Port business is booming right now. They want to oust the competition to grab a slice of the pie. That's their game plan!
Those rascals must be trying to scare people off to hog all the profits! No chance! This cheap trick won't work on me...
I do want others to trust me, but...
My priority is making sure justice is served.
When I found myself in doubt, you helped me find myself again...
You have my full support.
You've never stopped being a Patroller.
Thank you, {PlayerName}.
I like knowing someone has faith in me.
Nice job, purr-fect!
Finally you wake up.
You can talk again?
Dreams cleansed! Power restored! I can talk now.
Somnoire is growing faster... If this keeps up, Solaris will be in danger.
Walk through more gateways. Save people from dreams. Fight that person. I'm counting on you!
Talking drains my energy. Need to rest now...
Leave it to me.
Sleepy already? Not again.
(Stroke the white cat)
Meow—
Meow...
Meow—
(From the looks of it, I'm probably the only one who can enter the Somnoire as I please...)
(Besides that cat, the only other people here are the ones trapped in their dreams.)
(I will be the one to help them escape.)
Waving Battlefield? I was there a week ago... on break... Ahem, can't let my boss know this.
Anyway, I haven't had any dreams ever since then! It's so weird!
I heard that some researchers screwed up an experiment there. Some even died in an accident... Wait, don't tell me I'm being haunted by their ghosts!
Oh no, kind ghosts, have mercy on me!
Hmm, now that you mention it, I haven't had any dreams this week.
I used to have nightmares about the day my father left. He was devoured by a Tacet Field and never returned.
But since the dreams stopped, I've been sleeping better than ever.
Maybe it's my father who's been driving them away... Heh, maybe it's a blessing in disguise?
Hi, {PlayerName}! Are you ready for Encore's new story?
Ha! Warrior Encore!
What's the story this time?
Ahem, it goes like this...
A long, long time ago, there was a Cloud Kingdom, where the amazing warrior Encore lived.
Then she met you, Traveler Cosmos, Prince Cloudy, and many more new friends.
Together, they defeated the Dark Cloud Demon!
Sounds just like the last one.
It's a great story, Encore style.
You're in the story this time! That makes a big difference!
It's good, right? Stories about adventuring with friends are my favorite!
I'll tell you a new story next time, don't you worry about that.
It's you...
That person. He's awake...
Why are you talking less this time?
Yes, I met the Gatekeeper.
Black cat. He's formidable. My power. Limited again. Stop him, Dreamwalker...
So tired. Must rest...
Lazy kitty.
Night, night.
(Stroke the white cat)
Meow...
Meow—
Meow—
(The cat's weaker than last time. What's worse, the Gatekeeper said the expansion is accelerating...)
(I have to stop it before it's too late...)
What happened here?
I was just dreaming. In that dream, I tried my best to paint something new, but no one seemed to like it.
Instead, they just wanted more copies of my old stuff, treating me like some money machine.
But you told me to trust myself...
They are using you.
People aren't tools.
Thank you for supporting me, {PlayerName}.
No problem, Master Zhezhi.
You'll be better. I believe in you.
Y-you don't have to call me "Master"...
I-I'll keep practicing!
Hey! I can talk again!
How did you manage to do that?
Power grows. Strong enough to fight him.
Next time, I will talk even better!
String a full sentence together?
I prefer your current style.
Help me... Too much sleep. This is the last time...
You want some cat food?
Cats really do sleep through anything.
(Stroke the white cat)
I'm no cat, you know...
Meow...
Meow—
That white cat... Why are the Tacet Discords after it?
I'll handle them first.
So, are you interested in the details of that case?
Yes. I'm all ears.
Give me the details.
Back then, the Fractsidus killed Jing and his parents under the cover of night.
They then posed as Jing's parents and lay in wait until Xinyi figured it out.
But instead of exposing them right away, she played along, biding her time.
After two weeks, the Fractsidus couldn't restrain themselves any longer.
They used the pretense of searching for their lost boy to scout out Mt. Firmament.
Of course, Xinyi was prepared for this. She used the opportunity to expose them in the act and capture them.
A genius move.
I'd say your strategy is no less impressive than hers.
Though our enemy's identity remains unclear... I'll support you, come what may.
Meow! Haha!
I can finally talk in full sentences!
It doesn't sound like you.
I prefer how you used to talk.
Yeah, yeah, try to meow or speak three words yourself. You don't want to know how it feels...
Anyway, we're down to our last gateway.
Once you rescue the last person from their dream, I can finally balance my control over Somnoire with the Gatekeeper's.
That's when we can launch our final attack.
I'll finish him with one strike.
Alright, alright. Good kitty.
(Stroke the white cat)
"We" will finish this! Together!
Meow! Hey! Don't treat me like a cat!
Meow—
Why were you running away?
What happened inside the gateway?
Meow... meow...
You want me to go inside?
Meow!
In the Whining Aix's Mire, you encounter a white cat that escaped the Somnoire by train. It asks you to enter a mysterious gateway...
*cough* One more thing...
Go ahead.
You want some cat food?
No, not the cat food...
A gateway opens. Desorock Highland. The Somnoire shows up. A collection of dreams...
Close the gateway. Stop him. Please help, meow...
Collection of dreams, encroaching reality. Monsters from the dreams, they are nearby.
Follow them. You'll find an open gateway!
I can make you faster. Close that gateway. I'm counting on you, meow...
SPEED UP!
PAW IT! PAW IT HARD!
ALL THE WAY! ZOOM ZOOM!
FINISH IT!
Meow!
Well done, meow. Knew I can count on you!
More gateways... in other places...
Close them all. Must... stop him. Thank you, meow...
The gateway to the Somnoire is open again… Did something happen?
Ah, there you are! I owe you my thanks for helping us clean up the mess.
Were you intercepting those dream fragments?
Exactly. Those dream masses broke apart into countless dream fragments.
They scattered like leaves in a forest, making it difficult to retrieve them all.
The Ebony Gatekeeper mentioned he's working on a solution.
Is that so? Well, I guess he would've been more suited for this task than me...
Dreamwalker, I have a favor to ask. Can you continue to restore those chaotic Memory Zones?
Do you need to ask?
Sure, as long as you pay me.
Haha, I figured you'd say so! Thank you. And, as always, I'll be there if you need anything from me.
Rest assured. The Somnoire has always been generous. And, as always, I'll be there if you need anything from me.
Watch out! Those dream fragments were drawn here and are now forming into a mass!
We have nowhere to go… and you have nowhere to run…
One after another, I see them leave… How many more goodbyes must I endure? Oh, how I wish I could go home…
The crisis has finally come to an end. I can't thank you enough for your help.
Are you sure it's really over?
I am certain this isn't the end of it.
I... can't make any guarantees. The world inside this gateway always finds a way to create new problems.
By the way, have you noticed our surroundings?
This is where we had our showdown with the black cat.
Exactly. The Ebony Gatekeeper created this Memory Zone to draw in all those abnormal dreams, forcing you to confront them all at once.
As a trade-off... he probably needs to sleep for a while.
So, this is the "plan" he talked about.
Looks like he's capable of doing the right thing after all.
Both he and I are Observers of the Somnoire tasked with maintaining its stability. If either of us goes unchecked, it's bad news for the entire realm.
If there ever comes a day when I lose control, please, stop me.
What?
Are you saying you might go rogue someday?
Just a jest. But now, it's time to say farewell—
To thoroughly investigate the faults in the Somnoire, we'll need to temporarily sever its connection to the real world.
We'll see each other again, right?
Absolutely. No matter how long the night lasts, we shall always reunite in the light of day.
Aha, you're finally here.
It's been a while, my sweet seed of fate.
Are you here for the flowers? Perfect timing. They're about to bloom.
Consultants roam all across Solaris, and when they return, they always bring rare flower seeds as souvenirs.
You like flowers?
Nah-uh, I just enjoy planting them.
Watching them grow, waiting for them to bloom—you know, waiting makes the fruits so much sweeter.
Of course, I have my own special seed.
Every day, I'm consumed by the urge to see it thrive, trembling with excitement for its bloom, the soft touch of petals unfolding in my palm... This feeling… I can't wait to make it mine!
Hehe, it's the best thing ever to watch and protect it as its breeder.
Just a little fun of mine. Well, how's it going, {PlayerName}? Enjoying your time here?
I heard you got the Shorekeeper and all of us out of a huge mess, huh?
Yes, because I can.
How did you know that?
If I remember correctly, you weren't here back then...
Hehe, I expected as much. You've shown great potential since you arrived in Jinzhou.
Well... I'm a Bloom Bearer, and a Bloom Bearer knows what they want to know.
Aww, you're a sharp one. Yes, I had something else going on, couldn't say hi to you first. What a pity.
Didn't know the Shorekeeper would entrust a newcomer with such important tasks... She trusts you. A lot.
You are…
Hey, {PlayerName}. It's Beatrice. Remember me from the Error Cell?
I hate to ask, but could you come back to the Error Cell?
What happened?
We've run into some trouble, and honestly, you're the only one the Shorekeeper trusts to handle it.
I'll explain everything when you get here.
Thanks a lot! And don't worry, there'll be a reward for you.
Duty calls. I have to go.
"Oh, congratulations, {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} Popularity!" Whatever…
If only you could be mine… I'd root you in my garden, where only I could savor your sweet, robust vitality… Hehe, just kidding. Hope you don't mind.
…How strange.
I've felt this way before…
Hehe, interesting.

You encounter Camellya at the Black Shores' Greenhouse. As usual, she appears nonchalant but pleased nevertheless to chat. Your conversation is interrupted by Beatrice, who needs you to handle a problem at the Error Cell.
What a show. You never disappoint me. With you around, the days ahead will be so much fun.
The game's over. Here you go, the thing I promised you. Let's keep going, my hero~
The info in that matrix is related to you. With you by my side, I should be able to locate and capture it faster.
Hehe, alright. So...?
We need to solve this accident as soon as possible, and you promised to help if I played the game with you.
Haha! Guess I have no other choice, huh?
...Well, it's lovely to see you being a little pushy too! I like your serious side. Sure, I'll go.
What else do you know about Lady Flora? You said a small accident happened during your investigation...
Yeah, ended up stuck in a boring medical pod for half a month and almost died from severe Overclocking.
You call that a small accident?
Sure, it's no big deal, since I survived.
Hmm... My memories were sealed by Lady Flora somehow. No matter how much I try to recall, it doesn't work.
I only remember waking up in a cave, my mind completely blank. Drifted aimlessly for years, until I stumbled upon the Black Shores.
And guess what? Turns out I had lived here before! Naturally, I wanted to investigate further and figure it out.
So that's what I did. I'm sure I uncovered the truth behind my memory loss, but… when I woke up in the medical pod again, I'd forgotten everything.
Guess somehow I almost died from Overclocking when I learned about my past, and I had to seal my memories away again. That's pretty much what happened, I think?
I still don't know why Lady Flora did that though... Well, I don't really care. I can have fun with or without those memories.
It doesn't sound like you're talking about your past self.
Hello~? Are you listening? Told you I remember nothing, so... Lady Flora is more like a stranger to me.
It's like watching a movie. No matter how happy or sad the story is, it's someone else's story, after all.
Don't you feel the same? Tell me, what was on your mind when you witnessed those stories, staring at every frame on the screen?
Nothing.
...I had too many things to think about.
Haha, you don't care, do you? I knew we think alike.
Aww... You are more sentimental than I expected.
Anyway, I'll trust my instincts over some distant memories.
As long as my instincts remain, I'm still "me."
That sounds a bit too animalistic…
So you let your instincts define what's truly "you"?
Yeah, and what's wrong with that?
That's right!
My instincts rule me, and I rule them. I feel great joy when they are fulfilled, and when I ignore them, I suffer in return.
They guide me like how duty and responsiblity guides you... Who says one is better than the other?
No, there is no difference between these two.
Well… no comment from me.
Hehe, let's drop this boring discussion. Shall we split up to find the other stuff?
Sure. Whoever finds it first will go meet up with the other.
Ooh, then it's a competition—I'm in! Let the search begin!

Camellya enjoyed the game and gives you the bracelet as promised. Recognizing that her help is vital to resolving the current crisis, you ask her to stay. Camellya finds your assertiveness intriguing and agrees to help. In a discussion about self and her lost memories, Camellya claims her instincts define who she is. To gather more of Lady Flora's items, you decide to split up.
This Blake Bloom is…
You continue searching and find a forsaken Blake Bloom in a cave.
{Male=He's;Female=She's} sooo slow. Hehe, looks like I'm gonna win.
Ah, I can sense my prey deep inside. So many of them…
How wonderful.
Pathetic! Get out of my way, you weaklings!
Hehe, finally, something that gets my blood pumping.
Hahaha!
Good, good. Please me! Delight me! Entertain me!
Oh yes, that's what I want! Keep struggling! MORE!
Ah... Wonderful…
The way you fought really makes my heart race… Such power, such vitality…
Ugh, I wish I were the one dancing this deadly, bloody, beautiful waltz with you…
…I wanted to help you up.
Hehe, I know. I was just overwhelmed with joy… Cough! Ugh…
You're on the edge of Overclocking. And you were in a medical pod before... Does this happen often?
Yeah. Oh, are you worried about me?
Yes, can't I?
…I'm just worried that you might endanger the Black Shores.
Aww, you're sooo sweet. I'm almost blushing.
That's not considerate, darling. Besides, with the Tethys System here, I can't really cause any major damage.
And I'm good at dancing on the edge. I won't let myself Overclock that easily. But if it does happen… I'll just accept it as my fate.
It's very dangerous. You know the risks, right?
Of course I do. But once severe Overclocking symptoms appear, they can't be cured, can they?
And I'm happy!
It's been a blast competing and taking down those Tacet Discords with you... That's all I need to have a good time.
If one day I die from Overclocking, so be it! The Black Shores will make sure there's no Tacet Field generated from me.
I've always followed my instincts, ignored anything that didn't interest me. No regrets, even if I died now.
Carpe diem, enjoy the moment… Life is boring if you're stuck in the past or consumed by the future.
Anyway, what have you found? I got a stack of damaged photos. To locate that Stellar Matrix, we'll need three or four items tops.
I found this Blake Bloom.
The remaining frequencies... Yes, it belongs to Lady Flora.
It's been almost 20 years since the last frequencies were recorded.
Blake Blooms represent a Bloom Bearer's identity. They always have one on them. These frequencies can help us track Lady Flora's last activity.
She and the leader of Black Shores vanished at the same time, no longer appearing in records.
(Around the same time? The two cases might be connected...)
Oh, right. I just remembered what that strange feeling I had earlier was.
When I saw you in Jinzhou... It felt as if I'd seen you somewhere else before.
Anyway, have you told Beatrice that we're ready?
(Inform Beatrice of your results.)
How impressive, {PlayerName}! That's fast!
Please head to the Modulation Hall. I'll meet you there.

Camellya shows signs of Overclocking from battle, yet she appears unconcerned. She is accustomed to enduring pain and explains that savoring each present moment is her way of coping.

From the Blake Bloom's frequency, you discover that Lady Flora disappeared around the same time as the Black Shores leader. With enough items gathered, you head to the Modulation Hall.
{PlayerName}, please give me the things you just found… Oh, you want to come along, Camellya?
{PlayerName} begged me to go with {Male=him;Female=her}, and it looked fun, so I agreed.
Well, that's rare. The Camellya I know was only interested in going out to find candidates.
{PlayerName}, kudos to you for being able to get her to cooperate with you. Awesome.
Really?
After all, I'm a {Male=hero;Female=heroine}!
Yeah, normally, Camellya doesn't seem to care about anything.
Hehe, that's quite a confident statement, but you do have the skills to back it up.
With Camellya on this mission with you, you should be safer.
Don't worry. I'll be keeping a close eye on you.
You hand the three items to Beatrice. She records the information and then returns them to you.
Hold on. I need some time to process the data. Once that's done, you can dive into the Stellar Matrix with our portal.
Past, present, future… All the possibilities in the universe change within this swirling starry sky.
I'm starting to get a bit interested~! What kind of "me" is hidden in there?
Let's go, {PlayerName}. A new adventure awaits.
After Beatrice completes the modulation, you and Camellya dive into the stars to locate the escaped Stellar Matrix.
{PlayerName}, do you still have that bracelet?
Good. You can keep it, so... a piece of me always stays with you.
Since the past between us is a secret now, consider this bracelet our witness.
What exactly is this bracelet…?
Hehe, it's an old one. It was… a gift.
Got it for monitoring my Rabelle spectrum, as an Overclocking warning device.
But I don't really need it anymore. Told you I'll never lose control again.
Except in a special situation like this, in most cases, nothing can even leave a scratch on me.
I hit jackpot finding the matrix. It was a blast! But that's all in the past now.
You aren't going to get your memories back?
You said your memories are sealed by Lady Flora…
No, I'm quite happy with things as they are right now. No need to risk opening the floodgates and winding up in another medical pod.
Since Lady Flora—the past me—chose to seal away those memories, I'm fully behind my decision.
As for the memories we used to share, if fate decides to reveal them, they'll resurface naturally as we continue our journey together.
Plus… does it really matter? No, it doesn't!
Fate has already brought us back together.
I bet we'll have more wild stories to share, and more games to play.
No point dwelling on the past. I'd rather live in the moment.
…Speaking of which, I have a question for you.
{PlayerName}… Are you happy now? Having lost all memories, living a new life...
Yes.
No.
I'm not sure.
Is that so? Good to know. I'm happy too. Every moment <ano=Sparring>dancing</ano> with you brings me immense joy!
Then... If one day you get tired of all this saving-the-world stuff, I'll whisk you away to a place where no one can find us!
Heh, same here. But you'll be fine, because you have me now. We can take our time figuring out this life, together!
This is where I first set foot on this island, where everything began. The stars lie beneath our feet, where the Tethys System resides.
Tethys records all data on Solaris, capturing countless possibilities born and fading away.
But in every possible scenario, we always find each other.
All paths in the stars converge towards this single endpoint, so—
The universes where we didn't meet must have all perished! Only this one survived!
If the universe were a flower, then yes…
...This must be the perfect world for a gardener like me.

Once trapped in a labyrinth of memories and possibilities, Camellya has lost much. But now, she tells you she no longer wishes to recover her lost memories, believing the seal left by Lady Flora will naturally break when the time is right.

What matters to her now is enjoying this reunion with you.

Just as she did in previous timeline junctures, Camellya smiles and extends her hand, offering you a flower.
{PlayerName}, there you are! It's been a while, and you still look great.
Since you came to the Black Shores, so many unexpected things have happened… Even the Shorekeeper made an appearance.
Anyway, let's get to the point. Do you remember what the Error Cell is for?
Yes.
Not really.
Great, your memory is as sharp as ever.
Well, it's basically a "prison" for containing hazardous waste like corrupted Stellar Matrices.
The problem is, one of the "prisoners" has escaped.
It's headed towards the Necrostar and seems to be trying to go even deeper.
The Shorekeeper is tied up with modulation and can't leave.
That's why I need your help to recapture it and prevent any more incidents. You're the best person for the job.
What should I do?
How much are you paying?
Don't worry, I'll make it worth your time.
The escapee is hiding, but we can use the remnants of its data to track it down.
(…I think I heard something.)
What's the matter?
Nothing. Go on.
While investigating, I discovered that a few years ago, a Consultant accessed these data.
She was out in the field recently and just returned to the Black Shores. You should check in with her first.
Alright. I'll call if I get anything.
Thank you. I'm counting on you!
A corrupted Stellar Matrix has escaped and could endanger the Black Shores. To retrieve it, you seek out the Consultant who previously accessed the Matrix's data.
{PlayerName}, I'm sorry. That matrix is more cunning than we anticipated… My mistake.
Camellya and I got separated…
Do you know where she is?
Camellya is still inside that Stellar Matrix.
She was trapped inside and started to sink deeper—that's why you couldn't go any further.
Besides, Camellya has found the matrix core. Without her, it might have escaped again.
Now, we'll create a symmetrical Stellar Matrix, and that will allow you to reach the previously inaccessible areas.
What should I do then?
There will be various simulated areas. To reach the destination, you need to <color=Highlight>find and jump to the correct timeline junctures</color>.
Due to a mutated Stellar Matrix, you may not reach the destination in one go.
<color=Highlight>Multiple jumps</color> might be required to get there. {PlayerName}, please stay safe!

Beatrice informs you that Camellya is still trapped in the Stellar Matrix. To rescue her, you must enter the Matrix once again. Beatrice warns you that multiple jumps might be needed to reach the correct timeline juncture.
Master, master, m-master...
(KU-Riri is pacing back and forth, seemingly eager to say something.)
Master, the Overclocked Resonator known as "Lady Flora" has breached containment and left her medical pod.
The target is currently located in… located…
Where?
Calm down. Take your time.
Target is in the room ahead. Your need to calm her down and transfer her back to the medical pod.
"Lady Flora" is dangerous—her mind and language skills are impaired, making her prone to reckless behavior. She is a threat to the Black Shores' internal facilities.
As for the other residents of Petalfall Village, we have confirmed that they have all perished.
We couldn't save them in time. The situation worsened too quickly after we received the unusual signal until you arrived.
All of them…?
No, I remember…
(The previous recording mentioned <color=Highlight>a few survivors from the Tacet Discord Outbreak, but in this Petalfall Village, everyone perished except for Camellya.</color>)
(The situation here seems to differ from my timeline.)
When did I bring Lady Flora back to the Black Shores?
Two weeks ago.
Master, master, m-master...
Please calm her down as soon as possible. Prolonged Overclocking will put greater strain on her body.
KU-Riri turns and looks at the door a short distance away.

Upon crossing the Stargate, you find yourself in a simulated Black Shores from many years ago. There, you encounter a nervous robot, KU-Riri, who tells you that Lady Flora is Overclocking and has fled her medical pod to hide in a nearby room. This suggests you are not in the correct juncture, but rather a distorted version of history.
It's locked... So Camellya, in her Overclocked state, damaged the locked door's security system, when her mind was unclear?
I need to restore the security system first.
The mutated plants have grown so large… Camellya in this timeline has severely Overclocked.
It's you…
Restraints… I… AHHHHHH!
Voices… so many noises…!
It... hurts...
I'm taking you back to the medical pod.
My head… My whole body... hurts...
Petalfall Village…
I see… Ah, it's over…
You… defeated… me.
I seem to… have seen you… much earlier…
This… is...
…for you.
You find Lady Flora covered in vines, struggling against her Overclocking. As her condition eases, she gazes at you with a faint smile and offers you a flower.
Camellya disappeared… So, does that gate lead to a new juncture?
Lady Flora once Overclocked so much that her mind was heavily damaged, and her language abilities degenerated… Then, the Camellya I know…
Hello, you must be {PlayerName}, right? Beatrice filled me in on what happened.
The reason I looked into that Stellar Matrix is because of this little guy I found in the wild.
A small, damaged, and slightly old-looking robot quietly rests at her feet.
When I found it, it had been non-functional for a long time.
I tried to fix it, but I couldn't salvage much data… I only got this damaged recording:
…May: Majority of buildings in Petalfall Village damaged from Tacet Discord invasion. Heavy casualties. Survivors have been transferred…
Threat level extremely high according to the Tethys System. The Black Shores leader has decided to handle the issue {Male=himself;Female=herself} and has departed to…
(Static)… The village's remaining structures covered by highly mutated plants. Rescuing is difficult. More time needed…
A… (static)… was discovered in a deep underground cave. One Overclocked Resonator named 'Lady Flora' was rescued and taken to Black Shores. Biography pending...
Rabelle's Curve, this subject tends to enter the Overclocking state… currently stable… (static)…
(The Black Shores leader handled the issue {Male=himself;Female=herself}… So I brought this Lady Flora back to the Black Shores?)
The recording ends there. I had just joined the Black Shores back then, feeling curious about everything… especially about our leader.
Everything about {Male=him;Female=her} was shrouded in mystery, and only a select few had ever met {Male=him;Female=her}.
But I didn't give up. I started looking into the other name mentioned in the recording: Lady Flora.
The Stellar Matrix you're hunting down contained information about Lady Flora.
But… I found nothing. Someone deliberately erased the data, and I'm locked out from any remaining traces.
Someone wiped everything about Lady Flora…
Yeah. That piqued my interest, so I asked—well, pestered—my seniors to see if I could get anything.
Lady Flora was said to be very close to the Black Shores leader. They were inseparable and carried out many missions together.
Unfortunately, Lady Flora has been missing for nearly two decades…
Missing… Seems like I can't use this clue to locate that matrix.
Not necessarily. You're a trusted Bloom Bearer of the Shorekeeper, right?
The Hall of Foreign Affairs stores a lot of information about the Black Shores personnel. Try your luck there. Maybe you'll find something.

The Consultant reveals the data was intentionally erased, but it involves the leader of the Black Shores—your past self—and a Bloom Bearer named Lady Flora. You learn that you once saved Lady Flora from Petalfall Village and shared a deep bond, but she vanished twenty years ago.
I'm... back on the surface of the Black Shores island?
I should go look around.
It's really you!
Heard I can find the Black Shores here. Glad I didn't come to the wrong place.
You are…?
(Is this Camellya?!)
I'm Camellya. Or call me "Lady Flora" if you want. People from Petalfall Village like to call me that.
You left in such a hurry. We didn't even get a chance to talk.
I felt... off, like I missed out on something important, so I came here alone to find you.
How's the situation in Petalfall Village?
The injured have been transferred to other nearby villages. Most of the villagers are safe and sound, thanks to your timely rescue.
(Most of the villagers are safe… and with the way Camellya looks now… It seems I'm in an alternate timeline again.)
(But even if the history is changed, we still met each other.)
You're the Black Shores leader, aren't you?
I-I snuck in here, but please don't drive me out! I have my own Forte now! I can work for you.
Now? You mean you couldn't before?
I… don't know.
Those Consultants said my Rabelle's Test showed I awakened my Forte. But in the village, I didn't feel anything special.
… And I don't remember anything before coming to the village.
You don't remember?
You have lost your memory before?
Yes, villagers said I appeared in the woods by their lake one autumn morning.
That's all I remember. Didn't have anywhere else to go, so I stayed in that village.
Can I stay with you here? At the Black Shores? I-I want to serve you. Make me your Bloom Bearer.
Technically speaking, it's a job, and you'll be serving the entire Black Shores.
And Camellya, you are not "mine". You belong to yourself.
Hmm…
Join us if you pass the assessment. The Black Shores welcomes those who protect the world.
Great! But... I-I still don't know your name. Tell me, please?
I'm {PlayerName}.
Ah... It's a beautiful name. I'll never forget it.
I'm so happy, really, really happy that my vines feel so light…
How strange... This is our first formal conversation, but...
It feels like I had heard your name before...
Look, this is my Forte. I quite like it.
I want to shadow you, see how a strong person like you moves forward.
This flower... is for you. I'm looking forward to the days ahead.
Yes.

Crossing the Stargate again, you meet another version of Lady Flora at the Black Shores. Unlike the previous Lady Flora, she appears healthy and slightly bashful, yet her admiration for you remains unchanged. She mentions that meeting you feels familiar.

Thanks to your timely arrival, Petalfall Village has survived the disaster in this juncture, even though that is not how it truly happened. Like she did before, Lady Flora smiles and offers you a flower.
These Tacet Discords… The Stellar Matrix must've noticed us. It's trying to hold me back.
Camellya is trapped deep inside... She must be in danger now. I need to find the correct juncture fast.
Camellya.
Oh? It's you.
Done with the work? You should get some rest.
I've been super well-behaved these past few days! Did everything as you said! Didn't cause any trouble or go to places I shouldn't!
KU-Riri reporting in! The infrastructure damage in Petalfall Village is severe. The rebuilding will be difficult in the short term, and it requires reassessment…
You need some discipline, robot. How dare you interrupt my conversation with {Male=him;Female=her}?
You wanna know the situation in Petalfall Village? I can tell you. I was there, remember?
It's been… a few months since the Tacet Discords attacked the village.
I turned into a flower tree due to Overclocking and trapped those feeble creatures in an underground cave.
(KU-Riri's recording mentioned that <color=Highlight>Camellya was found in an underground cave</color>. Looks like this time, I jumped to the right juncture.)
How's the villagers?
Oh, I threw them out of the village when I started transforming. They would have died if they stayed.
Not many survived, but some did. They managed to hold on until you showed up, and they guided you to find me.
What a surprise. Thought they'd run away when I threw them out.
I have no interest in those crybabies… but since they took me in for a while, I owed them a favor.
It felt good to do good, huh?
You don't need to find an excuse for your good deed.
Hahaha! That's a cute way to put it.
What? I'm speaking from my heart. I don't wanna spare a glance at those weaklings.
I despise weaklings. Myself included. I was a sorry sap when I turned into that plant!
But you saved me. You pulled me out of Overclocking and brought me back to sanity. I should thank you.
I don't remember anything before I arrived in that village. I don't care anyway. You're the only one who's ever made me feel so excited.
So, how about making me your Bloom Bearer? You see... who else can keep me from causing trouble elsewhere?
…Well, indeed I can't just let you leave.
You would be a risk to public safety, no doubt.
Right? Making me yours exactly aligns with the interests of Solaris, and as you just said, would make the world a safer place.
Just so you know, when I was doing the Rabelle test, the staff said I'm still prone to Overclocking.
I may have great power now, but I might lose it or fall prey to my emotions again someday.
If that day comes, then… I'll embrace it as my destiny! Fate's already brought us together, and I'll pay any cost for that.
It's led me to the most exquisite flower in this world. I'll give anything for it, no hesitation!
Did you know? Climbing plants are obsessed with big, gorgeous trees. Clinging onto them like their life depends on it, sucking up all the energy they can get from the sun.
They're driven by an insatiable hunger to savor their beloved tree, down to the last bit.

After passing through the Stargate for the third time, you finally reach the correct timeline juncture.

The Lady Flora you meet resembles Camellya in the real world and, like the others, she does not hide her feelings for you.
One day, we'll have plenty of time together. You can definitely, rigorously... train me!
This flower is for you, to express my…
It's the correct timeline juncture. Initiating jump now!
Hello, {PlayerName}, what brings you here?
(Fill him in the situation.)
Oh? But Lady Flora's item was already picked up by another Bloom Bearer.
Who took it?
You looking for me?
Hehe, if you want it, try to catch me!
At the Hall of Foreign Affairs, you discover that Camellya has already taken Lady Flora's belongings. Now, you must find Camellya.
I guess I have no choice but to catch up with Camellya first.
Welcome back! Glad to see you safely return. Thank you for your hard work.
A Stellar Matrix is no match for us. Easy peasy.
Have you received the coordinates?
Yes, thank you. Leave the rest to us.
By the way, Camellya, Shorekeeper asked me to remind you. Please use the medical pod in good time.
What? My symptoms are already gone… Alright, I'll go later. She really worries too much.
But she helped keep my bracelet safe too. Heh, I owe her that.
{PlayerName}, shall we go?
Go where?
Hmm, let me think... To the surface. Veiled Rock, the starting point.
With the Stellar Matrices back in order, Camellya invites you to Veiled Rock.
When I found those photos, I made a decision.
Photos are great for capturing memories. Take some photos of me.
In the past, others recorded us, but now we'll have to do it ourselves.
Consider it... a tangible keepsake.
They last longer than our memories. A moment frozen in frame.
As the Black Shores leader, a small task like this would be a piece of cake for you, I bet?
Camellya asks you to take a photo of this moment as a way to capture her current feelings.
{PlayerName}, stay focused. Don't take your eyes off me!
Looks good. I wanna keep a copy of this too.
Excellent composition. Quite the photographer, aren't you? Hehe…
Oh, you're quick! I knew you wouldn't keep me waiting.
Were you following me?
Yeah, is that a problem?
I followed you to the cell on a whim. Then I heard something interesting.
Plus, this thing is just finding its way back to its owner. I see no wrong in that.
To its owner… Are you that "Lady Flora"?
Yes and no.
Just like you, I've completely forgotten about the past! All of it! So, I guess I'm not the Lady Flora you're looking for.
You've lost your memory too…
Then how did you know you're Lady Flora?
Of course, I did some digging, but… a little accident stopped me.
(If Camellya is Lady Flora, then we were supposed to be close, but neither of us remembers…)
(The fact that I used to be the leader... This should only be known to the Shorekeeper.)
(Maybe I shouldn't mention it to Camellya until I'm sure she's not a threat.)
{PlayerName}, if you want to use that trinket to find the problematic matrix, then play with me! Entertain me, and I'll help you.
What shall we play?
What if I say no?
Well… Then I'll take this and make a run for it!
You can try to catch me, but be warned, it won't be an easy chase. Or, you could play along and maybe I'll let you have it. It'll be more fun that way!
Since you handled the Threnodian, a little game of battle shouldn't be too much trouble for you, right?
As a Bloom Bearer, I need to pick the perfect seeds for the Black Shores and give them my utmost care.
All these years, I haven't met anyone intriguing—not one person!
You're MY seed of fate. If I let you go so easily, all my efforts, my yearning, my hunger will not be satisfied.
If you get taken or killed by somebody else...
...I would be very, very, very unhappy.
Why are you so obsessed with me?
Why do you call me your seed of fate?
Why? It's pure instinct!
Flowers thirst for water; beasts hunger for flesh. It's nature, just like my craving for you.
I want it, and I get it. That's how I live.
That fleeing Stellar Matrix might affect the Necrostar’s functioning. Worse, it could threaten the Black Shores.
So? I don't care! If this island's gonna blow up, so be it. Unless, of course, it ruins my fun.
Are you angry? Hehe, your anger is sooo delicious…
Fight me. I can't wait to see who'll be the winner. I've been itching to get a taste of your blade.
Enough small talk. I'll play.
Hahahaha! Fantastic! Let's get started!

After catching up with Camellya, she reveals that she is Lady Flora, but like you, she has lost her memories. She appears indifferent to everything except you and proposes a game in exchange for handing over Flora's items.
A notebook, a stack of photographs, and a portable water bottle are strewn on the ground. The warmth of the water suggests the owner left only moments ago.
The photos depict various landscapes of the Black Shores, indicating the owner's passion for photography. To your surprise, one of the photos is a candid shot of your own silhouette.
This is odd... Where could they be hiding...?
What's going on?
Well, a group of newcomers arrived today, but I just got word that there's one more than what was on the list.
We're not sure if someone slipped in unnoticed, so we're doing a full sweep of the area.
While you were handling the troubles at the Black Shores, I was stuck in a medical pod and missed the whole show.
What a pity I couldn't witness it in person… Show me. Your blade, your strength.
Found you!
Ah, the breeze here... It feels so perfect against my skin.
The waves crashing, the light shimmering on the water's surface...
Hehe, don't you think? Maybe we used to sit here like this, together...
Feeling the wind, watching the night unfold before us, again and again...
Something's on the ground? I need to check it out.
Another camellia... She's never tired of these little games.
Cracked bricks line the room, where massive vines coil through the space, their roots plunging deep into the walls and floor.
As you observe more closely, you notice the vines subtly pulsating, as if they were veins.
Debris and broken equipment are scattered across the floor, the aftermath of uncontrolled chaos.
Unlike the composed Camellya you once met in Jinzhou, her current, uncontrolled state has left her struggling to manage her Forte.
A malfunctioning screen flickers, displaying a log of recent visitors to the Black Shores.
From the data, you discover that Lady Flora was brought here only recently, and her condition has deteriorated rapidly over the past days.
Before I passed the assessment, I went ask the Gardeners about some key things we should know.
Wow, you really think ahead, don't you?
Hehe, you should always stay focused in a game.
So this whole place has been covered in mist... that explains a lot.
So what, just sit here, doing nothing?
Seems like it. The Gardener mentioned someone might've slipped in unnoticed...
So beautiful...
You will be switched to Camellya's perspective.
Shall we head to the Modulation Hall now?
Let's go.
No, I've got something else to handle first.
Really? Fine... I'll be a very good girl, waiting patiently for your return, hehe.
The fresh, pulsating despair from my enemies is always delightful...
I see… (static)… something… deep…
Camellya?
I'll catch… then meet me…
(Static)… what happened… {PlayerName}…
The communication cut out. Something must've happened.
Got separated from Camellya… I should check out the surroundings.
I've sealed my memories, letting the past fade into nothingness.
...Did I make the right choice?
But {PlayerName} already made {Male=his;Female=her} choice. Now I must make my own choice, too.
Ha... I'd rather die than live as a useless nobody.
Is that Camellya? No…
I'm inside a Stellar Matrix that holds Lady Flora's information, so it must be a simulation of some past event.

During the dive, something goes wrong. You lose contact with Camellya and the Modulation Hall.

On the other side of the Stargate, you find yourself in a strange cave. There, an illusion of Lady Flora, resembling Camellya, appears before you.
A part of a broken stone, hidden under the dense veins, faintly reveals itself, bearing some chiseled marks.
It reads… "Petalfall Village".
Veins are everywhere. Overly dense. The plants here are abnormal.
Many years have passed, and here I am again...
But I'm not gonna stay at the Black Shores and live off old memories.
Ugh! My body's giving out... Hah... Need a place to rest soon.
Camellya's illusion disappeared.
Since she mentioned "sealed her memories" and "returned", this must be the cave from twenty years ago.
Did Camellya seal her memories because of my choice?
…(Static)… {PlayerName}, can you hear me?
Yes. What happened?
Something's not right. I'll get you out of the Stellar Matrix first!
The surroundings turn dark, and you feel yourself being lifted out of the Stellar Matrix. You open your eyes, and find yourself back to the Black Shores.
You learn that Lady Flora sealed her memories because of a choice your past self made. Bewildered, you return to the Modulation Hall with Beatrice's help.
Hmph, this little troublemaker is clever, having set all these traps.
But now its core is cornered here, it can't run any further. I can handle it easily when I find it.
It's a pity I got separated from {Male=him;Female=her}.
I wish {Male=he;Female=she} could see what I just saw in those alternative timelines. Can't wait to see {Male=his;Female=her} reactions.
If I hadn't returned to the Black Shores and become a Bloom Bearer again…
It was still possible for us to reunite! I saw it! Whether as a wandering traveler or a Fractsidus member, I got to meet {Male=him;Female=her} anyway!
I've sealed my memories, letting the past fade into nothingness.
...Did I make the right choice?
Is that… me?
They said this matrix contains Lady Flora's information, so… this must be something "I" had experienced in the past.
Sealed memories and this cave… this is where I first awoke.
Seems like this is what Lady Flora last saw before she decided to seal her memories.
But {PlayerName} already made {Male=his;Female=her} choice. Now I must make my own choice, too.
Ha... I'd rather die than live as a useless nobody.
…{PlayerName}? So I knew {Male=him;Female=her} before?
Hahaha! That's it! {Male=He;Female=She}'s a magnet for all kinds of fun. Now let's see what else we can stir up!

After losing contact with you, Camellya crosses the Stargate and finds herself in the cave from the past. Like you, she has jumped through many simulated worlds and witnessed different possibilities, but her path always crosses with yours.

Intrigued by the Lady Flora illusion in front of her, Camellya decides to follow.
Guess I'd better not use my Forte, or I'd be at a disadvantage when {PlayerName} catches up later.
Lady Flora's illusion is ahead.
If this is indeed the final moments before you sealed your memories, let me find out the reasons.
Let me see why you made that choice.
After all these years, {Male=he;Female=she} still made that choice…
I never asked {Male=him;Female=her} much about the Black Shores or {Male=his;Female=her} past.
Haha, for the Black Shores, a better future must mean saving Solaris.
I don't care about that at all.
Why? Why do I have to lose my only beloved playmate, my most cherished opponent!
Here at the Black Shores, {Male=he;Female=she}'s the most trapped one... by far.
Ugh, is this an illusion from the past? Looks like I used to be quite… sentimental.
Though I had this guess while in the previous junctures—{PlayerName} was indeed the former Black Shores leader.

Lady Flora explains that the past duties imposed on the one she yearns for led to their decision to leave the Black Shores. Camellya listens to her past self, surprised by her depth of emotion. Through Lady Flora's words, Camellya realizes that you are the leader of the Black Shores.
I didn't care. As long as we were both happy when we crossed blades, I was happy.
But now, {PlayerName} wants to leave… and even abandon {Male=his;Female=her} memories?
Doing all of this for what? A so-called better outcome?
My Rabelle Index has worsened. The doctors and the Shorekeeper said I need a rest.
...Hmph. They mean well, but… I know myself better.
But now, thinking about the past will only make my Overclocking worse.
{PlayerName} is gone. I can choose to wait, but will {Male=he;Female=she} really return?
What if… I'm already dead by then?
What if I never see {Male=him;Female=her} again?
Dead is dead. It means the end. There's no point in imagining all this.
Fearing loneliness and death…? These emotions are so unfamiliar… so strange.

Lady Flora's condition has gradually worsened ever since she lost her Anchor. As memories from before her arrival at Petalfall Village resurface, her Overlocking symptoms intensify. Camellya struggles to understand what it means to care about others.
Rest won't help… I've lost my anchor. {Male=He;Female=She}'s no longer here to rein me in.
I've started remembering things from before I came to Petalfall Village.
Hehe, was our encounter there a gift from fate… or a curse?
What happened? My chest feels so tight, and I feel… a little unwell?
I must be affected by the environment. My body and emotions are…
This Stellar Matrix is starting to fight back. I'd better hurry up and take it down.
Even with treatment, I'll barely be able to maintain my current state.
But constant Overclocking and forced corrections will ruin me in the end.
Trapped in my body, needing {Male=his;Female=her} pity for love and attention...
If that's how I'll end up, I'd rather die on the spot!
I will never… become a pitiful… weakling... like that...
Ugh, my body... It's acting up again... Is it the surroundings?
Hahaha! Why am I always held back by Overclocking... Dammit...

Lady Flora refuses treatment, fearing it will leave her with nothing. Without her power, she would feel forever inferior to the one she cherishes, a fate she cannot accept. The heavy atmosphere triggers Camellya's own Overclocking symptoms to flare up.
I can feel my energy and power draining away, day by day...
Even if {PlayerName} one day returns, what will I be able to do for {Male=him;Female=her}?
…It's time to go. To where I met {PlayerName}. It will be closure for me, for this cherished connection.
I'll leave the bracelet {Male=he;Female=she} gave me here in the Black Shores.
Sanity is a gift from {Male=him;Female=her}. I would not give it up that easily.
I am one and the same with my instincts.
Like flowers thirst for water, and beasts hunger for flesh…
With or without my memories, my instincts will still guide me to {Male=him;Female=her}.
When we meet again, I hope {Male=he;Female=she} remains my worthy opponent. Friends or foes, united and unbound... It's a dream come true!
Hehe, indeed, that's the choice I would make.
Cough… I will bloom to my fullest... follow my desires… till the end of it all.

To put an end to her severe Overclocking, Lady Flora decides to abandon her memories, including all those of you. She believes that her connection to you is intrinsic to her nature and will ultimately guide her back to you. When that day arrives, she hopes to stand as their equal.

Watching her past self, Camellya acknowledges and accepts this choice.
I can't just sit here and rot away, clinging to old memories.
There is... another way, to keep Overclocking from eating me inside out.
A way to control my emotions... Stop the past from haunting me. A way to forget it all.
I will abandon my memories like {PlayerName} once did, sealing them away.
…I... can't see the road ahead…
One more step… I can't... die here...
...Huff... Ugh...
I passed the Bloom Bearer test!
Take me with you next time, please?
I'll try my best to control myself for you, dear master.
You'll abandon all memories and start over? Where are you going?
Heh… Having been there so many times...
I thought I was used to Overclocking...
All that talk about power, about being free...
And now? You're just a loser.
…Shut up.
Are you?
...I have no plan to drown here.
Consume and be consumed by power... What's wrong with that!
How pathetic. Everything will be forgotten anyway.
What is the point?
What do YOU know?
You… will never be {Male=his;Female=her} equal. Ever.
Forget and be forgotten...
So what!
{PlayerName}...
I traveled far and wide in our time apart. Fate led me back to you every time.
Once I was a nameless traveler, passing you right by.
Once I joined the Fractsidus, and we met in battle.
I may forget you, again and again…
But as long as I still have my instincts…
I'll always gravitate towards you.
And I know...
You'll find me at the end of it all!
Ah… Fighting by your side feels sooo good. My heart, my pulse, my frequencies—the vibrations are driving me crazy!
Such weaklings. I haven't had enough fun yet.
Anyway, {PlayerName}, where did you go after that? How did you find this place?
(Tell her what happened.)
You saw those possible iterations of history too?
Hehe… So you really were the leader of Black Shores.
…Yes.
I'm back.
No wonder I felt something familiar when I first saw you outside Jinzhou…
Hah... Welcome back, {PlayerName}. Glad to see you again.
I saw a lot of interesting stuff… I woke up in that cave a decade ago. Traveled all across Solaris before I ended up back at the Black Shores.
The matrix showed me several different iterations of my past. Looks like even the smallest deviations can lead to entirely different outcomes.
But one constant remained—you always saved me, and we always found each other.
Our encounter is preordained in every future...
My beloved seed, my only… rival.
And you just helped me with my Overclocking… Hmph, I won't let it happen again.
Gotta make sure to show you my best!
This Stellar Matrix should be temporarily deactivated since its core has been dealt with.
Let's go back. Give the coordinates to Beatrice, and this mission will be over.
Then... can I have the rest of your day?
What do you wanna do?
Hehe, let me keep it a secret for now.
Camellya smiles weakly before joyfully recounting what happened in the Stellar Matrix.

You find yourself reunited with Camellya. Considering the years apart, this reunion has been ten years in the making. In every world, you and she have met, parted, and reunited again. If this is your fate, Camellya embraces it willingly.

With the Stellar Matrix defeated, the two of you return home.
Is it a flower seed on the base?
The flower seed has unveiled the hidden path. Hehe, this space seems to defy its creator's will to aid me.
That flower is craving a flower seed. Guess I should place a seed there to unlock the gate.
Hehe, as I expected.
Heh, want to stand in my way? Get lost!
A flower seed should do the trick.
Good, the patterns are lighting up. Now I can rotate the platform.
So this is the correct path to take.
Hahaha, come be my prey, sweet little birdie!
Let's crush this pesky creature together!

Not long ago.
In the corrupted Stellar Matrix, Camellya has already passed through three Stargates, witnessing the possibilities of several different worlds before arriving in an underground cave.
You feel your body grow heavy, as if you're sinking beneath the water, and finally find yourself in an unfamiliar dream.
Yinlin, do you copy? Got an emergency for you to handle.
We need you to infiltrate the Blue Camel and get their latest transaction records.
Remember, don't get caught, or they'll destroy the evidence.
Infiltration... Hmm, I'll need to suit up right.
Gotta sever communications at their camp first. Can't have them calling for backup.
This outfit should do the trick.
That's their hideout. Time to find a discreet spot to change.
You change to blend in with the other Blue Camel Exiles.
This is it... Need to send it back ASAP.
Better hang onto this outfit in case I run into the guards.
Hey! What's that you're holding?
Delivery for my boss.
Replacement parts, nothing else.
Open it. We need to check what's inside. We've had reports about Exiles conducting illegal business recently.
("Red Eagle" needs this. I can't let them search the box.)
(Pretend to turn yourself in)
I confess, sir. This is proof of their crimes...
I can't stand their dirty deeds anymore, so I'm taking this to the Public Security Bureau myself.
If you don't trust me, you can come along.
Well... It's good that you want to bring them to justice.
Alright, I'll escort her to the Bureau. The rest of you, resume your duties.

Yinlin successfully acquires the transaction records by infiltrating the enemy camp. On her way back, she is apprehended by a Patroller for appearing to be an Exile. Yinlin decides to feign surrender so she can be sent to the Public Security Bureau, where she will deliver the records to "Red Eagle."
You are struck with a wave of dizziness as the Patroller's voice grows distant...
No injuries. Looks like they just passed out.
They'll wake at any moment. I need to get the evidence back to him.
This place... something feels wrong. I need to be on my guard.
What happened... Huh? Why are they all lying on the ground?
I've told you before not to come barging in here.
Something unexpected happened during the mission... This will be safer with you.
(Hand over the file)
What's this?
The Blue Camel's transaction records. You asked for them.
You attacked the Patrollers for this?
Something happened to them, but it wasn't my doing.
(...Something's wrong.)
You've been fooled! I never gave you such an order!
Can't you spot a fake transmission?
You've disappointed me, Yinlin.
Fake? How?
(Was the intel false, or did someone impersonate him when they contacted me?)
Blaming me won't make any difference. I need to get to the bottom of this.
Give me some time. I'll figure it out.
Yinlin presents the records to the "Red Eagle," only to be informed that no such request was ever made. Sensing something amiss, she decides to investigate further.
Back at the Blue Camel’s camp again? This isn't right...
I've been waiting for you, Yinlin.
You! Why are you here?
You were once part of the Séance Society, until you betrayed me...
Now answer me: who are you?
Patroller.
Undercover agent.
I'm nobody...
Ask any Patroller if they recognize you. They would only see you as a defector.
You are no Patroller, Yinlin. You never will be.
Haha, is that so? The only one who can prove you are who you say you are has lost faith in you.
You are no Public Security agent, Yinlin. Your foolishness has ruined everything.
That's right, Yinlin. That's who you are...
And you don't belong anywhere.
No one will ever accept you or see your worth. You're nothing!
I'm... nobody...
Yinlin visits the Dollmaker, who tells her that she is neither a Patroller, an undercover investigator, nor even his ally. She has no identity and even a place to stand.
Your thoughts drift back to before this quest began. The lines between memories, dreams, and reality blur together, making you forget that you've experienced all of this before.
Yinlin, do you copy? Got an emergency for you to handle.
We need you to infiltrate the Blue Camel and get their latest transaction records.
Remember, don't get caught, or they'll destroy the evidence.
What is this? Time's rewound to the start of the mission?
That's... me.
No, I have to stop this. How can any of this be possible?
Just before you can stop yourself, a blade intercepts one of your filaments.
Yinlin, calm down!
I have to stop myself!
Something's wrong with this mission.
No, everything's fine.
"Red Eagle" confirmed this mission was a bust.
He's the mole in the Public Security Bureau.
You did nothing wrong.
How could I have known...
No, you knew it all along. Just not in this place.
The mission was a success. You caught the mole and put an end to the Blue Camel's dealings.
As for the Patrollers, you never attacked them.
But I made the wrong judgement...
I put my trust in the wrong person.
No, you've always been cautious.
You're just too afraid of making mistakes, that's why you dream these things.
You've only ever had yourself to rely on, but still, you never waver.
Think about that question again. Who are you, really?
I am who I am...
I am Yinlin.
You enter the dream and tell Yinlin not to doubt herself. In reality, she has successfully exposed the "Red Eagle" as a traitor and completed her mission perfectly.

As the tides receded, a new world and an unexplored adventure awaited you.
Yangyang and Chixia found you unconscious at the Gorges of Spirits. Together, you decided to head to Huanglong's Jinzhou City, marking the beginning of your journey.

Jinzhou, a border city in Huanglong, had long been a battleground against the Threnodian Ovathrax. The Midnight Rangers, led by General Jiyan, fought tirelessly against the waves of Tacet Discords—nightmarish entities created by the Threnodian—near the Norfall Barrens...

Meanwhile, a mysterious organization known as the Fractsidus operated covertly within Jinzhou. They were aiming to resurrect the Threnodian. Somehow, they seemed especially interested in you, going so far as to extend an invitation...

You met Jinhsi, the Magistrate of Jinzhou. She explained the double threats Jinzhou was facing: external attacks from the resurgent Threnodian, and internal turmoil caused by the mysterious disappearance of Jinzhou's Sentinel.
As the Magistrate and the Sentinel's Resonator, Jinhsi resolved to travel to Mt. Firmament and uncover the truth about Jinzhou's missing Sentinel, Jué. A confrontation seemed unavoidable...

The rise of the TD Outbreak unleashed Ovathrax's latest creation: the Dreamless, an incomplete entity. With Jinzhou City under siege, you joined the battle, eventually defeating the Dreamless and absorbing it with your bare hands.
Jinzhou's immediate crisis was averted, but Magistrate Jinhsi was nowhere to be found...
You sought guidance from Sanhua, who directed you to a ferry near Mt. Firmament. There, you encountered Changli, your "Wayfinder" into the mountain.

This secret realm, where the flow of time warped and twisted, required a price for entry. However, you seemed curiously unaffected by the temporal distortion, while Changli seemed unbothered by its effects...

Within Mt. Firmament's Hongzhen settlement, you discovered that many animals and residents had been frozen in time, trapped by the erratic temporal flows. The Fractsidus had also infiltrated the area.

Xinyi, the mayor of Hongzhen, informed you that Jinhsi had only recently departed for Mt. Firmament's peak, in search of the Sentinel. Due to the temporal distortions, what had been days to you was merely moments inside the mountain.

Deep within the Mianloong Chamber, you finally found Jinhsi. Together, you faced the Sentinel, Jué. Jué explained its dilemma: to keep its power from spiraling out of control, it had chosen to remain confined within Mt. Firmament.
If the situation continued, its only recourse would have been to freeze time across all of Jinzhou, hoping future generations could find a solution to undo the damage...

At the mountain's peak, you stood by Jinhsi as she endured Jué's trial, proving the strength of human will. With your help, she stabilized and inherited the Sentinel's power, finally bringing an end to the temporal chaos on Mt. Firmament...
Jué revealed the truth: You were none other than its Arbiter, the founder of Jinzhou.
Jinhsi's unyielding resolve, coupled with the Temporal Mandate granted by Jué with your approval, allowed her to make it through the impossible trial.
Following Jué’s guidance, you set out on a new path, seeking answers to the mysteries of your origins. Your next destination is the base of an enigmatic organization known as the Black Shores.

You confronted a crisis in the Port City of Guixu alongside Yangyang. Shortly after, the Shorekeeper guided you to the Black Shores, a place shrouded in mystery. The Tethys System of the Black Shores had suffered a catastrophic failure, unleashing data-based pollution that corroded everything it touched.
Once again guided by the Shorekeeper, you delved deeper into the Black Shores, determined not only to save this ravaged place but also to recover memories of your past...
The Shorekeeper revealed that you were once the leader and founder of the Black Shores, an ancient organization spanning ages, with her serving as your loyal assistant.
The current crisis, it seemed, was intricately tied to your forgotten past, and the Lament recorded by the Tethys System during the disaster in Port City of Guixu held crucial secrets...
