We're simply spreading the truth through a tale. I'm certain it will pique your interest, so consider this a heartfelt invitation to you and your companions.
Join us, pour your essence into this endless play, and use your humble strength to defy the raging current of fate!

The Fool's Troupe makes its grand entrance to thunderous applause, and the city's excitement reaches a fever pitch. 
Amid the celebrations, you spot Phrolova, one of the Fractsidus Overseers, moving through the crowd.
You follow her trail to a rooftop, where she invites you to join her. Phrolova reveals that you're both searching for the same "special Resonator." As a gesture of goodwill, she offers to exchange a story with you, one that holds a hidden truth. 
Her tale needs a stage, and there is no better stage than Ragunna City at this moment.
The stage is set, and the curtain rises. Actors, the moment to dazzle has arrived.
The magic… is ready to unfold.
As anticipated, the Fractsidus is on the move.
Now, remember the rehearsal we did yesterday? All our preparations have led to this very moment.
She intends to use those Lycorises to summon and control the Tacet Discords. If we destroy the Lycorises, we can neutralize them.
Everyone is in position. We'll manage the west plaza.
Phoebe is stationed at the east plaza, keeping an eye on things.
The main stage is all yours for the grand performance.
Then...
Ladies and gentlemen! The grandest and most spectacular performance of the Carnevale is about to commence!
Let us give a warm round of applause as our actors now take the stage!
Leave that to me.
I'll take care of the lighting and create the mood to make the performance stand out.
Ready? The spotlight will be on you two.
Let's go, partner.
We're already part of the play.
As actors, we can't afford to have cold feet.
The curtain has been lifted. We can't keep our audience waiting.
To ensure the performance runs smoothly...
...we'll need a host.

With Phrolova's opening cue, your performance begins. 
Each of your allies plays their part to enhance the show, while the main stage is set for you and Carlotta to shine.
Ah, come now. Let us embrace the grand climax of this revelry!
"The wildcat has sounded thrice, and the hedgehog four. The peculiar bird sings—the moment is upon us."
O benevolent sorceress of realms unknown, I summon you. Grant us a just prophecy, and may fate favor us all.
You enter the Sonoro Sphere crafted by Phrolova. Here, she intends to tell you a story about a prophecy...
The night veils the world in darkness, while the feast captivates all. Yet you, remain clear-eyed amidst this revelry.
The honeyed wine has clouded their senses and quenched their flames of avarice, yet it has stoked your bravery and kindled the fire within your heart.
I shall unveil the first prophecy and shatter these burdensome stones—abandon the trifles of sentiment, and you shall ascend the throne.
To achieve this, a sacrifice of fresh blood is demanded—a purge of the Holy Maiden and all heretics.
My King, what halts your advance? You have already tainted your feet in the river of blood. There is no retreat.
The path born of injustice must be fortified with further transgressions… The soul must be steeled in bitterness.
Thus, I unveil my second prophecy to dispel all illusions—no mortal shall inflict upon you even the slightest harm.
And assuredly, you shall find favor with your people.
Defy destiny, mock both life and death, and rise beyond good and evil! Abandon all doubt, and grasp at unreachable hopes...
Now, hear the third and final prophecy—pleasure born of violence shall end in violence.
What a pity. The prophecy says the King will not take his final bow in this act.
Reality beckons. Have you glimpsed the truth in this dream?
Two prophecies fulfilled, but the third... I await to see how you will rewrite it.
Divine... divine retribution...! We're being punished again, just like 10 years ago!
If we defeat her, we can set the Cetus free!
We'll give this performance the perfect finale.
(Roooaaarrr—)
What's that... in the sea?
It looks like it's coming straight for us!
Splendid performance.
It's almost time for the final bow. But...
The symphony between us...
...Has only just begun its overture.
Pero?
You should take center stage for the final bow, {PlayerName}.
Hear that? The thunderous roar of applause! It has been far too long! This is the true essence of the Carnevale!
At last, the crisis has been resolved.
It's our hard-earned victory.
They're cheering for us all.
{Male=Lord;Female=Lady} Arbiter… I have heard… thy call…
I have awaited thee… for what seems like an eternity…
I have many questions for you.
How are you holding up?
Where can I find you?
{Male=Lord;Female=Lady} Arbiter… I am ensnared...
Beyond the clouds and among the stars... thou shalt find an inverted tower suspended in the sky—I am there, watching over Solaris from above.
The Lost... doth wander briefly amongst thy kind...
Seek her out… She, too, doth move within the folds of this festival...

You and your companions defeat Phrolova and free Cetus the Tidebreaker from her control. The gloom that had shrouded the Carnevale lifts, and the crowd erupts into applause for your performance.
As daylight breaks through the clouds, a golden Laurel descends over your head, a reward as promised. The Sentinel's voice then echoes in your mind, directing you to Their location. If you wish to find Them, head to the Inverted Tower suspended in the sky, from where They watch over the world.
You notice a hint of vulnerability in the Sentinel's voice. They leave you with a final clue: a "lost" person, someone connected to Them, is currently among the people enjoying the festival.
The next move is… hmm, am I getting this right? It feels a bit off...
Hello.
Try stepping back with your left foot first.
Dancing is not in rigid steps. Let your heart lead the way.
You are…
No, never mind… Anyway, your performance was splendid!
I'm here for the Carnevale as well. It's been ages since I've seen something as grand as this.
I love hearing the laughter and cheers of a crowd, no matter the occasion.
Kind stranger, could you show me those final steps from your curtain call?
Your Tacet Mark is glowing.
I'm sorry, but I can't stay here any longer. I must return...
Can you tell me your name before you go?
My name? It's… um…
Fl… No, I'm Cartethyia… Yes, that's right. Cartethyia.
Farewell, Laureate! I hope that someday, I might stand on stage with your troupe.
Are you alright, {PlayerName}? Some family members mentioned you were speaking to a wall… I'm worried you might still be under Phrolova's spell.
A wall? You didn't see her?
See who? Are you truly alright?
There was a girl here just now. She called herself Cartethyia.
The Sentinel led me to a girl just now.
Cartethyia… I'll make a note of it.
If she was indeed here, she is likely still in Ragunna. I will have my family start searching.
Let's not alarm the public just yet.
We should let the Carnevale continue as planned.
There are still many unresolved questions regarding the Order and the Sentinel. We need time to sort through what we've gathered.
Rushing into action now might only alert the Order's spies and disrupt what we've worked so hard to protect.
You're right.
Cartethyia... I will have my family find out more about her.
If we find out anything, I'll contact you, and we can discuss our next steps together.
Until then, as you suggested…
Let's keep this Carnevale going.

Following the Sentinel's lead, you meet a girl named Cartethyia. Something unusual about her frequencies catches your attention, but she disappears into the crowd before you can learn more.
Later, Carlotta arrives and remarks that no one else seems to notice Cartethyia. She offers to have her family members search for the girl in Ragunna, but you urge caution. Too many mysteries surrounding the Order and the Sentinel remain unsolved. Hasty moves could draw unwanted attention from the Order and disrupt the Carnevale. Besides, you need time to piece together the clues you already hold.
For now, you decide to enjoy the festivities.
With the crisis behind you, you and your companions spend the day basking in cheers and applause.
Later, back at the Palazzo Agrotta, you drift off to sleep, replaying the day's memories from the Carnevale.
Come closer, Righteous One, there's no need for hesitation.

I am Fenrico, the Primus of the Order of the Deep. Your deeds have reached my ears, and I have long wished to meet you. Alas, the burdens of this world delayed our meeting until now. I beg your pardon for the wait.
Please accept my respect for you—you and your troupe have shown great talent and ambition, breathing new life into Ragunna.
I ask you to deliver this message to your companions: from this day forth, the troupe shall have permanent rights to perform within the city.
I surely will.
Even if they're all Fools?
All mortals stumble, but through pilgrimage, they have cleansed their souls and atoned for their transgressions. They have earned their right to return to this divinely blessed land.
I understand that questions weigh on your heart. In the presence of a just Divinity, speak freely, and I will answer with all the honesty I possess.
By the great Sentinel Imperator, I swear to you. There shall be no deceit in my words.
I want to meet the Sentinel Imperator.
You have walked a path similar to Theirs. Indeed, you have the right to meet Them.
However, due to the Dark Tide two decades ago, the Sentinel's body was gravely wounded and remains in a state of recovery.
If you wish to meet Them, I will convey your request.
I see the thirst for truth in your eyes. It is clear that doubts still linger in your heart. Please, voice your concerns.
Tell me about the Blessed Fleurdelys.
Fleurdelys... She was the emissary of the Sentinel, and we are grateful for her contributions.
Twenty years ago, during the Dark Tide, she sacrificed herself to seal the calamity. She fulfilled her duties in this world and returned to the <color=yellow>divine embrace</color>.
Returned to the divine embrace?
Do you know how the Dark Tide came into being?
In Rinascita, wars were waged in the name of faith, tearing apart the Sentinel as our faith divided, weakening Their divine power.
The Dark Tide's true essence is the divine blood shed from the Sentinel's wounds.
That tragic past left deep scars, and with Their divine power drained, They could not prevent the Dark Tide's surge twenty years ago.

The Blessed Maiden chose to martyr herself. She <color=yellow>once again</color> resonated with the Sentinel and, through her sacrifice, restored some of Their divine power, bringing an end to the Dark Tide.

Yet, the Sentinel remains in a state of healing and still requires a mortal representative. Following the Blessed Maiden's departure, I was granted new authority to cleanse the aftermath of the Dark Tide.
I received the Divinity's blessing and became the new Enlightened One. By Their will, I fulfill the tasks left unfinished in this world.
Therefore, we must unify all beliefs, ensuring the purity and unity of our will to prevent another tragedy...
(Reflect on the Blessed Maiden's Second Resonance with the Sentinel.)

(He said she "once again resonated with the Sentinel," was that really a Second Resonance Awakening? Sentinel Jué had a trial with Jinhsi, but my permission was needed to transfer the Sentinel's power...)
You're hiding things from me.
I swear, my words are without deceit.
I see in your eyes that you have walked further on the path of justice than I anticipated.
O dear Sentinel… please forgive my transgressions.
The Dark Tide brought us a bloodstained lesson. To keep our people from faltering, I bound myself to silence, locking away what I witnessed on that fateful day.
Fleurdelys, the Unrighteous, deceived us all. She was not the Blessed Maiden chosen by the Sentinel... The true maiden has yet to reveal herself.
Why did people believe she was the Blessed Maiden?
Where did her power to seal the Dark Tide come from?
You must know that a being capable of rivaling our Divinity exists in this world—humanity's eternal adversary, the evil of all civilizations... the Threnodian.
As the Sentinel has Their Resonator, so does the Threnodian.
Fleurdelys was shaped—both body and spirit—by our ancient enemy. Her actions were intended to plunge this city into fear and chaos.
This is the truth I witnessed—Fleurdelys was the <color=yellow>Threnodian's Resonator</color>.
Never before have I seen a day so steeped in both shadow and light.
The birds sing, the flowers bloom… yet this world knows neither true joy nor eternity.

At the Cathedral of Mercury, you meet Fenrico. He apologizes for Alessio and others' deeds and promises to answer your questions as best he can.
In his words about the Sentinel, you catch a mention of the "Second Resonance Awakening." This raises suspicion—such a transfer of power from the Sentinel would require your permission.
When you press Fenrico about the true fate of Fleurdelys, he finally reveals a long-held secret: Fleurdelys was the Threnodian's Resonator.
Phrolova, you do have a knack for indulging in... pointless little chores.
Why, there's no rule against an actor making good use of the intermission.
Besides, I haven't disrupted your arrangement, have I?
"The one from a faraway land who discerns the truth dares to raise their sword against the divine. In response, the slumbering gods break free from their shackles, revealing their true forms..."
The possibility of the Second Resonance Awakening is now a certainty. So we just need to see if that special Resonator truly exists.
Was the Blessed Maiden a Resonator for the Sentinel or the Threnodian?
Or both? If so... Oh, a Resonator capable of wielding both powers... I am eager to see how this story ends.
Cristoforo, if you don't want to spoil the next act, I might have to give your carefully crafted plot a little nudge.
Speaking of which, {PlayerName} shines brighter than anyone else in your play. Do you find {Male=him;Female=her} interesting as well?
Phrolova, it seems we walk different paths. I don't share your fondness for that sort of... puppet theater.
I merely place the characters on their stage and they act out their fates, driven by their own volition.
To remain courageous amidst absurdity, to pursue a spark of divine grace—this, to me, is the truest essence of humanity, don't you think?
Even the most pristine cadence of death pales beside the untamed, fervent, and tenacious spirits of the living.
In their journey, they resolutely overcome all obstacles: they pursue, they tear, they burn—simply because they desire to.
I think you should leave your secluded mansion. Take a walk and listen to the voices scattered across the world.
…Perhaps.
From Huanglong to Rinascita, {Male=he;Female=she} has indeed added a few unexpectedly beautiful notes to my symphony.
I am certain that, even without any direction, {Male=he;Female=she} will walk the path that destiny has laid before {Male=him;Female=her}.
All things ascend towards a singular point of convergence, and what awaits at the end is... immortality.
Before the tides of fate, we are all but…
…humble servants.

Not far away, Phrolova watches your every move. Beside her stands another Overseer, Cristoforo the "Playwright."
It seems his script is only starting to unfold...
Were you awake, {PlayerName}? I trust you had a restful sleep?
We have uncovered some new information about the Sentinel. Please join us at the family's safe house.
I have sent the address to your Terminal. Brant and Roccia are also here. We are awaiting your arrival.
Raise your glasses! Shout it loud, friends!
To us, to the Carnevale, and to our very own Laureate, {PlayerName}!
A name that echoes through the world, destined to roam the skies before shaking the earth!
Hear, hear! That's me!
Please, stop. You're making me feel embarrassed…
Don't be fooled by how he looks. Brant is already deep in his cups, drunk as a skunk.
Oh, let him enjoy himself. The taste of victory is still fresh, and after such a battle, we should celebrate to the fullest!
Drink your fill, everyone! This round's on me!
HOORAY!!!
Hmm, I see… Someone's been eavesdropping.
Looks like we've attracted some unwanted attention.
Aren't we in your family's safe house?
A devout Acolyte wouldn't enter such a place without a good reason.
The Montelli family is known for its hospitality, but freeloaders... will not find us so welcoming.
Friends, let's keep the mood lively!
Come, let's discuss the information we've gathered so far.
During the Carnevale, you heard the Sentinel's voice and found a girl named Cartethyia. We've dug up some information on her.
In the Order, every high-ranking Acolyte is given a new name.
We contacted the Acolyte, Phoebe. After some digging in the Order's records, she confirmed that before taking on her holy title, the Blessed Fleurdelys was called... Cartethyia.
So, she is the Sentinel's Resonator.
The family will uncover the truth. The only remaining clue is the "inverted tower" you mentioned hearing about from the Sentinel, but even that feels elusive...
Judging by your expression, you must have discovered something new, right?
Do you recall what we learned from the stained glass in the Tower Ruins? There were two divinities at the dawn of Rinascita.
If one refers to the Sentinel, then the other, who could stand alongside Them, might be the Threnodian.
The two are undoubtedly linked, so uncovering one could lead us to the other.
Remember Gilberto, from the Fisalia family? It took a lot to get him to talk, but we finally got some information from him.
As he tells it, the Fisalia family's long-revered deity is none other than... Leviathan, the Threnodian from the sea's depths.
They worship the Threnodian…
It's hard to believe, I know. But recent events have only reinforced what we discovered from the stained glass.
The Fisalia family has been on this island since the founding of Rinascita, so their worship of the Threnodian may have persisted for centuries.
We will attempt to establish contact with the Fisalias to build an alliance and gather more intelligence.
Do you think they'll be willing?
Rest assured, negotiation is what we do best. If necessary, we'll present them with an offer they can't refuse.
Excuse me for the interruption. Greetings, esteemed guest.
The Primus wishes to invite you for a conversation at the Cathedral of Mercury. Would you be so inclined?
How curious. Since when has the Primus become so interested in social calls?
It could very well be a trap.
I'm merely conveying the Primus' invitation. The choice is yours.
Don't worry, he wouldn't dare do anything to me.
Perfect timing. I have many questions for him.
Remember, you're not alone. If anything happens, just let us know.
Very well, please follow me to the Cathedral of Mercury.
But the Blessed Maiden... she martyred herself twenty years ago...
There must be more to it than that...
I just saw a ghost?!
Did someone pretend to be her?
Did the Blessed Maiden suddenly come back from the dead?
Hahaha! There you are, my friend! A compliment, if too subtle, loses all its charm!

Carlotta invites you to the Montelli family's safe house for a celebratory dinner. You and your friends raise a glass and share a rare moment of laughter. During the gathering, Carlotta reveals that Cartethyia is actually Fleurdelys, the Blessed Maiden. This new information helps you piece together the clues you've uncovered.
Carlotta also shares a shocking revelation from Gilberto regarding the history recorded in the ruins: The Fisalia family actually worships the Threnodian known as the "Leviathan" from the deep sea, a belief that may date back centuries. Rinascita's Sentinel and the Threnodian are connected, and if the situation demands, the Montelli family might seek a conversation with the Fisalia family.
Meanwhile, the Montellis will keep investigating the mysterious Inverted Tower, the other clue left by the Sentinel.
Soon after, you receive an invitation from the Primus, Fenrico, to the Cathedral of Mercury.
How can that be? That Blessed Maiden... could she really be the Threnodian's Resonator? What if the Primus's words were a bunch of baloney?
But we saw Cartethyia following the Sentinel's instructions... They wouldn't mix up Their own Resonator, right?
Ugh, now my head hurts... Who was she really with? The Sentinel? Or the Threnodian?
He didn't seem like he was lying.
He definitely seemed like he was hiding something important.
Ugh, my head is starting to hurt too...
Well, probably won't get any more answers from him...
All the clues we've gathered so far point to the Threnodian.
And the Fisalia family worships the Threnodian. We'll have to wait for Carlotta to arrange an audience with them.
Something tells me this Carnevale is just the beginning. There's more ahead, I'm sure of it.

After leaving the Cathedral, you discuss the findings with Abby. Every clue now seems to point back to the Threnodian mysteries, and you'll have to wait for Carlotta to contact the Fisalia family.
Gazing out over the tranquil sea of Rinascita, you feel a shiver of foreboding. The Carnevale is only a prologue... Everything is just beginning.
In the presence of the just Divinity, feel free to express your doubts. I shall speak without reservation.
I swear by the great Sentinel Imperator there will be no deceit in my words.
Why do you banish people in the name of pilgrimage?
Why do you oppose the Carnevale?
Why did you work with the Fractsidus?
That's it for now.
We must create a land that aligns with the Sentinel's vision. We must purge this land of individuals who stray from the righteous path to ensure that our collective will remains unified and pure.
However, we honor the deeds of Napoli II, the founding Primus, and offer those who have strayed a chance for atonement.
The Pilgrim's Sail follows Napoli's path. He too once endured this arduous journey, yet emerged victorious, earning an audience with the Sentinel.
The trials are not mere sufferings but steps toward redemption. The penitent who confront the trials with sincerity will be allowed to return to the divine's embrace.
Unity is our shield, bound by the law of eternal continuity.
Though we revel in the joy of the Carnevale, we must also be vigilant.
For division is a chronic disease plaguing this city. The growing indulgence among our citizens has already invited divine punishment.
We, as stewards of divine will, must guide the people, erecting barriers of reason against the floods of passion. This is the only way to withstand the ever-changing tides.
We uphold the Sentinel's principles of justice. The gates to our divine land remain open to all who seek it.
This is a city of inclusiveness, welcoming all visitors… including those who try to overstep their bounds.
These charlatans misled our people with lies and flattery, diverting them from the divine will.
But your timely intervention corrected their course, sparing them from a ruinous fate. Once again, I offer my sincerest gratitude.
May the Divinity bless you, and may you always walk the path of righteousness.
Please, follow me.
Where are we going?
Ah, please allow me to keep that a secret for now—I wouldn't want to spoil the surprise. But here's a hint: you've been there before.

After all you've been through, your body aches for rest. As you sink into the soft bed, you let your thoughts settle and drift into a peaceful sleep, preparing yourself for the excitement and challenges of the upcoming Carnevale.
Wow! Is this real? Pinch me. I can't believe how different everything looks! So this is the Carnevale, huh?

At last, the day has arrived—the Carnevale! 
This long-awaited festival has finally begun, and excitement fills the air. Take a stroll around the bustling streets, check in with your friends, and keep an eye out for anything unusual.
I can't wait to explore! Oh, by the way, it's been a while since we last saw Zani and Phoebe. Wonder what they're up to right now...
Alright, let's go. We should also keep an eye out for anything unusual along the way.
An unending darkness cloaks the kingdom as monstrous beasts ravage the land.
The Holy Maiden has been captured by the Demon King, and chaos descends...
But lo! Two valiant heroes step forth, accepting the minister's quest, vowing to vanquish the beasts and rescue the Holy Maiden!
The heroes breach the first barrier, sweeping away the monsters within the city!
Now, they advance towards the Demon King's castle, where peril await at every corner... What trials lie ahead?
Phrolova summons a wave of Tacet Discords to block your path, but you and Carlotta manage to break through the obstacle and press on toward her location.
No wall can deter these free spirits, even the stars seem to cheer on their bravery!
Exercise caution. New enemies have appeared.
The Demon King unleashes its minions, long awaiting these audacious intruders...
Once again, Phrolova conjures a deadly swarm of Tacet Discords...
They launch a fierce assault, intent on crushing the heroes and grinding them to dust...
Don't confront them head-on!
Watch out!
Now!
Ah! A sudden twist unbalanced the heroes, then at this crucial moment, a mysterious figure enters the fray!
A Divinity-sent emissary? Or a spirit from the shadows perhaps?
She seems moved by their passion and righteousness,  see her join the heroes' ranks!
Ah, how delightful! I await your challenge with bated breath...
It seems the Demon King anticipated the heroes' arrival and has gladly extended an invitation...
You and Carlotta are surrounded by TDs, but Roccia arrives in time, diving headfirst into the fight to aid you.
With unyielding determination, the heroes accept the challenge!
The Demon King reveals itself at last, exposing its hideous visage and sharp fangs. The final showdown is nigh!
Facing Phrolova's taunts, you stand firm and accept her challenge, ready to face the powerful Tacet Discords she has summoned.
The Demon King summons its foul army, poised for a climactic battle with the heroes... The victor will soon be revealed.
Amidst the clashing swords and the cries of the minions, the heroes face the Demon King—victory belongs to the righteous and the brave!
And now, we await the Holy Maiden's return...
And so we arrive at the "happily ever after," yes?
But we do not live in a fairy tale. There is no playwright to script a happy ending for us... What lies behind the curtain is but a cruel jest, a dark satire.
Let me reveal the truth behind that idyllic ending. The Holy Maiden has long succumbed to darkness, drawing power from a heretical force and leading her people into depravity.
And the minister, having uncovered this truth, has vowed to root out this corruption himself.

At last, you reach Phrolova. It seems like the story should end here, but she has one last surprise. Unleashing her powers, she tears through the fabric of space itself, adding yet another twist to your tale.
Ah, {PlayerName} and Lady Phoebe! I've been capturing the Carnevale's many beautiful moments! What brings you all together here?
Hmm? You took this picture? Look at that composition and lighting! Who knew you had a knack for photography!
Buddy, you look so happy! Whatever the reason, thanks for making this moment special!
*Humph!*
It's all thanks to {PlayerName}. {Male=He;Female=She} fulfilled C-MOSS's wish.
Just like us, C-MOSS wants to savor every moment of the Carnevale and leave with no regrets.
You seem excited about the Carnevale too.
Why not join us in the celebration?
The Sentinel cherishes Their people, and as followers, we find joy in witnessing everyone's happiness.
But we have our duties, ensuring order during the Carnevale. I'm sorry I can't join in the festivities.
I wish you a wonderful time at the Carnevale!

With C-MOSS's wish granted, Fulmine arrives to thank you for your kindness. Phoebe, however, is bound by her duties to the Order. She needs to maintain order at the festival and can't join you for the rest of the Carnevale. 
You can see the excitement and joy in her eyes, though. With her blessings for you in mind, you decide to help keep the Carnevale safe.
(Hmm? There's something on top of that ruin.)
(Are those... corroded frequencies?)
(Need to find a way up there.)
(There are Fisalia markings on these crates. What's inside?)
(Something's being wrapped in these strange frequencies. I should clear them out first.)
Ah! You have returned!
How did it go? Any discoveries to share?
You tell Cristoforo and Zani what you found out.
Intriguing. Frequency corrosion, you say? So these missing Echoes appeared out of nowhere and turned hostile?
This is unheard of... Echoes are the Sentinel's gift to Rinascita. They're not supposed to turn on each other, much less humans.
Actually, there was a similar incident with hostile Echoes in Ragunna City recently.
It was more serious, and the Echoes involved almost hurt us. That's why we're investigating.
I presume the Fisalia you seek is entangled in this affair.
We're not sure yet.
Exactly.
I see... Very well. Allow me to offer you my thanks, {PlayerName}.
The frequency corrosion driving the Echoes mad has been resolved, but we must still caution villagers and their Echoes. They should exercise vigilance and avoid perilous areas.
Cristoforo leaves in a hurry. It looks like he's on his way to warn the nearby villagers and Echoes.
Looks like we're dealing with a repeat of the rehearsal incident here… But if Gilberto was behind this, how did he pull it off?
The petals might have the answers.
Petals? They give off a... strange feeling.
Any ideas of what it might be, Abby?
Alright. Let's give it a try. Huh, tastes kinda weird.
It's not an Echo, or a Tacet Discord… The frequency's coming from a Resonator. A super strong one!
...Strange. Gilberto's a Resonator, but he doesn't seem… particularly strong.
So Gilberto's not working alone.
Yes. Be it the mastermind or another pawn, it's got the Fisalia family written all over it.
They staged the accident, endangering civilians, and then used it to frame the Montellis.
What a story. This is definitely headline material. Just think of the leverage the Montelli family could get with this scandal...
Hey, {PlayerName}. Look, over there! That person looks kinda familiar.
It's Phoebe! What's she doing here with all those Echoes?
Wait... I got an idea...

Upon reaching the area where Echoes have gone missing, you're attacked by out-of-control Echoes. After quelling them, you notice that they seem to be manipulated, just like the Vitreum Dancers in Ragunna. 
Bidding Cristoforo farewell, you press on and encounter another familiar face—Acolyte Phoebe.
No bosses, no colleagues, no reports... What a good life.
These Echoes are keen to find their friends too. They're not fighters, but they can surely be your guide. Why not take them along?
After we hand Gilberto over to the family, we'll meet up with you as soon as possible.
Please be extra careful, {PlayerName}! May the Sentinel protect you!
You can take a Gondola in the harbor, but please be careful.
Livia, Brenno! Any sign of Beppe?
Strange, where could Beppe be...?
Oh... Cut it out, Brenno! Stop that...
Wait, Brenno's right here. Then who's poking me in the back? Beppe, you better have a good expla—
—Not Beppe. It's me. Abby!
Eek!
That's enough, Abby.
Hic...! Lame. I was just trynna have some fun with her.
Oh, it's you. Pardon me, {PlayerName}.
I thought you were at Ragunna City. Didn't expect to meet you here. Oh, uhh... Sorry, I don't think we've met.
Greetings, madam. My name is Zani. Averardo Bank.
I don't think we've met before.
Well... It's probably because I haven't been to church much... Ahem. Please don't stare at me like that. There are more pressing matters.
We're investigating the Echo incident from the Carnevale rehearsal at Whisperwind Haven, as requested by the Montelli family. One of our clues led us here.
The Echo incident... Yes, I've also heard of it. I even heard you were caught right in the middle of it, {PlayerName}.
Please accept my apologies on behalf of the Order.
It's okay. I didn't get hurt.
By the way, have any of you seen an Echo named Beppe? They're about this tall and usually wander around here, but I can't seem to find them anywhere...
May I?
Sorry, we didn't see the Echo you mentioned, but we've found clues on their odd behavior. They all point to a member of the Fisalia family, Gilberto.
He's also caused similar incidents here recently... Echoes went out of control and attacked each other.
The Order has also received reports of missing Echoes in this area. Is it possible that the Fisalia family is involved? I find it really hard to believe.
From what I know, the Fisalia family is deeply respectful of the Divinity. How could they commit such a blasphemous act? The Echoes are gifts from the Sentinel.
Have you seen this before?
A petal? The ritual one? No, wait... this frequency...
Oh, right! I think I saw this flower in the Cathedral of Mercury, and Priest Alessio was wearing it. Wait... Could he be involved with the Fisalia family's plans?
Most certainly.
No, we're still lacking key evidence.
Imperator granted us Echoes, the skies, lands, oceans, and sustenance. To which we should all be grateful and reverent.
I request to join your investigation, {PlayerName}. As a servant of the Sentinel, I simply cannot turn a blind eye to their unholy acts.
What do you think, Zani?
Fine by me. With someone from the Order as a neutral witness, the Fisalias won't be able to accuse us of fabricating evidence.
As long as I'm not treated like a heretic and get kicked out of Rinascita later.
I'm okay with it as well.
Great, it seems we've reached an agreement.
Beppe? Thank the Divinity, you're safe! But what happened to you?
Wait! Beppe... Oh...
Sorry, I got a bit carried away. Echoes don't usually act like this… Something must have startled them.
Something feels off. We should go check it out, {PlayerName}.

Phoebe reveals that she's searching for a missing Echo. You share your findings, and she realizes Gilberto's actions are blasphemy against the Sentinel, which calls for a punishment. With shared goals, Phoebe joins your team. 
Suddenly, the missing Echo appears, fleeing as if being pursued. You decide to catch up to uncover what's behind its panic.
Hi!
Umph!
Erh... Hmm?
Hah...!
You're saying the Fisalia family was involved in the incident at the Carnevale rehearsal? Do you have solid evidence?
Not yet, Mr. Alberto. But the clues we found all lead to Fisalia family member, Gilberto. We will investigate further.
The Fisalia family... It seems they've run out of patience. This mess has got our honored guest into trouble and given these rats a chance to make their move.
Please pass on my thanks to our guest for the help. If you find yourselves short of hands or funds, do let me know. I'll be discussing this matter with Director Pacino.
I will, sir. There's also another sensitive matter. It appears a Priest from the Cathedral of Mercury is involved, so it's highly possible that the Order is aware of this.
The Order... Let me handle them. You just focus on Gilberto for now. Whatever the case, the Carnevale must be secured.
This goes beyond the Montelli family. It's also about the faith and hope of countless Ragunnesi.
Understood.
And that was from...?
They want you for overtime?
It's from Mr. Alberto. He's the head of Averardo Bank. My superior.
Not really. It's from Mr. Alberto. He's the head of Averardo Bank. My superior.
But this doesn't sound like him. He's usually cautious and rarely makes outright promises unless one of the big shots in the family is twisting his arm.
If the top brass are alarmed, it can only mean that the situation may be...
Extremely bad?
Worse than we thought?
Hmm, maybe I'm overthinking this. Either way, we've finally got a lead.
We should search the area. See where Gilberto went.

To your surprise, the Order's "confessional" turns out to be a freight elevator. 
After leaving it behind, you arrive at Whisperwind Haven and meet Zani. Together, you set off to trace Gilberto.
Excellent. Everything is in place. Now, all we need is Her Majesty's approval.

O great Imperator. May you raise the tides, deliver your edict to our Queen, and let the clouds cover Ragunna, cleansing it of the wickedness left by the pleasure-seekers of this city of transgression.
Is he praying? I know the Fisalias are extremely devout, but who is this "Queen" he mentioned?
This prayer sounds... odd. It's definitely not from the Order's Codex.
O Divinity in the Abyss, Lord of Tides and Riddles, may you soon be freed. Let all lies melt away under your power. May you grant me strength to overcome all who oppose you.
Lord of Tides and... Riddles?
Huh? Who's there!?
Uh-oh, things just went south. Looks like we've got a fight on our hands.
You must be that outlander, right? The news of your arrival is all over Ragunna...
Since you're here, I guess you've uncovered quite a bit... Though it's insignificant compared to the truth beneath the tides.
As a gesture of goodwill, let me offer a word of advice: Curiosity won't lead you to the truth you seek, but rather closer to—
—Your impending doom.
He just turned Echoes into Tacet Discords. Is it the petals?
You... What have you done to those Echoes!?
Merely the neccessary sacrifices for our one true Divinity.

You finally pin down Gilberto, who is reciting eerie prayers. 
On seeing you, he transforms the nearby Echoes into Tacet Discords with a Lycoris flower. A fierce battle ensues.
No! This cannot be!
How pathetic. You're nothing but a discarded pawn.
...Which is not unusual with the Fisalia family.
Mr. Gilberto, please explain this "Lord of Tides and Riddles" you mentioned.
I appreciate your passion for the Order, Miss Phoebe, but now is not the time. We need to uncover the real culprit behind the Fisalias.
Oh, forgive me...
Do you really think you've won? No, it's already too late... Haha...
I might just be a pawn, insignificant and small, but while you're focusing on me, you've missed something far more important.
He shows no remorse for his crimes. I'll contact Mr. Alberto and have the family send someone to take over.
What? That's the... The Nimbus Sanctum.
These Echoes... are converging towards the sea of clouds. What's happening?
Ha. Muahahaha! Magnificent! Lorelei is now ours for the taking... Just as the prophecy foretold! All shall be cleansed!
Now, let us wait in patience as the sea of clouds descends to engulf that corrupted city. Only the faithful will rise anew from the tides!
Lorelei?
According to the Codex, Lorelei is a powerful Remnant creature residing in the Atrium of Reflections at the center of the Nimbus Sanctum.
Legends say the sea of clouds once flooded the Seminary of the Forgotten, reducing it to ruins, before spreading to Ragunna. It was Lorelei who curbed the raging clouds and ended the crisis.
If... if they've really done something to Lorelei, then Mr. Gilberto wasn't just bluffing. The clouds might truly engulf Ragunna, leading to a disaster beyond our imagination.
They are all mad... So this is what they've been planning all along.
We have to do something.
You two go ahead. I'll stay here and watch him until the family arrives, just in case he gets any bright ideas.
I'll stay with you. After all, this could provoke outcry from the Fisalia family. If I testify about Gilberto's misdeeds on behalf of the Order, they can't deny the facts or exploit the situation.
I agree. But what about you, {PlayerName}...
Phoebe's got a point.
Don't worry. I can take care of myself!
All right. There's a port nearby where you can catch a Gondola. It can take you close to the Atrium of Reflections.
After we hand Gilberto over to the family, we'll meet up with you as soon as possible.
Please be extra careful, {PlayerName}! May the Sentinel protect you!

Despite his defeat, Gilberto continues to preach a dark prophecy: Lorelei will command the sea of clouds to engulf Ragunna, sparing only the faithful. Meanwhile, an anomaly at the Nimbus Sanctum suggests Lorelei might also be influenced by a Lycoris. 
Zani and Phoebe stay behind to watch over Gilberto until the Montelli members arrive. You head to the sea of clouds alone.
Welcome, traveler. I am the harbormaster. Where do you wish to go?
The Atrium of Reflections.
You intend to navigate the sea of clouds? Surely you've noticed today's weather… I'm afraid it's far from ideal for sailing.
Is this kind of weather unusual?
Yeah, we've seen storms before, but nothing like this. I wonder what's causing it. I suggest you sit it out before departing.
I'm on a clock.
I can't wait that long.
I see. If that's the case, you can take the Gondola in the harbor, but please be careful.

Upon reaching the port near the sea of clouds, you prepare to board a boat to the Atrium of Reflections, but the port's services are suspended due to the anomaly. Fortunately, the harbormaster lets you take a Gondola yourself.
With no other options, you search the port for an available Gondola.
Aha. Perfect… There's still a Gondola here. I believe your name is… Noah, right?
*Gentle sounds of approval*
It seems fate has brought us together once more. Don't you agree? Kind {Male=sir;Female=lady}.
You're…?
It seems you do remember me. That's right. We crossed paths at Madame Nyarla's mask shop.
Truth be told, I need to catch the final train in the Nimbus Sanctum today. However, this lone Gondola is all the harbor offers.
So… since we share the same destination, would you mind also sharing this Gondola with me?
I don't mind at all.
Please step aboard, my lady.
Much obliged.
Well, then. Without further ado, let's be on our way.

While searching for an available Gondola, you encounter the noble lady you once met at the Masked Reverie.
She asks to travel with you to catch the train in the sea of clouds.
This song... where is it coming from?
That's Lorelei's song, guiding ships through the mist.
But her singing sounds a bit different today. There are hints of... sorrow and agony...
Perhaps it's merely my fancy. Regardless, her melody will guide us through fog and storm to the heart of the Nimbus Sanctum.
The cloud continues to spread. You may be right. This could be Imperator's test, but we must leave.
Do as you please! I'm not leaving. The relic of the Ancient One is here somewhere. I must...
How intriguing. These seem to be Reverberations hidden in the sea of clouds.
Perhaps you've heard that this was once the Order's seminary. It appears that even after the clouds consumed it, the Reverberations of its members linger on.
Maybe the anomalies in the sea of clouds are stirring them to life once more.
You seem very knowledgeable about all this.
Why yes, I've long been fascinated by Ragunna's history and art. After all, to chart our future, we must first understand our past. Is that not true?
We're likely to encounter more Reverberations on our way. They may even contain vital information. You can search for more if you're curious.
It seems we have some time before the train arrives. How about a little chat to pass the time?
I'm waiting for someone anyway.
Well, then. Where shall we begin?
"The city, an abomination of chaos, claims its first death at birth. Its mortality has become our sustenance, like a whale that slowly sinks into the abyss."
This comment on Ragunna comes from Rosselli, a painter from the past. Tragically, he died in poverty, his work overlooked. Now, ironically, even a mere sketch of his commands over a million Credits.
Now. What is your impression of Ragunna so far?
The people are very passionate.
A profit-driven place full of corruption.
A city of faith.
I'm not sure.
Passionate... Indeed. Passion is a quality the Ragunnesi possess in abundance. It's also why the Carnevale is so eagerly anticipated.
Indeed. Ragunna is not as glamorous as it seems. Beneath the veneer of prosperity, avarice reigns supreme.
Indeed, faith is Ragunna's crown jewel. Our devotion to the Sentinel stands unrivaled throughout Rinascita.
A most prudent response. Perhaps you're still acquainting yourself with Ragunna, or you simply prefer discretion. Either way, I take no offense.
Ragunna has many facets. Most people only see one side of it, but for me—
It's like two sworn enemies are forcibly bound together. That's Ragunna—a city where tradition and innovation, openness and isolation, ceaselessly wrestle for dominance.
That is why the Montelli and Fisalia families are in a constant clash, as you may have seen.
The Montellis champion innovation, staking all on the Carnevale. Meanwhile, the Fisalias cling to tradition, colluding with the shadows that lurk in Ragunna's depths.
Fortunately, this long struggle behind the curtains will soon come to an end. Not because of the two families, but because of you.
Me?
Yes, you. The Fated One. Perhaps you're not merely entangled in Ragunna's conflict, but are, in fact, the very eye of the storm. The city's fate may well rest upon your shoulders.
Are you serious?
I can hardly buy that.
You may have not noticed it yet, but we are... and have been in the same boat for a long time.
Ah. There's the train. It's time to say goodbye now.
I didn't catch your name.
I'll tell you next time. As for now, let's keep it a mystery.
Until we meet again, Fated One. May you find your own path in Ragunna.

You arrive at the Echo train station and wait for its arrival. 
During the wait, the noble lady shares her thoughts on Ragunna City, the Montelli and Fisalia families... and you.
A chat won't hurt.
After the mysterious lady departs, Zani and Phoebe arrive on a Gondola. Together, you set off toward where Lorelei resides.
So this is what's become of the seminary? I never expected this.
You've been here before?
No, but I've seen paintings of the seminary in the Cathedral. It had an enormous dome and spires that seemed to touch the heavens.
Then the Order was forced to abandon it when the sea of clouds swallowed it.
You reunite with Zani and Phoebe at the Atrium of Reflections。
Have you also come to repent and seek forgiveness?
The Sentinel has revealed a path to resist temptation and corruption. We need only devote ourselves wholly... to Lorelei.
We're just here to see Lorelei.
Patience. I see your eagerness for enlightenment, like our new brothers. You've removed your masks, but your hearts… they're still veiled.
Everyone here wears a mask. Everyone in Ragunna. Without exception, never unmasked. This is the source of our suffering. The mask veils our hearts.
Like our new brothers, they wear peculiar masks of madness. Poor souls tormented by evil desires. May they find peace in Lorelei's embrace.
Peculiar masks of madness?
Evil desires?
Yes, their masks are filled with madness, but even wrongdoers can seek redemption from Lorelei. The Sentinel granted Lorelei this authority, and no one can take it away.
Follow Lorelei's song and your heart, and you may meet our lady. But if your transgressions are... beyond redemption, you'll be lost in the sea of clouds forever.
So what should we do to see Lorelei?
Do you seek an audience with Lorelei? Sadly, you've come at a bad time. Lorelei is furious, and our mortal bodies can't withstand her wrath. We've sealed the path to her domain.
We appreciate the explanation, but we believe Lorelei is in danger... We're here to help her. Someone's planning to exploit her powers...
The path has been closed. You must leave.
(Sigh) Doesn't look like we'll be talking our way past him. Let's find another way, {PlayerName}.

At the Atrium of Reflections, a masked believer tells you that the path to Lorelei's domain is sealed. Unable to reason with them, you begin investigating the place to find an alternative way forward.
Oh. I have been cleansed of impure thoughts. I can finally escape from my wrongdoings.
Sing, dance! For we have been granted peace and freedom!
Yes, we only need to relish this moment!
We'd like to see Lorelei.
Oh! You've also come to rid yourself of your misdeeds? Then join us! Sing! Sing with us!
The door has been shut. Simply sing along and it will open before you!
(Just "Sing"? Doesn't look like we'll get more out of them. Let's go check somewhere else.)
But most of these are worn out and don't look like modern Rinascita script. Phoebe, can you read any of it?
Let's see... This seems like an ancient holy script dedicated to recording the deeds of Sentinel Imperator. As for its content...
"I shall grant this power to... the Night... Queen. May she... during the day... sea of clouds..."
Ugh. Much of this text is illegible. However, the adjacent drawing is mostly intact. It shows Sentinel Imperator speaking to a massive creature.
And the creature slowly shifts from an immense, amorphous form into a humanoid shape.
Could it be Lorelei? After all, no other being that large lives above the sea of clouds....
Actually, I'm not sure if the other figure is the Sentinel. It looks a little different from the Cathedral statues. Maybe it's just the lack of clarity in the drawing.
Anyway, does it mean... Lorelei and the Sentinel are somehow connected to each other?
Nothing about the barrier though. Are there any other clues?
These inscriptions and markings on the stela seem to say something.
We should investigate further.
A veil of mist shrouds the Atrium, radiating an aura of resistance. This must be the entrance that the believers refer to as "the path to audience."
However, it's completely sealed.
Small words are carved beside it: "We mourn the martyrdom of the Blessed Maiden."
Is this some kind of hint?
Misteltein! You're here!
*growl*—
*chirp*!
This is Misteltein. One of the missing Echoes. They probably followed the singing.
Misteltein, do you know how to remove the barrier?
Now how would an Echo know that, Phoebe—
*growl*—
They say that we just need to sing a specific song.
(Nods)
Y-You can understand what it's saying?
A specific song, huh? That's a direct lead. But which one?
I guess "singing" is our only option for clearing that barrier.
But which song?
The stela we saw mentioned the Sentinel, and we're in the ruins of the seminary.
Meaning it should be a "chorale"? There are also the inscription in front of the barrier: "We mourn the martyrdom of the Blessed Maiden."
Any chorales you know ring a bell, Phoebe?
The martyrdom of the Blessed Maiden... Could this be the "Aria of the Blessed Maiden"? It's a chorale rarely used these days. I doubt most Priests even know of it.
The Blessed Maiden? We met a playwright named Cristoforo earlier. He shared some stories about her.
Phoebe, if you know this chorale, why not give it a try? It might just clear the barrier.
M-me?
O-okay then. I suppose it's our best option at the moment. I'll give it a try. Ahem...

Through investigation, you realize that the key to unsealing Lorelei's domain is a "chorale." 
With encouragement from you and Zani, Phoebe gathers the courage and sings the melody. The song unlocks the sealed passage before you.
A song of false nature. Masking... A twisted view... Tear it to shreds...
Did you get the chorale wrong?
I'm sure I sang the "Aria of the Blessed Maiden"...
Not good... She doesn't seem too pleased with that one.
That flower... looks like the petals we found in Whisperwind Haven.
It's the Fractsidus. I've dealt with them before, and I've seen a flower just like this.
How long have I been in slumber... This nightmare... How long was I trapped in it?
Are you also part of the dream?
No, we are not... Might you be Lorelei?
I am. Travelers from afar, I sense… the kindness pulsing in your hearts. You must be the ones who broke the chains of my nightmare.
The oathbreakers, hiding behind their Masks of Madness… They tainted the Nimbus Sanctum with corrupted blooms, drowning me in rage and sorrow. Endless nightmares became my prison.
Masks of Madness... I recall those people at the entrance of the Atrium mentioned it.

Had you not freed me from my nightmare, I would never be able to fulfill the Sentinel's task… The tides of the Nimbus Sanctum would have engulfed the whole of Ragunna, just as they once claimed the sacred temple now lying in ruins beneath you.
Wait. The Sentinel? Does that mean...?
Yes, the Sentinel molded me from a mindless being to the form you see, and bestowed upon me the most precious gift... A soul.
They commanded me to restrain the clouds and prevent the Remnant Energy within it from... dissipating.
Can you contact Imperator? I need to meet with the Sentinel.

Unfortunately, it lies beyond my power. The Sentinel's link to the mortal realm is severed. Only through collective prayer, and a rite, at the height of the Carnevale, only then can mortals briefly commune with Them.
A rite... You mean the Carnevale?
No, that's impossible! The current Primus, Fenrico the Enlightened One, was given a direct oracle from the Sentinel. The Sentinel has always been with the people!
I'm afraid the Sentinel's current state... transcends mortal understanding. Your Primus is no exception.
Should doubt linger in your mind, I implore you to await the rite's completion. The Sentinel will surely answer the people's call—not your so-called… Enlightened One.
One last thing. Those oathbreakers wearing Masks of Madness you mentioned, do you know who they are?
All that I know is that they are not from Rinascita.
In the whispers between dreams, I heard them speak of their leader, a woman they called…
"—the Conductor."
Conductor...
It is time I return to my slumber. Their wicked acts have scarred the sea of clouds, and I must mend it… within my dreams.
The song shall guide you out of this domain. Farewell, visitors.

You defeat the "Queen of the Night," Lorelei's corrupted form under the Lycoris's influence, and restore her to her true self. Besides, you also find the Vitreum Dancer that fled away, but it is damaged while protecting you. Zani keeps it in the Montelli's Terminal.
Lorelei, a remnant creature enlightened by the Sentinel, reveals a shocking truth: the current Primus of the Order is not the legendary <ano=Sentinel's Resonator>Enlightened One</ano>. The Sentinel's link to the mortal world has been severed, and only the Laureate of the Carnevale gets a chance to communicate with Them. 
Lorelei also discloses the identity of the one causing Echoes to lose control—the Conductor.
What a wild turn this job's taken… Seeing the legendary Lorelei up close? Almost makes it worth the trouble.
Hmm? Are you all right, Phoebe?
Huh? I-I'm fine. I'm just… processing Lorelei's words. Forgive me, I… I need a moment to reflect.
In any case, we managed to stop their plot in time and found the missing Vitreum Dancer.
Speaking of that Vitreum Dancer… What brought it here? Lorelei's song, or maybe the Sentinel's guidance?
But those wearing the Masks of Madness... The Fractsidus, right? I'm curious about their role in all this. I think they supplied Gilberto with the flowers to turn Echoes into Tacet Discords.
Yeah, the Fractsidus is behind this.
Their actions remind me of something...
What's our next move, {PlayerName}?
We need more support.
You're right... Those snakes lurked in the shadows, using Gilberto as their fall guy. We can't expose them just by ourselves.
Oh, another thing. Since the Fractsidus is conspiring with the Fisalias, that makes them an enemy of the Montelli family.
There happens to be an auction at Averardo Vault today. The top members of the family will be there.
We should tip off the family about the Fractsidus' scheme. The Montellis can't afford to ignore this threat.
Agree.
What about you, Phoebe?
I intend to return to the Order first. While I believe Lorelei is truthful, I can't imagine the Primus would deceive our people. He is, after all, the <ano=Sentinel's Resonator>Enlightened One</ano>.
According to Lorelei, the Sentinel will deliver an oracle during the Carnevale. That's when the truth will come to light.
Speaking of which, are all Primuses called the <ano=Sentinel's Resonator>Enlightened One</ano>?
No, only Lord Fenrico has ever directly communicated with the Sentinel. Previous Primuses were merely indirect representatives, not the Enlightened One...
Silence and composure are gifts from the great Imperator. I'll keep today's events between us, locked away in my heart.
Then I believe this is where we part ways.
The Codex reminds us, "It is not the lighthouse that guides us through the storm to safety, but our own eyes fixed on the shore."
I'd like to offer these words to you—may your eyes always shine bright with clarity.

Shaken by Lorelei's revelations, Phoebe decides to return to the Order to seek answers and bids farewell to you.
With Lorelei's information, you are certain that Fractsidus is behind the chaos among Echoes.
You and Zani head to Averardo Vault, the heart of the Montelli family, to seek allies and repair the damaged Vitreum Dancer Echo.
Strange, did Gilberto just vanish into thin air?
I see. A <ano=Flying Echo>Wingray</ano>, that explains it.
Wingray?
Yes, it's a type of Echo that can fly. People in Ragunna often use them to travel quickly between locations.
If Gilberto set up this Wingray as an escape route, it should lead us straight to him.
Let's use the Grapple to hitch a ride on the Wingray.

Gilberto's traces end here. Zani speculates that he must have left using a <ano=Flying Echo>Wingray</ano>.
It seems Gilberto never anticipated that you two could also follow his lead and take the Wingray to where he was heading.
Quite the view isn't it, {PlayerName}?
Welcome to Whisperwind Haven—known for its iconic windmills and flower fields. Legend has it, this was once the home of the Blessed Maiden.
Some people are over there. Let's check if they know anything.
Lo! Foul monsters, taste my steel!
"The Blessed Maiden smote the fiends who dared ascend the hallowed stairs. Yet the Dark Tide surged on, as more monsters poured forth from the mist."
"In this fateful moment, the Blessed Maiden beheld her destiny's end. Moved by the Divinity, she chose to yield her life, for the Sentinel's cause and Rinascita's people."
O Imperator. Guide me!
Wait, wait. Your tone sounds a bit off. The Blessed Maiden should be more determined.
Determined? How about this then?
"In Imperator's name! Vile monsters! I swear your behinds shall be met with the end of my boots!"
I meant determined, not angry... You've got it all wrong!
Ah we meet again, valiant champion of the foreign land.
Our paths intertwine once more. Ha, a result of Imperator's divine intervention, don't you agree?
Hmm, pardon me, but this lady by your side seems rather familiar...?
I am Zani. I work at Averardo Bank.
Ah, yes. You look quite chivalrous, if I may say so. Yet with your weary face, I'm afraid I can only dub you the "Sorrowful Knight."
That's quite fitting. Do I thank you for that?
Ahh, no need for the formalities. Allow me to re-introduce myself. I am Cristoforo, a humble playwright grappling with modern trends. Delighted to meet you.
What are you doing here?
Actually, I've been working on a script about the Blessed Maiden lately. The well-known Martyred Maiden, Fleurdelys.
Her brave sacrifice during the Dark Tide saved Ragunna many years ago.
That sacred maiden perished just as the curtain fell, lying in the center of the sanctuary where spotlights converged. I've longed to capture that tragic scene in a play.
The script's nearly finished, but something's amiss. With Fleurdelys' home right here before me, I had hoped to find traces of the Blessed Maiden's early life.
Childhood plays a key role in shaping one's personality, you know.
So, did you find any?
Sadly, no, I confess I've made zero progress. Most legends of the Blessed Maiden are lost to time. I'm forced to rely on imagination…
Ahem, nevertheless, the script is finished. I've even asked the children over there to help me rehearse it.
Here, have a copy. I'm eager for your thoughts.
That's very generous of you.
I'll take a look when I have time.
Ahem...
Ah, apologies. I started rambling about my play again. Well, then. What brings you here?
We're looking for someone. Did you come across anyone from the Fisalia family?
The Fisalias… Come to think of it, I had noticed a nobly dressed gentleman around here recently... Yes, he bore their crest.
In fact, I even stared a bit. Old habits die hard. The Fisalias rarely venture beyond city walls, you see.
So Gilberto did pass through here... Thank you for the information, sir.
Speaking of that man... Word from the local villagers is that odd occurrences have plagued the area since his arrival.
Odd occurences?
You've likely noticed the abundance of Echoes here in Whisperwind Haven. One might say it's more their village than ours.
But since that nobleman's arrival, Echoes in the area have been vanishing without a trace.
Like time lost forever, books forgotten by people, and cherished memories faded away in time's current... Oh, pardon me. My playwright's pen is running away again.
Echoes disappearing? Sounds familiar.
We should look into it.
Hmm. Echoes started acting strangely when Gilberto showed up, just like what happened in the Carnevale rehearsal... This is no coincidence.
Mr. Cristoforo, do you know where those Echoes were last seen before they disappeared?
I'm in the dark as well. However, they might know a thing or two.

You run into Cristoforo, the mysterious playwright, again. He's on a journey for inspiration to finish his script about the Blessed Maiden, "Fleurdelys."

Suspecting a connection, you follow the Echoes to investigate further.

They wouldn't even hesitate to break their façade of neutrality, just to ensure we don't take the secrets out alive.
This seems to depict the people of Rinascita torn into two warring factions.
This one shows a man in Primus attire, wielding a lantern-shaped relic to dispel shadows and the monsters within.
The last one seems to depict the moment a girl communes with the Divinity of Rinascita.
The frequencies of these pieces have been reconstructed.
Now we only need to assemble them onto the stained glass. The last step to the secrets.
Teacher, the Seminary will soon be engulfed. What should we do?
We have to leave… but we can't go without the relic. We can't let it be lost to the sea of clouds.
The Seminary is but stone and tile. It can always be rebuilt. My days are numbered, but until my last breath, I will protect the sage's relic, no matter the cost.
...So, the relic... is a sword.
*Cough* If only... I'd known sooner...
Curse those monsters... curse the Dark Tide...
I... will carry on... Teacher's wish... to the very end.
The explorers have retrieved a sword from the sea of clouds, along with the remains of an Acolyte, likely one lost to the Dark Tide.
The sword appears to be an artifact passed down by our sages. Judging by its form, it seems crafted not for combat but for Carnevale rituals.
I suspect it may have once belonged to a Primus. Regrettably, all records of this sword were lost to the Dark Tide.
In honor of the Acolyte who once safeguarded this relic, we've decided to place it in a small chapel untouched by the sea of clouds.
The chapel stands beneath the cliffside, near the remnants of the broken bridge. It should be easy to find.
We've stored the relic in the bell tower, with the hope that future pilgrims will remember and honor its presence here.
Please proceed to the main entrance. A staff member will greet you there.
Everyone move! Follow the Averardo Vault Emergency Response Plan!
Prioritize the clients' safety! Stay calm and be professional!
You have bigger things to worry about. Just let me handle this.
This seems to depict the people of Rinascita torn into two warring factions.

This one seems to depict the moment a girl communes with the Divinity of Rinascita.

"From Their holy wounds... sprang the curse of Dark Tide..."
"Though the woes of Rinascita yet endure... the shattered Divinity hath chosen Their herald..."

"and Rinascita, under its glory... shall be a paradise free of suffering..."
It's the same Echo boat we were on earlier... Was it also attracted by Lorelei's singing?
*A gentle cry*
It's called Noah.
Noah... Well, I can't understand what it's saying, but it's a perfect timing. We can have it take us to Averardo Vault.
That's a really big waterfall... Is there no way up?
*An expressive cry*
Whoa, really? You can take us upstream?
*A cry of certainty*
Another waterfall. You sure about this, Noah?
*A confident cry*
Averardo Vault is just up ahead. It seems this is where we part ways, Noah.
*A cry of understanding*
I'm sure it can find its way back to the harbor. Don't worry. Now, we just need to follow this path to reach the vault. Let's go.
Welcome to Averardo Vault. Do you have an appointment?
My name is Zani. I'm an employee of the bank. Here's my ID.
(Present the family's invitation.)
Ah, this invitation… My apologies. Welcome to Averardo Vault. How may we assist you today?
We're not here on business. We've come to brief the family on the Echo incident from the recent Carnevale rehearsal.
I'll arrange that immediately. Please proceed to the main entrance. A staff member will greet you there.
These Echoes... Are they guarding the vault?
Yes. But I've never seen them in action before. The "Averardo Bank Employee Manual" says they can easily take out a whole squad of Resonators.
Of course, this doesn't apply to someone powerful like you, {PlayerName}. Still, their combat skills are formidable. Their mere presence is enough to make everyone feel safe.
This facility houses nearly half of Rinascita's wealth. It serves all of Ragunna's citizens, even including the Fisalias.
Despite our feud, no one in Ragunna can refuse the services of Averardo Vault.
What the... I thought they only responded to hostility!
Steady now. Don't move. It's on high alert but won't attack unless provoked. At least, that's what the Employee Manual says!
Stand down.
I apologize for the small mishap on behalf of the Montelli Family. And...
What a pleasant surprise to see you again so soon.
And you.
Yet your expression betrays no surprise, {PlayerName}.
Allow me to properly introduce myself. My name is Carlotta, Carlotta Montelli.
Montelli… You are the…
The second daughter of the Montelli Family, yes. Please feel free to call me Carlotta.
Also, I trust the renumeration meets your satisfaction, Ms. Zani?
It was you who tasked me with receiving {PlayerName}?
Surely a distinguished guest such as {PlayerName} deserves the attention of our most trusted employee.
I'm aware of your purpose here. On behalf of my family, allow me to extend our deepest gratitude for your endeavors.
Your eyes show curiosity about me and my role in this… drama. However, this isn't the place for such discussions. Please follow me.

You are stopped by Echo guards at the outer part of Averardo Vault. Just as tensions rise, the noble lady you met before shows up, commanding the guards to stand down. 
She formally introduces herself as Carlotta Montelli, the second daughter of Montelli.
Please accept my apologies, {PlayerName}, for withholding my true identity before.
Rinascita's affairs have grown… intricate. The Fisalia family, the Order of the Deep…
You've likely noticed that many desire the Carnevale to fail. We Montellis, having tied our future to its success, became their target.
…But, let's not dwell on that for now.
Here we are. Welcome to Averardo Vault—the Montellis' heart and glory.
Ms. Zani, do you mind handling the cleanup? I'm sorry. I just promised you a vacation... but looks like it will have to wait.
Oh it's fine. Just a bit of extra work. I can't stand by and watch my colleagues getting hurt.
Besides, you have bigger things to worry about. Just let me handle this.
We can always count on you, Zani.
Be sure to get that overtime pay.
Yeah, yeah… That's the burden of being good at my job.
There's more to this attack than it seems.
The Order must have been behind it, right?
Yes. At this juncture, neither the Fractsidus nor the Fisalias have any reason to interfere. It's some hidden truth about the Order the Sentinel is leading us towards.
The traitors must be watching us, knowing truth is on the verge of revelation.
I have a feeling that whatever's coming next… will not be easy.

After defeating the Echo guard, Carlotta asks Zani to handle the cleanup.
You both head quickly to the tower ruins.
A Wingray. Let's hitch a ride, shall we?
We're nearly there. That's the tower ruins, our destination.
This is where my family first found the Vitreum Dancer.
What do you see in the shattered stained glass?
It seems to be telling a story.
Is there a way to piece them together?
This seems to chronicle a legend of the Sentinel and the tale of how the first Primus founded the Order.
I've learned of this history before but many details have faded over time.
How do you know all this?
Well, art investment is one of our family's key ventures, so I've naturally picked up a thing or two along the way.
There is a stone tablet over there. It might offer some clues about these stained glass images.

Arriving at the tower ruins, you find shattered stained glass telling the Sentinel's legend and the Order's founding by the first Primus. 
An ancient stone tablet stands nearby, waiting to be deciphered.
This ancient stone tablet bears inscriptions in the ancient Rinascita language.

…On this day shall I depart. Though the woes of Rinascita yet endure, the shattered Divinity hath chosen Their herald.
…On the grandest of days, the maiden, crowned with golden laurel, shall commune with the Divinity. Thus she becomes the prophesied "Enlightened One," through whom Rinascita's woes shall end.
It seems to be some sort of prophecy… We might have to piece together the clues from both the stone tablet and the stained glass to unravel the secrets.
These ancient relics that spawn Tacet Discords often carry special frequencies—likely the key to restoring them.
Let's use the Terminal's Sensor to reconstruct their frequencies and align them with the tablet's inscriptions.

Carlotta successfully deciphers the prophecy inscribed on the stone tablet. 
To fully understand it, you may need to piece together the information from the tablet and the stained glass.
It's done. Now let's see…
Looks like these stained glass images recount a tale about the Divinity. Wait...
What is it?
It's just... the content is rather peculiar. I'll translate it for you.

You restore the frequencies of the stained glass using your Sensor. 
With that, Carlotta tells you a legend about Rinascita's divinity.

Rinascita has two divinities? I've never heard of such a thing.

There's only one explanation. These are not fabrications but buried truth.
If this is indeed the Order's doing... we must leave here immediately.

Watch out!
They surely know when to show up.
They've found us.
You go first. I'll cover you.
…Interesting, they're here even faster than I anticipated.

Carlotta is stunned by the revelation: the legend speaks of two divinities in Rinascita, with the Enlightened One depicted as a young girl—a sharp contrast to the Order's teachings. She suspects the Order destroyed these ruins to conceal this truth. She hints that another secret lies on a northern island, but before she can elaborate, the Order's pursuers arrive.
Keep it safe. I'll handle the rest.
Speak, who gave you the order?
Look at what you have done, distorting history, usurping the Sentinel's authority, and... colluding with wretches.
Who are your accomplices? The Fractsidus, the Fisalias, and even some of the Montellis, am I right?

So this is how you treat those truth-seekers? Banish them in the name of pilgrimage?
—Please, lower your weapon. There is still room for discussion, is there not, Miss Carlotta?
Carlotta swiftly defeats the pursuers and tries to pry out more information, but Priest Alessio soon arrives with reinforcements.
Stand down. Enough blood has been shed today. Imperator would not revel in senseless sacrifice.
And the Pilgrim's Sail is for the transgressors to seek rebirth, not for you to threaten our friends. Repent for your reckless words.
…Forgive me, Brother Alessio.
Ah, honored guest. You have been misinformed, as the truth is not what it seems. My lord Fenrico has arranged your audience with the Sentinel.
Why not hear the Sentinel's wisdom for yourself?
Of course, if Lord Fenrico is the true "Enlightened One."

However, the prophecy speaks of a maiden as the "Enlightened One." Is that why you destroyed the stained glass? To pass Fenrico off as the Enlightened One? So he can seize the Sentinel's power and rule Ragunna?
Oh, you stubborn people of little faith. You've surely been tempted by evil and swallowed its lies. Lord Fenrico is the undeniable Enlightened One and will guide us all.
Well, I see no point in debating doctrine with you. Let's move on to a more concrete subject. Now, Miss Carlotta, which one do you think is more important to the Montelli family?
Is it "Profit"…
…or "Bloodline"?

…My actions? What do you want me to do?

…Carlotta?

Time to go. The Order's rep is waiting for us.

Let's hope this Ash isn't after the "secret cache."

Not even a single Shell Credit can be taken, let alone any of the vault's artifacts and collections.
Amazing, but we've got work to do.
Let's head up to the monitoring room on the top level and check if the old lady we saw in the surveillance footage is "Ash."
Some of the defense systems have been activated. We should tread carefully from here on out.
Zani mentions rumors about a "secret cache" inside the Averardo Vault and suspects it's what the thief is after.
How beautiful... but why was it covered?
Really? You don't know this painting?
Isn't it just a landscape?
Be my witness, {PlayerName}—what I'm about to say is purely to satisfy our Acolyte's curiosity. No hidden agenda.
Why the sudden suspense?
Alright.
What's so special about this painting?

This piece, titled "Ballad Beneath the Stars," may appear simple at first—just a shepherd tending his flock under a vast sky. However, the pattern on the shepherd's clothes resembles the Order's emblem, only flipped upside down, and the number of stars matches the recorded blessings bestowed by our Sentinel Imperator.

What's more, the number of sheep is the same as the Sentinel's wings. Given that some fanatics claim the Sentinel's divine messages are fabrications, when you connect the dots, doesn't it seem like this shepherd is hinting at something?
Uh... What?
According my interpretation of the Codex, I don't see how this painting implies anything untoward.
Maybe not to you or some of your fellow Acolytes, and certainly not to the Montellis or the painter. But there are others who don't share that view and their voices are often the loudest.
That's why this painting is covered—to avoid stirring up trouble.
Very prudent, but it's still a shame people can't admire its beauty anymore.
What about the risk of people slandering the Order? Doesn't that bother you?
Just like some will appreciate a piece of art, others will hate or misinterpret it. The same goes for the Order.
People's views are shaped by their backgrounds and experiences. What's precious to one might be another's poison.
Everyone is entitled to their opinion. As long as they genuinely believe it, I don't see a problem.
Locking this painting away is perhaps the best option for now, but I believe it will eventually return to where it belongs, for everyone to see.
If more people thought like you, we'd see a lot less trouble in the world.
There's a covered vase here. What's the story behind this one?
Beautiful or ugly, what do you say?
Beautiful.
Ugly.
