Your support means much to us. May your path be safe and battles triumphant.
...I wonder what's happening with the Dark Tide. I should check in with Augusta and Iuno.
Hmm? {PlayerName}, the Dark Tide hasn't stabilized yet. Don't go pacing holes into the ground, I'll let you know the moment something changes.
It looks like tracking the Dark Tide is not for the faint of heart...
I thought Septimont's Central Hub can monitor the Dark Tide...?
It's really about searching for certainty within the uncertainty of Chaos. The Priestesses, myself included, have long made a habit of that.
It can. But many Resonance Beacons were destroyed during the last Tidespawn assault. The data is riddled with noise.
Besides, the Priestesses, myself included, have made a habit of chasing certainty in the uncertainty of Chaos.
We're more attuned to the Dark Tide's rhythm than any device. So the burden of watching it… naturally falls to us.
But you, you of all people... you're the one who insists on doing everything yourself...
Take these materials. Have the blacksmiths at camp forge you something worthy of your hand.
Let it serve as a reminder. No matter how far into the dark you go, we are still with you. Don't forget.
Iuno. Status report.
The frequency is stabilizing. If you're going in, this is your best window.
Remember that stretch of Chaos we once crossed?
If Leviathan has shaped this world through the Dark Tide… expect something similar. Shifting sands, obscuring fog. Every step, a gamble into the unknown.
That Discord Slayer, Galbrena, was it? She's bound to the Dark Tide. If she dared to hunt the Threnodian, she must know how to navigate its depths.
Once inside, find her existence in the Chaos. Reunite with her. She'll guide you forward.
So this time, I need to Anchor to her.
What exactly does that mean? What do I do?
You catch on quickly. I believe you know what to do.
Don't tell me you forgot already? It's about the Anchoring! You've done it before.
Immerse yourself in her rhythm. Feel it. Understand it. Find a trace of her within the chaotic frequencies. And when you find her... don't let her go.
{PlayerName}... Keep your wits about you once you're inside the Dark Tide.
Don't worry! I'll stick with {Male=him;Female=her} every step of the way!
Then I'm counting on you, Abby.
You should rest while you can, Abby.
Just remember, you're not going in alone, {PlayerName}. When the time comes, we will be right behind you.
Don't worry. I've faced worse.
I believe in all of you, as you believe in me.
If you're ready. Step forward.
I'm more than ready.
I need more time.
May the eternal sun light your path. And may each step bring you closer to victory.

The Dark Tide has stabilized. Now is the time to strike.

Before you depart, Iuno advises anchoring to Galbrena once inside. If she dares to hunt the Threnodian, then surely she knows how to navigate the Dark Tide.

With preparations complete, you and Abby leap into the Dark Tide together.
Tidespawn, dead ahead! Let's cut 'em down in one clean sweep!
Hah! It's always a blast fighting beside you, my fellow warrior!
Another horde inbound. They're not letting up.
They're heading straight for the Anchor Obelisks!
We will stop them.
...Is it just me, or have they slowed down a little?
Your Excellency! They're targeting the remaining Anchor Obelisks now!
But the Gladiators guarding them... They haven't recovered from the last wave…
Leave them to me.
Good. We'll split up and reinforce the rest. Stay sharp.
Yes, we saw it. The Anchor Stone has been activated. Sooner than expected...
Ground defenses are holding and no major fluctuations in the Dark Tide for now...
Wait... An intense frequency suddenly... It's moving toward the western front!
...Is this the best the mighty Gladiators of Septimont can offer?
A grand finale deserves grandeur! How can such a dull act satisfy the audience?
Hahaha! Yes! Now this is a scene fit for the final act!
Blades do not discriminate. Leave. This one's mine.
Oh? Has Huanglong fallen so low, they now send a blind man to die?
Prisoner Scar of Jinzhou. Surrender now. One strike is all it would take to end you. Surrender, and you may be spared pain.
In an epic play such as this, I refuse an early exit.
My orders were to bring you back. Dead or alive.
I never planned on bringing you back alive.
Your head belongs to me.
My family's potions are ready, but please, a word...
It's been crafted from the <ano=frequency>Threnodian's venom</ano>. Outside the corruption's reach, it induces hallucinations—warping your senses and clouding judgment.
Everyone...
If you aren't immediately entering the Dark Tide, I advise you all not to drink it.

You and Galbrena activate the Anchor Stone within the Dark Tide, sending a signal to your companions in the real world.

With the defenses at the Three Heroes' Crest holding steady, Augusta and the others prepare to drink the "antidote" and follow after you. But just then, Iuno senses a powerful frequency moving toward the western front. Scar appears, shattering the Gladiators' defenses in an instant.

Just as all seems lost, Scar's assault is intercepted by Qiuyuan's blade. The very man Qiuyuan was hunting turns out to be none other than this Fractsidus Overseer.
You're too late, defender of Huanglong.
Beneath the Dark Tide, It stirs once more...
ALL HOPE WILL BE SWEPT AWAY!
You talk too much.
All this time... Your eyes fixed on the tide...
Never once did you see the threat in the sky...
Annihilation, right on time!
{PlayerName}, how is the situation there?
Just cleaned them up.
We've cleared our sector too. Regrouping now.
More Tidespawn at the southwest basepoint!
Ugh. Trying to wear us down one flank at a time, huh?
They're closing in on the Obelisks on our side!
Wait... something's off. They're striking at weak spots in the formation... Since when did they fight with strategy?
Leviathan. It's directing them. It saw we were spread too thin and scattered their assault on purpose.
T-the north flank... Hold the Obelisks at all costs!
If I release this attack... the whole Obelisk array may fall.
It's testing me. Seeing if I'll trade lives for victory...
It's driving us into a corner.
If only we had more fighters...
We can't be everywhere all at once…

The Dark Tide's assault is relentless, targeting the weakest links of the Obelisk array. You and your companions cannot cover every front, and the situation grows dire...

Then, several familiar teleportation circles light up. The voices of your companions from Ragunna ring across the battlefield, and Galbrena arrives as well. They've come to reinforce the other fronts, helping the warriors reclaim the Anchor Obelisks.

Heroes from distant lands reunite here to face the crisis together. You take heart, and steel yourself for the battle still ahead...
—So! This is where we're needed, right? Time to help reclaim those Obelisks!
The north flank's ours! Let's give 'em a grand show!
The Montellis greet you. We will secure this side.
The poison Leviathan leaves behind... Allow the Fisalias to cleanse it.
Whew, made it this time! I've got this side covered!
By the name of Imperator! We'll protect the Obelisks here!
How are you all here?
That teleportation circle...
Let's deal with the mess first! Plenty of time to catch up after!
One Obelisk remains on the northeast...
I'll take that one.
You have my thanks, heroes from afar. May your names be etched in eternity!
This battle is not over yet. Let's end this, together!
I never thought I'd see the day... fighting side by side with the Order of the Deep.
...Onward, comrades! We're not about to shame Septimont now!
I've heard of the Montellis' "Sentry Constructs," but seeing that kind of firepower up close is something else...
That "poison"… it healed me? Maybe the Fisalias aren't as monstrous as they say…
S-she's absorbing the Tidespawn?! What kind of power is that?!
This calamity… ends here. For good.
The Threnodian's creatures have been defeated. They never broke through our defenses. With the Dark Tide now receding, it seems that all is resolved.
Now that you have returned safely, I'll continue with my mission.
Scar from the Fractsidus... Did he escape again?
Unfortunately, yes. I see you didn't catch the mastermind either.
That Cristoforo got away… But don't worry, I will hunt him down.
That Fractsidus... The calamity has passed, but our city-states are weakened. We must rebuild. Recover. We cannot join this hunt.
Survivors deserve more attention than criminals who deserve to die.
Rest assured, we're not forgetting this transgression.
That Primus got what he wanted. He fulfilled the fate he desired for Rinascita.
Thank you.
I only played a small part. It was the courage of these warriors that truly held the line.

Together with your companions, you defeat Leviathan. The Gem is devoured and sealed within Galbrena. With the will of Fenrico and all the past Primuses carried in the Lantern of Napoli the Second, you return safely from the Dark Tide, dispersing it once and for all. The Paradise collapses, the endless night fades, and at last, dawn breaks over Rinascita.

Atop the Three Heroes' Crest, Qiuyuan bids you farewell. While you ventured deep into the Dark Tide, he kept his promise and held the line with Septimont's Gladiators. Now, his journey must continue.

With her soul returned to her body, Cartethyia is revived. Through a voice in the sky, she promises to meet you again in Ragunna. You part ways with your companions from Septimont. Both city-states must now rebuild in their own way. But now, each day to come holds more hope than the last.
Thank you... heroes of Rinascita...
Is that Cartethyia's voice?
Hey—Cartethyia! You're welcome!
How do you feel, Cartethyia?
Oh, I'm back to myself now. Let's meet in Ragunna City, {PlayerName}.
Defeating Leviathan was just the start of Rinascita's "new era." There is plenty of cleanup work ahead for everyone.
Each day to come holds more hope than the last.
Septimont will have many matters demanding our attention. Ragunna will be no different.
Leave Septimont to us. Ragunna's problems... Well, they're looking a lot more complicated than ours.
Once everything is settled, will you come home to Septimont City?
I will.
We will meet again, heroes.
Phoebe?
Ahh?!
Is everything alright? You looked like you were somewhere else just now.
Oh... I was just thinking how the Blessed Maiden's voice sounded just like the heavenly voice during the Carnevale...
So I was wondering... about the Sentinel's messages we heard before... Was it... Do you think Their advice... "Consume healthy food, such as the Laurus Salad..."
Yup, that was her.
That's... a long story...
Huh?
(This calamity has passed, but now Ragunna must face a harsh truth. Primus Fenrico gave his life to stop the Dark Tide, and the Sentinel is gone.)
(For the Ragunnesi, what fills their hearts now… is likely sorrow and uncertainty.)
(But at the same time...)
Lady Carlotta, we've finished tallying all our losses. Here's the full report for your review.
Thank you. Secure all salvageable relief supplies first. The remaining personnel should assist the Fisalias in treating the wounded.
Rosemary has already dispersed the family's medicine in mist form. Thanks to that, treatment has been smoother than expected. The injured will be tended to shortly.
Repairs on the Genesis Nexus are still underway, but some damaged Common Echoes are already operational again.
Leave the residual Dark Tide frequencies to me.
Alright, crew! Come lend a hand!
Pero's got a whole mountain of tools over here... Like this rapid adhesive gun!
If you're having trouble restoring the damaged buildings, Mr. Fulmine and I can help using our Fortes!
If Imperator were here, They'd be happy to see this...

You return to Ragunna City with your companions. In the aftermath of battle, the Ragunnesi have come to learn that Primus Fenrico gave his life to disperse the Dark Tide, and Sentinel Imperator is gone as well. Though grief and uncertainty are still fresh, many are already taking the first steps to rebuild their future.

Cartethyia arrives at your side, just as she promised. Together, you recall Imperator's words: The path of civilization is never fixed. It shifts with the needs of the present. And that's up to the people of a civilization to decide.

You turn to Phoebe, still caught in quiet confusion, and give her the Civilization Capsule, the Relic Imperator left behind. She quickly understands what you are entrusting to her.

Now, Cartethyia and Phoebe both step forward to help rebuild Ragunna. Naturally, how could you not be part of it too?

Imperator once said: "Let the winds of the past depart. The ships of this new era no longer need their guidance. No longer shall scroll and prophecy bind, but by humanity's will shall a new era be forged."
We made it... Cartethyia...
I've now truly returned from the "dead."
B-blessed Maiden!
Please, just call me Cartethyia. Rinascita's Divinity is no more, and with it, the "Blessed Maiden chosen by the Divine."
Phoebe, your faith in the Sentinel has never wavered, nor has it been blind. It stems not from obedience, but from a deep belief in Their deeds and ideals.
Imperator once led the displaced to these isles, yet what allowed the Ragunnesi to stand firm upon the sea was not Divine favor, but their own efforts.
The statue in the city was built in Their likeness, but it was the people who gave shape to the faith it stands for.
Faith once united us. It was also what drove us to seek liberation… The path of civilization is never fixed. It shifts with what's being demanded at present.
And it's the people of a civilization who decide what they demand.
...As it was in the beginning, and ever shall be.
Everyone has their tasks to do now... But in the future...
I want you to have this, Phoebe.
Imperator entrusted me with this relic. Within it is Rinascita's past, and... its future.
Rinascita's future...
Eh... but it's empty. Where is the recorded future?
The future... is already in your hands.
...I see. Thank you, {PlayerName}!
From now on, perhaps I no longer need to hide who I really am.
So... I'll join in rebuilding Ragunna too!
Sign me up.
Everything's nearly wrapped up on my end, First Mate!
Good work, Brant. And thank you, everyone.
Oh, by the way, while we were deep in the Dark Tide, I caught sight of an old brewing recipe.
It dates all the way back to when Rinascita was founded. The brew was called Rebirth.

Back then, people were fighting the sea just like we are now. They built seawalls, linked the scattered isles… It was only through countless sacrifices that they finally held their ground on this archipelago.
Hmm... what would Rebirth taste like...
Piqued the First Mate's curiosity, eh? Well, I got my hands on Pero's magic tools and gave it a try myself!
Pero, Pero!
But you're a bit too young for this, Roccia. The crew and I will handle the taste test!
Hmm... It's bitter, and sweet...
As for the meaning it holds... well...
To the fallen, and to tomorrow!
To the fallen, and to tomorrow!
Disaster recovery in Ragunna City is nearly complete. Thank you so much for your help, {PlayerName}.
You're welcome. By the way, Phoebe, have you seen Galbrena?
Miss Galbrena? When she finished up here, I think I saw her heading to Margherita's Restaurant...
Hello, I'll have one Forte-astic Fizz & Freeze gelato. Extra large. Thanks.
...Seriously, what kind of name is that?
Can't believe you actually said it out loud.
They say if you mix mint, Viscum Berries, Mastic Nuvola, and cream in just the right proportion, you get a gelato that's not only packed with flavor, but sharp and cool enough to clear your head.
Oh, and the ad said if you say the name in one go, you get 30% off.
Okay... But how are you feeling with "that thing" in you? We've wrapped everything up here. Best we get to the Black Shores soon.
Everything's fine, Chimera's keeping it stable. Nothing to worry about for now.
Though ever since I absorbed that essence, Chimera has been grumbling nonstop about craving something cold...
Well I said nothing.
You're talking about yourself, right?
Chimera leaving you out to dry, eh？
Hey, I'm human too, you know. I'm allowed to want good food. Ugh... never mind, let's go.
Wait.
Abby, time to dig in!
Mmm—I've been dying for this!
Miss Margherita, one extra large Forte-astic Fizz & Freeze gelato, please. Thank you.
Right away! You helped Rinascita through its darkest hour. Now it's my turn to make sure our heroes eat and drink like royalty!
Here you go! Double the scoop, on the house! Unlimited refills!
I can't manage this on my own. Want to split it?
Wow. Something even you can't handle?
"You don't have to carry it all yourself. Sometimes, it's okay to lean on someone else." Wasn't that your line?
So, one side each?

Some time later, Ragunna City's reconstruction is nearly complete. You stop by Margherita's Restaurant to find Galbrena, ready to depart with her for the Black Shores to extract the Threnodian's Gem.

But she seems fascinated by the restaurant's new gelato special. Naturally, you don't want to spoil her good mood. Besides, it is about time you kept that promise—to treat Abby to a well-earned feast.

Still, even Galbrena seems a little daunted when Margherita brings out the extra-large serving. With a familiar smirk, she turns to you and makes an offer you have heard before: "So, one side each?"
Though Death may boast you fade in shade, in deathless verse your name is laid.
While lungs still breathe and eyes still shine, this poem, and you, shall stand through time.
One wish fulfilled... Alright, time to head to the Black Shores.
Yes, their ship should have docked by now.
He's the leader of the Ghost Hounds. Strong, ruthless, not someone to cross lightly. I teamed up with him once while hunting in the New Federation.
He tried to recruit me, but I'm used to working alone, so I turned him down.
They've got quite the network. I got that lamp Terminal through their channels.
He seems intimidating, but... I think he's alright. He did join the fight to protect Rinascita, after all.
If you ever find yourself in the New Federation, you'll probably get to know him better.
Ahhh, finally full... Hic... I think it's time for a nap.

After the meal, you and Galbrena head toward the harbor. You spot Calcharo, who aided Ragunna in the battle, waving from afar. 

Galbrena mentions she once worked briefly with him back in the New Federation, and that, surprisingly, he's not all that hard to get along with. If you ever find yourself in the New Federation, you will probably have the chance to become better acquainted.
That man...
Calcharo?
It's been a long time since I last sat down with the Order's doctrines… I didn't expect this many changes while I was "gone."
The Codex has been revised several times over the past decade…
Wait, "Flying Ragunnesi" was banned? That play is a masterpiece! And civilians aren't allowed to perform at the Carnevale anymore?
...Such harsh decrees should all be struck down!
O-okay, I've noted it down. Actually, I think this one should go too…
And this—"Acolytes must avoid close contact with Common Echoes"? That's beyond absurd!
There are… hundreds more like it.
Hundreds?! Most of these had to be written under Leviathan's influence. Even sealed away, It refuses to leave us in peace...
I'll call the Order together soon to carefully review these matters. Oh, right... Who sits on the Council of Ten now?
Council of Ten was disbanded years ago. After that, all decisions went straight to Primus Fenrico.
Fenrico… in the end, he broke free of the Threnodian's control and found his own redemption.
Looks like we'll have to move up the election for Primus…
Are you considering running, Cartethyia?
Given my current position, I don't think I am suited for that role.
Honestly, I've never had the patience for civic duties. There are certainly others better qualified within the Order.
But I will do everything in my power to correct the Order's past mistakes.
Now that I no longer need to hide, it's time I shoulder greater responsibility.
Lady Carlotta, we still face a significant shortage of supplies. The Black Shores have met some urgent demands, but moving forward…
In the future, we must rely on ourselves. It seems prudent to begin sourcing from elsewhere. The pace of our transport ship construction cannot falter.
The Echo ships are still undergoing repairs. The family's shipyard is also operating beyond capacity and cannot free up berths for new ships anytime soon...
Perhaps the lower decks of Porto-Veno Castle could alleviate this issue.
I have heard the Fisalias first secured their standing through deep-sea fishing…
Quite right. That was once the family's shipyard, though long idle due to certain historical circumstances. If needed, we can grant the Montellis access.
Well then, Lady Cantarella. What are your terms...?
As expected, your insight is as sharp as ever, Miss Carlotta. Terms… naturally, there are some.
The family has an ancient blueprint for a ship. I wish to see it brought to life with your expertise.
Once completed, it may serve your transport needs. It was once the "ark" carrying our ancestors from disasters. Now, I hope... it will carry the future.
That's truly… an offer one can hardly refuse. In that case, we will cover the funding and materials needed for construction.
But I believe the final ownership of this "ark" should remain with the Fisalia family.
Heh... so be it. We will also supply the requisite personnel.
The Fisalias are all eager to witness a "vessel of the old era" be reborn with our own eyes.
By the way, we have a list of medicinal herbs we wish to purchase…
Just send me the list, and I will see to it.
Very well... I look forward to our cooperation, Head of the Fisalias.
A pleasant one, to be sure... Montelli's newly anointed leader.
Well now, {PlayerName}… looks like Rinascita's been tied up with a neat little bow.

The other Bloombearers have already headed back to rest. They burned through every drop of strength out there. Once we've handed off the Threnodian's Gem to Tethys... I might even allow myself a few hours of real sleep!
Thank you all.
If it weren't for the Black Shores, we'd have been completely ensnared by Leviathan's schemes. On behalf of the people of Rinascita, please accept our deepest gratitude.
This is what the Black Shores does. We're just glad we earned our keep.
This might be the first real conversation we've had since everything ended. Thank you very much, Galbrena.
And really, I couldn't have done all this alone. Everyone played their part.
Still, if you hadn't come to "kill" me, we never could've pulled it off.
Honestly, pulling off a fake assassination in front of two powerful Resonators, without flinching or getting caught... Yes, not exactly a walk in the park.
Luckily, with a clear target, there's always a way to make the shot land. I didn't need to take you on, just sell the scene. "Blessed Maiden, down in one." Easy enough.
You're a real professional.
Promise me you two won't pull that kind of stunt again, okay?
What? No praise for my performance? I was planning to use this whole affair as a play for next year's Carnevale...
Well, we had to make it convincing, didn't we? Looks like I've still got it. Hmm… perhaps it could be a play in the next Carnevale...
Would you like to join us, Galbrena?
The Sentinel once said They didn't want the people to mourn Their passing with sorrow. What They truly wished to hear were songs and laughter.
We'll be inviting our friends from Septimont, too. I do hope you'll all come, including you, {PlayerName}.
Hooray! Carnevale!
I'm ready to wear that mask again.
I'll win the Laurel again.
Then it's settled! If you dare skip it, I'll drag you there myself!
It's a shame I'm not able to absorb the Threnodian's Gem, not in my current state.
It would throw your power completely out of balance. Better to leave it with me.

At Ragunna's harbor, a Black Shores vessel awaits. Cartethyia and the others arrive as well, offering thanks for the aid Galbrena and the Black Shores have given.

Soon, the time for departure comes. Your friends from Ragunna gather to send you off, and even your companions from Septimont arrive on Griffrexes to bid their farewells. Cetus the Tidebreaker rises from the sea to escort your ship. A wave of memories rises with you. Precious memories you will never forget.

To meet and to part, that is the rhythm of life. All that remains to say is: "Till we meet again."
But for now… it looks like it's time for goodbyes. At least for now.

The Order will soon elect a new Primus. From now on, Ragunna's affairs will no longer be decided by the Order alone. Instead, the Montelli and Fisalia families will help to guide decisions, together with the voice of the people.
We will begin addressing the wrongs the Order has committed. Ragunna's future belongs in the hands of its people. It will be led by their shared will.
Our family will also continue expanding Rinascita's overseas trade routes. Perhaps one day, we'll cross paths again in a distant land.
And should you ever return to Rinascita, know this. You will always be our most honored guest and dearest friend.
Not just us, but these little Echoes too. We'll hold this bond close, always.
If you ever visit any fascinating places, promise you'll tell me all about it! I'll turn your adventures into verse and have them sung across Rinascita.
{PlayerName}, remember not to overdo it. Eat when you're supposed to, and don't forget... Life is meant to be enjoyed.

To meet and to part... is a part of life. So please, accept this blessing I offer in my own name: May your eyes always shine bright with clarity, and may love and light guide you on every step of your journey.
This wide, free world has always been your stage. Wherever you go, I believe you'll always shine as its brightest star.
Aha! See, Augusta? Told you we'd make it in time!
Iuno… you…
Septimont's mess is mostly sorted now. The Senate can deal with the rest. We don't do rushed goodbyes around here. No matter how far, we had to come send you off.
You, my fellow warrior, are someone worth chasing. Yes, we've been chasing victory all along, but with you, it feels like victory itself was itching to catch up.
Next time we meet, you'll be even stronger, as will I. I'll be a Gladiator who can stand toe-to-toe with you!
Your strength comes from deep in your heart, unshakable and selfless. It shines above Septimont and reminds everyone what being a hero truly means.
Fighting by your side has been an honor. By the eternal blazing sun, your name will be remembered in Septimont forever.
This world will never forget what you've done for us, {PlayerName}.
And don't go forgetting us either, got it?! We're throwing a huge celebration in Septimont for this victory, and the Ragunnesi will be there too. So you'd better show up!
Woooooo—
It's Cetus The Tidebreaker! Are you here to see our {PlayerName} off too? Haha, I remember the moment we met {Male=him;Female=her} like it was yesterday.
Maybe it's more than just a farewell. I think the Tidebreaker wants to escort you on your journey.
We'll meet again. I'm sure of it.
I'll never forget the memories we've shared.
So… till we meet again.
Till we meet again, {PlayerName}!
How's everything going?
Good news and bad.
The Threnodian's Gem has been successfully contained. Tethys is already running a full-power analysis as we speak.
However... the Gem we've recovered was incomplete.
What the—... the Fractsidus again?
Could we have damaged it by accident…?
Could Chimera have eaten a part of it?

We're still investigating the cause. But look, successfully containing a Gem infused with the Threnodian's power? No small feat. It's already a huge step forward in our fight against the Threnodian and the Lament.
Rinascita… the Land of Echoes... If Tacet Discords can be manually converted into Echoes and become tools to fight the Lament…
Then maybe the Threnodian might also be something we could transform. Heck, maybe even utilize.
But that's all theorizing best kept to caffeinated hours. For now, we'll need to wait until Tethys completes its analysis before drawing any conclusions.
Well, I'm glad it helped. I'll be on my way then.
Hey, {PlayerName}… She's got real skill. Moves like she's already part of our rhythm. This kind of synergy doesn't come knocking twice. What do you say…?
Everyone in the Black Shores has made it their mission to stand against the Lament. Our goals are the same, and we've been walking the same path from the start.
I know you're not the type who likes being tied down by titles. But just remember this... You're not fighting it alone. So...
Take your time to consider this offer.
Just think of this as a keepsake.
This flower marks you as one of us. Whether you join us or not, if you ever run into trouble out there, the Black Shores will have your back.
I see… I'll take it then.
Oh, one more thing. My last Terminal gave out after I… "used" it too much. Think the Black Shores could lend me a new one?
You heard her, Aalto.
So, does that mean you're joining us?
If you want it, then you'll have to take it.
"Lend"? Please. You break it, you come get a new one.
Sure thing! Now, I better head to the Greenhouse. Gotta reserve a plot for our new "Sprout."
Oh, come on, {PlayerName}! Just give the lady what she wants!
Thanks. Well then… till next time.
Did you forget that promise we made?
You still haven't told me your real name.
...Angel. That's my real name.
Angel... Such a beautiful name... Hm? Hold on a sec! You're not planning to jump into the sea, are you? I could get you a boat—!
That would be the least of her concerns.
That's how she is. Let her be.
Your boat is... well, not very durable.
Don't worry about her. Nothing's stopping that one. No storm, and no raging sea.
If the Threnodian is truly bound to civilization, who's to say another one won't return to Rinascita in some new form…
Still, even if that happens, It won't be reclaiming this piece of Its power. That gives us a window to prepare.

The extraction of the Threnodian's Gem is a success, though Aalto reveals that the recovered Gem is incomplete, and the Black Shores will continue investigating the cause. Still, to contain even one Gem infused with the Threnodian's power is already a huge step forward in the fight against the Threnodian and the Lament.

With the matter concluded, Galbrena prepares to leave. Aalto suggests that the Black Shores could always use more hands.

You invite Galbrena to join the Black Shores. Though you don't expect to tie down a free spirit like the Discord Slayer, she accepts your offer. She pins the Blake Bloom to her chest and fulfills her promise to tell you her true name: Angel.

She spreads her wings, and you let her go. You believe neither storm nor sea could stop her. One day, you will meet again.

As you watch Galbrena vanish into the skies, the paper crane that was once Avidius slips from you, rising gently into the high heavens...
Yawn... You do love to make a person wait, don't you?
Still, breaking me out right under Mingting's nose without setting off a single alarm... Delicious. Tell me, how did you come up with that little idea?
Let's just say it was inspired by the Somnoire. Imagination, after all, remains humanity's sharpest blade.
As the Dark Tide spread and I was pulled in deeper, the mark of the Dark Tide you left in me allowed my frequency to merge with it...
Of course. And through Leviathan's power, I was able to "read" that frequency and "depict" you back into reality.
Leviathan's power of assimilation blurs the line between imagination and existence, turning fiction into fact.
But of course, none of it would have worked until Leviathan slipped the Sentinel's leash and reclaimed the reins of the Dark Tide.
It cost more time than I'd have liked, but everything unfolded exactly as you scripted. Such precision. Such devotion... Bravo.
A trial, nothing less.
Civilization's infancy must come to an end. So long as humanity remains cradled in the Sentinel's arms, it will never walk, let alone evolve. That is why I wrote this final act.
And those who cannot transcend their limits and overcome their lesser natures, who remain imprisoned by their own making... Well, such souls deserve no salvation.
No souls deserve salvation. Why even try? This world was born from Chaos and exists in disorder. The only winning move... is to be worse. Wilder. To out-chaos the Chaos.
Every noble act of salvation only makes Chaos hungrier. You want to destroy to save, but me... Ha, I want to save to destroy.
You sound disappointed in how this story ends.
Did I say that? Your stories have always been a treat. Screaming crowds drowning in despair, a world tearing at the seams... Every collapse, every unraveling... Chefs kiss.
If they cannot overcome the pain, then let them fall straight into the ending I want: an eternity of chaos and suffering. That's why I chose to work with you, dear playwright.
Speaking of which, Quillbearer who toys with hearts, your sins weigh as heavy as mine. Tell me... where will your ending play out?
It has already been written into the script.
But until I reach it, as long as breath remains in me, I will haunt the stage like a phantom. A reminder... that one must always look forward, sharpen thy self, and temper thy soul.
Oh, {PlayerName} wasn't wrong about you. You really are a cruel, extreme man. Sometimes I think you might be even more insane than I am.
Insanity, reason… or something in between... All are choices born of free will. And only through free will can we defy the surging tides of fate.
That is why we both seek to change it. For beneath such tides... no one is content to remain merely a humble servant.
You lost the Gem I entrusted to you, Cristoforo.
Forgive me. But haven't we already seized what we truly desired?
You see, even <ano=Journeying Paradise>the Beyond forged from Leviathan's power</ano> couldn't endure. It fell short of the perfection you long for.
But if you wish to try again, I remain at your service.
Tell me, how much of <ano=Leviathan>It</ano> remains within you?
Not much, but enough to make use of.
...I've fulfilled my promise to complete your finale. Let this be the last note of our symphony.
As you wish. My sincerest gratitude for your wonderful performance, Lady Phrolova. May you find the strength to create the Beyond you once envisioned.
If this world truly cannot change, perhaps I will seek a new path for myself.
Huh… who'd've thought someone as stubborn as she would learn to adapt.
But, Grand Architect, are you really going to let her walk off and do as she pleases?
Of all of us, you are the last one with any right to judge her for following her whims.
Judge? You wound me. I'm far more faithful to my indulgences than she ever was. No, no, no, no, I just want to tag along… and add a few more flourishes to her symphony.

There are still greater matters that demand your attention. Though our roads diverge, our ideals remain as one. In the end, they all lead to the same place. Separation is but the prelude to possibility.
All so that humanity may cross... that final gateway into eternity.
Our goals in Jinzhou and Rinascita have been fulfilled. A Threnodian's Resonator, an artificial Threnodian, and a Second Resonance Awakening. We now possess both the knowledge and the means.
Next... it is time we turn our gaze to our accomplishments in Lahai-Roi.
Somewhere in Rinascita, the members of the Fractsidus gather once more…
What is that in the center? An opening? Something inside is sending them frequencies to recover!
The Tidespawn are still hiding in there, ready to strike again... Damn it. There's no end to this...
We won't last much longer at this rate...
The entrance is open. Now's the time...
...What are you doing?
What I always planned to do—hunt the Threnodian.
The moment I jump into the Dark Tide, the Tidespawn will retreat to defend. That's when you seal the Anti-Corrosion Ward. Trap them in one stroke.
Jump into the Dark Tide? Are you out of your mind?!
More precisely, into the Journeying Paradise. This suffocating despair you see... It's a gateway. And Leviathan's sanctuary.
You're saying Leviathan built the Paradise inside the Dark Tide?
That grand city you glimpsed within it... It wasn't a hallucination. It was real. The Paradise's first form.
Right now, It's trying to break the Earthrend Wedge's seal and drown all of Rinascita in the Dark Tide.
But that's not Its true goal. It feeds on our terror. On "despairing frequencies." That's what fuels Its rebirth and Its "Paradise."
We must strike at the root. Kill Leviathan. Tear down the Paradise It's built. If not, it will descend upon Rinascita. Just as it did here, at the Three Heroes' Crest.
The Paradise won't fall unless we can reach it. How exactly do we do that?
The living can only enter the Journeying Paradise once they've been corrupted by the Dark Tide. Even then... one of you must go in first to open the way for the rest.
Inside, there's a "spatial anomaly." Whoever goes first must use the Sentinel's power to break through it, then find a "Waystone" to create a "connection" for the others to follow.
Augusta, you buried the "Waystone" yourself. But it's been corrupted. Only the Sentinel's power can purify it.
Take it. Leviathan's eye is still on this place, so I'll say no more. I trust you'll understand what's left unsaid.
Once I'm inside, I'll draw Its attention. That'll buy you enough time to prepare.
Good, all locked and loaded. Now if you'll excuse me… Someone's got to teach the Dark Tide some manners.
Huh? No... Hold on now—
And you, {PlayerName}... If your resolve is true, be ready. When the time comes, I'll guide you to Paradise.
See you all in "Hell."
The Tidespawn are retreating to the center! They're all inside the Ward's perimeter! Augusta!
Now! Activate the Anchor Obelisks!
We did it...
But... what good is that?! She just rattles on, doesn't even check if anyone's really listening, and then dives headfirst into the Dark Tide!
The Journeying Paradise lies within the Dark Tide... I do not think she was lying. That "grand city" she spoke of... I saw it myself.
{PlayerName}, we've set up camp near the Three Heroes' Crest to keep watch. Let's head back and rest for now.
There must be a way forward. Once we're back, we'll gather all of Ragunna's heroes and plan our next move together.
Everything It plotted fell apart. With no other choice, It began spreading the gospel of its "Paradise" by force… And that gives us a chance to "kill" It.

The battle rages on. Just as you begin to worry it will drag on into a war of attrition, Galbrena makes for the cliff's edge, preparing to throw herself into a strange opening within the Dark Tide. It is the gateway to the Journeying Paradise, and Leviathan's sanctuary.
 
Galbrena explains that Leviathan's true goal is to use humanity's fear of the Dark Tide to accelerate the creation of the Journeying Paradise. Only by defeating Leviathan and destroying Its Paradise can the crisis truly end. But with Leviathan's eye on you, she only offers a cryptic hint on how to enter, trusting you to understand.
 
Galbrena then plunges into the Dark Tide, drawing Leviathan's attention and buying you time to plan. Seeing the Tidespawn immediately pull back to defend the opening, Augusta orders all Anchor Obelisks to be activated at once to seal the Dark Tide's spread.
The nature of the Dark Tide and Leviathan… I see where we are now.
{PlayerName}! You're here.
Now will you tell how you made it here?
How did you know we needed reinforcements?
Regarding that... I think it's best you hear it from "them" directly.

At a makeshift camp near the Three Heroes' Crest, your companions are already waiting. You worry about the situation in Averardo Vault and ask why your Ragunna allies have come… Just then, a familiar voice sounds on your Terminal…
If not for the Black Shores' aid, we would not have arrived so swiftly, or with such peace of mind.
This disaster has swept across all of Rinascita. We Ragunnesi won't cower behind Septimont's walls, nor will we sit idle while the Dark Tide ravages your lands.
Septimont has long stood as the vanguard against the Tidespawn. This is your battleground. We'll follow your lead, Your Excellency. Just say the word.

Thank you for your trust. Though Septimont and Ragunna have drifted apart over the years, in the face of such calamity, we stand together as one for Rinascita. There's no need for formality between us.
Leviathan is the source of this chaos. If the Black Shores' plan can truly seal It away, then perhaps the storm It unleashed may yet be stilled.
That Discord Slayer spoke of a "connection" between the "Waystones." She must've meant the Anchor Stones' ability to resonate and link with another.
If there's another Anchor Stone inside the Dark Tide… that connection could open up a path for us.
When the Dark Tide swallowed me, I did leave an Anchor Stone behind… But how did you know that?
Not important right now. The real issue is that the Anchor has been heavily corroded. To reactivate it, we'll need to purify it using the Sentinel's power.
Even if we take another Anchor Stone with us, its power alone won't be enough to pierce the spatial anomaly inside the Dark Tide... and open up a path...

Reassured by the Black Shores' support, you turn your focus to Leviathan. Galbrena's parting words hinted that if Augusta's Anchor Stone in the Dark Tide can be reactivated, the resonance between Anchor Stones may reveal a path to the Journeying Paradise. But to purify the corrupted Anchor, the Sentinel's power is still needed.
 
A stranger from Huanglong brings the "Lantern of Napoli the Second," which contains a fragment of that very power, but only enough for one person. Each of your companions offers to take the risk, but you argue firmly and claim the task.
 
Still, they refuse to let you bear the burden alone. Together, you devise a final plan: you will enter first to activate the Anchor Stone and create a path. After that, the others will drink the Fisalia "antidote" and follow you into the Dark Tide. There, in the Journeying Paradise, you will reunite and face Leviathan together.
 
Until then, they will hold the line at the Three Heroes' Crest. The Dark Tide has yet to settle, and the moment to enter has not yet come. For now, you can rest and gather strength for the battle ahead.
You'll need this.
The lantern of Napoli the Second...?
How did this end up with you?
A dying martyr entrusted it to me.
The First Relic, infused with Imperator's pure, original power. That light once drove back the darkness across Rinascita.
Most of its strength was spent purging the Dark Tide beneath Ragunna. What's left can only shield one person.
Someone will need to carry it in first, to reach the Anchor Stone and reactivate it.... I'll do it. As a captain, navigating through uncharted waters is second nature.
I'll go.
Friends, this is not up for discussion.
I'm the one best suited for this task.
I know how to resist the Dark Tide's corruption.
The Fisalia family potion grants resistance. And I've endured Its whispers for long enough. I know Its tactics. Let me face this...
We don't even know where this Anchor Stone is. Finding it may take time, and your potion might wear off before you reach it.
But I still carry the Sentinel's power. I can hold out longer than anyone. I have to be the one.
This relic holds all that Primus once felt. His fury, sorrow, obsession... and resolve. I see that same resolve in you.
Take it.
Trust me.
The defenses here need all of you.
...Hey, don't go making this too dramatic.
Lady Cantarella, how many of your family's potions remain?
You're asking if I can brew enough to carry all of us into the Journeying Paradise... If we're ready to face Leviathan.
So once that Anchor Stone is activated, the path should be clear, right? Great, then would you do us the honor, brilliant Lady of Potions, and get us there.
You...
{PlayerName}, this is Rinascita's fight. It is neither your duty to shoulder it alone, nor our desire to see you do so. We will not have you face the Threnodian alone.
If facing Leviathan means being corrupted by the Dark Tide, then so be it.
The Priestesses foresaw this, "The Dark Tide will erupt and engulf all of Septimont." If that is our fate, we must meet it head-on.
I understand...
Then here's the plan.
I'll go first. I'll enter the Dark Tide, activate the Anchor Stones' connections, and hold the path open for the rest of you.
Meanwhile, we'll hold the line at the Three Heroes' Crest. The Tidespawn aren't the only threat. The Fractsidus might still have their hand to play.
Once the Anchors are active, we'll take the potions and follow.
Rinascita will not falter just because a few of its leaders are gone. Its people will rise.
We'll meet again in the Paradise and end this together... Leviathan will fall.
{PlayerName}, we all understand the burden you carry. We are grateful.
We'll continue to monitor the Dark Tide. When the moment comes, we'll move. Until then, prepare and rest.
(That visitor from Huanglong... He must know something about Fenrico.)
(If the lantern came from the Fabricatorium, then what's happened to the Dark Tide sealed beneath Ragunna's seas...)
(There's still time before I go. I need to find him and learn what happened down there.)
You're here... Harbinger of the Dark Tide.
Who are you? How do you know about this?
Qiuyuan.
The capital sent me to retrieve a fugitive... and gather intel on the Threnodian's Resonator.
I came searching for Ragunna's Blessed Maiden. Instead, I found the Primus.
He was tied to the Threnodian. Knew the truth of it all. But the Dark Tide silenced him.
In his final moments, he passed this lantern to me. Said it was meant for you.
So he's...
His ambition and his crimes were buried in blood. But he paid the price. Gave his life to drive back the Dark Tide beneath Ragunna's seas.
That's how the relic reached your hands. Think no more on it. Think only of what's ahead.
Maybe that was his atonement...
Maybe that's the debt he owed...
Death is a cheap way to pay for transgressions. He knew it wouldn't be enough.
Listen. Every Harbinger of the Dark Tide, Fenrico, Mya, the rest... they all met the same end.
…Death.
I know.
I'm not afraid.
I accepted this long ago.
You've already been touched by the Dark Tide. Even the Sentinel's power cannot reverse it.
That's why we're not arguing over who goes in first. Anyone else would just suffer longer.
You've been resisting the Threnodian's corruption this whole time, suppressing your Resonance Ability so Tidespawn wouldn't surface. Everything you said was just to hide the truth. Deliberately.
I didn't want them to worry.
The fewer who know, the better.
Don't forget, I'm also the Harbinger of hope.
You're prepared to walk into death alone.
You've traveled so far just to honor a dying stranger's final wish. I'll ask for just one more for me. Please...
…The Dark Tide rejects outsiders of Rinascita. But you're different.
I'll do what I can. I'll hold the line here. You do what must be done.
Thank you.
When you're truly prepared to die, death doesn't come so easily.
I never act with sacrifice as a given. Not even my own.
One last thing. The Magistrate of Jinzhou asked me to send her regards.
The people you helped… They're still waiting for your return.
Farewell.

You speak with the stranger from Huanglong named Qiuyuan. Dispatched by the Mingting Capital, he is hunting a fugitive while gathering intel on the "Threnodian's Resonator." He had originally sought Ragunna's Blessed Maiden, but instead found Primus Fenrico, who entrusted Qiuyuan with the Lantern of Napoli the Second before giving his life to drive back the Dark Tide beneath Ragunna's sea.

Qiuyuan speaks of your identity as a "Harbinger of the Dark Tide" and warns that all Harbingers share the same fate—death. But you have long since come to terms with that.

Looking at your companions busy in their preparations, you ask Qiuyuan for one favor: to help Rinascita weather this calamity. He replies that the Dark Tide rejects all but Rinascitans, and you are a rare exception. But he promises to defend the surface in your absence.

Before parting, he tells you the Magistrate of Jinzhou sends her regards. Those whom you once aided are still waiting for your return.
Yo! Loud and clear, {PlayerName}?
So, all available Bloom Bearers have arrived in Rinascita. We're standing guard at Averardo Vault, and Buling is already en route to reinforce Septimont.
When the Threnodian blindsided us in Jinzhou, we ate some dust. But this time? The Black Shores will show the world who we really are.
We've already synced intel with Ragunna, and time's short, so I'll make this a quickie. We've drawn some key conclusions about the Threnodian in Rinascita.
The Threnodian is the shadow of civilization, formless and immortal. According to Imperator's judgment, It can't be erased entirely… only shackled.
But the one you're about to face is different. The Fractsidus used the Threnodian's Gem to resurrect it, and that created a crack in the shell.
Tethys believes that with Imperator's power, you might be able to split the Gem from the Threnodian and stop Leviathan from fully reviving.
If you can extract the Gem, Tethys can tap into a Sonoro's infinite expansion to lock that thing down for good.
One more thing. Back in Jinzhou, Abby proved capable of absorbing the Threnodian's frequencies. This means, in theory, it could act as a temporary host for the Gem.
Heh. But know this, the Threnodian Leviathan is rooted deeply in the minds and souls of Rinascita's people. Only they can truly face It.
At Ragunna's request, we've teleported some of our strongest Resonators to reinforce the frontlines at the Three Heroes' Crest.
So leave the civilians to us. We'll keep them safe. As for combat power? I called in some... insurance. Never hurts to play it safe.

Aalto briefs you on the situation at Averardo Vault. All available Bloom Bearers from the Black Shores have been sent to Rinascita. 

He explains the nature of the Threnodian's revival and a possible countermeasure. The Threnodian you are facing is one the Fractsidus revived and recreated using the Gem. If Abby, with the ability to absorb Threnodian frequencies, can carry the Gem within itself, the Black Shores might be able to contain It using Tethys's infinite Sonoro expansion.
 
But Leviathan is rooted deeply in the minds and souls of Rinascita's people. Only they can truly face it. Therefore, at Ragunna's request, some powerful Resonators have been sent to reinforce you at the Three Heroes' Crest. As for Averardo Vault and the civilians of Septimont, the Black Shores will stand as the last line of defense, guarding them until your safe return.
Don't worry, we...
Into Woolies' belly you go!
Feed my blossoms, self-deceivers!
So you don't have...
Unleash the fangs!
...Right. Looks like I don't need to worry about your end.
Just try not to bring down their Vault in the process.
Ahem! In any case, you just focus on driving your blade straight into Leviathan's heart. We'll be Rinascita's last line of defense, and we'll be right here waiting for your safe return!
'Twas a battle fierce and dire. The Laureate fell, consumed by mire.
Into the Dark Tide {Male=he's;Female=she's} gone, vanished. Our minds shattered, hope now banished
O' woeful hearts! O' helpless hands! Was this the end of all our plans?
Then soared the dark slayer, wings aflame. Striking down foes, breaking the chain.
Our Laureate rose in radiant swell, outshining the Threnodian's spell.
Though shadows vast did crowd the night, the light of unity shone ever bright.
With lantern held high, {Male=he;Female=she} banished the Dark Tide. Rinascita's long night, hereby cast aside!
And while the dark hero has sadly gone, our Laureate is here for us to cheer on!
Ahem...
Well, it was such an epic fight. If I can spin it into a song, maybe it'll live on in the hearts of Ragunna and Septimont, and all of Rinascita.
Through this song, the land will rise anew, and the names of all the fallen will never fade…
So this is what a bard does...
Oh, I really am quite the legend.
Heh, but there's another player in this tale...
He was neither Ragunnesi nor Septimontian. Have you heard the story of this outlander?
No? Then listen close. My melody will bring the story to life before your eyes...

With the Dark Tide quelled and Leviathan defeated, a new dawn rises over Rinascita. At Margherita's, Ciaccona now sings a song about that battle. Woven into that song is a tale of a mysterious man from Huanglong. As you listen, his story unfolds before your eyes...
Um... hello? Sir?
Are you... a neighbor in need?
By the Sentinel, the Order of the Deep will assist you with all that we have.
I need to see Fenrico.
You wish to confess to our Primus? Alas, Lord Fenrico is currently away on a journey to spread the Sentinel's teachings.
But if you need assistance, simply let someone know you seek the Order's aid. They'll take you to the Cathedral of Mercury.
You can always find me in the Cathedral, brother. My name is Leon.
May Imperator be with you.
Confess... to a Primus colluding with a Threnodian?
But if he's not here, then I'll seek out the "Blessed Maiden"... or {PlayerName}.
Hello there! You are...
From Huanglong, right? I assume from the style of your clothing. Are you travelling? Rinascita does offer some marvelous views...
Ah!!!
M-monsters!
Watch out for the black mud!
La Guardia, protect the people! Citizens, to the Cathedral!
Children and seniors first! Quickly!
Fear not, the Order will shelter everyone!
Just as {PlayerName} once described...
Are these... the End Times before the Paradise descends?
Everyone, get out of here!
Hey, friend from Huanglong! You should get to safety with the others. These monsters aren't just for show!
Escort the civilians to safety.
I'll handle this.

His name is Qiuyuan. He appeared in Ragunna City, originally in search of Fenrico, Primus of the Order of the Deep. But before long, the city was struck by the Dark Tide and its spawn. By then, you had already departed for Avinoleum to seek Cartethyia's aid concerning the Civilization Capsule...
Those creatures... I dreamt of them!
That black mud is the Dark Tide!
Levia... I can hear It whispering...
Hey, snap out of it!
Quick! Get it out!
Get it out of my head!
Are you insane? It's crawling with monsters outside!
When did our customer get so strong?!
HeeheeHAHAHAHAHA!
The path to Its Paradise...
No, you cannot stop me!
Someone tie him up! Or just knock him out!
...With the pizza paddle?
...Hmph, the Threnodian's dregs.
Brother Leon, come aboard now!
The Cathedral is already close to capacity!
You go! There are still many in the city who need evacuating!
Tell Phoebe she must protect everyone inside the Cathedral. No matter what!
It's you...
Get to safety.
But there are still people trapped in the square!
Carlotta Montelli.
Sir Leon? And this is...?
Qiuyuan.
I might not have survived if not for this kind soul from Huanglong.
My deepest gratitude for your aid.
Tacet Discords have appeared in the city without the slightest forewarning—
Ms. Carlotta, what of the Montelli Quarter? Have the civilians there been safely evacuated?
They're en route to the Cathedral as we speak. You may rest easy on that front.
The Threnodian's shadow already hangs over this city...
I can actually see you through the Dark Tide?
Could it be...?
Are you leaving, sir?
This place is no longer safe. You must all retreat.
...May Imperator be with you, friend.
Quite the mysterious man to vanish in such a fashion.
I sense no ill intent. He appeared... to be searching for something.
An old acquaintance of yours, Sir Leon?
Not quite. Just crossed paths earlier on Bank Street.
Leviathan's whispers hold no sway over outlanders. May Imperator's grace guide him to what he seeks and keep him steadfast on his path.
Carlotta!
Everyone from the square should be inside the Cathedral by now. I went door by door to make sure! The children here are the last ones left.
You... you're a Toccata...
This city and her people are crying out to us. We will weather this storm together!
Divine Envoys, Ragunna hangs by a thread! Fulfill your sacred duty! Defend the city and her people!
Brace yourselves!

Qiuyuan fights alone, driving back Tidespawn in the streets and rescuing an Acolyte in the middle of evacuating civilians. Carlotta and the others soon arrive to help, guiding the civilians to seek sanctuary at the Cathedral of Mercury and Averardo Vault. Because Qiuyuan is not from Rinascita, the Dark Tide does not harm him. Instead, it allows him to sense you in pursuit of Galbrena, far away in Avinoleum...
{PlayerName} is here. I can sense it.
But there is another strange presence in this tower.
The Dark Tide follows the vessel bearing its power...
Its corruption is already here.
Pathetic. To die a needless death for a hopeless cause.
You're nowhere near enough to stop me.
This frequency seems to belong to the Maiden.
Just what I need.
This must be the work of that Maiden.
But {PlayerName} was not the only one to pass through here.
There's another... shrouded in dark flames with intent to kill.
The sound of a firearm...
Someone got here before me.
An agent from <te href=260009>Mingting</te>? Wait, I know you.
You serve under Lord Liang... Qiuyuan, if memory serves?
...You know Grandmaster Liang?

I had the privilege of meeting many distinguished officials in Mingting. The <te href=260002>Ministry of Sentinel Affairs</te> once introduced me to your <te href=260001>Internal Security Agency</te>'s workings.
I would never confuse the man behind Lord Liang. The one without sight yet seeing all... the Blind Watcher.
I see what others cannot. That's all.
This bullet ended Cartethyia... yet I sense no malice from it.
Born of light, yet flying amidst shadow.
What kind of flame... are you seeking?
Cartethyia, Resonator of both Sentinel and Threnodian.
Even in "death," you remain the vessel of both.
As for you...
There's no record of you in Mingting's archives.
All your frequencies are tied to the Threnodian.
Chaotic, ever devouring, assimilating... That is Tacet Discord. A power not fully your own.
You seek vengeance, but she is not your true target... it's the Divinity.
Besides spark and firewood, you needed another person to stoke the fire—
So it is you, {PlayerName}.
You match what Magistrate Jinhsi's bodyguard described. However...
The mark of Leviathan's Dark Tide clings to you.
That was why I sensed you through the Dark Tide in the city.
Anyone tainted by a Threnodian is fated for destruction.
Even if a cleansing fire could burn away that darkness, when the moment of choice comes...
Will you turn the blade on yourself?
That woman did shoot Cartethyia. {PlayerName} is after her now.
How do you know that?
I can sense lingering frequencies in a place.
The Sentinel is no more, the Blessed Maiden is gone, and now the Dark Tide descends…
You are outnumbered.
You said you met with Mingting's officials. That means you had an audience not just with Grandmaster Liang, but with the <te href=260008>Grand Marshal</te>, too.
She asked me to execute a Fractsidus Overseer named Scar in Rinascita, and help {PlayerName} in the process.
So Mingting had foreseen all this?
That's not my concern.
"Thou shalt wield the torch of the usurper to drive away the darkness."
That's all the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs gave me. Any clue what this "torch" might be?
Usurper... Torch...
That may be referring to Primus Fenrico and the "First Relic" he holds.
Then that relic might be the help {PlayerName} needs.
Fenrico should still be in the experiment site he secretly built.
It lies beneath the waters to the southwest of Thessaleo Fells. I'm afraid you'll need to pinpoint the precise location yourself.
I see.
One more thing. Don't tell anyone I was here.
Do I have your word?
And why is that? Are you not a Mingting official?
I was. Not anymore.
Mingting... is not the place you once visited.
Secure Cartethyia's body and get to a safer place.
But you kept this from {PlayerName}. That is why it all unfolded so suddenly.
But that's not the whole story.

Qiuyuan arrives in Avinoleum. By then, Cartethyia has already been killed by Galbrena, and you have left in pursuit. Only Cantarella remains. She recognizes Qiuyuan as a former high official of Mingting. He tells her someone in Mingting has sent him to aid you, and through his Mindsight ability, he perceives the Mark of the Dark Tide clinging to you...
To hide such a facility under the sea.
Such desecration. Such... absurdity.
You creatures lurking in the dark...
I'll show you what the real darkness looks like.
Away... darkness...
Looks like Fenrico is still controlling this place.
He should be up ahead.
This is...
The Fractsidus.
Oh?
What a shame you couldn't end "him" in Mingting… and now, you still can't.
Why are you here?
A grim stage has been set for {PlayerName} in this land.
A pale shadow compared to Lord Liang Dongyuan, the mighty master of both pen and sword.
You will pay for murdering Grandmaster Liang with your blood.
Oh really? Isn't that debt yours to answer for?
A wanted criminal of Mingting, and yet the Ministry of War sent you all the way to Rinascita to hunt down Scar in secret.
Who would've thought... Mingting places such importance on him.
If you know that, it means you still have eyes and ears in Mingting.
Without a doubt. I am... "everywhere."
Speaking of which, Scar should be in Septimont now.
He did a patchy job in Jinzhou and needs to answer for his own missteps. I will not interfere with how you handle him.
As for our dear Primus here, a ruling hand clinging tightly to a cruel fate, a martyr yet to earn a name...
You are here for him, no?
"Thou shalt wield the torch of the usurper to drive away the darkness."
A Huanglong prophecy, yes? But isn't it just another verse in Divinity's script?
What have you done to him?
Me? Nothing.
What you see is simply the consequence of him fulfilling his destiny.
A remnant of his consciousness still lingers, right inside that lantern.
Step aside.
Why of course. What could an unarmed Acolyte possibly do against Huanglong's blade?
How can a lone, flickering torch hope to banish shadow upon shadow?
Ruthless soul, your end awaits you!
Fenrico... he's not so different from you.
You have killed without hesitation, and your one mistake was a single act of mercy.
For that moment of weakness, you've paid no less than he did.
This place is marred by the Dark Tide's filth. Why risk yourself, brother?
It's you... the Fractsidus I sensed.
Playing dress-up again... Is this your twisted idea of fun?
By the Sentinel, do you not recognize me?
Your disguise means nothing to me. I recognize your frequency.
Hehe... What truly separates us, brother?
A face alone is a sorry veneer. I am an Acolyte...
Just as you are a fugitive clinging to an official's uniform.
And I, at the invitation of another, am merely a supporting character in this grand performance.
And my role is to stop you here.
As an Acolyte, my faith in "Imperator" is indestructible, though my flesh remains so very fragile.
You killed that Acolyte.
Oh, he's quite hale and hearty. Right now, he should be tending to the wounded in that vault.
Besides, it's beneath me to move against such an... ordinary character.
Such brutality. And here I stand, an unarmed Acolyte.
Still, allow me a parting word...

Following Cantarella's clues, Qiuyuan finds Fenrico at the Fabricatorium of the Deep, only to be blocked by an illusion of an Acolyte, a Fractsidus member in disguise. Qiuyuan instantly recognizes "him" as the one who killed his Grandmaster. Yet he also knows this figure is only a projection, not the true "killer." The man declares he will not stop Qiuyuan and steps aside, saying only by letting him pass will Fenrico's destiny be fulfilled...
Be gone... Be gone...
You short-lived glimmer of a candle...
Just as the tale of the fool...
Vociferous, but hollow.
The Dark Tide. Seems like he's still connected with the Threnodian...
My... cathedral.
This is...
A corner in the realm of my mind. It shifts with the person I meet.
This cathedral shows your obsession.
A soul from Huanglong...
Here, you shall find neither the gospel you can accept, nor the judgment you are meant to endure.
The Threnodian has taken everything from you.
Your Blessed Maiden is dead, your city crumbles.
The Dark Tide will soon swallow it whole. Your tie with the Threnodian should have shown you what's already happened.
Give me the lantern.
Tell me, by what right do you demand what is ours?
"The path born of injustice must be fortified with further transgressions…"
No. Our path was built upon a foundation of righteousness.
Here, one Primus after another offered up their battered flesh... in defiance of Leviathan.
And... be it Leviathan, Cartethyia, or the Fractsidus, none shall steal Ragunna from my keeping.
Under the hands of the Primuses, Ragunna flourished. By our light, the people were shielded from the Threnodian's corruption and led toward a true Blessed Land.
People need unity of belief. That is why a Primus must rule. That is the heart of our creed.
It is what sustained me across twenty years of struggle against the Threnodian. I sought to bend Its power toward a higher purpose.
But in the end... that creed consumed me. I believed I could use Leviathan as a hammer to forge a true Blessed Land against Its hollow "Paradise." But I was the one used.
Such is my appointed fate. I accept it without challenge.
What still binds me here... is naught but fury and hatred for the betrayal.
You are only mortal. Mortals don't stand a chance against a Threnodian.
Night and day, Its whispers echoed in our heads. A torment no soul can endure.
And despite Imperator's fading light granting us only fleeting moments of clarity, generations of Primuses have willingly walked this path.
And you still thought you could control Its power?
Ambition and obsession fueled your fight against the Threnodian. But in the end, they're the very things that brought you down.
Yours is a scripture of righteousness. Yet evil and atrocity are written all over your deeds.
I stand knee-deep in a river of blood. What is spilled cannot be unspilled.
There was a time I could have killed a man before he waded into a river of blood.
Now, that chance stands before me once more.
"No mortal shall inflict upon you even the slightest harm."
It is this prophecy and fate that lead me onward...
Pleasure born of violence shall end in violence.
You that are heavy laden by guilt, come and confess.

The First Relic draws on Qiuyuan's Mindsight to manifest the Cathedral of Mercury. There, the lingering consciousness of Fenrico confesses his ideals and intentions. To allow Qiuyuan to take the Relic and deliver it to you, Fenrico must finally accept his own death and find release. Perhaps it was fate that brought them to this moment, for Qiuyuan too is burdened by a regret over a past choice involving the Threnodian...
Tell me why.
By the order of the <te href=260011>Censorate</te>, you are to be executed by the Internal Security Agency.
Me?
You're just an ordinary man.
Those things are killing our people. I... won't let that stand.
Tacet Discords don't get to live. No matter the cost, I won't stop until... they're all annihilated.
Jinzhou's survival depends on stopping the Tacet Discords.
You wield incredible might, but such strength demands restraint.
A sword exists to deter, not kill. Draw too quickly, and you'll die by your own blade.
Your sword can cut down Tacet Discords. Or save lives.
If your resolve to protect this land stands firm, you will forge a legacy.
They accuse you of... colluding with Tacet Discords and wreaking havoc across Jinzhou.
What a joke...
Killing them isn't enough.
You killed these Tacet Discords. These people owe you their lives.
Yes. So what?
The border is in chaos, and all your Agency does is lick the boots of corrupt officials.
Grandmaster Liang from the Agency spoke in your defense.
Then why are you here?
Might as well... kill me here.
Do it.
If you let me live today. I swear... Every one of the ISA's dogs...
And every last Tacet Discord... I'll turn these lands white with your bones.
...I've read your case files in Jinzhou these past few days.
Those Censors failed in their duties and deceived us...
How could a single squad captain possibly conspire with Tacet Discords to kill and raid?

Qiuyuan once faced a difficult choice. Ordered by the Mingting Censorate to kill Geshu Lin, Qiuyuan hesitated, seeing that the man had not yet fallen to darkness. He saw the raging fire churning in the man's heart, but just as his own teacher once cautioned him, he urged Geshu Lin to wield his power with restraint. In defying the Censorate's command, he spared Geshu Lin's life.
I... I see it now. What haunts you, the memories you carry...
I see that rainy night. That battle. And the Threnodian... feeding on it all.
I see the plain drenched in blood. The man standing atop it all, burning in black flames...
What happened to him?
He fell into Ovathrax's abyss.
And shared my fate...
Maybe when we first met, he still held on to a shred of goodness. But even so, it didn't stop his end from coming.
You should have killed him when you had the chance.
History grants no second chances. And the dead do not return.
There's only one thing I can do. Next we meet, I'll end him, quick and clean.
If given the choice again, would you still become Primus?
I would.
Usurper they may deem me, but never shall they deny the fruit of my toil.
Well do I know my iniquities, and clear is the end of my path.
So, were I to choose anew, I would tread this path once more… though it spurns the wisdom of every Primus before me, though nothing but trials and terrors lie ahead.
Now... take this.
"Thou shalt wield the torch of the usurper to drive away the darkness."
So this is the "First Relic"?
Napoli the Second wielded it to purge Ragunna of the Dark Tide. And at that moment of triumph, the Order earned the Threnodian's full attention.
This lantern… carry it forth. Should the Journeying Paradise come, it will emerge from Septimont, where the Righteous One shall surely be.
{PlayerName} has also been tainted by the Dark Tide, like you.
The Dark Tide binds us all. I did feel {Male=his;Female=her} presence.
{Male=He;Female=She} now stands as the new Harbinger, walking a path that… was never meant to be {Male=his;Female=hers}.
That is why {Male=he;Female=she} needs this lantern far more than I do.
Is this your penance?
I do not repent. But a dying Primus has no right to hold onto this relic.
This is... my destiny.
Upon deception had I built my reign and legacy. And no mortal could inflict upon me even the slightest harm.
The wandering Righteous One... is no mere mortal.
Take this lantern!
The flame of ambition and obsession has died. Only the lantern's glow remains.
So... do you seek vengeance?
In violence shall I end the pleasure born of violence...
A Threnodian is no easy kill.
My flock, the faithful of the Order, and the wandering Righteous One… they shall prevail.
Even though I should fall into hell, Leviathan too shall burn beside me.
Become my knight. Take this and go.
In this way... shall I fulfill my destiny...
...I am Fenrico Macbeth...
Though I may never stand among the greatest Primuses…
History shall remember me... as Fenrico the First.
History's truth is inscribed in stone. May those who come after render their verdict on you.
So ends the path of <te href=260012>Fenrico the First</te>, of the Order of the Deep.
Your wish is well received.
I've lost everything, but it still doesn't cover the debt I owe the dead of that battlefield.

Through the Dark Tide, Fenrico glimpses these memories. Because Geshu Lin did eventually fall to darkness, guilt has haunted Qiuyuan ever since. But history grants no second chances. All that remains for both Fenrico and Qiuyuan is to fulfill their missions. Choosing to trust Qiuyuan, Fenrico hands the First Relic and the task of defeating Leviathan to him. With that, his soul vanishes into the depths of the Fabricatorium.
…As for what happened after, that we already know!
The mysterious swordsman stood alone and held back the Dark Tide at the fiercest frontline!
Not to mention, he made quick work of Scar, the Fractsidus Overseer.
I know those parts well...
How do you know about all of that?
Some of it came straight from the folks in Ragunna, and some from a certain Fisalia, who prefers to remain unnamed.
What about the Fabricatorium part?
Why did I see some things you weren't even recounting?
It's similar to what happened when I helped you see Cartethyia.
Perhaps it's the lantern. It holds the last flickers of Fenrico's will. It could have revealed a glimpse of what happened in the Fabricatorium.
A swordsman from distant shores aiding a disgraced Primus in taking vengeance against the Threnodian Leviathan…
Astonishing, isn't it? But it's all true...
That mysterious swordsman also mentioned someone else. A man burning in black flames...
Geshu Lin...
There's more to him than they want us to see. And more buried between Jinzhou and Mingting than they'll ever admit.
The order to hunt down Scar in Rinascita came straight from Mingting. Even Jinhsi was left in the dark.
Whatever he's carrying... could shake Mingting to its core.
Guess you'll have to wait until you're in Huanglong for answers.
Or... Perhaps we could go ask our mysterious swordsman himself?
If he brought you the First Relic, then he's one of the heroes who saved Rinascita.
We still owe him our thanks, but no one saw him after the final battle...
Locating a visitor from Huanglong in Ragunna shouldn't be a hassle, not with the Montellis, the Fisalias, the Order, and our Septimontian friends all out there preparing to rebuild Rinascita.
Let's go! I bet we can find him!
Through Ciaccona's Forte, you glimpse Qiuyuan's journey across Rinascita. But since the battle in Septimont, you haven't seen him again, nor do you know where to find him to offer your thanks.
Good to see you, {PlayerName}.
Ms. Zani and I have been assessing the damage to Averardo Vault and the Cathedral of Mercury.
The Vault is all right. As Lady Carlotta instructed, we just had to throw a few collections away.
You saved the day.
The losses are nothing compared with the safety of our people.
By the way...
Have you seen Qiuyuan? The one from Huanglong.
I think I saw him by the square.
Hard to miss someone from Huanglong in the crowd.
I also noticed quite a few friends from Septimont there discussing the rebuilding. Maybe you could ask if anyone's seen him.
Ragunna is indeed nothing like Septimont.
A harbor like this suits sea trade far better...
Is this your first visit to Ragunna, Augusta?
It is. After all, Ragunna was closed to outsiders.
But we'll be heading back to Septimont after trade negotiations with the Montellis and the Order are concluded.
About that Huanglong warrior who aided in Septimont's frontline defense...
Have you seen the Huanglong warrior?
The swordsman named Qiuyuan?
I ran into him earlier by the docks. We spoke briefly. He looked ready to board a ship home.
The Gladiators who stood their ground during the attack spoke of him. They said it was he who held the fiercest frontline alone when the Fractsidus unleashed the Dark Tide.
I don't dare imagine the casualties without his aid...
I want to thank him in person as well.
The ship hasn't set sail yet. So, you should find him at the dock.
Sir, how long before the ship departs?
The captain says once these goods from Septimont are loaded, we prepare to set sail.
I see no Acolytes supervising.
Thought you couldn't see! So you can, eh?
No... I just sense no one is causing you trouble.
Ragunna and Septimont have been through a lot. Really was those heroes who carried us through this disaster.
Still gives me chills when I think about it...
That's all behind us, sir.
Right you are...
You board first. I'll be ready soon.
Aye. Thank you, lad.
You have come.
Leaving so soon?
I've lingered long enough. My work isn't done.
Scar and the other Fractsidus operatives got away...
Our Grand Marshal likely expected as much. They always have a way out.
Pity. Would have liked to see if I could sever that goat head in one strike.
I still haven't properly thanked you for your help in Septimont.
Leviathan's influence was aimed at Rinascita. Outsiders like me were spared.
Besides, it was the Grand Marshal who asked me to help you here.
You should save your gratitude for her when you visit Mingting someday. She takes great interest in you.
Mingting... I've only been to Jinzhou so far.
The world is wide. Rove far enough, and you'll find your way there.
Wait, about Geshu Lin...
You know Jiyan. You fought in Norfall Barrens. You must also know what really happened in Jinzhou three years ago.
And what becomes of those who fall to the Threnodian. Not everyone has the strength to resist Its persuasions, not like the people here.
Are you still after him?
For the lives lost in that battle because of him, death is too light a punishment.
But it's what I can give him, and what I must.
Come now, lad! Ye' miss this ship to Mengzhou, and you're waiting till morning!
They call you Rover, but you're not without a home. You are a blade with a sheath.
Those who stand by you are your home. Your sheath. They will fight for you. And you, for them.
Maybe one day...
You will.
You are what they say.
May our paths cross again.
Back then, corrupt officials lied to the Internal Security Agency, to Grandmaster Liang, and to me. I went to Jinzhou to execute him.
But at the time... he wasn't what they claimed. It was only later that he fell to the Threnodian's influence.
And Lord Fenrico and his predecessors... Under Sentinel Imperator's guidance, they held the lantern high and drove away the darkness surrounding us.

In the end, you find Qiuyuan just before he boards a merchant ship bound for Mengzhou. He tells you he came to Rinascita to aid you at someone's request, and Scar was merely a side matter. The two of you are but strangers whose paths happened to cross. But the world is wide, the road is long. Perhaps one day, in Huanglong, your paths will cross again.
Welcome back. Shall we continue the story?
I'm ready.
Maybe later.
Welcome back. Shall we continue the story?
I'm ready.
Maybe later.
Welcome back. Shall we continue the story?
I'm ready.
Maybe later.
Welcome back. Shall we continue the story?
I'm ready.
Maybe later.
Shanoir...
Come back alive, Sollad.
Follow the Senate's orders, and you'll be safe.
…Umm hum.
The horn of doomsday has sounded. The Ephor and the vanguard are clashing with the enemies now.
Go. Answer the call.
I trust my fiancé will return to me, crowned in glory.
Shanoir...
Come back alive, Sollad.
I heard the fighting has already begun in the Plateaus—
Stop thinking about it.
The civilians in the city will soon be evacuated.
I heard the fighting has already begun in the Plateaus—
Stop thinking about it.
…But I want to fight at the Ephor's side, on the front!
Our duty is to guard Septimont and its people. We will hold fast here, until they return in triumph.
The battle here matters just as much as the one at the Three Heroes' Crest.
…Alright.
Then let's do our part.
Marion! Thank goodness, you're still alive!
A Discord Slayer saved me...
Marion! Thank goodness, you're still alive!
Haha, surprised? I didn't think I'd survive that monster siege either… but a Discord Slayer saved me.
A Discord Slayer? Where is she now?
She's headed for the Plateaus. No one could stop her… I need to report to the Ephor at once.
Leave that to me. You should get your wounds treated.
No. I'm still on my feet, and that can only mean one thing… my duty isn't finished.
I'll fight to my last breath here in Septimont.
…Thank you.
If only the family had brought more firearms…
