Facing those monsters with nothing but cold steel is a bit challenging.
But you seem used to it, don't you?
For years, we've been "hunting" to earn a glorious death today.
The only thing I can count on is the touch of striking them down with my spear.
And I bet that touch is pretty damn good, huh?
Ha… of course.
But you're not bad yourself. All dressed up, yet you've still got some real fight in you.
When you're ready, let's head back and keep fighting side by side.
I'll cover your back.
This might sting a little.
Hss…
How do you feel now?
Much better. The dizziness is almost gone, and I can move a lot more easily.
This potion feels almost magical… and it even has a kind of fragrance to it?
It was supplied by the Fisalia family. It can slow the spread of Dark Tide corruption, or suppress the festering wounds left by Tidespawn.
Really? I'll have more!
But it hasn't gone through the Order's analysis or approval. Too much, and your whole body could go numb, and you might even start hallucinating.
Wow, that's unexpected...
…You're not the first to come asking for more of it.
What are you saying?
Oh, {Male=Lord;Female=Lady} {PlayerName}! Can you understand them?
Ever since the reinforcements arrived from Ragunna, we've been seeing a lot of Echoes like this one.
It sounds like…
They've brought food.
Really? Thank you!
If you're dropping off supplies, head to the other side, and you'll find the spot there! I wonder what Ragunna's dishes taste like…
Fine work, {PlayerName}! With Rinascita safe for now, we've earned a proper breather.
There's still something I'd like to know.
You've worked hard too. Get some rest.
If there's anything you want to know, ask away!
About the Journeying Paradise…
About the Threnodian's Gem…
About Abby…
That's all. Get some rest.
Ah, the Paradise. A realm created by Threnodian Leviathan and the destination of the Dark Tide...
But judging by its nature, its reach, and the havoc it could bring… its "descent" is nothing less than what we define as the Lament.
Still, without question, your actions, {PlayerName}, kept that from becoming a true Lament.
Rinascita… what a journey it's been. Truly one for the epics...
You mean the missing frequency, right? We've already cross-checked it against Chimera and Cartethyia's frequency samples left here at the Black Shores…
Not a single one aligned. Not even close.
Which means… we can't dismiss the chance that the missing frequency has already been seized by the Fractsidus.
But don't worry. We've sped up the Gem's analysis. Even if the Fractsidus is scheming, we'll have countermeasures ready.
Abby? It's a curious case. Even in the deepest databanks of the Black Shores, we found no relevant data...
(But in that battle against the Journeying Paradise… Leviathan spoke Abby's name.)
(Yet no one else seemed to react. Was it only Abby and I who heard it?)
(Abby's true identity… Perhaps I'll only uncover it on the road ahead.)
Opposite the Three Heroes' Crests, a towering obelisk rises. One side is inscribed with countless names, meant to endure the passage of time. The other holds a short, but heavy, elegy:
They stepped into the relentless shadow, and with their oaths, their blades, their very lives, forged a new path.
They drove back the endless night, so that hope, dawn, and the future could shine upon Rinascita.
Their names are now etched upon the newborn isles.
You need not seek their graves. Look to the starry sky, the soaring birds, and the soothing waves…
They have never truly departed.
Greetings, honored warrior. Have you come to pay your respects as well?
Yes. I've brought these flowers for them.
The Divinity has gone… Now the future of Rinascita rests in our hands.
Friend, you know we Septimontians don't place our faith in divinities.
But I believe what is carved upon this obelisk is…
..."The Nine Billion Names of Divinity."
Oh… This… Huh? Why am I here?
What's going on?
I don't know!
Why am I here? I was supposed to be at home reading…
You don't remember anything?
No, not at all! Have we met before?
Yes!
No.
Do you really want to know?
Please tell me what I've been doing!
I guess my mind must have wandered off… Maybe I had a bout of hysteria or something.
…No. No, forget it.
Never mind. I'm not that eager to know what I've been up to lately.
To hell with the Threnodian! I'm going home to get some rest.
Hello, Laureate. Is there something you need help with?
Is that Echo following you?
Thanks to the Order and Imperator's grace, La Guardia is here to protect us when needed.
I'm headed to Whisperwind Haven to help the Order distribute supplies to villagers in need, which is why it is with me.
Even though the Sentinel is gone, La Guardia still bears the halo, standing by our side.
Perhaps this is the final revelation They left us, entrusting us to uphold Rinascita's order together with the Echoes.
Every blessed soul must keep their vow and contribute to a safe and peaceful Rinascita.
These children are still too young to understand that these Echoes are blessings from Imperator.
Ragunna's is united today because of assistance from these Common Echoes.
Come down, little one...
Children see a Mercurio and think it's a plaything.
It's only natural.
The Common Echoes are Imperator's final gift, a testament to Their love for us. How could anyone treat them like that?
So please, stop riding on it...
Nonsense! Absolute nonsense!
Huh!? You are overreacting...
What happened?
This Acolyte was telling me stories about the Dark Tide, like the Final Tide and Flood of the End Times prophesied by Sentinel Imperator.
It's pretty obvious that some of these concepts align with terms from current Tacetite theories.
For example, you've likely seen the Etheric Sea in Huanglong, haven't you? It's a unique sky phenomenon associated with the appearance of the Tacet Fields and Tacet Discords.
Ragunna just weathered the Dark Tide, and I'm telling you, there's a scientific explanation for everything that happened.
Nonsense! We survived the Dark Tide and stand here today because we were granted redemption. It's a divine miracle, beyond any doubt!
Only by gathering under the protection of Imperator and the Blessed Maiden, by constantly ascending and unifying, can we find the path to salvation.
I understand why you'd hold that view, but —
By Imperator! Perhaps I really should send you to the Order Penitentiary immediately. You should be on the Pilgrim's Sail, repenting for your sins!
Maybe you should stop here...
A few words won't change beliefs that run deep.
O-okay.
Sigh... I know. It's just… It doesn't make any sense to me.
Ragunna will not tolerate insults to our faith!
Hail Imperator—
So you have already perished. Your gaze no longer watches over the people of Ragunna.
You cannot look upon the Order, nor can you watch over your people.
Haha... Hahahaha...
O Imperator! Let us offer you a solemn, eternal farewell!
Veti, tell Mommy and Mr. Acolyte, are you still having that nightmare?
Nope! I've been sleeping great these days!
Have you been feeling better lately?
Yes, and it's all thanks to you. I no longer have those dreadful dreams.
Those days... It was hell...
Wonderful. Now that you're doing better, you can gradually stop taking the medicine you were on before.
May your dreams be peaceful and calm.
The Sentinel? Aren't They… gone? Do the Ragunnesi still believe in Them?
I've only recently come across a few tales of Imperator myself. Their words still guide the Ragunnesi to this day! If only we could keep following Their guidance—
Wait, guidance? Isn't the Sentinel that super-powerful being who died fighting the Dark Tide? I mean, sure, that's worthy of respect… but guidance?
I'd rather take my cues from the Ephor. And hey, I was practically the Sentinel's comrade! We fought together to drive back the Dark Tide!
Huh? What are you talking about? The Sentinel's majesty is far beyond anything you could hope to compare yourself to!
Whoa, hold your horses, lady. Something's not right about you.
How dare you change the topic? Acknowledge the truth that there is no greater existence than Imperator!
Sigh... Ragunna has always placed its faith in the Sentinel… but now that They're gone, I fear the winds are about to change.
A storm is brewing in Septimont as well… But you know what?
The current champion is also Ragunna's Laureate, {Male=he;Female=she} once fought side by side with the Blessed Maiden and other warriors against the Dark Tide.
Then perhaps, with such a godsent person now in Septimont, things won't turn out so badly after all…
Mr. Fulmine!
What is it? Calm down. Take your time.
Nathan had a major disagreement with an Acolyte named Matheus. Now he threatens to contact the Order Penitentiary to have Nathan expelled...
What? How did it come to this?
Heard it was about whether the Dark Tide should be explained through theology or science. Nathan insisted on a scientific explanation and the two started to argue.
Nathan's new to the city. You can't expect him to just get Ragunna's history...
Let me handle this... Hello, am I speaking to Brother Matheus?
Yes, that's me. May I ask to whom am I speaking?
This is Fulmine from the Pioneer Association. You may have heard of me.
I heard the Order plans to produce a documentary about the Tidal Sanctuary to spread Imperator's blessings?
Yes... the Order indeed has plans for that.
I believe the Pioneer Association can lend a hand. If you're interested, why not come to our studio for a chat when you're available?
Well... but...
Also, in the interest of cooperation, let's all just forget about that rather unpleasant argument you had.
...I see. Thank you for your contribution to the Order, Mr. Fulmine.
He hung up...
I'll take care of this from here. Don't worry.
We can finally return to our homeland, where dawn breaks, birds sing, and melodies drift through the air.
Salvation has touched each and every one of us. I… I can hardly believe it. To think I was part of something so great.
Perhaps… I truly was too arrogant before.
But your dedication wasn't in vain.
Back then, I couldn't see any other path, so I offered myself completely, hoping to win us a better future.
But it was the voices of Rinascita's people that gave me strength… strength gathered from every soul in Rinascita. Compared to that, I was so small.
The calamity is behind us now. I'm going back to Rinascita with the others. This time… I'll live with courage!
Which year is it now? How long have I been here?
I remember… after saying goodbye to my family, I set out for the Sanctuary. But not long after… everything became a blur.
Have you ever doubted the Divinity?
It's shameful to admit, but… I didn't join the Order out of faith, only for the fame.
Over time, I grew familiar with the scriptures and thought I should do something for Ragunna… Which year is it now? How long have I been here?
The face in the mirror looks so much older now. It's as if I've been lost in a very, very long dream.
What I should do with these books?
Ugh... Everything's such a mess.

{PlayerName}! Welcome back!

Do you remember the guidance you once gave us?
Thanks to your instructions, when the disaster struck, the three of us managed to survive and even claim victory!
It was through your efforts that we set aside our differences and worked together to overcome it.
We are truly grateful.
Ephor Augusta's definitely the strongest!
Hah? What could she even do against the Dark Tide?
Cut the disaster talk. Besides the one who won both the Carnevale Laureate and the Great Agon championship, who else would dare say they could defeat the Dark Tide?
Ephor Augusta is strong, yes, but not that strong. That's exactly my point.
Enough arguing. I heard you've seen that champion?
Tell me more! I'm dying to know!
Cut the disaster talk. Besides the one who won both the Carnevale Laureate and the Great Agon championship, who else would dare say they could defeat the Dark Tide?
Ephor Augusta is strong, yes, but not that strong. That's exactly my point.
You fools… The very one you're talking about is standing right beside you…
Haha, just kidding. Don't mind me. Carry on.
{PlayerName}, have you seen two young Gladiators by the names of Trefor and Disanta around here?
We're about to start our patrol, and I just can't find them anywhere.
Tell him what you know.
Keep it a secret.
What? They actually got into a fight over something that ridiculous?
Thank you for informing me, {PlayerName}. I'll go drag those two hooligans back right this instant.
Looks like they still haven't learned their lesson… This time, I'll have them clean up the sewers!
O my old friends... What a pity you missed this fight.
Hail, Hero! May applause greet you!
What are you doing?
I bring flowers to my old comrades and tell them of what's been happening in Rinascita.
I never thought this old man would live to witness such a legendary event before turning to ashes.
Haha… even if I were to join them next year, I'd still have something to boast about!
Pa! I heard the Blessed Maiden's voice!
Why not tell him how you stood with everyone against the Dark Tide?
Pa always loved hearing me chatter about little things. He wouldn't mind this either.
Go on, then. We can leave a bit later.
Thanks, Ma! Now… where should I start?
Oh, I know! Let's begin with the day when the Blightcloud over the Plateaus started to stir…
Keep talking. I'll borrow a jug and water these flowers.
Greetings, Champion. I serve here at the Ephor's Palace. Part of my duties include coordinating the Palace's schedule.
The Ephor has said you are to be given priority on the schedule. If you wish, I can brief you on some important details.
Please do.
Will it be long?
Understood. Let me gather the key points. It won't take much of your time.
I'll keep it brief. Just the essentials.
In general, Her Excellency handles the internal affairs of Septimont in the mornings. Afternoons are reserved for external matters like diplomacy and trade.
Normally, it takes three to four weeks to schedule an audience with Her Excellency. However, given that the matter you're here to discuss concerns Septimont's fate, that rule doesn't apply to you.
You've also been granted special clearance. No paperwork required, unlike other envoys.
As for your weapons... Oh, I see. You can carry them in the Palace with Her Excellency's personal permission.
The only thing I must remind you of is to keep your voice down within the Palace halls.
If there's anything else you should be aware of, I'll inform you promptly.
Hey, I heard you're heading to Ragunna again?
Yeah! The Ragunnesi really believe in the Sentinel, so the atmosphere's going to be totally different this time.
Want to come along?
Absolutely! Ugh... With everything going on right now, I wonder if we'll still get to see some amazing performances…
After the catastrophe, Augusta has truly come into her own.
Still no word on Avidius… and that Priestess…
She seems cunning… but who exactly is she? Doesn't ring any bells.
May applause greet you, Hero.
If you have questions about the Agons, I'm happy to help.
(Chisa's been in the Black Shores' care after Honami. I wonder how she's doing.)
(I should drop by when I have the time.)
I think it got stuck inside...
Try and go for another one, maybe?
I've seen this before. Just whack it a few times.
Do something with your invincible scissors, Chisa.
I've got a better way to handle no-good vending machines like this.
Yep. You've read my mind.
That may be a little too much. Here, watch this.
The vending machine jams and fails to dispense a drink, but Chisa seems to know exactly how to deal with the situation...
Here you go. Simplicity works best.
...Is something wrong?
Didn't have time for this kind of thing before.
Just wondering if it's past its expiration date.
You're right. We were always running from something. Or chasing after something.
Remember that canned fruit we had that one night? It's the same thing. I've never got an upset stomach from it, at least.
Before I transferred to Startorch, I used to hide next to the vending machines behind my high school building all the time.
No one else really went there. It was quiet. The sound of soda cans dropping down would make me feel relaxed.
Was life difficult back then?
Where I come from, discrimination and prejudice against Resonators are part of life. School was no exception.
The gossip, the looks, the way people kept their distance... intentional or not, it still got to me.
I tried to stand up for myself. I tried holding it in. Nothing changed. Just when I was close to breaking, I received an acceptance letter.
And so, with my family's blessing, I left home and went to Startorch Academy, far away in the Lahai-Roi region.
Startorch Academy... What was it like?
So it's true, you... No, it's nothing.
It is a multinational school built specifically for Resonators. A metropolis of science and research.
Even for a girl who couldn't face her own problems and chose to run away, they accepted me with a warm welcome. I met people who dreamed of reaching the stars.
This swing... It's just like the one back home.
Would you join me? There is room for one more.
Was it because you're a Resonator?

Chisa hands you a drink and begins to share painful memories from her past. As a Resonator, she faced constant discrimination in her hometown, even at school. Just when she felt she couldn't take any more, she received an acceptance letter from Startorch Academy. There, she was treated with kindness by the teachers and her classmates.
Chisa?
Solaris to Chisa.
I hear you. I'm just... enjoying the gentle sway. Especially... when someone's beside me.
Everything feels so peaceful all of a sudden.
When you're ready to move on, I'll get up.
You don't have to wait for me. I think I've been on the swing long enough.
Oh, you're back. Do you like sitting on the swing too?
I can already see our destination from here. Look at the cherry blossoms... they weren't blooming like this before.
They really are beautiful now.
They're the same as they were before.
Like clouds floating above the water, or like cotton poking through a torn couch... Sorry, I'm using weird analogies again.
It could be that my mood is just different now than before.
Luckily, a view like this can exist forever within this Sonoro Sphere.
That fountain over there... it's been concealed by leftover Irideglow Crystals. Kind of a shame.
I'll take care of it. Just like back in Neon Tower.
There's something in the water...
Let's fish it out and see what it is.
This looks like a cassette tape.
Ah, I know what it is.
Every Startorch Academy student has a frequency storage cassette like this inside their Terminals.
(I remember now. Galbrena once told me about them.)
I also have one in my Terminal. They were given out during the orientation.
If it's a device unique to Lahai-Roi, what's it doing here?
Random "castaways" often appear inside the Honami Sonoro Sphere. This must be one of those.
I'll take this to Namipon. It should be able to help us find where it came from.
Cherry blossoms... Right in front of us. It's so beautiful.
Let's go over there and take a picture.
This right here is a photo moment.
Sure. You and I together.

At a fountain, you discover a strange cassette, a device unique to Lahai-Roi. Every Startorch Academy student carries a similar frequency storage cassette in their Terminal. Chisa decides to bring it to Namipon, hoping it can help you locate its origin. With the cherry blossoms so close, the two of you decide to take a picture together.
Make sure you look towards the camera.
I will.
When I was little, my parents once took me to a park full of cherry blossoms for a picnic. I made kirigami in all kinds of shapes and had them guess what they were.
The kirigami didn't really look like anything, but when I told them, they'd always smile and pretend they understood.
Those cherry blossoms... they looked just like they do now. After being away from home for so long, drifting around... I feel like I'm home again.
Welcome home, Chisa.
Thank you, Senpai.
This student ID card came into my possession by chance. It was in that Tower that I found—No, that I recognized who it belonged to.
I never found the right moment to return this to you. Here, this belongs to you.
I was a student at Startorch Academy?
They told me about you at the Black Shores. That you've lost some memories.
We never met in person at school, but... I did read the course selection guide you wrote.
I don't remember anything.
It's okay. Honami is where we first met each other.
But I've been talking about myself this whole time. Why don't you tell me about your story so far? I'd like to know more about you.
Rinascita... sounds like quite an adventure. Only someone like you, Senpai, could accomplish so much.
You can stop calling me that for now.
Hold on, that title takes a little getting used to.
Alright. You always seem to find your way forward, no matter how uncertain things are. Like you did in Honami. But I...
What comes next? Should I continue my studies at the Academy? Should I go home? Or should I do something else... I still haven't decided.
No need to rush your decision. You can take your time and stick around here for a while.
At least, you won't have to face the future alone anymore.
You're right. We're partners.
I received a precious gift while traveling with you—the courage to face reality and move on.
There's something else I want to give you besides the ID card, {PlayerName}.
I was out of inspiration towards the end, but finally managed to finish it after coming back to Honami and getting some ideas.
So this is what you were working on during recovery.
Yes. It's a pretty tricky piece, so I ended up using a lot of paper. Looks very much like Honami, don't you think?
My hometown was built next to the Tacet Field created by Honami's fall. Even though the Lament still haunts us, some stubborn souls have rebuilt that familiar Tower again.
We still reach for the sky. Still hope radio waves break through the blockade to connect the isolated regions left behind...
The painful memories of home will never fade. But I won't turn away from the beautiful ones, either. Together... they are what make me Kuchiba Chisa.
This is my thank-you gift to you. Something precious to me... A memory of my home.
I'll hold on to it.
I just remembered... Namipon always said the cafe needed more life. Maybe now is the time to try?
Like you said, I have time to "stick around" for a while. So would it be alright if I invite your friends from the Black Shores here for a party?
Before I make any decisions on what to do next, I want Shashou Cafe to celebrate a real "opening day."

Under the cherry blossoms, Chisa returns your old student ID, revealing that you too once attended Startorch Academy in the past. Still, what matters more to her is the you she met in Honami, and she wants to know you better. You tell her stories of your adventures in Rinascita, and she confides her own uncertainties about the future. Your response moves her, and she says she's drawn strength from the journey you've shared. She then gives you a gift: an intricate kirigami of her hometown she made during her recovery in the Black Shores. A piece filled with feeling and memory. Finally, she suggests inviting your Black Shores friends to the cafe to celebrate a real "opening day."
Pink petals swirl upon the wind like drifting thoughts, gently filling the space between hearts.
Why not stay a little longer, in this long season, along the streets we once walked, here in Honami...
Ah, {PlayerName}. Perfect timing. There's something you need to know.
Since we took charge of the Honami Sonoro Sphere, we've been noticing some changes on the inside—
The link between Honami and the real world is stabilizing, and the city's time flow is almost in sync.
But scans from Tethys indicate that much of the recent frequency exchanges weren't passing through this rift.
Meaning?
Meaning it could either just be a misreading due to overlapping data, or... there's another access point to the Honami Sonoro Sphere.
On top of that, the city's buzzing with unidentified phenomena and unconfirmed hazard zones. We'll continue to monitor them closely and run further analysis.
By the way, how's Chisa doing?
She's just completed her treatment. Everything seems to be all right. Her Rabelle's Curve is within normal parameters, and there are no significant lingering Overclocking symptoms.
That said, I don't recommend repeating what happened in Honami. That level of Resonance strain is unsustainable.
Ah, excuse me.
...Yes. Mm-hmm. Got it. {Male=He;Female=She}'s with me right now.
I just got a call that Chisa submitted an itinerary not long ago and left for Honami alone.
Why would she go back?
She didn't specify. All she wrote was "I want to go back."
You can find her guide KU-Roro in the Haven of Sprouts. It may know something.
I'll go check it out. Knowing Chisa, she usually doesn't act without purpose.

Some time later, you return to the Black Shores to visit Chisa. Valentina tells you that the connection between Honami's Sonoro and the real world is stabilizing. Chisa has completed her treatment and shows no serious lingering Overclocking symptoms. However, she recently went back to Honami alone for reasons unknown. Her guide, KU-Shosho, might know more.
With Chisa's treatment over, you once again return to the Black Shores...
So, do you want to hang around a bit longer, or shall we head back? I'll follow your lead.
There's something I want to ask.
Let's go for another walk.
It's getting late. Let's head back to the cafe.
Is there something else you'd like to know? We've got plenty of time.
About your Overclocking symptoms...
About when I was a student at Startorch Academy...
About that cassette tape...
That's it for now.
Are you worried about me? I'm feeling all right for the time being.
Not pretending to be okay, right?
Not when I'm with you. The people at the Black Shores called it a miracle. That someone who was on the verge of Overclocking for so long could recover. But...
When we passed through Honami's rift, I felt a warm frequency flowing toward me. I suspect that's what helped stabilize my Resonance energy.
Was it...
It was the person who brought you to Honami... In the end, the same person pulled me back from the edge. Again.
I'm sorry. I was only a first-year student in Engineering. I hadn't been around long enough. Everything I heard about you came from what others said.
All I really heard was that you were popular. Always had friends around. If I hadn't been caught in the Honami incident, we probably would've never met.
The ones from Startorch aren't the average cassettes that you normally see. They are specialized equipment used to store frequencies.
One of the instructors described it as a frequency backup storage for the holder. It records the person's very "existence."
Why make backups of frequencies?
It's one of the Academy's safety precautions against the <te href=850080>Waveworn Phenomenon</te>. That is all that I know.
Come on, then. We should spruce the place up a bit to give our friends a warm welcome.
Anything else you'd like to know? As long as it's within my authority, I can answer.
About Honami's time flow...
About Chisa's stay at the Black Shores...
About the Bloom Bearer Sumika...
That's all for now.
After Honami was devastated, energy from the Lament sealed the entire city into a unique Sonoro Sphere like congealed amber. Its time flow was slowed down compared to the rest of the world.
A similar case would be Mt. Firmament. Being on the inside for a day means up to a hundred days might have passed on the outside.
But it's not permanent. As Honami's connection to reality grows stronger, the flow of time begins to restore itself.
You getting sucked into Honami through that rift has got Shorekeeper worried sick, and she's been closely monitoring everything that's going on over there since.
Good thing is, at that point, Honami's time flow was no longer that different from the real world. So to us, you were only gone for just a bit.
While she was recovering, Chisa applied for partial access to the Black Shores database, mainly to learn general knowledge and modern trends.
We also saw her strolling around the living area and taking a look at the facilities occasionally, just like a lot of the New Branches when they first get here.
The KU-Roro responsible for taking care of her can fill you in if you want to know more.
Sumika is a member of the Black Shores who went M.I.A. many years ago. We dispatched a team on a search and rescue, but nothing solid came of it.
The report Chisa submitted to us has detailed Sumika's operations and engagements in Honami.
She was one of the most outstanding researchers of the Error Cell, and an elite Bloom Bearer who made the Black Shores proud.
The Stellar Matrix will forever remember her noble pursuit of truth.
Come to think of it, this is the first time I'm here at this cafe while wide awake.
You sure it's not because you've been putting in more nap hours lately?
Says who? I got locked out by the Sonoro Sphere right from the start, remember? I couldn't even get to you. And don't get me started on all the wacky frequencies that I got mixed in with...
You did a great job. Welcome to Shashou Cafe, Abby.
...Whoa, why the formality all of a sudden? Ahem. So you asked Shorekeeper to invite the Black Shores gang over for a party. They should be here pretty soon, right?
Yep. Let's go check on Chisa and see how the decorating is going.

The next day, you and Abby arrive near Shashou Cafe. It is Abby's first time visiting this coffeehouse. You have already asked Shorekeeper to notify your friends in the Black Shores, and they should be arriving soon.
Gotta hand it to ya, I love what you guys did with the place. Feels like a mini festival in here!
Oh, you're here. Namipon and I are just making finishing touches to the party.
Welcome aboard, Abby.
Well, hello there, Chisa. It's nice to see you again. You're all so kind, you know. Say, whatcha got on the menu—
In the cozy cafe, vibrant lights dance on the walls. Soft chimes whisper. Glad to have you aboard again, Passenger.
Chisa's the Acting Manager today, and she'll be our host for the opening party.
Wait a minute... Something smells funny about this guy!
This frequency isn't Echo or TD. Feels like it's hiding a whole mixed bag in its fuzzy tummy!
It's the cafe's mascot.
It's the guardian of Honami City.
You say that, but I don't trust it. Hey, ain't there a whole lot more of you around here too?
Would you like to join us in putting up the decorations, Passenger?
Gladly.
Love to help.
And it's completely ignoring me! Now it even chats up {PlayerName} like they're old buddies or something...
Ah, the place is starting to turn into a party now.
Is something wrong with your friend?
No idea.
Abby's just a little excited today, that's all.
After being an emergency shelter for so long, it's finally starting to become what it was supposed to be.
I'll let you finish these last few decorations, {PlayerName}.

Chisa and Namipon have already decorated the cafe for the opening party. Right away, Abby finds Namipon suspicious and uneasy, seeing how close you and Namipon are. As the two face off, an unaware Chisa asks you to help place the final decorations.
Passenger, Chisa was the one who proposed the party. She has put lots of effort into preparations.
For this, I'd like to prepare a surprise—a special ornament just for her. Any recommendations?
Maybe something related to her?
Maybe something that she likes?
Agreed. It must be something that would let all the Passengers know Chisa is the manager of the day at first glance.
Ah, yes. It must be something that Chisa would fall in love with immediately.
And just like that, after a little tinkering here and some cuts there, Namipon hands you the ornament it just finished…
Namipon privately tells you it wants to surprise Chisa with a special piece of decor. With your input, it finishes the special piece in secret...
What's... this?
Oh, it's a standee of the cafe's manager. I made it with the lingering frequencies around.
{PlayerName}, do you like... No, what do you think of it?
As stylish as the original.
As cute as the original.
Fits in perfectly with everything around it.
You even included my weapon... Let's leave it here then.
Did you say... c-cute? Um, I guess just leave it like this, then.
If you think it fits, then... alright.
When Chisa sees the life-sized cutout of herself placed at the cafe entrance, she falls silent in astonishment. She then turns and asks your opinion of it...
Ah, this was left here by Passenger 3.
Passenger 3?
Passenger 1 is Chisa. You're Passenger 2. As for Passenger 3... Ahem...
Passenger 3 is the relentless seeker of truth. She never gave up her quest.
You see a glistening piece of amber on the bar counter. It reminds you of someone you once met.
This appears to be a gallery set up by Chisa. It displays scenes from around Honami, and pictures she took with people she holds dear...
*Light, upbeat melody*
Good afternoon, Honami. You're tuned in to your city radio, broadcasting live on a warm summer breeze.
As the temps slowly climb, looks like that midsummer heat is comin' in hot. But don't sweat it. Up next, we've got a special announcement.

Our meteor trackers are lighting up. Looks like a shower is set to dazzle just after midnight tonight. For anyone up for a little stargazing, grab your friends and family to catch this "Midnight Summer Magic Show."
Coming up next, here's a list of the best viewing spots across the city...
(So the seasons in Honami that stood still are flowing again...)
Maintain eye contact... Smile... Greet everyone as they come in...
Feeling a bit nervous?
Hello, Acting Manager. You there?
A little bit. I'm... I'm just reviewing the basics of greeting guests.
I'm listening. I'm just reviewing the basics of greeting guests.
Shashou Cafe is like "home" to me in Honami. Honestly, i-it's been a long time since I hosted anyone at home.
I think the last time was… sometime in high school.
Just greet everyone like you'd greet me.
To me, you're different from everyone else.
I-I didn't give it much thought at the time. Anyway... I need to pull myself together. A manager must stay composed.
You greeted me just fine.
Different?
Thank you for lending us a hand with the decorations, Passenger. I'm sure the others will be very pleased.
(Have a look around the cafe.)
(Wait for your friends to arrive.)
No, not at all. We're glad you made it, Shorekeeper. Shashou Cafe welcomes you aboard!
I see.
Mmm...
Oh, say something, Passenger. This awkward silence is killing me...
Sounds like you two already met at the Black Shores.
Yes. Shorekeeper personally oversaw all of the routine checkups during my recovery. She was very helpful.
Chisa remained on the verge of Overlocking for a prolonged period within a distorted temporal flow. Her case required a full evaluation by the Tethys System.
Now it's suddenly turned into a conversation about work...
Hi, Boss! Heard you bought the whole place out?
She's the manager.
I'm just a customer like you are.
Very good lah! My reading for you said visitors from all around, wealth coming in thick and fast. Super lucky day for an opening!
You must be Buling?
I've heard about you from {PlayerName}. You're the one who helped pinpoint Honami's rift. Thank you.
It's no biggie. Me and Boss, we go way back. Just treat me to a good meal and we're even.
Good to meet you, Chisa. And this floating one here... Hmm...
I'm the cafe's mascot. Call me Namipon.
Hello, Namipon. You show the way? Been walking until my legs go jelly. Need to sit and rest a while.
{PlayerName}, Chisa. I have arrived as scheduled.
I see you're all waiting here. Could I be mistaken about the time?

Not long after, Shorekeeper arrives. It turns out Chisa already met her while recovering in the Black Shores. Later, Buling arrives and lightens the mood. Although Chisa has heard of her from you, this is their first meeting. Namipon then leads Buling inside.
Ah, Bloom Bearer. Ms. Chisa has been gone for some time now.
Did you notice anything strange when she left?
She was only visiting the nearby facilities, like she normally does. But I had noticed her emotional readings had been low for a while.
She used to enjoy reading the archives, but in the past few days, I saw her staring off into the distance or performing kirigami.
Kirigami...?
Ah, yes. Making small art crafts by cutting paper. There are still a few left on this table. She usually always cleaned up afterward, but this time...
(These look like scraps from all the paper cutting. And this one here is a half-finished tower... It looks kind of familiar.)
After submitting her leave, I even asked her if she would like someone to accompany her on her travels, to which she refused.
I see.
I'll go find Chisa.
Please. I leave Ms. Chisa in your care.
Kuku... Why did she leave in such a hurry? Should I clean this up?

KU-Shosho explains that Chisa usually rests at the Haven of Sprouts, but has been in low spirits lately. She left in a hurry without even cleaning up her kirigami on the table. This unusual behavior prompts you to search for her in Honami.
Would you like to start off with something to drink?
Anything would be fine, thank you.
Is that...?
Oh... No need to mind that.
Very well. I shall follow the proper code of this cafe, and prevent eye contact with your standee.
Wait, I... I didn't mean that.
Why not take a seat?
It's okay, I'm just admiring the feng shui. Mmm, bright and open, good for drawing in fortune. Hard to find one so lucky.
There's no safer place in all of Honami.
Speaking of Honami... I actually came to see if any special Reverberations were hiding in the city ruins.
But after coming here... It's really quiet. You won't find another place like this in the outside world.
Is that good or bad?
A good thing, of course.
It means that lots of "people" here let go of whatever they were holding onto. Just poof, all gone!
...Oh yeah, the coffee beans haven't been changed in ages, right? Next time I'll bring some of my favorite blends for you to try.
Buling tells you that Honami feels quiet, likely because many of the "people" who once lived there have already faded away.
Here you go. I hope it's to your liking.
Thank you.
It's... a bit bitter. But nothing I can't bear.
Sounds like it needs more sugar.
How does it compare to the strong tea you had before?
It's all right. I rather think of it as a novelty.
I have to say that the tea was much more bitter.
Now then... {PlayerName}, Chisa. The Black Shores has conducted another investigation on Startorch Academy, the school that you both once attended.
As of now, we can confirm that the Academy, along with the entire region of Lahai-Roi, has been completely isolated from the rest of the world by the <te href=851070>Void Storm</te>.
The Void Storm?
A Waveworn Phenomenon unique to Lahai-Roi. When it's active, any form of communication is blocked.
So you're saying... right now there's no way for us to reach the Academy?
Oh, you're all here. How come I wasn't invited to the party?
I thought you couldn't make it.
Don't be silly. Seeing you is always my No. 1 priority.
Camellya, shouldn't you be on a mission?
Got it done early. And I would've finished it even sooner if someone had told me a city popped up off the coast of the Black Shores.
So... you must be Chisa?
...Hello.
I saw the report on Honami. Oh, it's such a shame I wasn't there for the excitement.
You wouldn't mind having an extra girl at your party, would you? I'd like to make up for all the fun I missed.

After trying the cafe's coffee, Shorekeeper shares news about Startorch Academy: the region of Lahai-Roi, where the Academy is located, has been sealed off by the Void Storm, making normal travel there impossible. As you and Chisa absorb this information, a familiar companion arrives. It's Camellya, who finished her mission early and rushed over as soon as she heard about Honami and your situation.
A city doomed to be destroyed again and again. Irideglow that triggers Overclocking, and TDs tearing through the streets...
But never mind that. You're here. I'm here. The two of us can dance... doesn't that sound a lot more fun?
Oh, {PlayerName}. If I got pulled in too, how much more fun would that have been!
Don't get ahead of yourself. The crisis is over.
I'll take it as a yes, then.
Fine, if you say so. I'll take those extra performances off the table, then.
Anyway, pushing through the pain of Overclocking and mastering the shiver of death clawing at your spine... I spy with my little eye a promising seed.
Interested in trying a little "germination test," Chisa? A little eval I host, just for the brave.
Eval as in...?
Defeat me, or be defeated.
Is this... some kind of tradition in the Black Shores?
Relax, dearie. Don't get worked up just yet. Hehe, you can show me your dance moves once you're fully recovered.

Camellya imagines how exciting it would have been to explore Honami with you, saying she wishes she had been dragged into the crisis with you. Seeing Chisa's potential, she invites her to take part in the "germination test" she will hold once Chisa has fully recovered.
Nom-nom-nom. Ya know, it must be really rough for you. Having your frequency get split into pieces like that, and then clearing your head of all the clicking and buzzing.
That's all in the past now. How's the Rice Dango?
Not bad, actually. Soft and chewy. Well... I guess I shouldn't have judged a Namipon by its smell.
Plus, you've been a big help to {PlayerName} these past few days. I'll come give you a hand after I'm done with this Dango.
That's lovely! We'll take all the help we can get.
With the help of a Rice Dango, Abby and Namipon bury the hatchet. Feeling a little guilty, Abby offers to help Namipon with the rest of the party prep.
We... doing food prep for the party... Huge cake for opening... Keep up the good work... Yay...
Where did all this food come from?
Big-pon helped gather them... All local pure Remnants... 100% natural... Additive free...
*Light, upbeat melody*
...We have a special guest with us today—
Well hello to all the lovely listeners of the Pioneer Podcast. It's your old pal, Aalto.
Glad to have you. Mr. Aalto, why don't you start us off with the Lilyland incident?
It all happened during the Troupe of Fools' big tour. Tickets were already pretty cheap, but scalpers hogged them all and were ripping off unsuspecting fans.
Not the first time they've done something like this, actually.
After Brant, the head of the Troupe, found out about it, he put on a disguise one night and snuck into their hideout. "Retrieved" all the tickets and bills as evidence right under their noses.
It was bye-bye scalpers! Brant offered free tickets to all the fans that came to watch their play. Such a happy ending.
Well it sounds awfully like Brant did most of the work, Mr. Aalto. So... So what exactly was your role in all of this?
Ah-ha-ha... Well, I supplied Brant with intel on the hideout, of course. I was undercover and it all happened right in front of me.
(So this radio can receive signals from outside of Honami now?)

The radio suddenly picks up a signal from outside the Sonoro. On a talk show hosted by the Pioneer Association, special guest Aalto recounts an incident he dealt with in Lilyland, where someone attempted to resell the Troupe of Fools' tour tickets at outrageous prices...
Everyone's here, and the food and drinks are almost ready. Shall we start the party?
Let's get this party started.
In a bit.
Now then, I believe it's safe to say I can finally go for a recharge...
Photo time's over.
Do the honors, Acting Manager.
Mmm-hmm.
(In this Honami summer night, I wish—)
(For the moments spent with friends to last forever.)
Hey!
Gimme that.
MINE!
Whoa!
Careful!
What's the matter?
Are the others on their way?
From the guest list you provided, only Encore, Buling, and myself were free to come. The others are either away or currently on assignment.
Encore... She locked herself in her room and insisted on finishing Tethys's assigned homework.
I can't imagine how much homework that must be...
Tell her it's time for another holiday.
Apologies. I didn't expect her to suddenly become so... competitive. It's a first, truly.
That I tried. Encore kept insisting she finish it, even remarking, "Your time has come, big bad homework!"
Yeah, that's Encore alright...
Is Encore that little girl with pink hair? I helped her with some math problems over at the Haven of Sprouts once.
She's a quick learner. She understood all the formulas I taught her in no time.
So you were Encore's new tutor.
That explains why she's picking a fight with Tethys.
There's still time before the party begins. Why don't we go inside and have a seat?

From Shorekeeper, you learn that no other guests are expected. Of everyone invited, only Shorekeeper, Encore, and Buling were able to come. Encore turned down the invite, choosing instead to finish the homework assigned by the Tethys System. Her newfound dedication to studying might be because Chisa tutored her in math during her time spent in the Haven of Sprouts...
Still grumpy about earlier?
As if! I told you, there's something off about that furball. It's like the frequencies of people's emotions all got balled up together like a... like a wad of bubble gum.
But then again... I didn't pick up anything bad from it though.
Be nice to the mascot, Abby.
A-Alright, alright, if you say so. I guess a chat wouldn't hurt.
You'll get along just fine.
The Aetherfin shows you a holographic reconstruction of the event that occurred here—
You see a girl looking off into the distance, her eyes lost in the blue sky. What could she be thinking?
You're awake, dear Passenger.
The morning after the opening party, you wake up on the cafe sofa...
Anything you'd like to know, Passenger? I'm here to help anytime.
About last night's view...
About what happened after the party...
That's it for now.
Mmm, it was the surprise "we" prepared, and Honami's way of answering everyone's wishes.
The city is free from its sorrow. Time isn't stuck anymore. That was... a little epilogue after the "real ending." And a happy one.
Actually... we had a big meteorite scare. Their original trajectory would have wiped out the whole Crossing.
But you and Chisa gathered everyone's strength and turned that big scary rock… into a sky full of stardust…
Then you curled up here in the cafe and took a nice, long nap. Chisa woke up first and watched you sleeping for a while.
You sure that's what happened?
Wait a minute, are you making this up?
Oops, guess you got me there. But that last part is true, though.
The wall is covered with pictures from Shashou Cafe's opening day—
Although the time you spent with your friends was short, every moment was captured forever. Now it feels clear and close enough to see and touch.
Good morning, {PlayerName}.
Good morning, Chisa.
Can I get you something to drink, Passenger?
It feels like we're back to our adventuring days in Honami.
I already had a cup of coffee this morning. And please stop trying to be Namipon.
That was a perfect wrap for our opening party. It was a very special night.
A fitting conclusion for everything that's happened over the past two months, a celebration for the cafe's opening, and... a commemoration for meeting new friends.
Even if we were to say farewell now, I wouldn't have any regrets.
Farewell?
So you've made a decision?
Yes. I have decided what I'll do next.
I will return home first and find my parents. After that, Startorch Academy, to complete my studies.
Neither will be easy, but I will overcome whatever stands in my way, just like... how we did together in that Tower.
"Nothing can trap me... I'll find my way back."
That's right. Nothing can stop you.
We'll be going our separate ways for a while. But I'm sure when this is all over, you and I will see each other again.
No... when the time comes, I promise I'll come looking for you.
Then again, I won't be leaving right away. The Black Shores still wants me back for a few health checkups.
What do you say I join the Black Shores during this time just like Camellya suggested?
That one was a joke. Now comes the real part.
Thank you, {PlayerName}... Thank you for everything you've done for me.

With the opening party a success, Chisa seems more at ease. She shares with you her plans. She wants to return home to find her parents first, and then go back to Startorch Academy to finish her studies. Neither will be easy, but she believes she can overcome the challenge just as she did with you in Neon Tower. Though saddened by the coming farewell, she trusts that you will meet again once everything is settled.
Whoa, why are your frequencies leaking all over the place?!
Grrr!
It's like... something's pulling them out...
Is that...
Startorch Academy?
Your frequency loss has been contained for now. How are you feeling?
Much better.
Abby's out cold. I think I'm next.
I'm glad to hear that. Your vitals are also within normal parameters now.
How can that be...? The readings tell me your vitals are within normal parameters now.
Hey, I'm still wide awake ya know, just a little beat. And this part of you feels completely empty.
The connection between your frequency and the rift has been cut off. You are out of immediate danger.
Why did my frequency start to dissipate?
What was trying to siphon my frequency?
We are unable to confirm at this time. But frequency signatures identical to the <te href=851070>Void Storm</te> were detected in the rift's proximity.
The most likely scenario is that this rift is acting as a conduit between here and the Lahai-Roi region, which is also where your frequency was drawn to.
Lahai-Roi is where it all started. Guess we'll need to pay the place a visit to find out the actual cause.
The Void Storm at Startorch was what brought me to Honami in the first place. Now it's the other way around.
Do you suppose this rift can take us straight to Lahai-Roi?
Is that a viable option?
Theoretically, yes. However, the frequencies inside the rift are highly unstable, and you are likely to lose your way without proper navigation.
I'm afraid now is not the appropriate time.
Ugh, this part of you feels completely empty. Let me check that out for you.

Some time later, a team from the Black Shores arrives. Shorekeeper checks your condition and confirms your vitals are stable, and the frequency loss you experienced has stopped. The leading theory is that the sudden spatial rift acts as a conduit to Lahai-Roi, the very region where your frequency was drawn. Investigating that region may be the only way to discover the root cause. Chisa suggests using the rift as a direct route, but the Shorekeeper warns it is too unstable and unsafe for travel for now.
Phew, never thought I'd actually be here, standing in the post-apocalyptic city from the storybooks I read when I was a kid.
Hello?
Hi, there, Bloom Bearer. I've collected some frequency samples and am analyzing them now.
Got anything so far?
Yep. Aside from the Void Storm readings we got around the rift, we also found scattered foreign frequencies in the vicinity.
What might have happened is that frequencies from another region got "spat out" into Honami when the rift was formed.
Another region... as in Lahai-Roi?
That's right. We still need to verify their exact origins, but the general areas are pretty much narrowed down.
"Safety risk, moderate. Further surveillance is needed." That'll do as the report for Valentina for now.
Notice anything unusual?
The rift seems to be in a stasis. No Tacet Discords popping out of it, at least.
But I've recognized a few flashing images within the rift.
Is it Startorch Academy?
Yes. Most information about that school is highly classified.
I only know what I do because a friend of mine is an instructor there, but we've been out of touch for a long time.
So this is where the radio went...
What's with all that noise it's making?
Oh, you're here. Look what I found.
Spotted it next to the rift. Here, listen to this—
This time... we... as our guest.
The thing's not even turned on, but it's been playing these choppy sounds non-stop.
I see the problem here... Try adjusting its receiver, Passenger.
Near the rift, Platya finds the radio Chisa had taken outside the cafe earlier. It's now emitting heavy static. Namipon, seeming to recall something, asks you to adjust the receiver.
{PlayerName}, what are you doing here? Are you... looking for me?
There you are.
Well, someone left her sick bed, so I came to check on her.
I'm sorry for not staying at the Black Shores and resting as I should.
What made you decide to come back?
But these are just conditions that made this possible. As for the true reason...
I wanted to see what's become of Honami... since the loop ended.
Strolling through the streets, I realize that this is my first time seeing the city as a tourist, despite being trapped here for months.
No more worrying when the next Lament will come. No more desperate reach for Neon Tower. Now, I can simply wander around. No burdens.
The Lament left scars. They won't fade. But what was once frozen in time... seems to be moving again.
This is the new future that we and everyone who once lived here forged together.
A new... future, you say?
By the way, I asked the Black Shores to help me verify the academy I once attended and dig into my records.
They didn't reach the school directly, but... I found out something. I was in Honami for around two months. Outside, over twenty years have passed.
Kuchiba Chisa... was a first-year student at <te href=851069>Startorch Academy</te> over twenty years ago.
...Over twenty years ago?
Yes. I had a feeling this would be the case when Sumika mentioned her findings, but I didn't expect such a huge time difference.
The nice orientation ceremony... still feels recent. But the classmates I met have long since graduated.
When I tried to contact my parents back home, I realized there was no way for me to reach them at all.
Where are they? What have they been doing? How will they react if they find out that their daughter is still alive... I have no way of knowing.
Now this place feels more like home than the world out there.
It just takes some time to get used to an unfamiliar environment.
Since you're here, would you walk with me? I'd like to see what Honami looks like now... together.
Any particular places you have in mind?
I haven't come up with an exact plan yet. Specific routes, time of travel, rest locations... None.
Just as I thought. I'm not my usual self today.
Hey, it's just a "weekend getaway." No plans needed. Just get up and go.
If you put it that way...
How about that lake surrounded by cherry blossoms?
I'm in stable shape, and the Black Shores approved my temporary travel.
Just ask the Black Shores to help you keep digging. With enough time, you're bound to find those connections again.

After some searching, you find Chisa on the pedway. She opens up about what's been troubling her—While she spent only two months in Honami, more than twenty years passed in the outside world. Unsure how to face a world that now feels unfamiliar, she asks you to walk with her for a while, perhaps... to the lake surrounded by cherry blossoms.
Something's probably broken inside. I'll take a look.
Namipon, was that a live signal from Lahai-Roi?
Yes, it was. That cassette we put inside lets it receive radio signals from the rift.
With the right tweak, maybe I can track it. Like I did with Neon Tower's—
It sounded like the Academy's radio talk show... But why did I hear my mother?
Does that mean she's at Startorch? Why is she there? Is she... looking for me?
Chisa?
(Chisa will need some time to process everything.)
I am detecting a unique frequency from this radio...
It has formed a connection with Lahai-Roi on the other end of the rift.
Once it's all fixed up, I can piggyback on this frequency and plot coordinates from there to Honami.
Understood. With established coordinates, you will be able to navigate your way within the rift.
The Black Shores will also assist with stabilizing the rift to ensure your safety as much as possible.
...Should you decide to travel to Lahai-Roi. To Startorch Academy.
What do you know about Lahai-Roi?
Lahai-Roi has been mentioned a lot in passing lately.
It is a region once forgotten, covered in snow most of the year and sparsely populated. No Sentinel is there to guide its civilization.
Beneath its ice fields lie Startorch Academy and numerous research facilities, built by a multinational alliance known as the <te href=851071>Spacetrek Collective</te>.
Startorch Academy enacts a strict access protocol for all personnel. I will have the necessary paperwork in place before your departure.
Looks like I need to make changes to my plans...
I want to go back to Startorch Academy.
My family is there, and so are my instructors and classmates. The future may be uncertain, but I know what I have to do.
We'll find the missing frequencies.
We'll find out the truth.
We'll return to the Academy we attended.
Now, we wait. And then...
We get through this together.
*Static noises*
*Static*... The universe... has rejected us...
...Is this the answer you've been seeking, {PlayerName}?
I hope to make you proud. I hope I haven't let you down...

It turns out to be a Startorch Academy radio program, and the guest is Chisa's mother, who is currently at the Academy. By tracing the signal, Namipon can pinpoint Lahai-Roi's relative coordinates. With support from the Black Shores, securing safe passage through the rift may soon be possible. Since her family is at the Academy, Chisa changes her plan and decides to return there first. You, too, have your own reasons for going. Lahai-Roi is now your next destination.
As you prepare to leave, a mysterious voice suddenly cuts through the radio...
Is something wrong, {PlayerName}? Why did you turn back?
I heard a voice on the radio just now.
I heard someone calling my name.
A voice from the radio? But isn't it broken?
You did? I'm right next to you, but... I don't think I heard anything.
You sure you didn't hear anything strange?
Yes. You must be exhausted. Should we go back to the cafe?
I guess I could use some rest.
No need. I'm fine.
(I don't think I was imagining it... that voice.)
Strangely, Chisa, standing beside you, doesn't hear it. But you're certain it wasn't your imagination.
Next up... Ehhh, gotta fix this radio.
So you and Chisa can get to school okay, I'm gonna use... a dozen Rice Dangos' worth of effort.
It'll be an investigation. We're not going to school.
That's a strange unit of measurement...
Okay, okay. When you get to Lahai-Roi, take care of each other, alright?
Are you really not coming with us?
Nope. I'm a Namipon from Honami. This is where I stay.
I'll look after the cafe while you're away. It'll always be here when you need to rest.
Oh, man... Why you gotta bring up the emotional talk out of the blue?
It means I'm trying really hard.
I will be using my powers to stabilize the rift's channel.
Did you hear any voices on the radio earlier?
No, to my ears the radio has been silent.
However, I was able to sense a peculiar frequency for a brief moment.
It felt independent from the Honami Sonoro Sphere, as if... it existed beyond a singular dimension.
I remember this Crossing. When I was little, my younger sister and I once snuck out to play in the shopping mall. Oh, we had a blast that whole afternoon...
So Honami is your hometown?
Yes, it is. I was on a train leaving Honami when the Lament struck. I, uh... I had a fight with my parents.
I'm sorry.
You still look really young...
Oh, don't be. That was years ago.
My Resonance ability might not be the strongest out there, but it gives me plenty of time to feel the world.
In the real world, all that's left of Honami is this giant Tacet Field. But inside this Sonoro Sphere, it still exists.
To me, the things I need to do stay the same. Collect Reverberations, analyze traces of the Lament, and then... search for the truth.
Did I... fall asleep?
Yes, you did. Everyone had a fantastic time last night.
After saying goodbye to your friends, you got tired and decided to take a rest in the cafe.
(I did...?)
(The only thing I remember is what happened right before watching the meteor shower.)
What's the matter? Did you not sleep well?
Where's Chisa?
Chisa...
Hehe, Chisa woke up before you. She tiptoed out for some fresh air. Said she didn't want to bother you.

Namipon explains that you fell asleep after seeing your friends off, though you have no memory of what happened after watching the meteor shower. When you ask about Chisa, you learn that she woke up earlier and went outside for some air.
If not mistaken, the sounds will become clearer once you've adjusted it to the right frequency.
(Let's give this a try then.)
(Adjust the knob clockwise)
(Adjust the knob counter-clockwise)
Hmm, that doesn't seem right. Try the other way.
(In that case...)
Oh, oh! There you go!
*Static*... Mrs. Kuchiba, would you mind sharing with us why you chose this particular design... *static*... of the Academy's new uniform?
Huh?
The inspiration came from... well, my daughter. She once made a cutout of this pattern from some old fabric at home...
...Very interesting... *static*... It really captures the Academy's spirit...
*Static*... If it's this uniform, I thought... my little Chisa would love to wear it...
*Loud whistle*
*Complete silence*
After some tuning, the signal clears. The broadcast is an interview about school uniforms, and Chisa recognizes who the guest speaker is...
I've never mentioned it before, but the buildings and infrastructure here... they remind me of the neighborhood I grew up in.
Brings back old memories?
Yes. Even just walking around here brings back memories.
That vending machine looks like it's still working.
I'll buy you some juice as a thank you for the hassle you went through to find me.
Space has just been sliced again.
The temperature's dropping, but there's no frost or ice anywhere. Could it mean this "Tower" really is absorbing warmth from human bodies, just like Sumika suspected?
Over there... I see something.
(Pick up the research report)
(Test No. 20 again...)
Who's there?!
What is this—?!
Is it running to...
…the very heart of the Lament?
These Fractsidus operatives... Looks like they're also among the Left Behind.
So they've become part of their own experiment... trapped in a loop they can't even recognize.
That's why they've been repeating Test No. 20.
Obsesssion... Too lighhhht... too lighhhht! Can't suppressss... the forgetting...
No, no... Too heaaaaavy... heaaaavy... heaaavy...
Too much... pain... Nooo... not here...
Must return... Must... GO—!
No, take me back to ████...!
Mom, I think I painted the tree crooked again...
Not at all, sweetheart. It's beautiful—Wait, GET AWAY FROM THE WINDOW!
Oh come on, you're lost again? Wait, what's that...?
RUN! GO BACK! JUST RUN!
Quick, hold my hand... HOLD MY HAND! Don't be scared, don't be scared...
Wrap your arms around my neck! On three... One, two...
No, Daddy! You promised to bring the puppy!
Three! Jump—now!
It's the helicopter again! Hurry! Wave the sheet... No! They didn't see us!
No... there's no time for last words...
It's alright... Daddy will be back when you count to one thousand... Haruka... Don't fall asleep... Stay awake...
Take the last candle...
It's okay... I'll find the way back...
Stay with me... don't go...
Losssst… it hurrrts… but you… you still…
Get ouuuut... of my waaayyyyy...
Let me… go hooome…
Chisa?
DON'T GO!
CHISA! COME BACK!
TURN AROUND AND GRAB MY HAND!
Chisa...
Is she inside that space now?
Sabotage—Damn it, we were so close!
Let me… GO HOOOME—!
Membership... Appraisal... Hmm, more fancy words....
Guess she's not the type to sit back and relax...
Every single one of these wind chimes carried someone's wish. Their ringing was like a prayer.
But now, everyone who made those wishes and anyone who might've made them come true... they're all gone.
The one who can make their wishes come true...
Isn't that you?
I… I can't make anyone's wish come true. What can I do?
Maybe people didn't make wishes here just so someone could fulfill them.
...Maybe they did it just to be heard. To share their joy and their sorrow. The wish itself is proof that they were here. A message for anyone who comes after.
And now... we can hear them too. Isn't that enough?
...You're a special soul. You really live up to that "Dark Justice" title, too. Thank you. I... I needed to hear that.
That title...
Please drop it.
Afraid not! Naming the hero is a privilege of the people.
Come on, let's go. We've got more locations to shoot!
I remember a huge bed of hydrangeas right by this tennis court...
TDs! Be careful!
I was scared me to death. TDs, in the residential area! {PlayerName}, thank goodness you were here!
Must be that dense Remnant Energy that pulled them in and changed the landscape… But it's not all bad. We got some amazing shots out of it.
You seem to know a lot...
...about Honami's past.
Of course I do. I'm part of that past.
This city, me, and everyone else still wandering here... we were all lost in the disaster. What's left are only remnants of the past.
I'm sorry. I didn't mean to hide it. I just... couldn't find the words.
You meant no harm.
...Don't be sorry.
You've already figured it out, haven't you? Or... did you know from the start?
No.
I realized it from the way you spoke and acted.
The Left Behind in Honami don't see Neon Tower's distortion. They don't remember the Lament that struck either.
They just... go on, repeating their old lives and memories in this Sonoro city.
But you remember everything. Why?
I can't say why exactly... but when the Lament came... I was aware of it. I felt my own end.
And in that instant, a single, powerful wish was born. I think... that wish is what's keeping me here.
I won't fade away. Not until I've seen it through. That's my choice.
So you came to me...
...to fulfill that wish?
...Yes. And with your help, it's almost within reach.
Alright, my sweet hero! Just one last place I want to photograph. Let's go.
This is the last one. Take the picture however feels right to you.
An ordinary neighborhood. An empty playground…
It's like everyone just... stepped out for a minute.
The last photo for the Honami City project is finally complete.
Could you deliver these to the Pioneer Association for me?
My application must be years overdue by now. Ah, just saying it out loud is so embarrassing!
I will. But... are you sure you don't want to be the one to do it?
I thought you'd want to see it to the end yourself.
...It's alright. I don't need to.
The truth is... I almost quit my appraisal. Halfway through.
When I joined the Association as an intern and saw what my peers were willing to do, I realized my dream was just a kid's fantasy. A naive admiration.
I couldn't do what they did. Staking their lives to photograph a dying city. I admired their passion... but I just didn't have it in me.
Compared to them, my resolve was a joke. So I came back to Honami, buried the project, and tried to forget.
But you couldn't forget.
You picked it back up.
...I couldn't bear the thought of Honami being forgotten. I refused to let that happen.
In that final moment, as I lay dying, I saw Honami's blue sky one last time. Saw the cherry blossoms falling as always...
Regret washed over me. And from it, a wish was born. Stronger than anything I'd ever felt.
...This city that I loved so much, its people, all of it... it didn't deserve to just vanish.
In that moment, I finally understood. The duty I walked away from... my friends at the Association...
They must have known this feeling. That's why they walked into danger. To record it all. To save something.
To save a civilization's memories.
To leave proof of existence.
...Yes. And completing this "Honami Photo Feature" with you is the last thing I can do for this city.
Your wish...
Is it fulfilled?
Yes. It is. Thank you, Dark Legend of Justice.
No... thank you, my friend. For helping me see it through.
You leave Honami City and deliver the photos to the Pioneer Association, along with Eri's membership application…
Hello again, Passenger! Hm? Where's the other Passenger?
She fulfilled her wish.
And left.
I see, I see. What a shame. I even had dessert ready for her. More for me, I suppose.
This is the reward she promised. She left it in my care for you.
Y'know, when she first wandered in here, she put on a cheerful face. But I could feel the weight on her.
On your little adventure together, did she get any happier?
...Yes.
She became happy.
Wonderful! After all, making sure Honami's people are happy is one of my duties, you know!
Welcome back, Passenger! Perfect timing! Someone came here looking for you. Said it's something important.
A customer in the coffeehouse?
Someone we know?
Yes! What a happy occasion!
Nope, a new face! Oh, this calls for a celebration!
Thanks to you and Chisa breaking Honami's loop, Shashou Cafe finally has a new visitor. Who knows, this cafe might just hum with life again.
About that customer…
Do you know anything else?
She said she's from the Pioneer Association. She seemed... troubled by a "membership appraisal."
We chatted. She asked about nice spots for pictures. I suggested the fountain.
The cherry blossoms there are in full bloom. They won the vote for... "Honami Crossing's Most Scenic Spot"!
Pioneer Association...
Membership...
Uh-huh. Whenever that came up, things got a bit heavy…
Too complicated. Not for a capybara like me. It's best you ask her yourself.
The cafe needs me, so I'll leave you to it, Passenger.
(Right. To the fountain it is.)
Maybe if I try a different angle, the photo would look better?
Hey, over here!
Hi, I'm Eri from the Pioneer Association. Finally, we meet!
(A Left Behind, but doesn't seem local. Where did she come from?)
(...Unusual. Better figure out her intentions first.)
I'm {PlayerName}.
Namipon said you were looking for me?
Ah, yes! The "Dark Legend of Justice"! Please, I have a request for you!
…"Dark Legend of Justice"?
Are you talking about me?
Of course! I recognized you immediately.
You're the "Mysterious Scissorswoman's" partner. The black-haired hero, Honami's newest urban legend!
It's not just that you're strong enough to fight the TDs. It's why you do it. People can see you're genuinely trying to protect this city.
Heh, "Mysterious Scissorswoman"...
Another bizarre nickname.
C'mon, legends need cool titles. It's part of the appeal!
Anyway, the real reason I sought you out is because I need your help with a project. I want to photograph Honami City.
This isn't just for fun. It's for my membership appraisal. I call myself a member of the Pioneer Association, but I'm technically still pending membership review.
Membership review?
Now things are getting heavy.
I've been a huge fan of Wutherium Geographic magazine since I was a kid. Joining the Pioneer Association as an editor? That's the dream.
But the Editorial Board has a crazy appraisal process. You have to pitch a project that aligns with the Association's mission, pull off a photoshoot, secure approval, and get it published.
I finally chose my theme, but now the streets are blocked, TDs are popping up everywhere, and my Terminal decided to die on me!
I was totally out of options until I started hearing about your heroics... Please, you have to help me! This is my one shot!
All right. I'll help you.
And the reward for all this?
Thank you, Dark Legend of Justice! Don't worry, I won't let you work for free!
Oh, don't worry. I'm not about to let a legendary hero work for free!
Let's get started then. Please, take a photo of this fountain at its absolute best.
This place... it used to be so full of life. You could see tired shoppers stopping by, listening to the water, stealing a moment of peace.

The Heliogyre's operations stand ready to perform primary verification tasks.
