The schedule is already very tight as is. If we keep rushing, my guys won't be able to handle it.
That's not up to me... but I'll see what I can do.
The inspection is just a few days away! Why are half of the buildings still unfinished? It's stressing me out!
The Blightcloud is constantly changing, so our blueprints keep changing too....
But we must persevere in order to keep Septimont safe!
You're right. I need to calm down and be patient...
I've been hauling construction materials in the city every day. My back is killing me.
On the bright side, the overtime we've done will help us meet the deadline.
That's right, we've done everything we can. The rest is for the Ephor to handle. What are you planning to do after this?
I want to rest. I don't want to do anything or think about anything. I just want to zone out in bed.
Based on our present construction speed, we'll miss the deadline.
Erisa, can I trouble you to work overtime for the next two days? Erisa? Are you listening?
Ah! Sorry, I was thinking of my little sister.
O-overtime, right? Sure, leave it to me!
Don't worry. Sarina is very capable. I'm sure she won't have any problem at her job.
That's why I'm worried. She's always been rather headstrong, and she hates following instructions.
It's her first job and she's working in the Ephor's Palace. I'm worried that she'll quarrel with her mentor...
...That's a possibility. I'll check how she's doing next time I report back to the city. Hopefully, everything's fine.
How was the hunt? Did anything unusual happen?
So many things happened. It'll take ages just to tell you about the Tacet Discords we saw driven mad by the Blightcloud.
All I can say is that the situation is even worse than we expected. Luckily, the Ephor had a backup plan or else we'd have been toast.
Yes, indeed. It must've been tough on you. Just submit your report, and go rest.
Rest early. There is a lot to do tomorrow.
I want to, but I can't sleep...
Missing home? Me too. Let's head back to the city together when we're done.
Erm... Actually, I'm just hungry.
...Interested in gold jewelry?
My prices are low. Tell me what you want, and I'll find it for you.
The gold jewelry you wanted is now in stock. I'll sell it to you at 30% market rate. What do you say?
That's so kind of you. In your eagerness, you've been caught red-handed. I've only just received this theft report, and you've already turned yourself in!
Y-you're police?
That's right. And you're under investigation. Come with me!
As you can see, this zone is under construction. There's nothing worth visiting here.
No wonder everyone here is either a soldier or a Gladiator... I guess we're in the wrong place for sightseeing?
Yeah... So roughly when will this place be ready? Looks like it still needs some work.
Well... only the person in charge knows when we'll be done.

Septimont only began developing cable cars in earnest as a means of transportation after the seawater had flooded these areas. It took us several years to build them, and even more years to establish a reliable operating line.
I see... will the sea level continue to rise?
We do get aqua alta from time to time, they're generally controllable. There's no need to worry.
Luckily, the cable car is here... Otherwise, we'd be exhausted!
We've just received orders from the Ephor. The deadline has been moved forward again, and we need to bring in more workers from the city.
We'll also need to send someone to keep tabs on the Blightcloud. I will discuss these matters with the Ephor later. Erisa, I entrust all on-site supervision work to you.
Sure, sure...
Why are you so distracted? Are you still worried about Sarina?
Who is Sarina?
That name sounds familiar.
Sarina is my little sister. She recently graduated, and now she's working.
It's a long shot... but did you see her at the Ephor's Palace?
Her post at the Ephor's Palace is her first job. She's always been rather impatient. She hates regulations and bureaucracy. All she cares about is getting the right result.
Oh my, isn't that just like you when you first started working? Your words were blunt, your actions were hasty, and you were always impatient for results.
R-really? I do remember that I was a bit overenthusiastic, but I wasn't that annoying, right?
I'm just messing with you. We can talk about it some other time. Let's focus on work now.
Look at the claws and that tail... Woah, doesn't the shape of this Blightcloud look like a dragon?
...How did you come up with a dragon? I only see a huge black cloud.
You've changed. You weren't always like this. In the past, you'd let your imagination run wild with me.
I'm not in the mood. The team I support is competing today, but I can't go see them live, and I'm upset about it.
Sorry, my protective gear was destroyed by Tacet Discords. I'll need a few days to repair it before I can hunt with you.
I'll lend you mine. Recently, Tacet Discords affected by the Blightcloud have become even more aggressive. They'll attack from miles away.
The Sanguis Plateaus is very dangerous now. We shouldn't rush in without being fully prepared.
...If you're interested in this purchase, I can lower the price a little.
The quality does look good. But this belongs to a series, right? Do you have the others?
Sure, I have them all!
Closing sale! Buy two, get one free! Don't miss out!
Buy a set to get 20% off and a free stylish sticker!
I can't believe that I found the set I've always wanted... And at such a cheap price!
Where did you buy this? I want to get a set too!
See that vendor shouting about discounts? I bought it there!
Have you heard? The Ephor came here for an inspection, and she specifically mentioned the need to speed up construction.
Did she come the day I took leave? Sigh... we've been so busy lately. Did she issue any targets?
She just thanked us for our hard work. Oh, right, she brought us some food and drinks as well. I took yours for you. I'll go get them after our shift.
You've been working too long. Isn't it time to take a break?
I'll stand guard for a while longer. Those guys on the next shift just returned from the frontlines. Let them rest a little.
Soft-hearted people really aren't suited to military life... Oh well, I'll stay with you for a while too.
Where is this? I don't think this is the arena we're looking for...
Obviously, we're lost! I told you that we should've turned left back there.
Oh no, we're going to miss the competition.
Forget about that. Look, they're selling merch here. Do you want to take a look?
...Something something Coast. Means this place, right?
Gah, this address is so blurry. I can't read it...
It doesn't have a return address either... How am I supposed to contact anyone?
I didn't expect to have to travel so far to deliver a parcel... Oh well, at least I get to enjoy the scenery!
Such a rare opportunity.  I should take a scenic detour before heading back.
...Okay, I've noted your feedback. You can take a break, and I'll submit the Sanguis Plateaus report for you.
Thanks. By the way, what's up with everyone here? They are either super busy, or they look burnt out. What happened?
Our schedule is very tight, and everyone is pushing hard to avoid delays. We've been shorthanded for weeks now.
That sounds tough.
Why are you so busy?
This concerns the lives of everyone in Septimont. I swear on my honor that I'll finish this job.
We must finish construction before the Blightcloud moves. Time is short, and this is very important, so everyone is working as hard as possible.
I see. I thought everyone was acting weird because they were affected by the Blightcloud... But I guess in a way, they are indeed affected by the Blightcloud.
...Don't waste your time on such nonsense. You should sleep now. I still need your help with an investigation tomorrow!
Yawn... I do feel sleepy. I've stayed up too long on too many nights recently...
I'll be resting. Call me when I'm needed.
Are you the acolyte who's been proselytizing on behalf of The Order of the Deep? I already told you we don't believe them, so stop being a nuisance.
No, you've got the wrong person! Ephor from above, I wouldn't dare do such a thing!
Sigh... I don't even know what to say right now.
Friend, we don't say "Ephor from above." Can't you do a bit of research before coming here?
Did I tell you about the acolyte I saw earlier today? I can't believe an acolyte that dumb exists!
You've already told me three times. I know it by heart!
Very well, then surely you won't mind another retelling.
Shouldn't you still be sleeping now? Why are you here in camp at this hour?
Hi... I dozed off for a while, and then I woke up. There's something on my mind and I can't sleep.
What is it? Is there a problem with your accommodations?
Well, sort of. But the main reason is that I'm so close to those Fluffy Gryphons. I'm too happy to sleep!
...Happy? Or hyper? As a Gladiator who hunts all year, you must've seen them all the time, right?

I'm happy. Besides, it's not the same. I've loved Fluffy Gryphons since I was a child. They're my favorite because they're so cool and strong. Sadly, I can only watch them from afar, and I can't pet them.
Why? Did something happen in the past? Were you chased by a Fluffy Gryphon as a youngster and left with childhood trauma?
No, I'm allergic to feathers... Are you okay? Do you wanna rest for a while?
You're a new guest, right? Although you look pretty strong, I still don't think you should go to the Sanguis Plateaus unprepared.
Indeed. Look, the protective gear I wore through countless battles over the years has been destroyed by Tacet Discords... such a pity.
Thanks for the advice.
How should I prepare?
We don't want to see innocent people injured. As Septimontians, we should resolve our own issues.
Better gear and better weapons... Just kidding, I'm the one who needs them.
We will head to the Sanguis Plateaus again to hunt soon. If the situation improves, the next time we meet will be when we're on the hunt.
Let's not get ahead of ourselves. We haven't been tasked to hunt yet. In the meantime, we should get a better set of weapons and gear.
But I sent all of my savings to my mother and sister...
Just use mine. You already owe me so much, I can't have you dying on me.
I feel bad about this. Wait a minute, let me write out an IOU...
Get lost! Who wants your barely legible IOU! Swear on your honor, and do not forget it!
Hey there! Looking for gladiator merch? I have everything here at a reasonable price!
I have your merch too! Do you want a stand or a bracelet? The same gourd decorations are also available as pendants!
Why are they so cheap?
Didn't know I was so popular...
I don't get a lot of foot traffic here, so I'm trying to increase sales by lowering prices! Earning less is better than earning nothing at all!
The economy isn't doing too well, and it's hard to run a business. I can holler all day and not sell a single thing.
But what choice do I have? If I don't work hard, I can't afford rent and food...
Average people like me can't become Gladiators or join the army. We can only make a living by the grace of others.
Nevertheless, I still consider myself lucky! At least, I have a proper job. Hahaha! I believe that if I hang in there, things will get better!
Let's do our best and fight for the chance to be noticed by the higher-ups! Then maybe, we can be promoted to work in the city!
Hmm? You don't want to be here anymore? I don't mind staying. The work is tough, but at least we're not supervised by city officials, which makes me feel more comfortable.
I want to get promoted. One day, I will work directly for the Ephor and build a successful career.
I admire your passion... but I just want to be an ordinary soldier until I retire.
You have my support!
Lying flat has its perks...
With your support, I'm even more motivated!
Right? Having a normal job is already a feat, so don't overthink it.
In any case, building this camp is a good opportunity, and I'm going to make use of it.
Good luck! When you've made it, don't forget about me!
We've been doing so much overtime lately... How are you physically holding up?
I'm okay. I sleep well, I eat regularly, and I'm also taking supplements. I'll be fine.
No, that's not healthy at all. What you need is good rest and a healthy diet. You shouldn't be doing the bare minimum to look after yourself.
...Isn't it okay to work hard once in a while?
No. I'm ordering you not to work overtime. Pass your work to me and go back to sleep now!
Lollo Logistics: We Promise, We Deliver!
Judging from your appearance, you're not a Septimontian either, right?
That's right.
I'm a real Septimontian!
Yeah, Septimontians don't usually come here.
Hahaha, as much as you try, you don't sound like a Septimontian.
I came here on a delivery run. But I can't find the recipient at all, and now I'm stuck with this parcel.
I've asked the Gladiators in the area. They're not too sure either, but they think he passed away a few years ago during a hunt.
Sigh... here's hoping the sender miswrote the recipeint's name.
On the bright side, I got the rare opportunity to visit this place.
When my job here is done, I'm going to take a break and walk around to admire the scenery.
An honor to talk to you, Champion of the Great Agon.
I watched the Final where you and Lupa fought side by side. That was a remarkable victory.
Thank you.
The credit goes to Lupa.
No need for modesty. Your strength has already proven itself.
Contender Lupa is a force to be reckoned with, but your prowess is unquestionable as well.
Speaking of which, I hear you're accompanying Her Excellency to the Sanguis Plateaus for the hunt?
Forgive my candor, but hunting and gladiating are not cut from the same cloth. A champion in the arena isn't necessarily a skilled hunter.
Agons are battles between people. But hunting? Hunting is a harsh contest of survival between humans and the Dark Tide creatures.
Those creatures are wilder and more vicious than any Gladiator. If you're truly set on joining the hunt, make sure you're well prepared.
May applause greet you. I'll be here, awaiting the triumphant return of you and Her Excellency.
Speaking of which, I've never been to the Sanguis Plateaus myself…
Hmm… I wonder if I'll ever get the chance to cross blades with the Dark Tide creatures.
But aren't you a clerk? Do you even know how to hunt?
I was a Gladiator before I took this post! When the time comes, you'll see what I'm really made of!
Hey, I heard you went to Ragunna. How was it?
The Carnevale was amazing! I saw so many unforgettable performances.
If I get the chance next year, I'll definitely watch the troupe's show again.
I want to see it too! Take me with you next time!
Sigh... I'm really not cut out for paperwork...
I've made up my mind! I'll sign up for a Gladiator certification next month!
One day, I'll head to the Plateaus and prove what my worth!
Did you hear? The Champion this time was absolutely incredible!
Really? Stronger than the Ephor?
Well... I was working overtime, so I didn't see it myself.
But they say the Champion wields a blade two hundred meters long! Imagine that!
Though the Ephor comes from a humble background, she's proven herself through strength.
But that Priestess… Reckless, willful, always bending the rules to her own ends...
Sigh... What a headache...
She's earned quite a reputation in the Senate.
It's a disgrace to Septimont to have someone of such origins as our Ephor.
But now's not the right time to unseat her. I must wait.
The true Hero of the Heroes will rise in time and take her place!
Want to make a bet? I'll have that palace guard laughing in under a minute!
You wish! Alright, I'll bet you a dinner you can't pull it off.
He's never seen my signature funny face! Just wait, you'll be buying me dinner!
Greetings, Champion.
Is there something you've come to discuss?
Welcome, Hero.
Thanks to your efforts, the crisis has been resolved.
Are you joining the hunt this time?
Tell me, which do you prefer: hunting or gladiating?
Welcome back, Champion. The other warriors have already told me of your deeds on the Plateaus.
I must apologize for my earlier remarks. You've more than proven yourself, the strongest among all.
Thank you.
You're flattering me.
Thanks to your efforts, the crisis was resolved swiftly. On behalf of the Ephor's Palace, you have my deepest gratitude.
According to our Septimontian customs, we always hold a feast after a victorious hunt.
However, this time the situation was more severe than expected. While the danger has passed, many from the Palace are still dealing with the aftermath. We can't prepare the feast just yet.
Please grant us a little time. In the meantime, enjoy what Septimont has to offer—its culture, its sights, and its spirit.
Your skill leaves a lasting impression!
I'll keep sharpening my edge with you as my goal!
Greetings, Champion.
It's an honor to see you before the hunt begins.
Augusta! You are our eternal Hero of the Heroes!
I shall sing your praises as your loyal servant until the end of time!
Welcome, distinguished guest.
If you'd like to know more about the Ephor's Palace, feel free to ask.
Welcome to the Ephor's Palace.
Is there anything I can assist you with today?
May applause greet you, traveler from afar.
If you have questions about the Agons, I'm happy to help.
Hunting and gladiating share the same root. But over time, they've grown into different paths.
Tell me, Champion, which do you prefer: hunting or gladiating?
Hunting.
Gladiating.
I see. A hunt on the Plateaus tests not just strength, but courage and clarity of mind.
Gladiating is a symbol of glory and of civilization itself. It brought prosperity to Septimont and became a cultural emblem we hold dear.
Whether it's hunting or gladiating, both are pillars of Septimont's traditions.
Gladiating is grueling, but it offers Gladiators a path to honor and fame. Hunting, by contrast, is rooted in duty.
If the Sanguis Plateaus were to fall, the Blightcloud would sweep in, unstoppable. It would devour all of Septimont in an instant, and the City of Glory would be lost to history.
That's why we train every day to prevent such a tragedy. With the Ephor leading us, I believe we stand ready. No calamity can shake us when we fight to protect our people.
Champion, your performance during the hunt was remarkable.
Your skill and awareness are on a level few could dream of. I can hardly imagine the battles you've fought to forge such ability.
Thank you for the compliment.
You fought well too.
Your timely aid made all the difference. With your help, we kept the damage to a minimum. You have our deepest thanks.
Next to you, I've still got much to learn. But you're my goal now, and I'll keep sharpening my edge until I can stand as your equal.
Do you remember what I said before, about the difference between hunting and gladiating?
In the beginning, the Agons were meant to train Gladiators, to temper them through combat and prepare them to defend Septimont's honor.
But over time, they became more of a spectacle than training. A show, deviating from the cause it once served.
It pains me to see that shift. But I had to adjust training schedules to match the trend.
But now, after what you've done, everyone in Septimont is speaking of hunting. I believe your example will draw more Gladiators to take up the mantle of hunter.
May applause greet you, Champion. I'm a devoted admirer of yours, and it's an honor to finally meet you.
I take it you've come to the Ephor's Palace to speak with Her Excellency about the hunt?
How did you know that?
Nah, you're wrong.
It wasn't hard to guess. The nobility greatly admires what you've accomplished so far. We believe you'll help usher in a new era for Septimont.
Hehe, very well then, I'll take your word for it.
If I may offer a word of advice as a noble, don't grow too close to the Ephor. Best to keep a healthy distance.
It's true that Ephor Augusta has had her share of accomplishments... but many still doubt her ability to lead all of Septimont.
There are people who are more suitable for her position. Frankly speaking, many among the nobility see her merely as a seat warmer until the true Hero of Heroes appears.
I don't entirely share their views, but as a noble myself... there's only so much I can say or do.
Still, I do hope she proves them wrong and manages to change the old fools' minds in the Senate.
Augusta, Hero of the Heroes. I didn't expect her to truly prove herself.
So now you acknowledge her.
She won't bring disgrace to that title.
Indeed. Her deeds speak clearly enough.
I must admit, she has proven herself worthy of leading Septimont. To some, she's already becoming one of the greatest Ephors in our history.
The nobles' view of her has begun to shift. Of course, it takes more than a day to overturn the old prejudices, but many have already let go of their former bias.
As her supporter, I'm glad to see more nobles taking up the hunt, fighting alongside Her Excellency and me.
As for those stubborn old voices in the Senate... Time has a way of silencing doubt.
I believe under Ephor Augusta's rule, more will come to see her as she truly is.
Greetings, Champion. It's an honor to meet you. I serve here at the Ephor's Palace. Part of my duties include coordinating Her Excellency's schedule.
If this is your first time visiting, would you like me to give you a quick briefing?
Please do.
Will it be long?
Understood. Let me gather the key points. It won't take much of your time.
I'll keep it brief. Just the essentials.
In general, Her Excellency handles the internal affairs of Septimont in the mornings. Afternoons are reserved for external matters like diplomacy and trade.
Normally, it takes three to four weeks to schedule an audience with Her Excellency. However, given the urgency of the hunt in the Sanguis Plateaus, that rule doesn't apply to you.
You've also been granted special clearance. No paperwork required, unlike other envoys.
As for your weapons... Oh, I see. You can carry them in the Palace with Her Excellency's personal permission.
The only thing I must remind you of is to keep your voice down within the Palace halls.
If there's anything else you should be aware of, I'll inform you promptly.
Greetings, visitor. How may we assist you today?
Assist in what?
I haven't decided yet.
That depends on your needs. We handle trade requests, public feedback on official decisions, and more.
I see. In that case, allow me to give you a brief overview.
For example, if you're applying for temporary residence in Septimont, turn left and proceed to the appropriate window for qualification screening.
If you have questions regarding recent decisions, the Senate can provide detailed explanations.
Don't worry. Most matters concerning Septimont can be handled right here. Once your application is submitted, you can expect a response within three to five working days in general.
Take your time to consider what you'd like to inquire about. We're always here and ready to help.
Welcome to the Ephor's Palace! I'm in charge of Agon-related matters. If you have any questions, feel free to ask.
Wait, aren't you the Champion of the Great Agon? I'm a huge fan! Never thought I'd get to meet you here in person.
Thank you.
I didn't expect to run into a fan here either.
You signed up right away without stopping by to inquire, so I thought I missed my chance to see you.
Hehe, well... in Septimont, it's harder to find someone who isn't your fan these days.
Usually, Gladiators stop by here first to ask about the Agon details, like how many teams have signed up, or what the rules will be.
Each tier of Agon comes with different rewards, rules, and levels of attention. Knowing the details helps with planning and strategy.
Most contenders think it through carefully before applying to strive for a better result. And they'll come for a full consultation before making a move.
It's not uncommon for Gladiators to skip an Agon entirely, choosing instead to focus on training in the hopes of getting better results next time.
But I doubt any of that will trouble you. With you and Contender Lupa on the field, I can't imagine anyone standing in your way.
Word is, you're the most seasoned hand in the whole security team.
Been through a lot when I was young, that's all.
What were things like before the Ephor took office?
Before the Ephor? Hah... those days...
That Angartitus fellow is acting stranger by the day...
Always chasing after that man Aerius for lessons.
Overheard him saying "Master, I burn for progress!" Can you believe it?
Hey, did you watch the newcomer's match the other day?
I did. A promising contender, indeed.
Yes. I'm embarrassed to say this, but the youngin's got...
Got more talent than when you first started out, right?
Youth, fire, talent... That kind of mix always shakes up the arena. The crowd loves it. Opponents hate it. The future is bright for that one.
But I hear this newcomer has zero understanding of the rules. Turns down bribes, swings too hard, offends the wrong names... The noble Houses are starting to lose sleep.
Listen in.
Leave.
A Gladiator who has a bit of backbone and temper is a good thing. Reminds me of when I was young. As for the rules, he'll come to understand them sooner or later.
Sure, but you don't have "later" if you're retiring soon. What if he ends up across from you before then?
You wouldn't want to end your glorious career in disgrace, would you? The young rise quickly, old friend.
Hmph... You're not wrong. If I met him now, my odds... let's just say, they ain't what they used to be.
Hehe. I may have a way to keep the boy's career... quiet. For a few years, at least.
That's it. I'm done. I'm handing in my resignation to the Ephor's Palace tomorrow!
Well, this is a surprise. What happened?
I'm sick and tired of being pushed around by the nobles and my superiors all day long...
It's okay. Quit if you want, I'll take care of our financials.
You want to handle our financials? How, exactly? I-I was just venting... I'm still going to show up for work tomorrow...
There's no way you're going back to work. No point torturing yourself. Don't worry, we have money now. I've been winning match after match lately. Half the teams in town are trying to poach me.
Listen in.
Leave.
But what if you lose a match, or get injured...
Eh, it's just money. Don't worry, worst case, I'll nab some weapons from the other side and sell 'em. We'll get by.
I-I was just dreaming about switching jobs. I didn't say I wanted you to pay all the bills by yourself.
It's just that ever since the Ephor left the Palace for the High Tide, no one's kept the nobles in check. They've been doing whatever they please...
Huh... I'm sure jealous of those Ragunnesi officials serving the Sentinel. Beats serving nobles.
Nobles... Just you wait. If I keep winning like this, we could be nobles someday.
Sir Pableus, your family's business is really making waves recently.
The commercial value of top-tier contestants can't be overstated.
Haha, we're merely assisting with a bit of promotional work, that's all.
Such modesty. This is already one of the most anticipated events in Septimont!
I'll be honest, Sir Pableus. Our House is very interested in sponsoring this tournament.
I came to you today to ask if you might mediate a small request.  We'd like to customize some icons and numbers on the contenders' projections...
Listen in.
Leave.
Ah… so that's why you've come. Well, I'm sure we can negotiate a deal.
I can see where you're going with this. Live betting odds during the matches, correct? Though, you know how particular the Gladiator managers can be...
We understand the game. No need to worry. If this goes through cleanly, we'll do an even split. The managers. You. Me. How about that?
What kind of stunt was that?! We were just seconds away from closing the bets...
They put fifty million Shell Credits on the Red Dragons out of nowhere!
Hmph. How shameful of them.
And to make it worse, no warning. Not a whisper.
How selfish of them! Giving us only 30% of the gains. Do these new nobles have no dignity?
Don't tell me you weren't aware of their little stunt, Sir Pableus?
M-me? How would I know anything about that...?

Please. The Red Dragons were on the ropes. Then, just as the betting closed, they're back on their feet like nothing happened! With acting like that, they should be performing with the Troupe of Fools in Ragunna!
I've recently taken notice of a young Gladiator, Mother.
She's a commoner, but made it all the way to Septimont on her own…
You must be referring to Calanthe.
You've heard about her as well?
Septimont was a different place back then. Lowborn Gladiators like us barely had scraps to fight over, let alone eat.
Really? I heard Septimont in those days had many legendary figures.
Listen in.
Leave.
I've heard stories about those Gladiators. Sure, the Ephor made short work of them, but still, they say their drinking cups were made of pure gold...
Heh. Gold cups? Hah. That's nothing. The madness of that area is far beyond your imagination.
Bet if I was born back then, I'd have been the top hound in the hunting party!
You? Back then, the grass on your grave would be knee-high by now.
I've seen plenty of your kind. Fresh out of boot camp, all puffed up. One sip of poison wine before the match, and you're twitching in the sand.
Couple rounds in, can't even hold your Echo together. You drop, eyes wide as moons, just in time to watch some noble put on a show.
That's the truth of old Septimont, lad. So while you're still breathing? Be grateful the Ephor only needs you standing guard.
Yes, I've heard of her... Indeed, as a newcomer, she does exhibit excellent reflexes and agility.
But listen well, my daughter. It's not enough to measure the potential of a Gladiator by their weapon alone.
Listen in.
Leave.
But didn't you just praise her, Mother? With adequate training, surely she could...
I said look into their eyes. That's what tells you everything. We don't invest in anyone who breaks at the first crack.
We need fighters like Lupa. Eyes locked on the enemy's throat, always calculating the kill. That's someone who wins, or dies trying.
Your judge of character requires more work, Missoula.
Y-Yes, Mother...
These new Gladiators are a useless bunch of fools!
Calm down, madam. There's no need to get so worked up...
You incompetent buffoons! We paid a fortune for this batch of nobodies. I want my money back!
Oh, the nerve! Do you remember how they bragged, Laocoon? Big mouths, zero skill, and don't even get me started on their attitudes!
Yes, these are the worst by far, madam... Only a handful barely made the cut, and Lupa still crushed them five to zero.
Listen in.
Leave.
When was the last time we lost so miserably? If this keeps up, our House's name will be dragged through the gutter!
I've lost count of how many times we've shuffled the instructor. But nothing is changing for the better.
There's little I can do. The teams I used to lead were all finalists and championship teams!
Now I'm handed a roster of greenhorns like this "Decimus." The boy plays nothing but defense. Just another fish too small to stir the water.
At this rate, we'll lose the Blue Furies match. And after that, if we lose to the Scratchy, there will be nothing left to lose to.
Well… looking at it another way, at least we're among the first Houses to start prepping for next season?
Oh, thank you for that dazzling optimism, Laocoon. Maybe next year we'll just stumble across another batch of miracle Gladiators like last time?
Be realistic. Stop putting all your hopes on new recruits and learn what it means to be a Gladiator, would you?
I bet those Ragunna fools wouldn't last a minute in a fight. What do you think?
Oh, for sure. That Order of theirs does nothing but pray to the Divinity.
How do you expect to protect your own people with just prayers?
If the Sentinel truly watches over these lands, They would surely need warriors worthy of fighting at Their side.
Hmph. Only those with strength of will deserve that honor. Blind faith will be the death of the Rinascitans. It's already caused Ragunna to grow stagnant.
The Ragunnesi leaders are hopelessly conservative. In strength, in vision, in presence—they can't hold a candle to our Ephor.
What are your thoughts on the matter, friend? Why can't they see it? That only someone as powerful as our Ephor has the right to lead?
The Ragunnesi bear a heavy burden.
Praise Septimont. Praise the Ephor!
Me no understand. I not from here. (mumbling gibberish)
We're all Rinascitans, and yet the divide between us runs so deep...
If The Order keeps tightening its grip, Ragunna will cut itself off entirely, and with it, the spirit of our people will wither.
Well said! You are truly a person of wisdom! Praise Septimont. Praise the Ephor!
Strength and glory. These virtues must course through every Rinascitan's veins! Only the strong can lead our people forward!
An outlander? Then I must introduce you to the many tales of our great Ephor...
Ugh. Will you please stop reading those Ragunnesi romance novels!
But, Mother! Isn't worshiping heroes what we Septimontians are all about?
You're daydreaming if you think that fantasy fodder counts as heroic.
Ragunna authors and their hack novels! They're messing with your head!
The nonsense they peddle! A banished Ragunna scion crosses the great seas to Septimont, finds true love after becoming a Gladiator Champion, and lives happily ever after...
Then after three years pass, he returns to Ragunna as Imperator's chosen hero to seek revenge on the nobles who once framed him.
Listen in.
Leave.
But Mother... he's truly an amazing Gladiator. Don't you wish your own daughter to marry a hero of great honor like that?
This won't cut it. Gladiating isn't just about the fight...
It's politics. People. Power plays.
But... isn't it just about signing the strongest fighter?
Don't be so naive. Brute force alone won't get you anywhere.
Remember Mya? From Ragunna? She made it to the end and won The Grand Agon years ago.
No one knows where she went afterward, but she proved that skill alone can take anyone to the top...
Listen in.
Leave.
Heh, Mya? You think that was skill? That was the most funded tournament in history. Coincidence? I think not.
The most funded tournament in history? I-I don't know what you mean, Mother...
What if I told you it was our wager on Mya that bought this family its seat at the high table?
But that can't be. She didn't have a patron, she fought for herself!

Oh, my foolish daughter. Agons and their patrons are nothing but a cover for the game of chess played behind the scenes. If you wish to keep yourself on the board, then you'd better know how to play your pieces correctly.
Betting on Mya, who had the highest odds of winning, wasn't a gamble. It was the safety net every House agreed to in silence.
Say, who do you think is the best Gladiator?
It depends... But I'd go for Lupa if you ask me.
Lupa is the real deal, no doubt. But if the Ephor ever entered the ring? All bets are off.
Aha! So even you think Lupa is the strongest out there! I knew it!
Listen in.
Leave.
For now, maybe. But strength can fade. My father once told me what the Ephor was like in the old days...
Pure strength combined with will and skill, no tricks or borrowed power. That's what I call the mark of a true champion.
Is the Ephor the strongest Gladiator in history?
Careful, Ricken. Such titles don't pass clean through time, they bend to the age that bore them.
Ugh, too bad. If only the heroes of each era could have the chance to fight it out.
Hey, you there {Male=Sir;Female=Miss}, who do you think deserves the title of strongest Gladiator?
Me, of course.
It's Lupa.
It's the Ephor.
Hah?! You're serious! Well, you do give off... quite the aura. You're not secretly some legendary warrior from the old tales, are you?
Ha! I knew Lupa was unbeatable! No one can take down our champion!
Are you sure? But I've never actually seen the Ephor in action before...
All the lads think Lupa is the strongest Gladiator around. But I think her partner also deserves more credit.
Listen in.
Leave.
I agree. That outlander is a force to be reckoned with.
Both of them bear the Lioness's blessing… I wonder what'd happen if they faced off against the Ephor.
If you strip away Resonance ability... then yes, I'd say the Ephor still holds the advantage.
True. But in a real combat scenario, things would never be so cut and dry...
Ah. You must be the champion, {PlayerName}! I'm glad to finally meet you in person!
Tell me, {PlayerName}. Who do you think is the greatest Gladiator of them all?
Each has their strengths.
I've no use for titles.
Each has their strengths... Well, then. What are your strengths, {PlayerName}?
I know a bit of everything.
But it's the title of "strongest" we're talking about... By the blazing sun, what is it you're after then, {PlayerName}?
Your words were truly inspirational, Master Aerius.
Now the Ephor has entrusted me with an important task. I will not fail Septimont.
I see you're finally learning how to sound the part.
But do you really understand what the task calls for?
Of course. You have to trust me, Master Aerius. My problem is that I'm too honorable and principled. Makes me an easy target if things go sideways.
Matters only become serious once they're exposed. The same words in different mouths don't carry the same weight.
Listen in.
Leave.

I see your meaning. I'll return the gift first thing tomorrow morning. Septimont isn't a place you can do business just by throwing money around. If they wish to see the Ephor, they'll have to go through proper channels.
Oh, you're being unreasonable again. No one said they shouldn't follow protocol. But we don't have to slap their hands just for knocking at the wrong door… especially when it's the Montellis.
This isn't about your intentions, it's about finesse. If you're working under the Ephor's roof, you put her, and Septimont, first. That's how you stay three moves ahead of the rest.
So you're saying... I should accept their gift. Then nudge them through the departments, make sure they visit all the right desks?
But what if the Ephor learns of this? She's always had zero tolerance for this kind of thing...
The Ephor is preoccupied with High Tide preparations, she won't have the time... Plus, helping her resolve difficult matters and manage Septimont affairs is the service she expects from us.
Stick with me. I've got enough old fox tricks to keep you learning till your hair is gray.
Those able to serve in the Ephor's Palace are undoubtedly the best of the best. It's only natural for them to face stricter trials.
The delicate balance between the Ephor, the nobles, and ourselves requires utmost attention. Next, I'll be going through the specifics—
Finally got a placement in the housing lottery. I knew the paperwork would be a hassle, but I still didn't expect it to drag on this long.
Yep. Ever since they started promoting the Great Agon, more people have grown curious about Septimont's culture. Now a lot of them have decided to stay.
We were lucky to get picked. I'm so excited to start this whole new chapter together in Septimont.
You always sound like you're narrating a novel. Can't you just say you're happy for both of us?
I-I really don't know what to say... My heart feels full. No matter what we get, I still... just can't wait to live here. With you...
You're fully aware that bypassing the chain of command and reporting above your superior violates protocol. Such actions carry serious risks. Did you even consider the consequences?
I did. At the time, I was confident that my judgment would help improve work efficiency without any negative impacts.
You're fully aware that bypassing the chain of command and reporting above your superior violates protocol. Such actions carry serious risks. Did you even consider the consequences?
I did. At the time, I was confident that my judgment would help improve work efficiency without any negative impacts.
You... We have rules for a reason. They are not something to be bent at the whim of personal judgment.
But I believe all Septimontians should follow Ephor Augusta's example. Solving the problem should always take priority over following procedure!
Traveler. You've seen more of the world than most. Perhaps you'd care to weigh in?
Rules always come first.
Achieving the goal comes first.
Well, how about that? Anyone with vision knows the value of order. That settles it. I trust this won't happen again.
Ugh... That's not how it should be.
See? Even the traveler agrees with the Ephor's decisive approach. Blind obedience was never her way!
Using the Ephor's name again... Hmph. We'll revisit this discussion another day.
I re-watched the Ephor's old Gladiator matches. She was incredible!
Who would've thought someone that fierce in the arena would end up leading Septimont? She's becoming my absolute idol!
That's right. With the High Tide on the horizon, Augusta's decisiveness and bravery are exactly what we need to weather the coming storm.
You had an audience with the Ephor too? She's a lot more commanding in person than on the Terminal, huh?
Definitely. After seeing her with my own eyes, I'm starting to think the stories about her lifting boulders with one arm when she was still a baby are true.
That's a little melodramatic, don't you think?
Have you heard the big news in Ragunna? After years of waiting, the Carnevale finally returned, only for the Laurel to be won by an outlander!
I heard the Montellis and Fisalias both had some unexpected shakeups. Word is, that same outsider might've been involved.
Yes. With all the tourists and dignitaries visiting Septimont in recent years, we may also be in for a big change.
Strange thing, isn't it? All these years in this department… never thought I'd find myself admiring someone in the Ephor's seat.
You're not alone. The way she gets people excited about the Agon is something else. She shows up to the matches in person, even presiding over the championship!
That's what we need. Puts Septimont on the tongues of outlanders and gives the people something to rally behind!
Excuse me, miss. I don't know where I am. Can you help me find my mama?
Of course, but I admit... I've never seen a lost child look as calm as you.
Oh, thank you. Thank you so much. My mind went blank and I didn't know what to do. I'm so glad you helped me find her!
Don't mention it, ma'am. Your daughter was very precise in recalling how she got lost, all I had to do was follow her trail.
Thank you, miss. Mama, what are we having for dinner? I'm hungry.
Wait... it's you! What are you doing here? Still remember me? We spent time together under that waterfall by Shifang Pharmacy!
Ohhh! Of course I remember you! I'm here on a commission. Time is tight, but let's talk later!
Let's meet when I'm finished. There's so much I want to say to you!
Those able to serve in the Ephor's Palace are undoubtedly the best of the best. It's only natural for them to face stricter trials.
The delicate balance between the Ephor, the nobles, and ourselves requires utmost attention. Next, I'll be going through the specifics—
The Ephor... the nobles... the Gladiators... There's so much to keep in mind. I need to pay attention.
Feels like I've been stuck on night watch my whole cursed life. I'd rather go on hunts 'till dawn than stand here on guard duty!

Who doesn't want to join a hunting party? But wait, isn't this only your second night watch? C'mon, I'll tell you something that'll lighten the mood. Did you know that the Ephor only sleeps ten minutes a day?
Besides that ten, every other minute is spent wrangling state matters.
Oh, I see where this is going. This is the part where I stop whining and pledge to live like the Ephor, eh?
No, no. The Ephor's a smiley person. She smiled when she greeted me!
She smiled 'cause you tripped and nearly bit your tongue clean off. The Ephor I know can scare Echoes into silence with a single glare.
So what? I've heard she's a regular at the cafe on Fountain Square. Has a soft spot for strawberry ice cream.
Yeah, right!
Yeah, right!
So... Uh. What do you think? Should we move somewhere quieter?
Quieter, is it? No, I know you. You're still trying to "serve the city" even after retirement. Giving up our home won't fix Septimont's housing troubles.
That said… we've been through so much together. Wherever you go, I go.
Thank you. There are young folk who need the city more than us. A bit of peace might do us good at last.
That is a very dangerous thought to have. You're challenging the very existence of gladiating!
I understand your outrage. But have you considered the kind of revenue these added wagers and events could draw?
It wouldn't sit idle in coffers. It'd be reinvested in Septimont's development. That doesn't sound too bad, does it?
No. It would bleed the desperate and the poor dry with false hopes and easy ruin. Profit wrung from suffering shames the spirit of Septimont. This debate is over!
You know, from all the intel I've gathered on Septimont, I got close to nothing on Ephor Augusta's past.
Strange, isn't it? She holds the city's highest seat, but everything about her origin is nothing but rumors.
That's not the sort of thing you ignore. Keep digging.
Oh, what should I do? There are so many people. What if someone's taken her...? Help. PLEASE? ANYONE?
Wow! Check out the shiny plates these soldiers are wearing. It's completely different from what you see back home!
Hey mister, can I take a photo? Just one? I'm coming over! Okay, ready?
Wow! Check out the shiny plates these soldiers are wearing. It's completely different from what you see back home!
Hey mister, can I take a photo? Just one? I'm coming over! Okay, ready?
Sir, I am on duty. Please stand back!
I-I said stand back!
Alright… breathe. Steady now. She may be the Ephor of Septimont, but I must carry Ragunna's poise, not lose it at the door.
Greetings, I am Nicco. Envoy from Ragunna. My meeting with Ephor Augusta was arranged in advance. May I wait here?
Ah, yes. Your name is on the visitor list. Please wait here.
I noticed you seemed somewhat unsettled earlier. Seems you've found your footing now. I hope the meeting goes well. May applause greet you.
If the clash of blades in the arena is the trumpet that draws the crowds, then the image beyond the sands is the pillar that anchors their loyalty.
Thus I suggest that a Gladiator's reputation should be carved in physical form, development of merchandise must be continued, allowing their glory to be passed down.
If the clash of blades in the arena is the trumpet that draws the crowds, then the image beyond the sands is the pillar that anchors their loyalty.
That's why I propose we immortalize a Gladiator's legend in physical form. We continue merchandising to let their glory live on in the hands of their supporters.
Indeed. Those who return to the arena time and again see their memorabilia snatched up like relics. The broader their collection, the longer their fame endures.
But… we mustn't neglect the lesser-known fighters. Strategies must be devised to help the dimmer stars burn brighter.
Finally got a placement in the housing lottery. I knew the paperwork would be a hassle, but I still didn't expect it to drag on this long.
Yep. Ever since they started promoting the Great Agon, more people have grown curious about Septimont's culture. Now a lot of them have decided to stay.
Hello, welcome to Thermes Baths.
Wow, this bathhouse is really impressive...
Well? See that? That's the fortress city of Septimont.
Cool! It's so cool!
Put in some hard training and work up a sweat, then soak in some hot baths to take off the edge!
This is what you call life as Septimont's warriors!
I'm tired of this wait. Why can't I get into the bathhouse yet?
Servant. Where is my servant? Oh, I forgot that I didn't bring my servant with me today...
Pardon me for my lateness, milord. Is this your first time visiting our bathhouse?
My name is Julius. It is an honor to serve as your temporary servant.
Master Olet, the public bathhouse for commoners only admits male guests after four o'clock in the afternoon. Prior to that, it was reserved exclusively for female guests only.
What did you say? No wonder they were all staring at me. You're saying I stood there all that time making a fool of myself!
Master Olet, I... It's just that the people here have never seen someone of such noble stature as yourself. Everyone was simply awed by your presence!
Listen in.
Leave.
Hmph. Spare me your cheap lies of flattery...

Still, I really didn't expect the bathhouse here to be so inconvenient. I merely wanted to experience it for the first time. I can do without a personal servant, but having to wait in line for vacant slots? The absurdity.

I couldn't agree more, Master Olet. This section of the bathhouse absolutely pales in comparison to the VIP lounge. However, if you'd like to have a tour, I can assist you in verifying your identity at the front desk once the bathhouse opens this afternoon. All members of the Septimont nobility need not wait in line at this establishment.
Oh? You're someone who understands proper etiquette. Interesting. I'll do just that.
I'll take this opportunity to see what the commoners' bathhouse is like.
There's not much to this place, is there...? Only a few pools, no private areas, and they won't even let me use bath salts or anything scented in the water.
Well... this is, after all, a public bath, milord. Even if you offered them to the commoners, they wouldn't really care for them.
Listen in.
Leave.
As a member of Septimont nobility, I certainly can see that the lives of the commoners... are indeed rather inconvenient.

But a public bathhouse packed with this many people. Can you possibly keep a place like this sanitary? I can even smell the stench from the sewers several streets away... Ugh. Just goes to show how thoroughly lacking the city planning is down in the Lower City.
Absolutely spot on, milord. Issues concerning city planning and population have accumulated over many years and are well beyond what we can resolve ourselves. We must look to your wisdom.

You're rather smart with words for someone your age, and your insight is quite impressive... Interesting. You know what, why don't you give me a tour of this place again next time? There's plenty I still want to see for myself.
It is my great honor, Master Olet! Whenever you come to visit, I, Julius, will be at your service and devote myself wholeheartedly to your service.
Are those two... Ivanck and Decimus?
Servant, do you have any idea who those two young men who won't stop shouting are?
No need to be bothered with them, Master Olet.
They simply can't comprehend your prestige.
You've done well today, Julius.
You're different from those other young men who let their temper get the best of them at the sight of nobles.
I'll be sure to get in touch with you on my next visit to the Lower City. Septimont always offers opportunities to outstanding young people such as yourself.
I am honored, milord! May your glory shine with the sun!
That was quite the stunt. Was he playing dumb the whole time...? Strutting through the Lower City like he's on parade. Was it all just for show?
Was he trying to throw off his political rival? Or does he have some other goals in mind?
No matter the case, now that we've crossed paths, I might as well take this branch and see where it leads.
No matter the price... I will climb my way up.
Olet mutters to himself while staring at the Terminal in his hands.

Julius. Male. Septimont commoner. Born aboard a Fool's Sail that drifted to Septimont twenty-three years ago. Married to another female commoner in the Lower City three years ago, and since then, took the name Julius. They have one son, who suffers cognitive impairments suspected to be caused by the Dark Tide.
Other than that, there's barely any mention of him in the citizen archives. Fool's Sail? Dark Tide aftereffects... So the boy's a Ragunnesi, huh? No wonder he's so desperate to claw his way upward.
What a shame. But even if you really do manage to make your way to the upper ranks, it won't be enough to save your son.
You're better off down here, Julius. Spending your life in the mud, chasing dreams that'll never come true.
What the hell is a peasant doing in the VIP baths?
Excuse me! Where's the staff? There's been a mistake.
What about commoners? They paid to get in, you know!
Excuse me, how much longer do I have to wait before I can get into a bath?
Certainly, I'll check that for you right away... Your current queue number is A077. Single male. There are seventeen guests in line ahead of you. Please be patient.
Listen in.
Leave.
I've been waiting all morning. Why are there still so many people? For a place this huge, don't tell me you can't let more people in.
Uh, mornings are reserved for female guests only... The men's baths are only available during the afternoon...
Fine, but if you're already doing separate baths, why the limit on the number of guests?
We limit the number of guests in the bathhouse to ensure each visitor enjoys a comfortable experience. We appreciate your understanding.

If we accept too many guests within a short period, it may affect their experience and cause overcrowding. Additionally, the circulation system won't be able to keep up in providing clean and sanitary water.
Is there any way to skip the line?
Leave.

If you're a member of a Septimont family or have official permission, you do not need to wait in line. And furthermore, making a reservation or signing up for one of our VIP memberships also gives you priority access.
You can make reservations to take a bath? Wait, what was that about signing up for a membership?

Our VIP membership... Any guest can be qualified for our membership status after making a single deposit of Shell Credits with us above a certain amount. Members get access to perks such as priority access, discounts, free beverages, and other exclusive benefits. Please note that all deposits cannot be withdrawn, and can only be used for baths and related services.
Even Septimont's picked up on this whole membership deposit gimmick now...
This is the VIP area, peasant. You're in the wrong place. Your baths are on the floor below.
Aren't they all just public baths? What's so special about this one?
Listen in.
Leave.
Heh. How dare you say they're the same? If you want to enjoy the service here, you need to have matching qualifications. Just ask yourself, what are your contributions to Septimont?

I-I work hard in my job! What do you mean contributions? Wasn't it we commoners who built this bathhouse to begin with, brick by brick? What right do you have to think you're above anyone else, sitting back and enjoying everything you never lifted a finger for?
Hmph. Your perception defines your perspective. How dare a lowly peasant like you speak about the contributions of us nobles? Know your place.
So what? Being a noble doesn't mean you can do whatever you want.
Heh. I'm sorry, but being nobles, we really can do whatever we want.
Damn it! The more I try to let it go, the more pissed off I get! Backing down just makes me feel even more like an idiot!
C'mon, Daphne! Get your act together! Why can't you just talk back for once?!
If I could do it over again, I'd make sure I shut her up for good! I have to make her apologize!
She's clearly the one in the wrong, so why do I have to back off the moment I hear the word "nobles"... Even Her Excellency the Ephor herself said Septimont belongs to all of us.
What happened?
Leave.

Ugh, I spent months' worth of my salary this morning to get a membership card just so I could try the VIP bathhouse, but then a noblewoman kicked me out. She said a commoner like me doesn't deserve to be in the same space as her...
Tell me, do you think I should've talked back to her?
Show her what you're made of!
Just walk it off.
Yeah, if only I'd thought of Her Excellency's words at the time...
Even if those nobles made contributions beyond our understanding, everyone deserves the same rights to live in Septimont.
Just walk it off... Why is everyone keeping telling me to just bear with it?

Every time in a situation like this, we think instinctively, "Just bear with it and it'll be over soon." That's why we end up getting pushed around. But we're Septimontians! When things like this happen, shouldn't we muster our courage to stand up and fight back?
Gladiator Plate Armor. Gold-tier quality! 5,000 each. Get it while it's in stock!
Can't you sell these a little cheaper?
I'm sorry, but this is the best deal I can offer...
Honesty's our trade, fair to everyone, young and old. We've been in this business for years, and our reputation speaks for itself.
I'll be honest with you, miss. This is as low as we can go.
I know, but right now our family's funds are... on the tighter side.
Listen in.
Leave.

I can understand your situation, but please think it through. Spending some money now on proper equipment is a way better investment than being forced to pay a "sponsorship fee" just because you didn't qualify for the main tournament.
I get what you're saying. Last time we bought gear from that merchant, Banagher, he sold us nothing but repackaged junk.
How are we supposed to fight with this junk? That's what our Gladiators kept complaining to me. You take my meaning, Miss Annika?
Banagher? Ha. Those scrap metals he calls armor don't even come close to my work. Honestly, you'd be better off strapping yourself with cardboard than using his junk.
My shop has always done honest business. Don't take my word for it, ask anyone on this street.
Since a friend recommended your shop to me, I place my trust in you. And I truly hope that we can establish a long-term partnership.

As a gesture of goodwill, our family's Gladiators will help promote your shop after winning this Agon season. As long as we can secure a place in the tournament, we'll be in for a long-term partnership. But on the other hand, I hope you can understand the situation we're currently facing.
Hmm. I just can't shake the feeling that the way Gladiator is handling their weapon is a bit strange...
Maybe the hilt was made too stiff?
There's still room for adjustments for this batch... Give me a moment.
There, modeling the pauldron after the buckler and adding concussion edges is perfect for Gladiators who excel in strength.

Offers an extra option for parrying, and it also lets you catch your opponent's weapon with your pauldron. And if it really came down to it, you can use that momentum to crash straight into them and close the distance...
Hey, you there. What do you think of that Gladiator's gear design?
That's quite unique.
Not interested.
Hehe. Sparking new ideas through actual combat is what makes the stuff we make at our workshop unique.
If we could test our equipment in more combat scenarios, our skills would do an even better job of protecting the Gladiators and the warriors out on hunts, wouldn't you think?
What is it? I'm already offering you money, is that not enough for you?
It's not about the money, milord... It's just that...
This second floor, you call it the VIP area, but the services here are nowhere near the standard that name implies.

I fail to see the difference between the equipment up here and what you have downstairs. The water quality seems about the same, too. So what exactly makes this a VIP area? Have you ever thought about actually renovating this place?
Listen in.
Leave.
We've received your feedback and appreciate your valuable input... We will take it into careful consideration.
As for renovation. It isn't a matter that can be easily settled...
Hmph. You're full of excuses. I get it. It's about money, isn't it?
Fine, I'll pay for it. Have a construction crew over this instant. I want you to redo the entire second floor exactly as I tell you.

I'm not in a position to make that decision, milord. You'll have to speak with the head of the bathhouse. And besides, it's not a matter of credits. Renovations or construction on major public buildings must be reported to the Ephor's Palace...
Rules, rules. Always with these rules! Finally, I've made a fortune for myself, and I just want to enjoy it. Is that too much to ask?
Fine. The renovations can wait. But let me ask you—
Do you have any private bathhouses for sale here?
Ah. Private bathhouses are hardly something I could come across, milord...
Pardon me. Do you mind if I borrow a moment of your time?
May I ask how you'd rate your recent bathing experience?
If you don't mind, could you please fill out this survey for us?
As a thank you, we've prepared some souvenirs for you.
What do you mean it's something you can't come across? What's the deal with private bathhouses? Come on, split it out. Why the secrecy?
Listen in.
Leave.

I'm not trying to hide anything, milord. It's just that these private bathhouses are nearly impossible to come by. They're all natural hot springs hidden away in remote and dangerous locations. Even the ones already developed are in the hands of those legendary Gladiators and upper-class nobles.
If anyone managed to get their hands on a natural hot spring, they wouldn't sell it off so easily. They are considered priceless treasures of Septimont.

Are they really as bizarre as you say they are? You mean to tell me you don't know a single Gladiator looking to sell a private bathhouse? Come now, introduce me to one and there will be a good fee in it for you.
It's not that I don't want to, milord. I don't have any connections. If I really knew someone like that, I wouldn't be stuck working here myself.
Congratulations to you, Madam Marcella. Your family's Gladiator has indeed shown remarkable valor.
Madam Flavia... I take it you didn't come all this way just for the flattery, did you?
Why, yes. The reason I came to see you today is to discuss an important matter... But rest assured, it's something on the positive side.
My congratulations to your family on securing a spot in the finals, Madam Marcella. I wonder, have you been following the tournament schedule?
Listen in.
Leave.
The tournament schedule? Matches for the upcoming week should be... Ah, I see your meaning...
Your family's Gladiator is currently just one win away from qualifying for the finals, correct?
I'm glad to see we're on the same page.

We love you, Cyrus!
...Do you understand everything I've just told you?
Understood, ma'am! I'll train harder than ever, and in four years' time, I will snatch that gold medal in the Agon of Champions!
That's what I like to hear! With your determination and my guidance. You will become the champion.
First, have a look at this. I've prepared a non-stop, strenuously gruelling multi-year training program
Starting today, we begin training based on this program.
I... Yes, ma'am!
...Do you understand everything I've just told you?
Yes, ma'am!
What's gotten into this Ta-da...?
What's wrong?
This Ta-da here only goes "ta-da" every time it hears someone sigh... It's driving me mad!
It's supposed to be cheering every time a Gladiator lands a spectacular blow... I have no idea what to do now...
Make the most out of its talents.
Have it "ta-da" in an environment where it feels comfortable.
...! I see! You're a genius!
I've got an idea. I'll have it encourage Gladiators that are beaten down and help cheer them up.
It'll become the best Ta-da cheerleader ever!
One more, Quintus. You can do this...
Do you know what is the most important thing about an elite Gladiator?
Reputation?
To become champion?
No, no. The most important thing for an elite Gladiator is that for whatever decision they've made, they must follow it through.
No matter the torment that lies ahead...
I will follow my decisions through. And I will take the gold medal at the next Agon of Champions!
Is getting that kid the gold medal what you're really after? Or are you trying to fix a regret of your own?
Regret? I've got who knows how many. But I'm not going to rely on the kid to help me fix them.
I will help him get that gold medal. Because I saw it in his heart's desires.
You have to let him win this match.
I don't care how, as long as you get it done. Understand?
All eyes will be on the Gladiators of the Varro family during the finals.
We will receive more votes, than a higher seat in the Senate.
A sponsorship? I can help with that.
Don't worry, it'll be easy. After all, "only the strongest deserves to lead Septimont."
I can help you, but I'll need your vote in return.
I can help with that.
Just watch, Lunaria. My Gladiator will win this match, and when that comes to pass, all the benefits of past favors will flow naturally into my pockets.
Hmph! Do you really think I don't know what you've been up to?
If you want votes, you may as well do it clean.
The Ephor has begun implementing reforms to facilitate transparency of the tournaments. Best you keep those petty ideas to yourself.
Why you...
...My Gladiator will win this match.
Hmph! Do you really think I don't know what you've been up to?
Lupa is incredible!
You think so too? Ah, it's so nice to meet a fellow fan!
I've watched her since her debut match. She's changed partners over the years, but she roams through the arena like a lone wolf.
There was this one time when she had several matches in a row. Seeing her fight with everything she's got like that, I knew she must've put an incredible amount of work into her training.
I'm so glad I got to see her fighting in team again!
And she's got a new teammate! They make such a good team. I wonder which family {Male=he's;Female=she's} from...
{Male=His;Female=Her} skills doesn't seem to come from any family, so I'm guessing {Male=he's;Female=she's} also a drifter...
Can you make this Ta-da do more "ta-da", Mr. Aurus?
More "ta-da"? I can maybe try... Like this?
Whoa! That's amazing!
Lupa is incredible!
You think so too? Ah, it's so nice to meet a fellow fan!
I made a few posters of Lupa...
And I made some badges. Here, have one!
Doctor... My leg...
Your leg is fine.
Then why can't I feel it?
...Well, the anesthetic hasn't worn off yet.
Is my leg gonna be okay? I want to keep fighting in the tournament.
...Count yourself lucky, it's nothing serious. But I won't be so sure about next time.
Why did you charge forward when you could've just dodged?
I wanted to save my Echo...
Echo? All that just to save a tool?
Dodo is not a tool. We've been through so many battles together he and I are companions now.
Hmm, right. If that's what you think, then I'll keep it short. Just remember one thing.
Gladiating can be brutal.
Doctor...
All right. You go get some rest now.
Is my leg gonna be okay? I want to keep fighting in the tournament.
...Count yourself lucky, it's nothing serious. But I won't be so sure about next time.
We've got three wounded come in today...
Still manageable...
I'll do my best to help them.
The doctor said I have to go through physical therapy.
I need to recover fast.
Hey, wanna buy some intel?
Intel?
That's right. You're here for the Agon, no? Don't you wanna know which team will win in the upcoming matches?
As long as you place bets based on my intel, you're guaranteed to make all the money!
You can tell who's the winner before the match even starts?
Of course! If there's one thing Ol' Karthes learned in all his years as a Gladiator: Nothing's unknown as long as you have the cash!
All you need to know is who's gonna win. And if you're willing to splurge, I can tell you much, much more.
(Seems like there's more to the Gladiator tournaments than meets the eye...)
Hey, wanna buy some intel?
Hey, I'm warning you to stay away from that guy Karthes.
Him claiming he knows who's going to be the winner is his way of tricking people into placing bets.
But in reality, he just has a few connections and knows which families are rigging the matches.
If you place bets based on what he says, you're bound to lose all your money.
Hmph, that old gambling addict... It'll all catch up to him sooner or later.
It's so cute!
Hello! Fine weather today. You want something that'll make you howl with pure joy?
Show me what you have.
Hope these will make you howl with joy!
