Their replays are definitely worth watching over and over again!
More "ta-da"! More!
Mama, when I grow up, I wanna be a Ta-da!
Why's that?
Because it makes everyone really happy whenever it waddles its ears, and I want to make Mama and everyone happy like that!
And Ta-da is always happy too!
Y-You... Why did you apply for a transfer to our team?
The whole reason I trained so hard was to defeat you in the tournament.
I won't have it! I'm challenging you to a fight right now! And this Gladiator passing by shall serve as a witness to our duel!
Me?
What's going on here?
Yes! Please. I'll put in an official request this instant.
Oh, Malacius. You haven't changed a bit. But I do not wish to fight you.
I only wanted to transfer to a more casual team where I wouldn't have to be put in matches constantly. I'd like to devote more time to honing my skills, or maybe even take on an apprentice.
But Malacius never allowed me. He only wants to defeat me in combat. What do you suggest to be the best course of action?
Have Malacius transfer to a different team.
You should stay on this team.
Team up with him and defeat others.
I'm afraid that won't...

Transfer to a different team? That's a genius idea! You switched to our team, then I'll switch to yours. I'll apply to join the Beasts Beneath right now, and we can meet each other in the arena once more!
Adapt to change without making change... I see...
Well, in that case, Malacius, there's no reason for you to fight me. For today, at least.
A solid suggestion. There's no reason for us to fight each other every single day. With your strength and my strategies, the two of us would dominate in the arena.
Just think about it. Doesn't that sound more intriguing than having a showdown with me?
This will be the tournament where you shall taste defeat at my hands, Gnaeus.
...You really did transfer to the Beasts Beneath.
How dare you slack off?! Keep up with your training so I can defeat you in a duel!
You couldn't beat me even if I slouched here all day. So dream on.
Are you here to pay respects?
This is where the heroes of Septimont lie at rest. Their souls will cross the Styx Lake, forever protecting Septimont.
My squadmate is among them.
But, if only he weren't... If only I fought harder... I'm such a...
Liselotta...
If only I fought harder. I will inherit your final wishes.
We will protect this city you loved so dearly.
I still remember our hunts. You always went for a giant's cut of steak.
These days, no one can finish one on their own.
Don't worry, we're all doing well. Liselotta even qualified for the Great Agon.
And... the city you loved so fiercely is in safe hands.
Rest easy.
Sigh... How I wish I didn't allow you to be a Gladiator...
But even I did, you would still tread on that path, right?
Such was your nature...
If I become a Gladiator, Mom will come back, right?
Where did my pass go? Weird, it was in my pocket a second ago.
I'm afraid I can't let you in without your access pass! I'm not making that mistake again.
What mistake?
What happens if someone loses their access pass?
I really don't want to talk about it... Long story short, I got bamboozled... Sigh, it's left a stain on my career that's for sure!
Normally, it'll take three days to get renewed. Or you can try your luck at the lost and found.
I'm not lying to you! I-I just can't find it. Really! Just let me in, please. I'll show you my pass later once I find it.
No can do. I had a Huanglong Taoist girl show up once with a similar story of how she lost her pass. Next thing I knew, she tricked me with a fake card as a distraction and sneaked into the city!
I got chewed out by my superior for that one. So yeah. No pass. No entry!
But I told you I can't find it! What are you going to do? Arrest me?
Fill out a form, and I'll guide you through the application for a new one. I'll explain your situation to my superiors.
You're a good person, after all...
It's all my fault. I never should have insisted we try new gear. If I hadn't been so persistent, Deosthene wouldn't have gotten hurt from that TD...
Now's not the time for that! Deosthene, can you hear me?
Ugh...
It's a deep wound, but he's still with us, and we've managed to stop the bleeding. I can't believe how terrible this armor is. It cracked on the first hit!
This is beyond repair... You really can't cheap out on stuff like this. It's even worse than the gear we use during training.
So, what do we do? Go back and find that merchant?
We need to get Deosthene to a doctor first. Oh, I've got plenty of stuff to say to the scump when we see him!
Hey, you little thief! You're trying to get someone killed, selling junk like this?
Sounds like user error to me. Like I told you, they're Gladiator gear. You're supposed to use them in tournaments and not against Tacet Discords!

I've only ever promised a cheap price tag, if I might add. I bought this batch off of Annika. If you've got problems with the quality, go take it up with her. Plus, I never said they come with a free warranty or customer service.
Squirm all you want! You're coming with us to the Ephor's Palace. Let's see what they have to say about your tricks there!

H-hold on a second! I just remembered, Annika did tell me that batch of gear was labeled defective. Ugh, how can I forget something so important? This whole getting old thing isn't easy, I tell you. I do apologize!
May I propose this, I'll pay you back three times what you paid. And I'll cover your friend's medical bills while I'm at it!
Look, I'm just a simple man trying to put food on the table... How about we pretend this never happened, ok? Please don't take this to the Ephor!
You're not getting off that easy. We let you off the hook this time, but what happens if others fall victim to your crimes again? We're putting an end to this right now!
Sorry for all the trouble, guys. I'm just glad I made it out alive. I'm never gonna cheap out again...
Well, as long as you've learned your lesson. How's your wound? You sure you don't want to take a few extra days off?
Yeah! Why are you out of the hospital already? I-I even felt bad and took a few of your shifts for you...
Hahaha. Well, knock yourself out! It's just a scratch, really. It should be fine as long as I don't move around too much.
But what should I do with all the credits I got for compensation? There's still quite a bit left after paying my medical bills.
Oh yeah! Didn't they say someone was building a school for orphans of fallen soldiers? Why don't you donate it all to them?
Not a bad idea! That's my good deed for the year sorted too. That settles that!
Hmm? What's on your mind, Mom?
Just thinking about the news I saw last night. Something about that champion Gladiator everyone's talking about... Her name's Lupa, right? She looks quite the warrior!
I think so, too.
Yep. Lupa's the best!
I'm stronger than she is.
Wow, she even gets your seal of approval? Seems like there's a lot to look forward to, then.
Really? Well, I can't wait to see you in the finals, then!
I once visited Septimont to watch the Agon about twenty years ago. I don't remember most of the details, but I'll never forget the amazement I felt watching them compete.
Mom, who was the champion twenty years ago? Was she as great as Lupa?
Hehe, I'd like to know as much as you do. I remember her name goes something like... My... My... Hmm? Strange, what was that girl's name? I can't remember all of a sudden..?
...Mom?
Ah. Forgive me. I felt a bit light-headed there for a moment. I need a bit of rest. I'll be better in no time.
We've known you for quite a while now, old man. How is it that we've never seen you sell a single item?
Yeah! Want us to give you a hand, old timer?
I can lend a hand too, if you want.
This gear doesn't seem too bad.
Please, spare me the jokes. If you'd really wish to help me, perhaps you could buy a few of my wares?
You've got a good eye! Everything in my shop is of the highest quality. It's just too bad none of the other passersby have senses as good as yours. They think my gear is antiquated.

Sigh... I remember back in the day, people used to fight over my goods. There weren't enough to go around! You know that foreign Gladiator who won the championship twenty years ago? I'd say she owes half her victory to me! But ever since my voice has gotten hoarse, I can't hawk my wares so well, so no one buys from me anymore.

Again with the story twenty years ago... As far as I'm concerned, there's no one cooler or stronger than Lupa. When I grow up, I want to buy some of your gear, old timer, then go ask Lupa to be my mentor!
Me too! Don't worry, old man. We'll be your shop's ambassadors!
Hehe! Warms my heart to hear it, youngsters.
It's getting dark. Why don't you two head on home? I'll be fine here on my own.
We wanna watch the cable cars a bit more. Remember when we sneaked away from home that one time, Talla? Man, did they let us have it when they caught up with us...
I remember. The sunset from the cable car was unlike anything I've seen! We should just tell them we're going to watch the Agon next time instead of sneaking out.
Sounds like a plan to me! Hey! We customers are walking over from the cable cars!
Remember what I taught you?
Yep! If they're tourists, we tell them these are Septimont souvenirs and ask them if they want to buy something to remember their trip.
If they're Gladiators, then we tell them this is the same kind of gear that Gladiator champions used to equip back in the day. If they buy it, it'll make them just as strong!
That's it. I'll be counting on you both!
How impressive! You know, Linnea, last time your father and I visited here, this place had nothing more than a single tent. I never imagined it'd grow into such a nice small town!
Do you like it here, Mom?
You've been here before?
What was it like back then?
Yes, it was about twenty years ago. My husband and I visited for our honeymoon.
It used to feel like we were in a desert. Basically just a camp with a few tents scattered here and there.
Are you here on vacation as well? I hear the Ephor ordered this place built not too long ago, so they could keep close monitoring of the Blightcloud.
I've never seen construction work done so efficiently in Septimont... Even the Gladiators are involved! Makes you wonder if there's something else going on behind the scenes...
Let's head home, Mom. Dad said we have to be indoors where it's safe by nightfall!
Give me a minute. I'm curious now. Let me look around a bit more.
Mmm... Okay, I'll give you another five minutes.
Phew... Oh, it's you! Didn't think we'd run into each other here.
Got your access pass issue figured out?
You look exhausted.
I was able to get a temporary one, albeit with a bit of work. I'll get an official one once my application goes through.
Yep! I had to run from one office area to another just to get my temporary pass sorted... Really experienced the true joy that is being stranded somewhere with no proper identification.
Anyway, I'm absolutely pooped. Sightseeing around the city will have to wait until tomorrow.
I'm gonna go drop my luggage at the hotel, then head to the baths and just relax for a while.
I hope they've got rooms left...
May applause greet you!
Applause...? What? Oh, yeah. I remember that means something like "good luck" here, right?
Thank you. Hope you enjoy your time in Septimont as well! Look me up if you ever come to Huanglong.
Phew! F-Finally, I made it to the market.
Let's see... Tomorrow I need to get a new acces pass, then go buy some merch, and... You know what? I'll think about it after I find the hotel.
Nobody seems to be thrilled to be on duty... Is it because of the finals?
That's right. Everyone wants to get home and watch the tournament. Of course, they're a bit distracted...
I've heard the Blightcloud's been acting up lately. Here's hoping nothing bad's about to happen...
Don't jinx it! I'm just a normal grunt. It's not like I'm some warrior like the Ephor...
Let me go, please! I have to find my child!
Calm down, ma'am. Give me the details. Slowly.
What happened?
You lost your child?
I ran out of Bamboo Irises while preparing medicine for her grandmother yesterday, and I planned to ask the Gladiators to help me gather some. I guess my daughter overheard me.
I couldn't find her anywhere when I got back home this morning. All I found was a note saying she went out to gather herbs. She's most likely left the Citadel.
So, please. Let me go find her!
Just take it easy, ma'am. We have a highly active Blightcloud on our hands. How are you going to protect yourself out there against the TDs?
B-But...
You stay put for now. I'll round up anyone not on duty and organize a search party. But listen to me carefully. Do not take a single step outside this Citadel!
You know, I've always been a fan of the Beasts Beneath. There's no way they're not taking home the title this year!
You're full of crap! What happened to supporting Scratchy? Now that the Beasts are winning, you're switching sides...
I mean, who doesn't like being on the winning side? Ugh... Wish I could go see the tournament in person.
Well, it just so happens I have an extra ticket for the Beasts match. We can go watch it when we're both free.
Lupa's team won. No surprises there. Still, I'm proud of you, Beasts Beneath! May applause greet you!
Oh? Not calling yourself a longtime Lupa fan, are you now?
Please. After today, we're all Lupa fans! Some people already watched the replays of her finals match a dozens times.
Well, it was an incredible match, after all. Such a great victory.
My pass is about to expire, but I'm having so much fun! There are still a ton of places I haven't visited yet.
That's just how it is. It's our first visit to Septimont, so they only gave us five days.
Oh, time, I wish you'd freeze at this moment! I want to go have another round at Solis!
You really are something... Let's just go see if we can apply for an extension.
Things have been getting more eventful around the Citadel lately. Fistfights happening in my neighborhood every night...
...We're doing our best.
You know, we get dozens of reports of assaults like yours every day. We just can't get to them all.
Just head home for now, and you'll hear from us. And try to stay indoors after dark.
You're back late tonight. Did you run into trouble out on the hunt?
Not me. Others.. We came across a three-man team that got torn apart on our way back. Held us up a bit.
Their gear seemed new, though. Wonder how they got hammered so badly...
Maybe they were sold crappy gear? Unlucky bastards...
...Is this the latest data on the Blightcloud? Why is there so much activity?
I'm just as surprised as you are. The Ephor was right to be concerned. Things are worse than we expected...
I'll round up some idle hands together during the day to go take a closer look. I'll leave the reports to you.
...Got it. This is urgent. I'll go bring the brass up to speed.
You remember that move during the match last night? They were all like... WOOSH! BAM! SMACK!
You're talking about when they opened with an upward thrust with the spear, then followed up with a quick jab, right? So cool!
That's the one! I'm adding it to my training plan. From now on, it's gonna be my killer move!
Uh... I mean, it's definitely cool and all, but please don't shout out your every single move during training. People will think we're weird.
Daddy, Daddy! When are you coming home? Mommy and I miss you!
M-Mommy's worried about you just eating that soldier food. She keeps talking about how it's not unhealthy...
Don't worry, Daddy will be home in a couple of days. Tell Mommy I'm doing fine here.
It's getting late. Head on home now. And be careful!
Ugh... I've been on all these shifts lately, I haven't even gotten a chance to go home... Wonder how my wife and daughter are doing.
Oh, right! For my next time off, I'll take them on a vacation!
It's been so long since we've gone out as a family... I can't wait!
I check the map. We need to make a right up here if we want to get to the market.
Aw, what? Weren't we going to go get some finals merch?
Ugh, fine. Let's stop by the hotel first for a quick rest, at least. My legs are killing me...
I'll just go on my own then. You head back and rest all you want!
May applause greet you! Welcome to the Citadel, recruits. As you'll be assigned your duties tomorrow, I'd like to open it up to any questions or feedback regarding your duties.
Captain Drusus, could you share with us some of your stories from the past? I wish to become someone like you, but I'm not exactly sure how to train myself.

Let's save the stories for when we're off-duty. As far as training goes... Well, it's not really something I can cram into a few words. Make the most out of every training opportunity you can get. Keep your eyes peeled when carrying out your duties. Practice. Learn. Growth in perseverance.
What about you? Got anything on your mind?
I-I'd like to know the difference between Gladiators and soldiers. It's my first day, so I'm not really sure how things work around here.
No need to worry. Soldiers and gladiators both fight for honor. Both are respectable. You'll get used to this place faster than you think.
Got it. Have you ever thought about becoming a Gladiator, Captain Drusus? With your skills, you'd be sure to do well in the tournaments!
Hahaha! An interesting suggestion!. But one I'll have to decline I'm afraid. I've got some promises to keep with my old comrades in arms.
Besides, I love what I do now! It's truly a joy, watching you all grow day by day into true guardians of Septimont!
Do you think I should be a soldier or a Gladiator when I grow up, mister?
Why the sudden question?
Our teacher is making us write a paper about our future dreams. But I don't know which one to pick...
I see... Then I suggest picking the soldier. You have a set routine as a soldier. It might save you a bit of work on that paper.
You're looking to buy some new equipment? What's your budget?
I need to keep it within around a month's salary. But quality is my No.1 requirement. I'm not getting scammed by junk again.
Well, you can rest assured, friend. Oh yeah, I have those tickets you wanted.
Thanks! I'll come get it after my shift. Finally, I can go see the troupe's performance!
I can't find my access pass. How about you cut me some slack and just let me through?
Rules are rules! You're not getting through the Citadel without an access pass!
I could really use a bath and have something yummy right now...
I also really want to go see a match at the Colosseum, go sunbathing at Leonidas Plaza...
Ugh... When is it my time to take a break?
Have you seen my daughter? Did anyone see her come through here?
Please calm down, ma'am. Can you describe your daughter to me in detail?
S-She turns eight this year. She was wearing... Oh no! I forgot what she was wearing!
Please be safe, Lilia...
Did you find the missing child?
No. We've swept the vicinity and got nothing. At this point, all we can do is try our luck at Mournfell Canyon.
...Got it. Then I'll head out there and have a look around. I'll let you know if I find anything.
You saved my daughter! Thank you! Thank you!
Say thank you to the nice man, Lilia!
...Thank you, sir.
Just doing my job, sir. Now, little girl. Remember, from now on, no sneaking out of the Citadel all on your own again, okay?
Ugh, the wound that I got from saving that kid is still killing me... I may have gone a little bit too far.
Did you see it, Mom? I fulfilled my duties as a soldier today.
Now I have the strength to protect others... just like you once protected me.
...I miss you, Mom.
Hard work is the only path to true strength!
I'm gonna be just like you one day!
What exactly is the difference between soldiers and Gladiators?

Captain Drusus, when will we be assigned field missions? I've done pretty much everything there is to do around the Citadel. I think it's about time we get to see some action. I've always had an interest in recon missions in the Sanguis Plateaus...
I share the same thought. But I know my skills need more work, and I'd just be holding everyone back...
You're still too early for field missions. We won't let you venture beyond these walls until we're sure you can protect yourselves.
But I can manage my own! I may not be as strong as you, Captain, but I can handle the average TD just fine!

I was once your age myself, so I understand the passion to get out there and prove yourselves. How about this, next time I go out on a mission, I'll bring you all with me. You can stick around, and maybe you'll learn something.
Really?! Thank you! I won't let the opportunity go wasted, sir!
I like your hustle. Keep an eye on him for me, Tullia. Don't let him go charging in like a lunatic at the first sign of a threat, like he always does during training.
Yes, Captain...
I-I mean. I won't, Captain!
Night patrols are also our responsibility. There's no room for mistakes...
Then have me go beyond the Citadel. I heard we're short on manpower out there.
Beyond the Citadel...? Sounds like there will be trouble around every corner.
You got this, Lupa! No matter how you do in the finals, I'll always support you!
With her capabilities, the win's in the bag for sure! I want to get stronger too... Wish I could be in the same training room with Lupa...
Is she really as tough as they say she is? I mean... could there be a chance she's cheating?
See? I told you all Lupa was going to win the championship!
Did you see her moves during the finals? I've watched the replays over and over, trying to recreate her moves.
I guess I was wrong about Lupa... It's all pure strength, plain and simple.
You're a quick learner! Won't be long before you can start heading out to the Sanguis Plateaus.
I heard that's where the Blightcloud is located. Have you ever been out there, Captain?
Sure have. I'll be honest, I'm not fond of doing recon work out there...
When's our next Sanguis Plateaus mission, Captain?

Thought you might never wake up again. I was gonna get Dr. Wu Sheng to check on you.
Isn't that what you wanted?
Am I supposed to say "Thank you"?
I have no interest in taking your life. Master Dollmaker wants to see you alive.
You're welcome. But save your gratitude for Master Dollmaker, since he asked me to keep you alive. We'd be in trouble if you died.
Why you insolent little whippersnapper. Show some manners when you're talking to Miss Yinlin.
Who? Me…?
Where is your <color=Highlight>family</color>?
Youngsters like you, always runnin' off and leaving yer family to rot.
It's "Family Reunion Day." Ain't no way I'm lettin' anyone leave this camp.
Go sit down next to the bonfire and stay there. Don't yer be thinking of slippin' off… Miss Yinlin, show 'em the way.
You heard the kind lady. Now keep your mouth shut and follow me.
And if I say no?
You can try to escape. I wouldn't recommend it, though.
Without Dr. Wu Sheng's antidote, you wouldn't make it too far with that poison inside of you.
You expect me to believe that?
It's all up to you. Just know I have no reason to lie.
You were planning to ask Master Dollmaker about your memories anyway, so why not come with me?
What exactly is this place?
It's the Séance Society's headquarters. We all live here.
Why don't you join the Society? Make things easier for all of us.
Where do I sign up?
No.
Good try. Try not to sound so obvious next time.
I expected as much. But you may have a change of mind later.
Come on. Joining or not, it won't hurt to introduce yourself first.

You soon discover that it was Yinlin who trapped you here. She reveals that this is the Séance Society's base and invites you once more to join the organization, offering to introduce you to its members.
Well. What are you waiting for?
Youngsters these days… always complaining about us old-timers being naggy.
Umm… I haven't even said anything yet.
Grandma Guan patrols this place daily to keep us safe. She used to be a Midnight Ranger.
Sigh, there's no one like my precious boy. No matter how long this old lady ran her mouth, he'd always listen till the end.
Who's that?
Her grandson.
Such a sweet boy he was… His parents died young. I was the only one he could rely on.
And they took him away from me, as if he hadn't suffered enough misfortunes...
How lucky I was to have Master Dollmaker bring him back to me... Praise the heavens for this miracle.
I'll do anything for Master Dollmaker. Nothing will ever be enough to repay his kindness...
But...Why would he make puppets for those Fractsidus devils…
I'm sure Master Dollmaker has his own reasons.
Yes... I'm just grateful to have my grandson back. Can't ask for more.
Greetings, stranger. The name's Jinlu. We're the guards here, He Chang and I.
Are you a Resonator?
Right you are. The two of us and Lirong used to be Midnight Rangers.
How are you feeling? Got the Overclocking under control?
Thanks for asking, Miss Yinlin. I'm feeling a lot better now.
Lirong though… He... he had it rough back there.
Why stay with a puppet when you know it's dangerous?
We served in the same unit. He Chang Overclocked trying to save me… In the end, he didn't make it.
What if you end up Overclocking too?
I know the risks… I'm just... I'll do anything. Anything to make it up to him, if I still can.
You discover that Jinlu met his fallen comrade He Chang here and chose to stay because of their strong bond.
Oh… So you've accepted my invitation, Rover.
Are you from the Séance Society?
Well, yes. My name is Lirong.
Since you are here, you must have lost someone, too.
Daddy…
Now, Yuanyuan, no need to be afraid… {Male=He;Female=She}'s not one of those evil Patrollers. You're safe with me.
Is this your daughter?
Yes, my daughter… Her name is Yuanyuan. My only precious.
I am Daddy's precious?
Absolutely, my dear. We will stay together... Nothing can take you from me again...
She was taken from you?
Ah, yes... Once we were separated by an unfortunate turn of events... But now I have her back, thanks to the Séance Society's help...
Truly a miracle, is it not?!
And you… Yes, you too can be reunited with your loved ones... Just come join us...
So... Your daughter had died?
No! She didn't... She was never gone!
Can't you see? Yuanyuan, she... She's still alive! Alive and well!
Daddy!? What's happening…? You're scaring me…
(He seems off. Is he Overclocking?)
Calm down! I'll get you a doctor!
No! No doctor! I don't need anything!!
I am not leaving her… You're not leaving daddy, right Yuanyuan?
Wah... I...
He might hurt the girl... I must act fast!

An anonymous email leads you to Lirong and his daughter, Yuanyuan. Lirong is a member of the Séance Society, a group that claims to reunite members with their loved ones. He invites you to join, but becomes agitated when asked about his daughter's fate, refusing to accept that she is no longer truly alive.
Miss Yinlin… Who might this be?
Don't worry. {Male=He;Female=She}'s Master Dollmaker's guest.
I see… Whatever. I just want to stay with my son.
Your son… Is he a puppet too?
So what!? He's still my one and only son… What would you know!?
Rover, let's stop it here...
What on earth happened...
That's why I won't let anyone threaten our peaceful life ever again…
You learn that Lianyue, who also reunited with her deceased child with the Society's help, refuses to let anyone disrupt their current life.
Dr. Wu Sheng, how's Lirong doing?
Out of danger for now, but he's still in a coma.
Sorry... I'm not that familar with taking care of Resonators. There's not much else I can do.
Shame. He shouldn't have disobeyed Master Dollmaker.
Was it you who injected me with poison?
Well, yes. Master Dollmaker asked me to.
We had no other choice. You refused to join us.
Did you poison everyone else here too?
No, why would I need to? They're not leaving here.
This is the only place where we can forever live with our loved ones.
You're a doctor. You should know how dangerous those puppets are.
I do. But I also know why we'll hold on to them no matter what.
Doctors can't save everyone. Not even the best of us can.
I could only watch as my better half passed away in agony...
Master Dollmaker saved us with his puppets. That's something no doctor can ever achieve.
What about you? Do you have someone you desperately need to see again?
As a matter of fact, I do.
No, I do not.
I don't know…
You can ask Master Dollmaker for help. He'll bring them back.
Rather fortunate of you... or shall I say, unfortunate? To not have a single person that you cherish.
Feeling lost? I suggest taking a walk and go chat with everyone a bit. We're all for helping each other.

Wu Sheng tells you that even the best doctors can't save everyone, just as he was not able to save his wife. The Dollmaker's puppets gave them a second chance, something no doctor could offer. While Wu Sheng understands the dangers of the puppets, he also knows how much they mean to the people here.
You've talked with everyone I see. Are you joining us now?
They're not bad people, but…
...They're just some poor souls longing to see their loved ones again.
Master Dollmaker saves them, letting them make amends for their past regrets.
A noble cause, is it not?
Is this why you betrayed me?
Heh. How is it betrayal when we were never a team?
Having a cop on our side makes things easier for the Séance Society, don't you agree?
I was just a young orphan, never knew who my parents were. Master Dollmaker took me in.
He taught me combat, puppetry, temperance, and how to become a Patroller.
I owe my life to him.
But he's in for more than just helping people.
Yes, his eyes are set on another ultimate goal...
We're all his subjects. He needs us to complete the last two puppets.
Every one of us has been aware of this, but still decided to join.
What kind of puppet is he trying to make?
That's not for your ears. Members only, you see?
But I do admit you're not like the others.
You rescued Lirong and showed respect to the puppets. They weren't just objects to you, I could tell.
I couldn't just stand by and watch.
Look at you, ever so righteous...
Maybe you're better suited to be a Patroller than me.
You were kind to those people and their puppets, too.
Kindness…
Hmph, or maybe... I couldn't just stand by, either.
Can I trust your words this time?
That's up to you. Trust is a delicate thing. You must follow your instincts and decide how much you're willing to give.
Enough chatter for now. I'll take you to Master Dollmaker's pl...
Help! HELP!

Yinlin reveals that she empathizes with these people who just want to see their loved ones again. She reveals that she was once a member of the Séance Society herself. She grew up alongside the Dollmaker and knows that his experiments are aimed at creating two special puppets. However, she keeps the details of this final experiment from you.
What's going on?
Miss Yinlin! The Tacet Discords are here!
Go tell your grandma. Get everyone somewhere safe.
O-okay!
What about you, Rover? Will you join them or flee while you can in this chaos?
They're not bad people...
So you want to help protect them. Knew it.
You owe me the truth after this. Everything.
Everything, huh... The secrets I hold might be bigger than you imagine.
If you really want to know... You'll need to survive this first!
Surrender now! We've got you surrounded! You are the leader here, aren't you?
My, my. That's quite the party.
Hey! Who the hell are you? Let {Male=him;Female=her} go!
And if I don't?
Freeze! Shut up!
Don't worry. I'm not going anywhere. I've got a hostage, you see?
Whoa! You-You... Don't move!
I wouldn't try anything stupid if I were you. Can't risk the VIP of Jinzhou getting hurt, now can we?
Ugh, fine... Lower your weapons guys!
"Trust me… Come this way."
When the Patrollers besiege the base, Yinlin takes you hostage but secretly passes you a message: "Trust me… Come this way."
Yuanyuan!
Stop, you're going to injure her.
Shut up! Take your hands off her NOW!
No! Daddy! *screams*
That's enough, Lirong.
Urgh…!?
She'll be safe in my care. You still have other things to do, remember?
Huff... Ugh... No! Don't! Yuanyuan!
Lirong!
Do you want to lose your daughter again?
Urgh… Gah… No, I... Fine, I'll leave it to you.
Do you know him?
Now, hand over the girl…
You see, that man is her father. Why do you want to separate them?
He is dangerous…
Oh well, whatever. Yuanyuan? Come over here please?
Yes...
Good girl. Stay here, Yuanyuan.
What did you do!?
And why would you be concerned? Smart {Male=boys;Female=girls} know how to mind their own business.
Oh? You're quite the fighter… Hmm, how about…
We're not fighting now? I can go on if you want.
Shh... They're coming… It's the Patrollers. We can't let them find out about Yuanyuan.
Now if you don't want to get into trouble, better do as I say... I'll explain everything later.
Including what's happening with the "Séance Society"…
Fine.
No.
Smart choice...
Oh, don't be so pigheaded. What if I pinned the blame on you?
Say, for trying to abduct this little girl? You'll have a real time talking your way out of that... Right, Yuanyuan?
Yes, Miss Yinlin...
(Guess I'll have to do as she said, for now.)
Good. Now come give me a hand. We'll need to hide the traces of fighting here.

A mysterious woman arrives and convinces Lirong to leave. After he departs, a fight breaks out between you and the woman over Yuanyuan. The confrontation only ends when a Patroller shows up. To uncover the truth about the Séance Society and the missing persons, you decide to cooperate with the woman, starting by cleaning up the scene.
So that's what the Séance Society was up to... Thanks for your statement, it really helped!
Somehow the Fractsidus was involved too! Who could have thought… Luckily you were there to stop them in time!
How's the Dollmaker?
How are the Séance Society people doing?
The man's still not saying anything... Guess we'll have to keep him under custody for now.
Nothing about that suspect lady either. We still have zero info on her.
Most of those Resonators have varying degrees of Overclocking. They need urgent care, the professionals from Huaxu Academy are already on it.
A guy named Lirong had it worst, didn't wake up from his coma until yesterday.
He's still recovering from some really bad aftereffects, but at least he's making progress.
Oh, so the missing cases led to an illegal cult-like organization AND a bunch of other twisted plans!
Unbelievable... We'd be toast without your help.
Actually, I couldn't do it without someone else's help.
Huh? And who's that?
An emissary of justice, hidden in the shadows.
An honorable companion.
I'm not sure whether she's a friend or foe.
What? Come on, you need to be more specific… Whoever they are, sounds like they'll make for quite the Patroller.
I'll be sure to tell her that.
Well, that's it for now. Ring me up when you find something unusual again. I'll catch you later!

You learn from Chixia that the injured are recovering, but the Dollmaker still refuses to cooperate. She thanks you for your help, and you hint that the real thanks should go to a mysterious partner. However, you make sure to keep the partner's name a secret.
(A letter without a signature. It can only lead to one thing.)
(Yinlin. She's waiting for me.)
(Same as last time, she said... Must be the wolf markings. I should look around.)
Splendid view, right?
As promised, I owe you a lot of explanation.
Had you been planning to get me involved?
No, I wasn't expecting to meet you.
My order was to oversee our deal with the Fractsidus.
You were just a pawn in my plan to find where Lirong kept the puppets.
But I didn't expect him to try and escape with them. Couldn't risk exposing myself yet, so I had to track him down and retrieve the puppets.
Around that time, Dollmaker caught wind of your special abilities. He asked me to bring you to that safe house.
You zapped me a little too hard back there.
Hehe… Oh, really? I even upped the voltage for the best effect. Was that just a zap to you?
No wonder our Dollmaker took so much interest in that body of yours.
So he couldn't recover my memories?
Unfortunately, no. He tried but couldn't gain access.
According to him, you possess a power beyond his understanding that prevented him from prying into your mind. You might be more special than you had thought.
Said he couldn't read your mind without risking his own sanity, let alone retrieve any information... I can't imagine what the hell is going on beneath your skull.
Who knows? Maybe you helped some strangers again only to mess with the wrong person, and ended up with your memories gone.
I say you should stop playing hero and take better care of yourself. You'll live longer that way.
Are you worried about me?
Don't think I need to, since you can handle yourself just fine. But... if you ever need my help, just let me know.
We have a lot in common. Both alone in this world.
Maybe I'll keep you in my thoughts. A reminder that I'm not the only solitary soul out there.
And eventually, we'll both learn to move through our lives with loneliness.
Perhaps the same loneliness was too much for Dollmaker to bear... That's why he gave up everything to resurrect my parents.
He had companions, he just never cherished them.
Yes… After my parents' death, we all became chess pieces to him, myself included.
Raised me to be a Patroller for his own agenda. He needed a mole in the Public Security Bureau.
In the end I did become a Patroller, but failed to stay by his side as he desired.
Maybe I'm indeed a heart-wrenching betrayer to him...
He dug his own grave.
Yes... We all have to face the consequences of our actions. I don't plan to defend him.
But if I had acted sooner, this whole mess could have been avoided. Why didn't I do something?
Perhaps… like everyone else in the Séance Society, I too held onto that naive pipe dream.
The dream of finally meeting my parents and having a real family... I indulged in it more than I care to admit.
Deep down, I knew my dream was built upon the sacrifices of innocent lives... but I couldn't bear to shatter it.
In the end, you still fulfilled your duty. As a Patroller.
Hmph... because I met you. A total outsider risking {Male=his;Female=her} life for me and for all those people...
A lot of it still remains unresolved. Dollmaker was merely a cog in the wheel. A bigger shadow lingers.
The Fractsidus…
Yes. We must stay vigilant until we expose the true culprits and destroy their plans for good.
We?
Don't tell me you're pulling out at this point?
If you are, I may have to wipe my true identity from your head by force...
Please go easy on me…
It was a joke. Anyway, I should thank you... Because of you, I was able to accomplish far more and save many more lives than I imagined.
You feel different. I have the feeling I can always trust your words, whatever you say.
Do you mean it?
Hehe... Well, take a guess?
Oh, and lastly… There is another thing I should thank you for. For trusting me all the way till the very end.
Until we meet again, Rover… Perhaps I'll meet you under an entirely different identity next time.

When you meet Yinlin again, she tells you that the Dollmaker attempted to extract your memories but failed. The cause of your memory loss is far more complex than you thought. She thanks you for your help and coyly suggests that your next meeting may be under a completely different guise.
You there… You're not one of us. How did you sneak in here?!
Quxiu, are you injured?
Miss Yinlin!? You're back!
Easy there. You need to rest…
This is Master Dollmaker's guest. You're safe with {Male=him;Female=her}.
It is my duty to protect our people... I'll be fine.
Those are no small wounds.
I'm fine... Ugh...
No more duties if you died from those wounds... We no longer need you to protect this place, remember?
But Master Dollmaker, he… he told me to protect this place at all cost.
That won't be necessary... Master Dollmaker's not coming back. I'll be getting rid of everything here.
Master Dollmaker's ultimate goal is near, and he won't need them anymore... Neither will I.
But…
Enough… You heard what I said. Stay put, I'll go fetch some first-aid for you.
Yinlin heads off to retrieve some medicine from Dr. Wu Sheng.
That should do the trick…
(I should check this place out while Yinlin's gone. Might find something about that Dollmaker.)
Urgh… Damn those monsters...
Did the Tacet Discords injure you?
We've fought off quite a lot of them lately. I just got a bit careless.
Do they come at your camp often?
Some of us said they could be attracted to the puppets…
I don't believe that though. I'll defend this place, no matter what.
Why are you guarding this place?
I don't know... This place sounded super important to Master Dollmaker. He told me to protect it with my life.
But... Indeed, he hasn't visited this place for a long time now... Maybe Miss Yinlin was right...
Anyway... I'll still be keeping them safe. Miss Yinlin said she'll get rid of everything here, but I believe they still retain some importance to her and Master Dollmaker.
Everything's back to where they were before…
Found a piece of paper inside one of the boxes. Seems like a transaction record.
Date of transaction... It says today. Items... 4 Reincarnation Puppets. What are those?
Signee... "Lirong". Probably forgot to take it with him.
(Is it the handiwork of one of the children back there?)
(Or… a memory of an adult member's youth?)
(This... It reads like the writing of a Patroller undercover.)
(But why is it here? Is the Dollmaker doing business with one of the Patrollers?)
(The Dollmaker has been delving into his Forte, trying to make a certain puppet.)
(Whose puppet is he trying to create?)
(What did she want to tell the Dollmaker... Guess I'll never know.)
(The message is still here, which means it probably never reached the Dollmaker.)
(Yinlin will be back at any moment now.)
(I should go back to Quxiu.)
After a while, Yinlin came back with some first-aid supplies to treat Quxiu's wounds.
This should do it. If it still hurts, go to Dr. Wu Sheng for a detailed checkup.
Thank you, Miss Yinlin! It's just a scratch... Nothing to worry about.
Go find somewhere safe to rest. You're relieved of your duties.
But Miss Yinlin...
We're burning it all. Stand back, I'll use my thunder to start up a fire... No trace will be left.
You sure you want to do this? I think you may regret it.
Oh? So you've read what's written inside?
Yes, I have.
No, I haven't.
You seem to enjoy meddling in other people's business...
You're really not a good liar, I'll give you that...
On second thought, the past can't be erased anyway.
Burning these makes no difference, and the flames could attract Tacet Discords.
Still, Quxiu, you should leave this place. We don't need you to protect these anymore.
What if those monsters come at us again? We'll have no one to stop them!
Your safety matters far more than these objects of the past. If you're okay, go help those who aren't.
Understood!
Yes?
(Should I ask Yinlin about it?)
You found anything?
(Nevermind...)
See those flowers? Don't you think they look out of place here?
Try counting them. I have a feeling that may be the passcode. (4, 1, 2, 3)
I just remembered there's another place we need to visit. Come with me.
Relax. Nothing's going to happen to you... Not yet, at least.
(Looks like a child's diary...)
(There's a crude drawing folded inside, with some scribbled words on the back.)
No signs of injuries on Yuanyuan. That woman wasn't controlling her through Resonance Abilities, either.
Then why is Yuanyuan obeying her commands...
(Done... Here's hoping they'll get my message.)
(Now, how do I get out of here...)
Oh, you're awake? Come out then.
Daddy, are we waiting for someone?
Yes, honey. We're expecting a new member...
There, Yuanyuan... Are you hurt?
No, Miss Yinlin. My body is fully functional.
I will not let those puppets fall into Fractsidus hands!
I think I've lost them...
Come help me cover up the traces.
While you don't look like the typical upstanding citizen, I doubt you would want any extra trouble.
I should be safe at this point.
No need to tip-toe around me, I know I'm a puppet. I'm just happy to see Jinlu again.
You're surprisingly open-minded about it.
Well, as a dead guy, I try not to overthink things anymore.
Greetings, Miss Yinlin. Back already?
Yeah, just bringing this {Male=boy;Female=girl} in.
Hey, bud... Wanna grab a drink tonight?
Haha, nah, I know you can't handle much.
Want one?
I'll pass... Go easy on it, okay?
Don't worry. I don't drink when I'm on duty.
Don't wander off on your own, okay?
I know, Mom. I'm not going anywhere.
You give a statement regarding what happened.
The large rock you saw earlier is only a hologram. Now the real entrance to the safe house is revealed.
(Found him. Lirong is here.)
(I should go take a closer look...)
The mysterious whispers of the woman suddenly sound distant. You see the chance to resist... but on second thought, you decide to close your eyes, play along, and see what she wants.
(No injuries. I still have my weapon and Terminal.)
(It's hard to tell from what little I've gathered so far. I should find out where this place is first.)
Linsi... Where are you?
Don't be scared, Xiaofu. We are right here with you...
Fujie. You have no idea how much I miss you...
It's me, Yinlin…
Our doc seems busy... I'll go get it myself.
Come on, Lizhu! The project deadline's coming up—you can't keep loafing around like this.
Did something happen?
Slacking off again?
Oh, hi {PlayerName}. You're here just in time.
Nonsense! I've been collecting data all day, so I think I deserve a tiny little break.
Now… have you heard of Pincer Maneuver Warriors?
Pincer what?
Sounds weird.
It's a simulation program that's gone viral on the Huaxu Hive. It simulates combat scenarios using data from digital entities and Tacet Discords.
You control two teams to perform a "pincer maneuver" and fight off endless waves of enemies in a limited time.
Is this an ad?
It's a bit awkward for an ad.
Anyway, that's what the anonymous uploader posted. I know, a lot of the game ads are kind of fake, but this one intrigued me. So I gave it a try after work.
Apparently, it's based on a tactical simulation project co-developed by the Academy and the Black Shores. They added some fun little features that make it surprisingly relaxing.
That's why I may have squeezed in A LITTLE free time from my research to play it. Can't blame me for this.
So, you're slacking off again.
No, I'm not! Don’t tell my mentor or I'll be in trouble.
Since you're here, I'm trusting you with my Huaxu Hive account so I can stay focused.
And if you're not too busy, why not try the program yourself? It's actually pretty fun! I promise!
Alright, alright.
If it's boring, I'm leaving a complaint on the feedback form.
I knew I could count on you! Here, let me set up your terminal.
No problem. Wait, how do you know there's a feedback form... Anyway, let me set up your terminal.
Lizhu takes your terminal and operates on it for a while...
All set. Now you can log in with my account.
There you are! How's the program? Let me check your progress.
Final stage cleared with such a high score? I knew it! You've got a knack for combat simulations.
No biggie. Just average.
It's simulated, after all—real combat's a different story.
By the way, the thread about the program has been trending nonstop.
Someone even dug into this internal program and found it connects to the Academy's public database. The protocol seems solid, so no risk of data leaks.
Who made this program anyway?
No clue. The anonymous poster keeps releasing new patches on the Huaxu Hive, but no other details.
Though, I have a feeling they've got a lot of free time on their hands.
Don't tell me it's you.
Sounds like someone I know… right in front of me.
Ahaha... Nice try, but don't forget, I've got a thesis to write.
(Stare at Lizhu quietly)
...Come on, seriously? It's not me, I swear.
You see, this program may seem entertaining, but it actually <color=blue>simulates a variety of experimental scenarios to test certain combat theories</color>, don't you think?
Plus, while you're enjoying those <color=red>fiery and exciting</color> battles, you might also notice the UI is so <color=red>elegant and well-designed</color>.
And the use of <color=white>Remnant Ecoacoustics data</color> in this program shows the developer has... ahem, a deep understanding of that research field.
I think I know who they are.
Are you hinting at something on purpose?
Well, well... If there's nothing else, I'll get back to my research. Catch you later!
Hi, up for a round of Pincer Maneuver Warriors? It's really gaining a lot of players lately!
It says low battery to the mechanical arm. Let's place it on the nearby mountains. I can use some solar energy to charge it up.
Two vandalized boats are stranded upon the nearby shores. Some repaired mechanical legs are left on the boat.
A mechanical arm. Perhaps it belongs to some device.
A mechanical leg. Perhaps it belongs to some device.
Damaged. No alternative arms founded.
Install the arm
Install the leg
Installation Success
Installation Success
Fails to start the engine... Maybe it can be restarted some time later...
Hmm?
Um... Does he mean "What's your business at the Vanguard Base"?
Vanguard Base?
Hmph.
He means "If you have nothing to do, don't loiter around here".
I'm sorry! My brother can be a bit rude... Let me explain for him!
The Midnight Rangers have three divisions: Outrider, Vanguard, and Rearguard, all under the command of General Jiyan.
The Vanguard is the vanguard force of the Midnight Rangers, mainly responsible for frontline combat. This is the Vanguard Base.
We are very close to the frontline here, and there are often Tacet Discord sightings around. If you have nothing important, please do not linger around, especially do not proceed further to the east.
Has the situation on the battlefield become more intense?
How do you understand what he's saying?
Although he doesn't talk much, he is very dedicated to his work and skilled, which is why General Jiyan specifically appointed him to guard this place.
Hmph, with the two of us, the Vanguard Base is impregnable!
That's right, even some of the soldiers who were originally stationed at the base have recently been deployed to the battlefield...
In order to defend this place, we can't leave our posts to ensure your safety, so please stay away from the front lines as much as possible.
Ah... Well, we grew up together, so even without words, I can understand what he means just from his expression.
Huh?
Danger.
How is the situation at the front lines?
Don't go.
It seems like my leg really doesn't hurt anymore...
Huh? I'm sorry, is there anything I can help you with?
Are you injured?
Uh... Yes, the Tacet Discord in Norfall Barrens is active and the attacks are intense. It's inevitable to get injured.
Last week, we, the defenders, successfully repelled ten attacks from the Tacet Discord. It's already good that I only have these minor injuries.
But luckily, General Jiyan is here. That's why I was able to recover from my injuries so quickly.

Now, please accept this as a gift to mark our first meeting.
In Ragunna, most ladies of your age will usually select a perfume that matches their tastes and personality.
A distinctive scent can bring back a moment and a feeling, much like how that perfume reminded you of home. For someone else, it could remind them of a rainy night and a particular person.
Is the same true for that pink bottle of perfume you carry? Did you choose it for yourself?
I'm curious... what kind of scent do you like, Ms. Carlotta?
Oh, that bottle… Not quite. It's more about the other meaning of perfume... more subtle, and perhaps even a bit dangerous...
I never imagined a fish from the depths could dance with fire…
I never imagined a fish from the depths could dance with fire... A delightful collaboration, Lady Changli.
It is always a pleasure to accept your invitation. Thanks to it, I was able to witness such a magnificent display of fire.
Indeed... But what if the fire were to burn beyond just these anniversary flames?
Oh? Then where does the Fisalia family intend to let it burn? Are you playing an offensive or defensive game here?
We now need to...
Phoebe, we now need to take an inventory of the leftover plates, forks, and candles from the ceremony. Additionally…
Understood. I will help as much as I can.
No need to worry about all that! I've already taken care of everything.
Lollo Logistics has already packed it all up! Mission accomplished!
But we haven't counted everything yet...
You two really have… very different personalities.
Black Cat... I mean, {PlayerName}, is there anything troubling you? May I be of help?
(Brief her on the situation.)
I see. So the <ano=Second Coming of Solaris><te href=800006>Sonoro Sphere</te></ano> trapping us is the doing of Abbowser, a darker side of Abby, correct?
And to escape, we need to rescue our scattered <te href=800004>Cube</te> companions, defeat Abbowser, and remake the... <ano=Control Unit><te href=800002>Anniversary Cake</te></ano>?
You are sharp as ever, Jinhsi.
{PlayerName}, do you know the whereabouts of Sanhua, Ms. Taoqi, and General Jiyan?
Jinzhou is in the midst of a bustling festival, and if all the key leaders are trapped within this Sonoro Sphere, I must consider whether our emergency plan remains operational.
Since your last meeting with Jinhsi was in the spring, the Remnant Cube's memory is also set to that season.
Though only a Cube simulated by Tethys, it's as if she really is Jinhsi in the flesh...
Don't worry, those outside won't be affected.
Consider this a holiday, Jinhsi.
I must ask for your help once again, Jinhsi.
If that's the case... No, while Jinzhou may be safe for now, the cake crisis we face still demands our attention.
No need for such formality. You are both the distinguished guest and savior of Jinzhou, {PlayerName}. I will always do my utmost to aid you.
Once the crisis is over, perhaps we can take a stroll together?
I imagine you could also use a good break by then.
Hmm... Zzz... Work...
Hey, wake up! You're not supposed to be working!
Hmm... Zzz...
Zani?
Zzz... Forgot to clock out...
Are you really sleeping?
Are you... still working?
Ugh, that's rough! She's even thinking about her work in her dreams!
Okay... No problem. I still have plenty of time in my schedule...
Sheesh! Hey, wake up! Stop working!
Ahoy, you are right on time!
I was just pondering the perfect, grand performance for the anniversary, when lo and behold, what did I discover at the back of the square?
A cannon!
So?
A sturdy sailor and a cannon. Ring a bell?
A bad idea.
No way, that one?
Haha, stay tuned!
How may I be of service, noble hero? Have you come to check if I've been up to any villainous deeds?
Seems you're giving yourself a break.
Hehe, a rare treat, indeed. It would be lovely to linger here indefinitely.
You can always stay here.
And what of you? Will you disappear again once your noble deeds are done?
Leaving behind only the hearts you've touched, left to quietly yearn for your next visit. Such cold-heartedness.
(Try to say something.)
(Stay silent.)
There, there. I was only teasing.
Now, let us set aside our worries and savor this respite. It is, after all, a rare and precious break.
Hehe.
Why do you keep laughing?
Everyone is enjoying the moment, so I'm very happy too!
Thank you!
It's nothing.
It's not nothing. The purpose of this ceremony is to remind everyone that they're amazing and it's time to relax. This is a reward for everyone striving to live a good life!
We've all seen your hard work, {PlayerName}. That's why you should enjoy this day too!
I wonder how Mr. Abbowser is doing.
Not repenting, for sure.
Planning some new mischief, I guess.
I don't think Mr. Abbowser is really that bad. Mischief is more like his way of life, or... how to put it, mission?
It seems like Mr. Abbowser is more afraid of being forgotten than being disliked.
Should I extend an invitation then?
Er, maybe that's not necessary?
I think the best way to communicate with Mr. Abbowser is to play the "Hero vs. Demon Lord" game with him!
Alright, leave it to me.
Alright, I'll be good at that.
I'll take care of the cake restoration. You can rest assured and focus on dealing with Abbowser, {PlayerName}.
Sorry to trouble you.
I'm simply doing my duty. To be honest, I would feel quite lost with too much free time on my hands.
But what about you, {PlayerName}? After you left Jinzhou and... before you return...
Will you always be busy saving others like this?
Who knows?
There are always people in need of help.
It's true that there are always people in need of help.

I've been thinking, as the nightmare of your <te href=800006>Sonoro Sphere</te>, Abbowser isn't truly committing wicked deeds or confusing our minds. It is simply keeping us, or more precisely, you, here. But for what purpose?
Maybe it is only trying to give you a break from your mission, if only for a little while?
{PlayerName}, Ms. Carlotta mentioned that during the Carnevale, one can witness spectacular Echo parades, marvel at grand troupe performances, and take part in enchanting masquerades!
Did you get to experience all of that?
Yes, I did.
Yes. It was pretty lively.
Hmm, perhaps we might try including such performances in the Moon-Chasing Festival. I wonder if people in Jinzhou would like the idea.
Would you be our advisor for that, {PlayerName}?
No problem, leave it to me!
Changli, have the burn marks on your left hand disappeared?
Hmm? Oh... yes, indeed. I wouldn't have noticed without your keen observation.
Is that good or bad?
Neither... It is merely the mark of the small price I paid for wielding the flame in my youth.
And the wound...?
That healed long ago. Many of the costs are so trivial that they can hardly be called a "price."
Someone asked me to remind you that too much spice is bad for your health.
Hehe, a preference for spicy food is just another trivial price for the power of flame. However…
Please pass that warning on to my true self once we leave the <te href=800006>Sonoro Sphere</te>.
She would greatly appreciate it.
Such a fascinating little world. I've long heard of the Tethys System's versatility, but seeing its work is another thing.
You look quite composed.
Well, panicking wouldn't help the situation anyway.
Besides, wandering in the memories of someone like you, {PlayerName}, is in its own way a rare pleasure.
Ah, do you prefer coffee? I see no tea sets in this square. I'll take that into consideration the next time I invite you for a game of Weiqi.
I'll have whatever you prepare for me.
Your turf, your call.
Heh, now if I don't treat you to some of my private collection next time, I'd be a terrible host.
Back to the issue at hand. {PlayerName}, this realm is called <te href=800003>Second Coming of Solaris</te>, yes?
How intriguing. The Second Coming of Solaris I know is still in testing, a far cry from what we're seeing here...
If this is a world built on your memory, then there must be some kind of temporal discrepancy between what we remember.
Hmm, it could be you are from the "future," or perhaps I am from the "past."
Ahem, some things are better left unsaid.
It's OK to act ignorant once in a while, Changli.
Hehe, then let's consider this our little secret.
So, here's how it works. You can put together a group CV, and I'll handle the internal referral for you.
Lady Carlotta has a good rating for you. Securing a position shouldn't be an issue.
Thanks. I'll make sure to repay you.
No need. I get a bonus for successful referrals.
Then I ran to the front of the line and led the singing. But I was actually a little drunk, so I was completely off-key the whole time!
Then some Envoys came to catch me, but I just kept singing while they chased me!
It was so much fun!
Well... That's definitely...
I'm sorry for involving you in such trouble again.
When Tethys issued a warning at the start of the event, I immediately tried to access this Sonoro Sphere called <te href=800003>Second Coming of Solaris</te>.
Does this mean you've come here in person?
No. Like all the other Remnant <te href=800004>Cube</te>s, I am entirely separate from my true self.
Hmm, is Abbowser also a Remnant Cube?
I cannot say for certain. Since Abby is full of mysteries, the possible inferences are complicated.
However, I may be able to obtain more information if I physically interact with Abbowser.
You don't have to bear everything alone.
It's never a burden when we can fix it together.
Yes, you're right... Just like fixing the Tethys System, we will fix this together, you and I.
However, a peculiar entity calling itself "Abbowser" quickly blocked the <te href=800007>Channel</te>. I was only able to transmit data the size of a Remnant Cube.
Ah, Shorekeeper. Are you also here to join us?
Are you... recharging? A-am I suppose to recharge as well?
Oh, no, no. I mean, are you also here because of the New Chief's supreme orders?
Yes. The New Chief just told us to "buzz off," so we are here—the charging station, the place with the most buzzes, which should be in line with the orders.
New Chief?
Uh-oh, it's a base race.
I've got a bad feeling about this...
Ha, ha, ha, isn't this {PlayerName}? What's your business here in the New Black Shores?
I've been waiting for you, my seed of fate!
Why do you suddenly want to be the leader?
I'd be disappointed if you weren't the New Chief.
Well, I never cared about saving the world, but this chattering jelly offered me a pretty good deal.
Oh, I'm thrilled! The recognition of my only fated rival!
Honestly, I'm not interested in being some chief, but this chattering jelly offered me a pretty good deal.
If I help establish this New Black Shores, it will help me catch YOU!
Minions of the New Black Shores!
Yes, Chief!
Just buzz off! Don't spoil the fun between me and {PlayerName}!
Hey, wait! Shouldn't we just work together?
Quiet, jelly! I'd never let anyone get in the way of playtime with my dear leader.
Abbowser... is the new leader of the New Black Shores? And Camellya joined Abbowser? Or... did Abbowser's minions join Camellya?
Camellya won't stop until she's had enough fun.
We'll figure this out after playing hide and seek with Camellya.
So this is the <te href=800003>Second Coming of Solaris</te>... No, even for a game, this is too...

In the Abbowser Castle, you discover a place that closely resembles the Black Shores. It turns out Camellya Cube and Abbowser have created the "New Black Shores" together! Now, Camellya Cube is in control of the game. Things could get ugly if she's not having fun.
Ahoy, if it isn't our Honorary Captain! It's been ages since we last met!
Why are you here? I ordered the "<te href=800008>Ghost Hounds</te>" to lock you up!
Aha, Signor Abbowser. My sincerest apologies for not introducing myself properly last time, it all happened too fast. I'm actually a professional prison breaker.
Dang it! Did you open the chest I prepared for {PlayerName}?
Come now, Signor Abbowser. A chest in a perilous dungeon? That's a treasure just waiting for the bravest adventurers, right?
You thief! I'll lock you up... Wait, what's going on with this chest? It's HUGE!
Didn't you put this here?
Come on, that's what minions are for! Besides, I just hired the most capable one.
You there, go fetch her to check this out!
Obviously, this is a giant chest with a sea of treasure inside.
Really?
It's a Chest Mimic by the look.
You've got a point. It may very well be a Chest Mimic. But isn't a Chest Mimic just a chest playing hard-to-get?
T-that sounds right!
A Chest Mimic is just a Chest Mimic.
A Chest Mimic bites... hard.
No, no, no, a Chest Mimic is just a chest with a twist!
Chest... twist... chest... Ugh, my head's spinning.
{PlayerName} is right. A Chest Mimic does bite hard. But why does it hurt so much?
Because that's the catch of every adventure! The law of quid pro quo! Are you ready to pay the price, Signor Abbowser?
W-wait, is that how things work?
Now, now, Signor Abbowser. Stop questioning it. No great adventure ever happened with just talk!
Without a doubt, Signor Abbowser, this chest is a super surprise for you!
Before you lock a nobody like me behind bars again, why not open the chest first?
Brant winks at you.
Hardcore players never miss a chest!
You're right! Here I come, giant chest!
Abbowser charges toward the giant chest and gets kicked away by the awakened Chest Mimic, just as expected.
Just as you suspected, Brant is the "culprit" who stole the treasure. But when Abbowser accuses him, Brant coolly tricks Abbowser into waking a giant Chest Mimic. So, who's the real villain now?
Nope. No way. Nyah nyah nyah!
Mr. Abbowser, you're not acting very lordly right now.
Ha! Like I care!
Anyway, my Echo army is worth WAY more than this! Unless you can prove they're as puny as you say.
I'm your proof.
Your Echoes are as brittle as Clang Bangs.
Y-you! When did you get here?
Mr. Abbowser, it appears your Echoes are not as reliable as you claim.
I can testify that {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} {PlayerName} took them down without breaking a sweat.
Noooo! My precious Echoes!
Abbowser runs away.
Built your little empire so quickly, did you?
Seems my contribution helped move things along.
Nothing to boast about. Just a few little communication tricks.
Indeed, another flawless collaboration, wouldn't you say, Cat's Eye?
By the way, were you enjoying yourself along the way? Abbowser claimed that setting up the castle was more challenging than it seemed, so I decided to try it myself.
They were fine.
It's like something's missing.
Being "fine" is never the Montelli standard when it comes to our friends.
True enough. You deserve better rewards for the help you've given me.
Lady Carlotta, dinner is ready.
Thank you, but not now. Our {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} Cat's Eye is in need of aid. It's my turn to repay {Male=him;Female=her}.
I've learned that this level also holds some other <te href=800004>Cube</te>s taken by Abbowser. We'll locate them together.

The negotiation between Abbowser and Carlotta is at a total stalemate. Your arrival tips the scales. With no minions or Echoes acting as backup, Abbowser is completely cooked and utterly defeated. Meanwhile, Carlotta seems to have found some clues leading to other Cubes in this level.
Oh Lady Primus, I have to confess. I sneaked some snacks from the storage, and now I'm totally broke because of it. I had to sell my minions to someone really shady.
I feel bad about it, but that cake was just too yummy!
It's your nature to love eating cakes, and nature is neither good nor bad. However, you shouldn't indulge your nature at the expense of others.
But owning up to your mistake and confessing? Now that takes real courage, you're a brave little one!
The Sentinel teaches us self-restraint, but that doesn't mean we should see our nature as a monster. It's a potential friend.
Promise me that from now on, you'll share half of every cake you eat with your friends. Can you do that?
Hmm... Deal! All hail the Primus!
All hail the Primus!
I never knew you had such an ambition, Phoebe.
{PlayerName}? And Lady Carlotta? W-why are you here?! P-please don't misunderstand me, I'm not...
C'mon, Primus. Without your guidance, we'd still be the lost and wayward bad <te href=800004>Cube</te>s! You're our savior!
S-savior?!
Excuse us for a moment.
We're also waiting for your guidance, Primus.
Lady Primus?
Rest assured, Mr. Abbowser. I'm only leaving for a little while. I'll be back once I've helped them.
I'll also pray to the Sentinel that They will watch over every obedient good Cube!
Nope. No way! I don't need the Sentinel! We want Phoebe! You will never take the Primus away from us!
Mr. Abbowser, please don't call me that. I'm just an ordinary Acolyte...
Indeed. The show is still missing a key character! The ceremony can't kick off in grand style without our beloved, ever-devout Acolyte!
We need your help.
I... I see.

When you arrive at the Order of the D, you're surprised to find that the so-called Primus is none other than Phoebe. In her usual well-meaning way, she tried to fix some bad Cubes, which landed her in a bit of a pickle. Deciding to lend a hand, you manage to rescue Phoebe from her predicament.
Hmm?
Calcharo?
And you are?
Never expected to see you here.
{PlayerName}, if you're here for the chest, take it. Abbowser owes us our wages, so we have no obligation to guard it.
That's it?
Why not just take this chest as your payment?
Mercs have their own codes.
Mercs have their own codes. If you take this chest, we'll have gained a friend and lost a difficult opponent.
No one gets the "<te href=800008>Ghost Hounds</te>" to work for free. Abbowser needs to pay for breaking its promise. Plus, I need to collect our payment: 500 <te href=800004>Cube</te> snacks.
However, we still have rules. We need a good reason for this, so...
Should I hire you to give you a good reason?
And them. Ghost Hounds are fiercer in packs.
Chief!
Certainly. On behalf of the Montelli family, I employ you all to assist {PlayerName}. Do we have an agreement?
Carlotta suddenly shows up beside you.
Another little favor I've done for you.
What brings you here?

I trust this comes as no surprise. This is simply another commercial expansion. Mr. Calcharo, I presume? I'll sign a contract with you to replace the one you have with Abbowser. From now on, you work for the Montellis.
I believe {PlayerName} will be more than happy to vouch for you, won't you?
They're all capable.
You can always count on Calcharo!
Thank you.
That's a deal, Ms. Carlotta.
I never knew I was worth so much!
Brant?
So he got you into the chest?
I would've never been captured if not for the fierce electrical currents in the water.
I never imagined the bounty on my head would be 500 Cube snacks! A new record, indeed!
...No, you were only worth half a Cube snack.
Abbowser promised us payment and agreed to triple the amount for every hour of delay.
A good lesson about overspending...
How much have you got?
Zero. Since we haven't received any payment yet, you can take this chest.

You finally meet the legendary and super mighty Elite No. 1, who turns out to be none other than your old acquaintance, Calcharo. In the end, you strike a deal: he hands over the newly captured Brant, and you hire him to help settle his debt with Abbowser.
Ha, ha, ha, your journey ends here!
Behold, my Elite No. 2, Cantarella!
Greetings. I am Elite No. 2.
Where's Elite No. 1?
Tsk, tsk, where are your manners? Must I remind you to focus on the present company while a lady is making her introductions?
Yeah, where are your manners?
What are you doing here?
Being a bad Cube.
Well, I did plan on being a righteous companion, but it seems my hero couldn't be bothered to show up on time.
I've been marching at full speed.
It's too late to apologize.
Too late!
Alas, your silence wounds me deeper than your lukewarm affection ever could.
It hurts!
Clearly, Cantarella is having her fun.
Attack, Elite No. 2! Teach {PlayerName} a real lesson!
My pleasure.
Cantarella blows a cloud of smoke toward you.
Ha, ha, ha, this is toxic smoke that will make you weak and wobbly!
Oops, it seems I accidentally released the enhancing smoke instead.
What?! We should delta!
Watch out.
Don't worry, I'll cleanse it. Hmm? Why is it...
Hah! No way to clean it up, right? This is the super ult of Elite No. 2! Now, you... Wait, why are you...
I'm actually feeling better... Phew, that almost got me. Guess there's no need to cleanse it after all.
Once again, Abbowser blocks your path, this time with the mighty Elite No. 2, Cantarella. But oops! She "accidentally" uses the wrong powder, making you even more powerful.
Hey, you, the so-called "most powerful Resonator" of the merc group, why are you standing with them? Did you seriously betray me?!
Time to settle our debts, Abbowser.
And you, Carty! Didn't we agree to cook up something big together?!
The mischief ends here, Abbowser!
Nah, not gonna happen. The game isn't over yet!
Hehe, looks like Elite No. 2 is here to save the day.
Ugh, you can't rely on anyone these days. Fine, I'll do it myself. Elite No. 2, give me a boost!
Certainly.
Cantarella releases her smoke on Abbowser.
Ha, ha, ha, this is Cantarella's special enhancing smoke! Behold my true power! My Serious Series killer combo…
Wait... I'm so sleepy...
Abbowser seems to be hypnotized by Cantarella.
Oh dear, it appears I've let the wrong smoke slip through my fingers again. How careless of me.
Switching sides now?
So your plan is to take over as the final boss yourself!
Hehe, I simply think that child got a bit too carried away.
Well now, who's the one really getting into the game?
I simply think that child got a bit too carried away, and it was up to me to gently reel it in.
So, I decided a little nap was in order.
Sorry, I've ruined the anniversary...
Cartethyia, do kindly cast your gaze upon me, {PlayerName}, and Mr. "Most Powerful Resonator" over there. Have you noticed our smiles?
Despite the somewhat tumultuous proceedings and the rather crude stage, I'm certain that your good wishes, along with Abbowser's, have been felt by all.
Really?!
I've been having fun!
Yeah, but there are still quite a few issues.
That's so good to hear!
I'll do better next time!
We should go now. It's time to start the ceremony!
Well, well... What a good move.
You are too modest, Lady Cantarella. Perhaps once this little comedy concludes, we can have a proper conversation?
I would be delighted. It has been quite the journey to get here.
With the help of Elite No. 2, Cantarella, you finally put an end to Abbowser's mischief without any fuss. Now that all the Cubes are safe, it's time to fix the cake and get the ceremony started!
What have you done?!
Hey, stop hitting me! Wasn't this your idea?
My idea?!
I asked you to arrange everyone in the same level so they could get to know each other. I never told you to lock them up!
Puh-lease! Letting them roam free with all those TDs around each level? It's dangerous. Take that Brant guy! He just waltzed in and helped himself to MY chests!
Oh yes, and the TDs! I said we just needed to design a few challenges to encourage cooperation, so people would get closer as they went. Why did you put dangerous TDs here?!
It's so {PlayerName} can feel like a total boss when {Male=he;Female=she} opens the chests!
Since when did the chests become the focus? Shouldn't the goal be to make sure everyone has a good time?
Everybody IS having a good time!
Oh really? Then what about Zani? What part of this is fun for her?
I asked her what she needed, and she was like, "A job." So, boom, I gave her a job. Come on, how could she not be having fun?
Ooooh, I get it now! You're just jealous of my amazing talent, Carty! Admit it! You're green-eyed over me and my fabulous chests!
Huh?
It was me who designed such a schmancy Abbowser Castle! All so {PlayerName} could scoop up every last Cube and have a blast doing it!
I'm obviously a game design genius. Of course you're jealous of me!
Abbowser storms off in anger.
So what now, Elite No. 3?
Ugh, I only wished to have everyone enjoy the game and make the anniversary more lively... I should have stopped Abbowser earlier.
Because from here on out, I'll make up for my mistakes with action!
It appears your dispositions are quite different... Look over there.
I'm so sorry about all this. I never imagined that the whole anniversary would turn into such a mess!
Worry not. The ceremony is not finished yet. We can still light the candle to continue it.
Yes, you're right! It slipped my mind!
However, we still lack some essential materials. To ensure a truly grand ceremony, we need to plan very carefully...
That's alright, we can start the work first! Abbowser isn't done yet, so let's push forward. The materials won't be a concern.
So she is the Elite No. 3... I see. She must be the Sentinel's Resonator in this region, right?

You encounter Elite No. 3, Cartethyia, who appears to have a special connection with Abbowser. By the time you show up, they've already split over a design dispute. To ensure Abbowser doesn't make a dramatic return, you decide to hunt it down.

[Next Page]
[Next Page]
During the chaotic hide-and-seek, Shorekeeper Cube encounters Camellya Cube...
I don't understand. You must realize that this isn't reality, and that we're only virtual beings generated based on {PlayerName}'s memory.
Yeah, I know. My head feels all light and free without those annoying voices, so of course this can't be the real me. But I don't care. {Male=He;Female=She}'s real, right?
As long as I have the real {Male=him;Female=her}, I'm the real Camellya.
I say you should take a break while you're here.
If "the conflict is meaningless," why not have a little fun in the meaningless? {PlayerName} is having fun, see?
Fun in the meaningless...? It's true that I have never seen this side of {PlayerName} before...
Hehe... I can see you're starting to waver, Shorekeeper.
It will be... my choice? Hmm... my own decision...
Well, well, looks like we're in agreement after all.
So? Finally ready to ditch that <ano=Tethys System>stupid machine</ano> and join us at New Black Shores?
Even with all your computing power, you'll still end up choosing to have fun with us. So just stop resisting!
The conflict between us is meaningless.
I... I have never tried it myself either...
...Fine then, if it's just for a little while.
Giving up already? Even Shorekeeper hasn't had her fill yet.
Shorekeeper?
Is there any reward if I just surrender?
This experience of playing a game together... it's special to me.
Oh? And what kinda reward are you looking for, my dear leader?
As much as I'd love to keep playing this game for another hundred, thousand, or even million years... Fine, fine, we'll call it quits. For now.
There's always more time, right?
Just hold on a sec! You've been hogging the game this whole time! I haven't even had a turn!
Oh, right. Almost forgot about you. Thanks for the place, but bye bye now!
Hey, no fair! You can't just back out like that! Minions, attack!
We don't follow your orders. Camellya is our chief!
Aww, poor you, jelly.
How could you guys do this to me? You're all bullies! Just you wait, I'll get you for this!
Abbowser buzzes off.
Nevertheless, according to the rules, the game should end once {Male=he;Female=she} is captured.

After having her fill of fun, Camellya ends the little game of hide-and-seek and prepares to return to the Cube World with you. Abbowser finally realizes it's been tricked by Camellya. But facing its own minions' betrayal, Abbowser has no choice but to make a strategic retreat.
Ta-da! Welcome to the world of <te href=800003>Second Coming of Solaris</te>!
Tethys generated everything here after scanning you. Pretty amazing, right? Of course, Encore helped too! See that huge cake over there? That's Encore's design!
Wait, why am I a Cube now?
Because I turned you into one! Miss Shorekeeper could only grant me a tiny bit of Tethys' computing power, so this <te href=800004>Cube</te> is the best I could manage for you.
Ah... I'm so dizzy! What's going on?
Look, it's an Abby Cube!
Abby Cube? Isn't it the real Abby?
Uh-uh. Only you and me are real here. The rest are replicas based on the scan results.
I followed Miss Shorekeeper's instructions and made 12 different Cubes! They should all be here... Huh?
Where's the cake?
Ha, ha, ha! Don't bother looking for it!
Another Abby Cube? Did you make two of them, Encore?
Nope, only one.
Ha, ha, ha! I ain't no ordinary Abby! I'm the purest, most perfect Abby!
Body of perfection, eyes gleaming with wisdom, and a smile bursting with health! Yes, that's me, Abbowser!
Sounds like a badass!
Wow, I'm positively shaking.
Aha, you have a good taste! In that case, I'll go easy on you later.
