JINZHOU SPEEDSTER! HEELLLPP!
That's enough Encore, you're freaking our precious client out.
Encore just did as Aalto said! Encore is usually a good girl.
Don't be scared, Rover. We just have a few questions for you.
Was it your idea to have those two ladies wear those counterfeit Blake Blooms and attract our attention?
I must admit, they looked quite convincing. If I was an outsider, I might mistake them for the real deal.
So you worked with a plant-type Resonator... Interesting.
A plant-type Resonator? We happen to know someone like that too, don't we?
Yeah. There are more than one of them out there. Not a big deal.
So please, tell us... What do you want from the Black Shores?
Why should I tell you?
My past might be related to the Black Shores.
Now you're finally biting the hook.
Why? Hmm, what if I told you... We have the information you want the most?
Oh? Really? So that lead about you was right indeed...
Haha, not bad, you've managed to catch on real quick.
Like what they say here in Huanglong: the straight hook is for willing fish to bite. Ta-daa da daah! Your efforts finally caught our attention.
Surprise! The people you've been looking for are right in front of you!
Now, how's that for a piece of intel? I'll let you have it free of charge!
You're both from the Black Shores?
Can't say I'm surprised...
Aww, not that disappointed look! Are we not what you had in mind?
Aww, not that disappointed look! Gotta learn how to enjoy a surprise while you can, or life gets real boring, you know?
I know you must have a ton of questions for me, but one moment, please.
As you already know, I'm an "information broker."
That means I make deals instead of passing out freebies. You want information from me, you gotta give me something in return.
Relax, Rover. We just want to make a deal with you.
We want you to come with us to an abandoned Court of Savantae facility, to help us recover a "Resonance Beacon."
In turn, I'll tell you everything we know so far.
Why should I trust you?
And if I say no?
Our business is centered around customer satisfaction and built on integrity! Otherwise, we wouldn't qualify as Consultants of the Black Shores.
Well, if you don't take this opportunity, you'll probably never get to learn more about the Black Shores again.
And since you're a first-time customer... I'm pleased to offer you an additional gift.
Here, have this. This should prove we're serious, since you already know what it represents.
And if you still have doubts about us... Just show it to that plant-savvy young miss. She'll be able to tell.
Finally, as a last resort...
Encore, do your cute face, quick!
What a dirty move!
It won't work on me!
Aww... Pwease help us... Pretty Pweeaaase...?
Look at this poor child, pleading to you like that! How could anyone have the heart to decline?! The deal's settled then!
We'll be waiting for you near this Beacon in Whining Aix's Mire! And don't forget to come alone, okay?

You track them down and discover they are Consultants for the Black Shores. Aalto strikes a deal to reveal what he knows about you in exchange for your help in recovering a Resonance Beacon from the Court of Savantae Ruins, in Whining Aix's Mire.
Rover, did you find them?
Yes. They're from the Black Shores.
What? Seriously? No way...
They gave me this Blake Bloom.
As I expected! This flower is indeed a type of Remnant plant.
And it contains a very unique kind of Remnant Energy. The concentration is much higher than usual, too.
No way, are they really from the Black Shores?
Tsk... Not as mysterious as people make 'em out to be. Well at least they're good at running, I'll give them that.
What did they tell you?
I made a deal with them.
You explain the current situation...
That place... I only heard it's an abandoned research institution. There's nothing special about it.
Because of the dangerous weather conditions in Whining Aix's Mire, it's been ages since anyone went there.
Don't worry, Yangyang. We all know how strong our Rover is!
There have been frequent Tacet Field activities recently. If you're going there alone, please be careful.
Just ring us whenever you need a hand! We'll come rushing!
Okay... Rover, I'll tell the Academy about this, and they'll help transmit your data from the Resonance Nexus. Then that Beacon in the Whining Aix's Mire should be unlocked for you.

After Aalto and Encore depart, Chixia and the others arrive. You brief them on your deal. Yangyang warns that Whining Aix's Mire hasn't been visited in ages due to treacherous weather and urges caution.
Heya, Rover!
I've sent the coordinates of that CSC research facility to your Terminal.
Now that we're in the same boat, let me fill you in on what we're getting into before we dive in.
The Court of Savantae is a mysterious scientific research organization. They are best known for their research in "Automata Mechanics," but...
What's with the psychedelic black light coming from Mourning Aix's Mire, and is that freaky ring in the waters really the lake monster's doing?
One day, a daring young scientist soared into the sky and never returned... Could this be the beginning of another diabolical plot?
Aalto, why are you telling bedtime stories now? Is it time to sleep already?
And then what happened? I want more!
What kind of stories have you been listening to...
Ahem, my bad. Old habits die hard. But the big part is coming right up!
One day, out of the blue, every single Court of Savantae member VANISHED!
The last words from that mysterious researcher, the Court of Savantae Committee's Chairman, was this—
"You want my research? You can have it! I left everything I gathered in the Court of Savantae's labs. Now you'll just have to find it..."
What do you think, Rover? Aren't you curious?
Enough of this. Let's go.
I'm leaving now...
Haha! I knew you'd be into this like I am! But stories aside, we do have an important mission on our hands.
Wait, don't go! We really do have an important mission on our hands!
I suppose the Magistrate of Jinzhou has already told you what we do.
As the saying goes, one miss is as good as a mile. Every single one of the Resonance Beacons is crucial.
After the Court of Savantae researchers disappeared, all of our Resonance Beacons near their facilities were damaged to varying degrees.
Recently, something went wrong with our Lament detection system, and we suspected it had something to do with a damaged Beacon around the area.
While our main goal is to retrieve the lost Resonance Beacons, we also might find some treasures.
Aalto, even Encore can tell what you're up to...
It's called seize the opportunity while I can! You're just too young to get it! Come on, let's go!
What really put them on the map isn't that; it's all the bizarre experiments they did.
We've set up Resonance Beacons worldwide to monitor the Lament, collecting data in real-time. This is how we predict when the next Lament is happening.
That's why we've been sent here, to investigate the case.

After meeting Aalto and Encore, you learn that the Beacon is hidden within the Court of Savantae Ruins, a once-revered institution known for its groundbreaking research in Automata Mechanics and strange experiments. Its members vanished without a trace, leaving behind only damaged Resonance Beacons.
Huh? Is my TD Detector working? How come it didn't warn us of so many Tacet Discords ahead?
Cause they all just appeared outta nowhere!
That's weird... Anyway, let's deal with them.
This is the place.
Ugh, those savants really love their puzzles, don't they...
No wonder folks never managed to get inside after all these years. Their security is top-notch.
That's because Aalto set off the security alarm! And now the gate's closed, hmph!
Ahem... Anyway! We've got to figure out how to open it up again.
This is... No wonder...
Those crazy savants... They were trying to recreate the Retroact Rain...
The power system here might still work... Let's split up and find it.
Hurray! Woolies, thataway!
Cosmos! Cloudy! You saw anything fun?
Reporting in! Cosmos saw nothing!
Cloudy saw nothing either, baa.
What?! Go! Go look again!
...I see.
Yes... I can feel the tension in the Streams.
I'm worried something bad is going to happen...
There you are, Rover!
Sorry for keeping you waiting.
Did something happen?
The Academy has noted a concerning rise in Tacet Field activities. Please use caution when exiting the city.
Thanks for the warning.
How's your research going?
Remember to check your Terminal signals, and wear the Academy's protective suit correctly...
Was that a voicemail message...
Is she sending the same thing to everyone...
It's just Baizhi being Baizhi. She's a little awkward with showing care, but I think it's cute!
Anyway! Rover, quick, tell us what happened!
After a brief moment of thinking, you give them a brief run down of your meeting with Jinhsi, but don't mention Jué's disappearance...
The Fractsidus again? Ugh, those jerks!
About Jiyan...
Jiyan the General, Jinhsi the Magistrate, and Jué, Jinzhou’s Sentinel... Is there any kind of connection between them?
Connection? ...No idea, but I did hear General Jiyan used to be a military doctor...
Hmm... Speaking of that, I think we'll need to start with a bit of Jinzhou's past.
...And don't forget to stay hydrated. Now, I have experiments to run. Take care.
A storyteller near the theater once told us something like this...
You reunite with Chixia and Yangyang outside City Hall, where the tension hangs in the air. Mentioning Jiyan's name prompts Yangyang to recount a tale about him as told by a certain storyteller...
Crystal potion, glass barometer, instant noodles, packets of nuts... Hmm, nothing too fancy...
Oh wow! A game card that went out of sale decades ago! Aha, lucky me!
It didn't take us long to solve that puzzle mechanic, thanks to your help.
Brute force works wonders.
I saw something similar before.
Haha... You didn't seem to be brute-forcing it, though. Do you happen to know someone from the Court of Savantae?
Oh? Do you happen to know someone from the Court of Savantae?
I'm really looking forward to making more deals with you.
Hey, Rover. How's it going on your end? Found anything good? I've collected some things, but not much.
Now, this is the last room...
Aalto, Rover! Encore spotted something!
It's getting closer. These will be my final words, haha... If only I had more...
I thought my enemies were misconceptions, waning passion, and my own ignorance.
Only in the end did I realize... time is my ultimate foe.
I became blindsided by my fear of death and insatiable thirst for truth, eventually derailing our research...
It was too late when I finally came back to my senses... We... We had already walked into that false "Gate"...
Now, I'm leaving my last realization behind...
They are our "past"... but they are also our "future"... Had I realized it sooner, there might have been a chance to get things back on track...
The future being hailing from our past... Please save us... once again...
Please, keep pushing forward... until you reach... the real Gate that can change the world...
Wow... She's so pretty...
Rover, about this person...
I think I know her....
But I can't remember why...
Heh, knew it...
Great, now that power's been restored, that elevator should work.
The Beacon's signal is coming from below. Let's go.

You come across a hologram of an aged man, lamenting his unfulfilled research and hoping for a savior 'from both past and future.' A beautiful woman's specter briefly meets your gaze, stirring a sense of familiarity that eludes you.
Wow! A big clunky monster!
Damn... Those savants never run out of new surprises for us...
The signal's coming from it. Did it swallow our Resonance Beacon?
Looks like peace isn't an option. Guys, brace yourself. We'll need to take it down!
Aalto, we doing it like we usually do?
Of course.
Hehe, then this big guy is Encore's to tackle!
Cosmos, Cloudy, ATTACK!
Let me figure out its weakness...
I see! It’s cobbled together from these metal parts!
We should target its joints, use the fallen parts to counter its attacks and destroy its unstable structure.
The honorable Madam Jinhsi, our great magistrate of Jinzhou, was handpicked by Sentinel Jué. Her status as the Sentinel's Appointed Resonator is rare among all past magistrates.
Our Jinzhou was leaderless for years until Jué finally chose her to be the next Magistrate, and she answered the call.
To further elaborate, we must start with the "Battle Beneath the Crescent"...
The Norfall Barrens, scarred by countless wars... Discarded weapons scattered like bones.
Our soldiers had fought to reclaim the land for years, to no avail.
Ovathrax, the dreadful Threnodian monster, fed on the frequencies of "weapons" turning our fallen soldiers into deadly Tacet Discords...
General of the Midnight Rangers, Geshu Lin, bravely rose to confront the threat.
As twin moons aligned, General Geshu Lin vowed to vanquish evil, raising his blade against the blood-red crescent that foretold destruction.
His sword blazed with black flames, laying waste to all who dared stand in his way. Victory seemed certain...
...Until the Retroact Rain began to fall.
Raindrops fell upwards as in the past. Monsters raged, loyal souls fell to blood-soaked sands... Infernal carnage!
Sacrificing his body to the black flames for power, Geshu Lin charged at the Ovathrax with all his might... And he was never seen again.

After the fall of their leader, the remaining soldiers despaired... Until a deafening roar of the <ano=Teal Dragon>Qingloong</ano> struck like lightning. A lone youth bravely stood up to lead. A hard-won retreat!
After the battle, that young man who tamed the wind ascended to fame, becoming the new General of the Midnight Rangers, selected by Sentinel Jué.
On the other hand, General Geshu was blamed for the massive losses that occurred under his command, earning him a notorious reputation in Huanglong...
That battle struck us hard, but our Sentinel rose from its long slumber to select a new Magistrate who guide us into the future.
Despite the previous disaster, Jinzhou was off to a promising start under our Sentinel and the new Magistrate's guidance. The people held hope for a better tomorrow...
Issuing his last command, Geshu Lin demanded all soldiers stand firm, no matter what happened.
Phew, job done!
Hehe, Encore is strong! Told ya!
Encore heard lightning! When there's lightning, it's gonna rain, and when it's gonna rain, Encore should bring an umbrella...
...Uh, no, no no no... Aalto said when it rains like this, we hide!
It's just ordinary rain, isn't it?
Is this part of the Court of Savantae's experiment?
No... This is...
...It's the real Retroact Rain.
Rover, Jinzhou...
Jinzhou is under attack! It's a TD Outbreak!
Emerging from the ruins, you find the sky dark and heavy with Retroact Rain. Yangyang calls to tell you Jinzhou is under attack by a horde of Tacet Discords.
Rover, have you noticed?
We've been seeing these black petals for a while now... They're scattered all over the place. I’m pretty sure they're not made by Miss Verina.
The Streams have been disrupted... Someone has been following us.
Leave it to me.
You two should head back to the city.
Rover... Are you sure you want us to leave? It could be dangerous for you...
Trust me.
...Okay. Chixia and I will wear these black flowers and go look for members of the Black Shores in the city.
Rover, please be careful. Ring us anytime when you need help.
Noticing you are being followed, you decide to send Chixia and Yangyang with the Blake Bloom to search for Black Shores members in the city while you confront your mysterious stalker.
Never thought they could pull off something like this... Incredible...
What on earth is the Retroact Rain?
The Retroact Rain is essentially a form of condensed Remnant Energy from the Etheric Sea.
Various events across space and time from every dimension are recorded in the form of Remnant Energy. The Retroact Rain conjures illusions of past events for those exposed to it.
That rain curtain we saw earlier was probably the results of their experiments.
Before the Retroact Rain forms, it goes through three stages. In the first stage, it looks just like any regular rain.
And what we're seeing now should be the second stage: Water droplets floating in midair, being absolutely still.
I've heard of plenty independent studies on the Retroact Rain.
But look at all these devices here... The sheer scale of this research is really something.
It really makes one wonder... What on earth were they trying to bring back with such a massive Retroact Rain?
Most of the researchers were driven by their obsessions. Some wanted to relive a particular experience, while others yearned to reunite with their loved ones...
Aalto is amazed to learn that the Court of Savantae had once attempted to recreate Retroact Rain, speculating on what they sought to achieve.
But why did they keep that big guy here?
According to our findings earlier, researchers who worked here were probably only a small faction of the Court of Savantae Committee.
Somehow, they believed this ancient civilization had once visited the Mire, which led to their attempts at recreating those past events with artificial Retroact Rain.
And when they failed to recreate the Retroact Rain, they resorted to making a "replica" of the lost civilization instead.
To get their desired results faster, they started feeding this "replica" various frequencies, datasets, and mechanical constructs...
It was probably the culprit behind the disappearance of those folks.
Those researchers... They were too obsessed with validating the "divine miracle", they eventually got lured in by that monster's frequencies of hunger and willingly walked into its maw...
The monster devoured them, but not with its teeth... Their own delusions and fear were their undoing in the end.
What a crazy bunch...
So Rover, now it's time for me to fulfill my promise.
What on earth does the Black Shores do?
Have you been stalking me?
Do you know a person named Camellya?
What are you doing in Jinzhou?
What is the relationship between me and the Black Shores?
As you already know, we monitor and research the Lament, and we’ve got Resonance Beacons set up in every nation worldwide.
The island our headquarters are built on is in fact a massive piece of Tacetite ore, which powers our various energy-intensive operations.
Our island is located in the perfect spot to accurately monitor the Lament, ensuring precise predictions.
...That being said, the Lament's behavior is constantly changing and we are still studying to understand its true nature.
All we can do for now is to observe the Lament, study its patterns, and provide early warnings to countries worldwide.
Alright, alright, no more beating around the bush. Yeah, we've had our eyes on you, but please trust me, we don't mean anything bad.
We just wanted to make sure you're a dependable ally.

The Black Shores members all work together to save the world from the Lament crisis. We've got talents from all walks of life, including skilled hackers, explosive experts, and even Fengshui masters... You name it, we have it.
We like your skills and methods. So, what do you say? Ready to jump on board?
Camellya? Course we do!
Yeah, she can be kinda unhinged, but she's indeed one of ours.
Just so you know, she only took up this mission because of you! Quite the charmer, aren't you?
So she wasn't lying.
She almost killed me!
So you've met her already? Nice, saves me some time introducing.
I know she can be a bit too... straightforward, in how she expresses herself, but... Don't worry. She won't do anything bad to you, really.
We just received a warning from our Lament detection system. Another Threnodian is about to revive near Jinzhou city.
So we came here to inform Jinzhou's Magistrate about it.
Another?
Did similar things happen in the past?
Yes. Entire countries had been destroyed... We're not letting such tragedies happen again.
Yes. Entire countries had been destroyed... We're not letting such tragedies happen again.
I'm just an insignificant Consultant at the Black Shores, so I don't know that much about all its hidden secrets.
But I believe the piece of intel I'm about to share with you will make this trip worth your effort.
This is not the first time you've been reawakened. Last time... You woke up at the Black Shores.
Rover, we share the same goal.
We're both aiming to fight against the Threnodians and prevent the Lament crisis.
Yep! Encore can prove it! The Threnodian is a bad, bad guy, and Encore and Aalto are the heroes of justice, so we're gonna stop the bad guys!
I understand. Trust isn't something you can afford to give out that easily.
Remember the Blake Bloom I gave you earlier?
It is more than just a symbol. It also holds the key to our headquarters. I'm sure it will come in handy for you.
Phew! Anyway, mission accomplished! We've got the Resonance Beacon secured, plus a sweet bonus of Court of Savantae's big secrets!
Glad I got you on board, Rover. Looking forward to our future collaborations.
Oops, almost forgot! Gotta check that Resonance Beacon again, just in case.
Wait... This is...
No, it can't be...
Hey, Aalto! WAAITT!
What do you want to know about the Black Shores?
They were likely studying an ancient civilization they deemed to be "divine beings", but later got denounced from the CSC due to their extreme methods.
And we've seen what that ended up with. It turned into a monster driven by the frequencies of "hunger," devouring everything in its path.
And, I suspect, the Fractsidus Overseer mentioned in that log may have something to do with it all.
This Blake Bloom is a product of that overflowing energy on the island.

Upon defeating the monster, Aalto discloses shocking truths about you, the Black Shores, and Camellya. You learn this is not the first time you have awakened from a long slumber—the last happened at the Black Shores. Before you can ask more, he suddenly flees sensing something amiss.
(The black petals scattered on the ground exude a faint ominous aura. You seem to have seen them on your way here…)
The flowers seem to be showing us the way. Let's follow it.
Woah. First time hearing about all that...
Why did Jué choose Jinhsi to be the Magistrate?
Uhhh... Maybe the Sentinel had its own special ways of picking candidates?
Or maybe it is their incomprehensible ways that set these divine beings apart from us? Their thinking tends to be elusive to the average person.
Yeah, true. Wouldn't be surprised if Jué decided to make me the Magistrate one day, not gonna lie!
Does it ever ask the opinion of the person selected?
I understand your concern.
Madam Jinhsi was only a teenager, and she was suddenly selected to be the Magistrate. It must have been so difficult for her...
I remember people were skeptical when she first took office.
Despite her achievements, many believed she lacked the necessary experience and authority in the political realm.
Seriously, Lord Jué knows how to choose 'em. Our previous Magistrates were all top-notch at running the show.
And Madam Jinhsi? She's already made this city a well-oiled machine in no time.
I'd have a mental Overclock just trying to keep up with all that paperwork... She was made for this!
Rover, since you are asking about this... Did you get clues about your past from Madam Jinhsi?
Jué asked me to go find Jiyan in the Norfall Barrens at a specific time.
There's another "Overseer" of the Fractsidus lurking in Jinzhou.
An organization called the Black Shores has been watching me.
The Norfall Barrens?! It's been a battlefield since ancient times...
Rover, it's dangerous there. The Norfall Barrens is the frontline in our defense against the Threnodian. We must be careful about going there.
They sent two Overseers at once... Their scheme must be far more expansive than we thought.
Though the Fractsidus do seem to know a lot about you... Their ideology and actions are too dangerous.
And right now, the odds are in their favor. If we rush into a confrontation, it could lead us into their traps.
The Black Shores? Doesn't ring a bell... Sounds like the name of a place, but I've never seen it on any map.
This flower... It's only a photo, and I can't tell where it came from with my ability.
The Black Shores is an organization that studies the Lament.
Every Black Shores member wears a flower like this.
Hmm... We're still in the dark about Fractsidus' plans, and the Norfall Barrens is too risky. The Black Shores seems to be our only option now.
But if we are to look for them with only a photo of this flower... It's going to be difficult.
Since it's about flowers... We should go ask Grandma Lin!
Yes! Grandma Lin runs a flower shop. I'm sure she can give us some tips.
Hehe... You're making me blush a little.
Grandma Lin loves listening to storytellers. I think I saw her earlier... Let's go look for her.
People only showed their respect to Madam Jinhsi because they trusted Jué's judgment...
Uh, what is that saying again? Real gold never loses its shine!
After hearing the story, you express your desire to find members of the Black Shores before heading to the Norfall Barrens. Yangyang suggests starting with the Blake Bloom, the organization's symbol.
We request your cooperation.
Huh? Oh yeah, yes ma'am!
Is it a coincidence? Is it fate? Nah, no...
Tough break... It's just plain bad luck.
Maybe he's got his own personality to blame...
Cosmos, Cloudy, it's treasure hunting time!
Let's see. Where are the goodies...
Amazing! It looks so realistic!
Y-you flatter me... Thank you...
I've seen similar petals on my way here...
Rover, did you see that? Miss Verina just conjured up this exquisite Blake Bloom out of thin air!
And it looks exactly like the one in the photo!
Erm, it's just my Resonance Ability...
Could you please make another one? Then there'll be one for each of us!
Sure, I-I'll give it another try...
Oh, I see! And guess what? Miss Verina just made another Blake Bloom for us. Now it comes in handy!
Easy peasy! I've got this!
Miss Verina, we should get you home now.
Yes, it's dangerous out in the wild lately.
It's dinner time. Grandma Lin is waiting for you.
Oh? Ah, sure. One moment, please...
Is it a coincidence? Is it fate? Nah, no...
(Ask him about the "Battle Beneath the Crescent".)
Oh oops, are you talking to me? My bad, I was lost in my thoughts.
I'm a student at Jinzhou Imperial Academy studying history, and I'm especially intrigued by everything related to the Sentinel.
The Sentinel plays a crucial role in Jinzhou's history. But here's something interesting, I'm not sure if you've noticed...
In our local folklore and tales, the Sentinel is always portrayed as an omnipotent being that transcends human understanding.
But I believe there must be a pattern in its thought process. The people chosen to become Magistrates must share some similar traits.
So, I wonder: what criteria does the Sentinel use to select future leaders?
We were all confident and determined to defeat the <ano=Ovathrax>Threnodian</ano> before. But after that crushing defeat, everyone's confidence took a hit.
Interestingly, the newly appointed General and Magistrate both seem to be the calm and cautious type.
Perhaps the Sentinel chooses our leaders based on the public consensus at the time.
But hey, that's just me thinking out loud. I'm all ears to your opinions. Your take might just open my eyes!
We still wanted to win, to eliminate that dreadful monster once and for all, but... we became more cautious.
It looks like a sundial, don't you think?
Maybe if we spin the dials to align every pointer in the same direction...
That Fractsidus Overseer has been really generous with his sponsorship... It would have taken us much longer to build this place without him.
Though he loves to meddle with our experiments a bit too much... Well, he's our patron, can't do anything about that.
This lab's location is a bit too remote for me, but I'm okay with it as long as we can keep doing our research.
Yeah... Where else could us "maniacs" possibly go?
The Committee kicked us out like trash... They'll never understand...
As Professor Heisen stated, we are embarking on a monumental endeavor with the power to redefine humanity's future.
This time, we will make the "divine miracle" we saw happen again for all of humanity to behold!
The experiments have been going smoothly, but we still can't get the desired outcome… Why?
The "Artificial Retroactive Rain" project has advanced to its second phase... We have various evidence that this ancient civilization was the Whining Aix's Mire at some point.
We believed we could recreate that “divine miracle” with the artificial Retroact Rain... have we been mistaken?
We have no time left. The "Artificial Controllable Tacet Field" should be complete by now... We’ll have to rely on our backup plan.
How's Subject A038 doing lately?
It has yet to assume a concrete form or exhibit vocalization behavior. In most cases, it remains motionless.
However, we've noticed some behavioral discrepancies from our initial expectations, and further observation and research would be necessary.
It's merely a "replica", after all. It's far from the true form of those "gods"...
By the way, things have been mysteriously disappearing lately. Any idea?
You noticed it too? Thought I was imagining things... And there's weird noises at the lab late at night.
I suspect it has something to do with Subject A038... Lately, its frequencies have always displayed signs of "hunger".
But it's been under strict surveillance. That couldn't possibly be A038... Right?
...I'll go check the security cameras once more.
Let's increase its rations. We can't afford to let it go hungry.
After all, it's our last hope now...
There is still some time before the next session. Here are some books to keep you entertained before that, dear listeners.
(Ask him about the "Battle Beneath the Crescent".)
So you want to learn more about that battle?
They say storytelling inevitably carries some subjective bias, all to enhance the ebb and flow of the narrative.
But when it comes to the "Battle Beneath the Crescent," we typically avoid adding any of our personal commentary, focusing instead on accurately retelling history.
But even just telling the story carries a heavy emotional weight.
Was Geshu Lin truly an unforgivable sinner? Was General Jiyan the perfect hero?
The sudden onset of the Retroact Rain, the decision of our Sentinel, and the timing behind this series of events...
I guess it will be up to future generations to figure it all out, haha.
Oh, how I love these stories...
Damn it! Our plan's all busted!
It's all that woman's fault.
Oh my, what a beautiful lady!
Can I take a selfie with you, please?
T-thank you for saying that...
Tough break... It's just plain bad luck.
(Ask him about the "Battle Beneath the Crescent".)
So you want to learn more about that battle? Not many youngsters care these days! I'm happy to talk about it with you!

I came here to ask Lady Iuno to look into my fate. See if there's any possibility of realizing my dreams in the future.
It's rather embarrassing to visit her at Tetragon Temple for a selfish matter like this. I wouldn't want to disturb the other Priestesses at work.
Since there are rumours of people meeting her here, I will continue to wait patiently for my opportunity... Or perhaps this wait is also part of her prophecy?
Graced by moonlight, this tree stands tall, bridging the heavens and the earth. For generations, it has silently watched over the hunting grounds, a steadfast witness to the stories of Septimontians.
Such magnificence... You share the same sentiment as I do, don't you?
Did you get to see Iuno?
Did you get your wish fulfilled?
Iuno? Who may that be?
Strange... Have we met before? And did I mention anything about a wish?
For some reason, I've been visiting this tree every night ever since I arrived at the hunting grounds.
Whenever I take in this breathtaking view, a strange sense of loss will always weigh heavily on my heart.
Am I... am I really here every night just for the view?
Do you have the same feeling as I do?
There's always this tingling feeling that I've forgotten something important. And yet I can't for the life of me recall what it was.
This is a tree that yearns for moonlight.
Only after nightfall does it emit its unique radiance.
...Just like me.
Whether I stand on battlefields or wastelands, oh, sweet moon, you're always there for me.
Only when bathed in moonlight do I truly belong to myself.
This is the first time I've seen leaves like these...
They are related to those in Maroonwood, but why do they exhibit blue shades?
Fascinating...
This is truly a remarkable place...
That Priestess... She's still not here yet.
Why do I come here every day?
Am I attracted to these views to this extent?
Or are there reasons beyond that?
These statues... They're magnificent, sir.
This one honors Atilius, a Hero of Heroes.
They all stand as a reminder of our duty.
"Never let the Dark Tide cross the canyons."
Strike sharp! Keep your balance! Move fast!
You missed the mark again.
How many times do I have to remind you what a missed strike can cost out there?
Sorry, Master!
Tyrannos was supposed to be the worst of it. Who knew there was something even more terrifying lurking behind it...
An enemy no one could've prepared for. That thing… it shouldn't even exist in this world!
Victory was ours in the end, but the cost was steep...
For a moment there, I thought we'd go down with the Sovereign.
But somehow… we made it out alive...
This one's no ordinary Corrosaurus. It's a lot tougher.
And it's not just the beast. Something's wrong with this High Tide. The temperature, the pressure, even the way the wild Tacet Discords are stirring… It's all off.
I can feel it in my gut. Something is getting closer, using this hunt as cover.
Not a prey... but a hunter.
I knew something would come at us, but I didn't expect it to be that ferocious...
Still, it's nothing but ashes now.
Your instincts saved us all.
Instinct is nothing compared to your valor.
Septimont is lucky to have fearless hunters like you.
It's an honor to accompany you on this hunt. I am LeBlanc, the messenger assigned to this team.
The terrain here concentrates Remnant energy, keeping the Blightcloud active all year round.
During the High Tide, we face large-scale assaults from Dark Tide creatures. Even when it wanes, this land is far from peaceful.
Septimont runs regular hunts alongside the High Tide expeditions to keep the monsters in check.
The hunt never stops. It's the only way to hold the threat at bay.
Recent reports show unusual activity, proving this Tide is far from ordinary.
Your support is vital to us. If you need anything, just say the word.
(Under the hands of a Priestess, even a blank wall may transform with quiet revelation.)
(But the Priestess averts her eyes from the flickering flames of fate, as if one more look will burn her.)
(She trembles. She cannot bear to look. She cannot bring herself to paint.)
Murals don't paint themselves.
I'm afraid of seeing too clearly. Once I see fate's full shape, I might never escape that future.
And if I falter or lose my way… what will happen to those who look to me for guidance?
Grandmother Lillibet once said, "Know your fate, and prepare for it.  Only then can we find firm ground on the path it takes us."
It's okay… as long as I remember that, I won't be lost.
I must say, you've leveled up fast. Your marksmanship and swordplay now are totally different from three months ago.
But hunting isn't just about skill and guts. You barely understand how those Dark Tide creatures fight, and your battle experience is still lacking.
No amount of grinding will fix that overnight. Maybe spend another ten years in Maroonwood, sis.
Don't be so sure. I'll prove I've outdone you.
Hah! Training with me even gave you my stubborn streak, huh?
Of course. So, you up for a bet? Whoever brings back fewer kills buys a round for the whole tavern!
Deal. But can we at least keep the drinks cheap?
I'm confident I'll win, but I need to keep some cash for food, just in case...
The first time I set foot on the Plateaus, I was just a greenhorn.
Now, twenty years have worn on.
Aye, only you and I remain from the old squad.
…If we fall out here, at least we'll die knowing it was a life well spent.
Ugh, this bedroll's like a rock...
What, you think this is the Leonidas Hotel? You're in the hunting grounds.
Watch it, spoiled noble brat.
Can't handle it? Go cry at home. If not, show me you've got some spine.
Next time you head to the hunting grounds, at least let me know first.
Running off on your own like that could get you killed.
I just… wanted to try out the new weapon...
But okay, I understand.
How many Dark Tide creatures do you think you'll bag next time?
At least twenty. As long as I outscore you, I'm good.
Heh, love the spirit. But you'll need another decade to catch up to me.
Oh yeah? You want to bet on it? Loser buys everyone a round at the tavern!
(Hums) Shattered blades lie buried, fortunes ever shifting...
To where will the singing spirits take you?
...Yeah, she won the bet this time.
Alright, folks! This is my first time doing this, so listen up! One top-shelf Solis's Paean for every one of you! On me!
To Silveira, who won't be coming back, and her final battle, fought with glory and honor!
She used to say a fine drink was meant for moments of victory and triumph.
But... well...
...Guess fate's got a taste for cruel jokes.
Hunting with the Ephor is the best experience you'll ever have.
But... aren't you scared of her? She is the Ephor, after all.
Scared? Heh.
Obedience isn't what our Ephor wants, kid. She wants warriors who stand and fight with her.
The Sanguis Plateaus… It stretches even farther than I imagined.
This isn't some sightseeing spot.
See Murmurstown over there? The Dark Tide's already claimed it.
Let your guard down here, and Septimont City could be next.
Hah! That was my kill. So how come you got the credit?
You mean the one that tried to run?
Hmph. If I hadn't landed the finishing blow, it would've gotten away.
Says who? I had it cornered! That counts for something!
It may just be an Echo...
But it has the instinct to hunt for prey. Or to be precise, hunt for frequencies.
Very interesting indeed...
Kreee!
Young folks these days are tough to train.
Each one's eager to prove themselves, itching to be first in the fight...
But come to think of it, we were just the same back in our day.
Haha, that's true!
You like these shiny accessories too, Wootter?
I'll bring you one after I've finished work.
Your fur is starting to get a bit messy too...
Alright, I'll buy you a comb, too.
There's no room for carelessness when it comes to weapons.
Your heart might tire, but your blade can't afford to.
An extra piece of armor might just save a life out there in the wilds.
Your sword and armor are as good as new. Happy hunting, young man.
Thanks, sir. You're always so reliable.
Haha, stay sharp, and don't get too comfortable relying on your gear.
Got it!
Priestess, I... I've come seeking answers for myself and my men.
The Dark Tide keeps surging and spawning those vicious monsters upon our land.
Over and over, it never seems to end...
All I want to know is, where will these foul creatures strike next?
…I told them to seek their fate after the High Tide passes.
But that pale Huanglong girl just thanked me and shook her head.
They said, "Seize every moment," but who knows how many of them will still be left…
Strange, I can still picture them clearly…
The girl looked so pale, but her smile was as bright and warm as the sun.
The young lad walked beside her... Not in a hurry, just calm and steady.
I gave them a kind reminder that once the High Tide passed, they could go to Tetragon Temple and ask the Priestesses about their fate.
I said even if you can't change fate, knowing what lies ahead is better than walking blind.
But they just smiled and said that compared to the time they still had together, the future didn’t matter much. To them, every day they were alive, and together, was already a gift.
Honestly… they weren't wrong. As long as you're still breathing, live each day the best you can. That's what really counts.
Listen, my friend. Don't be fooled by this beast just because it has the familiar face of a Corrosaurus.
Tyrannos isn't just another wild stray. It's the most brutal, intelligent, and vicious of the lot.
It holds grudges. Remembers every wound and every face that made it bleed.
So take this seriously and be extra careful!
You... I didn't raise you to be so defiant!
With all due respect, Uncle, we live in a new age now.
That's enough, Martina. Just save it!
A newcomer, are ya? Looking for someone to talk to?
Any stories about the hunts you've joined?
Haha, sure. Let me tell you one... One I'll never forget.
Thirty years ago, I went hunting with an old friend. We were young, hungry for the biggest, meanest beast we could find. My friend was stronger than the rest of us, and twice as ambitious.
Following his plan, we spent days luring a Tacet Discord into the beast's territory. The goal was to provoke its territorial instinct and drive it into a fight.
When the two monsters clashed, we pounced. With the help of the Griffrexes, we drove our blades through the beast's skull.
And then? What happened next?
And then... he claimed the kill, took the glory, and left the Plateaus.
I didn't mind. That was always our agreement. We both had dreams, and he had the better shot at making them real.
But... like the beast we slew, he couldn't conquer his own hunger. Just another hunter, lost in someone else's hunting ground.
So this is the Hunter's Den! It's massive!
You'll get used to it soon enough—hey, over there!
Look at how big that Hornett is! I've never seen one up close before!
I never thought I'd actually get to join the hunt…
Even if it's just the support team, I made it! My Ma would be so proud.
I just hope the work we do really helps the others out there…
My Gladiator friends used to tell me about how awe-inspiring this place is.
I've dreamed of seeing it for myself, and now I'm finally here.
How are you feeling? I'm honestly so excited right now!
Me too! No matter how much you imagine it, nothing compares to actually being here!
What else can I do to help the Gladiators...?
Ooh! I can check if anyone needs their weapons maintained.
The more I do, the more support they'll have out there on the hunt!
These tents... there's a wild kind of beauty to them, isn't there?
Real warriors rest here. They sleep beneath windy skies, waking to the sound of the horn...
Hey, Gennaro! The Gladiators are back! Come give me a hand!
I've always dreamed of visiting the camps out in the wilds during a real Gladiator hunt.
That would be incredible! Joining the hunt myself as a Gladiator... imagine that!
If there's even the slightest chance it could happen… hmm, I have to go ask!
New supplies just came in. Please check the inventory when you can.
Do let us know if you have any additional requests. We'll do our best to meet them!
Thanks. I'll go over the supply list first.
Everything's checked. Once the hunt begins, the Gladiators will be sent all over the hunting grounds. We'll be counting on you for more supply runs.
By the way, why is there a crate of Heartpour in this delivery? It's not listed.
Freebies from the sponsor. They even sent their own crew to drop it off.
Everyone's doing their part for this hunt. Just think of it as a gesture of goodwill.
Griffrexes are always so majestic...
I know, right? Just look at how their feathers shimmer… and the sheer elegance in the curve of their beaks...
Griffrex… oh, Griffrex…
How many times must I tell you, Martina? The glory of the hunt belongs to Lady Valeria, our Hero of Heroes. And to the honor of our clan.
We are of a lesser pedigree. That is why we serve the greater good, not chase after personal fame. Do what duty demands of you!
Uncle's right. We may have fallen from grace, but as long as Valeria, the Untarnished Blade, is remembered, our clan will rise again with her name lighting the way!
No, Uncle. Valeria's name alone can't hold up the glory of our House forever. I'd rather follow in her footsteps, hunt the giant beasts as she hunted, and earn a name of my own.
And one day, let them carve my name beside hers. "Martina, descendant of Valeria—a hero whose glory shines as bright as her ancestor's."
Didn't expect you to be so taken by Griffrexes, too.
Of course I am! Can't call yourself Septimontian if you aren't. They are our loyal companions and our wings in the hunt...
One day, I hope I'll become a Gladiator worthy of their trust and fight with the same valor as they do.
Always rambling on about glory, and then he aligns himself with that scorpion Falco?!
No Gladiator worth their honor would crawl that low.
Say what you want, but Avidius has what it takes to lead!
Enough. Let's not tear each other apart until we know the whole picture.
Eyes clear, feathers sleek, posture strong...
Mmm, the Griffrexes are ready to take flight at the next call.
Seems like they can feel it too. Today's a good day for a hunt.
Where did these Hornetts come from?
They were once trophies from great hunts.
Over time, the lingering frequencies of powerful Tacet Discords took the form of these Echoes.
Each Hornett embodies a victorious hunt.
Are you lost, sir? You're headed straight for the hunting grounds.
Hehe, don't fret, young man. I've walked this path longer than you've been alive.
Wait... are you a Gladiator too?
I am. And as long as these old bones still move, I'll carry that title with pride.
Are you planning to get a prophecy from the Temple before the hunt?
Yeah. Here's to hoping the Priestesses give me a good one.
But even if it's not what I want to hear, I'll still follow it. No matter what.
Even if my efforts are too small to tip the scales of fate...
All clear on tomorrow's schedule? You'd better stick to it, no exceptions!
You! Repeat it back to me! Let's see if you were actually listening.
Uhhh... I, um…somethin' about… going first? I'm leading the charge, right?!
WRONG! That's not even close! You didn't catch a single word, did you?!
Kids these days… just don't make 'em like they used to! Back in my prime...
I took on a whole pack of Kerasaurs by myself, moved like an eagle...
That's only 'cause you spooked 'em first—
Hey! I did NOT do that! How many times do I have to say that?!
Ephor Augusta is certainly capable. But cries for Avidius to be the next Hero of Heroes grow louder by the day.
Makes you wonder whose banner we should rally behind. A difficult choice indeed...
I respect the Ephor and hold no prejudice toward her background, but let's be honest. A Hero of Heroes is defined by innate talent, not by a crown of victory from the Great Agon!
Avidius has braved four successful expeditions into Manes Deep. If that doesn't prove he's fit to be ruler, what does?
Still, he's backed by Falco. That venomous scorpion alone should be enough to make you question his judgment!
Avidius is a hero, no doubt. Always has been, and he still is.
I've always known Ephor Augusta would turn the tide sooner or later...
Ha, listen to you. Since when did you start playing Priestess?
Another High Tide...
How many lives will it take this time...
That's not the way to put it, Lord Este. My loyalty to the Ephor has never wavered. Her deeds shine as gloriously as the eternal blazing sun. A mere figure like Avidius can never be compared to her.
The Ephor's deeds are indeed admirable. But I must insist that Avidius, too, is a true Gladiator and a hero deserving of the same glory!
I agree with you, Sforza. I have respect for Avidius as well.
As for you, Baglionia, spare us your theatrics.
A profit-chasing opportunist has no loyalty to offer. You'd call yourself faithful no matter who comes out on top.
What's the first and foremost rule in a hunt?
Answer the question, Nora.
Umm... a-avoid being noticed by your prey?
Wrong! It's about knowing your limits and having enough supplies!
"Will I last until the next hunt?" "Do I have enough supplies to survive out in the wilds?"
Out there, the hunter can just as easily become the hunted. If you don't want to end up as dinner, you've got to know both yourself and the enemy.
You've got skill, Nora, but you're still green when it comes to the real hunt. Never let your guard down!
Thank you for the advice! I-I'll give it my all!
Strong prey usually stake out their own territory.
By studying the size and environment of that territory, you can gather valuable intel.
C-could you please slow down a bit? I'm still trying to take notes...
The size of a prey's territory often reflects its strength. Observe its environment and the trails it leaves to deduce its patterns, preferred attacks, and even weaknesses.
But a word of caution. Never get too fixated on the prey itself. When you do, blind spots appear... yours included.
Mhm… Key points in a hunt… "gather intel"… "identify weaknesses"… and... what was next? You said it just now…
Right, I remember now—"Drive them onto the plateau near the Earthrend Wedge"!
So many notes to memorize... Real hunts are nothing like duels in the arena.
Ha... what should I even do now?
Anything happened?
Eek! Y-you're this year's Champion?! I didn't expect to meet you here! C-could I get your autograph?
I… used to be a professional Gladiator. But then I hit a wall. I thought hunting might help me push past it, but I just don't have that confidence anymore... Could you give me some advice?
Make use of your gladiatorial skills.
Hone your skills in real battles!
Hmm... you're right. Gladiator matches in Septimont evolved from hunting rituals, both meant to prepare us to fight the Dark Tide. There's got to be some overlap.

I wanted to start over and learn everything from scratch like a new hunter, but that pressure only made it harder to take things in. Thank you! I feel so much better now. Time to go over my notes again!
...You're right. Hunting and gladiatorial battles might not be the same, but they share one truth: to get stronger, you have to keep fighting real fights.
Thank you for your advice. I guess I shouldn't let doubts get in the way before I've even started. I'll step into the hunting grounds first and see for myself!
Who knows? Maybe I'll turn out to be a better hunter than I ever was in the arena!
Flaunting her title as Priestess to mock the Senate...
Hmph... I'll see to it that she falls from her lofty perch!
Well, well... the Champion of the Great Agon. Septimont's shining hero, here in the flesh.
Here to join us in this glorious hunt? Or perhaps you're here to chase the Priestesses' prophecies in Tetragon Temple?
If it's the former, my squad would be honored to have you. Rest assured, I'll equip you with only the finest gear, worthy of your might and title.
And if it's the latter?
Ah… then allow me to offer you a friendly piece of advice. Stay far away from a Priestess named Iuno.
She's a disgrace. Reckless, rude, and a stain on the Temple's name. She even speaks ill of honored members of the Senate. Trust me, associating with her will do your reputation no favors.
She's seen through you before, hasn’t she?
H-how dare you?! I was only looking out for you! But if you insist on chasing storms… then don't expect sympathy when they break.
Savior of Septimont? Too cliché...
Radiant star who dispelled the Dark Tide's miasma? Hmm... that might just do!
Savior of Septimont, radiant star who dispelled the Dark Tide's miasma! What an honor it is to see you again!
I, Bellfonte, must humbly apologize for my previous shortsightedness. Please forgive my reckless words. You've driven back the miasma and opened the path to final victory.
The people of Septimont will honor your glory and sing your deeds forevermore!
No, the one who dispelled the miasma was Iuno.
You owe Iuno the apology.
…Iuno? I'm sorry, I don't know anyone by that name. Who exactly are you talking about?
(Last time we spoke, his disdain for Iuno was palpable. But now… it's as if the name "Iuno" has been erased from his memory entirely.)
Forgive me. A proper Priestess should not wear such an expression.
I've seen the fate of countless Gladiators, and not one escaped the end I foresaw.
I must become more capable. Capable enough to bear the weight of their fates… And still smile as I see them off.
I must make myself acquainted with that hero...
Hmm... who could introduce us?
Savior of Septimont, radiant star who dispelled the Dark Tide's miasma! What an honor it is to see you again!
You've driven back the miasma and opened the path to final victory. The people of Septimont will honor your glory and sing your deeds forevermore!
No, that was Iuno's doing.
…Iuno? Who's Iuno? Is that… your hidden pseudonym?
(That look on his face… It's not feigned. He truly doesn't remember Iuno.)
Come on, Ferripaws! Make the flames burn brighter!
*A firm and resolved cry*
Don't get too close to the fire, or your whiskers will get singed!
*A cautious and resolved cry*

May applause greet you, young one. What brings you here? Crafting or repairs? As you can see, my hammer's swinging so fast it's practically throwing sparks. If you're looking to place an order, you'll have to wait your turn.
I'm curious about Wootters.
Why have they never appeared in Septimont City?
Well, folks say the Wootters did live in Septimont City a long time ago. But after the first Dark Tide hit, they all moved out to the Sanguis Plateaus and settled here.
Some believe it was the Sentinel Imperator who helped them make the move, so they could support the hunters fighting the Dark Tide.
We're grateful for these fuzzy little ones, and even more so to Imperator, who's always been a great ally of Septimont.
What's the most important trick in smithing, Ferripaws?
*An agreeing cry*
That's right! Just like cooking fish, it's all about the temperature!

Hold the hammer tight with your index finger locked in, the rest of your fingers loose but steady. Remember, it's all about using the momentum from your wrist, not brute force. That way, you'll last a lot longer.
Here, follow my lead. Hold it like this! Yes, just like that, and bring it down!
*A spirited cry*
That's it! Now, let's do that again!
Any discomfort after taking the potion?
Don't keep it to yourself. If you feel unwell, let the medics know right away, okay?
Are you hurt? Any discomfort? Here, let me check.
I-I'm alright, really!
Don't worry, I'm strong.
You're not just putting on a brave face? Well... your eyes are clear, and you seem steady on your feet. You really do look like you're holding up.
Healing isn't just about treating wounds. Gladiators exposed to the Dark Tide for too long can suffer mentally, too. Some even lose track of what's real.
Without timely medical intervention, or if they stay exposed to the Dark Tide for too long, there's a real risk their minds could be lost entirely.
So please, if you ever feel unwell, physically or mentally, don't hesitate to find a medic. Please... don't just try to tough it out.
This one, this one, and that one—yes, all three bottles. Take them three times a day!
And don't forget to change the dressing daily. That'll help with the healing.
How's the patient?
Much better after the tranquilizers. He's asleep now.
Good. Let him rest, but keep monitoring his condition.
Such serenity in Tetragon Temple at night...
I can hear the hunters singing in the camp...
The Dark Tide can affect a person's mind, numbing their emotions, erasing memories, and even causing hallucinations.
When you're treating them, pay close attention to their eyes. If someone avoids your gaze or stares blankly, there's a good chance they're experiencing these symptoms.
Then… how should I treat them?
Different symptoms require different treatments. I'll explain them to you in detail...
Seven, eight, nine... Hmm, that's odd. Where's the last one?
*An excited cry*
Aha! You found it already! That's a good boy, Wootter!
Oh, wait! It's too high up for you. I got it.
You did so well today, Wootter.
I couldn't have delivered the item on time without your help.
*A proud, joyful noise*
You're the best assistant anyone could ask for! What do you say, partners for life?
Hang in there... we made it back to camp.
Ugh... camp? I don't see it...
Where is he hurt? This way, let's carry him over to the medic's tent.
The spirit's vision... it's gone now...
Thank the eternal sun! I thought you wouldn't make it...
Thank you for bringing me back. Otherwise, I'd really be with the spirits now.
The patient we received earlier is stable now.
Whew, I'm exhausted... but honestly, this feels a lot better than sitting around doing nothing in the city.
No one died today, and that's my doing! Hehe!
Here to join the hunt? It's rare to see such a young Gladiator around here.
Yes, I've been looking forward to this for a long time.
Ever since I heard my father's stories about the glorious hunts, I've trained hard to be part of one...
You wish to visit Tetragon Temple... at night? Hehe, how very interesting.
There isn't much to see, I'm afraid. Only Priestesses in quiet thought, keeping watch over what is yet to come.
Ever through the flames do we gaze into a piece of Septimont's future, keeping vigil to preserve its peace.
All we hope is that our prophecies may guide the brave and shield the fearless.
Striking out isn't everything. If you drop your guard, you'll be bleeding out on the ground before your blade even lands.
But shouldn't I put everything I've got into the attack?
Sharpen that blade and ready your spear! This ain't playtime!
Once you're out in the hunting grounds, those Dark Tide monsters won't be cutting you any slack!
Hail! You've got the stance of a seasoned warrior. First time out on the hunt? Got questions? Ask away.
About the Hunter's Den...
About that temple high on the hill...
Maybe next time.
See that Blightcloud floating up there? It's been rotting the sky since the first Dark Tide hit Rinascita. Still threatens every soul in Septimont.
To keep it from spreading, Gladiators made their stand on the Plateaus ahead. That's how the Hunter's Den got started. A wall of steely spirits between the Dark Tide and the city.
Shh, quiet now. That's Tetragon Temple, the sacred dwelling place of the Priestesses.
We actually owe a lot to Lady Deiphobusia, the last Grandpriestess. She gave up part of the Temple's land so we could set up a base here.
If it weren't for her, we'd probably be out there brawling with monsters for a patch of ground! Haha!
Aye. If you're ever curious about the Den or anything else around here, just swing by.
Been a long while since the fire of the hunt burned this bright around here...
How I wish you were here to see it with me, old friend...
{PlayerName}! Welcome!
Do you know what it takes to survive in the hunting grounds? Caution. Above all else.
Caution alone is not enough to achieve victory. You must also strike with courage.
The Havoc Drake is definitely the strongest.
No, the Aero Drake is more powerful!
The Havoc Drake dishes out more powerful attacks, while the Aero Drake is only good for its endurance.
Attack power doesn't translate to survival. When damage output doesn't cut it, it comes down to who can survive the longest!
Enough of that. How about the two of you have an Echo duel?
A fight will help settle everything.
Where have Trefor and Disanta run off to this time...
{PlayerName}, have you seen two young Gladiators by the names of Trefor and Disanta around here?
We're getting ready to set out for the hunt tomorrow, and I just can't find them anywhere.
Tell him what you know.
Keep it a secret.
What did you say? They've gotten mixed up with a reporter from Ragunna and are about to fight over something that ridiculous?
Thank you for informing me, {PlayerName}. I'll go drag those two hooligans back right this instant.
Well, if anything were to happen to them, what am I supposed to tell their families...?
May howls of triumph follow you, Honorable {PlayerName}!
With your skills on our side, this promises to be a magnificent hunt!
However, do keep your guard up. Overconfidence killed many a hunter.
So danger is always lurking, huh?
While the hunt's still going, I'm not about to let my guard down.
Precisely! The Tacet Discords have proven to be very cunning. During a hunt, hunter and prey switch roles more often than you would think.
A single lapse of judgment could be the difference between life and death.
If only more of our young had your discipline. Perhaps then I could rest easier.
May glory light your hunt!
All three of us returned safely from the great battle. It's more than we could've wished for.
