Yum-yum! Hey sir, can we share this snack with the audience during our evening show? No snacks, no show!
Let me do something for you. Anything! To help you attract more customers.
Oh my, that'll be my great honor!
But...
What's the matter?
Have you heard? There's a monster in the wild recently, one they call the Jingle Beast...
The Jingle Beast...
Yeah. Somehow the nickname sounds cute even!
But you know what? It does all the terrible stuff you can think of!
When hunting, it makes these jingling sounds... They say its tusks are over half a meter long and its claws shred prey with ease.
It sounds scary.
Interesting.
No, that's not true. The "Jingle Beast" doesn't look like that...
Do you know it?
It... It's a... A friend of mine.
Well, actually... I need this one ingredient for my new snack, but the Jingle Beast has been messing things up. Can't find good meat anywhere right now.
Do you have other ways to replenish your stock?
There's only one place left to get it, and it's run by this Exile group called "The Savages."
Apparently, they're in cahoots with the Jingle Beast, and that's how they still have meat for sale.
But it's crazy expensive—five times the usual price! It's insane!
I'm just a small shop, how am I supposed to afford that?
So... I can't make a lot of these snacks for you to hand out yet.
Are you okay?
Me? Oh... I'm fine...
It suddenly struck me that there was another request to deal with... It should be right next to the tea house not far away. Now, if you'll excuse me, I must go!
Sorry, {PlayerName}. I'll be back soon!

Lingyang treats you to some local Jinzhou specialties at a food stall, suggesting the stall owner—one of his clients—offer snacks during the performance as a way to advertise. However, the owner explains they are short on ingredients due to the disruption caused by a creature known as the "Jingle Beast" and a gang called "The Savages." Hearing this, Lingyang appears deep in thought.
Day 1: I had one lazy day and now there's a whole convoy of missing packages! They shipped me off to a remote station for punishment. Time to redeem myself as the ultimate delivery hero!
Day 2: Played Echo Simulation all day.
Day 3: Played Echo Simulation all day.
Day 4: Come on! I can't keep playin games!
Day 5: Played Echo Simulation all day.
Day 6: They're freaking out about a "Tingle Beast" out there in the wild... Scared, wanna bail...
Day 7: It IS called the "Tingle Beast" right... Right?
No beasts, just Exiles ruining my day. Even more packages gone. Broke my terminal. No Echo Simulation now :( UGH!!
Day 8: They tried to force me into delivering stuff for them... Over my dead body! They can feed me to the Tingle Beast for all I care!!
Day 9: We Promise, We Deliver!
The Jingle Beast should've left behind some traces. Please let us know if you find anything suspicious.
I know you're a very experienced explorer, but just in case: Please try not to disturb the scene.
Have you found anything?
I found some red packets, drum sticks, and Lionpeppers...
All common stuff in Jinzhou. Nothing special. It just baffles me to no end...
What a great stomp on the Dipper poles! What an impressive jump! Haha!
Nice to see you again, sir.
Yeah, I'm still thinking about the show we just watched!
What an amazing show. I'd say it rivals the shows in my time!
The new Liondancer they picked really did a great job!
Our future is in good hands with these youngsters!
Sorry, but I'm not the one you're looking for. I never made any liondancing requests...
{PlayerName}, what brought you here?
I received a strange request from the Bei Family. It didn't mention any specific requirements.
Could it be your parents?
...No, it can't be. Now, if there's nothing else, please excuse me.
Please, one moment! Bei Shi... do you have an older brother?
How did you know...
The client who called me had a mature male voice.
And since he said he's from the Bei Family, there is only one other possibility...
Bei Shi, has something happened to you?
I'm Lingyang from the Liondance Troupe. This is {PlayerName}.
You can trust us.
...It's about my brother, Bei Ji. It's been a week now, and he still hasn't come back home.
A week ago... That's when I received this request.
Was he acting strange the last time you saw him?
My brother and I stopped talking to each other a while back, after a big fight. I don't even know when he last left our house...
But... he still sends me packages from time to time. It's been a bunch of strange stuff...
This package has old Angelica flowers, they don't smell good anymore.
And these meats... They are almost bad, even though they're refrigerated... Anything else he told you?
He mentioned hanging out with people from The Savages in one of his letters...
Why didn't you inform the Patrollers?
I didn't tell anyone, because I was worried my brother would get in trouble if I reported it to the police.
Yeah, The Savages seem shady. And there's talk of the Jingle Beast being connected to them.
But the return addresses on these packages are all different. How are we supposed to find him?
We can go ask the package delivery people.
I see... {PlayerName}, you're so clever!
Bei Shi, leave it to me! I'll help you find your brother.
Can I go with you?
I get it, Bei Shi. You really want to find your brother.
But it's dangerous out there with the TD Outbreaks happening more frequently. I can't guarantee your safety if we run into a spreading Tacet Field.
I... I can handle it. I used to be a member of the Pioneer Association, too.
Us Pioneers never... never back down from a challenge...
You don't sound so confident.
Don't bite off more than you can chew.
But... I...
If you insist... Okay, but we'll need to ask {PlayerName} about it.
{Male=He;Female=She} is a strong Resonator. With {Male=him;Female=her}, we'll be safer on our journey.
To be honest, I don't want to drag my friend into this... But this is an emergency, and Bei Shi want to tag along, so I'm asking a favor of you.
{PlayerName}, I know it's a big ask...
But please... Please help me!
I plan to.
Okay, then, since you're asking for my help...
Amazing! Thank you, {PlayerName}!
The guy who brings my packages is always the same dude, and I know where he works.
Okay, let's get this dealt with. {PlayerName}, are you ready?
Let's go.
One moment.
I was worried.
You didn't pay enough for the meal.
It's not a big deal, really! Thanks for coming to check on me.
What? Oh no! How much money did it cost you? I'll pay you back!
I'm just kidding.
I was really freaked out for a moment. If anyone finds out I let the guest pay, I'll be shamed in Jinzhou!
Are you in trouble?

At the teahouse, you find Lingyang discussing a mysterious request with Bei Shi. They suspect the request came from Bei Shi's brother, Bei Ji, who has been missing for a week and may be involved with "The Savages." To find out more, you and Bei Shi start investigating Bei Ji's packages.
After our adventure in the wilderness, the hustle and bustle brings a comforting sense of prosperity.
I must... do what I can to keep it thriving.
You got all the props ready?
Yes!
Silk balls, drumsticks, gongs... and dried fish!
What are the dried fish for?
To treat our Liondancer, of course!
C'mon, he's not a cat! You should get him some grilled meat.
Really? Thought he'd like dried fish...
Well, can't say I'm an expert on this...
Is Mr. Wufang here? If Mr. Qixing is around, that works too.
Hello sir. Why are you looking for them?
I've been their fan for ages!
Watched their liondance since I was a kid.
I don't ask for much. Just one photo with them would make my day!
Miss, can you please let me in?
They're quite busy right now, but I'll let them know. Sir, would you mind coming back after the performance?
Thank you, miss, thank you!
Sorry, but this is a staff only area.
Hello, is Lingyang here?
Oh, it's Rover. Hello.
Lingyang's busy getting ready for the performance, so he can't meet you.
Anything you want to say, I'll pass it along to him.
What on earth are they doing...
My brother... Is he really working for these people?
They don't seem to have a solid plan or established routes yet.
They seem disorganized, probably a new gang.
{PlayerName}, you found anything over there?
Are they all far away?
Yep, don't worry. I'm keeping watch.
If something happens, you'll know first.
You can focus on finding clues. Let us know if you find anything.
Hi Rover, you're back? How was the show?
It was a great show.
Hehe, of course! The liondances in Jinzhou are truly spectacular! I'll definitely go watch it myself next time!
Now, I'll be getting ready to go home. You're welcome to visit my place again anytime, {PlayerName}!
Oh, that's typical Lingyang.
Well, that was sudden...
Before I could say anything, he's gone...
You'll get used to him soon.
He's spontaneous, always doing whatever pops into his head at the moment.
He just loves helping people.
You'll often see him sprinting around the alleys, lending a hand wherever needed.
He's quick and strong, nothing seems to faze him. He's been such a blessing to us.
We do feel bad when he injures himself accidentally, though... He brushes it off and tells us not to fret, but even though he says not to worry, we still do.
{PlayerName}, can you go check on him? Whatever you order at my place will be on the house!
Sure, I'll go.
Let me finish my food first.
Thank you!
Of course, take your time.
The teahouse Lingyang mentioned is in the residential area, just past the square. Keep walking and you'll find it...

Lingyang heads to a teahouse to take care of an unresolved request. The stall owner expresses concern about Lingyang's tendency to prioritize others over himself and asks if you can check on him. You agree to help.
Keep going down this road and we'll reach the theater. But I guess you've been here many times already...
Well, let's just hang out a bit while we're here!
Sir! May your business boom!
Thank you, Lingyang!
It should be around here...
Wait... There's someone calling for help...
Over there! The Hoochiefs are attacking someone!
Hey, you two! Just came back from outside the city? Or are you going somewhere?
Remember to eat on time no matter how busy you are!
Oh, and when my store opens, you must visit! I'd love to see you there!
Have a happy wedding, Ms. Linling!
Thank you, Lingyang!
Lingyang! {PlayerName}! Nice to see you!
And oh, about the wedding suggestion... We may still need some time to think over it. It's our once-in-a-lifetime thing, after all!
But we'll surely go watch your liondancing show! This I am sure of!
Haha, Ms. Ganxue's shop is always so popular. Let's not bother her for now!
Her souvenirs are all made with care. I'm sure people will love them!
If even the Dim Forest can be restored to what it once was...
Then surely we can defeat the Lament as well, right?
We'll see the world fully recover one day.
If I could ever have the chance, I want to witness it with you.
Until then, please stay safe and sound.
Goodbye, {PlayerName}! No matter how many times, I still want to tell you: Fare thee well, blessings swell!
The tusk of an unknown creature, huge in size.
Partially completed red packets and silk balls.
These should be lion dance props. The designs are delicate, and you can tell meticulous craftsmanship from them.
Scattered scraps of defrosting meat, already spoiled and emitting a foul odor.
A messy bill with barely visible entries. The expenditure is almost zero.
You return to the city. On the way back, Bei Ji tells Bei Shi all about what happened.
What are you doing here?
You exit the cave to find that Bei Shi and the Patrollers have captured the thugs.
Are you in trouble?
What are you doing here?
What are you doing here?
About the Moon Lanterns...
About the Moon Lanterns...
Tsk... The control system's crashed. We'll have to force our way through.
Yes... Some TDs found their way inside, and we're now surrounded by a bunch of cops. Hard to make it out of here with the specimens.
Fortunately you caught that Rover. Whether {Male=he;Female=she}'s useful for research or not, holding {Male=him;Female=her} hostage will buy us some time.
What should I do next, Master?
Here's the coordinates. Bring {Male=him;Female=her} to me in the inner chamber.
{Male=He;Female=She}'s a sly one. Ready to bolt any moment.
I have trackers planted on {Male=him;Female=her}. {Male=He;Female=She}'s not going anywhere in our territory.
We'll talk once you get there.
You heard him. You're in our turf. Better not get any bright ideas.
You'll pay for this…
Well that's not your problem. Also, no one's coming to your rescue anytime soon.
I guess you managed to send out a distress call? Somehow it slipped past us. Ah… You had an encrypted transmitter tablet.
Hand it over. Don't try to deceive me.
(Hand over the tablet.)
You can dream...
Good {Male=boy;Female=girl}.
Funny you'd think you have a choice.
You are a valuable test subject. I don't want to make things difficult for you, unless you force my hands... Got it?
(Here's the thing. Dollmaker's listening to our every word. All my efforts will be wasted if he suspects anything.)
(I'll be typing on this tablet for you to see. I want you to follow my instructions.)
(Nod in agreement.)
Very well, if you can refrain from unnecessary struggle, we won't have to do things the hard way.
Where are we?
You don't need to know. Now get moving.
(We're in the factory where the Dollmaker makes his puppets. The place is full of traps and his minions. Very dangerous.)
At least tell me what he's planning to do with me.
Hehe. Patience. You'll know once you see him.
(Dollmaker's in bed with the Fractsidus, trading Overclock-inducing puppets for resources and funds.)
(I need your help to collect proof of his crimes.)
No more wasting time... Let's go.
(I'll take off your restraints on the way. I need you to pretend you're still bound, remember?)
Understood.

Yinlin brings you to meet the Dollmaker, maintaining a façade of hostility due to a bug the Dollmaker planted on you. Through a hidden panel, she explains that this factory produces puppets designed to trigger Overclocking for the Fractsidus in exchange for resources. She needs your help to gather evidence against the Dollmaker's involvement in all this.
You guarding this place for Master Dollmaker?
Out of my way. Master Dollmaker asked for this person.
Something's not right.
Urgh... Family... My family...
They're Overclocking... Must've been exposed to those puppets for too long...
And the bunch of cops who just attacked us finally pushed them over the edge.
Watch out!
Give my family back!
Yinlin, you made it. Have those cops entered the factory?
Not yet. But those Exiles were Overclocking and I had to take them down.
It's fine, they're disposable.
How pathetic.
They're a bunch of outcasts, willing to do whatever it takes to survive. No one would mourn them if they died.
I mean you.
Oh...? Me?
Your Forte could have saved many, but you...
I could save them, I'm sure, but who's going to save me?
What are you planning to do?
Stop it, Dollmaker... My parents would not consent to being brought back as puppets.
Yinlin... I thought at least you would understand me.
I don't blame you. You were too young when they passed away, after all. You hardly remember them.
And that's why I couldn't revive them from your memories. Not from my own, either.
This is where you come in, Rover. You're a godsend, a gift from above.
You want to use me for that?
Precisely. With help from the Fractsidus, plus your body's data… I will finally create their puppets.
Dollmaker, you…
I was an outcast, alone and shunned... Until my mentor and his wife took me in. They were my true family.
I'll do anything to bring them back, no matter the price...
That doesn't mean you can hurt other people.
So what? Why should I care?
It's almost time. We'll have to leave the factory behind, but there's a couple of prototypes I need to bring.
My identity must stay hidden. Use explosives to stop them if necessary, Yinlin.
But our people are still inside the factory.
"Our people"? There's only the two of us. The rest of them are not worth my concern.
What about Rover?
Same as before, Yinlin. Just knock {Male=him;Female=her} out.
No need to keep {Male=him;Female=her} intact this time, some level of basic consciousness is enough. The Fractsidus taught me methods to operate on a body like that.
I'll leave two puppets here. To pretend we're still holding {Male=him;Female=her} hostage behind the closed door.
We'll need the data repository too.
Yes... My research data. That's more valuable than my life.
I'll take care of the data transfer. Yinlin, you deal with this person. Be quick!

You speak to the Dollmaker and discover that the two final puppets he intends to make are Yinlin's parents—his former mentors. He captured you to get experimental data, hoping to create perfect puppets with the Fractsidus's backing. Now, with the Public Security Bureau involved, he's rushing to relocate both the puppets and his research data.
Ugh… Yinlin! What are you doing?!
It all ends here, Dollmaker… You're going nowhere.
You of all people should know why the Fractsidus offered their help!
Yinlin… You... How dare you betray me!
I have never forgotten who I am. My bloodline is one of Jinzhou's Patrollers. I will always uphold my duty, just like my parents before me.
They fought to the last minute of their lives, trying to save the innocent.
Everything I've done... I did it for them!
No... you did it to relive the kindness you once felt.
But my parents are gone. So are everyone else's loved ones... It's time we wake up from this dream you've been spinning.
No! Don't you dare!
The Exiles... He just let them in?!
Careful... Those people don't look right! They've all Overclocked!

The Dollmaker confronts Yinlin after learning of her betrayal. She asserts that, like her parents, she has always been a Patroller and has never forgotten her true identity and duty. She declares she cannot accept the Dollmaker harming others to recapture the warmth of the past.
Where are we…
Lightning has destroyed the control panel and hologram projectors. This is what the factory really looks like.
This thing...
The Fractsidus... You got this from them? In exchange for being their pawn?
Me? Their pawn? Hah! I'm the one pulling their strings, sweetheart!
It's over, Dollmaker… Surrender now.
Ugh… Gah… Yinlin!!
How could you do this to me!?
I created this home for my followers. They found salvation through my puppets. I am their savior!
You too, Yinlin! You had the chance to reunite with your family! Why are you doing this to me?!
Puppets can never replace real family.
I never met my parents, but my actions are guided by their beliefs.
As a child, I bemoaned my misfortune, but I knew better than to harm others to make up for it.
The dead deserve peace. My parents are gone, and I can't change the past.
But the present is mine to control. I can still bring justice to those who caused their untimely end...
What's wrong with doing what I can for our happiness? Laws and principles are just tools for those in charge!
Is that why you must deprave others of their happiness? Using them as your pawns?
Ha! Suddenly justice matters to you? Don't tell me you still think you're a Patroller?
I already wiped your data from their records. No one knows you were a Patroller. You can't prove it to anyone now.
Yinlin…
Yes, they may never allow me back... Doesn't matter now. It's a small price to pay to stop you and the greater evil you serve.
I don't need a recognized identity to do what's right. I can do it my way.
You… Gah… *coughs*…
I should get going. I'm leaving the rest to you, Rover.
Please... keep it secret from the Patrollers. Until it's all over. One day, I'll tell them everything myself.
Next time we meet, I'll explain all, and I'll thank you properly, I guess.
Yinlin! Wait!
Quick. Over there!

In the face of the Dollmaker's twisted obsession, Yinlin argues that puppets cannot replace real family and that it is wrong to take advantage of others' happiness to cope with one's own misfortune. The Dollmaker retorts that he has erased her Patroller records, making it impossible for her to prove her identity. But Yinlin asserts that even without this identity, she will continue to fight evil. That is the spirit her parents instilled in her, and the one that motivates her to pursue her goals in her own way.
You activate the switch to let Chixia and the other Patrollers into the inner chamber.
Rover! Are you okay?!
I'm fine. What about the others?
We've sent those civilians back to Jinzhou for medicals.
But they weren't super excited to leave for some reason. They didn't want to be separated from those puppets, no matter what...
There was really not much we could do about it...
They'll need some time to process.
Oh, where's that woman who kidnapped you?
Don't tell me she's already gone... Quick, we're going after her!
I don't think that's necessary at this point.
Uhh.... Yeah, she's a slippery one. Unlikely we can track her down.
Also... Something about her seems.... not so evil? No, can't make assumptions. She's still a suspect!
Uh, we'll table that for now. Rover, you're a crucial witness. Please, come to the Bureau for a statement when you can.
I'll see you there!

After the Patrollers secure the scene, Chixia updates you on the Séance Society's other members, but by then, Yinlin has already disappeared. You promise Chixia that you will go to the Public Security Bureau to provide a formal statement of what happened.
This should deactivate the alarms on the lower levels…
Good. Those Exiles can't reach us now.
Master Dollmaker's chamber is right up ahead... Don't die on me now.
So many prototype puppets... How many secrets does this factory hold?
Here, record the physical status of these puppets. Master needs to know for his research.
(These are his prized achievements. We need photos of them to prove what he's been up to.)
As you wish.
Hmph. That's more like it. Remember to capture every detail. I'll be watching you.
Yinlin reminds you to use your Terminal to record the prototype puppet data.
Intruder!! Kill her!
Tsk… They can't even recognize me now.
What's the plan?
Plan? We take them out, of course.
We can't stay here too long… Make it quick.
That's the total number of prototype puppets... Imagine what would happen if they're all activated at once.
All puppets are powered by these metal canisters... That's why non-Resonators can activate the puppets.
Military-grade mechs... How did they get their hands on these?
Strange. The path is blocked. That thing should open it back up. I'll handle it.
I can't get through here. But "Zapstring" should be able to get under it.
Yinlin ties you up again before activating the switch to the inner chamber.
Don't... Come near me...
That looks scary.
That looks adorable.
The Tacet Discords are increasing. Let's take them down first.
It's the Retroact Rain... We need to hurry up.
...Let's participate... Together...
Help... help me...
The voices are coming from here.
...I don't want...
It might be trying to tell us something... We need to decipher the message somehow.
The rain is getting worse. If this persists, we will likely have to face a minor TD Outbreak.
{PlayerName}, I have your back. Stay focused on analyzing the voices.
You should relax... Weekend... Who knows when is the next... Let's go... Come on... Go... Takeover...
It's the cheers during the Riverside Games, mingled together with cries for help.
Perhaps some people have been trapped in this place, or maybe...
Anyway, we have to figure it out.
Tacet Discords... They won't... No... I'm gonna... I can't... Help...
The voices... They are...
See? How lively! You really need to come and see it in person for the full effect.
And that's thanks to your efforts, Wenshu.

Well, I'm just doing my job. I should be the one thanking you. After all, without the Midnight Rangers tirelessly guarding the front lines, the <ano=sports games>Riverside Games</ano> wouldn't be possible.
Wenshu... Thank you, but you don't have to pitch me.
Why not? Go enjoy your youth! I would've rushed to sign up if I was still young.
{PlayerName}, it's good to see you here.
Oh! I guess you must be the Rover?
Nice to meet you! I'm the director of the Riverside Games. You can call me Wenshu.
Thank you for the invite, Wenshu.
Ah, I almost dropped the ball on this one. I would've forgotten to send out those invitations without Jiyan's reminder.
It's not worth mentioning, Wenshu. This is the first Riverside Games in many years, and you must have been busy with various matters. I only offered a little help when I could.
{PlayerName}, it's a slow day today. Please, take a break and have some fun.
That's right. Go participate in the event, you two! That's how you enjoy your day off!
You mean I can participate too?
Of course! The Jinzhou Riverside Games is an event for all people to enjoy.
Indeed. I'm looking forward to your performance, {PlayerName}.
Only a few events specifically require participants to be Resonators. Other than that, there are no special restrictions for any event.
We haven't held the Riverside Games in years. Look at him, Jiyan still remembers the rules better than I do. Who would've thought?
During the preparation, I came across some pictures from past Games and instantly felt a rush of adrenaline. Ah, the memories of my youth...
It's a pity that the Midnight Rangers are always on the front lines, getting ready for emergencies. The Riverside Games is their only chance to relax and have some fun.
{PlayerName}, I suggest looking around for events to join if you're interested. Many of them are open to on-site registration.
Now, if you'll excuse me, I need to confirm the safety of the surroundings before the race begins. You can consult Wenshu should you need any assistance.
Oh well, I didn't invite him over for that. I hoped he'd come and relax, not to find a new place to work.
On the other hand, we couldn't have brought the situation at the borders under control without Jiyan's prudence...
Sorry, I'm getting off track. The Gulpuff Relay is about to start, and I have to go to the scene in case anything happens.
Especially those still warming up in the backup lane. Gotta bring them over.
{PlayerName}, are you coming with me?
Sure, why not.
Don't always be so tense. Sometimes, you have to give yourself a breather. It's not good to push yourself too hard. So, how about picking up an event to participate in?
Got it.
Have a great time, {PlayerName}.
At the Riverside Games, you gather details from Jiyan and Wenshu as you prepare to assist with the event.
Ugh... All those hours of training for nothing. We're doomed.
Don't give up yet. We've still got some time before the relay starts!
Lingyan, Ganquan, what's wrong?
Hi, Wenshu! And this is...?
This is {PlayerName}.
Perfect timing! We're have a bit of a situation right now.
What's the matter?
Two of our teammates accidentally injured themselves during warm-up... Luckily, the wounds weren't too bad, but the doctor said that they wouldn't be able to participate in the relay anytime soon.
We've asked the organizing committee. Said we can still participate with temporary teammates.
But the relay is starting soon. It's impossible to find another person to join us, not to mention two...
Sigh... First our captain had to quit because of some family emergency, and now this...
Ugh. Are we supposed to just wait for the next Riverside Games? Who knows when that will be...
Speaking of which... Do you have a team, {PlayerName}?
No.
{PlayerName} is also a Resonator. {Male=He's;Female=She's} fully qualified for the Gulpuff Relay.
Still... it depends on whether {Male=he;Female=she} would like to join you.
What kind of competition is it, then?
It's simple! Four people take turns controlling a Gulpuff in a relay race. The first team to reach the finish line wins.
Sounds interesting. Count me in.
What can I get out of this?
Thank you so much! If we can get the prize money, we'll definitely split it with you!
Even if we don't rank, we'll treat you to a big feast in Jinzhou to thank you for doing us such a big favor.
That's right! We'll buy you the best barbecue in Jinzhou. That place is everyone's favorite!
Then you're only one person short for the relay. I know a good candidate for that...
Is it the person I'm thinking of?
Wh-who?
Jiyan.
Bingo.
Oh! Why didn't I think of him!
Huh? Are you serious? The general doesn't look like he'd be interested in events like this.
Well, there's more to your general than you know. That's all I can say.
What do you mean?
Instead of asking questions here, why don't you just go and invite him?
I don't have the guts...
I'll go.
Go invite him now, and you may still have a chance to get him onboard. Don't let others take your chance!
We're counting on you, {PlayerName}!

You find out that two members of Lingyan and Ganquan's team are injured and unable to race. To fill the gap, you join the team, but you still need one more member. After discussing it with Wenshu, you both agree that Jiyan is the best fit, so you decide to invite him to join.
...We're no longer seeing any unusual fluctuations now.
Good job. You should have successfully prevented a potential TD Outbreak.
As you requested, I compared the fluctuations with those of the previous Outbreaks, and I did spot some similarities.
Thank you, Mortefi.
I'm not done yet. Thank me later if you must.
Though there are some similarities, they aren't identical. I'm no expert in this field, and I can't give you any definitive conclusions yet.
This is the frequency sample I've recorded.
Frequency sample from a Sonoro Sphere... I'll deliver it to a colleague. It's in better hands with her.
Your colleague?
It's someone you know. Baizhi. She specializes in Ecoacoustic research, and the Sonoro Sphere is her field of expertise.
Yes... Whatever you do, please keep it safe.
What now, you don't trust me?
I trust you as always, Mortefi. But this sample... It means a lot to me.
Rest assured. You should know how careful we are with our samples... Especially such a valuable one.
This should be our wake-up call. The Waveworn Phenomena is more complicated than we thought.
It's a wake-up call, and it may also hold the answers we've been searching for all these years.
By the way, the Riverside Games people were looking for you, Jiyan. Probably wanted to discuss holding the event again at a later date.
Sure, I'll go talk to them once everything is settled here.
{PlayerName}, there is a place I need to visit. Could you come with me?
Sure, let's go.
Sure. I'll be waiting for you at Knell Square.
Now, if there's nothing else, I'm going back to my lab.
See you.
I'll join you later...
Thank you. I need to pick up something first. See you at Knell Square.
Jiyan gives Mortefi the recorded frequency samples, and Mortefi promises the Academy will use them well.
{PlayerName}, I heard you've returned to the city with General Jiyan?
Ah, what a relief. I am beyond happy to know you're all safe and sound.
There is something I forgot to give you. Let's meet up somewhere when you have the time.
Greetings, {PlayerName}.
You see those fish? They look so happy in the safety of their pond.
Happiness and safety often come at a cost, whether it be for fish or people.
And if we do not feel the weight of that price, someone else is carrying it for us.
What happened to that temporary team ten years ago?
Ten years... How time flies. I coordinated the Riverside Games that year, too.
Dozens of teams competed that day, and the race lasted well into the afternoon... The sunset was so beautiful, like what we're seeing now... It was so tranquil.
That team was thrown together last minute, and nobody thought they could win. They even stumbled during their first exchange.
But then, the team surprised everyone with their final runner's expert Gulpuff handling and victorious finish. It was truly a race to remember.
Just like how you looked in this photo.
We were worried. We weren't going to get a photo of you all together... Luckily, the photographer managed to capture a shot of the whole team.
Thank you.
I should thank you for bringing that team together, {PlayerName}.
I'm planning to talk to Jiyan about hosting the Riverside Games another time. If all goes well, please join us!
They must have been overjoyed to win.
Yes. I still remember how excited those kids looked...
Is this a group photo of us?
Wenshu shares the full story of the temporary team and gives you a photo of you and Jiyan's team as a keepsake.
Hi, {PlayerName}! Fancy seeing you again!
Thank you so much for your help that day.
You're welcome.
I'll forever cherish the memories of that race. I got to have you and our general as my teammates!
I heard you and the general tackled a big problem together.
Man, I hope to be as capable as you someday!
You are already quite capable.
Thank you for saying that! I've always wanted to serve on the front lines, but I was assigned to the Rearguard Camp. Guess I'll just have to stay here for now.
I don't want to give up my dream yet, so I'm still trying to apply for a transfer.
The front line is dangerous.
I know, but somebody's gotta be out there for our people. I won't regret my choice, no matter what happens.
And before that, I'll be giving my all to protect people as a Rearguard!
Duty calls. I should return to my post now. See ya around!
Hi, {PlayerName}!
You know what!
I finally managed to borrow the recording of the Riverside Games from ten years ago!
Wasn't it checked out by someone else?
Yeah, and they just returned it to the archives recently.
Since they're holding the Riverside Games again soon, I wanted to see if the recording was returned.
And surprise! It was!
But man, gotta say the video quality sucks... All backs and no faces at all. Thought I could finally admire how cool they looked.
You've already met one of them.
What? When? How?
That's a secret.
Come on, {PlayerName}, just tell me!
I could really use some advice from them...
The injured soldiers... Are they alright?
Yes they are! They're all fully recovered. Thank you for asking.
And... There's another thing, {PlayerName}...
Erm, you know they're gonna hold another Riverside Games, right? Lingyan and I want to join the race with our original teammates this time.
Sure. I understand.
Thank you, {PlayerName}! Promise you'll come cheer for us, alright?
I promise.
Hey, you're our top runner. You should go first and motivate us. Make the other teams sweat. Throw them off their game!
Hmm... I don't think that's the best tactic. Remember that team from ten years ago?
Oh, the record-breaking team?
Yep, it's them. Apparently their plan was to act weak in the beginning and then have their final runner blow past everyone else.
That's nonsense! What if we lag far behind and can't catch up again? All our efforts will be in vain!
What are you talking about?
Are you {PlayerName}? You gonna participate in the Gulpuff Relay too?
What is the Gulpuff Relay?
Oh, you haven't heard?
It's the best part of the Riverside Games. Four people on each team race Gulpuff Echoes in the water lanes. It's pretty intense!
And we're just figuring out our relay order. Open to suggestions!
I've trained for the longest time. Changfeng and the others are all pretty evenly matched. What do you think—should I lead off or bring it home as anchor?
You should go first to intimidate the opponents!
You should go last and take over the lead.
Can't you just go all out at once?
See! {PlayerName}'s on my side! So it's been decided!
Okay, okay! If you say so, I believe I can do it!
{PlayerName}, don't be silly! It's a relay! Anyway, thanks for the joke. It definitely helped calm my nerves a bit.
{PlayerName}, what are you doing here? Have you found any event that you're interested in?
Yes, but I've run into a bit of trouble.
Trouble? If you're comfortable sharing, tell me about it. Maybe I can help.
Actually, I do need your help.
So... you want me to join the relay as your temporary teammate?
Yes.
What's the matter?
What, are you scared?
No worries.
No.
The key to winning a relay race lies in mutual understanding, cooperation, and trust among team members.
Most of the teams are formed according to the Midnight Rangers units they belong to. Therefore, they're familiar with their teammates and have good teamwork.
I believe you can find a better candidate for your team. That candidate doesn't have to be me.
But we'll be disqualified without another teammate.
I really want to join the race with you.
Disqualification for teams without enough participants... Yes, I remember that rule. I imagine your teammates would be greatly disappointed if that happened.
Joining you... I see. It might be fun.
But given we never trained together before, it may prove challenging to win.
Doesn't matter, we're a last-minute temporary team anyway.
A temporary team...
You alright?
I'm fine, thank you for asking... It's been a long time since I last heard that phrase.
Indeed. No need to worry about the end result before the competition begins.
Yes... I'll join you.
Spectators are gathering along the lanes. The race should start soon.
Let's go join our new teammates.
What's wrong?
Nothing... Perhaps it's just my imagination.
The team would be thrilled to have you.
You invite Jiyan to join the team. He agrees to be a substitute after careful consideration.
We'll win and we'll break the record! You hear me?
Yeah!
I can't hear you! LOUDER! DO YOU HEAR ME!
YEAH!!
LOUDER!!
Oh my!
Wow, if this isn't the very important guest of Jinzhou! Thanks for rooting for us!
Sorry for being loud. But you gotta admit, sometimes a strong voice is needed to show our determination. Right?
I saw another team preparing for the race just now, but they seem to have run into some problem.
Wenshu just rushed over there. I hope they're okay!
Now, the race is about to start. We need to do a final warm-up. Remember to cheer for us, okay?
I heard we must all go back to the city now. For real?
Yes, because there is a security risk. We are here to escort you.
Say sike! I was hoping to snap a few more pics of that guy on the Gulpuff...
Safety first.
Ohh! You must be the runner in the lead just now!
What a pity they just suspended the race... I was really excited to see your performance!
You looked so cool! See, I've even got a video clip of you!
Thank you, please do more of these.
Thank you, but please don't bother.
Sure I will! My camera only captures the best moments!
Hmm? Do you not like it? Looks pretty good to me.
Anyway, let's hurry up and leave here, shall we?
Please excuse us. My sister's never been to the Riverside Games before. She's super into photography, so she may have gotten a little carried away talking about her work.
I understand.
So we're really not doing it anymore? Can't we try to find another way?
I still have more than half of my camera's memory left...
I'm sure the board of coordinators will find a way to hold it again on a later date. Now, please return to the city for your safety.
Alright. Let's go.
Ugh, fine. At least I've got two wonderful photos now! One of the famous Rover taking over the lead, and another with a guy on a Gulpuff.
By the way! Can I enter your photo in a contest? Like, is it okay for you?
No problem.
Better not...
That's great! I'm pretty sure it's gonna be an award-winning entry! I'll give you a half of my prize money!
Okay then... I'll just submit the other photo.
Let's go.
Can I stay a little longer please? I want to watch the full race.
The race is over now.
What happened?
Hi, {PlayerName}. Here's the thing. This kid won't let me take her home.
Where are her parents?
Well, you see, that's the problem. She managed to sneak in here. We are trying to get in touch with her parents.
Please don't call mommy. She'll be upset at me.
If it makes her upset, why did you sneak out?
Hmm... I...
Good girls don't lie.
I came here to see daddy. He won the silver medal in the last race!
I haven't seen him for a long, long time, so I thought maybe I can find him here.
The last relay? That was three years ago. What's your father's name?
Kongwen!
Oh... It's him.
Do you know my daddy?
Yes. We were stationed in the same camp.
Uh, well, he's... busy! Like, super, super busy! So he's not here today...
I know! Mommy said he's fighting monsters.
Really!
Yes, but we need you to go home first.
You can't lie to me!
Pinky promise.
Pinkies!
Let's go!
Alright, let's go.
I'll take her home first. Rover, we're counting on you to handle the rest.
Sure. Be safe.
I came here by myself!
Great! Can you take me to Daddy's place?
Yes, he's out there fighting now. I'll ask your dad to give you a call.
I never lie!
Rover is the witness. Pinkies!
Jiyan.
There is something I wish to do with you today.
And this is...?
A seed.
What seed?
This is the seed of a resilient type of flower, which I asked the Academy to help me breed years ago.
Did you plant all these flowers here?
From here, you can see all of Jinzhou city.
I thought... those who died for Jinzhou would want to see how it's thriving now.
This flower... We named it the Emortia.
Yes. The word represents both "departure" and "return."
Yes. I know there's nothing we can do to bring them back, but for us still living, we need something like this to hold on to.
Thank you, {PlayerName}, for finally bringing them peace. Now, they no longer have to fight.
And this is why I believe you should be the one to plant this seed here.
Thank you for your concern.
{PlayerName}, I have one more request.
If one day I perish in battle and cannot return home... Could you please plant one of these flowers for me?
You accept the seed. Despite its size, it feels heavy in your hand.
Together with Jiyan, you plant it. Perhaps one day, you'll watch the sunset again, with the flower you planted by your side.
Emortia... That's a beautiful name.
So the departed soldiers can one day return home...
Thank you, {PlayerName}.
I will not let you die.
Is Jinzhou safe now?
Are you alright, Jiyan?
We have prevented one Outbreak for the time being.
But a greater danger remains lurking in the darkness... Our knowledge of it is severely lacking.
I must act to prevent more deaths...
Every Midnight Ranger is prepared to die on the battlefield any day. I know this all too well as their general in command.
Helping the souls of our fallen ones return to their homeland... This is one of the few ways I can honor their sacrifices.
I promise.

At Knell Square, you see the flowers Jiyan planted for the fallen soldiers. Together, you plant an "Emortia" seed, hoping the souls you met in the Sonoro find peace and return home. Jiyan asks you to plant an Emortia for him if he cannot return home someday.
Sir, please calm down and stop talking about riding Gulpuffs.
But that was really fun!
May I have your hand?
What... What's wrong?
Nothing major. I just need to confirm something.
As I expected.
Huh? When did I get hurt? I didn't feel it at all.
The adrenaline from excitement may have dampened your sensitivity to pain.
However, your nervous response betrays your condition. You right hand has been shaking involuntarily, likely because the wound has been left untreated.
Fortunately, it's not caused by the Gulpuffs. Please take this to relieve the pain for now.
Ouch... It's really starting to hurt now that you've mentioned it.
Alright. Have you calmed down now?
I'm sorry. I got a little carried away... Sorry again for the trouble I've caused.
Let's go have someone see to your wound.
{PlayerName}, fancy seeing you here.
Jiyan and I are joining the relay race together.
I don't want to spoil your fun, but I'm afraid we need to suspend the race for now.
Can you fill us in on the data?
I checked the monitoring data as you asked, and I found unusual fluctuations near the upper waters to the north.
Why didn't the nearest Beacon pick up on this anomaly?
The Resonance Beacon is functioning properly, but we still don't know why it didn't issue a warning this time. I will investigate this further at a later time.
Is it related to the Gulpuffs' strange behaviors?
Animals are often the first to detect signs of danger.
Tacet Discords are similar to animals in this regard. They're very sensitive to any change in the frequencies in their surroundings. That's why those Gulpuffs went haywire.
I suppose that's why you asked me to check the monitoring data for you, Jiyan?
Yes.
The timing of this change is concerning. Why did it happen precisely during the Riverside Games?
Perhaps the Riverside Games' frequency resonated with something in the upper waters?
Let's go check out the upper waters now.
Yes. Let's go.
The lack of perceivable warning signs typically suggests unknown risks. Jiyan, {PlayerName}, stay safe.

Once the injured are safe, you and Jiyan learn from Mortefi that the manic Gulpuffs were affected by abnormal frequency fluctuations upstream. The timing of this accident strikes Jiyan as suspicious, so you decide to investigate upstream.
You... You managed to rope the general in?
Greetings, General Jiyan, {PlayerName}.
{PlayerName} has told me what happened. I will join you.
Hooray! Now we can join the race! With General Jiyan and {PlayerName} on our side, maybe we can even aim for a new record!
Not to be the party pooper here, but as a last-minute team, we probably won't hit the record. Unless...
Unless what?
Uh, sorry, forget about it.
Wait, what record?
Ten years ago, a team set the record in the Gulpuff Relay race. That record remains unbeaten to this day.
Since then, every time the Games are held, a major highlight is whether the record will be broken.
Yeah! I really wanted to learn from their strategy, but the video of that race got borrowed and never returned. Bummer.
They set the record. They must have trained together for a long time.
Well we're a temporary team. Wouldn't have been able to learn much from it anyway.
Keep your chin up. Your hard work will pay off.
Not to mention the team you were talking about was a temporary team, too.
Wow, so even General Jiyan has heard of that race!
Yes. That was a... good race.
Well, it's been ten years... I wonder how that team's doing now.
We should worry about ourselves first... There's not much time left, and we haven't even decided the relay order.
Ah, the relay order... It used to be decided by the captain...
Then... General, can you decide it for us?
As you have trained together extensively, I trust you can decide the order better than me. I will gladly cooperate to the best of my abilities.
Alright... in that case, I think Ganquan would be perfect as the first runner!
Me... the first? Seriously?
You've always been the first runner during our training. Surely you'll make a good start!
The first runner doesn't need to coordinate with the two of us; he only needs to exchange the controller with Lingyan. It's a safe arrangement indeed.
Whew—I'll do my best.
Hmm... As for General Jiyan and {PlayerName}, I think...
General, can you be the connecting third runner? Since you're familiar with both {PlayerName} and us Midnight Rangers.
A reasonable strategy. I agree.
Then the relay order would be me first, followed by Lingyan, then General Jiyan, and {PlayerName} last.
{PlayerName}, this is your first race, and you may receive plenty of attention as the last runner. Please stay calm and relax.
A piece of cake.
Butterflies are fighting in my stomach.
Prepare to be surprised when I win the race.
I'm glad to hear that.
Once I arrive at the exchange zone, go for the goal and don't look back. I'll take care of the rest.
I've always trusted your capabilities.
Any other questions?
Yes!
Our team doesn't have a name yet!
Since {PlayerName} brought this team together, maybe we should let {Male=him;Female=her} decide the name.
Team Rover.
Team Gulpuffalos.
Team Jiyan's Genius Head.
Team PowerPuff Heroes.
Good, it sounds easy to remember.
I'm starting to crave some buffalo wings too...
Not bad. It helps to release the tension.
We can have this as the team name, though I wouldn't call myself a genius.
Considering your character, I was expecting something... different.
Nevertheless, it is a good name. I have no objection.
The name is settled, then. Everyone, please get ready in your designated exchange zones.
We can stay in touch with our Terminals once the race begins.
That's unexpected.
Jiyan gives a pep talk before the race. You learn that the fastest race record was set by a temporary team a decade ago. You finalize your team name and relay order.
The relay race starts. Lingyan and Ganquan successfully exchange the controller. However, your team lags far behind the other teams.
Be careful of the driftwood. Jump over it.
{PlayerName}, here's the controller. We're counting on you.
The lane is narrowing ahead. Watch out.
Good!
Come on! Come on!
Shhh! Don't disturb {Male=him;Female=her}.
We are in the lead now. Don't worry, keep going.
Takeover...
Eh? Who was that?
Wait, the Gulpuffs don't seem right. Watch out.
{PlayerName}, are you all right?
I'm sorry for what just happened. You almost reached the finish line, and then...
I'm just glad everyone's okay.
{PlayerName}, did you notice anything unusual before?
I think I heard something.
An unfamiliar voice briefly interrupted our team's channel...
Wenshu, let's evacuate the spectators now. Send them back to the city in batches.
I understand, but most of the teams are waiting to start their race, and it's our first Riverside Games in years. Ending it early may spoil their fun.
The voice you mentioned... Could it be our spectators cheering?
I see. I thought the Gulpuffs were just frightened...
There might be an underlying cause of this unusual behavior.
The records will take some more time to download. Evacuate the people first.
I trust your decision, but...
A man somehow ended up riding a Gulpuff when it all happened, and he seemed to really enjoy it. Now, other people are eager to give it a try too...
They all seem super excited... I guess it will take some time to evacuate them.
Get that person to leave first, and the others should follow.
Wenshu, I'm going with you.
Anything I can help you with?
Of course! Rover, you are respected by many. If you're willing to help us calm people down, it will making things easier for sure.
No problem. Let's go.
Thank you.
No.
When {PlayerName} asked me to team up with {Male=him;Female=her}, I heard something similar by the racing lane.
I have requested the monitoring data records of all nearby waterways from the Academy for safety measures.
What happened?
The race is halted due to a disruptive incident. Jiyan points out something strange. But before investigating, you need to evacuate the spectators for their own safety.
This is... the Jinzhou city?
Yes and no. Technically, it's a replica of the city made up of Remnant frequencies.
A replica?
Simply put, it's an illusion made of memories. Scholars would call it a Sonoro Sphere.
The environment here is ever-changing. One misstep and you may fall. Stay close to me.
Are these the spectators we saw earlier?
No. They are memory projections from the previous Riverside Games.
I can't quite describe it, but something feels wrong with them. It's almost as if they are...
...Merely soulless shells.
Let's keep moving.
Come on! Are you seriously expecting teamwork among members of a temporary team?
No wonder they made a mistake. Such a shame.
A temporary team? Are they talking about us?
It's the temporary team from a decade ago.
Are you alright, Jiyan?
I'm fine. It brought back some memories.
According to Mortefi's speculation, this Sonoro Sphere was resonating with the Riverside Games' frequencies, and it led to the abnormal fluctuations we detected earlier.
Hey, look! Isn't that the temporary team? Their last runner is actually catching up!
Really? He... He's in the lead now?!
That kid... I remember he's a new recruit! Impressive!
What are those...
It's the Tacet Discords... Watch out!

You enter the Sonoro Sphere with Jiyan and find illusions discussing the temporary team from ten years ago. Jiyan seems to know the story but chooses to avoid the subject. Then, before you can act, the illusions turn into Tacet Discords and attack.
But why are they reenacting the Riverside Games from a decade ago?
I rarely ever mentioned it, but ten years ago, I was a part of that temporary team. Back then...
So those spectators were Tacet Discords too.
They seem to be playing a game of imitation.
Those are nothing but empty shells, no matter how lifelike they may seem.
All of this... I have a feeling it all ties back to the temporary team.
That sounds familiar.
It's the Knell Square's bell.
Something doesn't feel right...
Don't worry. I'm here with you... We'll go see for ourselves.

Jiyan explains these Tacet Discords are reenacting the Riverside Games from a decade ago and reveals he was a member of that record-breaking team. He believes the anomalies are linked to them. You hear the Knell Square's bell and continue exploring.
Wait, {PlayerName}. Look out the window.
The city's upside down...
So is everything in this place like this?
Are these fallen soldiers manifestations of memories... or the Tacet Discords' imitations?
They're Tacet Discords. Stay close to me.
Damn these monsters! Will they ever stop—
Stay focused. This is not a game.
Watch out... Don't let your guard down...
Help... Help me...
S-stay away from me... Ahhh!
Where on earth are these voices coming from...
A decade ago, shortly after the conclusion of the previous Riverside Games, a sudden TD Outbreak struck the Desorock Highland.
So the voices are from that past battle?
Yes... The Midnight Rangers had to send its latest recruits to the frontline because of the situation's urgency.
In the end, we contained the outbreak at a heavy price...
The battle took countless lives... Our victory was overshadowed by the immeasurable loss.
Your temporary teammates, did they...
And they were not the only ones who lost their lives in the Desorock Highland.
This Sonoro Sphere is probably made up of the <ano=lingering frequencies>Reverberations</ano> they left behind.
How did the TDs acquire their memories?
As Tacet Discords devoured the fallen soldiers' frequencies, they became convinced they were the soldiers they feasted upon... Now, they are just reenacting what happened in "their" memories.
But it seems the remaining frequencies of our soldiers are still resisting.
Yes... The Tacet Discords are merging together. This will endanger more civilian lives if we allow it to occur.
The deceased soldiers led us here to stop them?
It would seem so.
It's the bell. They must be showing the way for us.
Let's go.
They don't want to become one those monsters.

Jiyan speculates that the Sonoro Sphere is composed of the Reverberations of his late comrades who have been trapped here and forced to relive their memories. Their frequencies are stuck in a past battle against the Tacet Discords and they implore you for help. Guided by the bell, you venture further in the Sonoro.
The Tacet Discords should be aware of our presence now. They'll be harder to deal with.
Brace yourself for the fight.
According to what we've learned, this battle happened a decade ago. Why are they only calling out to us now?
I think... It's because of you.
Me? But I didn't even know them.
I was wondering why this year of all times... When the Riverside Games had been held before.
And you are the only variable here.
You invited me to join your temporary team so Ganquan and Lingyan can still participate in the race.
We initially fell behind, but later reclaimed the lead... It's like a deja vu of the race from a decade ago.
And that's what triggered the resonance...
The fallen soldiers... They must have held on to those memories dearly. That's how they resisted merging with the Tacet Discords...
Yes... They have been silently fighting for us all these years, or we would've faced a TD Outbreak...
During that past battle in Desorock Highland, did you...
Yes... We fought together.
They probably didn't want it to happen again. All those deaths and losses...
...And so they called out to us for help.
Let's move on, {PlayerName}.
The bell is right ahead.
Is it... Knell Square ahead?
Are these all Tacet Discords?
...Nonsense!
What on earth are they doing?
They are reenacting our first lesson for new recruits...
During their first lesson, new recruits must pay tribute to fallen soldiers in Knell Square.
We are required to do this before being allowed on the battlefield.
...After the battle in Desorock Highland?
Yes... I didn't attend the memorial that day, but that was when I finally realized...
These monsters will never fathom the weight of their sacrifices.
Jiyan... Let's go bid them farewell one last time.
What is this lesson about?
Its significance eluded most of us during initial training, myself included. Until that day...
Knell Square... It is the place where our career as soldiers begins and ends.

Jiyan is struck by how the Tacet Discords are mimicking the Midnight Rangers' tribute to fallen soldiers, finding it absurd as these monsters shouldn't have been able to understand the ceremony's meaning. As the bell rings again, the Tacet Discords move slowly towards the fog. You and Jiyan are ready to bid them a proper farewell.
Help... Help me...
No... Go away...
...Please... Can't let this one pass... Let's go together...
Sorry... I made a mistake...
...champion...
...We trust you...
Don't worry... We have Jiyan on our side...
He's Jiyan! Of course he can...
The command... Go... There's no time...
We are leaving it to you... Jiyan...
We'll do it together again...
Thank you, {PlayerName}.
Are you all right?
...I'm fine.
The soldiers... Are they gone?
They've been trapped here for ten years, and now finally free. I hope they're in a better place.
What happened here goes far beyond what we know about the Waveworn Phenomena so far...
I've sampled some of the frequencies here with my Terminal. We should deliver the sample to the Academy.
I want to join the race too!
Can I ride that Gulpuff?
The fog is thickening. Stay alert.
Be careful of the Tacet Discords, {PlayerName}.
Let's go.
The bell sounds closer now...
The atmosphere is thick and dangerous...
Let's take down these Murmurins first.
There are too many of them... It's impossible...
The reinforcement is here!
No... No! They're all dead! No one's coming for us!
We're here to help.
This is the remaining memory of the dead. We can't communicate with him.
It seems he's reliving that day on the battlefield.
Yes. Trapped inside his own memories.
What on earth are they thinking? Why are we getting new recruits as reinforcements?
They're just kids. No way we're letting them on the battlefield like this!
Are all of our bases compromised, leaving us with no seasoned soldiers?
Are these the memories from that past battle?
Yes. The Tacet Discords devoured our fallen soldiers' frequencies to gain their memories...
Why were the new recruits sent to the battlefield?
Back then, we suffered simultaneous assaults on our defenses, and we had a critical shortage of troops. The situation was urgent, and we had to deploy our latest recruits as a last resort.
Many of us couldn't make it back...
He does stand out among our new recruits, but he lacks experience on the front line.
And now our captain's asking us to listen to his commands? Can we really trust that kid?
What are his plans for us now? Retreat or stand guard?
We have no choice! Jinzhou needs our protection! We must buy more time for our people... But how do we defend this place, and who's left to do so?
....You know, those who stay may not make it back.
If we must stay to hold the lines, count me in. We can't let those monsters take this place.
But will our new captain make the right call in time?
The new recruit they're talking about...

These are my treasures.
At every performance, the troupe's actors bring out their own brews and sell them to the audience.
When the performance ends, the audience rushes to catch their favorite actors for an autograph. It's all part of the charm!
How about a bottle?
Scrub here... then give a little polish over there...
Wipe this side... wipe that side... Oh? Is there something you need?
About Lario...
What are you up to?
Ah, you've noticed Lario, have you? Ha!
Lario is an important member of the troupe. He carries our stage, and with it, our dreams.
We don't know where he came from or if there's another like him, but we've journeyed across many islands, gathering memories together.
A few days ago, the first mate found a record of a rare Echo called the "Pliosaurus Somnii" in the Montelli library. I wonder if it has anything to do with Lario.
If it's truly the legendary Pliosaurus Somnii... that would be something!
I'm giving Lario a good scrub. See all those barnacles? Still plenty of cleaning to do!
When we first found Lario, he was covered in seaweed and barnacles, roaring in a way that could turn the bravest sailor's knees to jelly.
Captain Brant said everything was fine and went to speak to the creature alone. We were all a bundle of nerves, I'll tell you that much.
When he came back, he told us this big fellow's name was Lario. No harm intended, he said, just thought we "smelled nice" and wanted to be friends.
We didn't understand at first, but now we know Lario can't clean himself at sea, and over time, he gets covered in barnacles. Must be terribly uncomfortable for him.
Lario is an Echo, so nobody knows why barnacles still grow on him. Another mystery, I suppose.
Anyway, whenever we went ashore we gave him a good scrub. That's when we really started to bond. He was so happy he even let us dance on his back!
Now, every time we land in a new city, we give him another good bath. In return, he lets us set up a stage on his back and put on a performance.
Ah, looking back, it's been quite the journey, hasn't it?
Have you finished reading the Order's new play? What do you think?
Same tired themes again. Praising the doctrine, dictating morality... Always painting those sent on the Pilgrim's Sail as the scum of the earth.
Exactly! By the end of it, I almost felt like marching straight back to the city and slapping every one of them, just to show them how ridiculous their little play really is.
If all we're after is revenge, might as well join Aldric and become pirates. Go after Ragunna's merchant ships, raid the Order's Acolytes, take whatever we want.
But that'd make us no better than the heretics they love to write about in their dramas.
There would be no turning back. We'd have no voice left, no way to clear our names or expose Fenrico's lies.
We'd just have to watch everyone we love become tools used by the Order.
...That's not the life I want.
I still want our story to be seen. The real story. Let the world see who we truly are.
Alright then, Mask up. Let's run through another scene.
This Carnevale, we aren't who we used to be in Ragunna—we're the Fools who fight for equality, for freedom. That's who we must become.
I'm done. Inspiration's as elusive as the moon in the sky, and I'm just a headless seaweed adrift in the ocean...
What's wrong?
I'm... I'm the traveler without shoes, stumbling down a path to inspiration that's nothing but thorns... *cough*!
Alright, I'll confess. The truth is I just can't seem to write a thing.
I've got a handful of half-baked manuscripts, but none of them capture the life of the Blessed Maiden.
How did she grow up, and what aspirations did she set for herself? How were her studies in the seminary, and how did she pursue her dreams?
I'm at a loss. I can't even figure out the ending for this script. I talked with the captain about it earlier, and he's just as stumped.
Recently, I received a mysterious package. The captain says it's a private collection from the Fisalia family. No idea who sent it, but they must have had a soft spot for me...
After reading, I felt like I was on the verge of piecing it all together. But inspiration's like a shooting star. Every time I reach for it... poof! It slips through my fingers.
I don't know what to do! Perhaps I am just a seaweed. Brainless, drifting with the tide...
What kind of fireworks display would fit the grand spectacle of Ragunna's Carnevale?
Fireworks shouldn't just light up the night... they need to dazzle in the daylight too!
Golden Fleece, burst forth in colorful flames! Wait, that's strange...
What are you up to?
I'm Kasper, the troupe's Fireworks Master. I'm experimenting with this Golden Fleece, you see.
It comes from the sighs of ancient dragons, the remnants of their flames. It was once used to make gunpowder.
But now, it will be transformed into the finest firework material!
No longer will it bring terror, but joy and laughter instead.
It will explode in the sky, lighting up Ragunna's sky!
But... there's still something missing... What could it be? Let me think a moment.
I've got it! I've got it!
Some Golden Fleece, a touch of unstable glazed young rock, and a feather from Pan Cake! I'll get consent first, I promise!
After that, three happy Nimbus Wraiths. I'll use their laughter to catalyze a rainbow of flame.
Then, the grand finale—Boom! My power will set it all off!
Oh, dear friend! Keep your distance, will you? I wouldn't want to blow you up by accident!
What's going on?
I'm working on a new firework invention... Just about to let out a sneeze!
Sneezing?
Oh? Didn't they tell you? Every time I sneeze, it sets off a little explosion.
Before I close my eyes, wherever my gaze lands, boom! That's where the spark happens.
That's quite a special ability.
Aha! That's why I need to pluck a feather from Pan Cake. You see, just a little tickle on the nose with it, and I'll—
Ahhh—Achooo!
Hold it in!
Whoops! Sorry, almost caused another disaster.
Another disaster?
It's a long story. You see, I was just accompanying my beloved Miranda to the Cathedral of Mercury to pray...
When wouldn't you know it, a pigeon feather landed right on my nose. Just as I was devoutly gazing at the Sentinel's statue, too... and then—sneeze!
So that's why you ended up being...
Exactly. The Acolytes thought I was a heretic trying to deface the statue. Without a second thought, they tossed me onto the Pilgrim's Sail.
I've spent years as a fireworks master in Ragunna without a single soul noticing. But one sneeze, and suddenly, I'm making headlines! Guess I finally got my moment.
You see the scar on my nose? The Acolytes were so afraid I'd sneeze on the Troupe of Fools that they actually clipped my nose before I boarded.
If it weren't for Brant saving me, I'd be breathing through my mouth for the rest of my life!
Speaking of odd things... if you manage to climb up to the Sentinel statue, you might find the little hole I left behind. My sneeze mark.
That's a bit absurd...
Absurd? This is Ragunna! At least I'm still alive to tell the tale.
Since I've been with the Fool's Troupe, business has been booming. Got me a solid group of customers.
When I was a fireworks master in Ragunna, business wasn't nearly this good. Now look at me, practically blowing up the competition! Ha!
Ragunna... the false Righteous One... cloaked in divinity, divinity... hmm...
Father... Mother... It's me, Todd... Did you like my performance...?
Don't cry... I'm here... I'm home...
I get what you're saying... but I want a No. 65 Tubpup with Nuvola Pasta...
It's so deep... It's all Troupe Strength in the Tubpup... I can't drink anymore...
Too much Tubpup... bad for your health...
I love you... but I can only see you in my dreams...
Look at our daughter... how adorable she is... Marina...
Can I see her one last time, please... Why... Why can't I see her face clearly...
Marina... Marina...?
Can't sleep either?
What's keeping you up?
As you can see, it's only when I'm fully awake that I can "craft" their dreams.
What kind of dreams do you craft?
Hmm… it varies, really. Most of the time, I create beautiful visions to heal the regrets that weigh on their hearts.
But, from what I've seen, the fear of "boarding the Fool's Sail" appears to be so deeply rooted that the dreams don't always turn out as they hoped.
What are their regrets?
Todd, hailing from an underground theater troupe, was banished merely for using comedy to satirize the Order's tax policies...
Gideon's family was framed by the Acolytes. At his lowest, he could only find solace with a Tubpup. It became his shelter, his only home in the storm.
Knox was sent aboard the Fool's Sail before his newborn child even had a chance to open their eyes. And as kin of a "heretic," the future doesn't look kind.
So that's how it is...
During this Carnevale, we all have to hide our identities and take on roles in the Fool's Troupe as we return to Ragunna City, after so long.
We must suppress our desire to reconnect with old friends while trying to complete the Montelli family's mission. It's... complicated. So insomnia, I suppose, is inevitable.
That's why I need to create dreams for them, to help them get some rest.
Why do you hide your true identities?
Well, the Order doesn't know... but most of the Fool's Troupe are survivors from the Pilgrim's Sail.
The moment the Order uncovers the truth, our Fool's Elysium will burn to the ground. We have to keep our silence, no matter the cost.
In our plays, we sing to condemn the oppression, to shed light on the bloodshed… One day, all of Rinascita will know what Fenrico has done.
Take a break when you feel ready.
Thank you… for taking the time to understand us, for wanting to know the Fools' story.
Who... who are you? How did you suddenly appear at sea? Why are you rescuing us?
I just want to return to Ragunna City… My belongings are still there, left behind in the rush.
Fede... we can't go back.
I understand your panic, Mr. Fede. But remember this—
In the eyes of The Order, a pilgrimage is no different from an execution...
(Narrator: A mere infatuation is far from enough. What Chappell, now fallen to mortality, needs is a heart consumed by desire. Without it, anyone's love is nothing but a delusion!)
(Narrator: The doctrines that sever human desires and the silence, the tasteless laws and divine meals, now only provoke her instinctive revulsion—)
I don't need a sermon, Acolyte Bugatti. Either shut up or join me in enjoying this delicious Golden Crab Pie.
Don't look at me like that, Bugatti. I'm not the Acolyte you once knew.
Call me Chappell... My name is Chappell Romanya, Lord Bugatti.
Hmm… These botched recreations. But I guess I'll have to finish them off anyway.
The taste and presentation might be lacking, but it's still edible!
Oh my! This one is... Poached Egg with Slug Relish, from "The Merchant of Ragunna."
Seems the slug meat got overcooked. No wonder Gisle's jaw started twitching halfway through his lines...
And here we have the Layered Yak Short Rib Bake... Must be the family feast main course from Act 3, Scene 6 of "The Lady of Camellya."
Ugh, this yak meat is far too fatty. No wonder Heather's aria sounded like it was dripping in butter...
Hello there, {PlayerName}! I'm testing out some new recipes, but I won't invite you to sample them just yet.
All these dishes are...
Yes, inspired by the plays, you see. Though recreating them has proven to be a bit more troublesome than I anticipated.
Golden Crab Pie is one of my few triumphant creations!
I'm Rossini. I didn't get the chance to introduce myself during today's rehearsal. I used to work in the kitchens of the Order of the Deep, preparing meals for the council members.
Why did the Order exile you?
I merely enhanced the council's meals—naturally, in the best way possible.
The head chef accused me of using sinister methods to incite the Acolytes' appetites, corrupting their piety and undermining the Order.
Heretic, he called me...  a laughable but effective accusation.
I suspect we'll head for Lilyland next.
I'd wager that Septimont is more likely.
What are you doing?
We're debating our next destination. We're still on a Pan-Ragunna Tour, after all.
The Captain often says, "Wherever the applause calls, there we'll go to 'capture laughter.' With our craft, our wit, and a touch of our own flair, we'll claim what's rightfully ours."
True enough. But each island has its own tastes when it comes to theater. We'll need to tailor our efforts to make sure everyone feels the journey was worthwhile!
But, whether we head to the Lilyland's Sea of Flowers or the exhilarating spectacles of Septimont, it's up to the captain to decide!
Focus, Doggins.
Look at me! I'm your audience. Break the fourth wall with your gaze!
Madame Nyarla has thrown us another curveball...
The imaginative design of this stage truly aligns with Madame Nyarla's signature style—"a labyrinth of opulent, fevered dreams."
But why do I feel like this "fevered and opulent dream" has left me standed outside the gates?
This new brew's potency should carry us through the entire Carnevale.
If Brant manages to snag the Laurel this year, you can bet Troupe Strength will sell like hotcakes. Heh, heh, heh...
This... this... is yet another baseless slander!
If this religious play actually gets performed, how will my wife and daughter see me? How will the rest of the town see them?
How are they supposed to live in Ragunna after this? Damn it!
Is there really no hope? If we head to Lilyland or Septimont... surely there's somewhere that will take us in...
I... I don't know...
Wake up, Fede. No city-state will take in outcasts without identity, unable to prove their very existence. We've lost our status as citizens of Ragunna.
Even our papers... they've turned to nothing but scraps of useless parchment.
Is there really no one who'll take us in? I still have a few friends... I...
Your friends? Do you truly think they'd welcome "heretics" like us?
What would you have me do, Chantelle? The Order's just left us to die out here, haven't they? How could they do this to us...?
Mr. Federico, please... stay calm. You can stay here while you plan your next steps.
Thank you so much Ahem... Fid?
Y-yes, thank you. I... we don't know how to thank you enough...
Oh, dearest Elisha... what shall our next ballet be?
Who are you talking to?
Ah, {PlayerName}, is that you? I was just asking Elisha what our next performance should be...
See, each island nation has its own preferences, you know.

Take Septimont, for example. They favor plays like "The Three Hundred Knights of Capitoline" and "Assassin's Journey"—you know, action-packed, filled with historical sagas and war. That's their thing.
I like them too, but Elisha doesn't share my enthusiasm.
She prefers heart-wrenching tragedies like "The Shape of the Ocean" or "The Perished Waterworld." You know, those tear-jerking stories that only the Riccioli people seem to appreciate...
But I can't stand that place. And let's be honest, tragedy is not in my wheelhouse. Ugh... it's so frustrating, Elisha, my dear Elisha...
Hey! Want to try my first latest dish?
Your first dish?
Your latest dish?
Ah, yes! This is inspired by a performance I saw. A true Rinascita culinary creation, born from the stage!
Place a Goldcrest Scarab into a pie, baked with Mastic Nuvola and Viscum Berry... then nestle it in a Bell Crab shell, arranging it just so, to mimic the playful movements of the scarab...
Goldcrest Scarab?
Bell Crab's shell?
Yes, exactly! Isn't it fascinating? To help the actors truly feel their roles, I've gone all in to recreate these legendary dishes!
So, what do you think? Want to try this dish—the one that brings "Chappell Romanya" back to the mortal realm, but leaves "Acolyte Bugatti" with a most perplexed expression?
Sure!
Maybe not...
No, no, no! No way! There's just no way!! You eat it, I'm not eating it!
Scared you enough to jolt you awake?
Hey! Are you sure you don't want to give it a try? I can guarantee this dish has a flavor like no other!
What should I do, Mama Jemma? I can't go anywhere, and I can't sing...
It's alright, I can't sing either, and I'm doing just fine here, aren't I?
Come on, let me show you around. Let's see what you might be able to do.
Hello there! Need some help?
What are you doing?
Jemma is comforting those recently exiled by the Order. I'll see if there's anything I can do to help.
The captain said if they're headed to the Riccioli Islands or Septimont, we should arrange for Echoes to help them avoid dragons and safely get to where they want to go.
Everyone's got their own path to walk, after all. Not everyone's going to stay here.

In the past, some have sought refuge with their families in the Riccioli Islands, while others ventured to Septimont, trading honor for a new identity, all holding onto the hope of one day returning to Ragunna.
And then there are those who turned to piracy. That's not really our way.
But that's fine, everyone's choices take them down different roads. Let's just help each other while we can!
One-two-three, perfect!
Woohoo! Yay!
What are you doing?
We're rehearsing. This is Doggins, the main character of our play!
An Echo as the main character?
Ha! Don't underestimate our Doggins. This kid is sharp as a tack!
He sneaked aboard the Pilgrim's Sail, searching for his exiled friends, and ended up here.
But the friends he was looking for... they're not here. They went somewhere else.
Still, our little Doggins didn't give up. He decided to stay with us and join the tour across Rinascita!
This play we're rehearsing is all about Doggin's own journey. I'm sure if his friends see it, they'll come looking for him.
Woohoo! Yay!
