When a Tacet Discord is defeated, the remaining frequency may become an <color=#ffd12f>Echo</color>. You can obtain <color=#ffd12f>Data Bank</color> EXP by absorbing an Echo for the first time. Level up Data Bank to raise the probability of Echo drop.
Damaging or defeating enemies grants <color=#ffd12f>Resonance Energy</color>. When Resonance Energy is full, the powerful <color=#ffd12f>Resonance Liberation</color> becomes available.

After a <color=#ffd12f>Resonance Beacon</color> is activated, you can open the Map and <color=#ffd12f>fast travel</color> to an activated Resonance Beacon.
Head to a Resonance Nexus to <color=#ffd12f>heal</color> injured or downed Resonators.
The <color=#ffd12f>Resonance Nexus</color> stores information on the surrounding area. Activate it to obtain the corresponding <color=#ffd12f>Map</color> data.
Head to a Resonance Nexus to <color=#ffd12f>heal</color> injured or downed Resonators.

When the enemy is about to use certain moves, a <color=#ffd12f>Weakness Halo</color> will appear. Attack in time to trigger a <color=#ffd12f>Counterattack</color> to block the incoming attack and gain an upper hand.

Perform Dodge at the right moment to avoid enemy attacks. A successful <color=#ffd12f>Dodge</color> grants <color=#ffd12f>damage immunity</color> for a limited amount of time, allowing you to perform <color=#ffd12f>Dodge Counter</color> in your next Basic Attack.

Deal damage to reduce enemy <color=#ffd12f>Vibration Strength</color>. <color=#ffd12f>Counterattack</color> greatly reduces enemy Vibration Strength. When the Vibration Strength is fully depleted, the enemy is <color=#ffd12f>Immobilized</color> and cannot take any action for a period of time.

When some enemies are <color=#b49f50>Immobilized</color>, you can use <color=#b49f50>Finishing Attack</color> to deal great damage to them. After taking the Finishing Attack, they will recover from Immobolized.
The <color=#ffd12f>Grapple module</color> can help to overcome complex terrain. When it is used directly, the operator can <color=#ffd12f>leap</color> a short distance upwards.
There are <color=#ffd12f>Grapple Points</color> in overworld, and you can make a long-distance leap by aiming your Grapple at them.
The <color=#ffd12f>Sensor</color> module in the Utility helps reveal valuable content in the scene, such as <color=#ffd12f>collectibles</color>, <color=#ffd12f>enemy weaknesses</color>, etc.

Resonators gain <color=#ffd12f>Concerto Energy</color> when dealing damage or performing Dodges in combat.
When Concerto Energy is full, the other Resonators' icons will glow up.

By reaching a higher <color=#ffd12f>SOL3 Phase</color>, you will have the opportunity to gain more <color=#ffd12f>rewards</color> after defeating enemies or clearing Sonoro Spheres. However, be warned that the enemies you encounter will also be more <color=#ffd12f>dangerous</color>, and vice versa.
After clearing Tacet Fields, you can consume Waveplates to obtain various Echo development materials and the <color=#ffd12f>collected Echoes</color> of the corresponding Sonata set.
Tacet Fields will revive periodically, so you can challenge them repeatedly for materials. It should be noted that you need to consume the Waveplates to obtain the materials.

A Simulation Training Ground located in Jinzhou. Complete the trials to obtain necessary materials for Resonator upgrade and development. Increase <color=#ffd12f>SOL3 Phase</color> to unlock more rewarding trials.

The product of a collapsed Sonoro Sphere, scattered all over the world. It records the untwisted memories of the past. If you are lucky enough to discover one, the <color=#ffd12f>Relic Merchants</color> will gladly exchange valuable items for it.
The Mutterfly swarm will move to the next location when you approach. Follow them to find out more content to explore.
The Mutterfly swarm will move to the next location when you approach. Follow them to find out more content to explore.
A common general-purpose training mechanism. Find and hit all the mechanisms to complete the training.
A common intelligent training target. Different targets have different <color=#ffd12f>training rules</color>. After activation, drones will be released. Hit all the drones to complete the training.
The <color=#ffd12f>Propulsion Flux</color> is a gravitational anomaly in the overworld. <color=#ffd12f>Use the Glider</color> in it to <color=#ffd12f>lift</color> the Resonator.

Accumulate <color=#ffd12f>Union EXP</color> to increase <color=#ffd12f>Union Level</color> and unlock more quests and activities.
You can quickly obtain Union EXP through the following ways: 
I. Complete the <color=#ffd12f>Daily Activity</color> quests.
II. <color=#ffd12f>Consume Waveplates</color>.
III. <color=#ffd12f>Complete various quests</color>.
IV. <color=#ffd12f>Open Supply Chests</color> and complete gameplay activities in the overworld.
Absorb Echoes to increase Data Bank level. The higher the level, the higher the <color=#ffd12f>Drop Rate</color> of Echoes and the higher the <color=#ffd12f>max absorbable Rarity</color> of Echoes.
Some special frequencies will form visible Acoustic Prints. Follow the Acoustic Prints and find the source of the sounds.
Select and use the Zoom Camera via the wheel to locate targets.
The requirements of the photo are shown on the left. When met, they turn green. Tap the camera icon on the right to shoot.
Once you've taken the photo, if a "Goal Completed" pop-up appears at the top, tap the upper-right corner to exit.

The <color=#ffd12f>Tacetite Fulminate</color> emits a golden light, with unstable energy contained within it.
After Utility is unlocked, you can use the <color=#ffd12f>Levitator</color> to grab it.

After grabbing <color=#ffd12f>Tacetite Fulminate</color>, you can either throw it <color=#ffd12f>directly</color> at the target or use <color=#ffd12f>Aim</color> to <color=#ffd12f>precisely control</color> where it lands. Once thrown, the Tacetite Fulminate will trigger a violent explosion.
An operation platform developed by Huaxu Academy and available to Resonators. Use it to synthesize Potions, craft objects, and purify advanced materials.
Deal damage to reduce the enemy's Vibration Strength. When Vibration Strength drops to 0, the enemy is <color=#8c7e51>Immobilized</color>.

Resonators gain Concerto Energy when dealing damage or performing Dodges in combat. Switch Resonators when the Concerto Energy is full to consume all Concerto Energy and trigger the exiting Resonator's Outro Skill, and at the same time trigger the incoming Resonator's Intro Skill.
Use <color=#ffd12f>Counterattacks</color> and <color=#ffd12f>Dodge Counters</color> to interrupt enemy actions.

Most of your enemy's moves can be blocked with <color=#ffd12f>Counterattacks</color>. Frequently use Counterattacks to reduce the enemy's Vibration Strength and put it into an <color=#ffd12f>Immobilized</color> state.

When the Impermanence Heron raises its wings to protect its head, it will enter a defensive state. Use the Intro Skill to reduce its Vibration Strength, putting it in an <color=#ffd12f>Immobilized</color> state.
When Inferno Rider casts its charge, you can use the <color=#ffd12f>special Echo</color> to defend. Successful defense will put it in a <color=#ffd12f>Immobilized</color> state.
You can avoid ground shock attacks by getting to a higher ground.

When Lampylumen Myriad is in the air, you can attack the <color=#ffd12f>Ice Chrysalises</color> on the ground to shoot it down. Your <color=#ffd12f>Freeze Meter</color> will grow as you are exposed to the attacks of Lampylumen Myriad, the attacks of the Ice Chrysalises, and the fog on the ground. When your Freeze Meter is filled, you will be <color=#ffd12f>Frozen</color>.
The grab attacks deal massive damage. Use <color=#ffd12f>Counterattacks</color> to block the grab attacks.
After taking a certain amount of damage, Mech Abomination shapeshifts and releases a powerful attack.

<color=#ffd12f>Destroy the legs, head, and the ancient bell</color> to greatly deplete its Vibration Strength. Using <color=#ffd12f>Counterattacks</color> against the giant ice balls will also greatly deplete its Vibration Strength, <color=#ffd12f>but it's not an easy task to achieve</color>.

After absorbing the <color=#ffd12f>Prisms</color> of different attributes, the Heron will <color=#ffd12f>recover all its HP</color> and enter the <color=#ffd12f>enpowered state</color> of the corresponding attribute. The enhanced Heron will launch fiercer attacks.

After absorbing the <color=#ffd12f>Prisms</color> of different attributes, the Heron will <color=#ffd12f>recover all its HP</color> and enter the <color=#ffd12f>enpowered state</color> of the corresponding attribute. The enhanced Heron will launch fiercer attacks.

After entering the berserk state, it will gain a shield and <color=#ffd12f>great DMG Reduction</color>. When the <color=#ffd12f>shield</color> is destroyed, its Vibration Strength will be greatly depleted.
When the Roseshroom enters the charging state, target the <color=#ffd12f>core at its head</color> with <color=#ffd12f>Pistols</color> to greatly deplete its Vibration Strength.
The Hoochief Cyclone can generate a wind field to restrict the movement of Resonators.
The Autopuppet Scout can generate an ice wall to block ranged attacks from Resonators.

The Fusion Prism is immune to <color=#ffd12f>Fusion</color> DMG. It provides a buff for surrounding enemies, which greatly increases the damage they deal.
The Fusion Prism can be absorbed by Cyan-Feathered Herons and Violet-Feathered Herons, providing a permanent damage bonus for the Herons after absorption.

The Glacio Prism is immune to <color=#ffd12f>Glacio</color> DMG. It provides a buff for surrounding enemies, which grant them Super Armor (their moves won't be interrupted when hit).
The Glacio Prism can be absorbed by Cyan-Feathered Herons and Violet-Feathered Herons, providing a permanent Super Armor state for the Herons after absorption.

The Spectro Prism is immune to <color=#ffd12f>Spectro</color> DMG. It provides a buff for surrounding enemies, which periodically grants them a shield.
The Spectro Prism can be absorbed by Cyan-Feathered Herons and Violet-Feathered Herons, providing a permanent shield for the Herons after absorption.

The Havoc Prism is immune to <color=#ffd12f>Havoc</color> DMG. It provides a buff for surrounding enemies, which allows them to deplete Resonators' Resonance Energy with their attacks.
The Havoc Prism can be absorbed by Cyan-Feathered Herons and Violet-Feathered Herons, providing a permanent Energy Depletion effect for the Herons after absorption.
When an Excarat burrows underground, you can use <color=#ffd12f>Plunging Attacks</color> to force it to surface.
The Traffic Illuminator can put Resonators in a <color=#ffd12f>stagnant</color> state.
Resonators' attacks can reflect the halbard illusions and light arcs from the Lioness of Glory back at it to deal damage to the Lioness of Glory.
When Kerasaur recovers from being Immobilized, it will be highly resistant to whichever Attribute DMG it took the most before this Immobilization.
When the Pilgrim's Shell is Immobilized. Use <color=#ffd12f>Hero's Slash</color> to instantly defeat it.

Gladiators will summon Echoes to aid them at the start of the fight.
When a Gladiator is defeated, so too is their Echo.

When Cartethyia casts <color=#ffd12f>Resonance Skill, Heavy Attack, or the final stage of a Basic Attack</color>, she will summon Sword of Virtue's Shadow, Sword of Discord's Shadow, and Sword of Divinity's Shadow.

Cartethyia can recall these three Sword Shadows when performing a <color=#ffd12f>Plunging Attack</color> to increase the DMG dealt by this attack. 

Recalling the Sword Shadows also grants the corresponding <color=Highlight>Heart of Virtue</color>, <color=Highlight>Power of Discord</color>, and <color=Highlight>Mandate of Divinity</color>, which enhance Cartethyia when she turns into Fleurdelys.

Upon casting Resonance Liberation, Cartethyia turns into Fleurdelys and unlocks new moves.

Fleurdelys's attacks restore Conviction. When Conviction is full, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Liberation again to cast Blade of Howling Squall, dealing massive DMG.
Upon reaching certain Union Levels, you need to complete <color=#ffd12f>SOL3 Phase Ascension Quests</color> to lift the <color=#ffd12f>Union Level cap</color>.
View Echo details at Echo Collection or Echo Overview.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Click Gamepad=Press} button with an icon of magnifying glass at the bottom left of the card to see its details. Spend Prestige Points there to unlock it.

Through dueling, you gain Duel Resonance, which increases your Duelist Level and grants abundant rewards. There is a weekly cap on the amount of Duel Resonance that you can obtain.

Your dueling skill is represented by Fame Flags. Each victory grants you Fame Flags. There is no limit to the amount you can obtain.
Once you become the "Apex Duelist," Endless Challenges become available where you are free to challenge any duelist in Septimont. Show them what it means to be the best!

After interacting with Corroders nearby, the <color=#ffd12f>Corroders</color> will temporarily <color=#ffd12f>follow</color> you.
Bring them <color=#ffd12f>close to Spikes</color>, and they will dissolve the golden pillar to the side, eventually dissolving the Spikes.

In the wild, where Tacetite clusters develop freely, sometimes <color=#ffd12f>Spikes</color> can be found blocking the path or <color=#ffd12f>sealing off</color> items or puzzles.
Look closely around the Spikes for <color=#ffd12f>Corroders</color>. They will dissolve the Spikes.
Induction Cells of different colors have to be placed into the corresponding colored Induction Cell Sockets to activate the puzzles.

Use <color=#ffd12f>Levitator</color> to put the <color=#ffd12f>Induction Cells</color> into the Induction Cell Socket to turn on or off the mechanical device.
Induction Cells of different colors have to be placed into the <color=#ffd12f>Induction Cell Sockets of corresponding colors</color> to activate the puzzles, or the Induction Cells will be popped.

Use Levitator to put the <color=#ffd12f>Induction Cells</color> into the <color=#ffd12f>Induction Cell Changer</color> to change the operating mode of the Induction Cell, and <color=#ffd12f>change</color> the current <color=#ffd12f>color</color> of the Induction Cell.
<color=#ffd12f>Fragile rocks</color> can be destroyed by means like Basic Attacks. You might find good things inside.
Touch the <color=#ffd12f>signs</color> to restore a certain amount of <color=#ffd12f>STA</color>.
After activation, it will summon enemies in the form of a projection. <color=#ffd12f>Defeat</color> all <color=#ffd12f>enemies</color> to complete the challenge and receive rewards.

<color=#ffd12f>Defeat</color> the nearby <color=#ffd12f>Tacet Discords</color> to ensure the successful activation of the <color=#ffd12f>Sound Emulator</color>. Complete the challenge to receive rewards.
After activation, <color=#ffd12f>reach the finish line</color> or <color=#ffd12f>collect a certain amount of Target Points</color> within the specified time to claim the corresponding rewards.
When a Resonator is on the <color=#ffd12f>Module: Slow</color>, STA consumed will increase and their <color=#ffd12f>Movement Speed will be reduced</color>.
When a Resonator is on the <color=#ffd12f>Module: Speed</color>, they will be <color=#ffd12f>launched</color> in the direction of the arrow.
When a Resonator jumps onto the <color=#ffd12f>Module: Jump</color>, they will be <color=#ffd12f>bounced</color> upward.
After interacting with the Signals Console, you will start the <color=#ffd12f>Decryption</color>. The Signals Hub will only be unlocked after all Signals Consoles are decrypted.

When the <color=#ffd12f>Signals Hub</color> is locked, you can use the <color=#ffd12f>Sensor</color> to locate the <color=#ffd12f>Signals Consoles</color> that are connected to the Signals Hub but hidden in a different location.

The Weight Block is placed near the Pressure Table. After the Utility is unlocked, you can use <color=#ffd12f>Levitator</color> to grab the <color=#ffd12f>Weight Block</color> and place it at the intended <color=#ffd12f>landing</color> spot.
When the Weight Block is placed on the <color=#ffd12f>Pressure Table</color>, it will <color=#ffd12f>stick</color> to it.

You need to <color=#ffd12f>place an object</color> on the <color=#ffd12f>Pressure Table</color> to <color=#ffd12f>activate</color> it.
When there is <color=#ffd12f>no object placed</color> on the Pressure Table, the item(s) controlled by it will be <color=#ffd12f>locked</color>.

The Weight Block is located near the Pressure Platform. Use the Levitator to grab the Weight Block, and then use the Levitator again to position it at the intended landing spot.
Unlock the Utility to access this feature.

After Utility is unlocked, you can use the <color=#ffd12f>Levitator</color>
to place the scattered <color=#ffd12f>Components back to the Matrix</color>.
While using Levitator, you can <color=#ffd12f>rotate</color> to adjust the direction of the Components.

The <color=#ffd12f>Key Repeaters</color> emit the Decryption Pulses in different directions. After the Utility is unlocked, you can use the <color=#ffd12f>Levitator</color> to place the Key Repeaters on the Encryption Blocks. While using the Levitator, you can <color=#ffd12f>rotate</color> to adjust the direction in which the Decryption Pulse is emitted.

Use the <color=#ffd12f>Grapple Shooter</color> to launch temporary <color=#ffd12f>Grapple Points</color>, facilitating swift movement of the Resonators.
Unlock the Utility to play this.
When a Resonator jumps onto the <color=#ffd12f>Flobble</color>, they will be <color=#ffd12f>bounced</color> upward.

The <color=#ffd12f>Explosive Charge</color> triggers a violent <color=#ffd12f>explosion</color> if stimulated.
After the Utility is unlocked, you can use the <color=#ffd12f>Levitator</color> to grab the Explosive Charge on branches.

After grabbing an Explosive Charge, you can throw it to a distance to trigger an explosion. By <color=#ffd12f>Aiming</color>, you can <color=#ffd12f>precisely control</color> its landing spot.
Explosive Charges scattered on the ground cannot be controlled with Levitator, but you can <color=#ffd12f>attack</color> them directly to trigger an <color=#ffd12f>explosion</color>.

Following the instruction on the track, <color=#ffd12f>attack the Magnetic Cube</color> to move it along the specified direction. When Magnetic Cubes <color=#ffd12f>reach</color> specified <color=#ffd12f>Magnetic Conveyors</color>, the challenge is completed.

Transform into <color=#ffd12f>Cruisewing</color> to take on a flying challenge and collect as many Coins as possible within a specified time to earn points.
The higher your points, the better rewards you can unlock.
During the flight, <color=#ffd12f>rotate your view</color> to change your route. Hold the Accelerate button to <color=#ffd12f>speed up</color>, and hold the Decelerate button to <color=#ffd12f>slow down</color>.

These mysterious Tacet Discords are scattered across the world, holding a special interest in human items. Unexpected rewards often await where they linger.
<color=#ffd12f>Blobflies</color> follow a <color=#ffd12f>fixed route</color>. If they fly too high, try shooting it down using <color=#ffd12f>ranged attacks</color>.
After gliding through the <color=#ffd12f>Gravitation Vortex Ring</color>, you will be granted <color=#ffd12f>acceleration</color> in the specified direction.
Use Lingyang's Plunging Attacks to destroy the obstacles or avoid them along the path to your destination.

After interacting with the puppet mechanism, you will enter the <color=#ffd12f>Puppet Control</color> state.
In this state, you can leave the puppet where it is <color=#ffd12f>whenever necessary</color> and <color=#ffd12f>switch back</color> to control your Resonator.
Utilize the puppet to access places beyond your reach and deactivate the laser mechanisms obstructing your way.
Interact with the special mechanisms to rotate and shift the scene.
Use <color=#ffd12f>Plunging Attacks</color> to hit the mechanism on the ground to match the random patterns with the <color=#ffd12f>Target Patterns</color>.
Use the <color=#ffd12f>Spinning</color> Device to <color=#ffd12f>connect pathways</color> and complete the information transmission.
There are multiple groups of strings of the same color on the Terminal panel. Ensure that there are no overlappings between the lines connecting them.

The areas contaminated by toxic spores are highly dangerous. Prolonged exposure may cause limited visibility and difficulty in breathing. If you encounter such areas during exploration, please <color=#ffd12f>leave</color> the contaminated areas as soon as possible.
After the challenge starts, use the <color=#ffd12f>Explosive Charges</color> and other means reasonably to <color=#ffd12f>hit</color> as many <color=#ffd12f>targets</color> as possible.

After the challenge starts, reach the finish line within the specified time while collecting as many Hologram Tokens as possible. Upon reaching the finish line, challenge points will be calculated based on the number of Hologram Tokens collected. Reach higher points for better rewards!
The Overdash Club has set up various modules in the tracks. You can utilize them strategically to reach the finish line faster, but be sure to avoid the traps at the same time.
The Overdash Club has set up various tracks for the challenge. You can choose any one of the unlocked tracks for your challenge.
Connect the strings of the same color on the Terminal panel to complete decoding.

When in the Challenge Zone, your <color=#ffd12f>Glory Level</color> is shown on the top left corner of the screen.

Search for and defeat Tacet Discords or occupy Banners of Conquest to gain Hunt Points. Hunt Points are used to increase Glory Level and acquire buffs.

The difficulty of the challenges will decrease as the Glory Level gap between you and the enemy narrows.

The competition does not end when you're downed in the Challenge Zone, but your Glory Level will decrease to the number of your <color=#ffd12f>Trial Level</color>. However, you will gain a Hunt Points bonus, which remains in effect until your Glory Level recovers to the highest level you've ever achieved. Please take note of this when fighting tough opponents.

You can gain Trial Points by occupying Banners of Conquest. Trial Points will increase your Trial Level, which will only be effective in this competition and does not reset when you are downed.

Areas of greater danger house Tacet Discords of greater Glory Levels. It might be wise to obtain Buffs by raising your Glory Level first before facing Tacet Discords of a higher Glory Level.

There are five areas in the Old District. Each area contains a special Tacet Discord that has the highest Glory Level of that area. Defeat them to obtain <color=#ffd12f>abundant rewards</color>.

Draining of floodwaters in the Old District has revealed a large number of Tacet Discords. The Gladiators of Septimont have now launched a competition to hunt them.

Defeating Tacet Discords in the Challenge Zone and occupying Banners of Conquest will increase your Glory Level, granting you <color=#ffd12f>powerful buffs</color>.  Make good use of these buffs to claim victory and glory in the challenge!

Banners of Conquest can be found in the Challenge Zone.

Interacting with the ones marked by a yellow light grants you Hunt Points and Trial Points.

Interacting with the ones marked by a blue light grants you Buffs.

Some Banners of Conquest in the Challenge Zone have been overrun by Tacet Discords. Defeat them and occupy the Banners of Conquest to gain Hunt Points and Trial Points. Trial Points increase your Trial Level. Defeating the Tacet Discords will occupy the Banner. Once occupied, the Banner of Conquest will no longer be interactable.

Counterattacks, Dodge Counters, and Attacks in combat grant <color=#ffd12f>Battle Engagement Points</color>, which can <color=#ffd12f>temporarily raise Glory Levels</color> by 100 levels as Hunt Points do.

Upon taking damage, only Glory Levels added by Battle Engagement Points will be lowered. But not the Glory Levels provided by Hunt Points.

The Glory Levels added by Battle Engagement Points will rapidly decrease when out of combat.

These Dreamscape Tacet Discords have been affected by Contagion and are much tougher than their regular counterparts. You must find their weaknesses to defeat them. Completing Challenge Goals or casting Special Moves grants powerful buffs against the Tacet Discords in Dreamscape Contagion.
Septimont's Dreamscape Nodes gather various dream frequencies, each presenting unique challenges based on the dreams and emotions they contain.
Counterattack can Immobilize Kerasaur. When a Kerasaur is Immobilized the second time, its ATK and RES will be reduced.
Dodge the Drakes' attacks several times to decrease their RES. Defeating one Drake in the group makes them unable to coordinate their attacks.
Continuously attack a Gladiator with a raised shield to break their defenses and instantly defeat them. Doing so also decreases the RES of other Gladiators.
Dodge Counter greatly reduces the Vibration Strength of Pilgrim's Shell. Attacking an Immobilized Pilgrim's Shell deals Electro DMG to targets within a certain range.
After taking the gladiator spear, follow the interaction prompt to throw the spear and destroy the Tidal Blight on the giant statue.
Find the Patrol Units and help them reach the platform so they may activate it to get you the gladiator spears.
The Hero's Legacy Armor will unlock the <color=#ffd12f>Hero's Slash</color> Skill in certain scenarios when the enemy is in a certain state. Use this Skill to instantly defeat or weaken the enemies.

Aim at the mechanism, then press the highlighted button to don the Hero's Legacy Armor and gain the <color=#ffd12f>Hero's Slash</color> Skill. Aim and {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} the corresponding button to slash.
Hold the Skill button and release once Rend is fully charged to cast the skill, destroying all destructible objects nearby.

Gather three Recollections of Heroes to charge the Hero's Legacy Armor. When the armor is charged, aim at the mechanism and {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} the highlighted button to don the Hero's Legacy Armor and access a powerful <color=#ffd12f>Hero's Rend</color> Skill.
Some stubborn Bitter Resentments can only be cleared by using <color=#ffd12f>Hero's Rend</color>.

Frequencies of bitter resentment are flowing in these strange threads...
When Bitter Resentment is shelled up, use <color=#ffd12f>Hero's Slash</color> to eliminate them.
Try switching rails to collect more energy and obtain more points.
You can jump to the rails on the left or right.
Some Tactical Hologram: Vitreum Dancers have a slowing debuff. During the Hologram challenge, zones that greatly slow you down will appear.
Use <color=#ffd12f>Hero's Slash</color> to destroy more Aftertune Figments in a short time. Slash Vibration Figments to release a blast of energy to destroy multiple Figments nearby at the same time.
Destroying Cacophany Figments lowers your points. Try to avoid them.
Touch Ta-da's Protection and then use Dash to enter the Speed Hooray mode, dashing forward and running much faster.

If your Glory Level is below the recommended level for the next Banner, you may raise your Glory Level by <color=#ffd12f>activating Banners of Conquest, exploring the current area, or defeating TDs</color>.

{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Click Gamepad=Press} Echoes in the list on the left to add them to your deck.
Each deck can contain Echoes of up to 2 Attributes. To change Attributes, remove Echoes with the Attribute you are replacing from the deck first.

A deck is comprised of 21 Echoes, one of which must be a Core Echo and the remainder, Normal Echoes. The number of Echoes in a deck is subject to an upper limit and a minimum requirement that must be met to proceed with the duel. 

Echoes have different Skills. Some Skills complement or boost other Skills. Please keep this in mind when building your deck.
An error occurred. Please contact our Customer Service for assistance

Drag Echoes from your hand into the Deployment Zone to Deploy them.
The left side is the Frontline, and the right side is the Backline. Position your Echoes strategically according to their attack range.

Drag Echoes from your hand or the Deployment Zone to the Reconstruction Area on the right to Reconstruct them.
Reconstructing the Echo shuffles it back into the card stash and restores 1 Energy. You may draw the Reconstruted Echo again in later rounds.

Each Echo has four basic stats.

Strength (STR): Affects the DMG dealt during the Battle Stage.
Constitution (CON): Represents the Echo's ability to withstand DMG.
Energy Cost (Cost): Represents the Energy required to Deploy or Modulate this Echo.
Damage (DMG): At the end of each Battle Stage, surviving Echoes deal DMG to the opponent equal to this value.

Generally, higher values indicate more powerful stats.

The Deployed Echoes surviving the Battle Stage will deal damage to the opponent equal to the sum of all of their <color=#ffd12f>DMG</color>. Certain Echo Skills may also affect the DMG dealt by the Echoes.

Each duel lasts a maximum of 8 rounds. After the 8th Round. The duelist with more HP wins.
Using Transform may sometimes consume or refund additional Energy. The exact amount depends on the skill's effect.
Echoes with Transform in the Deployment Zone can also be dragged directly to the Transform Area to activate it. Echoes used this way will also be consumed.

Some Echoes possess the special <color=#ffd12f>Transform</color> Skill.
Drag an Echo with <color=#ffd12f>Transform</color> Skill to the Transform Area to activate it. However, this Echo will be consumed, and you won't be able to draw it again for the rest of the duel.

Echo A will replace Echo B in the Deployment Zone upon Modulation, inheriting Echo B's DMG (the inherited DMG will add to Echo A's original DMG). Echo B will be shuffled back into the deck after Modulation and may be drawn again in later rounds.

Modulation activates an Echo's Modulation effects. The full effects are dependent on the specific Skills.

Only on-hand Echoes can be Modulated. You cannot Modulate a Deployed Echo with another echo in the Deployment Zone. Stacking two Echoes that are both in the Deployment Zone will only result in them swapping positions.

A Deployed Echo can only be Modulated twice.

To Modulate a Cost 3 Echo, it must be stacked on top of a Modulated Echo. In other words, you must Modulate a Cost 1 Echo first before you can Modulate a Cost 3 Echo.
Drag Echo A from your hand onto Echo B in the Deployment Zone to perform a Modulation.
When you Modulate Echo B on the Deployment Zone using Echo A from your hand, Echo A inherits Echo B's Special Skills and activates them.
Every Echo in the Deployment Zone can be Modulated at most twice.
Some Echoes possess a Special Skill that only activates under specific conditions.
Deploying a Core Echo costs no Energy. It will stay on-hand throughout the duel before being Deployed, but cannot be Reconstructed or Modulated.
Each Core Echo has its own Trial. During the duel, you can only add Core Echoes to your hand after completing the corresponding Trial.

When Resonators enter the <color=#ffd12f>Sea of Flames</color>, they become eroded by the Incinero Petal Pollens, causing a <color=#ffd12f>steady decline in their HP</color>.
This effect will gradually disappear within seconds after the exposure stops.

Resonators can use the <color=#ffd12f>Shooting Mechanism</color> to train their shooting skills. Hitting different targets will trigger different effects:
Normal Targets: Yellow. Hit all of them to proceed to the next stage.
Explosive Targets: An explosion symbol marked on it. When hit, it will trigger an explosion, breaking the surrounding targets.
Trap Targets: A prohibition symbol marked on it. When hit, your points will be deducted.
Connect the pipelines to ensure the fuel in the tank smoothly reaches the ignition device, enabling the flames ejected to achieve the firepower required to activate the sensor.

After the Utility is unlocked, you can use the Levitator to connect the <color=#ffd12f>fuel pipelines</color> to the remaining section. Adjust the direction of the <color=#ffd12f>fuel pipelines</color> by rotating them with the Levitator.

A poor-quality spear barrel will be destroyed after the Hit Gauge is full, granting the Resonator a temporary <color=#ffd12f>Immunity</color> to the surrounding Incinero Petal Pollens.
A good-quality spear barrel will not be destroyed after the Hit Gauge is full. It can be used to assemble the <color=#ffd12f>Explosive Spear</color>.
Attack the spear barrel with your weapon to build up the Hit Gauge displayed at the top.

After the Utility is unlocked, you can use the Levitator to throw the <color=#ffd12f>Explosive Spear</color> at the enemies, dealing AoE multi-stage DMG.
Defeat all Tacet Discords and protect the three Sound Emulators to complete the challenge.
You can crush the scrapped vehicles and boxes along the road. They may contain useful materials.

Transform into the Inferno Rider and speed along the track created by the floating highways.
As you race, you can control the Inferno Rider to wield its blade to <color=#ffd12f>destroy</color> obstacles in your path and <color=#ffd12f>avoid</color> road signs.

You can equip an <color=#ffd12f>Ultrasonic Pulse Chip</color> to launch a Water Vortex. The Water Vortex can <color=#ffd12f>clear</color> the mud along the path. Upon hitting the enemies, it can <color=#ffd12f>remove</color> the enemies' <color=#ffd12f>Mud Shields</color> and knock them back. Upon hitting the Swamp Vortex, it can trigger an <color=#ffd12f>AoE DMG</color>.

The Swamp Vortex <color=#ffd12f>knocks back</color> the units it hits and deals <color=#ffd12f>minor damage</color>. The Water Vortex released by an Ultrasonic Pulse Chip can dispel the Swamp Vortex, dealing <color=#ffd12f>a large amount of damage</color> to the enemies within the range.

After activating the Suppressor, you must <color=#ffd12f>remain within its range for a period of time</color> to advance the repair progress. When <color=#ffd12f>mud</color> and <color=#ffd12f>enemies</color> appear within the range, the Suppressor will cease to function.

The mud <color=#ffd12f>blocks the mechanisms and grants the enemies special Mud Shields</color>. The Water Vortex released by an Ultrasonic Pulse Chip and the Swamp Vortex can remove the mud and the shield it grants.

To address the issue in the Dim Forest, try to eliminate the Offshoot Cores.
When the drones light up, use either <color=#ffd12f>melee or ranged</color> attacks to rotate them, directing the sound wave emitted by the central drone towards the Offshoot Core. If successful, you'll eliminate the Offshoot Core and obtain a valuable Offshoot Core sample.
<color=#b49f50>Use Waveplate</color> to claim rewards and gain EXP. Accumulate EXP to level up Union Level.
Various Utilities are available on your Terminal, making your exploration easier. Utilizing these tools well helps you uncover more mysteries.

Sensor
The Sensor can reveal valuable content within a certain range of area, such as <color=#b49f50>collectible items, enemy weaknesses or Acoustic Prints</color>.

Sensor II
You may find some Acoustic Prints concealing special information during your exploration. When you approach them, they will display certain appearance changes. Use the Sensor to uncover hidden mechanisms or supply chests.

Grappling Hook
Grappling Hook can assist Resonators in crossing over terrains. Use it in open areas to make a leap upward, or look for Grapple Points in the map for even further travels.

Levitator
Levitator allows you to control highlighted objects and throw them at specific targets for different effects. Use levitator to capture and manipulate these objects as needed.
After activating a Resonance Beacon, you can open the Map and fast travel to the activated Resonance Beacon.
The Resonance Nexus stores information on the surrounding area. Activate it to obtain the corresponding Map data.
Head to a Resonance Nexus to <color=#ffd12f>heal</color> injured or downed Resonators.

Injured or downed Resonators can rally at a<color=#b49f50>Resonance Nexus</color> to recover to their optimal state. 
If you're temporarily unable to reach the nearest Resonance Nexus, you can <color=#b49f50>Cook</color> and consume food to restore Resonators' HP.

Resonance Terminal preserves relevant enemy data. Use <color=#b49f50>Sensor</color> installed with Resonance Terminal to reveal enemy <color=#b49f50>Weaknesses</color>. Attack their weaknesses with certain methods to deal more damage.
Once you reach certain Union Level caps, it is necessary to clear Ascension Quests to increase your SOL3 Phase.
The first clear of a Tacet Field will reward <color=#b49f50>Waveplate Plate</color>, which can be used to exchange for rare materials in cities.
Relic Merchant Chenpi is collecting Sonance Caskets. He's willing to pay you with various rewards in exchange for the Sonance Caskets you found.
Use the equipped Zoom Camera to locate the targets.

Certain obstacles that have been eroded with Wutherons cannot be destroyed using normal methods. It can only be broken by using Levitator to grab a nearby Tacetite Fulminates to trigger an explosion by throwing onto it.

[<color=#c19f51>Team Selection</color>]

After the trainee has formed a team, they can enter the challenge. The minimum number of Resonators in a single team is <color=#c19f51>1</color> and the maximum is <color=#c19f51>3</color>. The team formation will record the development status of the selected Resonators, which will remain unchanged in a large-scale training.

Starting from the <color=#c19f51>3</color>rd level training - Real Scene Simulation, trainees need to form <color=#c19f51>2</color> teams to challenge before the training begins.

[<color=#c19f51>Training Purpose</color>]

If the trainee eliminates all the enemies within the limited time, the training is considered successful. Only after success can they enter the next training. If all the small trainings within a large-scale training are completed, the large-scale training is considered successful.

In large-scale training, the status of the Resonators will be inherited. The trainee needs to ensure that at least <color=#c19f51>1</color> Resonator in the team survives, which is considered to have passed the large-scale training.

[<color=#c19f51>Training Subjects</color>]

The entire gameplay is composed of <color=#c19f51>4</color> large-scale trainings. In the first <color=#c19f51>3</color> large-scale trainings, each large-scale training has <color=#c19f51>4</color> rounds of small training. The <color=#c19f51>4</color>th large-scale training has only <color=#c19f51>1</color> training.

Trainees can temporarily leave the Tower of Adversity after completing a training, and the training progress of the trainees will be recorded. They can then choose to continue or reset the training progress.

Except for the behavior of continuing training, trainees can only play from the first training of the large-scale training.

[<color=#c19f51>Ability Limitations</color>]

In the Tower of Adversity gameplay, trainees cannot develop Resonators, use items, change equipment and Echo during the training process, and some system functions will also be prohibited.

[<color=#c19f51>Guardian of the Voice</color>]

In the Tower of Adversity gameplay, different trainings may have different buff effects. Trainees can adjust the team formation, equipment or Echo according to the buff effects.

[<color=#c19f51>Reward Rules</color>]

When passing a training for the first time, the trainee will receive a reward after the training settlement. <color=#c19f51>Repeatedly passing the cleared training will not receive the reward again</color>.

"[<color=#c19f51>Tower of Adversity</color>]

A large underground comprehensive experimental center built before the Lament. It sank into the sea due to the terrain changes during the Lament, and only recently resurfaced. 

This research station has a depth of over ten thousand meters reaching the Moho, and there is a trend to continue to expand downwards. At the same time, there seems to be a periodic echo coming from the deep well, as if it is breathing. Therefore, the deep well has also gained the nickname of the Gate of Hell. 

Without a doubt, humans do not have the industrial capacity to build such a facility. At the bottom of the deep well, countless mysteries are waiting to be unveiled...

[<color=#c19f51>Exploration Cycle</color>]

The environment of the Tower of Adversity naturally recovers in a <color=#c19f51>two-week</color> cycle, and the data and monsters will be updated after the cycle is reset. The rewards from the data will also be updated. 

[<color=#c19f51>Underground Structure</color>]

The Tower of Adversity has <color=#c19f51>3</color> areas to be explored, and each area has <color=#c19f51>4</color> depths. Only after the explorer has completed the exploration of the <color=#c19f51>3</color> areas at the same depth, can they proceed to explore the deeper layers. 

[<color=#c19f51>Lineup Selection</color>]

Exploration requires the formation of <color=#c19f51>3</color> teams, each to complete the exploration of <color=#c19f51>3</color> areas. The Resonators who have already fought will be locked in the exploration area and cannot participate in the exploration of other areas until the exploration of the <color=#c19f51>3</color> areas of the same difficulty is completed. The explorer can choose to manually unlock the Resonators, but after the unlock, the exploration points of the current area will be reset. 

[<color=#c19f51>Exploration Rules</color>]

Explorers need to conduct multi-layer exploration in each area, each layer of exploration has a certain time limit. If the exploration is not completed within the time limit, it will be judged as a failure; if all the monsters are defeated within the time limit, it will be judged as a pass. 

[<color=#c19f51>Exploration Degree</color>]

When the explorer is exploring the surface layer, the relay layer, and the deep layer, the exploration degree will be evaluated in real time according to the explorer's performance. After the exploration is completed, a fixed amount of exploration points will be settled; 

When the explorer is exploring the mutation layer, the exploration should be ended as soon as possible to avoid pollution. The <color=#c19f51>faster the exploration is completed</color>, the <color=#c19f51>more exploration points will be obtained at the time of settlement</color>. 

[<color=#c19f51>Residual Echo</color>]

In the research station, each area node will have a Master of Illusion. The Master of Illusion has obtained the enhancement of the Lament's Echo, and has a stronger power than the general monsters, and even has rule-like characteristics (such as enhancement effects). The explorer needs to choose the lineup carefully according to the characteristics. 

[<color=#c19f51>Reward Rules</color>]

The deeper the exploration, the more information obtained, the more rewards. Every time a certain exploration degree is reached, rewards will be settled at the end of the cycle; when the explorer has completed the exploration of the surface layer, the relay layer, and the deep layer, rewards can be obtained in advance. 

[<color=#c19f51>Ability Limitations</color>]

In the Tower of Adversity, it is not possible to cultivate Resonators, use items, change equipment and Echo during the exploration, and some system functions will also be prohibited."

Echo System

[Echo Upgrade]
Upgrading an Echo raises an Echo's Mainstat. This improvement is not randomized.
Echo Upgrade also unlocks new Substat slots every 5 levels.
The level cap of an Echo depends on its rarity.

[Echo Tuning]
By Tuning an Echo, you can unlock new random Substats and unleash its potential. The unlock Substats will be fixed and cannot be tuned again.
(Echoes with the lowest rarity may not be able to be Tuned due to data interference.)

[Data Modification]
Data Modification for Mainstats and Substats has different rules and item requirements.
Use a Modifier to adjust the first Mainstat of a selected Echo into the designated stat. This can only be done on unupgraded 5-star Echoes.
1 Modifier is consumed for each Mainstat Modification.
Use a Transducer to adjust the Substats of a selected Echo to random stats, excluding locked Substats. This can only be done on fully tuned 5-star Echoes.
The number of locked Substats determines the amount of Transducers consumed in each Modification:
- With 2 or fewer locked stats, consume 1 Transducer.
- With 3 locked stats, consume 2 Transducers.
- With 4 locked stats, consume 3 Transducers.
You may choose whether to apply the Modification results in Substat Modification. Discarding the result does not refund used Transducers.

Substat Modification results that are not confirmed due to unexpected errors will be saved in the server for up to 30 days. Please confirm your results in time.

[Basic Gameplay]
The game is played with a deck of 16 cards. Each player starts with a hand of 8 cards. Players flip a coin to decide their play order in each round.
In a player's turn, they draw one card from their opponent's hand. If a player has two identical cards in hand, they may play them as a pair.
The game ends when any of the victory conditions are met.

[Victory Conditions]
1. Each player starts with 2 HP. Drawing the Crownless Card costs 1 HP. If a player's HP drops to 0, they lose the game.
2. If a player plays every card in their hand while their opponent is still holding the Crownless Card, the player who goes out wins.

[Card Details]
1. Wild Card: At the start of each turn, the Wild Card randomly transforms into another number card in the player's hand. It cannot transform into the Crownless Card, a card that has already been played, or repeat its transform in previous rounds. Wild Cards can form pairs like standard cards.
2. Crownless Card: There is only one Crownless Card in the deck. Drawing it causes the player to lose 1 HP (out of 2). The first player to lose 2 HP loses the game.

Data Merge

[Standard Merge]
You can merge or Batch Merge 5 unupgraded Echoes into 1 random new Echo in the Terminal.
You cannot select equipped and locked Echoes as Merge Materials.

[Targeted Merge]
This feature unlocks at Data Bank Lv. 15.
You can merge 5 unupgraded 5-Star Echoes into a random new Echo of the Sonata Effect of your choice.
You cannot select equipped and locked Echoes as Merge Materials.
*If a selected Sonata Effect currently only has Cost-1 or Cost-3 Echoes unlocked, Targeted Merge may still produce an Echo of a locked Cost type. In this case, the Echo produced will be of 3-Star rarity and will unlock the corresponding Echo Collection entry. Afterward, you may obtain Echoes of the newly unlocked Cost type. The highest Rarity of the Echoes obtained will depend on the current Data Bank level.

[New Echoes]
The Rarity of the Echo produced depends on your Data Bank level and is irrelevant to the Rarity of merged Echoes. Upgrade your Data Bank to get Echoes of higher Rarity from Data Merge.
Data Merge only produces Echoes already unlocked.

[Extra Yield]
Standard Merge sometimes produce extra Echoes in addition to the base yield.
Merge Echoes of higher Rarity and Cost for a higher chance to yield extra Echoes.
*Targeted Merge does not produce extra Echoes.

[Auto Select]
Auto Select lets you quickly select available Echoes in the order displayed. You can change the sort and filter settings to change which Echoes are displayed and selected first.

Some <color=Wind>Aero</color> attacks will apply a stackable <color=#ffd12f>"Aero Erosion Effect"</color> to the target.

Some <color=Thunder>Electro</color> attacks will apply a stackable <color=#ffd12f>Electro Flare</color> effect to the target.
While <color=#ffd12f>Electro Flare</color> lasts, it deals periodic <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> to the target. The target loses half of the effect stacks with each instance of damage.
<color=#ffd12f>Electro Flare</color> stacks up to 10 times by default. The higher the stacks, the more DMG dealt.

At maximum stacks of <color=#ffd12f>Electro Flare</color>, any new stack inflicted becomes stackable <color=#ffd12f>Electro Rage</color>.
<color=#ffd12f>Electro Rage</color> increases the DMG dealt by the next <color=#ffd12f>Electro Flare</color> triggered. <color=#ffd12f>Electro Rage</color> is removed once triggered.
<color=#ffd12f>Electro Rage</color> stacks up to 10 times by default. The higher the stacks, the more DMG <color=#ffd12f>Electro Flare</color> deals.
Dodge attacks carefully to avoid building up <color=#ffd12f>Electro Flare</color> effect.

Some <color=Ice>Glacio</color> attacks will apply a stackable <color=#ffd12f>Glacio Chafe</color> effect to the target.
When <color=#ffd12f>Glacio Chafe</color> is inflicted, the target receives <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
<color=#ffd12f>Glacio Chafe</color> stacks up to 10 times by default. The higher the stacks, the more DMG dealt.
Each stack of <color=#ffd12f>Glacio Chafe</color> effect reduces the target's Movement Speed.

When <color=#ffd12f>Glacio Chafe</color> reaches max stacks, the target will be <color=#ffd12f>frozen</color>, and all stacks of <color=#ffd12f>Glacio Chafe</color> will be removed. Struggle to accelerate your recovery from the <color=#ffd12f>frozen</color> state.
Dodge attacks carefully to avoid building up <color=#ffd12f>Glacio Chafe</color> effect.
Some <color=Fire>Fusion</color> attacks will apply a stackable <color=#ffd12f>Fusion Burst</color> effect to the target.

When <color=#ffd12f>Fusion Burst</color> is stacked to its max, all stacks will be removed to trigger an <color=#ffd12f>explosion</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> around the target.
<color=#ffd12f>Fusion Burst</color> effect stacks up to 10 times by default. The higher the stacks, the more DMG dealt.
Dodge attacks carefully to avoid building up <color=#ffd12f>Fusion Burst</color> effect.

Some <color=Light>Spectro</color> attacks will apply a stackable <color=#ffd12f>"Spectro Frazzle Effect"</color> to the target.
While <color=#ffd12f>"Spectro Frazzle Effect"</color> lasts, the number of its stacks is periodically reduced by 1 to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> to the target.

The building up of <color=#ffd12f>"Spectro Frazzle Effect"</color> greatly increases the DMG it deals.
Dodge attacks to avoid the accumulation of <color=#ffd12f>"Spectro Frazzle Effect"</color> and effectively reduce the DMG taken.

Some <color=Dark>Havoc</color> attacks will apply a stackable <color=#ffd12f>Havoc Bane</color> effect to the target.
While Havoc Bane lasts, the DEF of the inflicted target is reduced.

<color=#ffd12f>Havoc Bane</color> stacks up to 3 times by default, with each stack reducing the target's DEF by 2%.
Dodge attacks carefully to avoid building up <color=#ffd12f>Havoc Bane</color> effect.

By Moon's Grace

[About]
The Moon-Chasing Festival is a Huanglong traditional festival that features various origin stories, with the most popular being the tale of The Fox and the Moon. On this special night, families and friends come together to admire the moon and make wishes, expressing their hopes for a brighter future.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 17. For the best experience, complete "Thaw of Eons" before participating in this event.

[Event Rules]
1. Help Xiangli Yao prepare for the Moonlit Fair to boost the festival's Popularity.
2. Increase Popularity by fulfilling Wishes and building stalls.
3. Invite Companions to assist in preparations by completing the corresponding Side Quests, and earn higher Wish Ratings and Funds.
4. Achieve the festival goals to claim and redeem rewards.
5. After the event concludes, unclaimed rewards will remain available for 30 days and will be reissued via Mail when you log in during this period (Note: Rewards that have not been redeemed will not be reissued.)
Popularity

1. During the Moon-Chasing Festival, you can increase Popularity via the activities in <color=#8c7e51>Lodge Wishes</color> and <color=#8c7e51>Fair Stalls</color> to make the Moonlit Fair more lively.
2. Popularity ranges from Level 1 to Level 6.
Fair Stalls

1. Build or upgrade stalls to increase Popularity, gain buffs, and unlock Companions.
2. Building or upgrading stalls requires Funds, which can be earned by completing Wishes in Lodge Wishes.
3. Stalls can be upgraded multiple times, with higher levels providing greater buffs.
4. After building a stall, you can participate in the stall's activities and may earn unexpected rewards, with additional daily rewards for Thus Says the Moon, Hsin's Fortuity, and Riddle Twiddle.
Lodge Wishes

1. You can spend Preparation Credits and Funds to fulfill people's Wishes in <color=#8c7e51>Lodge Wishes</color>. Each Wish has its own resource cost.
2. Fulfilling Wishes will earn you Funds and Wish Tags. Setting new records will boost Popularity.
3. Send the right Companions to fulfill the Wishes in <color=#8c7e51>Lodge Wishes</color>. You can view their detailed stats on the Companions page.
Lodge Wishes Rules

There is a preferred Companion Stat for each Wish. Selecting your Companions accordingly will earn you a higher score.
To boost your Companions' stats, interact with them on the Companions page.

Preparation Underway: Your Companions act in turn, earning scores based on their stats.
Scoring Rules: Scores fluctuate each round, as your Companions can't always perform at their absolute best. Nevertheless, Companions with higher stats have the potential to earn higher scores.
During preparation, Companions may experience a "Eureka" moment. The likelihood of this occurring varies for each Companion.
"Eureka" allows for additional investments. Higher risks yield greater rewards. Make your choice wisely.
Results: A Wish Rating depends on the combined scores of your chosen Companions. Higher Ratings earn you more Funds and Wish Tags.
Companions

1. Companions can help you fulfill Wishes in <color=#8c7e51>Lodge Wishes</color>.
2. They have three stats: Knowledge, Action, and Teamwork. Higher stats and better matches with the Wish's recommended stat lead to higher Wish Ratings.
3. Build and upgrade <color=#8c7e51>Fair Stalls</color> and complete the <color=#8c7e51>Festival Journal</color> quests series to unlock more Companions.
Interacting with Companions

1. You can interact with Companions to boost their stats and Bond Level.
2. Each Interaction has its own cost of Wish Tags. A higher cost results in greater enhancements.
3. Complete Wishes in <color=#8c7e51>Lodge Wishes</color> to earn Wish Tags.
Sailing Time

1. The fishers of the Riccioli Islands follow a strict tradition of working from sunrise to sunset, believing the night belongs to Cetus the Tidebreaker, who guides lost souls back home.

2. While sailing in certain waters around the Riccioli Islands at night, Rachel's Threat Level will rise. Once it reaches a critical point, Ghost Medusas will emerge and attack. Stay alert and avoid their strikes!

3. The riskier the waters, the greater the rewards. Fish caught in areas where Ghost Medusas appear tend to be of higher quality.

4. Some special species only appear at night. Check the Index for details.

5. Night on the Riccioli Islands spans from 19:00 to 5:00.
Durability

1. As a Gondola Echo, Rachel takes damage upon bumping into hazards on the sea. Steer clear of Bampuffs, Tornadoes, and Ghost Medusas while navigating the waters.

2. Rachel's Durability decreases when damaged. If it reaches zero, it will automatically return to the dock, and all collected catches will be lost.

3. To ensure a safer and more successful voyage, you can use Riccioli Fishery Coins to restore Rachel's Durability before weighing anchor at the dock. Keep a close watch on its Durability to avoid unnecessary losses.
Fame

1. Fame reflects your skill in fishing and the recognition you've earned from the fishers of the Riccioli Islands. Increasing your Fame will grant you more convenience while sailing across the Riccioli waters.

2. You can earn Fame by exploring the Riccioli Islands, completing Requests from Merchant Planck, and updating the Index.
Locked Requests

1. Certain Requests require specific Fishing Abilities. If you haven't unlocked the necessary ability, you won't be able to complete these requests.

2. On the Fishing Abilities page, you can consume a certain amount of materials and coins to unlock the Fishing Abilities.

About Tactical Simulacra

[About]

The Academy is experimenting with a new type of technology rumored to be capable of simulating powerful enemies to help with the troops' combat training...

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 14.

[Event Rules]

1. In Tactical Simulacra, challenge waves of powerful enemies by using special buffs across different simulation domains.

2. As you complete more challenges, more special buffs will be unlocked to aid you in taking on subsequent challenges.

3. The results of each challenge consist of three parts: Monster Points, Time Points, and Technical Points.

i. Monster Points are earned by defeating enemies in challenges.

ii. Time Points are earned based on the time remaining when a challenge is completed. The more enemies that are defeated, the higher the point conversion factor.

iii. Technical Points are earned for each successful Counterattack and Dodge triggered. There's a maximum limit to the number of Technical Points that can be earned from each challenge.

Enhanced Drop Rate

For certain classes of Tacet Discords, your Terminal can consume extra computational power to enhance its Echo absorption and increase your chances of getting Echo drops. It can perform a limited number of enhanced absorptions, and then it will need time to recharge.
The enhanced absorption attempts of different classes are counted separately.
*Cooldown resets at server time 04:00 every Monday.

[About]
Mt. Firmament is a secluded haven, detached from the rest of the world. It is rumored to be the very place where the Sentinel Jué descended...
Complete event quests to earn great rewards.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and arrive at Mt. Firmament in the main quest "Voyage to Firmament."

The event consists of four phases, with each phase unlocking progressively as you advance through the main quests.

If you have any unclaimed rewards when the event ends, you can log in within 30 days afterward to receive the rewards via mail.

(3) The team regenerates more Skill Energy every second.

About Mail System

[Mail Types]
There are two types of mail: Starred Mail and Other Mail.
Starred Mail stays pinned at the top of your mailbox and does not expire. It will not be deleted when you select "Delete Read Mails."
Other Mail has an expiration date and will be automatically deleted when it expires.

[Mail Capacity]
The mailbox can store a maximum of 99 mails.
Once the limit is reached, the oldest mails without attachments or with claimed attachments will be automatically deleted.
Make sure to claim your attachments promptly to avoid any loss from expiration and deletion.

The number of Echoes you can equip is limited by the total COST. The COST of equipped Echoes cannot exceed your current COST limit.

When Echo skills are in use, the corresponding main Echo cannot be replaced or unloaded temporarily.

Every Echo comes with its own "Sonata." When the number of Echo assembled with the same Sonata reaches 2 or 5, the corresponding Sonata Effect can be activated.
Multiple Echo with the same Sonata and the same name equipped will only count towards the Sonata Effect once.
Echo with the same name may carry different Sonata due to data differences.

[Eligibility]
You can participate in these events as soon as you meet the specified eligibility criteria.

Ragunna Sales Blitz!

[About]
A train crashes from the dreamscape into reality, ripping open a gateway to the realm of illusions.
A looming shadow greets you with a grim prophecy: the world will succumb to this nightmare, and night will reign eternal.
You struggle to awaken from this terrifying vision, desperately clinging to shreds of reality left in the shattered dreams...
Thankfully, a white cat appears and guides you back on track, helping you find the lost allies trapped in the realm of dreams. Together, you battle against the darkest terrors of chaos.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 17.

[Dreamscape Odyssey]
Join the strange white cat in rescuing your Resonator companions from their Dreamscapes. Together, you will delve deep into the Somnoire to uncover the truth behind the nightmares. Each of the 6 Dreamscapes offers unique rewards upon completion.


[Rift Runner]
Nightmares have torn through the veil of reality, wreaking havoc across the world. It's down to you to restore the crumbling order to the land, with the mystic boon of Illusive Sprint received from the strange white cat.
Compete "Dreamscape Odyssey: The Mountain and Six Credits" to unlock "Rift Runner."
Each of the 6 challenge stages offers unique rewards upon completion.

[Nightmare Revisits]
The looming shadow stares at you with its fiery eyes, as if trying to draw you back into the endless darkness. Enter the Somnoire with your trusted companions, link your minds and spirits, and relive your epic battle against the ever-lurking nightmare. Fight the Black Cat again with Resonators of your choice. This time, the combat challenge will feature new exciting twists. Use the power of Dream Link to gain an upper hand!
Complete "When the Night Knocks" to unlock "Nightmare Revisits."
Each of the 6 challenge stages offers unique rewards upon completion.

[Dream Shards]
Complete Rift Runner, Nightmare Revisits, and the quest "When the Night Knocks" to earn Dream Shards.
Collect the required quantities of Dream Shards to unlock the corresponding milestone rewards.
Dream Shards are obtainable at any time by participating in the event.

[Limited-Time Rewards]
Complete the Limited-Time Rewards objectives to earn exclusive rewards, including the Featured 4-Star Weapon "Somnoire Anchor" and Featured Weapon Projection "Projection: Somnoire Anchor."

[Tips]
The Limited-Time Rewards objectives will expire when the event ends, but you can continue challenging the stages afterward to earn the standard rewards.

In the Tower of Adversity, your skills are put to trial. Complete the specific challenge goals to earn your Crests. Collect enough Crests to earn hefty rewards.

The Tower of Adversity features four Zones: <color=#c19f51>Stable Zone</color>, <color=#c19f51>Experiment Zone</color>, <color=#c19f51>Hazard Zone</color>, and <color=#c19f51>Overdrive Zone.</color> Each Zone contains one to three Towers and each Tower has multiple Floors, each representing a unique challenge. Progress through the challenges to unlock new Towers and Zones. Clearing all challenges in a Zone unlocks the next Zone.

In the Tower of Adversity, clearing a challenge reduces participating Resonators' <color=#c19f51>Vigor</color> by a specific amount. Once a Resonator's Vigor is depleted, they can <color=#c19f51>no longer take part in new challenges</color>. Vigor does not restore over time, but you can use the [Reset] option on a Floor to recover the Vigor.
In the Tower of Adversity, environmental effects affect your combat tactics. Use them strategically to gain an advantage.

Crest Rewards in the Stable Zone, Experiment Zone, and Overdrive Zone can be claimed only once. However, the challenges in the Hazard Zone are <color=#c19f51>periodically reset</color>, along with your progression, bringing in new enemies, challenge goals, Area Effects, and rewards. Take on the challenges again to earn Crests and <color=#c19f51>claim fresh rewards.</color>

Complete the challenges and meet their challenge goals to obtain Crests. Collect a certain number of Crests to get various rewards, including Astrites and Hazard Records. Hazard Records can be exchanged for Phantom Echoes, Premium Tuners, and more at the Adversity Exchange.

About Tactical Simulacra II

[About]

The Academy is experimenting with a new type of technology rumored to be capable of simulating powerful enemies to help with the troops' combat training...

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 14.

[Event Rules]

1. In Tactical Simulacra II, challenge waves of powerful enemies by using special buffs across different simulation domains.

2. As you complete more challenges, more special buffs will be unlocked to aid you in taking on subsequent challenges.

3. The results of each challenge consist of three parts: Monster Points, Time Points, and Technical Points.

i. Monster Points are earned by defeating enemies in challenges.

ii. Time Points are earned based on the time remaining when a challenge is completed. The more enemies that are defeated, the higher the point conversion factor.

iii. Technical Points are earned for each successful Counterattack and Dodge triggered.

[Combat Rank]
Hitting the enemy steadily improves your Combat Rank, while successful Dodges, Dodge Counters, and Counterattacks provide a greater boost. However, getting hit significantly lowers your Combat Rank.
Hold Dash to enter the Illusive Sprint state after touching the white cat's blessings.
Pincer Maneuver Warriors II

[About]

It seems that someone has just updated the mysterious combat simulation program that's going viral on the Huaxu Hive at the Academy...

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 40.

[Event Rules]

1. In Pincer Maneuver Warriors, challenge waves of powerful enemies by controlling two teams with special buffs across two separate simulated battlefields.

2. The simulated battlefield offers buffs that either apply to both teams or are exclusive to one team.

3. There are 4 stages with limited enemy waves and 1 stage with infinite waves.

i. In stages with limited enemy waves, you can only proceed to the second half of the battle when time runs out or after eliminating all enemies.

ii. In the stage with infinite enemy waves, you can only proceed to the second half when time runs out.

4. Points earned in stages with limited enemy waves include both Time Points and Monster Points, while Points earned in the stage with infinite waves include only Monster Points.

i. Monster Points are earned by defeating enemies in challenges.

ii. Time Points are earned based on the time left when a challenge is completed.

Flying along the Wind Trail allows you to <color=#ffd12f>automatically</color> follow the wind's direction.
Follow the Wind Rings to stay on course. Pass through them to earn challenge points!

Across Rinascita, you may stumble upon these fragile containers scattered around. Shatter them to uncover hidden treasures within.

Keep a close eye on those bearing the Montelli family crest, as they contain Monnaies—an old currency that can be redeemed for rewards at Averardo Bank.
Smash the floating containers with the Gondola or your attacks and collect the treasures within!

These collapsed morph paintings drain frequencies and energy from their surroundings to maintain their forms, causing the minerals, plants, and even animals nearby to lose their vibrancy and color.
The absorbed colors transform into chaotic color blocks on the Overflowing Palette. <color=#ffd12f>Adjusting all the blocks into a designated color</color> will restore the environment's former vibrancy.
Select a color on the right and apply it to the blocks on the palette to the left. The new color will spread to all connected blocks of the same color.
Different Overflowing Palettes have different move limits. Plan your moves carefully to return the land to its former vibrancy!
The <color=#ffd12f>Resonance Nexus</color> stores information on the surrounding area. Activate it to obtain the corresponding <color=#ffd12f>Map</color> data.

After a <color=#ffd12f>Resonance Beacon</color> is activated, you can open the Map and <color=#ffd12f>fast travel</color> to an activated Resonance Beacon.
Head to a Resonance Nexus or Resonance Beacon to <color=#ffd12f>heal</color> injured or downed Resonators.

<color=#ffd12f>Defeat</color> the nearby <color=#ffd12f>Tacet Discords</color> to ensure the successful activation of the <color=#ffd12f>Sound Emulator</color>. Complete the challenge to receive rewards.

The product of a collapsed Sonoro Sphere, found throughout the world. It records undistorted memories of the past.
Use Grapple to hook and quickly approach the Sonance Caskets in Ragunna. The Plushie Echoes in the Garden of the Lost are collecting them—perhaps a visit will reveal more.
A village of Plushie Echoes in the Garden of the Lost. The villagers are gathering Sonance Caskets throughout Ragunna to unlock the Sonoro Sphere within a morph painting.

While steering a Gondola, you can use Waterfall Surge to swim up a waterfall.
<color=#ffd12f>(Please note that this function can only be used in safe waters. Protect your Gondolas, and protect yourselves.)</color>

A special Gondola that cruises along the most scenic spots in Ragunna City, often called the city sightseeing water bus.
Board the Gondola to relax and enjoy the voyage.
Aim your Grapple at the Wingray. When the visual cue appears, cast Grapple to link yourself to the Wingray. It will carry you upward.

The link will automatically break once you reach the highest point.
The Wingray will return to its starting point after a short time.

Use Utility: <color=#ffd12f>Flight</color> to leap into the air and start flying. Flight is a Utility specific to Jinzhou (including Mt. Firmament), the Black Shores, and Rinascita regions. Available only while out of combat.

When in Flight, use movement keys (or the control stick) to ascend or dive.
As you dive, you gain momentum for the Echo Wings, allowing you to ascend higher.
Try diving to restore momentum when it depletes.

{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the Ultra Flight button to activate <color=#ffd12f>Ultra Flight</color>.
This mode allows you to defy gravity completely but consumes <color=#ffd12f>more STA</color>.
Compared to level flights, your STA consumption rate increases when ascending and reduces when descending.
Boost Unit: Flight is a reward for <color=#ffd12f>Exploration Progress</color>. It increases <color=#ffd12f>max STA</color> while Flying.
The settings menu offers an option to invert ascending and diving input, allowing you to customize controls to your preferences for smoother experience!
Once the challenge begins, follow the ground cues to avoid the Vitreum Dancers dashing toward you.

When you reach a Leap Spot, using Utility will activate Echo transformation automatically. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the Utility button to transform into a Cuddle Wuddle and jump.
Aim your camera to the next Leap Spot and {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} the Utility button to leap again.

When you reach a Climbing Spot, the Utility will automatically become Echo transformation. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the Utility button to transform into a Cuddle Wuddle for the climbing challenge.
Aim your camera toward the next Climbing Spot and {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} the Utility button to climb again.
Reach the final Climbing Spot to perform the Leap for the Top!
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Utility button to transform into a Cuddle Wuddle and smash the Seamrock. Ready to throw this Plushie Punch!
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the button while the pointer is in the highlighted section to speed up the progress. The rock will break once the progress bar is full.
When the pointer enters the orange zone, activate Powerful Punch mode. Rapidly {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} the left and right buttons to speed up the smashing.
Press the Utility button to transform into a Cuddle Wuddle and break the Friable Rock with a single punch!

Ordinary Nightmare Clouds can be absorbed into Lottie Lost's picture book, transforming them into beautiful paintings.
Absorb Nightmare Clouds to earn rewards!

Nightmare Clouds of ghostly flames. 

Observe the number of flames and absorb Nightmare Clouds <color=#ffd12f>in the correct order</color>. Absorbing them in the wrong order will reset the challenge.

Nightmare Clouds that keep multiplying.
 
Lottie Lost must use the <color=#ffd12f>Finished Book</color> and <color=#ffd12f>Hold</color> the Enhanced Absorption button to <color=#ffd12f>absorb</color> and eliminate all Nightmare Clouds at once.

Lottie Lost draws power from the stories in the <color=#ffd12f>Finished Book</color>, enhancing her ability to absorb Nightmare Clouds.
 
<color=#ffd12f>Hold the Enhanced Absorption button</color> to absorb all Nightmare Clouds within her radius.
 
The Enhanced Absorption state lasts for a limited time and can be refreshed by reading the Finished Book again.
Lottie Lost can resonate with the Unfinished Book, sensing the trail of its lost pages.

Guide Lottie Lost to collect the lost pages by following the sensed trail as closely as possible.
Once all the pages are collected, the Unfinished Book will be fully restored.
Stand right before the monument base, then use Grapple to pull the misplaced monument back to its base to restore the monument.
Restore all the monuments, and you might uncover something unexpected!

Approach the base and interact with the flickering point to read the <color=#ffd12f>inscription</color>.
Find the painting mentioned in the text and use Levitator to place it on the <color=#ffd12f>matching base.</color>

Dreamscape Nodes gather various dream frequencies, each presenting unique challenges based on the dreams and emotions they contain.

Clear the Dreamscape Tacet Discords and meet all <color=#ffd12f>challenge goals</color> to link the Node to Somnoire. You can interact with the node's core to retry challenges as many times as needed.
Some special Dreamscape Nodes feature <color=#ffd12f>enhanced</color> Nightmare Tacet Discords.
To complete the challenge, <color=#ffd12f>meet all challenge goals within the time limit</color> or defeat the Nightmare Tacet Discords directly.

The Dreamscape Nexus serves as a central point for transmitting frequencies and dreams to Somnoire. Protect it from being destroyed within the time limit. Each defeated wave of enemies <color=#ffd12f>reduces the remaining defense time.</color>
Beware of Nightmare Tacet Discords in some waves, which can <color=#ffd12f>deal greater DMG</color> on the Dreamscape Nexus.
Fae Ignis from the Dreamscape doesn't die when its charge is interrupted. However, when defeated, it will always explode and release fireballs at a faster rate.

Cuddle Wuddle enters a prep phase of synergy when its HP drops below 80%. During this time, you can interrupt the synergy by dealing DMG equal to 20% of Cuddle Wuddle's max HP or defeating the other Plushies Echoes.

Once Cuddle Wuddle enters the synergy with other plushies, they will launch Coordinated Attacks. However, if Cuddle Wuddle's <color=#ffd12f>HP drops below 30%</color>, the synergy will end, and Cuddle Wuddle will be paralyzed.
<color=#ffd12f>Counterattacking</color> the Vitreum Dancer's strikes can break its weapon, which makes the Vitreum Dancer enter an Enraged state and become even more powerful.

Questless Knights, Diurnus Knights, and Nocturnus Knights can enhance their weapons, indicated by a glowing effect. Counterattack them three times to remove the enhancement, or they will continue to enhance their weapons repeatedly.
Face the Nightmare Clouds and use Utility to transform into a Lottie Lost. <color=#ffd12f>Hold the button</color> to absorb the Nightmare Clouds with her picture book!
When the Roseshroom charges for shooting a laser, shoot the core at its head to interrupt the charging.
Select a piece to preview its landing point, then select the point to move the piece.
When a black piece lands on the outer circle, it <color=#ffd12f>opens all gates and maze walls in that direction.</color>
You can pause the game at any time, and <color=#ffd12f>all pieces will stay in place.</color>
Press the <color=#ffd12f>Reset button</color> to restart the game.

The game ends when either side's pieces form a straight line.
<color=#ffd12f>If black pieces connect, you win</color>; if white pieces connect, the Lifer wins.
Use <color=#ffd12f>Sensor</color> to locate the Terminals granting buffs to the Lifer.
Submit a <color=#ffd12f>Stake of Imbalance</color> at a Terminal to remove the buffs.
After submitting the Stakes, you can freely <color=#ffd12f>turn The Lifer's buffs on or off</color> through the Terminal.

Each of the three altars is connected to the Discipline Steles around it.
Stand on the altar platform to charge the steles, but <color=#ffd12f>Tacet Discords will appear</color> to disrupt the effort.
<color=#ffd12f>When only the player is within the altar's range</color>, the steles charge most efficiently.
<color=#ffd12f>When there are Tacet Discords within the altar's range</color>, the steles stop charging.
<color=#ffd12f>When the player is out of the alter's range,</color> the steles stop charging, and the energy begins to drain.
In the dark area not illuminated by the Macabre Torch, Tacet Discords are enhanced, entering the Shadow state that makes them <color=#ffd12f>immune to all attacks.</color>
The Macabre Torch's light can dispel the Shadow state of Tacet Discords, making them vulnerable again.
There are certain enemies who will try to extinguish the nearby Macabre Torch after taking specific amounts of damage.
Use Levitator to collect the stained glass pieces.

Place the collected pieces onto the missing parts of the stained glass.
A <color=#ffd12f>golden glow</color> will appear if the piece fits correctly.
A <color=#ffd12f>red glow</color> will appear if the piece doesn't fit.

Go through the Tacet Mark protruding from the ground to enter the Tacet Field in another dimension.

After clearing the Tacet Field, you can consume Waveplates to obtain various Echo development materials and collected Echoes of the corresponding Sonata set.
Surveillance cameras are used to scan for suspicious activities. Staying within their view increases Alertness.
Vitreum Dancers patrol the Vault, charging at intruders and dealing DMG on impact.
Scatter Prisms greatly enhance Carlotta's Forte. Shooting them with the "jewelry set" disables the surveillance cameras and Vitreum Dancers within a large area permanently.

Alertness indicates how alert the Vault's security system is to your actions. It increases when you are detected by Vitreum Dancers, spotted by surveillance cameras, or engage in combat. You can lower it by disabling security systems or defeating enemies. If Alertness reaches 100, you will be forced to retreat and restart from the previous area.
Defense Lasers block certain pathways and deal DMG to anyone who touches them.
