John Wicktorio: No Debts for Old Men

[About]

John Wicktorio, a retired Acolyte and accountant of the Order, found his cherished Echo brutally killed by some thugs.
Determined to settle the scores and avenge his old pal, he's stepping back into the game to make the culprits pay.

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 14 and unlock the Resonance Nexus in Ragunna City during the Main Quest: "The Sacred Breeze So Often Breathes."

[Event Rules]

1. During the event, you will enter a special sphere to battle waves of enemies within a set time limit, with the aid of unique buffs.

2. You will collect Coins by dealing damage to enemies, but taking damage will cause you to lose Coins.

3. Progressing through enemy waves unlocks more special buffs to give you the support you need.

4. The Coins you have collected by the end of the countdown will be your Coins record of this stage.

5. Defeating each enemy wave grants additional time.
Proceed to Rinascita

[About]
O Rover guided by the tides, you have banished the shadows of war in Jinzhou and crossed the boundaries of time on Mt. Firmament. When you stood upon the secluded shores, did you hear the gospel carried on the tempest winds, echoing across the Stormy Sea? Did you glimpse the unparalleled splendor that lies within the fabled land of the Echoes? Now, steel your heart and embark on a journey into the unknown, brave the storm, and carve a path to Rinascita.

[Eligibility]
Go to the Resonance Nexus in Jinzhou and unlock the Terminal during Main Quest "First Resonance."

[Event Rules]
Main Quest Chapter II is now available, eligible players can now experience this Chapter early.
Chapter II progress is saved separately from Chapter I progress. Taking on Chapter II early does not affect your progress in Chapter I.
Early access to Chapter II also unlocks Time Adjustment, Resonance Conversion functions, as well as some Utilities.
*For the optimal experience, we recommend completing Chapter I Act VIII "To the Shore's End" before starting Chapter II: Prologue.
Glamour Couture

[Event Rules]
During the event, you can use trial Resonators in special outfits to repeatedly challenge specific stages. 

The trial Resonators are at fixed levels and equipped with preselected sets of weapons and Echoes. In the trial stages, team composition and the sets of weapons and Echoes cannot be changed.

[Event Rewards]
After completing the event stages, you can claim stage rewards on the event page.
Each stage rewards can be claimed once only.
After the event concludes, rewards for cleared stages will be distributed via mail.
Outfits

[Outfit]
Outfits are alternative appearances for playable Resonators.

[Notes]
Some Outfits include special Weapon Projections that can change the weapon's appearance.

Some Outfits can be purchased at a special offer when on sale. Outfits on special offer revert to their original price after the sale.

Each unique Outfit is purchasable once. Please ensure that you own the Resonator before purchasing their Outfit. You may purchase an Outfit without owning the corresponding Resonator, in which case the Outfit becomes usable once you own the Resonator for that Outfit.
Tales of the Isles

[About]
After braving the perilous sea mists and tumultuous waves, you've finally arrived in Rinascita, the Land of Echoes.
Radiant lights stretch across the horizon, while cheerful melodies echo through the bays and blooms.
The Carnevale is around the corner. May your journey be one to remember.
This is a Permanent Event. Complete event quests to earn rewards.

[Eligibility]
Complete Main Quest "Through the Sea Thou Break" to unlock

[Event Rules]
Complete event tasks to earn Stamps, which can be used to increase your Event Level. Advancing to higher levels unlocks rich rewards and the Amidst the Sea of Clouds challenges.
Please note that some event quests are unavailable in Co-op Mode, and the quest-tracking feature may be disabled in certain game scenarios.
Lollo Campaign: Comeback

[About]

Maji, your good old friend, is back again with his "Brand New Lollo Campaign Plan." As always, your support is greatly appreciated. Complete the campaigns to claim your Lollo Stamps—a gift of gratitude from Lollo Logistics.
Lollo Stamps can be exchanged for Lollo Helper special deliveries.

Echo Recommendation

[Recommended Attributes]

On the Echo Selection page, use "Suggest" to open the filter. This allows you to check the most commonly used Mainstats and Substats for the current Resonator and quickly filter out suitable Echoes.

While switching between "All," "COST 1," "COST 3," and "COST 4" Echoes on the Echo List on the left, the recommended attributes will adjust accordingly.

[Recommended Sonata Effects]

On the Resonator - Echo page, use "Suggest" to check the most commonly used Sonata Effect for the current Resonator.

Use "Auto Equip" to equip all Echoes that best match the selected Sonata Effect.

On the Sonata Selection and Sonata Gallery pages, the most commonly used Sonata Effect for the current Resonator will be marked with a thumb-up icon.


[Data Updates]

The recommendations are based on data collected from recently active players and refresh every Wednesday at 00:00 (server time). Actual refresh may experience some delay.

If there is not enough data, default recommendations generated by the system will be displayed instead.
Echo Presets

Echo Presets allow you to easily save and apply customized Echo lineups for your Resonator.

[Saving Presets]

Select the "Current Setup" column and use "Save As Preset" to save the equipped Echo lineup for the Resonator.

Each preset can be named to your liking. Please ensure the names follow local laws and regulations.

You can save up to 20 Echo Presets. If you reach the limit, you will need to delete an existing preset to create a new one.

[Applying Presets]

Select any saved preset and use "Apply" to equip the preset to the current Resonator.

About Tactical Simulacra III

[About]

The Academy is experimenting with a new type of technology rumored to be capable of simulating powerful enemies to help with the troops' combat training...

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 14 and complete Main Quest Chapter II Prologue "Through the Sea Thou Break" to unlock.

[Event Rules]

1. In Tactical Simulacra III, challenge waves of powerful enemies by using special buffs across different simulation domains.

2. As you complete more challenges, more special buffs will be unlocked to aid you in taking on subsequent challenges. Use different buffs to defeat enemies to complete the challenge objectives in Bonus Challenge and obtain additional rewards.

3. The results of each challenge consist of three parts: Monster Points, Time Points, and Technical Points.

i. Monster Points are earned by defeating enemies in challenges.

ii. Time Points are earned based on the time remaining when a challenge is completed. The more enemies that are defeated, the higher the point conversion factor.

iii. Technical Points are earned for each successful Counterattack and Dodge triggered.

[Combat Rank]

Hitting the enemy steadily improves your Combat Rank. Defeating enemies provides a significant boost.

Familiar gateways are appearing throughout Rinascita. Interact with these gateways to enter the Somnoire.

Venture into the gateway and help restore the corrupted Memory Zones!

Interact with the Fishing Spot to fish.

Some Fishing Spots require specific Fishing Abilities. Acquire the corresponding Fishing Abilities to gain access to these spots.

Various frequencies gather beneath the waters of the Riccioli Islands. Ghost Medusas appear at night.

As you sail and fish, your Threat Level to these waters increases. Higher Threat Level attracts fiercer Ghost Medusas.

However, on a high Threat Level, <color=#ffd12f>catch quality</color> will be higher, and the chance to catch <color=#ffd12f>Mutants</color> will increase.

You may switch between Fishing Abilities on your voyage with the wheel.

Using this feature wisely makes your fishing trips more efficient and rewarding.

Under the influence of the Sentinel or the Threnodian, mutants can be found among the many species in the sea.

Mutants can always be found at the Fishing Spots of their original species.

Enhancing Phoebe's Fishing Abilities or fishing in the areas where Ghost Medusas appear at night can increase the chance of catching Mutants.

To catch the "biggest fish," you'll need a bigger ship. Captain Ahab has just one, but it really needs some repairs.

Provide Queequeg with a design print, logs, and Fishery Coins, and he'll handle the rest for you.

Fishing Rules

Fishing Spot Rules:

1. There are two types of Fishing Spots: Sea Life Fishing Spots and Material Fishing Spots, each offering different resources.

2. Each Fishing Spot requires a specific Fishing Ability to access. Check the Fishing Abilities page for details.

3. Each Fishing Spot has a limited number of catches. When depleted, the spot will disappear and automatically generate after a certain period, possibly at a different location.

Fishing Rules:

1. When the harpoon lands within a glowing area, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=click Gamepad=press} the button to accelerate the Fishing Progress. Brighter areas grant greater acceleration.

2. Once the Fishing Progress reaches 100%, 1 Fishing Attempt will be consumed, and you will have a chance to catch the target.

3. When all Fishing Attempts are used up, no further fishing can be done, and you will proceed to handle the storage for the harvest.

4. During fishing, you can access the Cargo page to manage your catches. Doing so will interrupt the current fishing attempt.

[About]
The Black Shores has developed a special training program that can simulate dangerous trials in Solaris by using Tethys system data. The program is a good measure of the challenger's combat capabilities under adverse conditions.
 
[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 30.
 
[Crisis Trials]
As a member of the Black Shores, take on trials under a selection of Stress Modules.
Select a Stress Level for each trial. The Stress Level must meet the requirements to complete the trial.
Each trial has a default Stress Module. Support Modules are available to lower the trial's difficulty.
After completing a Crisis Trial, the corresponding Disaster Trial along with its Stress Module and Support Module will be unlocked.
 
[Disaster Trials]
To gather additional combat data and improve the Black Shores's crisis response plans, this training program also includes a Hard Mode.
As a member of the Black Shores, you will face <color=#c89a45>hard challenges</color> with various Stress Module combinations.
Disaster Trials have no required Stress Level. Data samples are gathered from participants pushing their limits.
Participating in a Disaster Trial will consume Support Modules, so select them carefully in advance.
Certain high-difficulty Stress Modules can only be unlocked after clearing a Disaster Trial.
<color=#c89a45>Warning: Equipping too many Stress Modules may make the trial excessively challenging.</color>
 
[Revival Mechanism]
If a participant is downed in a trial, they can consume Stress Levels to revive. This also gives a corresponding buff.
Please note that consuming Stress Levels will affect the completion and final result of Challenge Goals.

[Matrix Crystals]
Obtain Matrix Crystals by completing Challenge Goals in the Crisis and Disaster Trials. Matrix Crystals can be exchanged for rewards at the Supply Station. Completing certain Stress Level challenges in Disaster Trials will grant an <color=#c89a45>event-exclusive Title reward</color>.
<color=#c89a45>The Supply Station closes when this event ends. All remaining Matrix Crystals will expire and will not be reserved after the event ends. Please exchange your Matrix Crystals in time.</color>

Special Notes:
1. All saved progress has an expiration time. Once the time expires, your progress will be lost.
2. All saved progress will be wiped during version updates. Please pay attention to the updates and be sure to complete any in-progress challenges beforehand.
3. You can save up to 10 challenge progress at a time. When the limit is exceeded, the oldest save will be overwritten.
4. If a Rover gender change is made, all mid-challenge saves will be lost.

Use the Gravity Calibrator to <color=#ffd12f>change the gravity direction</color>, enabling access to unreachable areas.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Click Gamepad=Press} the direction indicator along the wheel to change the gravity. <color=#ffd12f>The yellow indicator shows the direction guided by Cartethyia</color>.
Use <color=#ffd12f>Whistle from Utility</color> near waters with matching gravity to summon Cartethyia's companion, Phaom, for a ride.

In certain waters, the Gondola will cruise along a fixed route.

Simply control the Gondola's left and right movement.
Use Utility: Flight to chase the light spark along the Wind Trail.

Ride the Gondola and follow the light spark until you reach the end of the route. 
 
Pass through <color=#ffd12f>Power-up Rings</color> to maintain your cruising speed and avoid <color=#ffd12f>Obstacle Rings</color> along the way.

Twisted frequencies permeate the castle, giving birth to a Sonoro Sphere where past and future intertwine. <color=#ffd12f>Use the lamp given to you by Cantarella</color> in certain areas to travel between different dimensions.
In the Sea of Ghosts, remnants of jellyfish float in circular areas. Use the lamp within these zones to travel to different dimensions.

Coming in contact with the <color=#ffd12f>umbrella of a Bouncy Jellyfish</color> will <color=#ffd12f>bounce</color> the Resonator upward.
 
<color=#ffd12f>You can only interact with Bouncy Jellyfish in the current dimension</color>. Bouncy Jellyfish from other dimensions appear as visions and cannot be interacted with.

Enemies from alternate dimensions are shrouded in shadows, granting them <color=#ffd12f>immunity to all forms of attack</color>.
 
Use the lamp and <color=#ffd12f>switch to their respective dimensions</color> to clear their shadows and make them vulnerable to attacks.

The late head of Fisalia's obsession is in a special shadow state, making them <color=#ffd12f>immune to all forms of attack</color>.
 
During combat, the lamp's energy can be charged <color=#ffd12f>by performing Dodge and Counterattack</color>.
 
Once fully charged, the lamp will emit a powerful light to dispel the shadows, making the enemy vulnerable to attacks.
Some Overflowing Palette paintings contain Colorblocks formed by abnormal frequencies. <color=#ffd12f>These blocks cannot be colored normally</color>.
Complete the Drake's challenge by evading lightning strikes within a given time period.
Some Resonators' abilities are limited in certain gravity environments.

The Nimbus Wraith has left special pattern hints on the ground.
 
Follow its guidance and <color=#ffd12f>walk along the highlighted path as accurately as possible</color> using Sensor to complete the pattern.
Thanks to Phaom's awesome sailing ability, you can ride up waterfalls to reach <color=#ffd12f>areas with different gravity orientations</color>.

Complete Training Tasks to obtain Magic Dice and move your Cube forward. Roll the Magic Dice and watch your Cube advance based on the roll.
As your Cube moves forward, it will collect rewards from all the pads it passes.
In each round of the race, you'll encounter Resonator Cubes. Meet them to activate their special Cube Bonus!
After each round of the Race, you'll see a Summary where you can view the Cubes met, the rewards earned, and other Race data. Close the Summary to move on to the next round!

Conquer Abbowser Castle with your Cube companions to free the other trapped Cubes.

Utilize the resources in Abbowser Castle to level up your Cubes until you're ready to defeat Abbowser.

Gather all your Cubes and host the Ceremony together.

Your rescued Cube companions from Abbowser Castle will help with Ceremony preparations.

As the preparation progresses, the Anniversary Cake will change in stages.

Freed Cubes will stick around in the Cube World. Maybe they'll have a story to share?

Cube companions will fight alongside your Resonators in Abbowser Castle. 

Use Echo Skills to make your Cubes cast <color=#ffd12f>powerful attacks</color>.

Some Cubes can even cast themselves to form Combos with Resonators or other Cubes.
Defeated Elite or Boss enemies may drop Data Modules.

Cubes can be equipped with Data Modules to gain extra powers in battle.

Data Modules come in many types. Be sure to <color=#ffd12f>equip them to the corresponding slot</color>.
Extra Data Modules can be <color=#ffd12f>decompiled</color> and recycled into upgrade materials.
Leveling up Cubes <color=#ffd12f>unlocks</color> more of their Data Module <color=#ffd12f>slots</color>, allowing them to be equipped with more Data Modules.

There are 3 types of Data Modules for your Cubes. 

Aside from Abbowser Castle, Abbowser's Shop also has powerful Data Modules. To shop there, collect the coins obtained by conquering Abbowser Castle.

Equip Ability Modules to give your Cubes the Abilities of other Cubes. 
An Ability Module <color=#ffd12f>cannot be equipped</color> if the Cube already has <color=#ffd12f>that same ability</color>.
A Cube's final slot is unlocked when it reaches Level 10. Equip an Awakening Module to this final slot to completely change the Cube's Ability.
Players can <color=#ffd12f>support</color> a <color=#ffd12f>Cube</color> by <color=#ffd12f>predicting</color> that it will be the match <color=#ffd12f>Winner</color>.

Each day from 8:00 to 19:30, players can support their favorite Cube by predicting that it will be the match winner. Each day, the match starts at 20:00, and the match winner will be decided on the same day.

During a match, Dice rolls decide which Cubes move first and how far.

Cubes on the same pad <color=#ffd12f>stack</color>. When the bottom Cube moves, it will <color=#ffd12f>carry along</color> all Cubes stacked above it.

During a round, <color=#ffd12f>there is a chance</color> for a Cube to trigger its own special <color=#ffd12f>Ability</color>.

In each match, the <color=#ffd12f>No. 1 Ranked</color> Cube wins. Players who <color=#ffd12f>supported</color> the winning Cube will <color=#ffd12f>receive</color> Popularity Rewards.

The Popularity Rewards are determined by the Popularity consumed in Support, and the Cube's <color=#ffd12f>Underdog Odds</color>. These odds <color=#ffd12f>refresh regularly</color> based on how much Support the Cube receives.
Each match is split into the 1st Half and 2nd Half. The rankings in the 2nd Half will determine whether a Cube <color=#ffd12f>advances</color> to the next match.

Past memories lie buried deep within dreams, and the key to exploration is in your hands. Please do not forget, only within dreams will the answers be revealed.

[Dreamscape Aid Update]
Current Dreamscape Aid Resonators: Zani, Jinhsi, Phoebe, Shorekeeper, and Verina. Use at least one Dreamscape Aid Resonator to gain a 150% Illusive Points Bonus!
Current Dreamscape Aid Effects:
- All Resonators in the team gain a 30% Spectro DMG Bonus.
- Hitting a target with Basic Attack grants 20 Dreamscape Energy. This effect can be triggered once every second. Casting Resonance Skill grants 100 Dreamscape Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 10s. Dealing Spectro DMG grants 30 Dreamscape Energy. This effect can be triggered once every second.
- Enter Lucid Dream when Dreamscape Energy reaches 500. In this mode, certain Metaphors will be enhanced, Crit. Rate and Energy Regen of all Resonators in the team are increased by 50% and 100% respectively, and the cooldown of their Resonance Skill and Resonance Liberation is reduced by 50%. Lucid Dream lasts for 10s and depletes all Dreamscape Energy when it ends.

[Exploration]
- Choose three Resonators from the Resonator pool and embark on epic battles in the Illusive Realm.
- The Echo Skills, Stats, Levels, Resonance Chains, and Weapons of Resonators can be carried over in the event.
- In the Illusive Realm, you can gain powerful boosts from Metaphors. Metaphors marked with Dreamscape Power provide additional enhancements when Lucid Dream is activated through Dreamscape Aid.
- Each battle in the Illusive Realm brings you against different enemies. Complete these challenges to earn Illusive Points and reach milestones to claim bountiful rewards.

[Remnant Crystal]
A Remnant Crystal will appear in the Memory Zone after defeating the powerful enemies found in the deepest parts of the realm. Use Waveplates to collect its rewards.

[Difficulty]
Higher SOL3 Phases offer more challenging Exploration in the Illusive Realm with more Remnant Crystals and Illusive Points as rewards. During a match, Dice rolls decide which Cubes move first and how far.

<color=#ffd12f>There is a chance</color> for a Cube to trigger its own special <color=#ffd12f>Ability</color> to try to reach the finish line first.

Cubes that arrive later at the target pad will stack on top of those that arrived earlier.
When Cubes are stacked, if the bottom Cube moves first, it will carry along all the Cubes stacked above it. Among stacked Cubes, the higher up a Cube is, the higher its rank.

During the Support Phase, players can <color=#ffd12f>support</color> their favorite Cube by <color=#ffd12f>predicting</color> that it will be the <color=#ffd12f>Match Winner</color>.

<color=#ffd12f>Supporting</color> a Cube consumes a player's Popularity. <color=#ffd12f>Popularity</color> can be obtained by completing the event's <color=#ffd12f>Daily Tasks</color>.

If the Cube you Supported wins, you will <color=#ffd12f>receive Popularity Rewards</color> based on [Popularity Given] x [Underdog Odds].

Don't worry, you'll get back 80% of the Popularity you gave in Support if your prediction turns out wrong!

The Support Phase lasts from 08:00 to 19:30 every day.

Based on the Support a Cube receives and its starting position, the Cube's <color=#ffd12f>Underdog Odds</color> are <color=#ffd12f>refreshed</color> daily at 12:00 and 18:00. 

Your Popularity Rewards for correctly predicting the winner will depend on the Cube's Underdog Odds. Be sure to keep an eye on any changes to those odds!

The Race Page shows all stages of the Race and who's advancing.

The Race consists of 5 stages: Group A, Group B, Quarterfinal A, Quarterfinal B, and the Final, with 10 matches in total.

During the Support Phase, the current Contenders and match will be highlighted. After each match is over, the page will update with the Contenders for the next match.

Each Group Stage is split into the 1st Half and the 2nd Half.
A Cube's ranking in the 1st Half will determine its starting position in the 2nd Half.

After the 2nd Half ends, only the <color=#ffd12f>frontrunner Cubes</color> will <color=#ffd12f>advance to the next Stage</color>.

The top 4 ranking Cubes from each Group Stage will advance to the Quarterfinal Stage. The top 2 from the Quarterfinal Stage will move on to the Final, where the champion will be decided.

After each match ends, the Match Recap page will allow you to watch the match replay. 

If the match that just concluded was the 1st Half, a "2nd Half Starting Position" button will appear on the main page. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Click Gamepad=Press} to view the starting positions of the Cubes for the 2nd Half.

1. Enter Abbowser Castle with up to 3 Cube allies. Your Cube allies will proactively assist you in battle. Additionally, casting Echo Skill triggers the Cube allies' active skill.

6. Items not picked up or unopened chests will automatically be placed into your Backpack after the end results.
7. Levels 5, 10, and 15 to 21 can be challenged in Co-op mode.

[Patron Board]
1. The Patron Board is formed according to the results from supporting the Cubes. The top 100 players from your server will be displayed on the Patron Board.
2. Your ranking will also be available on the Patron Board. Your info will not be displayed on the Patron Board if you haven't supported a Cube or if your results are below 50% of the participants.
3. Rankings on the Patron Board are determined by total Popularity. Two or more players will have the same ranking if they have the same Popularity, with the order within the Patron Board determined by the number of correct predictions and the time at which they were made.
4. Only Popularity obtained from supporting Cubes counts toward the total Popularity Rankings. Popularity obtained from doing Daily Event Tasks will not be counted.
5. You need to have supported a Cube at least once to be ranked.
6. The Patron Board will show your avatar and name as it was when you supported the Cubes.
7. You will be removed from the current Patron Board if your name contains sensitive characters that violate the User Agreement. If abnormalities are detected during the Cube supporting process, the offending player's ranking data will be deleted, and they will be banned from the current rankings. The Dev Team reserves the right of final interpretation.

Cubie Derby

[Event Duration]

2025-05-14 08:00 to 2025-05-26 03:59 (server time)

*From 2025-05-14 08:00 to 2025-05-23 19:30 (server time), you can support your favorite Cube every day. From 2025-05-23 19:30 to 2025-05-26 03:59 (server time), support will be closed. During this period, you can view race results, check the Patron Board, watch replays, and claim event rewards.

[About]

The first Cube Games hosted by the Pioneer Association are officially up and running! Twelve Cube stars are set to showcase their skills on the track, setting aside their standings and identities, as they fully commit to compete for the title of fastest Cube!
For those who cannot participate in the race, no worries! We've got you covered! You can support potential winners through our official channels! Plus, the Pioneer Association will offer full live event coverage, and everyone is welcome to tune in and cheer for their favorite contestants!
(This program is brought to you by the Montelli Second Coming of Solaris Branch, in partnership with the New Black Shores.)

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 8.

[Rules]

1. During the event, 12 Cubes will take part in elimination matches in 2 Groups, with 1 match taking place per day and 10 matches in total to decide the Ultimate Race Winner.
2. From 08:00 to 19:30 server time, you can support your favorite Cube by predicting the Match Winner of the day.
3. Each match starts at 20:00 server time. From the event page, you can view the race live broadcast and cheer for your favorite Cube in the live chat.
4. After the match, you must go to the event page to finalize the calculations for your Popularity rewards based on the Cubes' final placements and the prediction outcomes.
5. The Patron Board will be updated at 04:00 on the following day. You can view your ranking on the Patron Board.
6. After the 2nd half of the Final, a commemorative item will be sent out to all Rovers who unlocked this event. Please claim it before the event ends.
Cube, Cubic n Cubie

[About]
The Second Coming of Solaris's Anniversary is approaching, but trouble has struck the Cube World. The mysterious demon king Abbowser has captured all Cubes and issued the legendary Black Cat Warrior a mighty challenge. "You show up in a strange land, take on my minions, save your buddies, and then face off with me in an epic boss fight! Classic! This is gonna be a blast!"

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 22.

[Rules]
1. Enter Abbowser Castle with up to 3 Cube allies. Your Cube allies will proactively assist you in battle. Additionally, casting Echo Skill triggers the Cube allies' active skill.
2. Each Abbowser Castle level provides Data Modules, granting a massive increase to your Cube's combat powers. Certain modules also come with extra skill effects.
3. Gain level progression by defeating enemies. Enemies of different strengths count towards different amounts of progression. Once the progress bar activates a chest, you'll obtain its rewards after the end results.
4. Resonators on the same Floor share Revival Chances. Resonators will not be able to recover from being downed after all Revival Chances are depleted.
5. Upon either reaching 100% progression, 0 remaining time, or 0 Revive Chance, the level will be finalized.
6. Items not picked up or unopened chests will automatically be placed into your Backpack after the end results.
7. Levels 5, 10, and 15 to 21 can be challenged in Co-op mode.
Echo Aspect

[Echo Aspect]
By switching Aspects, you can change the appearance of Echo Wings and Glider.

[Important Notes]
Each Echo Aspect can only be purchased once and can be used on all Resonators you own.
Echo Aspects have usage requirements. You must progress through Main Quest Chapter I Prologue to unlock Glider Aspect, and Main Quest Chapter II Act II to unlock Echo Wings Aspect.
You may purchase Aspects even if you haven't met the requirements yet. Once you meet them, the Aspects will become usable.
Virtual Crisis

[About]
Tethys's crisis simulation program is getting an upgrade. With newly gathered data from the Black Shores and Rinascita, harsher scenarios await those who dare to face the challenge…

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 30.

[Crisis Trials]
As a member of the Black Shores, take on trials with different combinations of Stress Modules.
Each Crisis Trial has a default set of Stress Modules. Support Modules are available to lower the trial's difficulty.
After completing a Crisis Trial, the corresponding Disaster Trial along with its Stress Modules and Support Modules will be unlocked.

[Disaster Trials]
To gather additional combat data and improve the Black Shores's crisis response plans, this training program also includes a Hard Mode.
As a member of the Black Shores, you will face <color=#c89a45>hard challenges</color> with various Stress Module combinations.
Disaster Trials have no required Stress Level. Data samples are gathered from participants pushing their limits.
Participating in a Disaster Trial will consume Support Modules, so select them carefully in advance.
Certain risky Stress Modules can only be unlocked after clearing the corresponding Disaster Trials or clearing a Disaster Trial with the required Stress Level. 
<color=#c89a45>Warning: Equipping too many Stress Modules may make the trial excessively challenging.</color>

[Revival Mechanism]
If a participant is downed in a trial, they can consume Stress Levels to revive. This also gives a corresponding buff.
Please note that consuming Stress Levels will affect the completion and final result of Challenge Goals.

[Matrix Crystals]
Obtain Matrix Crystals by completing Challenge Goals in the Crisis and Disaster Trials. Matrix Crystals can be exchanged for rewards at the Supply Station. Completing certain Stress Level challenges in Disaster Trials will grant an <color=#c89a45>event-exclusive Title reward</color>.

<color=#c89a45>The Supply Station closes when this event ends. All remaining Matrix Crystals will expire and will not be reserved after the event ends. Please exchange your Matrix Crystals in time.</color>
Solaris New Voyage Celebration

[About]
"Hi, Rover, welcome to the Solaris Photo Show!"
How will your journey unfold in this brand new world? The scenery you dream of, the companions you wish to encounter, and the stories you are about to write... memories will unravel in full color, starting right here, with you.
 
[Eligibility]
Create a character profile after the Version 2.4 update and reach Union Level 5.
 
[Duration]
The Solaris New Voyage Celebration unlocks once you meet the requirements. The event lasts 30 days.
 
[Event Rules]
The event has four types of tasks: Tidal Memories, Combat Scenes, Scenic Wonders, and Growth Roadmap. Complete these tasks to earn item rewards and Celebration Festivity Points.
Accumulate Festivity Points to unlock valuable rewards. Keep building it up to claim a <color=#ffd12f>standard 5-star Resonator of your choice</color>!
If you have any unclaimed rewards when the event ends, you can log in within 30 days afterward to receive the rewards via mail.
If you do not select a preferred 5-Star Resonator as your Celebration Gift during the event, this reward cannot be reissued. If you meet the requirements and have already made your selection, the corresponding standard 5-Star Resonator reward will be reissued via Mail.
Please note that certain content of the event is not available while in Co-op mode. Quest Tracking is not available in certain areas.
The Everglorious Summit

[About]
The streets of Septimont are teeming with life. Travelers from near and far have gathered in their finest for the Great Agon.
Go explore Septimont in this time of celebration, taste the bitterness of defeat and joy of triumph in the competition, and experience the glory of the arena amidst stunning landscapes.

[Eligibility]
Arrive in Septimont during the Main Quest "Shadow of Glory."

[Event Rules]
The event has four phases, each unlocking progressively as you advance through the Main Quest.
Complete event quests to earn great rewards.
If you have any unclaimed rewards when the event ends, you can log in within 30 days afterward to receive the rewards via mail.
Please note that certain event content is not available while in Co-op mode, and event Quest Tracking is not available in certain areas.

Dreamland Echoes and Yield

Fenrico may cast Holy Summon to summon Divine Envoys at his command and start channeling Retribution.
When Fenrico casts Holy Summon, Phrolova will charge up to counter the incoming Retribution.
Defeating the Divine Envoys ensures that Prolova's charge-up remains uninterrupted and allows her to generate a Remnant Field that defends Resonators inside against Retribution. After Retribution ends, Phrolova will counter Fenrico, lowering his vibration strength.
If the Remnant Field could not be generated, Retribution will deal massive amounts of damage to any active Resonator.

Orchestration is one of Phrolova's Resonance abilities. It can tap into an object's essence and change its state. After Orchestrating, the behaviour of nearby objects will be affected for some time. Orchestration can be ended early.
Orchestration consumes energy. Energy gradually recovers when not Orchestrating.
Special Grapple Points will appear during Orchestration. They function just like normal Grapple Points.
During Orchestration, each attack slows the enemy's attack speed. After taking 5 attacks, the enemies will be locked. All locked enemies will be instantly defeated when the Orchestration ends.
Enemies cannot hit you when you're in Orchestration.

Micro Echo Brooders are stored centrally and require significant space. To preserve valuable manufacturing floor area, they are usually concealed within structural partitions.
These units deploy rapidly when activated and may bump into surrounding objects. You can control them via Orchestration.
Defective Power Controllers will periodically release large shockwaves that damage anything nearby. Use Orchestration to fix the Power Controllers.

Special music stands are found around the Orchestration Altar. Put a complete Music Sheet on the stand corresponding to the altar to activate the Orchestration Altar and initiate Polyphone Orchestration mode.
During Polyphone Orchestration, drag to link the music notes by number in ascending order up to number 5.

After connecting the numbers in ascending order, the missing notes on the top of the screen will be restored, and the Orchestration will be complete, returning the chaotic melody to its original form.
If there are multiple notes, link all notes up to number 5 of their corresponding colors.
Use Grapple to enter the special water current that can rapidly transport you between connected areas.
Use the up and down movement keys (or the control stick) to ascend and dive. Use the left and right movement keys to control your direction.
Energy pipes supply large amounts of energy to various areas and connect to an array of opening and closing valves. Operate the valves by sending energy through the pipes to the correct place.
The Breaker is one of the safety devices for the Energy Pipes. Press on the pedal to reconnect the disconnected Energy Pipe.
The Prayer Rite must be performed exactly as specified by the Order of the Deep for it to be considered a display of devotion. Failure to do so warrants expulsion from the group.
When the Triptych Chest displays 3 identical icons, hit its button to open the chest.

Completing the Analysis

In the Tidal Defense Simulator, you need to deploy Combat Machines to fend off waves of Tacet Discords aiming to destroy the Energy Matrix.

Tacet Discords attack in waves. During the <color=#ffd12f>Preparation</color> phase before each wave, you can consume Sim Credits to deploy various types of Combat Machines.

There are three terrain types in the Tidal Defense Simulator: ground, wall and ceiling. Combat Machines can only be deployed on specific terrain based on their type.

In each Preparation phase, you will receive a certain number of Sim Credits. You will also earn a small number of Sim Credits by defeating Tacet Discords.

Once Combat Machines are deployed, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=click Gamepad=press} Start to begin the simulation. Tacet Discords will advance along preset routes.

If Tacet Discords reach the Energy Matrix, they'll reduce its Durability. The amount of depletion depends on the Tacet Discord type. The simulation fails if Durability drops to 0.

Tacet Discords enter through invasion points. During the simulation, they won't attack you directly but will follow preset routes. You can see these routes as marked lines in the Preparation phase.

Additionally, the Preparation phase shows previews of Tacet Discords moving along these paths. Use this info to strategically deploy your Combat Machines based on their movement patterns.

After completing a simulation, you'll be granted Rating Stars based on the remaining Durability of the Energy Matrix.

Rating Stars can be used to unlock Overwatch Protocols, granting tactical advantages for future simulations.

In Deathtrap Mode, you'll be able to choose a Tactic during the Preparation stage before each wave. Tactics grant powerful combat buffs.

Each Tactic belongs to a specific Tactic Set, where you can view detailed descriptions and effects.

In the Total Defense Test of Deathtrap Mode, Tacet Discords do not stop attacking and become more powerful with each wave. Defend against an unending stream of enemies and strive to set your highest wave record!

In some stages of the Tidal Defense Simulator, certain paths will be blocked at the start of combat.

Once a specific wave is reached, these paths will open, creating new invasion points and changing enemy routes.
KU-Money's Shop appears after every certain waves, spend your Sim Credits there to purchase items.
You can use the purchased items by {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tapping PC=pressing Gamepad=pressing} the corresponding buttons. Consumables will be depleted upon use.

Use the wheel to quickly switch between your carried items.
You can only carry a limited number of items. Different items have different carry limits. Once you reach the limit, you won't be able to purchase more.
Drag frequency samples of the same Attribute (color) to connect them.
Once samples of the same Attribute are connected, all other single samples of that Attribute will become fixed. Drag the connected samples to link with the fixed ones.
Connect all frequency samples of the same Attribute within the move limit to complete the analysis and win the challenge.

Clearing Frequency Contamination

In this simulation, some Tacet Discords are Shielded. Shielded Tacet Discords are immune to Slow effects.

Use pulling-in-type Combat Machines (Vortex Generator and Whirlpool Device) to directly remove Tacet Discords' Shields.
Use knockback-type Combat Devices and KU-Roro's Weapons to push Tacet Discords off the edges, instantly defeating them. Tacet Discords defeated this way will not trigger their Deathsound effects.
Tacet Discords with Passive - Fortified have very low HP, but the DMG they take is fixed at 1 for each hit.
Tacet Discords with Domain - Disable periodically disable nearby Combat Machines for a short time.
Tacet Discords with Passive - Invisibility do not trigger Combat Machines on walls and ceilings.
Tacet Discords with Domain - Barrier periodically grant Shields to nearby Tacet Discords.

When Tacet Discords with Deathsound - Contamination are <color=#ffd12f>defeated</color>, they release Frequency Contamination on the spot. Combat Machines cannot be deployed in the contaminated areas, and the already deployed ones <color=#ffd12f>become disabled</color>.

The <color=#ffd12f>Frequency Neutralizer</color> removes Frequency Contamination.
When <color=#ffd12f>carrying</color> Frequency Neutralizers, you can deploy Combat Machines to contaminated areas. The system will <color=#ffd12f>automatically consume</color> the required number of Frequency Neutralizers for the deployment.
Certain Combat Machines can also clear contamination using their Optional Modules.

In this zone, Resonators' total DMG increases over time. Landing hits, Dodge Counters, or Counterattacks further boost total DMG for a short duration.
During the drill, Resonators' Weapons will auto-attack. They cannot use regular skills, but may Dash, Sprint, and cast Active Skills.
The drill is presented from a wide overhead perspective, providing a clearer view of the battlefield.

During the drill, defeating TDs yields Enhancement Modules. You can spend them in the Shop between waves to upgrade Resonators, Weapons, or purchase Items.
Survive the required waves to complete the challenge.
New Weapons unlock in certain waves. Resonators will use multiple Weapons at the same time.

Some weapons can be absorbed to evolve another weapon into its Ultimate Form. The evolution requirements differ depending on the Weapon. The evolved Weapons inherit all buff effects of the absorbed weapon.
Some waves spawn Chest TDs. Defeating them grants Upgrade Card rewards.

Items spawn when eliminating certain TDs, reaching a certain number of waves, or at specific locations on the drill field. Pick them up for instant effects including:
- Magnetic: Automatically collect all Enhancement Modules on the field within range.
- Healing:  Restore 20% of Max HP.
- Rampage: Greatly increase DMG, Movement Speed, and Attack Speed for 10s.

Doubled Pawns Matrix: Pilot

[Doubled Pawns Matrix: Pilot]
In Doubled Pawns Matrix: Pilot, your skills will be tested through multiple challenging stages. Confront the enemies and earn points to claim corresponding rewards.

[Eligibility]
Achieve at least 24 Crests in one phase of the Tower of Adversity and reach at least 3,500 points in one phase of the Respawning Waters: Torrents in Whimpering Wastes after 3.0 is released.

[Matrix]
Doubled Pawns Matrix: Pilot consists of two Zones: Stability Accords and Singularity Expansion. Earn the required points in Stability Accords to unlock Singularity Expansion.

[Stability Accords]
You may deploy up to 3 teams. Defeat all enemies in one round to complete the challenge.

[Singularity Expansion]
There is no limit to the number of teams you can deploy. Defeating all enemies in a round will open the next round, with enemies growing stronger each time.

[Power Circuits]
In Doubled Pawns Matrix: Pilot, you must deploy three Resonators in each team and select a Power Circuit before starting the challenge.

[Demo Resonators]
Demo Resonators are available only if you own the corresponding Resonators. Each Demo Resonator is set to Lv. 90, equipped with a Lv. 90 weapon and a fitting Echo set with Lv. 25 Echoes . They inherit the Resonance Chain from your own Resonators.

[Resonator Enhancements]
In Doubled Pawns Matrix: Pilot, certain Resonators will receive special skill enhancements.

[Viral Infection]
In Singularity Expansion, enemy HP increases by each round, and stronger enemy effects will be unlocked as rounds progress.

[Vigor]
Each time a Resonator participates in a challenge, 1 point of Vigor is consumed. Resonators with 0 Vigor cannot be deployed. Vigor is calculated separately for Stability Accords and Singularity Expansion.

[Weapon & Echo Occupation]
Different Resonators cannot use the same weapon and Echo in this event. If a Resonator in the team has equipped a weapon or Echo used by another Resonator with a challenge record, you cannot start the challenge with this team.

Honami City: Free Exploration
Irideglow Portal
Loot obtained in Honami City carries special frequencies and must be placed in the Storage Bag.
Stickers contain harnessable Remnant Energy. These Stickers can be equipped in your Storage Bag interface to offer Resonators a variety of enhancements.

Namipon Stickers can be obtained by eliminating Tacet Discords, breaking destructible objects, or opening Supply Chests.
Stickers come in different types, which offer different enhancements and base stats.
As you explore Honami City, the Lament Residue will slowly corrupt your Resonators. Their resistance against the corruption is shown as Stability.

Stability will decrease when attacked by Tacet Discords influenced by Lament Residue. If <color=#ffd12f>all Stability is lost</color>, <color=#ffd12f>the exploration will be terminated</color>, and all items in your Storage Bag will be lost.
Sparkling Water can be found throughout Honami City. Break them to restore some Stability and HP.
Namipons will assist in your exploration of Honami City. Selecting different Namipons will allow you to cast various Support Skills while exploring.
Wearing the Namipon Badge increases your Max Stability in Honami City.
Different Namipons are attached to specific Sticker sets. Equip the corresponding Stickers to activate their special effects.

Although the looping crisis is over, there are still unresolved mysteries in Honami City.
Explore Honami City with Namipon and Chisa in search of loot to enhance your combat power and upgrade Shashou Cafe. Uncover the truths behind the anomalies in the city!

Unlock more Namipon Support and Namipon Stickers as you investigate and venture into yet unexplored areas in search of valuable loot.
Build up your team's abilities as you plumb the depths of Honami City!
While exploring, you'll come across loot contaminated by Lament Residue. Interact with the loot item to purify it and obtain rewards.

Aside from Stickers, Honami City is filled with unique collectible items that, while lacking practical effects, hold significant value. These loot items can be sold to the Sales Champ in exchange for Rice Dangos, which can be spent to enhance your exploration abilities in Honami City.
Due to Lament's residue, TDs in Honami City will grow increasingly dangerous over time, and enemies will deal greater Stability DMG. Be mindful of the time elapsed during your exploration.
When an enemy's level far exceeds yours, its level indicator will be red. Please proceed with caution.
In heavily contaminated zones, TDs affected by Irideglow may appear. Defeat them all to purify the zone and obtain higher-value loot.
Stability can be consumed to open Capsule Machines contaminated by Lament Residue, which have a higher chance of containing high-value items.
You can book the Namipon Shuttle from a Telephone Booth, which lets you safely extract at any moment. Extraction by Namipon Shuttle does not incur item loss.

Honami City is now open to free exploration. Aside from the Telephone Booth, you can also book the Namipon Shuttle from the Preparations menu. Ticking that option allows you the freedom to extract at any time.
All areas in Honami City have been unlocked. You may now freely explore Honami City or continue with the story.
Various Irideglow Portals might appear while you're exploring. They can randomly transport you to special areas in Honami City.
Tunability
Off-Tune Level
Tune Break

Some of your attacks build up certain enemies' Off-Tune Level.
Once their Off-Tune Level reaches the limit, they enter the Mistune state.
During this state, you can unleash a powerful Tune Break to shatter their defenses.
Landing a Tune Break resets the enemies' Off-Tune Level and inflicts Tune Disruption, leaving them vulnerable to follow-up attacks.

When an enemy uses a Special Skill (a red ring will appear as a warning), if you <color=#ffd12f>successfully Dodge or counter</color> the attack, the enemy will immediately enter the Mistune state. Attack enemies with Tune Break in this state will not reset their Off-Tune Level.
Operation: Frontier Renewal

[About]
Lahai-Roi's route network, along with the Spacetrek Observatory that used to monitor its terrain, ecosystem, and climate, has been devastated by a Void Storm. It's time to rebuild them all!
Use rebuild materials gathered in Lahai-Roi to assist Dhalifa in restoring the Route Network and the Spacetrek Observatory.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 8 and complete Tutorial Quest "Operation: Frontier Renewal"

[Event Rules]
Explore Lahai-Roi and use 3 types of materials to rebuild 10 routes.
Reaching a Route Constructor unlocks it as a Fast Travel point.
Once activated, the Constructor will automatically complete the route rebuild. Restored routes will revitalize the surrounding area, unlocking a variety of side quests and challenges.
Each completed route increases Network Activity. Reaching certain Activity milestones advances the Spacetrek Observatory's rebuild progress.

This event is permanently available. From Version 3.0 onward, you can access this event via the Region Guide on the Lahai-Roi map.
Network Activity
Rebuild Lahai-Roi's route network to increase Network Activity, enabling more supplies to reach the Spacetrek Observatory and accelerate its reconstruction.
Tactical Hologram: Synchronization

[About]
The Synchrolink System is now online in the Exostrider simulator cockpit.
The cockpit is embedded with the Exostrider's neurons, designed for training Synchronists in Augmented Resonance with the Exostrider. 
During this process, Synchronists can measure and record their resonance stress to assess adaptation levels and neural-load thresholds.
Complete training goals to earn Department-issued Synchro Coins, which can be exchanged for a variety of rare supplies and rewards.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 27 and activate the Startorch Academy Resonance Nexus during Main Quest "What Burns Beneath Frostlands."

[Synchro Shop]
Complete Tactical Hologram: Synchronization to obtain Astrite and Synchro Coins, which can be exchanged for rewards at the Synchro Shop.

Tactical Hologram: Synchronization is a permanent event that can be experienced at any time and will continue to be updated in future versions. Please stay tuned.

O Rover guided by the tides, you have climbed the peaks of Jinzhou and listened to the waves crash against the Black Shores. Go to the Resonance Nexus in Jinzhou and unlock the Terminal during Main Quest "First Resonance."

Early access to Chapter II/Chapter III also unlocks Time Adjustment, Resonance Conversion functions, as well as some Utilities.
*For the optimal experience, we recommend completing Chapter II - Segue "Flowing Starlight in the Iris" before starting Chapter III.

Motorbike Progression

[Motorbike Modding Level]
The Motorbike Modding Level can be raised by completing quests in Lahai-Roi, opening Supply Chests, and defeating enemies. Reaching the next Modding Level improves your motorbike's performance and unlocks abundant rewards.
Defeat enemies in Lahai-Roi (including Tacet Discord Nests, Boss Challenge, and Void Storms) to generate Modding EXP, up to a daily limit of 5,000. This limit is reset every day at 04:00 a.m. server time. Modding EXP can no longer be earned once you hit the Modding Level cap.

[Motorbike Specs]
Some of the motorbike's specs can be improved by raising the Modding Level. The motorbike's ATK and Shield Strength increase with your SOL3 Phase. 
 
[Motorbike Expansion Modules]
Complete Motorbike Modding Tasks to obtain Modding Points for specific modules, then spend those points to upgrade the Module to unlock more motorbike functions.
Expansion Modules are either Core or Specialized types. The Specialized Modules can only be effective after being upgraded and installed on the corresponding Motorbike Expansion Modules. Core Modules can be installed on any Motorbike Expansion Module to receive their effects when upgraded.

[Motorbike Modding Tasks]
Expansion Modules have their corresponding Modding Points and Modding Tasks.
Modding Tasks are either Permanent, Limited-Time, or Recurring.
Limited-Time tasks have to be completed within the specified time. They cannot be progressed any further once time is up, and rewards are not granted for uncompleted Limited-Time Tasks.
Limited-Time Tasks in this game version will be replaced with Recurring Tasks after the next game version update. Recurring Tasks are also permanent. You may complete the Recurring Tasks to earn the needed points for the corresponding Expansion Module.

Expansion Module Upgrades

You can upgrade Expansion Modules with Modding Points under the following conditions:
1. Specialized Modules can be upgraded after the preceding module has been upgraded to Lv. 1.
2. Core Modules can be upgraded with sufficient Modding Points.
Motorbike Modding Tasks

Expansion Modules have their corresponding Modding Points and Modding Tasks.
Modding Tasks are either Permanent, Limited-Time, or Recurring.
Limited-Time tasks have to be completed within the specified time. They cannot be progressed any further once time is up, and rewards are not granted for uncompleted Limited-Time Tasks.
Limited-Time Tasks in this game version will be replaced with Recurring Tasks after the next game version update. Recurring Tasks are also permanent. You may complete the Recurring Tasks to earn the needed points for the corresponding Expansion Module.
Defeating Enemies in Lahai-Roi

Defeat enemies in Lahai-Roi (including Tacet Discord Nests, Boss Challenge, and Void Storms) to generate Modding EXP, up to a daily limit of 5,000. This limit is reset every day at 04:00 a.m. server time. Modding EXP can no longer be earned once you hit the Modding Level cap.
Echo Projector

You may project Echoes by equipping unlocked Echoes from the Gallery into the Projector via the Utility Wheel panel. 
When in a designated area, projected Echoes can perform special skills to help you solve puzzles.

[Resonator Level]
As your SOL3 Phase goes up, the level of Support Resonators available for you will increase to the level cap at the current SOL3 Phase.

[Sync Level]
If you reach a new SOL3 Phase during combat with a Support Resonator on your team, they cannot level up automatically. You may later level up your Support Resonator manually via the event page, after you've exited the combat state.
Sky Projection Array Control Module

Use the Spacetrek Observatory to broadcast control signals, adjusting the Sky Projection Array to generate simulated weather across Lahai-Roi.
Certain weathers can only be simulated at specific times and areas. Please make sure you have adjusted to the right time or moved to the corresponding areas for the simulation.
Some weather may trigger special events.
Operation: Frontier Renewal

[About]
Lahai-Roi's route network, along with the Spacetrek Observatory that used to monitor its terrain, ecosystem, and climate, has been devastated by a Void Storm. It's time to rebuild them all!
Use rebuild materials gathered in Lahai-Roi to assist Dhalifa in restoring the Route Network and the Spacetrek Observatory.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 8 and complete Tutorial Quest "Operation: Frontier Renewal"

[Event Rules]
Explore Lahai-Roi and use 3 types of materials to rebuild 10 routes.
Reaching a Route Constructor unlocks it as a Fast Travel point.
Once activated, the Constructor will automatically complete the route rebuild. Restored routes will revitalize the surrounding area, unlocking a variety of side quests and challenges.
Each completed route increases Network Activity. Reaching certain Activity milestones advances the Spacetrek Observatory's rebuild progress.

This event is permanently available. From Version 3.0 onward, you can access this event via the Region Guide on the Lahai-Roi map.

There are two waves of enemies within the Void Storm Zone.

Free Autopilot
The expedition motorbike helps you move faster. Its functionalities improve through upgrades.

When riding the expedition motorbike, you have access to features such as Acceleration, Boost, Drift, and Bounce Jump. While moving, a force field is deployed around the expedition motorbike, and the Resonator will be forced to dismount upon taking damage or being controlled after the force field is down.
You can summon the expedition motorbike or adjust the relevant settings via the Utility Wheel. The motorbike cannot be summoned while in combat or when there is insufficient space.

There is a speed limit when riding the motorbike on the Startorch Academy campus grounds, and Boosting will be restricted. There are certain areas with restricted access for motorbikes.
Riding the motorbike and using Boost on decorated roads does not consume Energy.

{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the Autopilot button to enter Autopilot Mode.
During this time, Cinematic Mode can be switched on, and the game's aspect ratio will change, and automatic camera movement will occur.

After placing a navigation waypoint, a recommended route will be plotted along the highway to the waypoint on the map. Once you are within range of the highway, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Autopilot to arrive near your destination.

On maps that support Autopilot, you can set specific markers as the destination. A recommended route will be plotted on the current road network, allowing you to reach the destination manually or via Autopilot.

Autopilot Mode allows free camera movement and will automatically avoid obstacles (such as traffic) on the road. During Autopilot, feel free to move around the camera, listen to the Heart Radio Channel, take photos, and switch to Cinematic Mode when available.
On highways, Autopilot Mode can still be activated even without a destination, and the expedition motorbike will loop along a designated route on the current road network until you exit the mode.

Novelty is a new card category added to the Lahai-Roi version of Peaks of Prestige. They are items with unique powers.

Novelties can be placed onto the Deployment Zone like Echoes, but do not directly participate in the Battle Stage. Instead, they influence the duel with unique abilities, such as Quick-Deploy, drawing extra cards, or boosting stats.
Keep in mind that Novelties usually last for a limited time or have a set number of uses, and will be shuffled back to your deck after their duration or uses are finished.
While you can only deploy up to 4 Echoes, Novelties have no such limit.
Domain is a new card category added to the Lahai-Roi version of Peaks of Prestige. These cards possess extremely powerful abilities that can shift the tide of any duel.

You may only include one Domain card in your deck. Each Domain features a powerful Active Skill, such as Energy recovery, drawing extra cards, and Quick-Deploy. They can even gain new effects if your deck meets certain requirements.

<color=#ffd12f>Cube Blocker</color> is the core component of the Smartprint Cube. It can be moved along the circuit as long as there is enough secure space along its path.
<color=#ffd12f>Cube Blockers</color> come in two forms, each with different secure space requirements to move.

Use <color=#ffd12f>Directional Input</color> to control the Blocker's movements. Move the <color=#ffd12f>Cube Blocker</color> to the <color=#ffd12f>Endpoint Module</color> to bring the Smartprint Cube back online.
Long Cube Blockers (1x2) must be perfectly aligned to trigger the Smartprint Cube's compilation.
Use the <color=#ffd12f>Reset</color> button to reset the progress.

Bounce Modules launch the Cube Blocker two blocks in the arrow's direction, allowing the Blocker to bypass faulty components on circuit modules.
Long Cube Blockers must be perfectly aligned to trigger this module.
The module will not be triggered if there is not enough secure space for the Blocker in the target direction.
Faulty Components in the circuit cannot be passed through and can be destroyed through other means.

Move the Blocker to the button connected to the Faulty Component to break the component.
Long Cube Blockers must be perfectly aligned to trigger the module.
The module will crack and disappear after the Cube Blocker passes through.

Some compilation processes will involve multiple Cube Blockers. All Cube Blockers must reach the corresponding Endpoint Module to complete compilation.
You can only control one Cube Blocker at a time. Use the <color=#ffd12f>Switch</color> button to change between Blockers.

Data Modification can adjust the stats of Echoes.

Use a Modifier to adjust the first Mainstat of a selected Echo into the designated stat. This can only be done on unupgraded 5-star Echoes.

Use a Transducer to adjust the Substats of a selected Echo to random stats, excluding locked Substats. This can only be done on fully tuned 5-star Echoes.

The number of locked Substats determines the amount of Transducers consumed in each Modification:
With 2 or fewer locked stats, consume 1 Transducer.
With 3 locked stats, consume 2 Transducers.
With 4 locked stats, consume 3 Transducers.
You may choose whether to apply the Modification results in Substat Modification. Discarding the result does not refund used Transducers.

Substat Modification results that are not confirmed due to unexpected errors will be saved in the server for up to 30 days. Please confirm your results in time.

Endless Track

Close cooperation between H.E.R.M.E.S. and the biker is essential to pass the challenges. Once the challenge begins, H.E.R.M.E.S. moves automatically along the track. The biker controls the left and right movement to dodge obstacles and aim at enemies ahead.
During a match, light gates granting buffs appear along the track. Steer H.E.R.M.E.S. through them to collect these buffs (Up to 1 each time.)
Redundant system data manifests into enemies on the track. Shoot them down to claim buffs, or crash through them to clear the path. But crashing causes DMG equal to the enemies' remaining HP.
Special stages feature a boss enemy that stays on the track for a limited time, continuously attacking the biker with projectiles.
Defeating the boss grants Support Items with special buffs, which the biker can claim based on their current build.

Failing to defeat the boss before the countdown ends results in the boss crashing into the biker, dealing DMG based on its remaining HP. The challenge progress is saved after the boss is defeated and Support Items are claimed.
Elites are tougher enemies with higher HP. Defeat them promptly, or the biker will fail to dodge them and take damage.
In this challenge, H.E.R.M.E.S. is equipped with the Main Weapon: Zap Module. It fires an additional laser beam at regular intervals, dealing massive damage.
In this challenge, H.E.R.M.E.S. is equipped with the Main Weapon: Repeater Module. It fires multiple projectiles in a short burst, making it a good choice for focusing fire on a single target.

In this challenge, H.E.R.M.E.S. is equipped with the Main Weapon: Shotgun Module. It fires multiple projectiles at once in a wide, front-facing fan area, making it a good choice for dealing with groups of enemies.

In this challenge, H.E.R.M.E.S.'s Support Droid is equipped with the Orbital Strike Protocol. When attacking, it automatically locks onto targets and calls down an orbital laser strike, dealing area damage to the designated zone.
In this challenge, H.E.R.M.E.S.'s Support Droid is equipped with the Sustained Combustion Protocol. It fires projectiles that inflict a burning effect, continuously dealing damage to the target.
In this challenge, H.E.R.M.E.S.'s Support Droid is equipped with the Guided Missile Protocol. It automatically fires a guided projectile that locks and attacks the closest target.
In Endless Track, H.E.R.M.E.S. continuously generates new track segments, introducing more buffs and powerful boss enemies. Push to your limits and challenge your own record!

The Wild Card changes into a random card (except for the Crownless Card) in the player's hand at the start of each turn. A Wild Card will not change into a card that has already been played or repeat the same transformation in the same turn.
Wild Cards can be used to form pairs, as with standard cards.

Exoswarm Containment Units will appear on the terrain in this challenge. When Exoswarm moves onto a Containment Unit, it enters a Rest state and skips its next turn.
Compact and inconspicuous, Containment Units are difficult for Exoswarm to detect. As a result, Exoswarm will not actively avoid them while moving.

Sigillum gains a stack of Off Course when hit by Echo Skill, stacking up to 5 times. Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once.
Each stack of Off Course makes Sigillum take 10% more total DMG. At 5 stacks, the total DMG taken is increased by another 30%.

The guidance you gave Aemeath in childhood is now in the blade she raises to protect her family. Within a limited time, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Skill to have Aemeath cast the techniques you once taught her, unleashing a joint combo attack.

If Aemeath casts Resonance Skill within a certain time after performing Basic Attack Stage 2, 3, or 4, she can cast Chained Skill Sync Strike: Armament Merge or Sync Strike: Call of Dawn. After that, Aemeath can perform Basic Attacks or Chained Resonance Skill to increase her Synchronization Rate.

When her Synchronization Rate reaches 50%, Aemeath can cast Resonance Skill within a certain time after performing Basic Attack Stage 4, then cast Chained Skill Seraphic Duet: Overture or Seraphic Duet: Encore.

Endstate Matrix

[Endstate Matrix]
In Endstate Matrix, your skills will be tested through intense combats. Confront the enemies and earn points to claim corresponding rewards.

[Eligibility]
Achieve at least 24 Crests in one phase of the Tower of Adversity and reach at least 3,500 points in one phase of the Respawning Waters: Torrents in Whimpering Wastes after 3.2 is released.

[Challenge Cycle & Phases]
Endstate Matrix progresses through Challenge Cycles. Each Challenge Cycle spans across multiple Challenge Phases, which reset with version updates. Rewards are offered independently for Challenge Cycles and Challenge Phases 

[Cycle Rewards - Doomsday Cycle]
The current Challenge Cycle is "Doomsday Cycle". Complete the Cycle Tasks and Challenge Tasks to earn Encrypted Data and unlock exclusive rewards. Encrypted Data will be cleared at the end of the Cycle.
- Cycle Tasks reset at the start of a new Challenge Phase. In Doomsday Cycle, you may earn up to 420 points of Encrypted Data via Cycle Tasks.
- Challenge Tasks update at each Challenge Phase and last for the duration of the Challenge Cycle. In Doomsday Cycle, you may earn 20 points of Encrypted Data via each Challenge Task and up to 180 points in total.

[Matrix]
Endstate Matrix consists of two Zones: Stability Accords and Singularity Expansion. Earn the required points in Stability Accords to unlock Singularity Expansion.

[Stability Accords]
You may deploy up to 3 teams. Defeat all enemies in one round to complete the challenge.

[Singularity Expansion]
There is no limit to the number of teams you can deploy. Defeating all enemies in a round will open the next round, with enemies growing stronger each time.

[Power Circuits]
In Endstate Matrix, you must deploy three Resonators in each team and select a Power Circuit before starting the challenge.

[Demo Resonators]
Demo Resonators are available only if you own the corresponding Resonators. Each Demo Resonator is set to Lv. 90, equipped with a Lv. 90 weapon and a fitting Echo set with Lv. 25 Echoes. They inherit the Resonance Chain from your own Resonators.

[Resonator Enhancements]
In Endstate Matrix, certain Resonators will receive special skill enhancements.

[Viral Infection]
In Singularity Expansion, enemy HP increases by each round, and stronger enemy effects will be unlocked as rounds progress.

[Vigor]
Each time a Resonator participates in a challenge, 1 point of Vigor is consumed. Resonators with 0 Vigor cannot be deployed. Vigor is calculated separately for Stability Accords and Singularity Expansion.

[Weapon & Echo Occupation]
Different Resonators cannot use the same weapon and Echo in this event. If a Resonator in the team has equipped a weapon or Echo used by another Resonator with a challenge record, you cannot start the challenge with this team.

Soar to the Beat

[About]
Enter the world of the Stellar Orbit Beats and pilot your spacecraft through the boundless universe.
Press buttons to the beat in a music face-off with other Resonators.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and activate the Resonance Nexus in Startorch Academy during Main Quest "What Burns Beneath Frostlands" to unlock (for the best experience, please complete this event's preceding quest "Gold Suspended in Shadows").

[Rules]
1. You can access the event via the Stellar Orbit Beats machine in the Mind Dive Arcade or through the Event Page. Pilot your spacecraft alongside other Resonators and hit the notes in time with the music to complete the track. A stage is completed once the spacecraft completes its journey.
2. Fly through space and press the buttons to the beat! Hit the Notes at the right timing to earn Stage Points. Reach the goals for each stage to unlock rewards.
3. Based on your final score, you will receive a Stage Rating of SSS, SS, S, A, or B. A stage will not be finalized if you quit mid-way.
4. Each music track has 3 difficulties: Easy, Normal, and Hard. Easy and Normal are unlocked by default. Hard is unlocked after completing the goals on Normal difficulty.
5. You can team up with unlocked Companion Resonators to challenge a stage together. Each Companion Resonator has their own skills that provide unique buffs.
6. Each track's Hard difficulty features a Friend Ranking leaderboard. Think you've mastered the beats? Compete with your friends for the top spot!
7. Any unclaimed rewards will be sent to your in-game mailbox automatically if you log in within 30 days after the event ends.

[Event Rules]
Use Lucy's Resonance Ability to bring up the Breach Protocol Interface. Select codes from the code matrix to place them in the buffer. In order to complete the hack, match your code sequence in the buffer with the sequence required to upload.

Start from the first row of the code matrix. After selecting a code, the next must be from the same column. Then select from the same row. Keep alternating between column and row with each pick.

Selected codes fill the buffer to match the target sequence. If your code does not match a target sequence in exact order, you must restart that sequence from the beginning.

The breach fails if the remaining empty slots in the buffer are fewer than the unmatched codes in the target sequence.

The breach succeeds only when every target sequence is fully matched.

<color=#ffd12f>Four rare ancient plant specimens known as Voidbane Eldertrees</color> are waiting to be restored. But Void Storms sweep through the Dimmr Plains year-round, and the trees remain stunted by Voidmatter contamination and other anomalies.
You must first work with the Survey Team members and the Soliskin to clear the <color=#ffd12f>Voidmatter contamination and other anomalies</color> around the Voidbane Eldertrees.

The factors hindering the growth of the Voidbane Eldertrees have been removed, but after prolonged exposure to Voidmatter, the plants have entered an adaptive dormant state...
<color=#ffd12f>Deliver the corresponding area's "Restoratives"</color> to restore the growth of the Voidbane Eldertrees.

Restoratives can be obtained in large quantities from the <color=#ffd12f>recommended tasks and challenges within the corresponding sectors</color>.
In addition to recommended tasks, it can also be obtained from <color=#ffd12f>quests, challenges, and Supply Chests</color>.
You can also check which activities drop this item in the <color=#ffd12f>Exploration Progress</color> page.

Once the Restoration is completed, the Voidbane Eldertrees will resume growth, using their own energy to <color=#ffd12f>form bridges linking nearby survey sectors</color>.
It will also create <color=#ffd12f>support mechanisms</color> within the corresponding survey sectors.

Each completed Restoration grants the rare research specimen: Prism Fruit.
Deliver it to <color=#ffd12f>I.R.I.S. at the Base Camp</color> for analysis to advance the survey and <color=#ffd12f>expand the Base Camp</color>.

Once all Restorations are complete, all Prism Fruits have been delivered, and the <color=#ffd12f>Base Camp has been upgraded to Level 5</color>, the Solvein Heartwood's energy overflow will become even more pronounced, and the Dimmr Plains ecosystem will revive once more.

Dimmr Plains - Void Storm Zone

There are many mysterious caves throughout the Dimmr Plains. Interact with the Light Builder at a cave entrance, then rotate the Exostrider components inside until the projection matches the pattern on the wall to open the cave.
Voidcreeps release Voidmatter to erode the surrounding environment. Entering the affected area will continuously drain HP and restrict movement.

Lumescribe Components can suppress Voidmatter and cleanse Voidcreeps. A Voidcreep's tendrils exposed to light will close up, and its main body will shrink and explode after prolonged exposure.
Standing within a Lumescribe Component's range protects you from the Voidcreeps. The Voidcreep tendrils in the area will only disappear after all Voidcreeps in the area have been removed.

Attack or use the Hoverdroid to shoot the Solvein Heartwood Branch to activate a Lumescribe Component. It can also be activated by the light from another Lumescribe Component.
Interact with a Lumescribe Component to move it between rails.
Sometimes obstacles will block the light from a Lumescribe Component. Attack the obstacle to destroy it.
While standing within a Lumescribe Component's range, your Hoverdroid is empowered. Use it to deal a deadly blow to enemies.

The Reactor Drive energy within the Stalaglow Cavern is being eroded by Voidmatter. Purification cannot be completed until the Threnodian creations have been driven off.
Use Lumescribe Components to drive away the Threnodian creations. If the illuminated target is a clone, the clone will be destroyed. If it is the real body, the real body will be shot down.
When you approach a Royan rune fragment, the rune carved by Sigrika will react. Casting the selected rune power allows you to see the rune fragments scattered throughout the area.
Align the scattered rune fragments with the runes on the stone to reveal the complete rune.

A special monster left behind in the Voidthirst Cradle. It seems to have no physical form and cannot be attacked or destroyed.
It will relentlessly pursue intruders and drag them into the void, but remains completely still while being observed.
When you see Voidmatter contamination effect at the edge of the screen, she is getting close. Press the button to turn around quickly at such moments.
Aligning the main body and its reflection triggers resonance, releasing a directional beam that activates nearby mechanisms.

Soliskin Platform is created when Soliskin energy is released through a scientific instrument once contaminated by Voidmatter.
The platform itself is made of unstable Soliskin energy. As you move across it, the unstable platform tilts toward your position.
Soliskin Platform still obeys the laws of light and cannot pass through opaque objects.

When the platform is tilted at the proper angle, you can ask Hiyuki to freeze the Soliskin Platform beneath your feet. A frozen platform temporarily stops tilting.
Use the frozen platform to reach higher ground and continue forward.

A branch of the Solvein Heartwood. It seems to still bear traces of Exostrider creations and can store a small amount of Soliskin energy.
Try striking it to awaken the Soliskin energy within, which can be guided to and reactivate the nearest abandoned mechanics.
The Dimmr Plains are abound with such abandoned mechanics: Lumescribe Emitter, Lumescribe Component, and Soliskin Platform.
Dodge the falling blocks and climb upward using the path they form. First things first, catch up to Denia.
In Voidmatter Blocks, you must dodge the falling blocks until the countdown ends to win the game.

Before a block falls, it will track horizontally above you for a limited time. You can rotate the block by 90 degrees with the Rotate button.
Once you are in the right position, you can manually drop the block.

While dodging the blocks, be careful not to let the stack rise beyond the ready zone. If it does, the game will also fail.
When Voidmatter Blocks fill an entire row, that row is cleared, reducing the stack height.
In Voidmatter Blocks: Infinite, you must dodge falling blocks while also adjusting positions and orientations to earn points. Reach certain milestones to claim rewards.

Before a block falls, it will track horizontally above you for a limited time. You can rotate the block by 90 degrees with the Rotate button.
Once you are in the right position, you can manually drop the block. Manually dropping a block grants bonus points.

While dodging the blocks, be careful not to let the stack rise beyond the ready zone. If it does, the game will also fail.
When Voidmatter Blocks fill an entire row, that row is cleared for a large score bonus. The more rows cleared at once, the greater the bonus.
Once activated, it condenses Exostrider energy into a beam that can clear Voidmatter contamination and certain obstacles.
One side of it is a smooth, mirror-like surface. When struck by the Origami Construct's energy, it forms crystals that reflect beams. Can be rotated after interaction.
A construct issued by the Spacetrek Collective to members of the Dimmr Plains Survey Team for protection against Voidmatter threats. While aiming, it can alter the state of Rock Mirror.
Once activated, the Speed Pipe propels the gliding expedition motorbike forward without consuming energy.
Touch Score Rings to gain points and restore energy.

Advance on a designated track, get past any obstacles in your way, and earn enough points to complete the challenge.
Use Drift to slide under barriers or Bounce Jump to leap over obstacles. You may also use Drift to swing out the motorbike through certain spots to grab more points.
After interaction, a large number of motorbike mechanisms and score items will appear in the field. Earn enough points within the time limit to complete the challenge.
Hiyuki has left traces of her frequency throughout the Dimmr Plains. You can activate the power sealed within them in the face of threats.
A special plant found in the Dimmr Plains. Use the Projector to blow it away for a possible surprise reward.
After the Stridergate incident, faint traces of Voidmatter still remain in Lahai-Roi. Use the Voidwing Moth Echo to dispel the Voidmatter residue.

In the Dimmr Plains Void Storm Zones, when a Resonator takes enemy damage, they gain 1 stack of Warp, increasing all DMG taken by 10%.
Casting Tune Break Skill on the second wave of enemies restores HP to the Resonator and removes Warp. When the Resonator attacks enemies or inflicts Negative Statuses, enemies lose HP over time for a certain duration. This effect can stack.
