<color=#ffd12f>Supporting</color> a Cube consumes a player's Popularity. <color=#ffd12f>Popularity</color> can be obtained by completing the event's <color=#ffd12f>Daily Tasks</color>.

If your prediction turns out wrong, 80% of the Popularity spent on Support will be refunded.

Based on the Support a Cube receives and its starting position, the Cube's <color=#ffd12f>Underdog Odds</color> are <color=#ffd12f>refreshed</color> daily at 4:00, 12:00, and 18:00.

Breach Protocol
About Breach Protocol

In the Breach Protocol Interface, select the code sequence required to upload from the code matrix and shelve the sequence in the buffer.

To complete the hack, match the code sequence in the buffer with the sequence required to upload.
How to use Breach Protocol

In the Breach Protocol Interface, start from the first row of the code matrix. After selecting the first code, the next one must be chosen from the column of the previously selected code. After that, you must select from the row of the new selection. This row-column alternation continues throughout. Selected codes will be shelved in the buffer for matching with the target sequence.
Breach Protocol: Successful Hack

If the selected sequence does not match the target sequence in the exact order, you'll need to start from the beginning.

The hack will fail if the number of unfilled slots in the buffer is less than the number of unmatched segments in the Target Sequence.

The hack will succeed only when all Target Sequences are fully completed.

Phantasma Dreamland: Rhapsody

[Phases & Days]
- In each phase, you must reach the required revenue target within the given days to advance to the next phase.
- Entering a new phase will raise the difficulty of the Phase Goal.
- <color=#c79f49>Completing all Phase Goals</color> to clear the stage.
- Each new phase grants some Frequency Crystals and will <color=#c79f49>automatically deduct the required Dreamland Coupons for the previous phase</color>.

[Weekly Activity Points]
You can obtain corresponding Weekly Activity Points after achieving a certain number of goals and completing stage settlements. Completing the goals of phases 1 to 7 will grant 400/800/1,200/1,600/2,000/2,400/3,000 Weekly Activity Points respectively, and completing goals of phases 8 to 12 in Infinite Mode will grant 3,600/4,200/4,800/5,400/6,000 Weekly Activity Points respectively.
 
[Dreamland Echo]
- The number of Dreamland Coupons earned each day is affected by the Echoes, props, and Dream Block types.
- A maximum of 20 Echoes can be placed on the field at one time. Up to <color=#c79f49>100</color> Echoes can be accommodated on and off the field. 
- At the start of each new day, Echoes on the field will randomly change positions.
- If the field is full when a new Echo arrives, the newcomer will be concealed and may appear on the field the next day.
 - As phases progress, the rarity of Echoes available for recruitment will gradually increase, up to Gold rarity.
- Echoes with Dream of Connection attribute will be added to the recruitment pool once unlocked.

[Dreamland Props] 
- Dreamland Props offer a variety of special effects. You can possess up to 10 Props at a time.
- Dreamland Props are divided into multiple rarity levels. The higher the rarity, the more difficult it is to obtain. Relic is the highest rarity.
- Dreamland Props can be sold for Frequency Crystals, except for Relics.
- Dreamland Props can be obtained from the Dreamland Shop or Strange Encounters.

[Dreamland Shop] 
- Dreamland Shop automatically pops up upon entering a new phase.
- Frequency Crystals can be spent to purchase Echoes and Props in Dreamland Shop.

[Phantasma Blessing]
- Phantasma Blessings provide different effects that can aid in Dreamland management.
- Each use consumes one Blessing attempt. Once all attempts are used, Blessings can no longer be activated.
 
[Dreamland Details]
- In the Dreamland Detail page, you can view all Echoes currently on and off the field, as well as your daily yield.
- In the Dreamland Detail page, you can also <color=#c79f49>Dismiss</color> any Echoes on the field.

[Strange Encounters]
- There is a chance to trigger Strange Encounters during your operation.
- Choose your encounters based on your Dreamland's situation.
 
[Infinite Mode]
- Stages offer Infinite Mode after being cleared.
- In Infinite Mode, Phase Goals are significantly harder to reach, and the Phase durations will be <color=#c79f49>infinite</color>. Your challenge is considered successful once you reach the system limit for revenue.
- You can choose to end the run at any time, and it will still count as a cleared challenge.

His ability to analyze escape routes was second to none. No fugitive ever slipped past his calculations.
You spot a young delivery girl dodging a pack of monsters while a cargo box bobs on her back.
The moment you see her, her name pops into your mind. She is one of the three Prescients overseeing Psyche Pass—the Fleece Prescient.
Through the rain, you catch sight of a man's silhouette.
Against the moonlight, his face is veiled in its shadow, but you can see the curve of his eyes, the faintest hint of a smile there.
You realize it's a hidden outpost built as a place for Sentries to rest and recover.
But you're not the first to arrive. You barely have time to take it all in before you come face-to-face with a squad of resting Sentries.
A hunt is closing in, swift and inevitable, like a storm on the horizon.

"Good morning, everyone. Thank you for watching Megalopolis Today. We begin today's morning news with a report on an attack by unidentified lifeforms that occurred at Memorial Park around 9:30 p.m. yesterday. Local authorities have confirmed that all victims have been safely transported to Central Hospital for treatment, and surprisingly zero deaths resulted from the incident. Witnesses claim seeing a second unidentified lifeform using flames to eliminate the creatures involved in the attack. Now, let's turn our attention to the live report from our correspondent on the scene." On the glowing screen, a woman sits in a spacious office, speaking directly to the camera.

"Thank you. Behind me is the scene where the attack took place last night. Even at this distance, the destruction caused by these unidentified lifeforms is extensive. As you can see, the damaged concrete structures and…" The scene cuts to an outdoor area filled with foliage, as the man referred to as the news correspondent continues his report. You quickly realize this is a live broadcast using a communication device similar to a Terminal.
"Mom! I'm on TV!" An excited citizen suddenly bursts into the frame.

"As you can see, the damaged concrete structures and exposed steel reinforcements are riddled with holes. It appears that one of the unidentified lifeforms may have used a firearm, and scorch marks are visible on the wreckage..."
"What a load of crap!" A citizen with a thick accent suddenly pops up from below the screen.
"Yeah! What do you mean, 'unidentified lifeform using flames'?! It was Flame Ranger, for Sentinel's sake. The Guardian of the City!"
"Flame Ranger! Flame Ranger! Flame Ranger!"
The screen flickers, accompanied by a burst of static, before cutting back to the news studio.

"It seems we've run into some issues with the feed from our correspondent. Next up on Megalopolis Today, a meet-and-greet signing event scheduled this morning for the comic book artist, Danqing, was canceled after the organizers failed to contact the artist. The venue is now packed with fans who have been waiting in line since the night before..."

"I can't believe it! You saw what happened last night, right, Abby? You were there. Up close. You saw how I was kicking butt and taking names. In what world did I come remotely close to being like one of those monsters?"
"(Yawns)... How long was I asleep...? You say something, Chixia?"
"Chixia? Who's Chixia? My full name is Flame Ranger—Tch, ow! I'm still sore there..."
You remember the hint from that *piece of paper*. It appears that you're already inside a "movie."
"Either way! No one got hurt in the end, which is great. Thanks for having my back yesterday, partner."
"Yesterday?"

"WHEEEEEEEEOOOO—WHEEEEEEEEOOOO—WHEEEEEEEEOOOO—" Your conversation is interrupted by the wail of an ambulance screeching past you.

"This year, they voted my city the best place to live in Solaris-3. Main reasons? Lowest rates of violence, and community satisfaction scores higher than anywhere else. Can't deny it, it's all true. This city's always got a new promise for you—"

You arrive at what appears to be a train station. Inside the steel behemoth, the air is thick with the clamor of people coming and going and the constant murmur of the PA system blaring the same message on a loop. Truth be told, you've never seen this many bodies packed together, not even during the Carnevale in Ragunna...
Suddenly, a girl with a familiar blue hat stops you in your tracks.
"Hello. I am the Public Security officer on duty. May I see your identifications, please? ...Hmm? You're the girl from the accident scene earlier..."
"Huh? Isn't this Yangyang? What's up with this Public Security officer thing?"
"It's probably something similar to a Patroller..." You whisper, keeping your voice low. Abby responds with a puzzled nod.
"Oh, hey! If it isn't my favorite officer! Here's my ID."

"Mm... In light of recent incidents, we're conducting security checks at all points of entry... for the safety of the public." After verifying your IDs, the officer gestures for you to proceed. "Your IDs are in order. Thank you for your cooperation."
"Incidents. You mean those freaky monsters causing all the chaos, right?"

"Yes. We still haven't figured out the pattern or logic behind their movements. All we know is that they attack anything on sight." The officer frowns as if recalling the incidents from the past days.

"We have to treat this with the utmost caution. Places like the train station, the business districts, and Central Hospital are packed with people. If something happens, we Public Security officers are the first line of defense."
"Being an officer sure is tough... Wouldn't it be great if Flame Ranger could swoop in every time and save the day?"
"Uh... Hehe..."
"This Flame Ranger... the one from yesterday's incident?" It's clear that the name has caught the officer's attention.
"What do you make of this Flame Ranger, Officer?"
"Flame Ranger... She's shown up during multiple crises... From her actions, it seems she's either a masked hero or a vigilante."
"You mean the legendary Ally of Justice?"
"Justice...? Her abilities are disturbingly similar to those of the unidentified lifeforms. For the sake of public safety, I'm afraid I can't condone someone like that living in the city."
"If we just accept what she's doing, what happens if one day she loses control and turns into one of those mindless creatures?"
"Phew. She's got her hands full, huh? See? I told you being an officer is tough."
A sudden burst of noise erupts from a nearby crowd. You turn to glimpse a massive creature emerging from the shadows between buildings.
A shadow in the shape of a bird cuts across your vision—the officer with the blue hat. Weapon drawn, she leaps forward, rushing straight toward the fleeing crowd.
"Hey! Wait up, Officer!"
"Everyone, get back! Now! Move this way and remain calm!"
"I'm with Public Security. Follow my lead and evacuate the building to my left!"
"See, what did I just tell ya... Wait, where are you going?"

Beneath your feet, the Gondola glides steadily through the water, the ripples reflecting the stars in Ragunna's night sky.

You drift from the northern seas toward the city on the verge of losing itself in celebration.

He yawns in your direction

The Court of Mercury is unnervingly silent.

The stillness of it all unsettles you.

Inside the office, a navy blue chandelier hangs from the ceiling. A soft halo of blue light fills the room, as though the space itself were submerged beneath the sea's ebb and flow.

The festivities have begun. Every lamppost in the city is aglow, their warm yellow light spilling through the windows.

The High Adjudicator's office provides an unrivaled view of the Carnevale, with an unobstructed sightline to the central square. A telescope even stands beside the desk.
Every past High Adjudicator has enjoyed the celebrations in comfort from this very spot, year after year.
Yet, at this moment, only a lone clerk occupies the office.

The ambush turned on its head.

About Map Exploration
 
[Events]
There are various types of events on the map, each with the following effects:
Story Event: A mandatory event required to progress, including the main story and final challenge.
Battle Event: Engage in battle and earn Dream Fragments based on the battle's difficulty.
Random Event: Trigger different outcomes.
Recruitment Event: Spend Dream Fragments to recruit Resonators.
Respite Event: Restore Film Rolls.
 
[Film Roll]
Film Rolls are consumed by Battle Events, Random Events, and Story Events.
If you are defeated in a battle, use Film Rolls to restore your Resonators to their pre-battle state.
 
[Bond]
Bonds can be formed between certain Resonators, and a Resonator can hold multiple Bonds.
Bonds provide combat buffs that apply to all Resonators unless specified otherwise.
Bond Level is based on the Star Ratings of all Resonators sharing the same Bond.
Increase the Bond Level to unlock its unique Synergy Burst.

[Synergy Burst]
When three Resonators with the same Bond are in the team, their Synergy Burst is triggered, providing the following effects:
1. Targets are immediately immobilized.
2. Resonance Skill and Resonance Liberation Cooldown are reset. Resonance Energy is recovered and 100 Concerto Energy is restored.

New skills for Queen of the Night!

<color=Highlight>[Burst Bubble]</color>: Burst Bubbles track Resonators and detonate after a short delay, dealing damage to herself (<color=Highlight>2% of her Max HP</color>) or Resonators and other enemies (<color=Highlight>10% of their Max HP</color>).

<color=Highlight>[Healing Bubble]</color>: Healing Bubbles track Queen of the Night and restore herself (<color=Highlight>2% of her Max HP</color>) or Resonators and other enemies (<color=Highlight>10% of their Max HP</color>).

The creeping malevolence gnaws at the Queen of the Night, driving her to flood the Sea of Clouds with chaotic tides. Yet, as a being enlightened by the Sentinel and entrusted with purging corrupt frequencies, a sliver of sanity may remain in her to help you end this calamity.

Reconstructed arena for Fleurdelys!

<color=Highlight>[Shielded Crown]</color>: When Fleurdelys's HP drops below <color=Highlight>20%</color> for the first time, she gains a <color=Highlight>Shield equal to 50% of her Max HP</color>.

<color=Highlight>[Realm]</color>: Fleurdelys's arena is always shifting. Resonators gain corresponding buffs when staying in different zones. While in <color=Highlight>Realm of Spear</color> in the center of the arena, Resonators <color=Highlight>deal 30% more DMG to shielded enemies</color>. While in <color=Highlight>Realm of Shield</color> that covers the entire arena, Resonators <color=Highlight>gain a Shield equal to 10% of their Max HP every 5s</color>, which is unstackable. While in moving <color=Highlight>Realm of Resonance</color>, all Resonators in the team <color=Highlight>restore 10 points of their Resonance Energy each second</color>.

The two opposing forces, the Sentinel and Threnodian, had etched their unique frequencies deep into Avinoleum's very essence. Here, unpredictable anomalies occur and fade without warning. Stay sharp in the constantly changing environment and brace yourself for the relentless storms of echoing blades.

Aid from the packs for Feilian Beringal!

<color=Highlight>Bear Will</color>: Feilian Beringal summons a <color=Highlight>Spearback</color> to help the first time its HP drops below <color=Highlight>75%</color>. <color=Highlight>Ape Spirit</color>: Feilian Beringal summons a <color=Highlight>Hoochief Menace</color> to help the first time its HP drops below <color=Highlight>55%</color>. Hoochief Menace sacrifices its HP to restore <color=Highlight>0.2% of Feilian Beringal's Max HP</color> each second.

<color=Highlight>Group Aid</color>: Feilian Beringal summons <color=Highlight>Havoc Dreadmane and Spearback</color> again to help the first time its HP drops below <color=Highlight>30%</color>. They provide corresponding buffs to Feilian Beringal.

With the other Tacet Discords fueling its rage, Feilian Beringal has unleashed a violent storm of frequencies, pushing its horde toward Ragunna in a relentless expansion. To end this onslaught, you must cut the beast's ties to its allies!

I never really got this Namipon's way of speaking. Last I saw, it was wandering <color=#d08c0f>in a residential park near Sakura Quarter</color>. Oh, and those ad banners by the store... Wait, why aren't they in the same style?

If I remember right, this Namipon loves a good view with pastries. And around here, the best view has to be where <color=#d08c0f>sakura petals drift across the water</color>. You'll probably find it there.

Honestly, this Namipon might be the bravest of the lot… though of course I'm still better. Last sighting was in the <color=#d08c0f>Meishin Passageway</color>, where most of Honami's urban legends are set.

This one works in Honami's <color=#d08c0f>Commercial District</color>, serrated with office buildings and malls. But in that concrete jungle, there's a <color=#d08c0f>giant cherry blossom tree</color> so tall its branches cover the sky... I wonder how it got that big.

As a pro detective, I can say with certainty this Namipon is hiding in the <color=#d08c0f>Meishin Passageway</color>—the stage of countless urban legends. It also loves to leave riddles that only it finds challenging. If you spot any <color=#d08c0f>odd objects around</color>, that's probably its work.

One of my fellow capybaras swears they saw it in <color=#d08c0f>the underground street</color>, being chased by a Tacet Discord. But they call it the Student with Ultimate Luck, so it'll probably be fine... I guess.
This one's drawn to water, so keep an eye on <color=#d08c0f>pools around here</color>. A capybara disguised as a mermaid should be... *relatively* easy to spot, right?

The Nami Clan once ruled the underground street. They say if you light a lamp in the dark, someone will come to your aid. If you're looking for the yakuza Namipon, try your luck at <color=#d08c0f>Seisen Garden</color>. It's deep in the underground street.

Not long ago, it left a note saying it went to the park for ninja training. After that, no word. But come to think of it, have you noticed the new Namipon statues under <color=#d08c0f>the wisteria tree in Central Park</color>? Could that be its doing?
This Namipon is the type to hit every single spot in the guidebook when visiting somewhere new. By now, it's probably already wandered to <color=#d08c0f>Central Park</color>.

Parks are often refuges for the downhearted. The Left Behind here say it's often seen alone in <color=#d08c0f>a pavilion</color>, staring blankly into the air. Ah, such is the melancholic world of an adult capybara.

Sakura Quarter

Once hailed as "Honami City's most beautiful living quarter," Sakura Quarter was a place where cherry blossoms framed the rows of residences in a picturesque harmony. Cross the blossom-shaped footbridge and walk a few blocks, and you would see the famous "Sakura Upon Water" spot, a favorite for young lovers. The housing prices here, however, were anything but beautiful.

In the past, the neighborhood was safe, uneventful, and almost free of ghost stories. But after the Lament, tales began to spread. Many speak of the "Mysterious Scissorswoman," a black-haired, red-eyed schoolgirl. At times, she leaps from rooftops, drifting down like a crow's feather. At others, she flashes across the streets, cutting through TDs with her giant scissors. Some say she came from Hell, others call her a hero of justice, while a few whisper that her figure in battle resembles the legendary miko herself.

Even before the Lament, Meishin Passageway was already a fixture among Honami's urban legends. In the strictest sense, it refers to a passage connecting two parallel tunnels in the Commercial District, open only during certain times of the year. Many residents swore they heard strange noises, saw traffic cones gathering on their own, or felt a tap on the shoulder, only to turn and find no one.

Though the city hall insisted that it was just an old service passage from construction, this hardly deterred the thrill-seekers. Over the years, tales multiplied. Some claimed that ten minutes inside meant a full day outside. The best-known story came from a local radio interview. A man said the passageway had granted his wish by letting him see his long-departed family... His proof was a limited-edition Namipon plushie with a unique serial number, which was thought to be destroyed in a fire, but somehow appeared in the passageway.

Hanakage Underground Street was originally part of Honami's subway system, and was later repurposed into a cultural passage themed around contemporary art. Before the Lament, quarterly film festivals and exhibitions filled the streets with artworks from across Ashinohara. The gift shops sold unique souvenirs that could only be found in Honami.

Of all its events, the annual "Honami Urban Legend Exhibition" always drew the largest crowds. Submissions ranged from amateur films by students to pieces by renowned photographers of the Pioneer Association. One anonymous short film went almost unnoticed at the time of its debut, but years later, it resurfaced in public debate. Countless interpretations sprang up, as tales in the film began to manifest in reality, one by one: "The Migrating Fish Windsocks," "The Wish-Granting Passageway," and "The Midnight Ghost Bus."

Contrary to popular memory, the park around Neon Tower predates the tower itself. In fact, Neon Tower was sited here precisely because the park's open grounds would minimize radio interference. After the tower's completion, the original Honami City Park was expanded into Honami Central Park, a proud symbol of the city center. At the time, it also stood as the largest park in all of Ashinohara.

Its first urban legend came shortly after staff began hanging fish windsocks. One morning, they discovered that every windsock, once scattered across the park, had gathered above the innermost garden. Not long after, the Pioneer Association published a grainy, shocking video captured by a citizen staying late there one night: under the moonlight, many windsocks glided through the sky toward a single spot, as if they were alive...

Hyvatia is Spacetrek Collective's first detection array built at Sundermere to monitor and stabilize the Reactor Drive's energy state in real time.

The Research Institute implanted the Exostrider's space-time error correction module runtime into Hyvatia's core, allowing Hyvatia to adjust the Exostrider's orbit and detect hidden spaceborne threats with high precision. Therefore, Hyvatia possesses sufficient computational power to predict the Reactor Drive's rotation.

Hyvatia's core function is to detect abnormal or dangerous energy fluctuations, perform immediate emergency calibrations, and feed this data back to the Drive to ensure stable operation.

After the Reactor Drive was set above Lahai-Roi by the Exostrider, it remained on high alert to the activities of Aleph-1. 

When the Drive's immune response is triggered, a mechanized "Reactor Husk" will arise from the depths of the energy well, with the sole purpose of eliminating intruders at all costs.

Research by Spacetrek Collective shows that Reactor Husk was once part of the Exostrider. Both share a mission to resist the Threnodian threat and safeguard civilization.

A warm, humid haven beneath the Roya Frostlands. Following an ancient polar shift, this region became the new Solaris pole, prompting the Roya to migrate below ground. Here, the Spacetrek Collective established Startorch Academy. Today, this borderless academic city has become a cradle for countless rising scholars.

Officially Spacetrek Collective: Startorch Academy, it stands as a borderless scientific community dedicated to the pure pursuit of knowledge. Its name reflects its ethos, "to carry the flame of inquiry and ignite the torch of civilization." Within this vast academic city, knowledge flows freely and cultures meet in harmony.

A grand observational array established by Startorch Academy. Unlike the Cassettes, which record humanity, this system was built to record Lahai-Roi. It continuously tracks terrain shifts, ecological cycles, and celestial disturbances wrought by Void Storms and the Threnodian, like a giant eye observing the turning of the ages.

A colossal lift linking Lahai-Roi to the Roya Frostlands, its structure resembling a spine piercing both heaven and earth. Powered by orbital-acceleration technology, it plummets and ascends through the deep cavern, serving as one of Lahai-Roi's most important transportation hubs.

A sacred homeland of the Roya and the habitat of the Soliskin. Bathed in the radiance of the Reactor Drive, its towering trees reach hungrily toward the light, their deep, interwoven roots returning that energy to the earth.

A vast waterfall often visited by Jetrays. When they leap in unison, their silver wings form a shimmering curtain, hence the name. They travel in flocks for mutual protection, and Roya herders are often seen being carried by their wings, crossing the skies together in serene harmony.

As you explore Lahai-Roi, a new Expedition Motorbike Utility will be available

The expedition motorbike helps you move faster. Its functionalities improve through upgrades.

When on the expedition motorbike, use features such as acceleration, Boost, Drift, and Bounce Jump etc. While moving, a force field is deployed around the expedition motorbike, and the Resonator will be forced to dismount once the force field is down.

The motorbike is equipped with the Adaptive Hook module, which can be used to grab resources, Sonance Caskets, and other items over long distances.  

The motorbike is able to receive the Heart Radio Channel, allowing you to tune in and enjoy your favorite music while on the road.

Numerous Challenge Tracks can be found in Lahai-Roi for you to take on with the motorbike.

A new battle mechanic has been added when Resonators battle enemies: Off-Tune Mechanic.

Off-Tune and Mistune

Your Resonators' attacks build up enemies' Off-Tune Level. Once the enemy's Off-Tune Level reaches the limit, they enter the Mistune state.

During the enemy's Mistune state, your Resonators can unleash a powerful Tune Break, dealing additional damage. Landing a Tune Break resets the enemies' Off-Tune Level.
Within a period after being struck by Tune Break, the enemy's Off-Tune level cannot be built up again.

Tune Break

For powerful enemies, once their Off-Tune Level is full, Resonators must cast a Tune Break skill to deal Tune Break damage to enemies in the Mistune State.

Tune Break skills deal damage to enemies, reduce their Vibration Strength, interrupt their attack patterns, and reset their Off-Tune Level.

In ancient times, the shift in magnetic poles centered Solaris's planetary axis on Lahai-Roi. Gradually, over the ages, the cavern beneath layers of ice became home to human settlement.

In this warm, humid underground haven, the "sun" the people speak of is something else entirely. Look upward. The ██ brings here constant, unyielding daylight. Yet one question lingers in the author's heart:
If one day the ██ were to fall dark, what would become of us?

It may not be the largest cafeteria in Solaris, but it is definitely the most advanced. Every meal follows rigorous safety standards, with scientifically tailored nutritional values, ready made for long-term storage in even the harshest environments.

...To adapt to the vast and complex terrain of the underground haven, a new type of all-terrain vehicle was developed.

Though officially designed for research expeditions, the user manual contains no explicit rule against taking it for a joyride beyond the grounds of Startorch Academy.

Long before the Spacetrek Collective was founded, the self-sufficient nomadic Roya people had already made their home in these vast caverns. The construction of both Startorch Academy and the Research Institute would not have been possible without their help.

Drawing upon mechanical remnants of the ██, the Roya forged a settlement unlike any other. Skilled in astronomy and chronology, they are said to guard an ancient mission—awaiting the day they might repair and awaken the slumbering ██.

Do Clockatoos Dream of Electric Schedules? (Excerpt) ...The crown feathers of a Clockatoo form the hour and minute hands on a living "clock face." At fixed hours each day, it lets out a clear, piercing call. A light tap on its head will silence it. For this reason, most Roya use the Clockatoo as an "alarm-capable" timepiece and timer. Note: Bringing Clockatoos into the dormitory is strictly forbidden by the Academy.

In ancient times, It held up heaven and earth with a colossal sword; Its body nourished all life, and its blazing, deathless ██ drove back darkness from this world.

Now, upon the frozen land, it lies in silent slumber...

The main road linking Startorch Academy and the Spacetrek Observatory. The now desolate, muddy path still bears the marks of the convoys that once struggled through here.
A cliffside road carved into the mountain. The Void Storm that ravaged the Observatory erased this route as well, leaving only the wind's scream where traffic once passed.
A cliffside road carved into the mountain. After the Void Storm destroyed the northern section, this stretch too fell into decay, its cracked surface now buried beneath sand and dirt.
Loose soil covers this broken roadway. Once a key link between the primary network and the cliffside roads, it is now all but impassable.
A level road tracing the lakeshore. Even its sweeping views cannot restore the vitality the pavement itself has lost.
A long highway stretching across southern Lahai-Roi, initially a natural path leading to Bjartr Woods. The Roya refer to it as Godhfavn, meaning "embrace of the divine."
A road connecting the Howling Tunnel to Startorch Academy. Damage has rendered its steep incline nearly impossible to traverse.
The winds roar through this massive natural tunnel, like the rumbling of the Exostrider's throat. The Roya call it Jotunhals, meaning "throat of the Exostrider."
A grand bay bridge linking Bjartr Woods and the Etching Plains. Several years ago, a tremor from Sundermere fractured its structure, and it eventually collapsed after seasons of erosion.

An underwater tunnel connecting Bjartr Woods to Sundermere. Deep under the seabed, the Exostrider's greatsword causes unusual tectonic shifts, frequently compromising the integrity of the tunnel's rushed and flawed design.

Advance… extend… the foundations of the Observatory…
("After the Void Storm, the foundations of the Spacetrek Observatory were heavily damaged. Fortunately, most of the energy conversion array built on top remained functional. So the team decided to retract the foundations to prevent further wear. Once resources were sufficient, we would extend them again and begin structural repairs," says Dhalifa!)

The Suspension Platform is the Observatory's primary support and control core. Restoring it calls for no small amount of resources and effort. Let's get through it together.
("The Suspension Platform we're rebuilding won't just support the main body of the Spacetrek Observatory, it will also become the primary workspace for the researchers. Its upper level will even feature an open plaza where people can relax and enjoy the view of the Etching Plains. I can't wait to see the platform after it's fully restored," says Dhalifa!)

When the Spacetrek Observatory first began recording Lahai-Roi's ecology, climate, and landscapes, many researchers who had worked tirelessly for it broke into tears. It was our way of resisting the Void Storms that could erase even existence. And now, with your help, we stand only one step from rebuilding it. I hope you, too, will feel what we felt on that day! (So says Dhalifa!)

Now that the Spacetrek Observatory is operating again, Lahai-Roi's long-shut eyes have reopened. Everything it observes is once more captured in tangible records, streams of data flowing into the Suspension Platform like the pulse of the earth. The researchers will analyze, interpret, and archive this information to assist the Spacetrek Collective in studying Void Storm activity.

The main road linking Startorch Academy and the Spacetrek Observatory. Students often pull over here to capture the colossal silhouette of the Observatory against the distant sky.

A cliffside road carved into the mountain. Researchers studying Lahai-Roi's terrain often marvel at the vast, arcing walls. When convoys pass through, echoes rise from the valley's depths as if answering their awe.
A cliffside road carved into the mountain, linking the Spacetrek Observatory with the broader southern Lahai-Roi. A waterfall shrouded in mist marks the road's end.

A key link between the primary network and the cliffside roads. When headlights cut through the sandy wind, travelers can't help but glance toward the distant sandstorm, catching glimpses of a giant shadow moving within.
A level waterside road offering a sweeping view. Under the Reactor's glow, the lake shimmers with flecks of light. As you pass, the reflected shoreline shifts and dances across the ripples.

A long highway stretching across southern Lahai-Roi. With the Solisylum's approval, the Spacetrek Collective expanded Godhfavn, turning it into a fully developed highway. Out of respect to the Roya, the original name was preserved and translated as Sol's Embrace.

A road connecting the Howling Tunnel to Startorch Academy. Compared to other roads near the Academy, the Starleap Ascent is of moderate length and has varying road conditions, making it one of the main sites for students' expedition motorbike tests.

After reinforcing the rock walls and paving the highway, the tunnel can now accommodate heavy transport, shortening the journey from Startorch Academy to southern Lahai-Roi. The winds that once echoed here are now said to carry a different meaning: they are the Exostrider's blessing for Roya students heading to the Academy.

A grand bay bridge linking Bjartr Woods to the Etching Plains and Startorch Academy. For Roya students bound for the Academy, the bridge is a gateway to a new life. With anticipation, anxiety, and excitement, they step onto it and begin their academic journey.

An underwater tunnel connecting Bjartr Woods to Sundermere. Rebuilt with a new blueprint, the tunnel now withstands the tectonic shifts caused by the Exostrider's greatsword. Beyond improved durability, its transparent structure offers travelers a stunning panoramic experience.

A spacious lobby filled with soothing greenery. It's the perfect place to unwind, whether you're taking a moment of rest on the plush sofas or enjoying a friendly card game with companions.
A wide selection of drinks and snacks is served here. Thanks to the tireless efforts of Lollo Logistics, ingredients from across Solaris all find their way here.
The items once displayed here have long since vanished into the passage of time. Perhaps your own collection could be used to fill these empty display cases once more.
A relaxing swimming pool awaits here. To immerse yourself here is to bathe in the frozen starlight of Sonoro, gathered here in one place.
From here, you can gaze out at the distant view of the Sonoro. Between the carefully trimmed hedges and lawns, the occasional chirping of birds and insects drifts through the air.

This place once housed a diverse film collection as well as Mr. Geisel's ride. Though those symbols of dreams and memories are no longer here, your own ride and the Startorch Academy's promotional video now stand in their place, giving form to new dreams and hopes.
This is Mr. Geisel's private study. Meticulously maintained by Cobb Copo, the room feels suspended in time—as if its owner has merely closed an unfinished book and stepped out for a moment.

For the biomechs that escaped their cages, becoming true beasts has always been their deepest desire. Unfortunately, they were created with far too much humanity and far too little savagery.
The biomechs attempted to pass the "wisdom" stored in their databases on to other creatures, but mutual understanding was never possible.
This is an age of machines, and a great one at that.
Some researchers believe biomechs are capable of appreciating "art." Most, however, insist that it is nothing more than algorithmic hallucination.
Now, with the hard-won freedom on the line, the biomechs stand ready for a desperate battle.
No one knows why the biomechs targeted the research funds. Perhaps an early trading system has formed among them. Or perhaps it was simply an attempt to disrupt the project.

Riot Blades
Lv. 0: <color=Highlight>Energy Regen</color> is increased by 50%. Cannot be downed during the challenge.
Lv. 1: When dealing <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color> or dealing damage with <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color>, fire Riot Blades toward nearby enemies, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. CD: 4s.
Lv. 2: <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> Cooldown is reduced by 50%. Riot Blades last longer and can orbit for a short distance, its Cooldown is reduced by 2s.
Lv. 3: <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> DMG is Amplified by 200%. For every enemy hit by Riot Blades, restore 5 Resonance Energy.

Mind Shock
Lv. 0: When <color=Highlight>in Mid-air</color>, Crit. DMG is increased by 100%. The effect is removed 2s after landing. Cannot be downed during the challenge.
Lv. 1: When <color=Highlight>in Mid-air</color>, every 4 hits generate a Data Core, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
Lv. 2: Data Core generation is reduced to 2 hits. Each generation splits into 3 cores, increasing damage radius and causing enemies to take 60% Amplified damage.
Lv. 3: Data Core triggers Mind Shock, dealing additional damage.

Impulse Tide
Lv. 0: Dealing <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color> or dealing damage with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> grants 60% All-Attribute DMG Bonus. Cannot be downed during the challenge.
Lv. 1: Dealing <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color> or dealing damage with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>, creates an Impulse Tide that pulls in nearby targets and deals <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>. CD: 5s.
Lv. 2: Cooldown of Impulse Tide is reduced by 2s. Affected targets take 60% Amplified damage.
Lv. 3: Impulse Tide releases a shockwave, dealing additional damage.

Hypnotic Chant
Lv. 0: All <color=Highlight>Negative Status</color> DMG is Amplified by 100%. Cannot be downed during the challenge.
Lv. 1: Defeating a target affected by <color=Highlight>Negative Statuses</color> leaves behind a Ceaseless Chant, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> per second to nearby targets.
Lv. 2: Damage dealt to enemies affected by <color=Highlight>Negative Statuses</color> is Amplified by 100%. Defeating such enemies applies 1 stack of the same <color=Highlight>Negative Status</color> to nearby targets. Ceaseless Chant DMG is increased by 100%.
Lv. 3: Ceaseless Chant DMG is further increased. It explodes every 4s, dealing additional damage and increasing affected targets' <color=Highlight>Negative Status</color> stacks by 1.

Piercing Claw

A proving ground prepared just for you—and the graveyard for the countless knights who came before. Legends say this very soil witnessed the fall of the Third Grand Commander. Now, once in a while, when the rain falls on its mechanical remains, an elegy for the valiant is sound.

It was here that the Fifth Grand Commander led the knights in a final stand. Not against a tyrannical lord, but... a Void Storm capable of obliterating all life. They failed to overcome it... or did they?
This is where it began, long before they were called the Knights of the Wild. Here, a group of Mechascouts with no way home drained their last sparks of energy to save a single child.

This land may never have heard the noble knight tales that flutter through the windmills of Egla Town. Yet the stories born are no less worthy. Let them be remembered in the rustle of the grass and the sighing winds of the emerald plains.

Machines are not born with names. Yet... if one walks through the world with the bearing of a knight, does it not deserve a name of its own? So a young man once took up his pen and inscribed their names. Astra, Caldheim, Petrahane, Airelas...
Charge, my friend! Charge! Even if your hands hold no blade, you carry one within your heart. And who is to say that a machine cannot have a heart?

The Eighteenth Grand Commander... takes the humble form of a trash can. Yet, no one ever dares toss a wrapper or a pit into its belly. Within that metallic shell lay praises written for the Knights of the Wild.

They say the Seventeenth Grand Commander was a mere human who possessed no martial prowess to speak of. Yet before the Void Storm descended, it was he who guided the knights in a desperate, wandering flight, leading them from lands doomed to be cursed. But as for his fate...

[About]

At this year's Club Show & Tell, Van Tassie of the Psychological Threshold Alternative Therapy Society proudly unveils his latest project: the "F.U.E.L. Optimization Simulator." He claims this game will revolutionize the Academy's culinary experience by gathering the essential data.  As is par for the course, your name is on the playtest roster. Yet, something about the project's core design seems... slightly off from the outset.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and activate the Resonance Nexus in Startorch Academy during the Main Quest "What Burns Beneath Frostlands" to unlock.
(Notice: Complete "Gold Suspended in Shadows" to have a better gaming experience.)

[Rules]

1. How to Play

Access the event from the Mind Dive Arcade machine or the Event Page. Control your Resonator to move left and right to catch falling food and earn Gourmet Points.

2. Energy & Skills

Catch food to build Energy. Once your Energy bar is full, you can activate a powerful Resonator Skill.
Be careful—catching certain negative foods will drain your Energy and slow you down.

3. Clearing a Stage

Reach the target Gourmet Points to earn 1 Star to clear the stage. Quitting the game midway will finalize this stage based on the Gourmet Points earned.

4. Stage Unlocks

Stage 1 is available when the event begins. A new stage unlocks each following day, each featuring a new Resonator with unique skills.

5. Rewards

If you have any unclaimed rewards when the event ends, you can log in within 30 days afterward to claim them in your Mail.

Cubie Derby: Championship

[Event Duration]

2026-05-09 04:00 to 2026-05-25 03:59 (server time)

*From 2026-05-09 08:00 to 2026-05-23 19:30 (server time), you can support your favorite Cube every day. From 2026-05-23 20:30 to 2026-05-25 03:59 (server time), support will be closed. During this period, you can view race results, check the Patron Board, watch replays, and claim event rewards.

[About]

A new season of Cubie Derby is back for the 2nd Anniversary of the Second Coming of Solaris! Come watch the match and support your Cube!

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 8.

[Rules]

1. During the event, 18 Cubes will take part in matches in 3 Groups. Not counting the Final, 1 match takes place per day with 14 matches in total to decide the Ultimate Race Winner.
2. The entire competition is comprised of 3 Stages: Preliminary, Eliminator, and the Final. Please refer to the event schedule for specific times and dates.
3. Between the end of the previous match till half an hour before the next match starts (20:30 server time), you can support your favorite Cube by predicting the Match Winner of the day.
4. The match of the day starts at 21:00 server time. From the event page, you can view the race live broadcast and cheer for your favorite Cube in the live chat.
5. After the match, you will obtain Popularity rewards based on the Cubes' final placements and the prediction outcomes.
6. The Patron Board will open at 04:00 server time on the day after the Preliminary B - 2nd, and thereafter be updated at 04:00 on the next day after each match. You can view your ranking on the Patron Board.
7. After the Final, a commemorative item will be sent out to all Rovers who unlocked this event. Please claim it in time before the event ends.
8. Any unclaimed rewards will be reissued via in-game Mail upon your next login within 30 days after the event ends.

Lynae appears completely unfazed. She's here to kick ass and chew bubblegum!
"Easy peasy!" Lynae's flashing a victory sign at the camera. We're all looking forward to her next showing!
Lynae claims that given her past training, these contestants don't stand a chance. When pressed for details, she suddenly developed selective hearing and changed the subject. How suspicious!
Lynae is thrilled with her own performance and plans to go all out in the next match. She even mentioned something about a special surprise for the audience.
Lynae has declared that if she wins the Final, she'll spray paint a giant portrait of herself on the course. So far, the event organizers have declined to comment on the matter.
Congratulations to Lynae, our new Champion! In other news, event organizers quickly confiscated her spray paint right after she pulled out a can. A real pity, if you ask me.
Lynae states that the results do not matter, and she's here to have a good time.
Lynae is calling this a perfect finish! She's off to train now, aiming for back-to-back victories in the next Derby.
Mornye's initial concerns about her prosthetic legs proved unnecessary given her cube form. She's ready to compete as best as possible.
Mornye says she's quite used to hovering in the air. Her fondness for flight may well be the secret to her outstanding performance.
According to a few keen-eyed spectators, Mornye spent the entire night before the match de-stressing by calculating her odds of winning.
Mornye stated after the match that she really needed a triple-strength Instant Wakeup Energy Gel Sachet.
Mornye told us in an interview that despite not being particularly athletic, she's more than willing to demonstrate the might of the Spacetrek Collective techs.
Congratulations to Mornye for placing first in the competition! Mornye remarked that while this outcome didn't exactly match her calculations, life is always full of surprises.
Mornye stated that she will give it her absolute all in the final stretch of this competition.
Mornye expressed her joy at participating in this competition, noting that occasional outdoor exercise has increased her research efficiency.
Before the match begins, Aemeath sends her best to all Fleet Snowfluff fans, stating that she definitely won't let them down.
Aemeath thoroughly enjoyed the competition and has decided to put on a live show for the contestants and audience alike after the Final.
Aemeath credits her superhuman pace to her younger days spent chasing Snowfluff Seals.
Aemeath states that she is fully prepared for the next match. We can't wait to see her in action.
Aemeath hopes that her victory will make someone out there proud.
Inspired by her win, Aemeath is set to write a song about this competition. We can't wait to hear it!
Aemeath believes that a temporary setback is a minor inconvenience. She remains determined to prove her true strength in the Final.
What a brilliant performance! Let's give a big round of applause to Aemeath!
Luuk Herssen is in a remarkably calm and positive mindset before the match. He's stated that he simply intends to do his best.
Luuk Herssen demonstrated precise control during the match, which he attributes to the muscle memory developed from years of performing surgery.
Luuk Herssen has kindly offered medical aid and mental health support to those eliminated from the match. The event organizers extend their thanks for his generosity.
Luuk Herssen was not at all surprised by his win. But he does feel that he could have done even better.
Luuk Herssen says eating candy before a match is his secret to excellent performance.
Congratulations to Luuk Herssen on winning the Final! During his interview, he says he'll donate the prize money to children in need.
Luuk Herssen isn't disappointed with his result. He believes it was enough that he gave it his all.
Luuk Herssen is satisfied with his performance in the competition. He added that he'll likely be back for the next Derby.
Sigrika's parents sent her a good luck package before the match. To honor their expectations, she is determined to compete at her absolute best.
Sigrika is deeply grateful for everyone's support, and she has stated that she will achieve great results in the next match as well.
Sigrika states that she will redouble her efforts in the Eliminator. With the help of Soliskin, she's certain she'd win.
Sigrika says she finds this competition easy because she spends all day chasing Exoswarm.
Sigrika believes everyone who made it to the Final is incredibly strong, and that she's starting to feel the pressure...

Congratulations to Sigrika on becoming the Champion! In her interview, Sigrika thanked her family and friends in the Roya tribe, her classmates and teachers at Startorch Academy, as well as the Soliskin and Exoswarm... Let's give a round of applause for her victory!
Sigrika states that while she thoroughly enjoyed the competition, it's now time to conclude her journey with a spectacular victory.
Sigrika competed brilliantly in the Final! She's promised to keep pushing forward and is aiming for another championship next time.
Hiyuki declined our interview, stating that she would like to meditate in peace before the match.
When asked about her plans after her win in the Preliminary, Hiyuki stated that she would like to rest and eat something, preferably with a cup of fine tea.
In her interview, Hiyuki shared her daily sword practice routine. The event organizers kindly remind you: for safety reasons, please do not attempt these yourself.
Hiyuki won the Eliminator with ease. It looks like she's still holding back. You don't want to miss what she'll bring to the next match.
In her pre-Final interview, Hiyuki stated that she did not attempt to draw upon a future where she is victorious. She values the experience itself more than the outcome.
Huge congratulations to Hiyuki for coming out on top! She's dedicated to perfecting her skills and aims to create more miracles in the years to come.
Undeterred by her defeat, Hiyuki has decided to put everything on the line in the next match. Let's see what she can do!
An excellent result for Hiyuki in the Showmatch. We look forward to her performance in future Championship matches.
Denia doesn't think she has a chance of winning... She just wanted to do her best to make it to the finish line.
Denia is somewhat surprised that she wasn't eliminated in the Preliminary, though she chalks it up to a bit of luck.
We've heard from a reliable source that Denia is currently preparing for the match and is not in the locker room. Let's turn our cameras to the other contestants.
Denia has delivered another outstanding performance! She rather modestly remarked that luck was on her side again. Perhaps she really is the "chosen one" of the course!
Denia looks incredibly nervous at the starting line of the Final! Let's wait to see how the results unfold!
Denia has claimed victory in the Final! In her acceptance speech, she thanked her friends at Startorch Academy, whose support made it possible for her to reach this far.
Someone reported hearing things being smashed in Denia's locker room, but when we arrived, everything inside seemed to be fine. Maybe Denia got caught up in a video game.
Denia was outstanding in the Showmatch! She remarked that next time, she'll show us her true abilities. Can't wait to see what she's really capable of!
Chisa was reading a mystery novel an hour before the match, so the interview team decided not to bother her.
When asked about her post-match plans, Chisa said she'd be going to the Spacetrek Archive to look up some research papers.
Chisa cooked up a Lemon-Scented Sukiyaki in the locker room and shared her delicious meal with the other contestants.
Chisa notes that she knows how to find her way through a labyrinth, citing her experience in Honami City. In her view, that was the key to her success today.
Speaking after her victory, Chisa said she'd like to return to a certain cafe and hang a photo of her victory on the wall.
Congratulations to Chisa on her victory! After thanking her fellow competitors, a mysterious capybara showed up with victory snacks for her.
After reflecting on why things didn't go her way, Chisa reaffirmed her commitment to the competition. Win or lose, she won't let up on her prep work.
After winning the Showmatch, Chisa said she had a wonderful time competing alongside everyone.
When interviewed, Phrolova would not reveal her reasons for participating in the Derby and declared that her actions in cube form are not representative of her real self.
Phrolova has emerged victorious! Unfortunately, she left immediately after the match, so we were unable to complete our post-match interview.

Phrolova may not be on the best of terms with the other contestants, so the event organizers provided her with a private locker room. Melodious strains of violin can always be heard emanating from within.
Phrolova remarked that defeating her "rivals" has brought her a fleeting sense of satisfaction. She hopes to lead a climactic movement for everyone during the next match.
Phrolova says the time is ripe to bring her grand performance to its dramatic conclusion!
Phrolova has been crowned Champion! There was a flash of delight on her face before she reverted to her expressionless demeanor as if nothing had ever happened.
Phrolova vows that she will not fail a second time. She is prepared to do anything to bring this final movement to its conclusion.
Phrolova expressed her satisfaction with her final performance and offered her deepest regards to the opponents she defeated.
Augusta is fully prepared for the match and will storm the field with the force of a thunderbolt!
Augusta secured an effortless victory. It seems the competition was merely a small hunt for someone of her stature.
Augusta believes there are no shortcuts to victory. The only way to win is through relentless training and endless fighting.
Augusta is the first across the finish line! Let's give a huge cheer for yet another victory!

Augusta believes that future Agons should include elements of the Derby. It would keep certain gladiators from relying too much on Fortes and combat techniques while neglecting basic strength and endurance training.
Victory belongs to Augusta! She has nothing but high praise for the iron resolve and formidable strength shown by all participants. She looks forward to competing with them once more.
Augusta says that winning and losing are simply parts of the game. She is determined to turn the tide and secure a victory in the Showmatch.
Augusta feels she still has work to do and says she'll be back in the competition as soon as she's fully prepared.
Iuno declared that she will charge at the finish line, moonlight in arms.
Iuno claims that winning is a breeze, and the result is obvious even without a prophecy.
Iuno declined to be interviewed, saying she wanted to get a good night's sleep before the match.
Iuno is pleased with her showing. She noted that the Moonring's flight speed is still a bit on the slow side, else she would've finished even sooner.
Sticking to hunting tradition, Iuono performed a small divination ritual before the match. She's not one to blindly follow fate, but it seems to have strengthened her belief in victory.
Congratulations to Juno on her championship victory! May her glory endure forever, as timeless as the moonlight.
Iuno isn't quite pleased with her performance, but she's determined to see the competition through to the end.
Iuno has won the Showmatch. She expressed her gratitude for the audience's support and promised to do better next time.
Jinhsi states that she would not try for a better result by using her Temporal Mandate to return to the start of a match. She believes that every outcome is both precious and significant.
Jinhsi excelled in the Showmatch. She remarked that she was simply glad to have given it her all.
Changli admits that things haven't gone exactly to plan, but she believes a touch of the unexpected is more interesting than a predictable outcome.
Changli emerged victorious in the Showmatch. She hopes that by the next Derby, she will have formulated a more formidable winning strategy.
Calcharo believes that it wasn't a lack of effort on his part. There were just too many heavy hitters.
Following his victory in the Showmatch, Calcharo expressed his desire to celebrate with his Ghost Hounds.
Shorekeeper has suggested that if teleportation were allowed, her finish time would have been vastly improved.
After winning the Showmatch, Shorekeeper mentioned that she'll be reworking the office calendar so Black Shores staff have time to exercise on top of their regular duties.
Carlotta notes that victory or defeat hinges on numerous variables, including wind direction, temperature, barometric pressure, and even air humidity.
Carlotta came out on top in the Showmatch. She stated that she was well pleased with how she competed.
After careful reflection, Cartethyia eventually concluded that a wandering knight really does need a horse to go fast.
Cartethyia took the top spot in the Showmatch. She has decided to have a proper celebration after she gets back.
Phoebe believes everything is a trial of Imperator, and she accepts them all with gratitude.
Victory goes to Phoebe in the Showmatch! Phoebe chubby!

The ancient mountain stands tall, its peak reaching towards the sky. A river flows for thousands of years, forming the blade of a powerful weapon. As it is unsheathed, a powerful dragon's roar echoes through the heavens and earth, causing the sea to churn. This awe-inspiring weapon strikes fear in all who witness its might.

The Exclusive ROM for Changli.
Forged from the very essence and feathers of a legendary bird, this weapon blazes with an intensity that bathes the world in its luminous glow. With each fiery surge, it consumes all in its path, leaving nothing but ashes in its wake.

The Exclusive ROM for Jinhsi.
Each swing of the blade reveals the flow of time and the change of the stars. The sword embodies all things, uniting them into one. Its gentle aura seems capable of dissolving the indestructible, whether it's millennia-old ice or the stagnation of time.

The Exclusive ROM for Galbrena.
From darkness she seizes power, layering sins upon herself. To hunt. To kill. To deliver a relentless and fatal blow to all evil.
From the light she falls, with her vows etched in her mind. For the deceased. For the living. For her pistols' true targets.

The Exclusive ROM for Lupa.
The young wolf races through the wilds, shedding every shadow that once held her back.
The lone wolf strides into the arena, cutting down each obstacle in her path.
She seizes victory. She claims glory. She raises everything she has high above. She belongs to the arena, but even more, she belongs to herself.

The Exclusive ROM for Iuno.
By what means do all things endure? By light and heat, by matter and word, by the mechanics of converging chances, by the soft dissolution into silence, by a moment that mimics the eternal... All things rise and fall in endless rhythm, each bearing its meaning. As for hers, it lies here within her grasp.

The Exclusive ROM for Ciaccona.
All things exist within the lines of poetry. Every sound has its meters and rhymes.
The forest's melodies ascend in spirals toward the moon's silvered grace, harmonized by the nightingales' chorus. When the final note falls and vanishes into the silent earth, a flawless chord echoes endlessly in the depths of this boundless realm.

The Exclusive ROM for Augusta.
Thunder shall purge her pain and weakness. From the crucible of blood and sand, the Sun rises. Not dimmed by dust, but ablaze in her full radiance.

The Exclusive ROM for Chisa.
A crimson thread emerges in the void, as if binding the structures of all things onto a single thread.
At her fingertips, the endless season is drawn taut, snipped, and rewoven, until the scattered path at last converges once more upon this timeline.

The Exclusive ROM for Mornye.
Every pattern can be observed. Every phenomenon can be understood.
The ideal may lie light-years away, yet the path toward it rests within her own hands.

The Exclusive ROM for Lynae.
Prismatic light dances at her fingertips, arcs of color carving radiant trails.
Every rushing hue converges upon her aim, and at last, she reaches a sky where nothing lies beyond her sight.

The Exclusive ROM for Denia.
Dream dissolves like foam, leaving only a silent white dwarf.
Yet the light that once swept the cosmos remains.
She waits in quiescence until her borrowed light finds its way back to the main sequence star.

The Exclusive ROM for Luuk Herssen.
Those are not ridges of the mountains, but the spine of the earth, carrying the night. They protrude from the abdomen of darkness. From the incision spills the light of new life.
Your shadow was nailed to the dying night. With the breaking dawn, your flesh shall rise.
Let it knock open every door of denial.

The Exclusive ROM for Aemeath.
As you drift across the hushed sea of stars, stardust scatters beside you as time crumbles in your wake. All that remains is the unyielding loneliness, warped, diluted, and remade into the plumes of your wings.
The universe sends you on a tribulation of silence, yet you travel on, repaying in radiance.

The Exclusive ROM for Sigrika.
Sunlight gathers. The answer is made plain.
What must be done awaits. The Rein is in your hand.
Step forward, toward the sunlit end.

The Exclusive ROM for Hiyuki.
How keen a blade it takes to impale this unrelenting night?
She presses ever forward for the answer, those unbound wishes roaring in her veins.

Into the Land of Paradox

[About]
Startorch Academy and the Roya Tribe have joined forces to establish a foothold on the Dimmr Plains, launching a joint scientific expedition into this long-isolated realm. Objectives include collecting environmental data, recovering ancient plant samples and Exostrider components, and remediating environmental damage caused by Void Storms. The fruits of this operation will effectively advance ecological research and habitat restoration in Lahai-Roi.
You receive a message from I.R.I.S., inviting you to join the inaugural expedition...

[Eligibility]
Complete Main Quest "Starlights from Yesterdays" to unlock.

[Rules]
What appears to be an entirely new species of ancient trees has been discovered across four sectors of the Dimmr Plains. The Department of Light Energy Sciences has officially named them Voidbane Eldertrees. Due to the combined effects of the Solvein Heartwood and Void Storm contamination, these specimens have become stunted and irregular in their growth. The expedition team has developed a plan to restore them to full health.

Work with the Survey Team members to clear Voidmatter contamination and other anomalies within the sectors to complete the necessary preparations.

The required material, "Restoratives," can be obtained through each sector's exploration tasks and challenges. Deliver the required quantity of Restoratives for a sector to restore its Voidbane Eldertree.

Complete Restoration of a tree grants you rare Prism Fruits, which can be delivered to I.R.I.S. at the Base Camp to advance exploration progress and expand your base.

Once you have completed all Restoration activities across the Dimmr Plains and upgraded the Base Camp to Level 5, the energy flow from the Solvein Heartwood will be intensified, making the Dimmr Plains shine once more.

Echo Management Optimization

[Echo Management]
You can create multiple management plans for Echoes based on COST, Sonata Effects, and Mainstats.
When a new Echo is obtained, it will automatically be locked or marked for discard according to the enabled plans.
Echo Management Plans do not affect already upgraded Echoes.

[Presets, Sharing & Importing]
You can import recommended management plans via the Suggested Plans feature, or import other Rovers' configurations via the Sharing & Importing feature.
After importing, all local plans will be overwritten and enabled.
Echo Smart Discard

Echo Smart Discard provides two discard methods: Suggested Plan and Custom Management Plan. They can be selected at the same time.

Based on the selected methods, Echo Smart Discard can quickly filter and discard owned Echoes that are unupgraded, unequipped, and not locked.

Startorch Racing, Rerun!

[About]
Startorch Racing is back! This time, it's not just a race against the clock. You're going head-to-head against other players. Hop on your expedition motorbike and throttle toward the finish line!

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 8 and unlock the "Expedition Motorbike" Utility.

[Rules]
1. In "Startorch Racing, Rerun!", players need to compete against other players in Co-op Mode on select racetracks. Players are ranked by the order they reach the finish line.
2. Once the first player crosses the finish line, the race enters a 20-second countdown. The race will automatically end after the countdown.
3. During the race, all combat skills will be locked. Follow the trackers to pass the checkpoints and cross the finish line to complete the race.
4. During the race, players holding the 1st place for a certain period activate the "Front Runner" state, granting a special leaderboard display. Players staying in the 3rd place for a certain period activate "Power Boost," granting them a performance buff and a special leaderboard display.
5. The Co-op race starts when all players join the instance. The max wait time is 120s.
6. When a Co-op race starts, the host cannot quit the Co-op instance, nor disband the party.
7. The race will be automatically ended after 300s.
8. The map resources for the corresponding levels must be downloaded first.
9. Once the race ends, select "Quit Co-op" to return to your own world.
10. Once the race ends, you may select "Restart" to invite other players to another race. The race restarts when all others agree.
11. All players have an Energy Tank cap of 2,400 in this race, regardless of Resonator skills.
12. Special rule for this race: Hop Dash cannot be used after Bounce Jump.

Sanhua used to believe that transience was the root of all beauty in the world. Just like snow and ice, so pure and captivating, but destined to melt. But sometimes, as she holds a frozen flower in her hand, she wonders - is she admiring its fleeting beauty or mourning its inevitable demise? She freezes the frosty blossom, determined to preserve it for just a little longer. Just like this moment with all its precious memories and beauty that she vows to protect forever.
Ksana

Baizhi's been preserving this pair of rings from her time at Huaxu Academy. They are identical in shape and style, with only slight differences in wear. Their origins are a mystery—some say they're a memento from a deceased family member, others claim they are some kind of <te href=850076>Remnant</te> technology device that Baizhi and her team created to strengthen her bond with <te href=850140>You'tan</te>.
Though no one really knows why Baizhi cherishes these seemingly modest rings so much, and she has never cared to explain, only Baizhi understands their true significance. To her, they are the embodiment of her past team's efforts and a poignant reminder of her teammates and mentors who sacrificed themselves deep in the icebound plain. These rings represent the teachings and expectations they held for her, driving her to carry on their will and continue the research in Remnant Ecoacoustics.
Simplistic Rings

Baizhi meticulously studied the behavioral patterns of <te href=850140>You'tan</te> and recorded detailed data. But many mysteries still surround this <te href=850076>Remnant</te> Creature: What is its composition? How did it come into existence? And are there other similar creatures to be found? Inspired by her colleague's words, Baizhi embarked on a modeling project to recreate You'tan. The result is a complex model consisting of 205 components. It's said that Baizhi can assemble it flawlessly, even with her eyes closed. While not as intricate as the real You'tan, this model serves as a deconstruction and ambitious attempt to replicate the creature from frequencies to a physical form.
Miniature You'tan

It is a remembrance and an honor. 
There are still many uncharted territories in the field of science waiting for explorers like them to enter and make their voices heard. Humans will respond positively to their voices, which is the meaning of their research on "<te href=850076>Remnant Energy</te>."
Medal of Honor

I've been wanting to find a way to help people tell the difference between fake images and real photos, but it seems there's still a lot of work to do. What should I do...

This is Squeakie, my plushie. Here, give it a squeeze—isn't it adorable? I made it when I first joined <te href=850090>Lollo Logistics</te>. Everything was new, I mean, scarily new… and I was super nervous about the job… So having Squeakie around was such a comfort!
